attributes.name: harvest_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the yield record. 'draft' indicates data is being captured; 'in_progress' indicates active harvest pass; 'completed' indicates finalized and reconciled; 'cancelled' indicates voided record; 'pending_review' indicates awaiting quality or agronomic sign-off.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP; Granular Farm Management; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: harvested_area_acres
attributes.description: GPS-tracked actual harvested area in acres for this harvest pass. May differ from planted area due to field boundaries, obstacles, or partial harvests. Sourced from John Deere Operations Center precision agriculture data. Used as denominator for yield per acre (YPM) calculations.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; USDA RMA; GLOBALG.A.P.; Esri ArcGIS

attributes.name: moisture_adjusted_production_bu
attributes.description: Total production adjusted to standard moisture basis in bushels. Calculated as: total_production_bu × ((100 - moisture_pct_at_harvest) / (100 - standard_moisture_pct)). Used for grain settlement, sales contract fulfillment, and financial crop enterprise accounting.
attributes.references: USDA Grain Inspection; FGIS; SAP S/4HANA MM; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: moisture_pct_at_harvest
attributes.description: Grain moisture content percentage measured at the time of harvest (as-harvested moisture). Critical for drying cost calculation, storage decisions, and moisture-adjusted yield computation. Sourced from combine moisture sensor data via John Deere Operations Center.
attributes.references: USDA Grain Inspection; FGIS (Federal Grain Inspection Service); SAP S/4HANA QM

attributes.name: mrl_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the harvested crop has been assessed as compliant with applicable Maximum Residue Limits (MRL) for pesticide residues per EPA, Codex Alimentarius, and destination market requirements. Required for export documentation and food safety compliance.
attributes.references: EPA; Codex Alimentarius; FDA; GLOBALG.A.P.; ISO 22000

attributes.name: ndvi_at_harvest
attributes.business_glossary_term: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) at Harvest
attributes.description: NDVI value recorded for the field at or near the harvest date. Ranges from -1 to +1; values above 0.6 indicate healthy dense canopy. Used to correlate remote sensing data with actual yield outcomes for predictive yield modeling and AI/ML applications.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS; Climate FieldView; NASA; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: organic_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this harvest was produced under USDA National Organic Program (NOP) certified conditions. Drives premium pricing, segregation requirements, and organic certificate of analysis (COA) documentation.
attributes.references: USDA NOP; GLOBALG.A.P.; ISO 22000; FDA FSMA

attributes.name: phi_compliance_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) for all applied crop protection products has been satisfied prior to this harvest date. Mandatory compliance check under EPA pesticide registration requirements and FSMA produce safety rules.
attributes.references: EPA; FDA FSMA; GLOBALG.A.P.; SAP S/4HANA QM

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this yield record was sourced. Enables data lineage tracking and reconciliation across John Deere Operations Center, Climate FieldView, Trimble Ag Software, and Granular Farm Management integrations.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; Climate FieldView; Trimble Ag Software; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: standard_moisture_pct
attributes.description: Industry-standard moisture basis used for moisture-adjusted yield calculation (e.g., 15.5% for corn, 13% for soybeans). Defined by USDA grain grading standards and used as the reference point for dry bushel equivalents.
attributes.references: USDA Grain Inspection; FGIS; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: test_weight_lbs_per_bu
attributes.description: Grain test weight measured in pounds per bushel (lbs/bu) at harvest. Key grain quality indicator used for USDA grade determination. Below-standard test weight may result in grade discounts at grain elevator. Sourced from combine sensors or grain elevator COA.
attributes.references: USDA Grain Inspection; FGIS; SAP S/4HANA QM

attributes.name: total_production_bu
attributes.description: Total gross grain production in bushels (BU) recorded for this harvest pass at as-harvested moisture. Primary production quantity used for grain receipt (GRN) creation, sales contract fulfillment, and crop insurance documentation.
attributes.references: USDA Grain Inspection; SAP S/4HANA MM; USDA RMA; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: total_production_mt
attributes.description: Total gross grain production converted to metric tons (MT) for international trade, export documentation, and financial reporting under IFRS. Derived from total_production_bu using commodity-specific conversion factors.
attributes.references: Codex Alimentarius; IFRS; FAO; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this yield record was last modified. Used for change data capture (CDC), audit trail, and data quality monitoring in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 22000; FSMA; SOX; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: yield_per_acre
attributes.description: Actual harvested yield expressed as bushels per acre (BU/acre) for this harvest pass. Core agronomic performance metric (YPM) used for benchmarking against field crop plan targets, historical averages, and regional USDA NASS yield data.
attributes.references: USDA NASS; USDA RMA; GLOBALG.A.P.; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: yield_target_bu_per_acre
attributes.description: Planned yield target in bushels per acre (BU/acre) from the associated crop plan for this field-season-variety combination. Used to compute yield variance and performance against plan for financial crop enterprise accounting.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; SAP S/4HANA PP; USDA RMA

attributes.name: yield_variance_bu_per_acre
attributes.description: Difference between actual yield_per_acre and yield_target_bu_per_acre. Positive value indicates above-plan performance; negative value indicates shortfall. Used for financial crop enterprise accounting, crop insurance (USDA RMA APH), and agronomic benchmarking.
attributes.references: USDA RMA; Granular Farm Management; SAP S/4HANA CO

Supports NRCS Conservation Stewardship Program (CSP) documentation, GAP soil health certification, and long-term land productivity management within Granular Farm Management.

attributes.description: The final approved indemnity payment amount in US dollars as determined by the approved insurance provider (AIP) and USDA RMA following completion of the loss adjustment process. Used for financial loss reporting and SAP FI/CO posting.
attributes.references: USDA RMA Final Loss Determination; MPCI Policy; GAAP; IFRS; SOX Financial Reporting Controls

attributes.name: gis_polygon_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the GIS polygon or spatial feature in Esri ArcGIS representing the precise geographic boundary of the affected area within the field. Enables spatial analysis and precision agriculture integration.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Spatial Reference Standards; USDA FSA CLU GIS Standards; GPS/RTK Field Mapping

attributes.name: indemnity_determination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the final indemnity amount was officially determined and approved by the insurance provider and USDA RMA. Triggers financial posting in SAP FI and revenue recognition under GAAP/IFRS.
attributes.references: USDA RMA Final Loss Determination; GAAP Revenue Recognition; IFRS 15; SOX

attributes.name: insurance_claim_number
attributes.description: The unique claim number assigned by the approved insurance provider (AIP) or USDA RMA upon formal submission of the loss event claim. Used for claim tracking and ADM system integration.
attributes.references: USDA RMA ADM System; MPCI Claim Processing; Standard Reinsurance Agreement (SRA)

attributes.name: loss_cause
attributes.description: Primary cause or peril responsible for the crop loss or damage event. Determines applicable insurance coverage type and USDA RMA cause-of-loss code. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hail|drought|flood|frost|pest|disease|wind|fire|excess_moisture|prevented_planting — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA RMA Cause of Loss Codes; MPCI Policy; Crop-Hail Policy

attributes.name: loss_cause_detail
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the specific cause of loss, providing additional context beyond the primary cause code (e.g., 'Late-season frost event on 2024-04-15, temperatures dropped to -3°C for 4 hours'). Supports adjuster documentation and RMA claim narrative.
attributes.references: USDA RMA Loss Adjustment Manual (LAM); GLOBALG.A.P. Incident Reporting

attributes.name: loss_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the crop loss or damage event occurred or was first observed. This is the principal real-world event date used for insurance claim eligibility and PHI/REI compliance verification.
attributes.references: USDA RMA MPCI Policy; FSMA Traceability Rule; ISO 22000

attributes.name: loss_description
attributes.description: Full narrative description of the crop loss event including observed damage symptoms, affected crop growth stage, and initial field conditions. Used for agronomic risk management and insurance documentation.
attributes.references: USDA RMA Loss Adjustment Manual (LAM); GAP Documentation Standards; ISO 22000

attributes.name: loss_severity
attributes.description: Categorical severity classification of the crop loss event based on the assessed yield loss percentage. Used for prioritization of adjuster resources, financial risk reporting, and agronomic risk management KPI tracking.
attributes.references: USDA RMA Loss Severity Classification; MPCI Policy; GLOBALG.A.P. Risk Assessment

attributes.name: ndvi_at_loss
attributes.business_glossary_term: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) at Loss
attributes.description: NDVI value recorded for the affected field area at or near the time of the loss event, derived from satellite or drone imagery. Provides objective remote-sensing evidence of crop health degradation for insurance and agronomic documentation.
attributes.references: NDVI Remote Sensing Standards; Climate FieldView; Esri ArcGIS; USDA RMA Precision Agriculture Evidence

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, adjuster comments, or agronomic observations related to the loss event that do not fit structured fields. Supports comprehensive documentation for insurance and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: USDA RMA Loss Adjustment Manual (LAM); GAP Documentation Standards

attributes.name: phi_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the crop loss event and any associated pesticide applications were compliant with the Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) requirements at the time of loss. Critical for food safety and MRL compliance documentation under FSMA and EPA regulations.
attributes.references: EPA Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) Requirements; FSMA Produce Safety Rule; FDA MRL Standards; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: policy_coverage_type
attributes.description: Type of crop insurance policy coverage applicable to this loss event. Determines the indemnity calculation methodology and USDA RMA reporting requirements.
attributes.references: USDA RMA Policy Coverage Types; MPCI; Crop-Hail; Revenue Protection (RP); 7 CFR Part 457

attributes.name: prevented_planting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the loss event qualifies as a prevented planting claim under USDA RMA MPCI policy, where the insured was unable to plant the insured crop by the final planting date due to an insured cause of loss.
attributes.references: USDA RMA Prevented Planting Provisions; MPCI Policy; 7 CFR Part 457.8

attributes.name: replanting_recommended
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agronomist or loss adjuster has recommended replanting of the affected area following the loss event. Triggers replanting payment eligibility assessment under MPCI policy.
attributes.references: USDA RMA Replanting Payment Provisions; MPCI Policy; GAP Agronomic Standards

attributes.name: reported_date
attributes.description: The date on which the crop loss event was formally reported to the crop insurance agent or USDA RMA. Critical for claim filing deadline compliance under MPCI policy terms.
attributes.references: USDA RMA MPCI Policy Notice of Loss Requirements; 7 CFR Part 457

attributes.name: rma_adm_submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which the loss event claim data was electronically submitted to the USDA Risk Management Agency (RMA) Actuarial Data Master (ADM) system for official claim processing and reinsurance reporting.
attributes.references: USDA RMA ADM Electronic Submission Requirements; Standard Reinsurance Agreement (SRA); 7 CFR Part 400

attributes.name: total_field_acres
attributes.description: Total insured acreage of the field at the time of the loss event. Used to calculate the percentage of field affected and to validate affected_area_acres against the insured unit.
attributes.references: USDA RMA Acreage Reporting; FSA CLU; MPCI Insured Unit Definition

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the crop loss event record was last modified. Supports audit trail, data lineage tracking, and change management for insurance claim documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FSMA Record-Keeping Requirements; ISO 22000; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: yield_loss_bu_acre
attributes.description: Estimated yield loss expressed in bushels per acre (BU/acre) resulting from the crop loss event. Primary quantitative metric for MPCI indemnity calculation and agronomic impact assessment. Aligns with YPM reporting standards.
attributes.references: USDA RMA Yield Loss Calculation; MPCI Policy; YPM Reporting Standards

attributes.name: yield_loss_pct
attributes.description: Estimated yield loss expressed as a percentage of the expected yield for the affected area. Used for crop-hail policy claims and comparative loss analysis across fields and seasons.
attributes.references: USDA RMA Crop-Hail Policy; MPCI Loss Ratio Reporting; WASDE Impact Analysis

products.name: cover_crop
products.description: Master record for cover crop plantings used in conservation and soil health programs between primary cash crop seasons. Captures cover crop species or mix, seeding rate, planting date, termination date and method, biomass estimate, and associated field and growing season references.

attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the cover crop planting record. Primary key for the cover_crop entity.

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.description: Reference to the agricultural field on which this cover crop was planted. Links to the land and soil domain field master record.

attributes.name: grazing_herd_id

attributes.description: Reference to the growing season during which this cover crop planting is associated. Typically the off-season or inter-season period between primary cash crop seasons.

attributes.name: organic_certification_id

attributes.description: Reference to the agronomist or crop advisor responsible for prescribing and overseeing this cover crop planting program.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. IFA; GAP (Good Agricultural Practices)

attributes.name: rotation_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the crop rotation plan that prescribes this cover crop planting as part of a multi-season soil health or conservation strategy.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Conservation Practice Standard 340; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: seed_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the seed lot used for this cover crop planting. Enables traceability from field planting back to seed origin, certification class, germination test results, and supplier.

attributes.name: station_id
attributes.description: Reference to the weather station providing meteorological data (temperature, precipitation, ET) for this cover crop planting location. Supports growing degree day calculations and irrigation scheduling.
attributes.references: Climate FieldView; John Deere Operations Center; NOAA weather data integration

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to equipment.work_order. Business justification: Cover crop planting and termination operations require work orders for equipment scheduling and cost tracking. NRCS/CSP practice payment documentation requires linking cover crop field activities to a
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: biomass_estimate_lbs_acre
attributes.description: Estimated above-ground dry biomass produced by the cover crop at termination, expressed in pounds per acre. Key indicator of soil organic matter contribution, nitrogen cycling potential, and weed suppression effectiveness.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Practice Standard 340; Sustainable Agriculture Research & Education (SARE)

attributes.name: cover_crop_type
attributes.description: Functional classification of the cover crop by plant family or agronomic category. Determines nitrogen fixation potential, biomass contribution, and soil health benefit. 'mix' indicates a multi-species blend.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Conservation Practice Standard 340; Sustainable Agriculture Research & Education (SARE)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cover crop planting record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and record provenance tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) audit trail requirements; GLOBALG.A.P. record-keeping

attributes.name: csp_contract_number
attributes.description: USDA Conservation Stewardship Program contract number under which this cover crop planting qualifies for conservation payment. Links field-level practice to federal program financial records.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Conservation Stewardship Program (CSP); USDA Farm Service Agency

attributes.name: days_to_termination
attributes.description: Number of calendar days between the cover crop planting date and the actual termination date. Indicates the length of the cover crop growing window and is used to assess biomass accumulation potential and program compliance.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Practice Standard 340; SARE cover crop management guidelines

attributes.name: establishment_rating
attributes.description: Field-assessed qualitative rating of cover crop stand establishment success. Evaluated by agronomist or field scout based on germination uniformity, plant density, and canopy coverage. Informs replanting decisions.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. IFA; USDA NRCS Practice Standard 340

attributes.name: fsma_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cover crop termination timing and method comply with FSMA Produce Safety Rule requirements for application of biological soil amendments. Particularly relevant for fields transitioning to fresh produce crops.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Produce Safety Rule (21 CFR Part 112); GLOBALG.A.P. IFA

attributes.name: gps_coverage_geojson
attributes.description: GeoJSON polygon representing the GPS-mapped boundary of the actual cover crop planted area within the field. Supports precision agriculture spatial analysis, as-applied mapping, and NRCS program acreage verification.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS; John Deere Operations Center; Trimble Ag Software; USDA FSA CLU

attributes.name: is_bmp_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cover crop planting meets applicable Best Management Practices (BMP) for water quality, nutrient management, and erosion control as defined by state or federal environmental agencies.
attributes.references: EPA BMP (Best Management Practices); USDA NRCS; State environmental agencies

attributes.name: ndvi_at_termination
attributes.business_glossary_term: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) at Termination
attributes.description: NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) value measured at or near the cover crop termination date. Provides an objective, remote-sensing-based indicator of cover crop biomass and canopy health at termination.
attributes.references: Climate FieldView; John Deere Operations Center; NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) standard

attributes.name: nitrogen_credit_lbs_acre
attributes.description: Estimated plant-available nitrogen credit in pounds per acre attributed to legume cover crop nitrogen fixation or biomass decomposition. Used to adjust NPK fertilizer application rates for the subsequent cash crop season.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Nutrient Management Practice Standard 590; EPA Nutrient Management

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for agronomist or operator observations regarding this cover crop planting, including establishment challenges, weather impacts, pest pressure, or special management actions taken.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. IFA record-keeping requirements; GAP (Good Agricultural Practices)

attributes.name: nrcs_practice_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: NRCS (Natural Resources Conservation Service) Practice Code
attributes.description: USDA Natural Resources Conservation Service conservation practice standard code associated with this cover crop planting (e.g., '340' for Cover Crop). Required for EQIP, CSP, and other USDA conservation program payment documentation.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Conservation Practice Standard 340; EQIP; CSP

attributes.name: organic_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cover crop planting is conducted under a certified organic production system in compliance with USDA National Organic Program (NOP) standards. Affects allowable termination methods and input restrictions.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP); GLOBALG.A.P. Organic

attributes.name: planned_planting_date
attributes.description: Originally scheduled planting date for the cover crop as defined in the rotation plan or agronomic prescription. Enables variance analysis between planned and actual planting timing.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; Trimble Ag Software field planning

attributes.name: planted_area_acres
attributes.description: Total area in acres on which the cover crop was successfully planted. Used for seed cost accounting, NRCS program payment calculations, and soil health program reporting.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS CSP; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: planting_date
attributes.description: Actual calendar date on which the cover crop seed was planted or broadcast in the field. Used for growing degree day (GDD) accumulation tracking, establishment assessment, and program compliance verification.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. IFA; Climate FieldView planting records; USDA NRCS

attributes.name: planting_method
attributes.description: Method used to establish the cover crop. Affects seed-to-soil contact, establishment success rate, and seeding rate requirements. 'interseeding' refers to planting into a standing cash crop canopy.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Plant Materials Program; Trimble Ag Software; Climate FieldView

attributes.name: planting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cover crop planting record. Tracks progression from planning through establishment and termination. 'failed' indicates the cover crop did not establish adequately.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. IFA; USDA NRCS Practice Standard 340

attributes.name: prescribed_seeding_rate_lbs_acre
attributes.description: Agronomist-prescribed target seeding rate in pounds per acre as specified in the cover crop prescription or rotation plan. Enables variance analysis against actual seeding rate applied.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software VRA prescriptions; USDA NRCS Practice Standard 340

attributes.name: primary_goal
attributes.description: Primary agronomic or conservation objective for planting this cover crop. Drives species selection, seeding rate, and termination timing decisions. Used in NRCS program reporting and CSP payment calculations.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Conservation Stewardship Program (CSP); BMP (Best Management Practices)

attributes.name: record_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally referenceable business identifier for this cover crop planting record. Used in field documentation, NRCS program submissions, and CSP contract reporting. Format: CC-{YEAR}-{SEQUENCE}.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Conservation Stewardship Program (CSP); FMIS record numbering

attributes.name: seed_cost_usd
attributes.description: Total seed cost in US dollars for this cover crop planting, calculated from seed lot unit cost and quantity used. Used in enterprise budget tracking, NRCS program cost-share calculations, and crop enterprise profitability analysis.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management financial planning; SAP S/4HANA CO module; USDA EQIP cost-share

attributes.name: seeding_rate_lbs_acre
attributes.description: Actual seeding rate applied for the cover crop, expressed in pounds of seed per acre. Used to verify compliance with NRCS practice standards, calculate seed costs, and assess establishment adequacy.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Practice Standard 340; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA

attributes.name: soil_cover_pct
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of soil surface covered by the cover crop canopy or residue at peak growth or at termination. Key metric for erosion control effectiveness and NRCS practice standard compliance verification.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Practice Standard 340; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA

attributes.name: soil_temperature_at_planting_c
attributes.description: Soil temperature in degrees Celsius measured at the time of cover crop planting. Critical for predicting germination success and establishment timing, particularly for cool-season cover crop species.
attributes.references: Climate FieldView; USDA NRCS agronomy technical notes

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this cover crop planting record originated. Supports data lineage, integration audit trails, and conflict resolution in the FMIS data lakehouse.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance; SAP S/4HANA; Climate FieldView; Trimble Ag Software; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: species_mix_name
attributes.description: Common name or blend designation of the cover crop species or species mix planted (e.g., 'Winter Rye', 'Crimson Clover', 'Cereal Rye + Hairy Vetch Mix'). Supports soil health program documentation and seed procurement.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Plant Materials Program; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA

attributes.name: species_scientific_name
attributes.description: Botanical (scientific) name of the primary cover crop species or lead species in a mix (e.g., 'Secale cereale', 'Trifolium incarnatum'). Required for NRCS program compliance and GLOBALG.A.P. documentation.
attributes.references: USDA PLANTS Database; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the cover crop was terminated (killed or incorporated). Critical for calculating days of cover, biomass accumulation, and ensuring adequate decomposition time before primary crop planting.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Practice Standard 340; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA; FSMA Produce Safety Rule

attributes.name: termination_method
attributes.description: Method used to terminate (kill) the cover crop prior to primary crop planting. Affects residue management, soil disturbance, and organic certification compliance. 'roller_crimper' is preferred in no-till and organic systems.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Practice Standard 340; National Organic Program (NOP); GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cover crop planting record was last modified. Supports change tracking, data quality monitoring, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) audit trail requirements; GLOBALG.A.P. record-keeping

attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P.; GAP Standards; Climate FieldView

attributes.name: harvest_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the harvest operation commenced on the field. Used for equipment utilization analysis, OEE calculation, and operator time tracking.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; SAP S/4HANA PP Module

attributes.name: harvested_area_acres
attributes.description: Total field area harvested during this event, measured in acres. Used for yield-per-acre calculations, crop insurance reporting, and FSA acreage certification.
attributes.references: USDA FSA; USDA RMA; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: is_gmo
attributes.description: Indicates whether the harvested crop contains genetically modified organism (GMO) traits. Required for identity preservation, COOL labeling, export documentation, and USDA APHIS compliance.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; USDA NOP; COOL regulations; EU GMO labeling directives

attributes.name: moisture_pct_at_harvest
attributes.description: Grain moisture content percentage measured at the time of harvest. Critical for determining drying requirements, storage eligibility, and moisture-adjusted yield calculations. Industry standard for corn is 15.5%, soybeans 13%.
attributes.references: USDA GIPSA; GLOBALG.A.P.; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

attributes.name: mrl_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the harvested crop meets Maximum Residue Limit (MRL) requirements for pesticide residues as established by EPA, FDA, and applicable international standards (Codex Alimentarius).
attributes.references: EPA MRL regulations; FDA; Codex Alimentarius; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: ndvi_at_harvest
attributes.business_glossary_term: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) at Harvest
attributes.description: NDVI value captured from satellite or drone imagery at or near the time of harvest. Used to correlate canopy health with final yield outcomes and validate remote sensing models.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS; Climate FieldView; Trimble Ag Software; NASA NDVI standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operator or agronomist observations about the harvest event, including equipment issues, field conditions, crop anomalies, or other contextual information not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P.; GAP Standards

attributes.name: organic_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the harvested crop was produced under USDA National Organic Program (NOP) certified conditions. Required for organic premium pricing, identity preservation, and NOP compliance documentation.
attributes.references: USDA NOP; USDA AMS; GLOBALG.A.P. Organic

attributes.name: phi_compliance_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) for all applied crop protection products has been satisfied prior to this harvest event. Mandatory for food safety and MRL compliance under FSMA and EPA regulations.
attributes.references: EPA PHI requirements; FSMA; GLOBALG.A.P.; FDA MRL standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this harvest event data originated (e.g., John Deere Operations Center, Climate FieldView, SAP S/4HANA PP). Supports data lineage and SSOT governance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; John Deere Operations Center; Climate FieldView

attributes.name: source_system_event_reference
attributes.description: Native identifier of this harvest event in the originating operational system (e.g., John Deere Operations Center machine data ID, Climate FieldView harvest activity ID). Enables cross-system reconciliation and audit traceability.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; Climate FieldView; SAP S/4HANA PP Module

attributes.name: standard_moisture_pct
attributes.description: Industry-standard moisture percentage used as the basis for moisture-adjusted yield calculations and grain pricing (e.g., 15.5% for corn, 13.0% for soybeans per USDA GIPSA standards).
attributes.references: USDA GIPSA; CBOT grain standards

attributes.name: test_weight_lbs_per_bu
attributes.description: Grain density measurement expressed as pounds per bushel (lbs/bu), indicating grain quality and maturity. Used for grade determination and price dockage calculations per USDA GIPSA standards.
attributes.references: USDA GIPSA; Federal Grain Inspection Service (FGIS)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this harvest event record was last modified in the data platform. Supports change tracking, data quality monitoring, and audit compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 22000; FSMA; SOX; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: parent_harvest_event_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on harvest_event (parent_harvest_event_id)

products.name: grain_delivery
products.description: This association product represents the Grain Delivery event between a yield_record and a delivery_location. It captures the operational record of a specific quantity of harvested grain being allocated and physically delivered from a harvest operation to an authorized customer receiving location. Each record links one yield_record to one delivery_location and carries delivery-specific attributes — quantity, date, load ticket, quality grade at delivery, moisture at delivery, and COOL compliance — that exist only in the context of this specific delivery transaction and cannot reside on either the yield record or the delivery location alone.. Existence Justification: In grain merchandising operations, a single harvest load (yield_record) is routinely split across multiple delivery destinations — a grain elevator, an export terminal, and a food plant dock may all receive portions of the same harvest. Conversely, a customer delivery location receives commodity from many yield records across multiple fields, operators, and seasons. The business actively manages these allocations as 'grain deliveries' or 'load allocations', tracking quantity delivered, moisture at delivery, quality grade, load ticket number, and COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) verification — data that belongs to neither the yield record nor the delivery location alone.
products.reference: Internal - M:N Association

attributes.name: grain_delivery_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the grain_delivery association
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association PK

attributes.name: delivery_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking this grain delivery to the authorized customer receiving location where the grain was delivered.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: yield_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking this grain delivery to the specific harvest yield record from which the delivered grain originated.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: allocated_quantity_mt
attributes.description: Quantity of grain from this yield record allocated and delivered to this specific delivery location, expressed in metric tons. Belongs to the delivery relationship — the same yield record may have different quantities allocated to different locations.
attributes.references: DECIMAL(14,4)

attributes.name: cool_origin_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) compliance has been verified for this specific grain delivery. Required for food manufacturing and retail customers under USDA COOL regulations. Belongs to the delivery event as it is verified per shipment, not per yield record or per location.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: delivery_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the grain was physically delivered to and received at the delivery location. Belongs to the delivery event, not to the yield record (harvest date) or the delivery location (static master).
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: load_ticket_number
attributes.description: Bill of Lading or scale ticket reference number issued at the time of this specific delivery. Uniquely identifies the physical load movement from the farm/storage to the receiving location. Belongs to the delivery event.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: moisture_at_delivery
attributes.description: Grain moisture content percentage as measured by the receiving location at the time of delivery. Used for moisture dockage calculations and settlement. Distinct from moisture_pct_at_harvest on the yield_record, which is measured at the field.
attributes.references: DECIMAL(5,2)

attributes.name: quality_grade_at_delivery
attributes.description: Official grain quality grade assigned by the receiving elevator or inspection point at the time of delivery. May differ from the quality grade recorded at harvest on the yield_record due to storage, blending, or re-grading. Belongs to the delivery relationship.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

products.name: prescription_zone_rate
products.description: This association product represents the zone-level input rate specification between a vra_prescription and an input_product. It captures the operational precision agriculture record that defines exactly how much of a specific input product is prescribed for a specific management zone within a VRA prescription. Each record links one vra_prescription to one input_product for one management zone, carrying the prescribed rate, area, and application method that exist only in the context of this zone-input-prescription combination. Sourced from Trimble Ag Software and Climate FieldView prescription workflows.. Existence Justification: A VRA prescription is specifically designed to apply multiple input products (e.g., N, P, K fertilizers simultaneously) at spatially variable rates across management zones, and each input product appears in many prescriptions across fields, seasons, and farms. The business actively manages this relationship as a 'prescription line item' or 'zone-rate specification' — a recognized operational concept in precision agriculture that carries zone-specific rate, area, and method data. This is not an analytical correlation; agronomists and equipment controllers actively create, update, and execute these zone-rate records as part of the VRA workflow.
products.reference: Internal - M:N Association

attributes.name: prescription_zone_rate_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prescription Zone Rate - Prescription Zone Rate Id
attributes.description: Primary key for the prescription_zone_rate association
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association PK

attributes.name: input_product_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prescription Zone Rate - Ag Input Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the agricultural input product whose application rate is specified for this zone
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: vra_prescription_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prescription Zone Rate - Vra Prescription Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the VRA prescription that contains this zone-level input rate specification
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: application_method
attributes.description: The specific application method for this input product in this zone within the prescription (e.g., broadcast, banded, foliar). May differ per input within a multi-input prescription.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: prescribed_rate
attributes.description: The specific application rate prescribed for this input product in this management zone. Varies by zone and input combination; cannot reside on vra_prescription (varies per input) or input_product (varies per prescription and zone).
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: rate_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the prescribed_rate in this zone-input combination (e.g., lbs/ac, oz/ac, gal/ac). May differ across input products within the same prescription.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: zone_area_acres
attributes.description: The area in acres of the management zone covered by this input-prescription combination. Used to calculate total input quantity required for this zone and for cost/compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

products.name: crop
products.description: Master reference table for crop. Referenced by crop_id.

attributes.name: crop_id
attributes.description: Primary key for crop

attributes.name: average_yield
attributes.description: Historical average yield for this crop expressed in the yield_unit, used for crop planning and forecasting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this crop master record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: crop_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the crop type based on agricultural use and market segment.

attributes.name: crop_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code used for crop identification in Farm Management Information Systems (FMIS) and regulatory reporting. Externally-known unique identifier.

attributes.name: crop_name
attributes.description: Common name of the crop (e.g., Corn, Wheat, Soybeans, Cotton). Human-readable identifier used across all agronomic systems.

attributes.name: crop_type
attributes.description: Classification based on the crop's lifecycle duration: annual (single season), perennial (multi-year), or biennial (two-year cycle).

attributes.name: disease_susceptibility
attributes.description: General susceptibility of the crop to disease infections, used in IPM-based disease management strategies.

attributes.name: drought_tolerance
attributes.description: Crop's ability to withstand water stress and drought conditions, critical for irrigation planning.

attributes.name: frost_tolerance
attributes.description: Crop's ability to withstand frost conditions during growing season.

attributes.name: gmo_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether genetically modified varieties of this crop are available and approved for cultivation.

attributes.name: growing_season
attributes.description: Primary season during which the crop is typically cultivated, used for crop planning and rotation scheduling.

attributes.name: harvest_method
attributes.description: Primary method used for harvesting the crop: manual labor, mechanical equipment, or combination.

attributes.name: market_price_per_unit
attributes.description: Current market price per yield unit (e.g., price per bushel, price per kilogram), used for revenue forecasting and crop selection decisions.

attributes.name: maturity_days_max
attributes.description: Maximum number of days from planting to harvest maturity for late-maturing varieties of this crop.

attributes.name: maturity_days_min
attributes.description: Minimum number of days from planting to harvest maturity for early-maturing varieties of this crop.

attributes.name: ndvi_threshold_healthy
attributes.description: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) threshold value indicating healthy crop vigor, used for remote sensing and field health monitoring.

attributes.name: nitrogen_requirement_kg_per_hectare
attributes.description: Recommended nitrogen fertilizer application rate in kilograms per hectare for optimal yield, used in Variable Rate Application (VRA) prescriptions.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional agronomic notes, special cultivation requirements, or regional considerations for this crop.

attributes.name: organic_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this crop can be grown under organic certification standards.

attributes.name: pest_susceptibility
attributes.description: General susceptibility of the crop to pest infestations, used in Integrated Pest Management (IPM) planning.

attributes.name: phi_days
attributes.description: Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) - minimum number of days required between last pesticide application and harvest to ensure compliance with food safety regulations.

attributes.name: phosphorus_requirement_kg_per_hectare
attributes.description: Recommended phosphorus fertilizer application rate in kilograms per hectare for optimal yield.

attributes.name: planting_depth_cm
attributes.description: Recommended seed planting depth in centimeters for optimal germination and establishment.

attributes.name: potassium_requirement_kg_per_hectare
attributes.description: Recommended potassium fertilizer application rate in kilograms per hectare for optimal yield.

attributes.name: rei_hours
attributes.description: Restricted Entry Interval (REI) - minimum number of hours workers must wait before entering treated fields after pesticide application, ensuring worker safety compliance.

attributes.name: rotation_compatible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this crop is suitable for inclusion in crop rotation schedules to maintain soil health and reduce pest pressure.

attributes.name: row_spacing_cm
attributes.description: Recommended distance between crop rows in centimeters for optimal growth and equipment access.

attributes.name: scientific_name
attributes.description: Scientific botanical name of the crop using binomial nomenclature (e.g., Zea mays for corn, Triticum aestivum for wheat).

attributes.name: seeding_rate_kg_per_hectare
attributes.description: Recommended seeding rate in kilograms per hectare for standard planting density.

attributes.name: soil_ph_max
attributes.description: Maximum soil pH level tolerated by the crop for healthy growth.

attributes.name: soil_ph_min
attributes.description: Minimum soil pH level required for optimal crop growth and nutrient availability.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the crop in the master reference system. Active crops are available for planting schedules and field assignments.

attributes.name: temperature_max_celsius
attributes.description: Maximum temperature in Celsius tolerated by the crop before heat stress occurs.

attributes.name: temperature_min_celsius
attributes.description: Minimum temperature in Celsius required for crop germination and growth.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this crop master record was last modified.

attributes.name: water_requirement_mm
attributes.description: Total seasonal water requirement in millimeters, used for Evapotranspiration (ET)-driven irrigation planning.

attributes.name: yield_unit
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for crop yield reporting (e.g., bushels per acre for corn, kilograms per hectare for wheat). Used in Yield Per Minute (YPM) calculations.

attributes.name: parent_crop_id

products.name: zone_map
products.description: Master reference table for zone_map. Referenced by zone_map_id.

attributes.name: zone_map_id
attributes.description: Primary key for zone_map

attributes.name: crop_season_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific crop season or growing period for which this zone map is applicable. Links the map to temporal crop planning cycles.

attributes.name: farm_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the farm or agricultural operation that owns or manages the field associated with this zone map.

attributes.name: field_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agricultural field for which this zone map was created. Links the zone map to the specific field boundary and location.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the zone map was formally approved for use in field operations and variable rate application prescriptions.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the supervisor, agronomist, or authorized personnel who reviewed and approved the zone map for operational use.

attributes.name: attribute_measured
attributes.description: Specific agronomic or environmental attribute measured or represented in the zone map (e.g., soil pH, organic matter percentage, elevation above sea level, NDVI value, soil moisture content).

attributes.name: classification_method
attributes.description: Algorithm or methodology used to classify and delineate management zones within the map (e.g., manual delineation, k-means clustering, supervised classification, unsupervised classification, threshold-based).

attributes.name: collection_date
attributes.description: Date when the underlying data for the zone map was collected or captured. Important for understanding temporal relevance and data currency.

attributes.name: coordinate_system
attributes.description: Spatial reference system or coordinate system used for the zone map (e.g., EPSG:4326 for WGS84, EPSG:32633 for UTM Zone 33N). Critical for accurate geospatial alignment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this zone map record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Primary source of data used to generate the zone map, such as satellite imagery, drone-based remote sensing, in-field sensors, manual survey, yield monitor data, or soil sampling results.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this zone map becomes valid and applicable for field operations and variable rate application prescriptions.

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: Date until which this zone map remains valid. Nullable for maps with indefinite validity. Used for version control and temporal management.

attributes.name: external_reference_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier or reference code for the zone map in the external source system. Enables cross-system traceability and data reconciliation.

attributes.name: file_format
attributes.description: Digital file format in which the zone map is stored or distributed (e.g., Shapefile, GeoTIFF, GeoJSON, KML, ISO 11783 XML). Critical for system interoperability.

attributes.name: file_path
attributes.description: Storage location or file path where the zone map digital file is stored within the data lake or file system. Used for retrieval and access management.

attributes.name: file_size_mb
attributes.description: Size of the zone map file expressed in megabytes. Useful for storage management and data transfer planning.

attributes.name: generation_date
attributes.description: Date when the zone map was generated or created from the source data. Distinct from collection date as processing may occur later.

attributes.name: integration_system
attributes.description: Name of the external Farm Management Information System (FMIS) or precision agriculture platform from which the zone map was imported or to which it is exported (e.g., Climate FieldView, Trimble Ag Software, John Deere Operations Center).

attributes.name: is_vra_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this zone map is actively used for variable rate application prescriptions in field operations (True) or is for reference only (False).

attributes.name: map_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric business identifier or code for the zone map, used for external reference and system integration.

attributes.name: map_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title assigned to this zone map for identification and reference purposes.

attributes.name: map_type
attributes.description: Classification of the zone map based on the agronomic or environmental attribute it represents (e.g., soil type, yield potential, elevation, NDVI vegetation index, soil moisture, nutrient levels).

attributes.name: max_value
attributes.description: Maximum value of the measured attribute observed across all zones in the map. Defines the upper bound of the data range.

attributes.name: mean_value
attributes.description: Average or mean value of the measured attribute across all zones in the map. Provides a central tendency measure for the field.

attributes.name: min_value
attributes.description: Minimum value of the measured attribute observed across all zones in the map. Defines the lower bound of the data range.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this zone map record was last modified or updated. Audit field for change tracking and data governance.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, or contextual information about the zone map, such as data quality issues, field conditions during collection, or special considerations.

attributes.name: resolution_meters
attributes.description: Spatial resolution of the zone map expressed in meters, representing the grid cell size or minimum distinguishable feature size in the map.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the zone map indicating whether it is in draft, actively used for field operations, archived for historical reference, superseded by a newer version, or deprecated.

attributes.name: total_area_hectares
attributes.description: Total area covered by the zone map expressed in hectares. Represents the spatial extent of the mapped field or region.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for the attribute represented in the zone map (e.g., pH units, percent, meters, index value, volumetric water content).

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for the zone map following semantic versioning (e.g., 1.0, 2.1). Enables tracking of map revisions and updates over time.

attributes.name: zone_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct management zones defined within this zone map. Indicates the granularity of the variable rate application (VRA) prescription.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the agronomist, precision agriculture specialist, or system user who created or generated the zone map.

attributes.name: parent_zone_map_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on zone_map (parent_zone_map_id)

domains.name: livestock
domains.description: Manages all animal husbandry and breeding operations including herd and flock records, animal identification (RFID/ear tag), breeding programs, health and veterinary treatment logs, feed ration and nutrition planning, vaccination schedules, growth performance, and animal welfare compliance. Serves as the SSOT for animal lifecycle data from birth through harvest, supporting APHIS regulatory requirements, FSIS compliance, and antibiotic/withdrawal period tracking.

products.name: animal
products.description: Core master record for every individual animal in the herd or flock. Serves as the SSOT for animal identity across the full lifecycle from birth through harvest, sale, or disposal. Captures RFID tag, ear tag, electronic ID (EID), species, breed reference, sex, birth date, birth weight, dam/sire references (self-referencing lineage), origin (born on farm vs. purchased), current herd assignment, current location (pen/pasture), production class, production group assignment, GMO status, current lifecycle stage, and disposition status. Supports APHIS traceability requirements, USDA NAIS/RFID compliance, and COOL country-of-origin documentation.
products.reference: APHIS Animal Identification / USDA NAIS

attributes.name: animal_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate identifier for each individual animal record. Serves as the primary key and universal reference across all livestock management systems.
attributes.references: USDA NAIS (National Animal Identification System); APHIS Animal Traceability Framework

attributes.name: breed_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking to the breed master record for this animal's registered or recognized breed (e.g., Angus, Hereford, Duroc, Merino). Supports genetic performance benchmarking, EPD (Expected Progeny Difference) analysis, and breed association reporting.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Breed Standards; Beef Improvement Federation (BIF) Guidelines

attributes.name: dam_animal_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the mother (dam) animal record within this same table. Enables maternal lineage tracing for genetic performance analysis, EPD calculations, and pedigree documentation. Null for purchased animals with unknown dam.
attributes.references: Beef Improvement Federation (BIF) Guidelines; USDA AMS Breed Association Standards

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: USDA-assigned Premises Identification Number (PIN) for the physical location where the animal currently resides. 10-character alphanumeric code (3-letter state abbreviation + 7 digits). Required for USDA NAIS/ADT interstate movement documentation and disease traceability.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Premises Registration; USDA NAIS; 9 CFR Part 86

attributes.name: herd_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the herd or flock to which this animal is currently assigned. Drives management group decisions, vaccination scheduling, and regulatory reporting at the herd level. Sourced from Granular Farm Management herd master.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Herd Identification Standards; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module

attributes.name: pen_location_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the current physical pen, pasture, or paddock where the animal is housed or grazing. Supports daily management, feeding operations, and biosecurity zone tracking. Linked to the facility location master.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; USDA APHIS Premises Registration

attributes.name: production_group_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the management or production group (e.g., contemporary group, feeding pen group, breeding group) to which this animal is assigned. Contemporary groups are used for EPD (Expected Progeny Difference) calculations and performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: Beef Improvement Federation (BIF) Contemporary Group Guidelines; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Each purchased animal must reference the procurement PO for cost basis establishment, financial reconciliation, and COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) documentation. animal.source_vendor_id already lin
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: sire_animal_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the father (sire) animal record or AI (Artificial Insemination) sire reference. Enables paternal lineage tracing for EPD (Expected Progeny Difference) analysis, genetic improvement programs, and pedigree documentation.
attributes.references: Beef Improvement Federation (BIF) Guidelines; USDA AMS Breed Association Standards

attributes.name: source_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the external vendor, auction house, or producer from whom the animal was purchased. Null for born-on-farm animals. Supports supplier traceability, biosecurity source tracking, and procurement analytics in SAP S/4HANA MM module.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule; USDA COOL 7 USC 1638; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: Purchase price or capitalized cost basis of the animal at time of acquisition, expressed in USD. For born-on-farm animals, represents the capitalized cost of raising to weaning. Used for inventory valuation, COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) calculation, and financial reporting under GAAP/IFRS.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 905 (Agriculture); IFRS IAS 41 (Agriculture); FASB Agricultural Accounting

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date the animal was acquired by the operation — either the birth date for born-on-farm animals or the purchase/transfer-in date for externally sourced animals. Used for inventory aging, cost basis calculation, and COOL documentation.
attributes.references: USDA COOL 7 USC 1638; FSMA Traceability Rule; GAAP Inventory Accounting

attributes.name: antibiotic_free
attributes.description: Indicates whether the animal has never received antibiotic treatments and qualifies for 'Never Ever 3' (NE3) or antibiotic-free marketing programs. Drives premium market channel eligibility and label claim compliance.
attributes.references: USDA FSIS Labeling Policy; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock; FDA Guidance for Industry #213

attributes.name: birth_date
attributes.description: Actual or estimated calendar date the animal was born. Used to calculate age, determine production class eligibility, schedule vaccinations, and compute days-on-feed (DOF). Required for USDA age verification programs and COOL documentation.
attributes.references: USDA COOL 7 USC 1638; USDA Age and Source Verification Program; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: birth_weight_kg
attributes.description: Body weight of the animal recorded at or shortly after birth, expressed in kilograms. Baseline measurement for growth performance tracking, EPD (Expected Progeny Difference) calculations, and dam/sire genetic evaluation.
attributes.references: Beef Improvement Federation (BIF) Guidelines; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module

attributes.name: brand_description
attributes.description: Description of the hot iron or freeze brand applied to the animal for permanent ownership identification. Includes brand symbol, location on body, and registration state. Required for cattle ownership verification in brand-law states and theft prevention.
attributes.references: State Brand Laws (varies by state); USDA APHIS; Western States Livestock Brand Registries

attributes.name: breed_composition_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the animal's genetics attributable to the primary breed identified in breed_id. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 75.00 for 75% Angus). Used for crossbreeding program management, breed association registration eligibility, and genetic improvement analytics.
attributes.references: Beef Improvement Federation (BIF) Guidelines; USDA AMS Breed Association Standards

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the country where the animal was born, raised, or slaughtered as required by USDA COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) regulations. Mandatory for retail muscle cut labeling compliance.
attributes.references: USDA COOL 7 USC 1638; ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; USDA AMS COOL Final Rule

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the animal record was first created in the system. Supports data lineage, audit trail requirements, and FSMA traceability documentation. Populated automatically at record creation and never updated.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S; ISO 8601; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: current_weight_kg
attributes.description: Most recently recorded live body weight of the animal in kilograms. Updated at each weigh event. Used for feed ration calculation, marketing weight assessment, and growth performance monitoring. Distinct from birth weight and harvest weight.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; Beef Improvement Federation (BIF) Guidelines

attributes.name: disposition_date
attributes.description: Date the animal was removed from active inventory through harvest, sale, death, condemnation, or transfer out. Used for inventory reconciliation, mortality reporting, and lifecycle cost analysis. Null while animal is in ACTIVE disposition status.
attributes.references: USDA FSIS 9 CFR Part 309; GAAP ASC 905; APHIS 9 CFR Part 86

attributes.name: disposition_status
attributes.description: Current disposition status representing the animal's standing in the operation. ACTIVE=currently on inventory; HARVESTED=sent to harvest/slaughter; SOLD=sold to external party; DIED=natural or accidental death; CONDEMNED=condemned at ante/post-mortem inspection; TRANSFERRED_OUT=moved to another facility. Core lifecycle status field for inventory reconciliation and FSIS compliance.
attributes.references: USDA FSIS 9 CFR Part 309; APHIS 9 CFR Part 86; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: ear_tag_number
attributes.description: Visual alphanumeric identifier printed on the physical ear tag applied to the animal. Used for visual identification in the field and pen. May be a farm-assigned number or official USDA 840 tag number. Supports COOL country-of-origin labeling traceability.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS 9 CFR Part 86; COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) 7 USC 1638

attributes.name: eid
attributes.description: Electronic Identification number as printed on the visual ear tag and encoded in the RFID transponder. May differ from the raw RFID tag number in formatted display. Used in John Deere Operations Center and Granular Farm Management for animal-level record linkage.
attributes.references: ISO 11784/11785; USDA APHIS Animal Traceability Rule (9 CFR Part 86)

attributes.name: gmo_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the animal is derived from genetically modified genetics (GMO), confirmed non-GMO, or status is unknown. Required for non-GMO certification programs, organic certification under USDA NOP, and export documentation to GMO-sensitive markets.
attributes.references: USDA NOP (National Organic Program) 7 CFR Part 205; Non-GMO Project Standard; EU Regulation 1829/2003

attributes.name: health_status
attributes.description: Current veterinary health status of the animal. HEALTHY=no active health concerns; SICK=active illness under observation; QUARANTINE=isolated for biosecurity or regulatory reasons; TREATED=currently under veterinary treatment with active withdrawal period; RECOVERED=returned to healthy status post-treatment; CONDEMNED=condemned by veterinary inspection.
attributes.references: USDA FSIS 9 CFR Part 309; APHIS Veterinary Accreditation; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Health Module

attributes.name: last_weigh_date
attributes.description: Calendar date of the most recent live weight measurement. Used to assess recency of weight data, calculate average daily gain (ADG) since last weigh, and trigger re-weigh alerts when interval exceeds operational thresholds.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; Beef Improvement Federation (BIF) Guidelines

attributes.name: lifecycle_stage
attributes.description: Current biological and production lifecycle stage of the animal. Drives nutritional requirements, veterinary protocols, and management interventions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NEONATAL|WEANED|GROWING|FINISHING|MATURE|GESTATING|LACTATING|DRY — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; NRC Nutrient Requirements of Domestic Animals

attributes.name: official_usda_tag
attributes.description: Official USDA 840-prefix 15-digit national uniform ear tag number assigned under the USDA Animal Disease Traceability (ADT) framework. Required for interstate movement of cattle, bison, and other covered species. Begins with country code 840 (USA).
attributes.references: USDA APHIS 9 CFR Part 86; USDA Animal Disease Traceability (ADT) Rule

attributes.name: organic_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the animal is enrolled in and compliant with USDA National Organic Program (NOP) certification requirements, including organic feed, no antibiotic use, and outdoor access. Drives premium pricing and labeling eligibility.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) Organic Regulations

attributes.name: origin_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the animal was born on the operation, purchased from an external source, or transferred in from another company-owned facility. Critical for COOL country-of-origin labeling, FSMA traceability, and biosecurity risk classification.
attributes.references: USDA COOL 7 USC 1638; FSMA Produce Safety Rule; APHIS 9 CFR Part 86

attributes.name: parity_number
attributes.description: Number of times a female animal has given birth (parturitions). Parity 0 = never calved/farrowed/lambed; Parity 1 = first calf/litter; etc. Used for reproductive performance analysis, culling decisions, and production benchmarking for dairy and cow-calf operations.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Reproductive Module; Dairy Herd Improvement Association (DHIA) Standards

attributes.name: production_class
attributes.description: Operational production class that defines the animal's role in the production system. Determines applicable management protocols, feed rations, performance benchmarks, and marketing channels. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: COW_CALF|STOCKER|FEEDLOT|DAIRY|BREEDING|SHOW|SEEDSTOCK|REPLACEMENT_HEIFER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA NASS Livestock Survey; Beef Improvement Federation (BIF) Guidelines; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: Official registration number issued by a recognized breed association (e.g., American Angus Association, National Swine Registry) for purebred or registered animals. Required for seedstock marketing, EPD publication, and breed association reporting.
attributes.references: American Angus Association; National Swine Registry; American Hereford Association; USDA AMS

attributes.name: rfid_tag_number
attributes.description: 15-digit ISO 11784/11785 compliant RFID electronic tag number embedded in the animal's ear tag or bolus. Primary electronic identifier used for automated reading at chutes, scales, and gates. Required for USDA NAIS traceability and APHIS interstate movement compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 11784/11785; USDA APHIS 9 CFR Part 86; USDA NAIS

attributes.name: sex_code
attributes.description: Biological sex and reproductive status of the animal. M=Male (intact bull/boar/ram), F=Female (cow/sow/ewe), C=Castrated male (steer/barrow/wether), S=Spayed female, B=Barrow. Drives production class assignment, feed ration, and harvest yield expectations.
attributes.references: USDA NASS Livestock Survey Codes; Beef Improvement Federation (BIF) Guidelines

attributes.name: species_code
attributes.description: Standardized species classification of the animal. Drives applicable regulatory frameworks (FSIS, APHIS), withdrawal period rules, and feed ration formulations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BOVINE|SWINE|OVINE|CAPRINE|EQUINE|POULTRY|CERVID|BISON|OTHER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; FSIS 9 CFR; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: tattoo_number
attributes.description: Permanent alphanumeric tattoo applied inside the ear or on the body for permanent identification, particularly for swine, sheep, and registered cattle. Used as a backup identifier when ear tags are lost and for breed association registration.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Swine Identification Standards; National Swine Registry; American Angus Association

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent modification to the animal record. Used for change data capture (CDC), data synchronization between SAP S/4HANA and Granular Farm Management, and audit trail compliance under SOX and FSMA.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S; SOX Section 404; ISO 8601

Acts as the organizational anchor for all animal-level records.

attributes.description: Average live body weight in kilograms of animals in the herd at the most recent weigh event. Used for feed conversion ratio (FCR) calculations, drug dosage determination, and market readiness assessment. Supports YPM (Yield Per Acre Metric) and performance benchmarking.

attributes.name: certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: Earliest expiration date across all active certifications (organic, GAP, GLOBALG.A.P.) held by this herd. Used to trigger recertification workflows and prevent lapsed-certification sales into premium market channels.

attributes.name: classification
attributes.description: Operational classification of the herd's production stage or management purpose (e.g., breeding, finishing, nursery, cow-calf, stocker, replacement). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: breeding|finishing|nursery|grow-out|cow-calf|stocker|replacement|farrowing|lactating|dry|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.description: System timestamp recording when this herd master record was first created in the FMIS or ERP system. Supports data lineage, FSMA traceability audit trails, and SOX financial reporting controls for livestock asset records.

attributes.name: current_head_count
attributes.description: Actual number of live animals currently in the herd as of the last inventory reconciliation. Drives feed ration calculations, housing capacity utilization, and USDA NASS livestock inventory reporting. Updated upon births, deaths, purchases, and transfers.
attributes.references: USDA NASS Livestock Inventory; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Standard; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: disease_status
attributes.description: Current disease surveillance status of the herd as determined by USDA APHIS or state veterinarian. 'confirmed' status triggers mandatory reporting, movement restrictions, and potential depopulation under the National Animal Health Emergency Management System (NAHEMS).
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Animal Disease Traceability Rule (9 CFR Part 86); NAHEMS; OIE Terrestrial Animal Health Code

attributes.name: dispersal_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the herd was fully dispersed through sale, harvest, or depopulation. Null for active herds. Used to close the herd lifecycle record and trigger final regulatory reporting to USDA APHIS.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS ADT Rule; FSIS Ante-Mortem Inspection Records

attributes.name: expected_market_date
attributes.description: Projected date when the herd or a cohort of animals is expected to reach market weight and be ready for sale or harvest. Used for sales order planning, slaughter scheduling, and logistics coordination with TMS and WMS systems.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; FSIS Ante-Mortem Inspection Scheduling; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: formation_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this herd grouping was formally established or first registered in the FMIS. Used for herd age tracking, performance period calculations, and audit trail compliance under FSMA traceability requirements.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule (21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S); USDA APHIS ADT Rule

attributes.name: herd_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the herd, used in operational systems such as SAP S/4HANA livestock modules, FMIS records, and regulatory submissions to USDA APHIS. Serves as the cross-system reference key.

attributes.name: herd_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name assigned to the herd or flock grouping (e.g., 'North Pasture Angus Cow-Calf Herd', 'Broiler House 4 Flock'). Used in operational reports, Granular Farm Management, and John Deere Operations Center displays.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management — Livestock Module; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Standard

attributes.name: herd_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the herd record. 'active' indicates operational management; 'quarantined' triggers APHIS disease containment protocols; 'dispersed' indicates the herd has been sold or depopulated; 'pending' indicates formation in progress.

attributes.name: housing_type
attributes.description: Primary housing or production system type for the herd (e.g., pasture, confinement, feedlot, free-range). attributes.name: is_antibiotic_free

attributes.name: is_gap_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this herd operation holds a current Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) certification. Enables premium market access and satisfies retailer food safety audit requirements under GFSI-recognized schemes.

attributes.name: is_globalg_ap_certified

attributes.name: is_gmo_free

attributes.name: is_organic_certified

attributes.name: last_health_check_date

attributes.references: USDA APHIS Veterinary Accreditation Program; FDA Veterinary Feed Directive (VFD); GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Standard

attributes.name: morbidity_rate_pct
