attributes.name: building_number
attributes.description: Identifier for the building or structure within the parent facility that contains this pen. Used for facility layout navigation, maintenance work order routing in SAP S/4HANA PM module, and emergency response planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module Plant Maintenance Standards; USDA APHIS Premises Identification

attributes.name: capacity_head
attributes.description: Maximum number of animal head this pen or housing unit is designed to hold at one time, based on species-specific stocking density standards and welfare regulations. Used for occupancy management, welfare compliance audits, and feed ration planning.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Animal Welfare Act; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements

attributes.name: commissioned_date
attributes.description: Date the pen or housing unit was first placed into operational service. Used for asset lifecycle tracking, maintenance scheduling, depreciation calculations (CAPEX), and historical occupancy trend analysis.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Asset Lifecycle Standards; GAAP Fixed Asset Accounting; USDA APHIS Premises Registration

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this pen location record was first created in the system. Supports data lineage, audit trail requirements, and Silver Layer lakehouse record management. Populated automatically at record insertion.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity; ISO 22000 Record Keeping

attributes.name: current_occupancy
attributes.description: Current number of animal head present in the pen at the time of last update. Enables real-time occupancy monitoring, stocking density compliance checks, and feed delivery quantity calculations. Updated upon each animal movement event.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; USDA APHIS Traceability Standards; Animal Welfare Act

attributes.name: decommissioned_date
attributes.description: Date the pen or housing unit was permanently taken out of service. Nullable for active pens. Supports asset lifecycle management, historical capacity reporting, and regulatory premises deregistration with USDA APHIS.
attributes.references: IFRS 16 Asset Lifecycle Standards; GAAP Fixed Asset Accounting; USDA APHIS Premises Identification

attributes.name: feed_delivery_method
attributes.description: Method by which feed rations are delivered to animals within this pen. Drives feed delivery scheduling, TMR (Total Mixed Ration) batch targeting, and feed management system integration with Granular Farm Management and SAP S/4HANA PP module.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; USDA APHIS Feed Safety Regulations; FSMA Preventive Controls for Animal Food

attributes.name: flooring_type
attributes.description: Type of flooring surface within the pen or housing unit. Impacts animal welfare assessments (lameness, injury risk), manure management practices, and compliance with GLOBALG.A.P. and GFSI welfare audit criteria. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: concrete|slatted|dirt|rubber_mat|bedded_pack|pasture|grated — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; USDA APHIS Animal Welfare Act

attributes.name: gis_polygon_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the pen boundary polygon stored in the Esri ArcGIS geospatial system or John Deere Operations Center field mapping layer. Enables spatial analysis, boundary-based animal tracking, and integration with precision agriculture platforms.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Spatial Data Standards; John Deere Operations Center Field Mapping; USDA APHIS Premises Identification

attributes.name: housing_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical housing or containment structure type. Drives welfare audit requirements, ventilation standards, biosecurity protocols, and regulatory reporting under USDA APHIS and GFSI frameworks. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pen|paddock|pasture|barn|feedlot|farrowing_room|milking_parlor|processing_facility — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Animal Welfare Act; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements

attributes.name: is_biosecurity_restricted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pen requires restricted personnel access under the operation's biosecurity plan. When true, access logs, PPE requirements, and visitor protocols are enforced per APHIS biosecurity guidelines and GLOBALG.A.P. standards.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Biosecurity Guidelines; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; FSIS Directive 6100.1

attributes.name: is_climate_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pen or housing unit has active climate control systems (heating, cooling, or humidity regulation). Relevant to welfare compliance for sensitive species/life stages (farrowing, nursery), energy cost tracking, and IoT sensor deployment planning.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; USDA APHIS Animal Welfare Act; ASHRAE Agricultural Standards

attributes.name: is_covered
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pen or housing unit has a roof or overhead shelter structure. Affects weather protection assessments, welfare audit scoring, and heat/cold stress risk classification for animal health management.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; USDA APHIS Animal Welfare Act

attributes.name: last_cleaned_date
attributes.description: Date the pen was most recently cleaned and sanitized. Supports biosecurity compliance tracking, disease prevention scheduling, and welfare audit documentation. Required for GLOBALG.A.P. and GFSI audit trails.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; USDA APHIS Biosecurity Guidelines

attributes.name: last_disinfected_date
attributes.description: Date the pen was most recently disinfected with an approved disinfectant product. Distinct from cleaning — disinfection is a separate biosecurity step required between animal groups and after disease events. Tracked for APHIS and FSIS compliance.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Biosecurity Guidelines; FSIS Directive 6100.1; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent animal welfare or facility inspection conducted at this pen location. Supports audit scheduling, compliance gap identification, and regulatory reporting to USDA APHIS and GFSI certification bodies.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Animal Welfare Act; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; SQF Code

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: GPS latitude coordinate of the pen centroid or primary access point in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum). Enables spatial tracking of animal locations, feed delivery routing, and GIS-based biosecurity zone mapping in Esri ArcGIS and John Deere Operations Center.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Spatial Reference Standards; WGS84 Datum; USDA APHIS Premises Identification

attributes.name: lighting_type
attributes.description: Type of lighting available within the pen or housing unit. Relevant to animal welfare assessments, photoperiod management for reproductive performance, and energy efficiency reporting under CAPEX/OPEX tracking.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; USDA APHIS Animal Welfare Act; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: GPS longitude coordinate of the pen centroid or primary access point in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum). Enables spatial tracking of animal locations, feed delivery routing, and GIS-based biosecurity zone mapping in Esri ArcGIS and John Deere Operations Center.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Spatial Reference Standards; WGS84 Datum; USDA APHIS Premises Identification

attributes.name: manure_management_type
attributes.description: Method used to collect, store, or manage manure generated within this pen. Required for EPA nutrient management plan compliance, USDA NRCS BMP (Best Management Practices) reporting, and environmental permit documentation.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Water Act; USDA NRCS BMP Standards; APHIS Environmental Compliance

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special instructions, or contextual information about this pen location that does not fit structured fields. Examples include temporary capacity restrictions, ongoing construction notes, or special biosecurity instructions for staff.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; Internal SOP Documentation

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the pen or housing unit. Controls whether the pen is available for animal placement, feed delivery scheduling, or welfare inspections. 'quarantined' status triggers biosecurity protocols per APHIS and FSIS requirements.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Biosecurity Guidelines; FSIS Directive 6100.1; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module

attributes.name: pen_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code or label assigned to the pen or housing unit, used in operational signage, feed delivery manifests, animal movement records, and FMIS integrations (e.g., Granular Farm Management, SAP S/4HANA PP module). Must be unique within the parent facility.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; USDA APHIS Traceability Standards

attributes.name: pen_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the pen or housing unit (e.g., 'North Farrowing Room 3', 'Pasture B-12', 'Feedlot Pen 7A'). Used in operational reports, welfare audit documentation, and staff communications.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; USDA APHIS Premises Identification

attributes.name: production_stage
attributes.description: Livestock production stage for which this pen is designated. Determines applicable feed ration programs, health protocols, withdrawal period tracking, and welfare audit criteria. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA PP production order classification and Granular Farm Management livestock records. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: nursery|grower|finisher|breeding|gestation|farrowing|lactation|dry_lot|backgrounding — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Livestock Production Standards; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; FSIS Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: species_type
attributes.description: Primary livestock species for which this pen or housing unit is designed and designated. Determines applicable welfare standards, ventilation requirements, stocking density limits, and regulatory reporting frameworks (APHIS, FSIS, USDA). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cattle|swine|poultry|sheep|goat|equine|mixed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Species-Specific Regulations; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; Animal Welfare Act

attributes.name: stocking_density_limit
attributes.description: Maximum allowable stocking density for this pen expressed as head per acre (outdoor) or square feet per head (indoor), per applicable welfare and regulatory standards. Used to enforce compliance thresholds and trigger alerts when current occupancy approaches or exceeds limits.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Animal Welfare Act; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements

attributes.name: stocking_density_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the stocking density limit field. Distinguishes between outdoor (head per acre) and indoor (square feet per head) density metrics to ensure correct welfare compliance calculations.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Animal Welfare Act; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this pen location record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, data quality monitoring, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity; ISO 22000 Record Keeping

attributes.name: ventilation_type
attributes.description: Type of ventilation system installed in or applicable to the pen or housing unit. Affects air quality management, heat stress mitigation, disease transmission risk, and welfare compliance under USDA APHIS and GLOBALG.A.P. standards.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Animal Welfare Act; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; ASHRAE Agricultural Ventilation Standards

attributes.name: water_source_type
attributes.description: Type of water delivery system or source available within the pen. Critical for animal welfare compliance, daily water consumption monitoring, and drought contingency planning. Supports GLOBALG.A.P. and USDA APHIS welfare audit requirements.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; USDA APHIS Animal Welfare Act; FSMA Water Quality Standards

attributes.name: welfare_certification_status
attributes.description: Current animal welfare certification status for this pen location under applicable certification programs (e.g., GLOBALG.A.P., Certified Humane, Animal Welfare Approved). Drives audit scheduling, corrective action tracking, and customer-facing welfare claims.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; Certified Humane Standards; USDA APHIS Animal Welfare Act; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements

products.name: breeding_event
products.description: Master and transactional record for the breeding program — encompassing both breeding activities and semen/embryo inventory management. For breeding activities: captures breeding date, female animal ID, sire ID or semen lot reference, breeding method (natural service, AI, embryo transfer), technician, conception check date, conception result, expected parturition date, and breeding program reference. For semen/embryo inventory: captures sire ID, sire name, breed, genetic registration number, EPD values (calving ease, birth weight, weaning weight, yearling weight, milk, marbling, REA), genomic-enhanced EPD flag, semen supplier, collection date, lot number, quantity on hand (straws/embryos), storage tank ID, storage location (canister/goblet/cane), conception rate history, cost per unit, and quality grade (post-thaw motility). Record type discriminator (breeding_activity vs semen_inventory) separates the two concerns. Supports genetic improvement tracking, EPD analysis, reproductive performance KPIs, AI program planning, and breeding cost accounting.
products.reference: AI / Embryo Transfer Records / SAP PP

attributes.name: breeding_event_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each breeding event or semen/embryo inventory record. Serves as the primary key for the breeding_event data product.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. livestock traceability standards; APHIS animal identification requirements

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the liquid nitrogen (LN2) cryogenic storage tank in which the semen straws or embryos are stored. Used for physical inventory location management and tank maintenance scheduling.
attributes.references: USDA AMS semen storage standards; facility asset management best practices

attributes.name: breeding_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the genetic improvement or breeding program under which this event is conducted. Links the event to a defined breeding objective, selection criteria, and EPD targets.
attributes.references: USDA National Animal Germplasm Program; breed association genetic improvement program standards

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or contractor who performed the breeding procedure (AI technician, embryo transfer specialist, or natural service supervisor). Supports labor accountability and technician performance KPIs.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors workforce records; APHIS veterinary accreditation requirements

attributes.name: herd_id
attributes.description: Reference to the herd or flock to which the female animal belongs at the time of the breeding event. Supports herd-level reproductive performance reporting and APHIS premises identification.
attributes.references: APHIS Premises Identification Number (PIN) requirements; USDA herd management standards

attributes.name: observation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to weather.observation. Business justification: Heat stress at breeding time significantly reduces conception rates in cattle and swine. Reproductive efficiency analysis requires correlating breeding events with weather observations (THI at breedin
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: primary_breeding_female_animal_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dam (female animal) involved in the breeding activity. Links to the animal master record for the cow, heifer, sow, ewe, or other female subject of the breeding event.
attributes.references: APHIS NAIS (National Animal Identification System); USDA livestock traceability requirements

attributes.name: semen_inventory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the semen inventory lot record used in an artificial insemination event. Nullable for natural service and embryo transfer events. Links to the semen_inventory record type within this product or a dedicated inventory record.
attributes.references: USDA AMS semen lot traceability standards; SAP S/4HANA MM lot management

attributes.name: trial_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.trial. Business justification: Breeding events are conducted as part of reproductive research trials — synchronization protocol efficacy, semen quality comparisons, conception rate studies. Linking breeding_event to trial enables r
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: actual_parturition_date
attributes.description: Actual recorded date on which the dam gave birth (calved, farrowed, lambed, etc.). Used to calculate gestation length, compare against expected date, and update reproductive performance records. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: APHIS animal health record-keeping requirements; USDA livestock production standards

attributes.name: breeding_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the breeding activity (natural service, artificial insemination, or embryo transfer) was performed. Principal real-world event date for the breeding transaction. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: APHIS animal health record-keeping requirements; USDA livestock production standards

attributes.name: breeding_method
attributes.description: Method used to achieve conception. 'natural_service' indicates direct mating; 'artificial_insemination' (AI) uses processed semen; 'embryo_transfer' (ET) implants a flushed embryo; 'in_vitro_fertilization' (IVF) uses laboratory-produced embryos.
attributes.references: USDA AMS livestock breeding standards; APHIS animal health regulations; Granular Farm Management AI program conventions

attributes.name: breeding_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for recording additional observations, complications, or contextual information about the breeding event or inventory record (e.g., synchronization protocol used, heat detection method, embryo quality grade, technician observations).
attributes.references: APHIS animal health record-keeping requirements; GLOBALG.A.P. livestock documentation standards

attributes.name: collection_date
attributes.description: Date on which the semen or embryo was collected from the donor animal. Used for lot age tracking, quality assessment, and regulatory compliance with USDA semen import/export requirements. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: USDA AMS semen collection and processing regulations; APHIS import/export health certificate requirements

attributes.name: conception_check_date
attributes.description: Date on which pregnancy diagnosis (rectal palpation, ultrasound, or blood test) was performed to confirm or deny conception following the breeding event. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: APHIS animal health record-keeping requirements; USDA livestock reproductive management standards

attributes.name: conception_rate_history_pct
attributes.description: Recorded historical conception rate (as a percentage) for this sire or semen lot based on prior breeding events. Derived from field performance data and used in sire selection and AI program planning. Distinct from the result of any single breeding event.
attributes.references: USDA AMS AI program performance standards; breed association sire summary data

attributes.name: conception_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the pregnancy diagnosis check. 'confirmed_pregnant' indicates successful conception; 'open' indicates the animal did not conceive; 'recheck_required' indicates inconclusive result requiring follow-up; 'not_checked' indicates no pregnancy check has been performed.
attributes.references: APHIS animal health record-keeping requirements; USDA reproductive performance KPI standards

attributes.name: cost_per_unit
attributes.description: Purchase cost per semen straw or embryo unit in USD. Used for breeding cost accounting, COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) allocation to offspring, and ROI analysis of genetic improvement programs.
attributes.references: GAAP cost accounting standards; SAP S/4HANA CO (Controlling) module; IFRS IAS 41 Agriculture

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this breeding event or inventory record was first created in the system. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX internal controls; FSMA record-keeping requirements; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: epd_birth_weight
attributes.description: Expected Progeny Difference (EPD) value for birth weight for the sire, expressed in pounds. Positive values indicate heavier-than-average offspring. Used in sire selection to manage calving difficulty and neonatal survival.
attributes.references: USDA AMS EPD calculation standards; breed association genetic evaluation methodologies

attributes.name: epd_calving_ease
attributes.description: Expected Progeny Difference (EPD) value for calving ease for the sire. Expressed as a percentage advantage in unassisted births compared to breed average. Used in sire selection to minimize dystocia risk.
attributes.references: USDA AMS EPD calculation standards; breed association genetic evaluation methodologies

attributes.name: epd_marbling
attributes.description: Expected Progeny Difference (EPD) value for marbling (intramuscular fat) for the sire. Expressed as a USDA marbling score unit advantage. Used in beef quality grade prediction and premium market targeting.
attributes.references: USDA AMS EPD calculation standards; USDA beef quality grading standards; breed association genetic evaluation methodologies

attributes.name: epd_milk
attributes.description: Expected Progeny Difference (EPD) value for milk production for the sire, expressed in pounds. Reflects the milking ability transmitted through daughters. Used in maternal breed selection for calf nutrition and growth.
attributes.references: USDA AMS EPD calculation standards; breed association genetic evaluation methodologies

attributes.name: epd_rea
attributes.description: Expected Progeny Difference (EPD) value for Ribeye Area (REA) for the sire, expressed in square inches. Indicates genetic merit for muscle expression and cutability. Used in carcass merit prediction and sire selection for yield grade improvement.
attributes.references: USDA AMS EPD calculation standards; USDA beef yield grading standards; breed association genetic evaluation methodologies

attributes.name: epd_weaning_weight
attributes.description: Expected Progeny Difference (EPD) value for weaning weight for the sire, expressed in pounds. Indicates the sire's genetic merit for pre-weaning growth. Key metric in beef and sheep genetic improvement programs.
attributes.references: USDA AMS EPD calculation standards; breed association genetic evaluation methodologies

attributes.name: epd_yearling_weight
attributes.description: Expected Progeny Difference (EPD) value for yearling weight for the sire, expressed in pounds. Indicates the sire's genetic merit for post-weaning growth rate. Used in feedlot performance prediction and sire selection.
attributes.references: USDA AMS EPD calculation standards; breed association genetic evaluation methodologies

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the breeding event or inventory record. 'planned' indicates a scheduled breeding activity; 'completed' indicates the event occurred; 'cancelled' indicates the event was voided; 'pending_confirmation' indicates awaiting conception check result.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. livestock management standards; Granular Farm Management workflow conventions

attributes.name: expected_parturition_date
attributes.description: Calculated expected date of birth (calving, farrowing, lambing, etc.) based on breeding date and species-specific gestation length. Used for calving/farrowing schedule planning, nutritional management, and labor allocation. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: USDA livestock production standards; Granular Farm Management reproductive planning conventions

attributes.name: genetic_registration_number
attributes.description: Official breed association registration number for the sire. Serves as the externally-known unique identifier for the sire in breed registry databases, enabling EPD lookup and genetic verification.
attributes.references: Breed association registration standards; USDA AMS genetic improvement program requirements

attributes.name: genomic_enhanced_epd
attributes.description: Indicates whether the EPD values for this sire are genomic-enhanced (GE-EPD), meaning they incorporate DNA marker information in addition to traditional pedigree and performance data. Genomic-enhanced EPDs have higher accuracy, especially for young sires.
attributes.references: USDA AMS genomic evaluation standards; breed association GE-EPD methodology documentation

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Batch tracking identifier (LOT) assigned by the semen supplier or collection facility to a specific collection of semen straws or embryos. Enables full traceability from sire to offspring and supports recall management.
attributes.references: USDA AMS semen lot traceability standards; SAP S/4HANA MM batch management (LOT); FSMA traceability requirements

attributes.name: offspring_count
attributes.description: Number of live offspring born from this breeding event (e.g., 1 for singleton calf, 2 for twins). Recorded at parturition. Used for litter size tracking, multiple birth analysis, and reproductive performance KPIs.
attributes.references: APHIS animal health record-keeping requirements; USDA livestock production standards

attributes.name: post_thaw_motility_pct
attributes.description: Quality grade expressed as the percentage of progressively motile sperm cells observed after thawing a representative straw from the lot. Minimum acceptable threshold is typically 30-35% per USDA AMS standards. Used to assess semen quality and predict conception rates.
attributes.references: USDA AMS semen quality standards; Society for Theriogenology semen evaluation guidelines

attributes.name: quantity_on_hand
attributes.description: Current count of semen straws or embryos available in inventory for this lot. Decremented upon each use in an AI or ET breeding event. Used for inventory planning and reorder decisions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM inventory management; Manhattan Associates WMS stock management

attributes.name: record_type
attributes.description: Discriminator field that separates the two concerns managed by this data product: 'breeding_activity' for actual mating/insemination events, and 'semen_inventory' for semen or embryo inventory management records.
attributes.references: FMIS data modeling best practices; SAP S/4HANA livestock management conventions

attributes.name: semen_supplier
attributes.description: Name of the commercial semen supplier or AI stud from which the semen was procured (e.g., ABS Global, Select Sires, Semex, Genex). Used for vendor performance tracking, procurement records, and quality traceability.
attributes.references: USDA AMS semen import/export regulations; SAP S/4HANA MM vendor master

attributes.name: sire_breed
attributes.description: Breed designation of the sire (e.g., Angus, Hereford, Holstein, Simmental). Used for crossbreeding program management, breed composition tracking, and genetic diversity analysis.
attributes.references: USDA AMS breed classification standards; breed association registration records

attributes.name: sire_name
attributes.description: Registered name of the sire used in the breeding event or associated with the semen/embryo inventory record. Used for genetic reporting, catalog references, and breeder communications.
attributes.references: Breed association registration standards (e.g., American Angus Association, Holstein Association USA)

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Precise physical location within the storage tank, expressed as canister, goblet, and cane identifiers (e.g., 'C2-G3-CN4'). Enables rapid physical retrieval of specific semen straws or embryos during AI procedures.
attributes.references: USDA AMS semen storage and handling standards; AI technician operational best practices

attributes.name: synchronization_protocol
attributes.description: Hormonal synchronization protocol used to coordinate estrus and ovulation timing prior to the AI or ET event. Common protocols include CIDR (Controlled Internal Drug Release), OvSynch, CoSynch, Select-Synch, and MGA (melengestrol acetate). 'none' indicates natural estrus detection was used. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CIDR|OvSynch|CoSynch|Select_Synch|MGA|none|TAI|FTAI — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA AMS reproductive management guidelines; FDA veterinary drug approval requirements; Society for Theriogenology protocols

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this breeding event or inventory record was most recently modified. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for change tracking, data synchronization, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX internal controls; FSMA record-keeping requirements; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

products.name: parturition_record
products.description: Transactional record capturing each birth or calving/farrowing/lambing/kidding event. Records dam ID, sire ID, birth date, birth time, number of offspring, individual offspring IDs, birth weight per offspring, birth type (single, twin, triplet), ease of birth score, colostrum administration, dam body condition score at birth, and attending staff. Initiates the animal master record for newborns and feeds into herd performance reporting.
products.reference: Calving/Farrowing Record / FMIS

attributes.name: parturition_record_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each parturition (birth/calving/farrowing/lambing/kidding) event record. Serves as the primary key for this transactional entity.
attributes.references: APHIS Animal Identification Standards; USDA National Animal Identification System (NAIS)

attributes.name: breeding_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to livestock.breeding_event. Business justification: A parturition_record (birth/calving event) is the direct outcome of a breeding_event. Linking parturition_record.breeding_event_id → livestock.breeding_event.breeding_event_id closes the reproductive
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the farm facility, barn, or pen where the parturition event occurred. Supports location-based performance analysis and biosecurity management.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Premises Identification; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: herd_id
attributes.description: Reference to the herd or flock to which the dam belongs at the time of parturition. Used for herd-level performance reporting and APHIS traceability.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; FSIS Traceability Rule

attributes.name: observation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to weather.observation. Business justification: Neonatal survival and dystocia rates are correlated with weather conditions at birth (extreme cold causes hypothermia, heat stress affects dam). Parturition records with dystocia_flag and dam_post_par
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: primary_parturition_animal_id
attributes.description: Reference to the female parent (dam) animal record that gave birth. Links to the animal master record for the dam, enabling lineage tracing and dam performance analytics.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module

attributes.name: primary_parturition_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the farm worker or veterinary staff member who attended and recorded the parturition event. Used for workforce accountability and SOP compliance tracking.
attributes.references: OSHA; GLOBALG.A.P. Worker Health and Safety Module

attributes.name: birth_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the parturition event occurred. Used as the primary date dimension for herd performance reporting, age calculation, and regulatory records.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; ISO 8601

attributes.name: birth_time
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the first offspring was born during the parturition event. Enables time-of-day analysis for staffing optimization and dystocia risk assessment.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; ISO 8601

attributes.name: birth_type
attributes.description: Classification of the parturition by number of offspring born in the event (e.g., single, twin, triplet). Impacts dam recovery protocols, colostrum management, and offspring survival rates.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; USDA APHIS

attributes.name: birth_weight_kg
attributes.description: Average birth weight in kilograms across all live offspring born in this parturition event. For individual offspring weights, see the offspring detail records. Used for growth performance benchmarking and genetic evaluation (EPD).
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; Beef Improvement Federation (BIF) EPD Standards; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: breeding_method
attributes.description: Method by which the dam was bred that resulted in this parturition: natural service, artificial insemination (AI), or embryo transfer (ET). Used for genetic program performance analysis and sire utilization reporting.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; Beef Improvement Federation (BIF)

attributes.name: colostrum_administered
attributes.description: Indicates whether colostrum was administered to the newborn offspring following birth. Critical for passive immunity transfer and neonatal survival; required for animal welfare compliance documentation.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Welfare Module; USDA APHIS; FSIS

attributes.name: colostrum_source
attributes.description: Source of colostrum provided to the newborn offspring: from the dam directly, pooled from other animals, commercial colostrum supplement, or frozen colostrum bank. Relevant for biosecurity and disease transmission risk management.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Welfare Module; USDA APHIS; FSIS Biosecurity Guidelines

attributes.name: colostrum_volume_ml
attributes.description: Volume of colostrum administered to the newborn offspring in millilitres. Used to verify adequate passive immunity transfer per species-specific protocols and animal welfare standards.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Welfare Module; USDA APHIS Neonatal Care Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this parturition record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule; SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: dam_body_condition_score
attributes.description: Body Condition Score (BCS) of the dam at the time of parturition, assessed on a standardized scale (e.g., 1–5 for cattle/sheep, 1–9 for swine). Indicates dam nutritional status and predicts post-partum reproductive performance.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; Beef Improvement Federation (BIF); GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module

attributes.name: dam_parity
attributes.description: The parity number (number of times the dam has given birth, including this event) at the time of parturition. First-parity animals carry higher dystocia risk; used for reproductive lifecycle analytics.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; Beef Improvement Federation (BIF)

attributes.name: dam_post_partum_status
attributes.description: Health status of the dam immediately following the parturition event. Drives post-partum care protocols, veterinary treatment scheduling, and culling decisions.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Welfare Module; USDA APHIS; FSIS

attributes.name: dystocia_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the parturition involved dystocia (difficult birth requiring intervention). Drives veterinary follow-up workflows and is used in sire EPD (Expected Progeny Difference) calculations.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; Beef Improvement Federation (BIF); GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Welfare Module

attributes.name: ease_of_birth_score
attributes.description: Standardized numeric score (typically 1–5 scale) indicating the difficulty of the parturition: 1=No assistance, 2=Easy pull, 3=Hard pull, 4=Mechanical assistance, 5=Caesarean/Veterinary. Used for dystocia tracking, sire selection, and animal welfare compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 1|2|3|4|5 — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; Beef Improvement Federation (BIF) Guidelines; GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Welfare

attributes.name: event_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the parturition event, used for cross-referencing with farm management systems (e.g., Granular, SAP) and regulatory reporting. Format: PART-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; ISO 11784/11785 Animal Identification

attributes.name: gestation_length_days
attributes.description: Number of days from confirmed conception or breeding date to the birth date. Compared against species-standard gestation norms to flag premature or overdue births and assess breeding program accuracy.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; Beef Improvement Federation (BIF)

attributes.name: intervention_type
attributes.description: Type of veterinary or assisted intervention performed during the parturition event. Used for dystocia severity classification, cost allocation, and sire/dam selection analytics.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Veterinary Standards; GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Welfare Module

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for attending staff or veterinarian to record additional observations about the parturition event not captured in structured fields (e.g., unusual presentations, environmental conditions, dam behavior).
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Record Keeping Requirements; USDA APHIS

attributes.name: offspring_born_alive
attributes.description: Count of offspring born alive during this parturition event. Key metric for reproductive efficiency reporting and herd performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; USDA APHIS

attributes.name: offspring_stillborn
attributes.description: Count of offspring born dead (stillborn) during this parturition event. Used for mortality analysis, genetic program evaluation, and animal welfare compliance reporting.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Welfare Module; USDA APHIS; FSIS

attributes.name: placenta_expelled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the placenta (afterbirth) was fully expelled following parturition. Retained placenta is a significant post-partum health risk requiring veterinary intervention; tracked for dam health monitoring.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Welfare Module; USDA APHIS Veterinary Standards

attributes.name: placenta_expulsion_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours after birth until the placenta was fully expelled. Values exceeding species-specific thresholds (e.g., >12 hours in cattle) trigger retained placenta alerts and veterinary follow-up workflows.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Welfare Module; USDA APHIS Veterinary Standards

attributes.name: presentation_type
attributes.description: Describes the position of the fetus at the time of delivery (anterior/normal, posterior/backward, transverse/sideways). Relevant for dystocia risk assessment and veterinary intervention records.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Veterinary Standards; GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Welfare

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of the parturition record within the farm management system. DRAFT indicates pending verification; CONFIRMED indicates validated entry; AMENDED indicates a corrected record; VOIDED indicates a data entry error.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; GLOBALG.A.P. Record Keeping Requirements; FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: season_code
attributes.description: Agricultural season in which the parturition event occurred. Used for seasonal performance benchmarking, feed planning, and herd management scheduling.
attributes.references: USDA NASS Agricultural Statistics; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this parturition record originated (e.g., Granular Farm Management, SAP S/4HANA, John Deere Operations Center, or manual entry). Used for data lineage and reconciliation in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance Policy; FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: species_code
attributes.description: Livestock species involved in the parturition event. Determines the applicable regulatory framework (FSIS, APHIS) and terminology (calving, farrowing, lambing, kidding, foaling).
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; FSIS Species Classification; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: total_offspring_born
attributes.description: Total count of offspring born during this parturition event, including stillborn. Used for litter size analytics and dam reproductive performance KPIs.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module; USDA APHIS

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this parturition record was most recently modified. Used for change detection in incremental Silver layer loads and audit compliance.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule; SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: veterinary_intervention
attributes.description: Indicates whether a licensed veterinarian was required to intervene during the parturition event (e.g., caesarean section, manual correction of malpresentation). Drives post-event health monitoring and cost tracking.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Veterinary Accreditation; GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Welfare; OSHA

products.name: health_treatment
products.description: Transactional record of every veterinary treatment, medical intervention, vaccination, and health protocol template for individual animals or groups. Captures treatment date, animal ID, record type (treatment_instance or protocol_template), treatment type (therapeutic, prophylactic, vaccination, metaphylaxis, arrival processing, parasite control), diagnosis code, clinical signs, drug/product name, active ingredient (AI), dosage, route of administration, withdrawal period (PHI/REI), booster due date (for vaccinations), vaccine manufacturer lot number, treated-by (veterinarian or farm staff), prescription/VFD reference, protocol reference (self-referencing FK for treatments following a protocol template), trigger criteria (temperature threshold, morbidity rate for protocol templates), treatment outcome, re-treatment flag, withdrawal status, earliest eligible harvest date, and veterinarian approval date. Serves as the consolidated SSOT for all animal health interventions and standardized health management procedures. Critical for FSIS antibiotic withdrawal period compliance, FDA VFD documentation, HACCP records, USDA residue avoidance programs, APHIS disease surveillance, GLOBALG.A.P. animal health certification, and herd health protocol management.
products.reference: FSIS Antibiotic Withdrawal / APHIS VFD / SAP QM

attributes.name: health_treatment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each health treatment record or protocol template in the livestock health management system. Primary key for the health_treatment data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; FSIS Antibiotic Withdrawal Compliance

attributes.name: animal_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual animal record in the livestock master data product. Populated for individual animal treatments; may be null for group-level treatments where group_id is used instead. Supports APHIS individual animal traceability requirements.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Animal Identification; COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) 7 CFR Part 60

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the farm, barn, pen, or facility location where the treatment was administered. Supports GIS-based disease mapping in Esri ArcGIS and pen-level health analytics for APHIS disease surveillance.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Disease Surveillance; Esri ArcGIS Geospatial Analysis; GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Health

attributes.name: health_protocol_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing foreign key to the parent protocol_template record in this same health_treatment product. Populated when this treatment_instance was executed following a standardized health management protocol. Null for ad-hoc treatments or for protocol_template records themselves.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Health Standard; USDA APHIS Herd Health Protocol Management

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.material_master. Business justification: Drug inventory management and withdrawal-period compliance reporting require linking each treatment to the inventory material master. Enables MRP-driven drug stock replenishment, cost-per-treatment ac

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: FDA GFI #213 and VFD regulations require antibiotic treatment events to be linked to the corresponding VFD regulatory filing. health_treatment.vfd_reference_number is a denormalized reference; a prope

Normalizing by a

attributes.name: booster_due_date
attributes.description: The date on which a follow-up booster vaccination is due for the treated animal, based on the vaccine manufacturer's protocol. Applicable only for vaccination treatment types requiring multi-dose schedules. Drives vaccination schedule alerts in the FMIS.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Veterinary Biologics; GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Health and Welfare Standard

attributes.name: clinical_signs
attributes.description: Free-text description of the observable clinical signs or symptoms presented by the animal or group at the time of treatment, as recorded by the attending veterinarian or farm staff. Supports HACCP documentation and veterinary case history.
attributes.references: HACCP 21 CFR Part 120; USDA APHIS Disease Surveillance; ISO 22000

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System-generated timestamp recording when this health treatment record was first created in the FMIS or SAP QM system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory record-keeping compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Reporting Controls; FSMA Record-Keeping Requirements 21 CFR Part 1

attributes.name: diagnosis_code
attributes.description: Standardized veterinary diagnosis code identifying the disease or condition being treated, aligned with USDA APHIS disease reporting codes or ICD-10-CM veterinary adaptations. Used for APHIS disease surveillance reporting and herd health analytics.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Disease Surveillance; ICD-10-CM Veterinary Adaptation; NAHMS (National Animal Health Monitoring System)

attributes.name: dosage_amount
attributes.description: Numeric quantity of the drug or vaccine product administered per animal or per unit of body weight, as prescribed. Used in conjunction with dosage_unit for complete dosage documentation required by FDA VFD and FSIS withdrawal compliance.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Regulations 21 CFR Part 558; FSIS Antibiotic Withdrawal Compliance

attributes.name: dosage_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the administered dosage amount (e.g., mL, mg, mg/kg body weight). Required for accurate withdrawal period calculation and FDA VFD documentation.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Regulations 21 CFR Part 558; FSIS Antibiotic Withdrawal Compliance

attributes.name: ear_tag_number
attributes.description: Physical ear tag identifier of the treated animal, denormalized from the animal master for rapid field lookup and cross-referencing with paper-based treatment logs. Supports USDA NAIS (National Animal Identification System) traceability.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS National Animal Identification System (NAIS); COOL 7 CFR Part 60

attributes.name: earliest_harvest_date
attributes.description: Calculated date on which the animal first becomes eligible for harvest or product collection after completing the mandatory withdrawal period. Derived from treatment_date plus withdrawal_days; stored as a business-critical compliance field to prevent premature slaughter and FSIS violations.
attributes.references: FSIS Antibiotic Withdrawal Compliance; USDA Residue Avoidance Program; GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Health

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional observations, special instructions, or contextual information recorded by the veterinarian or farm staff at the time of treatment. Supports HACCP documentation and veterinary case history completeness.
attributes.references: HACCP 21 CFR Part 120; GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Health Standard; ISO 22000

attributes.name: number_of_animals_treated
attributes.description: Count of individual animals included in this treatment event. Value is 1 for individual animal treatments; greater than 1 for group-level treatments such as metaphylaxis or arrival processing. Used for drug inventory reconciliation and treatment cost allocation.
attributes.references: FSIS Antibiotic Withdrawal Compliance; SAP S/4HANA MM Drug Inventory; GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Health

attributes.name: product_used_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the total_product_used quantity (e.g., mL, mg, doses). Required for drug inventory reconciliation and cost reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; FDA CVM Drug Label Requirements

attributes.name: record_type
attributes.description: Discriminator indicating whether this record represents an actual treatment event applied to an animal or group (treatment_instance) or a standardized health management protocol template used as a reference for future treatments (protocol_template). Drives downstream processing logic and reporting.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Health and Welfare Standard; USDA APHIS Veterinary Biologics

attributes.name: retreatment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this treatment record represents a re-treatment of an animal that did not respond adequately to a prior treatment for the same condition. True when this is a follow-up treatment; False for initial treatments. Supports antibiotic stewardship and treatment efficacy analytics.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Disease Surveillance; Antibiotic Stewardship Program Guidelines; GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Health

attributes.name: rfid_tag
attributes.description: Electronic RFID tag identifier associated with the treated animal, used for automated identification in chute-side treatment systems and integration with John Deere Operations Center livestock modules. Supports ISO 11784/11785 RFID standards.
attributes.references: ISO 11784/11785 RFID Animal Identification; USDA APHIS NAIS

attributes.name: route_of_administration
attributes.description: The method by which the drug or vaccine was delivered to the animal (e.g., subcutaneous injection, intramuscular injection, oral drench, topical pour-on, intranasal spray). Affects withdrawal period applicability and FSIS residue compliance.
attributes.references: FDA CVM Drug Approval; FSIS Antibiotic Withdrawal Compliance; GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Health

attributes.name: total_product_used
attributes.description: Total quantity of the drug or vaccine product consumed for this treatment event, calculated as dosage_amount multiplied by number_of_animals_treated. Stored for drug inventory depletion recording in SAP MM and cost-of-treatment reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module Drug Inventory; FSIS Antibiotic Withdrawal Compliance

attributes.name: treated_by_name
attributes.description: Full name of the veterinarian or farm staff member who administered the treatment. Captured for FSIS, HACCP, and GLOBALG.A.P. audit trail requirements. May be a licensed veterinarian (DVM) or trained farm employee acting under veterinary supervision.
attributes.references: FSIS HACCP Records; GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Health; FDA VCPR Requirements

attributes.name: treatment_cost
attributes.description: Total cost of the treatment event in the farm's operating currency, including drug product cost and veterinary service fees where applicable. Used for herd health cost-of-production analysis, OPEX reporting, and Granular Farm Management financial planning integration.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management Financial Planning; SAP S/4HANA CO Module; GAAP Cost Accounting

attributes.name: treatment_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the veterinary treatment, vaccination, or health intervention was administered to the animal or group. This is the principal real-world event date used for withdrawal period calculations, FSIS compliance, and HACCP records.
attributes.references: FSIS Antibiotic Withdrawal Compliance; USDA APHIS Disease Surveillance; HACCP 21 CFR Part 120

attributes.name: treatment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the treatment event or protocol template, used for cross-referencing with veterinary records, VFD documentation, and SAP QM notifications. Format typically follows farm-assigned numbering conventions (e.g., TRT-2024-00123).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; FDA Veterinary Feed Directive (VFD) Regulations 21 CFR Part 558

attributes.name: treatment_outcome
attributes.description: Clinical outcome of the treatment as assessed at the end of the treatment course or at follow-up evaluation. Used for herd health analytics, treatment efficacy reporting, and antibiotic stewardship program monitoring.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Disease Surveillance; GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Health; Antibiotic Stewardship Program Guidelines

attributes.name: treatment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the treatment record. 'draft' indicates a record in preparation; 'active' indicates an ongoing treatment; 'completed' indicates the treatment course is finished; 'cancelled' indicates the treatment was voided; 'pending_approval' indicates awaiting veterinarian sign-off for VFD-regulated products.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Regulations 21 CFR Part 558; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

attributes.name: treatment_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which the treatment was administered, captured for IoT-integrated barn management systems and time-sensitive drug administration protocols requiring exact timing records.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; ISO 22000 Food Safety Management

attributes.name: treatment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the treatment purpose. 'therapeutic' treats an existing disease; 'prophylactic' prevents disease in healthy animals; 'vaccination' administers a biological vaccine; 'metaphylaxis' treats an entire group when a portion shows disease; 'arrival_processing' covers standard processing at receiving; 'parasite_control' targets internal or external parasites.
attributes.references: FDA Center for Veterinary Medicine (CVM); USDA APHIS Veterinary Biologics; GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Health

attributes.name: trigger_criteria
attributes.description: For protocol_template records, describes the specific conditions that trigger execution of this protocol (e.g., 'rectal temperature > 104°F', 'morbidity rate > 10% in pen within 7 days', 'BRD pull rate exceeds threshold'). Null for treatment_instance records.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Health Standard; USDA APHIS Herd Health Protocol Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System-generated timestamp recording the most recent modification to this health treatment record. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking for regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Reporting Controls; FSMA Record-Keeping Requirements 21 CFR Part 1

attributes.name: vaccine_lot_number
attributes.description: The manufacturer's lot number (batch identifier) for the vaccine product administered. Required for USDA APHIS Veterinary Biologics traceability, adverse event reporting, and product recall management. Applicable only when treatment_type is 'vaccination'.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Veterinary Biologics Regulations 9 CFR Part 113; FDA Biologics Lot Release

attributes.name: veterinarian_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the supervising veterinarian reviewed and approved this treatment record or protocol template. Required for VFD-regulated antibiotic treatments and GLOBALG.A.P. animal health certification audits.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Regulations 21 CFR Part 558; GLOBALG.A.P. Animal Health Standard; HACCP 21 CFR Part 120

attributes.name: veterinarian_license_number
attributes.description: State-issued veterinary license number of the attending or supervising veterinarian responsible for the treatment authorization. Required for VFD documentation and VCPR compliance. Null when treatment is administered by non-veterinary farm staff under a standing order.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Regulations 21 CFR Part 558; VCPR Requirements; State Veterinary Practice Acts

attributes.name: vfd_reference_number
attributes.description: The official Veterinary Feed Directive (VFD) document reference number issued by the licensed veterinarian authorizing the use of a VFD antibiotic in animal feed. Mandatory for medically important antimicrobials used in feed per FDA VFD regulations. Null for non-VFD treatments.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Regulations 21 CFR Part 558; FDA Guidance for Industry #213 Antimicrobial Resistance

attributes.name: withdrawal_days
attributes.description: The mandatory number of days that must elapse after the last treatment before the animal or its products (meat, milk, eggs) may enter the food supply, as specified on the drug label. Also referred to as Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) for meat animals. Critical for FSIS residue avoidance compliance.
attributes.references: FSIS Antibiotic Withdrawal Compliance; FDA CVM Drug Label Requirements; USDA Residue Avoidance Program

attributes.name: withdrawal_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status of the animal with respect to drug withdrawal period. 'in_withdrawal' indicates the animal cannot yet be harvested; 'cleared' indicates the withdrawal period has elapsed; 'not_applicable' applies to non-withdrawal products or protocol templates.
attributes.references: FSIS Antibiotic Withdrawal Compliance; USDA Residue Avoidance Program

products.name: vaccination_record
products.description: Transactional record of each vaccination administered to an individual animal or group. Captures vaccination date, animal or group ID, vaccine product name, manufacturer lot number, dosage, route, booster due date, administering technician, veterinary prescription reference, and compliance status against the herd vaccination schedule. Supports APHIS disease surveillance, FSIS pre-harvest food safety, and GLOBALG.A.P. animal health certification.
