attributes.references: PAACO Feedlot Audit Protocol; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard v5.4; Welfare Quality Protocol

attributes.name: antibiotic_use_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether antibiotic treatments were administered to animals in the assessed pen or herd during the assessment period. Supports antibiotic stewardship tracking and withdrawal period compliance.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Veterinary Feed Directive; FDA Guidance for Industry #213; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard v5.4; FSMA

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the animal welfare evaluation was physically conducted at the pen or herd location. This is the principal real-world event date for this transaction.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard v5.4; PAACO Feedlot Audit Protocol; USDA APHIS Animal Welfare Act

attributes.name: assessment_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the welfare assessment observation period concluded, enabling duration calculation and assessor productivity tracking.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard v5.4; ISO 22000:2018

attributes.name: assessment_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the assessment, used in audit documentation, corrective action reports, and certification body submissions. Format: AWA-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard v5.4; SQF Code Edition 9; PAACO Feedlot Audit Protocol

attributes.name: assessment_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the welfare assessment observation period began, used for duration tracking and scheduling compliance.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard v5.4; ISO 22000:2018

attributes.name: assessment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the welfare assessment record, tracking workflow from initial data entry through review and closure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|in_progress|completed|reviewed|closed|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard v5.4; SQF Code Edition 9

attributes.name: assessment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the assessment purpose: routine internal evaluation, pre-certification audit preparation, third-party certification audit, corrective action follow-up, or regulatory inspection.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard v5.4; USDA APHIS; FSMA; SQF Code Edition 9

attributes.name: assessor_certification_number
attributes.description: Professional certification or accreditation number of the assessor (e.g., PAACO-certified auditor number, veterinary license number), required for certification body submissions.
attributes.references: PAACO Certification Requirements; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard v5.4; USDA APHIS

attributes.name: assessor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who conducted the welfare assessment, captured for audit documentation and certification body reporting where assessor identity must be recorded.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard v5.4; PAACO Feedlot Audit Protocol; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: body_condition_score
attributes.description: Numeric score assessing the nutritional status and fat reserves of assessed animals using the standardized Body Condition Scoring (BCS) scale (typically 1-5 for cattle, 1-9 for swine). A key welfare indicator for feed adequacy.
attributes.references: PAACO Feedlot Audit Protocol; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard v5.4; Welfare Quality Protocol; USDA APHIS

attributes.name: certification_body
attributes.description: Name of the third-party certification or accreditation body associated with this assessment (e.g., GLOBALG.A.P. approved certifier, SQF certification body, BRC-approved auditor). Required for certification audit traceability.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard v5.4; SQF Code Edition 9; BRC Global Standard; GFSI

attributes.name: certification_reference
attributes.description: External reference number or audit report number issued by the certification body for this assessment, enabling cross-referencing with certification body records and retailer audit portals.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard v5.4; SQF Code Edition 9; BRC Global Standard; GFSI

attributes.name: cleanliness_score
attributes.description: Scored assessment of animal hygiene and coat/skin cleanliness, reflecting housing conditions, stocking density, and manure management. Expressed on the protocol-defined scale.
attributes.references: PAACO Feedlot Audit Protocol; Welfare Quality Protocol; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard v5.4

attributes.name: corrective_action_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of identified non-conformances and required corrective actions, including specific welfare deficiencies observed and recommended remediation steps.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard v5.4; SQF Code Edition 9; BRC Global Standard; ISO 22000:2018

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which identified corrective actions must be implemented and verified, as agreed with the certification body or internal quality management system.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard v5.4; SQF Code Edition 9; ISO 22000:2018

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether one or more corrective actions were identified during this assessment. Triggers corrective action workflow and follow-up assessment scheduling.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard v5.4; SQF Code Edition 9; BRC Global Standard; ISO 22000:2018

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this assessment record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FSMA Recordkeeping Requirements; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: fear_response_score
attributes.description: Behavioral welfare indicator measuring animal fear and stress response during human approach or handling, scored per the applicable protocol (e.g., flight zone test, avoidance distance). Reflects human-animal relationship quality.
attributes.references: Welfare Quality Protocol; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard v5.4; Five Freedoms (Freedom from Fear and Distress)

attributes.name: feed_access_score
attributes.description: Scored assessment of animal access to adequate feed, including feeder space, feed availability, and diet appropriateness. Reflects Freedom from Hunger under the Five Freedoms framework.
attributes.references: PAACO Feedlot Audit Protocol; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard v5.4; Five Freedoms (Freedom from Hunger); Welfare Quality Protocol

attributes.name: follow_up_assessment_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next welfare assessment or corrective action verification visit, set based on assessment outcome rating and certification body requirements.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard v5.4; SQF Code Edition 9; PAACO Feedlot Audit Protocol

attributes.name: injury_prevalence_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of assessed animals exhibiting visible injuries, lesions, wounds, or integument alterations (e.g., tail biting, horn injuries, pressure sores). Key welfare outcome indicator.
attributes.references: PAACO Feedlot Audit Protocol; Welfare Quality Protocol; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard v5.4; USDA FSIS

attributes.name: lameness_score
attributes.description: Prevalence rate or average locomotion score for lameness observed in the assessed population, expressed as a percentage of lame animals or a standardized locomotion score. Critical welfare and productivity indicator.
attributes.references: PAACO Feedlot Audit Protocol; Welfare Quality Protocol; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard v5.4

attributes.name: mortality_rate_pct
attributes.description: Observed mortality rate for the assessed pen or herd during the evaluation period, expressed as a percentage. A critical welfare outcome metric tracked against PAACO and GLOBALG.A.P. thresholds.
attributes.references: PAACO Feedlot Audit Protocol; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard v5.4; USDA APHIS; USDA FSIS

attributes.name: overall_welfare_score
attributes.description: Composite welfare score calculated per the applied protocol methodology, aggregating all scored indicators into a single numeric outcome. Used for trend analysis, certification thresholds, and retailer reporting.
attributes.references: PAACO Feedlot Audit Protocol; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard v5.4; Welfare Quality Protocol; SQF Code Edition 9

attributes.name: respiratory_disease_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of assessed animals showing clinical signs of respiratory disease (e.g., Bovine Respiratory Disease complex). Tracked as a health and welfare outcome indicator per PAACO audit criteria.
attributes.references: PAACO Feedlot Audit Protocol; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard v5.4; USDA APHIS

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this assessment record originated (e.g., SAP QM module, Granular Farm Management, Trimble Ag Software, manual entry, or third-party auditor portal). Supports data lineage in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: FSMA Recordkeeping Requirements; SOX Section 404; ISO 22000:2018

attributes.name: species_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the animal species being assessed. Determines applicable welfare standards, scoring thresholds, and regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard v5.4; Codex Alimentarius Commission

attributes.name: stocking_density_score
attributes.description: Scored evaluation of animal stocking density relative to protocol-defined space allowances (e.g., square feet per animal). Reflects freedom of movement and housing welfare compliance.
attributes.references: PAACO Feedlot Audit Protocol; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard v5.4; Five Freedoms (Freedom to Express Normal Behaviour); EU Council Directive 98/58/EC

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent modification to this assessment record, supporting audit trail and change management requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FSMA Recordkeeping Requirements; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: water_access_score
attributes.description: Scored assessment of animal access to clean, fresh water including drinker availability, functionality, and cleanliness. Reflects Freedom from Thirst under the Five Freedoms framework.
attributes.references: PAACO Feedlot Audit Protocol; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard v5.4; Five Freedoms (Freedom from Thirst); Welfare Quality Protocol

attributes.name: welfare_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for assessor observations, contextual notes, environmental conditions at time of assessment, or additional welfare findings not captured in scored indicators.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard v5.4; PAACO Feedlot Audit Protocol; SQF Code Edition 9

attributes.name: welfare_outcome_rating
attributes.description: Categorical rating derived from the overall welfare score, classifying the assessment outcome against protocol-defined thresholds. Used for pass/fail determination in certification audits.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard v5.4; PAACO Feedlot Audit Protocol; SQF Code Edition 9; BRC Global Standard

products.name: semen_inventory
products.description: Master record tracking the inventory of semen straws and embryos held for artificial insemination (AI) and embryo transfer (ET) programs. Captures sire ID, sire name, breed, genetic registration number, EPD values (calving ease, birth weight, weaning weight, yearling weight, milk, marbling, REA), genomic-enhanced EPD flag, semen supplier, collection date, lot number, quantity on hand (straws/embryos), storage tank ID, storage location (canister/goblet/cane), conception rate history, cost per unit, and quality grade (post-thaw motility). Supports genetic selection decisions, AI program planning, and breeding cost accounting.
products.reference: AI Semen Catalog / Breed Association EPD

attributes.name: semen_inventory_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each semen or embryo inventory record in the artificial insemination (AI) and embryo transfer (ET) program. Primary key for the semen_inventory data product.
attributes.references: APHIS Animal Identification Standards; USDA National Animal Identification System (NAIS)

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the liquid nitrogen (LN2) cryogenic storage tank in which the semen straws or embryos are stored. Enables physical location tracking for retrieval, tank maintenance scheduling, and inventory audits.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; IETS Cryopreservation Standards; ISO 22000

attributes.name: canister_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the canister within the storage tank where the goblet or cane holding the semen straws or embryos is located. Provides precise sub-tank location for efficient retrieval during AI or ET procedures.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; IETS Cryopreservation Standards

attributes.name: certificate_of_analysis_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.certificate_of_analysis. Business justification: Semen suppliers provide COAs for each lot documenting post_thaw_motility_pct, health_cert_number, and quality_grade. semen_inventory has coa_document_reference as plain text. Linking to certificate_of
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: herd_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to livestock.herd. Business justification: semen_inventory tracks AI semen and embryo inventory used in breeding programs. Each semen inventory is typically managed at the herd or operation level. Adding herd_id → livestock.herd.herd_id connec
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: APHIS VS 16-3 requires import permits for bovine semen imported from foreign countries. semen_inventory.health_cert_number is a denormalized reference; a permit_id FK links the semen lot to the specif
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.shipment. Business justification: Semen inventory is received via inbound shipments requiring cryogenic cold chain management. Linking semen_inventory to shipment enables cold chain excursion verification, COA matching against receive
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Semen procurement requires linking each inventory lot to the approved vendor for supplier qualification tracking, COA verification, and recall response. A domain expert expects semen lots to reference
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: breed
attributes.description: Breed classification of the sire (e.g., Angus, Hereford, Holstein, Simmental, Charolais). Drives genetic selection compatibility, EPD benchmarking, and breed-specific AI program planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Angus|Hereford|Holstein|Simmental|Charolais|Brahman|Limousin|Gelbvieh|Red Angus|Shorthorn — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; Breed Association Standards; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module

attributes.name: collection_date
attributes.description: Date on which semen was collected from the sire or embryo was harvested from the donor dam. Critical for age-of-material tracking, quality assessment, and regulatory traceability under USDA APHIS import/export rules.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS 9 CFR Part 93; IETS Standards

attributes.name: conception_rate_pct
attributes.description: Historical conception rate (pregnancy rate per AI attempt) achieved with this sire's semen lot, expressed as a percentage. Derived from breeding outcome records and used for genetic selection decisions and AI program planning. Updated as breeding results are recorded.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; NAAB Sire Summary; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock

attributes.name: conception_rate_sample_size
attributes.description: Number of AI attempts used to calculate the historical conception rate for this semen lot. Provides statistical confidence context for the conception_rate_pct value; small sample sizes indicate lower reliability.
attributes.references: NAAB Sire Summary; USDA APHIS

attributes.name: cost_per_unit
attributes.description: Procurement cost per semen straw, embryo, or dose in USD. Used for breeding program cost accounting, COGS calculation, and ROI analysis of AI versus natural service programs. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM purchase order pricing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; GAAP; IFRS IAS 2 Inventories

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the semen inventory record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail, data lineage, and FSMA traceability requirements.
attributes.references: FSMA; ISO 22000; SOX; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the cost per unit value (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR). Supports multi-currency procurement from international semen suppliers.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS; GAAP

attributes.name: epd_accuracy
attributes.description: Accuracy value (0.00 to 1.00) associated with the sire's EPD estimates, reflecting the reliability of the EPD based on the amount of progeny and genomic data available. Higher accuracy reduces the risk of genetic selection errors.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; Breed Association EPD Standards; NAAB

attributes.name: epd_birth_weight
attributes.description: Expected Progeny Difference (EPD) value for birth weight in pounds. Used alongside calving ease EPD to assess calving difficulty risk and select appropriate sires for heifers versus mature cows.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; Breed Association EPD Standards; NAAB

attributes.name: epd_calving_ease
attributes.description: Expected Progeny Difference (EPD) value for calving ease, expressed as a percentage of unassisted births. Higher values indicate easier calving. Critical for heifer breeding decisions to minimize dystocia risk.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; Breed Association EPD Standards (e.g., American Angus Association); NAAB

attributes.name: epd_marbling
attributes.description: Expected Progeny Difference (EPD) value for marbling (intramuscular fat), expressed in marbling score units. Drives carcass quality grade outcomes (USDA Choice/Prime) and is a key metric for beef quality programs.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Beef Grading Standards; Breed Association EPD Standards; NAAB

attributes.name: epd_milk
attributes.description: Expected Progeny Difference (EPD) value for milk production, expressed in pounds of weaning weight attributed to the milking ability of daughters. Used for selecting sires whose daughters will be retained as replacement heifers.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; Breed Association EPD Standards; NAAB

attributes.name: epd_rea
attributes.description: Expected Progeny Difference (EPD) value for Ribeye Area (REA) in square inches. Indicates the sire's genetic potential to transmit muscle mass to offspring, influencing USDA yield grade and cutability.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Beef Grading Standards; Breed Association EPD Standards; NAAB

attributes.name: epd_weaning_weight
attributes.description: Expected Progeny Difference (EPD) value for weaning weight in pounds. Indicates the sire's genetic potential to transmit growth performance to offspring at weaning age (approximately 205 days). Key metric for cow-calf operation profitability.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; Breed Association EPD Standards; NAAB

attributes.name: epd_yearling_weight
attributes.description: Expected Progeny Difference (EPD) value for yearling weight in pounds. Reflects the sire's genetic potential for post-weaning growth performance, critical for stocker and feedlot program sire selection.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; Breed Association EPD Standards; NAAB

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which the semen straws or embryos are no longer certified for use, as specified by the supplier on the COA. Supports inventory expiry management and prevents use of out-of-date genetic material.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; NAAB Semen Standards; ISO 22000

attributes.name: genomic_enhanced_epd
attributes.description: Indicates whether the EPD values for this sire have been enhanced using genomic (DNA marker) data, resulting in higher accuracy predictions. Genomic-Enhanced EPDs (GE-EPDs) carry greater reliability, especially for young sires with limited progeny data.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; Breed Association Genomic Testing Standards; NAAB

attributes.name: goblet_cane_position
attributes.description: Specific goblet and cane position within the canister where the semen straws or embryos are stored (e.g., 'G2-C3'). Enables precise physical retrieval and supports inventory audit accuracy.
attributes.references: IETS Cryopreservation Standards; USDA APHIS

attributes.name: initial_quantity
attributes.description: Original quantity of semen straws or embryos received at the time of the lot's first receipt into inventory. Used as the baseline for consumption tracking, utilization rate analysis, and breeding cost accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the semen or embryo inventory record. Drives availability for AI scheduling, quarantine holds for health compliance, and depletion tracking. Aligns with Manhattan Associates WMS inventory status and SAP S/4HANA MM stock status.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; FDA 9 CFR Part 93; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the semen inventory record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, data synchronization, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: FSMA; ISO 22000; SOX; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Batch tracking identifier assigned by the semen collection facility or supplier to the specific collection lot. Used for traceability, quality recall, and conception rate analysis by collection batch. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA QM batch management.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; FDA 21 CFR Part 58; GLOBALG.A.P. Livestock Base Module

attributes.name: material_type
attributes.description: Classification of the biological material stored in inventory. Distinguishes between conventional semen straws, sexed semen straws, and embryos for AI and ET program planning and cost accounting.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; IETS (International Embryo Technology Society) Standards

attributes.name: post_thaw_motility_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of progressively motile sperm cells observed after thawing, as reported on the Certificate of Analysis (COA) from the semen supplier. Primary quality grade indicator; minimum acceptable threshold is typically 30-35% per NAAB standards. Drives AI program quality decisions.
attributes.references: NAAB (National Association of Animal Breeders) Semen Standards; USDA APHIS; ISO 22000

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchase Order (PO) number associated with the procurement of this semen lot. Links the inventory record to the procurement transaction for AP invoice matching, GRN reconciliation, and cost accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: quality_grade
attributes.description: Overall quality classification of the semen lot based on post-thaw motility, morphology, and concentration assessments from the COA. Used for AI program tier selection and supplier quality management.
attributes.references: NAAB Semen Standards; USDA APHIS; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: quantity_on_hand
attributes.description: Current count of semen straws or embryos physically available in storage. Decremented upon each AI or ET use event. Core inventory metric for AI program planning and reorder decisions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Inventory Management; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: Date the semen straws or embryos were physically received into the farm's storage facility. Used for Goods Receipt Note (GRN) reconciliation against purchase orders in SAP S/4HANA MM and for storage duration tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM GRN; USDA APHIS

attributes.name: sex_sort_target
attributes.description: Target sex for sorted semen straws (female for heifer production, male for bull calf production). Only applicable when sexed_semen is True. Drives replacement heifer program planning and calf crop gender management.
attributes.references: NAAB Semen Standards; USDA APHIS

attributes.name: sexed_semen
attributes.description: Indicates whether the semen straws in this inventory lot are sex-sorted (sexed semen), allowing producers to select for heifer or bull calves. Sexed semen commands a premium price and has lower conception rates than conventional semen.
attributes.references: NAAB Semen Standards; USDA APHIS

attributes.name: sire_name
attributes.description: Common or registered name of the sire animal from which semen was collected. Used for genetic selection decisions, AI program planning, and breeder communications.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; Breed Association Standards

attributes.name: sire_registration_number
attributes.description: Official breed association registration number for the sire (bull or ram) from which semen was collected. Used for genetic pedigree verification, EPD lookup, and regulatory compliance with breed registries (e.g., American Angus Association, Holstein Association USA).
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; Breed Association Registration Standards; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit in which the genetic material quantity is counted and tracked (straw for semen, embryo for ET material, dose for bulk liquid nitrogen containers). Ensures consistent inventory accounting across material types.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM UoM Standards; IETS

products.name: veterinary_prescription
products.description: Master record for veterinary prescriptions and Veterinary Feed Directives (VFDs) issued by a licensed veterinarian for use on the operation. Captures prescription date, issuing veterinarian (DVM license number), drug or medicated feed product, approved species and indication, dosage instructions, withdrawal period, quantity authorized, expiration date, VCPR (Veterinarian-Client-Patient Relationship) reference, and regulatory filing status. Required for FDA VFD compliance and FSIS antibiotic stewardship documentation.
products.reference: FDA VFD Rule / AMDUCA / FSIS

attributes.name: veterinary_prescription_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each veterinary prescription or Veterinary Feed Directive (VFD) record. Serves as the primary key for the veterinary_prescription data product.
attributes.references: FDA Veterinary Feed Directive Rule (21 CFR Part 558); FSIS Antibiotic Stewardship

attributes.name: animal_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific animal or group of animals for which the prescription was issued. Links to the livestock animal master record.
attributes.references: APHIS Animal Identification; USDA NAIS

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the licensed veterinarian (DVM) who issued the prescription. Required for VCPR validation and FDA VFD compliance.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Rule 21 CFR Part 558; APHIS Veterinary Accreditation

attributes.name: health_protocol_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to livestock.health_protocol. Business justification: veterinary_prescription is issued in accordance with established health protocols. Linking veterinary_prescription.health_protocol_id → livestock.health_protocol.health_protocol_id enables protocol-le

attributes.name: herd_id
attributes.description: Reference to the herd or flock for which the prescription applies when issued at the group level rather than individual animal level.
attributes.references: APHIS Herd Management; USDA NAIS

attributes.name: input_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.input_product. Business justification: VFD regulatory compliance and VCPR audit trails require prescriptions to reference the authoritative input_product record. Enables drug class verification, EPA/FDA registration validation, and withdra
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: production_group_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to livestock.production_group. Business justification: veterinary_prescription (including VFDs) is frequently issued for an entire production group rather than individual animals. The existing animal_id FK covers individual prescriptions, but group-level
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: FDA GFI #213 requires VFD prescriptions for medically important antibiotics to be filed with the regulatory agency. veterinary_prescription.regulatory_filing_status is denormalized; a regulatory_filin
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: animal_weight_kg
attributes.description: The average or representative body weight in kilograms of the animals at the time of prescription. Used for weight-based dosage calculations and to verify appropriate dosing.
attributes.references: FDA Animal Drug Regulations 21 CFR Part 514; FSIS Antibiotic Stewardship

attributes.name: approved_species
attributes.description: The animal species for which the drug is approved and prescribed (e.g., cattle, swine, poultry, sheep, goats). Must align with FDA label approval or AMDUCA extra-label use authorization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cattle|swine|poultry|sheep|goats|equine|aquaculture — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Animal Drug Regulations 21 CFR Part 514; AMDUCA Extra-Label Drug Use; APHIS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this veterinary prescription record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and FSIS record retention compliance (VFD records must be retained for 2 years).

attributes.name: dosage_amount
attributes.description: The numeric quantity of drug to be administered per dose or per unit of feed (e.g., grams per ton of feed, mg per kg body weight). The principal quantitative fact for this prescription.
attributes.references: FDA Animal Drug Regulations 21 CFR Part 514; FDA VFD Rule 21 CFR Part 558.6(b)(6)

attributes.name: dosage_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency or schedule at which the prescribed drug is to be administered (e.g., once daily, continuous feed, single dose). Required on the prescription label per FDA regulations.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Rule 21 CFR Part 558.6(b)(6); FDA Animal Drug Regulations

attributes.name: dosage_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the prescribed dosage amount (e.g., g/ton for medicated feed, mg/kg for injectable drugs). Required for accurate compounding and dispensing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: g/ton|mg/kg|mg/lb|g/head/day|oz/ton|ppm|mL/head — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Animal Drug Regulations 21 CFR Part 514; USP Veterinary Drug Standards

attributes.name: drug_class
attributes.description: Antimicrobial or pharmacological class of the prescribed drug (e.g., tetracycline, macrolide, ionophore, beta-lactam). Used for antibiotic stewardship analytics and WHO critically important antimicrobial (CIA) classification tracking.
attributes.references: WHO Critically Important Antimicrobials List; FDA Guidance for Industry #152; FSIS Antibiotic Stewardship

attributes.name: dvm_license_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) License Number
attributes.description: The state-issued veterinary license number of the prescribing veterinarian (DVM). Required on all VFD documents per FDA regulation and for FSIS antibiotic stewardship audit trails.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Rule 21 CFR Part 558.6(b)(3); State Veterinary Licensing Boards; APHIS Veterinary Accreditation

attributes.name: dvm_state
attributes.description: The US state in which the prescribing veterinarian holds their active license. Required for cross-state regulatory compliance verification.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Rule 21 CFR Part 558.6(b)(3); State Veterinary Practice Acts

attributes.name: egg_withdrawal_days
attributes.description: The number of days eggs must be withheld from sale following drug administration in laying poultry. Applicable only for poultry operations; null for non-poultry species.
attributes.references: FDA Animal Drug Regulations 21 CFR Part 514; FSIS Residue Avoidance; Codex Alimentarius MRL Standards

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date after which the prescription is no longer valid and the authorized drug or medicated feed may not be dispensed or used. FDA VFD regulations require an expiration date not to exceed 6 months from issue date for most VFDs.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Rule 21 CFR Part 558.6(b)(9); FSIS Antibiotic Stewardship

attributes.name: extra_label_use
attributes.description: Indicates whether this prescription involves extra-label drug use (use of an FDA-approved drug in a manner not specified on the approved label). Extra-label use requires a valid VCPR and is regulated under AMDUCA (Animal Medicinal Drug Use Clarification Act).
attributes.references: AMDUCA 21 CFR Part 530; FDA Extra-Label Drug Use in Animals; AVMA Guidelines

attributes.name: indication
attributes.description: The disease, condition, or clinical indication for which the drug is being prescribed (e.g., bovine respiratory disease, necrotic enteritis, mastitis prevention). Required for VCPR documentation and FSIS antibiotic use justification.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Rule 21 CFR Part 558.6(b)(5); FSIS Antibiotic Stewardship; VCPR Requirements

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the veterinarian issued the prescription or VFD. This is the principal real-world event date for the prescription transaction and is required on all VFD documents per FDA regulation.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Rule 21 CFR Part 558.6(b)(1); FSIS Antibiotic Stewardship

attributes.name: milk_withdrawal_days
attributes.description: The number of days milk must be withheld from sale following drug administration in dairy animals. Separate from meat withdrawal period as milk and meat withdrawal periods often differ for the same drug.
attributes.references: FDA Animal Drug Regulations 21 CFR Part 514; FSIS Residue Avoidance; Codex Alimentarius MRL Standards

attributes.name: number_of_animals
attributes.description: The total count of animals covered under this prescription or VFD. Required on VFD documents per FDA regulation and used for dosage calculation and antibiotic use density metrics.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Rule 21 CFR Part 558.6(b)(7); FSIS Antibiotic Stewardship

attributes.name: prescription_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to the prescription or VFD at issuance. Used for regulatory filing, pharmacy dispensing, and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Rule 21 CFR Part 558.6; FSIS Antibiotic Stewardship Documentation

attributes.name: prescription_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the veterinary prescription. Active indicates the prescription is valid and may be dispensed; expired indicates the expiration date has passed; cancelled indicates the prescribing veterinarian voided the order; filled indicates the full authorized quantity has been dispensed.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Rule 21 CFR Part 558; FSIS Antibiotic Stewardship

attributes.name: prescription_type
attributes.description: Classification of the prescription by regulatory category. VFD (Veterinary Feed Directive) applies to medicated feed products; prescription_drug covers legend drugs requiring a valid VCPR; OTC_extra_label covers over-the-counter drugs used in an extra-label manner; compounded covers compounded preparations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: VFD|prescription_drug|OTC_extra_label|compounded — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Animal Drug Regulations 21 CFR Parts 514, 558; AMDUCA Extra-Label Drug Use

attributes.name: production_class
attributes.description: The production class or use category of the animals covered by the prescription (e.g., beef cattle, dairy cattle, broiler, layer). Determines applicable withdrawal periods and regulatory requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: beef_cattle|dairy_cattle|swine_market|swine_breeding|broiler|layer|turkey|sheep|goat|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Animal Drug Regulations 21 CFR Part 514; FSIS Residue Avoidance; USDA NASS

attributes.name: quantity_authorized
attributes.description: The total quantity of drug or medicated feed product authorized under this prescription (e.g., total grams, total pounds of medicated feed, total vials). Controls dispensing limits and prevents over-use.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Rule 21 CFR Part 558.6(b)(8); FSIS Antibiotic Stewardship

attributes.name: quantity_dispensed
attributes.description: The cumulative quantity of drug or medicated feed product actually dispensed against this prescription to date. Used to track partial fills and ensure authorized quantity is not exceeded.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Rule 21 CFR Part 558; FSIS Antibiotic Stewardship

attributes.name: quantity_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the authorized quantity (e.g., lbs of medicated feed, mL of injectable solution, number of vials). Required for dispensing accuracy and inventory reconciliation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: lbs|kg|g|tons|mL|vials|tablets|oz — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA VFD Rule 21 CFR Part 558.6(b)(8); USP Veterinary Drug Standards

attributes.name: route_of_administration
attributes.description: The method by which the drug is to be administered to the animal (e.g., oral via medicated feed, intramuscular injection, subcutaneous injection). Required for proper drug use and withdrawal period determination. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oral|injectable_IM|injectable_IV|injectable_SQ|topical|intramammary|intrauterine — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Animal Drug Regulations 21 CFR Part 514; AMDUCA Extra-Label Drug Use

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field for any additional veterinarian instructions, warnings, or conditions associated with the prescription (e.g., do not use in animals producing milk for human consumption, refrigerate after opening). Captures label-specific or VCPR-specific guidance.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Rule 21 CFR Part 558.6(b)(10); AVMA Prescribing Guidelines

attributes.name: treatment_duration_days
attributes.description: The number of days the prescribed drug treatment is to be administered. Used to calculate total drug quantity needed, withdrawal period start date, and antibiotic use days for stewardship reporting.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Rule 21 CFR Part 558.6(b)(6); FSIS Antibiotic Stewardship

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this veterinary prescription record was last modified. Supports audit trail requirements and change tracking for regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Rule 21 CFR Part 558.6(c) Record Retention; FSMA Recordkeeping Requirements; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: vcpr_reference
attributes.description: The reference number or identifier for the established Veterinarian-Client-Patient Relationship (VCPR) under which this prescription was issued. A valid VCPR is a legal prerequisite for issuing any veterinary prescription or VFD under FDA regulations.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Rule 21 CFR Part 558.6(b)(2); AVMA VCPR Policy; State Veterinary Practice Acts

attributes.name: vfd_distributor_name
attributes.description: The name of the licensed feed manufacturer or distributor authorized to produce and supply the medicated feed under this VFD. Required on VFD documents per FDA regulation for medicated feed traceability.
attributes.references: FDA VFD Rule 21 CFR Part 558.6(b)(4); FDA Medicated Feed Regulations

attributes.name: withdrawal_end_date
attributes.description: The calculated calendar date on which the withdrawal period ends and the animal or animal products are cleared for harvest or sale. Derived from last treatment date plus withdrawal_period_days; stored for operational scheduling and FSIS compliance verification.
attributes.references: FDA Animal Drug Regulations 21 CFR Part 514; FSIS Residue Avoidance; USDA FSIS Directive 10,800.1

attributes.name: withdrawal_period_days
attributes.description: The mandatory Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) — the number of days that must elapse after the last drug administration before the animal or animal products (meat, milk, eggs) may enter the food supply. Critical for FSIS food safety compliance and MRL (Maximum Residue Limit) adherence.
attributes.references: FDA Animal Drug Regulations 21 CFR Part 514; FSIS Residue Avoidance; USDA FSIS Directive 10,800.1; Codex Alimentarius MRL Standards

products.name: animal_transaction
products.description: Transactional record of all livestock transfer events — both purchases (inbound) and sales (outbound) — between the operation and external parties. Captures transaction date, transaction direction (purchase/sale), counterparty premises ID (vendor for purchases, buyer for sales), species, breed, head count, weight (purchase weight or sale weight), price per head or per CWT, total transaction value, transaction channel (direct, auction, video auction, formula), origin state/country, health certificate number, brand inspection certificate, import permit (if applicable for purchases), quarantine period required (for purchases), receiving pen assignment (for purchases), transport carrier, BOL reference, grade and yield basis (for sales), and COOL chain-of-custody documentation. Purchase-specific attributes (quarantine period, receiving pen, import permit) are populated only for purchase transactions. Sale-specific attributes (grade/yield basis, sale channel) are populated only for sale transactions. Serves as the consolidated SSOT for all livestock commercial transfers. Supports livestock cost basis accounting, revenue recognition, enterprise profitability analysis, COOL compliance, and APHIS traceability. Distinguished from procurement/sales domain records by being animal-specific with livestock traceability attributes (health certificates, brand inspections, premises IDs) that generic commercial transaction records do not carry.
products.reference: USDA AMS Livestock Reporting / COOL / SAP SD SO

attributes.name: antibiotic_withdrawal_clear_date
attributes.description: The date on or after which the animals are cleared from any antibiotic withdrawal period and are eligible for harvest or sale. Critical for FSIS food safety compliance and prevention of violative drug residues in meat products. Populated based on most recent treatment records.
attributes.references: FSIS 9 CFR Part 309; FDA NADA/ANADA Withdrawal Periods; USDA APHIS; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: avg_weight_per_head_lbs
attributes.description: Average live weight per individual animal in pounds at the time of transfer. Derived operationally at point of transaction (scale ticket) and stored as a business fact. Supports performance benchmarking, feed efficiency analysis, and grading decisions.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Livestock Reporting; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: brand_inspection_cert_number
attributes.description: Certificate number issued by the state brand inspection authority verifying ownership of branded livestock at time of transfer. Required in brand law states (e.g., TX, CO, MT, WY) for cattle and horse transactions to establish legal title.
attributes.references: State Brand Laws (e.g., Texas Agriculture Code Ch. 142; Colorado CRS 35-41); USDA APHIS

attributes.name: breed
attributes.description: Breed designation of the animals in the transaction (e.g., Angus, Hereford, Duroc, Hampshire). Relevant for cost basis accounting, genetic program tracking, and premium pricing in sales contracts.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; Granular Farm Management; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this animal transaction record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SLA monitoring for data ingestion pipelines from source systems (SAP S/4HANA, Granular Farm Management).
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5; ISO 22000; SAP S/4HANA Audit Log

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction value (e.g., USD for US Dollar, CAD for Canadian Dollar, MXN for Mexican Peso). Supports multi-currency operations for cross-border livestock imports and exports.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS IAS 21; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: grade_yield_basis
attributes.description: The pricing and grading basis applied to outbound sale transactions. Indicates whether the sale price is based on live weight, dressed weight, USDA yield grade, USDA quality grade, or a formula-based pricing arrangement. Populated only for sale transactions.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Livestock Grading 7 CFR Part 54; USDA Quality and Yield Grades; FSIS

attributes.name: head_count
attributes.description: Number of individual animals included in this transaction. Used for inventory reconciliation, cost-per-head calculations, and APHIS movement reporting. Combined with weight and price fields to derive per-unit economics.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS 9 CFR Part 86; SAP S/4HANA MM; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: health_certificate_number
attributes.description: Official USDA APHIS Veterinary Services (VS) health certificate number issued by an accredited veterinarian certifying the health status of animals at time of movement. Required for interstate and international livestock shipments per 9 CFR Part 86.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS VS 9 CFR Part 86; APHIS Form VS 1-27; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Batch or lot tracking identifier assigned to the group of animals in this transaction for traceability purposes. Supports APHIS animal movement traceability, FSIS recall readiness, and COOL chain-of-custody documentation from farm to harvest.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; FSIS 9 CFR Part 320; FSMA; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, special conditions, or remarks associated with the livestock transaction. May include auction lot descriptions, special handling instructions, or negotiated contract terms not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/SD; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: origin_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country of origin for the animals. Required for COOL compliance, import permit processing, and APHIS international traceability. Populated for all transactions; defaults to USA for domestic transfers.
attributes.references: COOL 7 CFR Part 60; USDA APHIS VS; CBP Import Regulations; ISO 3166-1

attributes.name: origin_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code of the origin premises from which the animals were shipped. Required for COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) chain-of-custody documentation and APHIS interstate movement reporting.
attributes.references: COOL 7 CFR Part 60; USDA APHIS 9 CFR Part 86; FSMA

attributes.name: price_per_cwt
attributes.description: Purchase or sale price expressed per hundredweight (CWT = 100 lbs) in USD. Standard pricing basis for cattle and hog transactions in North American livestock markets. Populated when the transaction is priced on a weight basis.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Livestock Market News; SAP S/4HANA SD/MM; DTN Market Data

attributes.name: price_per_head
attributes.description: Purchase or sale price expressed on a per-head basis in USD. Populated when the transaction is priced per individual animal rather than per CWT. Mutually exclusive with price_per_cwt for a given transaction; one or both may be populated depending on transaction channel.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/MM; USDA AMS Livestock Market News; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA MM purchase order number associated with this livestock purchase transaction. Populated for inbound (purchase) transactions only. Enables three-way match (PO, goods receipt, invoice) in accounts payable processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; GAAP; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: quarantine_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days the purchased animals must remain in quarantine isolation before integration into the main herd or flock. Populated only for purchase transactions where quarantine_required = True. Supports antibiotic withdrawal period tracking and biosecurity compliance.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS VS 9 CFR Part 93; State Veterinarian Requirements; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: quarantine_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the purchased animals are subject to a mandatory quarantine period upon arrival at the receiving premises. Applicable to purchase transactions only. Drives receiving pen assignment and health monitoring workflows.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS VS 9 CFR Part 93; State Veterinarian Requirements; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: rfid_tag_range
attributes.description: Range or list of RFID electronic identification tag numbers (e.g., 840 USDA official ear tags) assigned to the animals in this transaction. Supports APHIS electronic animal identification traceability requirements and individual animal tracking.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS 9 CFR Part 86; USDA 840 RFID Tag Standard; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: species
attributes.description: Biological species classification of the animals involved in the transaction (e.g., bovine for cattle, swine for hogs, ovine for sheep). Drives regulatory reporting requirements, withdrawal period tracking, and FSIS/APHIS compliance rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bovine|swine|ovine|caprine|equine|poultry|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; FSIS 9 CFR; GLOBALG.A.P.; ISO 22000

attributes.name: total_transaction_value
attributes.description: Gross total monetary value of the livestock transfer in USD, representing the full purchase cost (for inbound) or gross sale revenue (for outbound). Used for cost basis accounting, revenue recognition, and enterprise profitability analysis in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; GAAP ASC 330 (Inventory); IFRS IAS 41 (Agriculture)

attributes.name: total_weight_lbs
attributes.description: Aggregate live weight in pounds of all animals in the transaction at the time of transfer (purchase weight for inbound; sale weight for outbound). Used for CWT (hundredweight) pricing calculations, cost basis accounting, and yield analysis.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Livestock Reporting; SAP S/4HANA MM/SD; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: transaction_channel
attributes.description: The commercial channel through which the livestock transfer was executed. Direct = farm-to-farm; Auction = physical livestock auction market; Video Auction = remote video-based auction (e.g., Superior Livestock); Formula = price tied to a market index or formula; Private Treaty = negotiated private sale.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Livestock Market News; Packers and Stockyards Act 7 USC 181

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The principal real-world business event date on which the livestock transfer (purchase or sale) was executed — i.e., the date of ownership transfer or market transaction. Distinct from transport or arrival dates.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Traceability; COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) 7 CFR Part 60; FSMA

attributes.name: transaction_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record represents an inbound livestock purchase (animals acquired from an external party) or an outbound livestock sale (animals transferred to an external buyer). Drives which conditional attributes are populated (e.g., quarantine period for purchases; grade/yield basis for sales).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/SD Module; APHIS Premises Identification

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the livestock transfer event, typically sourced from SAP S/4HANA (purchase order number for inbound or sales order number for outbound) or the auction/market reference number. Used for cross-system reconciliation and counterparty communication.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/SD Module; APHIS Traceability Standards

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the livestock transfer event. Tracks the lifecycle from initial draft through confirmation, transit, completion, or cancellation. Drives downstream accounting and traceability processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/MM Module; APHIS Traceability Standards

attributes.name: transport_carrier_name
attributes.description: Name of the licensed livestock transport carrier responsible for moving the animals between premises. Required for APHIS traceability, FMCSA compliance, and freight cost allocation.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; FMCSA 49 CFR; Animal Welfare Act 7 USC 2131

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this animal transaction record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Used for incremental data processing, change data capture (CDC), and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5; ISO 22000; SAP S/4HANA Audit Log

products.name: production_group
products.description: Master record defining a managed production group or lot — a cohort of animals managed together through a defined production phase (e.g., feedlot pen placement, farrowing group, broiler flock, dairy string). Captures group ID, group name, species, production phase (receiving, backgrounding, finishing, lactating, dry, nursery, grow-finish), placement date, placement head count, current head count, target closeout date, target market weight, assigned herd, assigned pen/location, feed ration plan reference, health protocol plan reference, and performance targets (ADG, FCR, mortality rate, feed cost/head). Serves as the operational unit for group-level performance tracking, feed delivery, and closeout cost accounting.
products.reference: Feedlot Closeout / Flock Management / Granular Farm Management

attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the production group (cohort/lot of animals managed together through a defined production phase). Primary key for this master resource entity.

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the farm facility or production site where this production group is housed. Used for regulatory premises identification, biosecurity zoning, and multi-site performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Premises Identification Number (PIN); FSMA Traceability Rule; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: feed_ration_id
attributes.description: Reference to the assigned feed ration plan defining the nutritional program (NPK-equivalent nutrient targets, ingredient mix, feeding frequency) for this production group during the current phase. Links to the feed management and nutrition planning domain.

attributes.name: health_protocol_id
attributes.description: Reference to the assigned health protocol plan specifying vaccination schedules, preventive treatments, biosecurity procedures, and veterinary intervention triggers for this production group.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Veterinary Accreditation; FSIS 9 CFR Part 309; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Livestock; HACCP

attributes.name: herd_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent herd or flock to which this production group belongs. Links the group to the herd master record for species, breed, and facility context.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Herd Identification; FSIS Traceability

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.livestock_product. Business justification: Feedlot closeout reporting and FSMA lot-level traceability require linking a production group (marketing lot) to the resulting livestock_product batch. Supports antibiotic-free, organic, and non-GMO c

attributes.name: lactose_pct

attributes.references: DHIA; ICAR milk recording standards; FDA PMO

attributes.name: linear_score
attributes.description: Logarithmic transformation of somatic cell count expressed on a 0–9 linear scale, as defined by DHIA. Provides a normalized, statistically stable measure of udder health for genetic evaluation, herd benchmarking, and DHIA enrollment reporting.
attributes.references: DHIA linear score methodology; USDA Animal Improvement Programs Laboratory (AIPL)

attributes.name: milk_temperature_c
attributes.description: Temperature of the milk at the point of collection, expressed in degrees Celsius. Used for milk quality compliance (FDA PMO requires rapid cooling to ≤10°C within 4 hours of milking), cold chain monitoring, and detection of fever-related health events in the animal.
attributes.references: FDA Pasteurized Milk Ordinance (PMO) Grade A cooling requirements; USDA AMS dairy quality standards

attributes.name: milk_yield_kg
attributes.description: Volume of milk produced by the animal during this milking event, expressed in kilograms. Primary quantitative outcome of the milking transaction. Used for lactation curve modeling, DHIA test-day reporting, and dairy enterprise revenue estimation.

attributes.name: milk_yield_lbs

attributes.name: milking_duration_sec
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in seconds for the milking event from unit attachment to detachment. Used for parlor throughput optimization, teat condition monitoring, and robotic milking system performance analysis (OEE — Overall Equipment Effectiveness).
attributes.references: ISO 6690 milking machine installations; USDA dairy facility management guidelines

attributes.name: milking_event_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this milking event or test-day record, typically assigned by the parlor management system or DHIA testing service (e.g., DHIA test-day report number, parlor event ID). attributes.references: DHIA test-day reporting standards; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) dairy program

attributes.name: milking_session
attributes.description: Identifies the milking session within the day: AM (morning), PM (evening), MID (midday for 3x programs), or labeled 3X variants for three-times-daily milking schedules. attributes.references: DHIA milking frequency standards; USDA dairy management guidelines

attributes.name: milking_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the milking event was recorded, including timezone offset. Enables intra-day sequencing of milking sessions, parlor throughput analysis, and robotic milking interval tracking. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; DHIA milking event standards

attributes.name: mun_mg_dl
attributes.description: Concentration of urea nitrogen in milk expressed in milligrams per deciliter (mg/dL). attributes.references: DHIA; USDA dairy nutrition guidelines; EPA nitrogen management BMPs (Best Management Practices)

attributes.name: peak_flow_rate_kg_min
attributes.description: Maximum milk flow rate recorded during the milking event, expressed in kilograms per minute. Indicator of teat canal health, milking unit vacuum performance, and potential mastitis risk. Captured by parlor management systems and robotic milking units.
attributes.references: ISO 6690; USDA dairy equipment standards; NMC (National Mastitis Council) guidelines

attributes.name: protein_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of true protein content in the milk sample. Used for component-based milk pricing (protein premium/deduction), cheese yield estimation, and feed ration optimization. Key performance indicator for dairy enterprise profitability.
attributes.references: DHIA; FDA PMO; ICAR milk recording standards; USDA AMS Federal Milk Marketing Order (FMMO) pricing

attributes.name: protein_yield_kg
attributes.description: Absolute quantity of true protein produced in this milking event, calculated as milk_yield_kg × protein_pct / 100. Stored for DHIA component reporting, FMMO protein pricing, and cheese yield estimation in downstream processing.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Federal Milk Marketing Order (FMMO); DHIA component reporting

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this milk production record. Supports data governance and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: DHIA data quality standards; USDA NASS data integrity guidelines; FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act) record-keeping requirements

attributes.name: record_type
attributes.description: Classification of the source and method of this milk production record. DHIA_TEST_DAY: official DHIA supervisor test; DAILY_PARLOR: routine parlor management system record; ROBOT_AMS: automatic milking system (robotic) record; MANUAL_ENTRY: hand-entered observation; ESTIMATED: interpolated or estimated value. Drives data quality weighting in analytics and DHIA enrollment eligibility.
attributes.references: DHIA record type classifications; ICAR milk recording standards

attributes.name: somatic_cell_count
attributes.description: Number of somatic cells per milliliter of milk (cells/mL). Primary indicator of udder health and mastitis status. attributes.references: FDA Pasteurized Milk Ordinance (PMO); EU Regulation 853/2004; DHIA; ICAR

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

products.name: ration_ingredient
products.description: This association product represents the Ration Ingredient role between feed_ration and material_master. It captures the bill-of-materials composition of each feed ration formulation — specifically, which ingredients (material_master records) are included in a given ration, at what inclusion rate, in what quantity per batch, and at what cost. Each record links one feed_ration formulation to one material_master ingredient with attributes that exist only in the context of that specific ration-ingredient combination. Serves as the SSOT for ration composition, supporting NRC nutritional compliance calculations, feed cost allocation, and feed mill mixing operations.. Existence Justification: A feed ration formulation is composed of multiple feed ingredients (material_master records such as corn silage, soybean meal, mineral premix), and each ingredient appears across many different ration formulations. Nutritionists and feed mill operators actively manage this composition daily — creating, adjusting, and versioning ingredient inclusions with specific rates, quantities, and costs per ration-ingredient combination. This is a classic bill-of-materials / recipe composition relationship that the livestock feed industry universally recognizes as 'ration ingredients' or 'feed formulation lines'.

products.name: protocol_drug_authorization
products.description: This association product represents the Authorization (role) between health_protocol and input_catalog. It captures the veterinarian-approved authorization of a specific drug or biological product from the input catalog for use within a defined health protocol, including the prescribed dosage, administration route, treatment step sequence, and applicable withdrawal periods. Each record links one health_protocol to one input_catalog entry and carries attributes that exist only in the context of this specific protocol-drug combination — a core veterinary formulary concept in livestock health management.. Existence Justification: A health protocol (e.g., a BRD treatment ladder or arrival processing protocol) specifies multiple drug products and vaccines drawn from the input catalog in a defined treatment sequence, and each input catalog item (drug, vaccine, antiparasitic) appears across multiple protocols for different species, production classes, and protocol types. The veterinarian actively manages this relationship by defining which specific catalog inputs are authorized for each protocol, at what dosage, via which administration route, and in what step sequence — data that belongs neither to the protocol master record nor to the catalog item alone. This is a recognized operational concept in livestock health management, commonly called a 'Protocol Formulary' or 'Protocol Drug Authorization'.

products.name: animal_hold
products.description: This association product represents the operational hold event between an individual animal and a hold record in livestock quality management. It captures the specific placement of an individual animal under a quality, regulatory, food-safety, or withdrawal-period hold. Each record links one animal to one hold_record and carries per-animal attributes — withdrawal end date, per-animal disposition, and hold initiation timestamp — that exist only in the context of this specific animal-hold pairing and cannot be stored on either the animal master or the group hold record alone.. Existence Justification: In livestock operations, a single hold event routinely covers an entire group or pen of animals (e.g., a withdrawal-period hold after a group antibiotic treatment), meaning one hold_record applies to many animals. Simultaneously, an individual animal accumulates multiple hold records across its lifecycle — different drug withdrawal holds, regulatory holds, food-safety holds — each with its own initiation date, release date, and disposition outcome. The business actively manages which specific animals are under which specific hold, and each animal-hold pairing carries its own per-animal disposition and withdrawal clearance data that belongs neither to the animal master nor to the hold record alone.

domains.name: land
domains.description: Authoritative domain for all land and soil asset data including field boundaries (GIS/ArcGIS-mapped), parcel ownership and lease records, soil health profiles (pH, EC, OM, CEC, NPK), soil sampling history, conservation practices, land use planning, and environmental monitoring. Integrates with Esri ArcGIS and John Deere Operations Center for RTK-accurate field mapping and GPS positioning. Supports BMP and ISO 14001 environmental compliance for sustainable land management.

products.name: field
products.description: Master record for each agricultural field or paddock — the foundational spatial and operational entity of the land domain. Captures RTK-accurate GIS boundary geometry (polygon/multipolygon from Esri ArcGIS) with versioned boundary history, field name, code, total area, irrigated area, GPS centroid, elevation, slope, aspect, drainage class, status (active/fallow/retired), sub-field management zones (VRA zones delineated by EC/yield/NDVI), and integration keys to John Deere Operations Center and ArcGIS feature IDs. Supports boundary change tracking for FSA compliance and temporal field geometry. SSOT for all field-level spatial identity, boundary history, and precision management zone definitions.

attributes.name: farm_unit_id
