attributes.name: legal_description
attributes.description: Full legal description of the parcel as recorded in the county deed or land registry, including metes-and-bounds, lot-block-subdivision, or Public Land Survey System (PLSS) section-township-range narrative.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds; USDA NRCS PLSS Standards

attributes.name: nrcs_land_capability_class
attributes.description: USDA Natural Resources Conservation Service (NRCS) land capability class (I–VIII) and subclass (e, w, s, c) rating the parcel's suitability for cultivation, indicating erosion risk, drainage limitations, and conservation treatment needs.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Land Capability Classification System; USDA Agriculture Handbook 210

attributes.name: organic_certification_status
attributes.description: Current USDA National Organic Program (NOP) certification status of the parcel, indicating whether the land meets organic production requirements, is in the 3-year transition period, or is managed under conventional practices.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) 7 CFR Part 205; GLOBALG.A.P. Organic Standard

attributes.name: organic_transition_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the parcel began the USDA NOP-required 36-month transition period from conventional to certified organic production, used to track certification eligibility and compliance timelines.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) 7 CFR Part 205.202

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Classification of the operational control arrangement for this parcel — whether the enterprise holds fee-simple title (owned), operates under a cash rent lease, crop-share lease, or custom farming agreement.
attributes.references: USDA Economic Research Service (ERS) Farmland Tenure; GAAP ASC 842 Lease Accounting

attributes.name: parcel_name
attributes.description: Operational or colloquial name assigned to the parcel by the farm operation (e.g., 'North Quarter', 'River Bottom Field') for internal identification and communication.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; USDA FMIS Best Practices

attributes.name: parcel_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the parcel record indicating its operational and administrative state within the enterprise land management system.
attributes.references: ISO 19152 LADM; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: plss_range
attributes.description: Range designation (e.g., R5E) within the PLSS grid, representing the east-west position relative to a principal meridian.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS PLSS; Bureau of Land Management (BLM) General Land Office Records

attributes.name: plss_section
attributes.description: Section number (1–36) within the Public Land Survey System (PLSS) township-range grid identifying the one-square-mile land division containing this parcel.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS PLSS; Bureau of Land Management (BLM) General Land Office Records

attributes.name: plss_township
attributes.description: Township designation (e.g., T12N) within the PLSS grid, representing the north-south position relative to a principal meridian baseline.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS PLSS; Bureau of Land Management (BLM) General Land Office Records

attributes.name: prime_farmland_class
attributes.description: USDA NRCS prime farmland classification indicating the land's capability for sustained agricultural production, used for conservation program eligibility (ACEP, RCPP), environmental impact assessments, and land use planning.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Prime Farmland Policy (7 CFR Part 657); USDA NRCS Land Capability Classification

attributes.name: soil_survey_map_unit
attributes.description: USDA NRCS Web Soil Survey map unit symbol (e.g., 'HrA', 'MnB2') identifying the dominant soil series and slope class for the parcel, used for soil health planning, conservation program eligibility, and variable rate application (VRA) prescriptions.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Web Soil Survey; USDA SSURGO Database

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation for the state in which the parcel is located, used for regulatory jurisdiction, FSA state office routing, and geospatial classification.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviations; FIPS 5-2 State Codes; USDA FSA

attributes.name: total_deeded_acres
attributes.description: Total land area of the parcel as recorded in the county deed or land registry, expressed in acres. Represents the legal boundary area and is the authoritative acreage for title, tax assessment, and FSA program enrollment.
attributes.references: County Recorder / Register of Deeds; USDA FSA Acreage Reporting; USDA NRCS

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the parcel record in the enterprise data platform, supporting change data capture (CDC), audit compliance, and data freshness monitoring.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SOX Internal Controls; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: wetland_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether any portion of the parcel contains USDA NRCS-delineated wetlands subject to Swampbuster provisions (Food Security Act), EPA Section 404 permitting, and conservation program restrictions.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Wetland Conservation Provisions (Swampbuster) 7 CFR Part 12; EPA Clean Water Act Section 404

attributes.name: zoning_classification
attributes.description: County or municipal zoning designation for the parcel (e.g., A-1 Agricultural, A-2 Rural Residential, EFU Exclusive Farm Use) governing permitted land uses, structure placement, and development rights.
attributes.references: County Planning and Zoning Ordinances; USDA NRCS; EPA Land Use Regulations

products.name: ownership
products.description: Ownership record linking parcels to legal owners (individuals, entities, trusts, LLCs, partnerships). Captures owner name, ownership type (fee simple, joint tenancy, tenancy in common, life estate, trust, LLC membership), ownership percentage share, deed reference number, deed book and page, recording date, effective date, expiration date (for term interests), title insurance policy number, and ownership status (current/historical/disputed). Supports multi-owner parcels with fractional interest tracking and ownership chain history. Note: land valuation and acquisition financial transactions are owned by the finance domain — this product captures legal ownership records only. SSOT for who legally owns each parcel and the chain of title.
products.reference: County Deed Registry / Title Record

attributes.name: ownership_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each land ownership record in the system. Primary key for the land_ownership data product.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal owner party (individual, entity, trust, LLC, or partnership) holding an ownership interest in this parcel.
attributes.references: USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service (NASS); GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the land parcel that is subject to this ownership record. Links to the parcel master record in the land domain.
attributes.references: USDA Farm Service Agency (FSA) Parcel Identification Standards

attributes.name: prior_ownership_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the immediately preceding ownership record in the chain of title for this parcel. Enables traversal of the full ownership history and chain-of-title lineage.
attributes.references: ISO 19152 Land Administration Domain Model (LADM); USDA FSA Land Records

attributes.name: assessor_parcel_number
attributes.description: The Assessor Parcel Number (APN) assigned by the county assessor's office for property tax assessment purposes. Also known as a parcel identification number (PIN) or tax parcel number. Used for cross-referencing with county tax records.
attributes.references: County Assessor Standards; USDA FSA Farm Records

attributes.name: chain_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential integer indicating the position of this ownership record in the chain of title for the parcel. A value of 1 represents the earliest recorded ownership; higher values represent more recent ownership records. Supports chain-of-title history and ownership lineage analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 19152 Land Administration Domain Model (LADM); USDA FSA Land Records

attributes.name: conservation_easement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this parcel is subject to a conservation easement that restricts certain land uses in perpetuity or for a defined term. Conservation easements are commonly held by land trusts or government agencies under USDA NRCS programs.
attributes.references: USDA Natural Resources Conservation Service (NRCS) Easement Programs; Internal Revenue Code Section 170(h)

attributes.name: conveyance_date
attributes.description: The date on which the ownership interest was conveyed (transferred) from the prior owner to the current owner, as stated in the deed instrument. Distinct from recording_date (when filed) and effective_date (when legally binding).
attributes.references: County Recorder Standards; USDA FSA Land Records

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country in which the parcel is located. Supports international operations and COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) Regulations

attributes.name: county_name
attributes.description: Name of the county in which the parcel is located and where the deed is recorded. Used for jurisdictional routing of legal documents and regulatory reporting to USDA FSA county offices.
attributes.references: USDA FSA County Office Structure; FIPS County Codes

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this ownership record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance with FSMA record-keeping requirements.
attributes.references: FSMA Record-Keeping Requirements; ISO 22000; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Indicates the data quality and verification status of this ownership record. 'Verified' means the record has been validated against official county recorder or title company sources; 'unverified' means the record has not yet been validated; 'under_review' means validation is in progress; 'rejected' means the record failed validation.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; GLOBALG.A.P. Record-Keeping Requirements

attributes.name: deed_book
attributes.description: The deed book (volume) number in the county recorder's office where the deed instrument is officially recorded. Used in conjunction with deed_page for precise legal document retrieval.
attributes.references: County Recorder Standards; Uniform Real Property Transfer Act

attributes.name: deed_instrument_type
attributes.description: Classification of the legal deed instrument used to convey ownership. Warranty deeds provide full title guarantees; quitclaim deeds convey only the grantor's existing interest; grant deeds include implied warranties; trustee and sheriff deeds arise from trust or court proceedings.
attributes.references: Uniform Real Property Transfer on Death Act; County Recorder Standards

attributes.name: deed_page
attributes.description: The page number within the deed book at the county recorder's office where the deed instrument is officially recorded. Used in conjunction with deed_book for precise legal document retrieval.
attributes.references: County Recorder Standards; Uniform Real Property Transfer Act

attributes.name: deed_reference_number
attributes.description: Unique reference number assigned to the deed instrument conveying ownership of this parcel. Used to cross-reference with county recorder and title company records for chain-of-title verification.
attributes.references: County Recorder Standards; USDA FSA Land Records

attributes.name: dispute_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes describing the nature of any ownership dispute, legal challenge, or title defect associated with this ownership record. Populated when ownership_status is 'disputed'. Supports legal team review and resolution tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Legal Governance Standards; American Land Title Association (ALTA)

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the ownership interest legally became effective, which may differ from the recording date. For example, a deed may be executed and effective on one date but recorded later. This is the MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_FROM field for this ownership record.
attributes.references: USDA FSA Land Tenure Standards; ISO 19152 Land Administration Domain Model (LADM)

attributes.name: encumbrance_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of any encumbrances, liens, easements, mortgages, conservation easements, or other title restrictions affecting this ownership record. Populated when encumbrance_flag is True.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA) Standards; USDA NRCS Conservation Easement Program

attributes.name: encumbrance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ownership record is subject to any encumbrances, liens, easements, mortgages, or other claims against the title that may affect the owner's full use and enjoyment of the parcel.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA) Standards; USDA FSA Land Records

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the ownership interest expires or terminates, applicable for term interests such as life estates or time-limited ownership arrangements. Null for perpetual fee simple ownership. This is the MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_UNTIL field.
attributes.references: USDA FSA Land Tenure Standards; Uniform Real Property Transfer on Death Act

attributes.name: farm_service_agency_tract_number
attributes.description: The USDA Farm Service Agency (FSA) tract number assigned to this parcel for farm program eligibility, commodity program enrollment, and conservation program participation tracking.
attributes.references: USDA Farm Service Agency (FSA) Farm Records System

attributes.name: legal_description
attributes.description: Full legal description of the parcel as recorded on the deed, typically expressed in metes and bounds, Public Land Survey System (PLSS) section-township-range notation, or lot-block-subdivision format. This is the authoritative legal boundary description for the parcel.
attributes.references: USDA FSA Farm Records; Public Land Survey System (PLSS); ISO 19152 LADM

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: General free-text notes or remarks related to this ownership record, including special conditions, legal caveats, or administrative observations not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: owner_entity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the legal entity type of the owner. Distinguishes between natural persons and legal entities for regulatory reporting, USDA farm program eligibility, and compliance with FSMA and COOL requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: individual|corporation|llc|partnership|trust|government|cooperative|nonprofit — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA Farm Service Agency (FSA) Payment Eligibility Rules; IRS Entity Classification

attributes.name: ownership_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this ownership record. 'Current' indicates active legal ownership; 'historical' indicates a past ownership interest that has been transferred or extinguished; 'disputed' flags records under legal challenge; 'pending' indicates a transfer in progress; 'transferred' indicates completed conveyance to a new owner.
attributes.references: USDA FSA Land Tenure Data Standards; ISO 19152 Land Administration Domain Model (LADM)

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Legal classification of the ownership interest held by the owner in this parcel. Fee simple is the most complete form of ownership; joint tenancy includes right of survivorship; tenancy in common allows fractional interests without survivorship; life estate is limited to the owner's lifetime; trust and LLC membership reflect entity-held interests.
attributes.references: Uniform Real Property Transfer on Death Act; USDA FSA Land Ownership Classification

attributes.name: percentage
attributes.description: Fractional ownership interest held by this owner in the parcel, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 50.0000 for a 50% undivided interest). Supports multi-owner parcels with tenancy-in-common or LLC membership fractional interest tracking. All ownership records for a parcel should sum to 100%.
attributes.references: Uniform Partition of Heirs Property Act; USDA FSA Payment Limitation Rules

attributes.name: record_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned to this ownership record, used for cross-referencing with county recorder offices, title companies, and legal documentation. Serves as the business identifier for chain-of-title tracking.
attributes.references: USDA Farm Service Agency (FSA); County Recorder Standards

attributes.name: recording_date
attributes.description: The date on which the deed or ownership instrument was officially recorded with the county recorder's office. Establishes the legal priority of the ownership claim in the chain of title.
attributes.references: County Recorder Standards; Uniform Real Property Transfer Act

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this ownership record was sourced or last updated. Supports data lineage and master data management. Typical sources include Granular Farm Management, Esri ArcGIS, SAP S/4HANA, Oracle NetSuite, or manual entry.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; FMIS (Farm Management Information System) Integration Standards

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation for the state in which the parcel is located. Used for jurisdictional compliance, USDA FSA state office routing, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviation Standards; USDA FSA State Office Structure

attributes.name: title_insurance_company
attributes.description: Name of the title insurance underwriter or company that issued the title insurance policy for this ownership record. Used for claims processing and title defect resolution.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA) Standards

attributes.name: title_insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: The policy number of the title insurance policy issued to protect the owner's interest in this parcel against title defects, liens, or encumbrances not discovered during the title search. Issued by a licensed title insurance underwriter.
attributes.references: American Land Title Association (ALTA) Standards; State Insurance Regulations

attributes.name: transfer_reason
attributes.description: The reason or mechanism by which ownership was transferred to the current owner. Used for USDA FSA farm program eligibility determination, estate planning analysis, and land tenure reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sale|inheritance|gift|foreclosure|condemnation|partition|exchange|court_order — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA FSA Land Tenure Data Standards; USDA Economic Research Service (ERS) Land Ownership Survey

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this ownership record was last modified in the system. Supports audit trail, change tracking, and data lineage for compliance with SOX and FSMA record-keeping requirements.
attributes.references: FSMA Record-Keeping Requirements; SOX Section 404; ISO 22000

attributes.name: usda_farm_number
attributes.description: The USDA Farm Service Agency (FSA) farm number associated with this parcel, used for enrollment in commodity support programs, conservation programs, and crop insurance. A single farm number may encompass multiple tracts and parcels.
attributes.references: USDA Farm Service Agency (FSA) Farm Records System; USDA Agricultural Act

products.name: lease
products.description: Agricultural land lease agreement record capturing the contractual relationship between landowner and farm operator/tenant for use of agricultural parcels. Stores lease type (cash rent, crop share, flex rent, custom farming agreement), lease start date, lease end date, annual cash rent rate ($/acre), crop share percentage, flex rent base price and trigger mechanism, total leased acres, payment schedule (annual/semi-annual/quarterly), auto-renewal flag, right-of-first-refusal flag, lease document reference, FSA farm number, and lease status (active/expired/terminated/pending/under negotiation). Links to parcel and farm_unit for legal and operational context. Note: lease payment transactions and accounts payable are owned by the finance/invoice domains — this product captures the lease agreement terms only, not financial transactions. SSOT for land tenure agreements and rental obligation terms.
products.reference: Granular Farm Management / Land Lease Record

attributes.name: lease_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the agricultural land lease agreement record. Primary key for the lease data product.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; SAP S/4HANA RE-FX (Real Estate) module

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the landowner (lessor) party record. Identifies the individual or entity that owns the land and is granting the lease.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; SAP S/4HANA Business Partner

attributes.name: farm_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the operational farm unit to which the leased land is assigned. Provides operational context for crop planning and field operations.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; John Deere Operations Center

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the land parcel(s) covered under this lease agreement. Links to the parcel master record in the land domain for legal and GIS boundary context.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS; USDA Farm Service Agency (FSA) parcel records

attributes.name: tenant_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Leases are executed between legal entities (accounts). The tenant operator account is required for billing, FSA farm operator designation, crop insurance enrollment, and lease payment processing. Role
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease agreement contains an automatic renewal clause. When True, the lease renews for an additional term at expiry unless either party provides written notice of termination within the required notice period.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; standard agricultural lease contract terms

attributes.name: cash_rent_rate_per_acre
attributes.description: Annual cash rent rate expressed in US dollars per acre. Applicable for cash_rent and flex_rent lease types. Represents the base rental obligation per acre per year. Sensitive commercial term.
attributes.references: USDA ERS Cash Rent Survey; Granular Farm Management; IFRS 16 (lease liability measurement)

attributes.name: conservation_practice_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease agreement mandates adherence to specific conservation practices (e.g., cover cropping, no-till, buffer strips) as a condition of tenancy. Supports BMP and ISO 14001 environmental compliance tracking.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS; ISO 14001; GLOBALG.A.P.; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: county_fips_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: County Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) Code
attributes.description: Five-digit FIPS code identifying the US county in which the leased land is located. Used for USDA program enrollment, regulatory reporting, and geographic analytics.
attributes.references: USDA FSA; US Census Bureau FIPS codes; NRCS county records

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the lease record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SOX audit trail requirements; Databricks Lakehouse Silver layer conventions

attributes.name: crop_restriction
attributes.description: Free-text description of any crop-specific restrictions or requirements stipulated in the lease (e.g., no GMO crops, organic production required, specific rotation mandated). Impacts crop planning and seed selection decisions.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; USDA National Organic Program (NOP); GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: crop_share_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of crop proceeds or harvested commodity allocated to the landowner under a crop share lease arrangement. Typically ranges from 25% to 50%. Applicable only when lease_type is 'crop_share'.
attributes.references: USDA ERS; Granular Farm Management; GLOBALG.A.P. land tenure

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this lease record (e.g., USD, CAD, BRL). Supports international operations and multi-currency reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS 16; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL to the executed lease agreement document stored in the document management system. Enables retrieval of the original signed contract for legal and audit purposes.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; SAP S/4HANA Document Management

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the lease agreement expires or is scheduled to terminate. Nullable for open-ended or evergreen leases. Used for renewal planning and land tenure reporting.
attributes.references: USDA FSA; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the lease agreement was formally signed and executed by both parties. May differ from the start date for leases signed in advance of the crop year.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; SAP S/4HANA RE-FX

attributes.name: flex_rent_base_price
attributes.description: The commodity base price (in $/bushel or $/MT) used as the reference point for flex rent adjustment calculations. When the actual commodity price exceeds this threshold, additional rent is triggered. Applicable only for flex_rent lease type.
attributes.references: USDA WASDE; DTN market data; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: flex_rent_cap_per_acre
attributes.description: Maximum allowable flex rent payment per acre per year, capping the upside obligation for the tenant regardless of commodity price or yield performance. Applicable only for flex_rent lease type.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; USDA ERS

attributes.name: flex_rent_trigger_mechanism
attributes.description: The mechanism that activates the flex rent adjustment above the base cash rent. Price trigger: based on commodity market price. Yield trigger: based on actual field yield (YPM). Revenue trigger: based on gross revenue per acre. None: not applicable for non-flex leases.
attributes.references: USDA ERS Flex Lease guidance; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: fsa_farm_number
attributes.description: USDA Farm Service Agency (FSA) assigned farm number for the leased land. Required for federal program enrollment, crop insurance, and USDA compliance reporting. Links to FSA farm records.
attributes.references: USDA FSA; USDA Farm Records; FSMA compliance

attributes.name: fsa_tract_number
attributes.description: USDA FSA tract number identifying the specific tract of land within the FSA farm record. A farm may contain multiple tracts; this field identifies the specific tract(s) covered by this lease.
attributes.references: USDA FSA; USDA Farm Records

attributes.name: improvements_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease agreement permits the tenant to make permanent improvements to the land (e.g., drainage tile installation, building construction, irrigation infrastructure). Relevant for CAPEX planning and land stewardship.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; USDA NRCS conservation practice standards

attributes.name: lease_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the lease agreement. Used in correspondence with landowners, FSA filings, and internal reference. Format: LSE-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; USDA FSA lease documentation standards

attributes.name: lease_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the lease agreement. Active: in force and binding. Expired: past end date without renewal. Terminated: ended early by either party. Pending: executed but not yet effective. Under negotiation: terms being discussed. Draft: not yet executed.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; SAP S/4HANA RE-FX contract lifecycle

attributes.name: lease_type
attributes.description: Classification of the lease agreement structure. Cash rent: fixed $/acre payment. Crop share: landlord receives a percentage of crop proceeds. Flex rent: base rent adjusted by commodity price or yield triggers. Custom farming: operator provides services for a fee. Pasture lease: grazing rights. Hunting lease: recreational use. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cash_rent|crop_share|flex_rent|custom_farming|pasture_lease|hunting_lease — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA Economic Research Service (ERS) land tenure classifications; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: legal_description
attributes.description: Formal legal description of the leased land parcel(s) as recorded in the deed or title document. Typically expressed in Public Land Survey System (PLSS) notation (e.g., Section-Township-Range) or metes and bounds.
attributes.references: USDA FSA; Bureau of Land Management (BLM) PLSS; Esri ArcGIS

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional terms, special conditions, negotiation history, or operational notes related to the lease agreement that are not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: payment_due_month
attributes.description: Calendar month (1–12) in which the primary annual rent payment is due to the landowner. For semi-annual schedules, this represents the first payment month. Used by the finance domain to schedule AP obligations.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP

attributes.name: payment_schedule
attributes.description: Frequency at which cash rent payments are due to the landowner under the lease agreement. Drives accounts payable scheduling in the finance domain. Common agricultural practice is annual or semi-annual.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; IFRS 16

attributes.name: renewal_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days prior to the lease end date by which written notice of non-renewal or termination must be provided by either party. Typically 30, 60, or 90 days for agricultural leases. Drives automated renewal alert workflows.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; state agricultural lease statutes

attributes.name: right_of_first_refusal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lease agreement grants the tenant/operator a right of first refusal (ROFR) to purchase the land if the landowner decides to sell. When True, the operator must be offered the opportunity to match any third-party purchase offer.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; standard agricultural lease contract terms; USDA FSA

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this lease record was ingested. Supports data lineage and reconciliation across Granular Farm Management, SAP RE-FX, and Oracle NetSuite.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver layer data lineage standards

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the lease agreement becomes effective and the tenant/operator gains the right to use the land. Typically March 1 or the start of the crop year for agricultural leases.
attributes.references: USDA FSA; Granular Farm Management; GLOBALG.A.P. land tenure documentation

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation (or ISO 3166-2 subdivision code for international operations) identifying the state in which the leased land is located.
attributes.references: USDA FSA; ISO 3166-2

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the lease was terminated early, if applicable. Populated only when lease_status is 'terminated'. Distinct from end_date which is the scheduled expiry.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; SAP S/4HANA RE-FX

attributes.name: total_leased_acres
attributes.description: Total land area covered under this lease agreement, expressed in acres. Used for cash rent calculation, FSA reporting, and land tenure analytics. Sourced from FSA farm records or GIS boundary measurement.
attributes.references: USDA FSA; Esri ArcGIS; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the lease record. Used for change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SOX audit trail requirements; Databricks Lakehouse Silver layer conventions

products.name: soil_profile
products.description: Authoritative soil health profile for a defined soil mapping unit or management zone within a field. Stores USDA NRCS soil series name, soil texture class (USDA triangle), soil order/suborder, drainage class, available water capacity (AWC), organic matter percentage (OM), cation exchange capacity (CEC meq/100g), electrical conductivity (EC dS/m), bulk density, soil depth to restrictive layer, NRCS hydric soil flag, prime farmland designation, and profile creation/update dates. SSOT for baseline soil physical and chemical characteristics.
products.reference: USDA NRCS Web Soil Survey / SSURGO

attributes.name: soil_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the soil profile record. Primary key for the soil_profile data product within the land domain.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey Manual

attributes.name: field_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agricultural field or parcel to which this soil profile belongs. Links the soil profile to its geographic land unit as mapped in Esri ArcGIS and John Deere Operations Center.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS; John Deere Operations Center

attributes.name: agronomist_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for certified crop adviser (CCA) or agronomist observations about this soil profile, including anomalies, historical land use context, or special management considerations not captured in structured fields. Supports GLOBALG.A.P. and USDA NRCS conservation planning documentation.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P.; USDA NRCS; American Society of Agronomy

attributes.name: awc_cm_cm
attributes.description: Available Water Capacity (AWC) expressed as centimeters of water per centimeter of soil depth (cm/cm), representing the volume of water held between field capacity and permanent wilting point. Critical input for irrigation scheduling and evapotranspiration (ET) modeling.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey Manual; FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56

attributes.name: bulk_density_g_cm3
attributes.description: Soil bulk density expressed in grams per cubic centimeter (g/cm³), representing the mass of dry soil per unit volume including pore space. Indicates soil compaction level; values above 1.6 g/cm³ typically restrict root growth. Informs tillage and cover crop decisions.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey Laboratory Methods Manual; ISO 11272

attributes.name: cec_meq_100g
attributes.description: Cation Exchange Capacity (CEC) expressed in milliequivalents per 100 grams of soil (meq/100g). Measures the soil's ability to hold and supply positively charged nutrient ions (Ca, Mg, K, Na). Higher CEC indicates greater nutrient-holding capacity and influences fertilizer recommendations.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey Laboratory Methods Manual; Soil Science Society of America

attributes.name: conservation_practice_code
attributes.description: USDA NRCS Conservation Practice Standard code(s) applied to this soil mapping unit (e.g., 340 Cover Crop, 600 Terrace, 412 Grassed Waterway). Supports EQIP/CSP program documentation, BMP compliance reporting, and ISO 14001 environmental management system records.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Conservation Practice Standards; EQIP; CSP; ISO 14001

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this soil profile record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports data lineage, audit trail, and FSMA traceability requirements.
attributes.references: FSMA; ISO 22000; GLOBALG.A.P.; SOX

attributes.name: depth_to_restrictive_layer_cm
attributes.description: Depth in centimeters from the soil surface to the first restrictive layer (e.g., fragipan, claypan, bedrock, seasonal high water table). Limits effective rooting depth and influences crop selection, drainage tile placement, and irrigation design.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey Manual; SSURGO

attributes.name: drainage_class
attributes.description: USDA NRCS drainage class describing the natural soil drainage condition (e.g., well drained, poorly drained). Critical for tile drainage design, planting date decisions, and ISO 14001 environmental management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: excessively drained|somewhat excessively drained|well drained|moderately well drained|somewhat poorly drained|poorly drained|very poorly drained — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey Manual; ISO 14001

attributes.name: ec_ds_m
attributes.description: Soil electrical conductivity (EC) measured in deciSiemens per meter (dS/m), indicating soil salinity level. Values above 4 dS/m may indicate salinity stress for most crops. Used for precision agriculture zone delineation and irrigation water quality management.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS; FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 29; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: erosion_risk_class
attributes.description: Qualitative erosion risk classification for this soil profile based on USDA NRCS Universal Soil Loss Equation (USLE/RUSLE) factors including erodibility (K-factor), slope, and cover. Drives conservation practice selection and FSMA Produce Safety Rule compliance for water quality.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS RUSLE2; EPA; FSMA Produce Safety Rule

attributes.name: gis_map_unit_area_ha
attributes.description: Area of the soil mapping unit or management zone in hectares as calculated from the GIS polygon in Esri ArcGIS. Used for proportional nutrient application calculations, yield per acre metric (YPM) normalization, and land valuation.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS; USDA NRCS SSURGO; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: is_hydric
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this soil is classified as a hydric soil by USDA NRCS criteria, meaning it formed under conditions of saturation, flooding, or ponding long enough to develop anaerobic conditions. Hydric soils are associated with wetlands and trigger regulatory review under Section 404 of the Clean Water Act and USDA NRCS wetland conservation provisions.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Hydric Soils List; Clean Water Act Section 404; USDA Farm Bill Wetland Conservation

attributes.name: is_prime_farmland
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this soil mapping unit is designated as Prime Farmland, Farmland of Statewide Importance, or Unique Farmland by USDA NRCS. Prime farmland designation affects land use planning, conservation program eligibility (CRP, EQIP), and regulatory review for development.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS; Farmland Protection Policy Act (FPPA); 7 CFR Part 658

attributes.name: k_factor
attributes.description: USDA NRCS soil erodibility K-factor from the Universal Soil Loss Equation (USLE/RUSLE), ranging from 0.02 (least erodible) to 0.69 (most erodible). Quantifies the susceptibility of soil to detachment and transport by rainfall and runoff. Used in conservation planning and NRCS EQIP program applications.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS RUSLE2; USDA Agricultural Handbook 703

attributes.name: lab_reference_number
attributes.description: External laboratory sample reference or accession number assigned by the certified soil testing laboratory. Enables traceability back to the original Certificate of Analysis (COA) and laboratory report for audit and GLOBALG.A.P. compliance verification.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P.; ISO/IEC 17025 (Laboratory Accreditation); USDA AMS

attributes.name: land_capability_class
attributes.description: USDA NRCS Land Capability Classification (LCC) rating from Class I (fewest limitations) to Class VIII (unsuitable for cultivation). Used for conservation planning, crop insurance rating, and USDA program eligibility determination. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: I|II|III|IV|V|VI|VII|VIII — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Land Capability Classification; USDA FSA

attributes.name: land_capability_subclass
attributes.description: USDA NRCS Land Capability Subclass modifier indicating the primary limitation type: 'e' (erosion), 'w' (wetness/drainage), 's' (soil limitations), 'c' (climate). Complements the land_capability_class for conservation practice planning under BMP guidelines.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Land Capability Classification

attributes.name: management_zone
attributes.description: Agronomic management zone designation within the field (e.g., 'Zone 1 - High Productivity', 'Zone 3 - Low OM'). Used for variable rate application (VRA) prescriptions in Trimble Ag Software and Climate FieldView to optimize input use efficiency.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software; Climate FieldView; USDA NRCS

attributes.name: mukey
attributes.description: USDA NRCS SSURGO (Soil Survey Geographic Database) Map Unit Key (MUKEY) — the unique national identifier for the soil map unit polygon. Enables direct linkage to the SSURGO database for detailed soil property lookup, Web Soil Survey integration, and NRCS program eligibility verification.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS SSURGO; Web Soil Survey

attributes.name: nitrogen_ppm
attributes.description: Plant-available nitrogen (N) concentration in the soil expressed in parts per million (ppm), typically measured as nitrate-N or ammonium-N. Core component of NPK (Nitrogen-Phosphorus-Potassium) soil fertility assessment driving fertilization event planning.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS; Soil Science Society of America; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: nrcs_soil_series
attributes.business_glossary_term: USDA Natural Resources Conservation Service (NRCS) Soil Series Name
attributes.description: Official USDA NRCS soil series name assigned to this mapping unit (e.g., 'Drummer', 'Tama', 'Clarion'). Derived from the SSURGO/Web Soil Survey database and used for agronomic benchmarking and land valuation.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS SSURGO; Web Soil Survey

attributes.name: organic_matter_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of organic matter (OM) in the soil by weight, measured by loss-on-ignition or Walkley-Black method. Key indicator of soil health, water-holding capacity, and nutrient cycling. Supports carbon sequestration reporting and ISCC sustainability compliance.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS; ISCC; ISO 14001; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: ph_method
attributes.description: Laboratory method used to determine the soil pH value (e.g., 1:1 water suspension, 1:2 CaCl2 solution). Required for accurate interpretation and cross-laboratory comparability of pH results per USDA NRCS and university extension standards.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey Laboratory Methods Manual; AOAC International

attributes.name: ph_value
attributes.description: Soil pH (Potential of Hydrogen) measurement representing soil acidity or alkalinity on a 0–14 scale, typically measured in a 1:1 soil-water suspension. Drives lime application decisions, nutrient availability, and crop selection. Target range for most crops: 6.0–7.0.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS; Soil Science Society of America; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: phosphorus_ppm
attributes.description: Plant-available phosphorus (P) concentration in the soil expressed in parts per million (ppm), typically measured by Bray-1, Mehlich-3, or Olsen extraction method. Core NPK component driving phosphate fertilizer recommendations and environmental runoff risk assessment.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS; EPA; GLOBALG.A.P.; Soil Science Society of America

attributes.name: potassium_ppm
attributes.description: Plant-available potassium (K) concentration in the soil expressed in parts per million (ppm), typically measured by Mehlich-3 or ammonium acetate extraction. Core NPK component influencing crop quality, drought tolerance, and potash fertilizer application rates.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS; Soil Science Society of America; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: profile_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this soil profile or management zone within the farm management information system (FMIS). Used for cross-referencing with Granular Farm Management and Trimble Ag Software records.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: profile_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the soil profile or management zone (e.g., 'North Field Zone A', 'River Bottom Unit 3'). Used for display and reporting in FMIS dashboards.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey Manual

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the soil profile record. 'active' indicates the profile is the current SSOT for agronomic decisions; 'superseded' indicates a newer profile has replaced it; 'pending_review' indicates awaiting agronomist validation.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P.; ISO 14001

attributes.name: restrictive_layer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the soil restrictive layer type encountered at the depth recorded in depth_to_restrictive_layer_cm. Determines the agronomic and engineering implications for root penetration, drainage, and deep tillage feasibility. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fragipan|claypan|bedrock|hardpan|water table|caliche|permafrost — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey Manual; Keys to Soil Taxonomy

attributes.name: sampling_date
attributes.description: Date on which the soil sample was collected for laboratory analysis that established or last updated this soil profile. Determines the currency of the soil data for agronomic decision-making; most university extension services recommend resampling every 3–4 years.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS; GLOBALG.A.P.; University Extension Soil Testing Guidelines

attributes.name: sampling_depth_cm
attributes.description: Depth in centimeters at which the soil sample was collected (e.g., 0–15 cm for surface, 15–30 cm for subsoil). Sampling depth affects interpretation of pH, OM, and nutrient results and must be consistent across sampling events for trend analysis.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS; Soil Science Society of America; University Extension Soil Testing Guidelines

attributes.name: slope_pct
attributes.description: Average slope of the soil mapping unit expressed as a percentage (rise/run × 100). Influences erosion risk assessment, tillage method selection, irrigation system design, and conservation practice requirements under USDA NRCS and EPA BMP guidelines.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS; EPA BMP; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: soil_order
attributes.description: Highest-level USDA Soil Taxonomy classification order for this soil profile (e.g., Mollisol, Alfisol). Determines broad agronomic suitability and management approach. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Alfisol|Andisol|Aridisol|Entisol|Gelisol|Histosol|Inceptisol|Mollisol|Oxisol|Spodosol|Ultisol|Vertisol — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Taxonomy; Keys to Soil Taxonomy

attributes.name: soil_suborder
attributes.description: Second-level USDA Soil Taxonomy classification suborder for this soil profile (e.g., Udoll, Aquoll). Provides finer agronomic classification for crop suitability and drainage management planning.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Taxonomy; Keys to Soil Taxonomy

attributes.name: texture_class
attributes.description: USDA soil texture classification based on the relative proportions of sand, silt, and clay as determined by the USDA textural triangle. Drives irrigation scheduling, tillage decisions, and nutrient management planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sand|loamy sand|sandy loam|loam|silt loam|silt|sandy clay loam|clay loam|silty clay loam|sandy clay|silty clay|clay — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey Manual; USDA Textural Triangle

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this soil profile record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Tracks data currency for agronomic decision support and supports audit trail requirements under GLOBALG.A.P. and ISO 14001.
attributes.references: FSMA; ISO 22000; GLOBALG.A.P.; ISO 14001; SOX

products.name: land_soil_sample
products.description: Individual soil sampling event record capturing laboratory-analyzed nutrient and chemical results for a specific field zone or GPS-referenced sample point. Stores sample date, lab submission date, lab report date, lab name, sample depth (inches), GPS coordinates, management zone ID, pH (1:1 water), buffer pH, organic matter (%), nitrate-N (ppm), phosphorus (P Bray/Mehlich-3 ppm), potassium (K ppm), calcium (Ca ppm), magnesium (Mg ppm), sulfur (S ppm), zinc (Zn ppm), CEC (meq/100g), EC (dS/m), percent base saturation, and COA reference number. Core to NPK fertilizer prescription and VRA planning.
products.reference: Trimble Ag / Climate FieldView Soil Sampling

attributes.name: land_soil_sample_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each individual soil sampling event record. Primary key for the soil_sample data product in the land domain.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems; USDA NRCS Soil Survey Standards

attributes.name: field_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agricultural field from which this soil sample was collected. Links to the land domain field master record for GIS boundary and parcel context.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Field Mapping; John Deere Operations Center Field Registry

attributes.name: lab_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: Soil testing laboratories are qualified vendors in the procurement system. Linking soil_sample to the lab vendor enables vendor qualification tracking, invoice matching for lab services, COA verificat
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: management_zone_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sub-field management zone from which this sample was drawn. Management zones are delineated areas within a field with homogeneous soil characteristics used for Variable Rate Application (VRA) prescription planning.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software VRA Zone Management; USDA Precision Agriculture Guidelines

attributes.name: soil_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.soil_profile. Business justification: A soil sampling event is conducted within a specific soil mapping unit or management zone that is authoritatively described by a soil_profile record. Linking soil_sample to soil_profile establishes th
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: base_saturation_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the soil's Cation Exchange Capacity (CEC) occupied by base cations (calcium, magnesium, potassium, sodium). Calculated from individual cation concentrations relative to CEC. Used to assess nutrient balance and guide lime and fertilizer application strategies.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Fertility Assessment; Mehlich-3 Base Saturation Calculation Method

attributes.name: buffer_ph
attributes.description: Buffer pH value measured using a buffered solution (e.g., Shoemaker-McLean-Pratt or Sikora buffer) to determine the lime requirement for acidic soils. Used in conjunction with water pH to calculate the amount of agricultural lime needed to raise soil pH to target levels.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Testing Methods; SMP Buffer pH Method; Sikora Buffer Method

attributes.name: calcium_ppm
attributes.description: Plant-available calcium (Ca) concentration in parts per million (ppm). Calcium is a secondary macronutrient essential for cell wall development and root growth. Also used in calculating percent base saturation and Cation Exchange Capacity (CEC) balance.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Fertility Guidelines; Mehlich-3 Extraction Method; GLOBALG.A.P. Soil Nutrient Standards

attributes.name: cec_meq_100g
attributes.description: Cation Exchange Capacity (CEC) of the soil expressed in milliequivalents per 100 grams of soil (meq/100g). CEC measures the soil's ability to hold and supply positively charged nutrient ions (Ca, Mg, K, Na, H). Higher CEC indicates greater nutrient-holding capacity and influences fertilizer efficiency.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey Laboratory Methods; ISO 14235 Soil Quality; GLOBALG.A.P. Soil Health

attributes.name: coa_reference_number
attributes.description: Unique reference number of the Certificate of Analysis (COA) issued by the laboratory for this soil sample. The COA is the official document certifying the analytical results and chain of custody.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; USDA NRCS Soil Testing Standards; GLOBALG.A.P. Record Keeping Requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this soil sample record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date and Time Standards; SOX Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity

attributes.name: crop_season_year
attributes.description: The four-digit crop production year associated with this soil sampling event (e.g., 2024). Used to align soil test results with the corresponding growing season for fertilizer prescription planning and year-over-year soil health trend analysis.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Nutrient Management Planning; Granular Farm Management Financial Planning

attributes.name: ec_ds_m
attributes.description: Electrical Conductivity (EC) of the soil measured in deciSiemens per meter (dS/m). EC is an indicator of soil salinity and total dissolved salt concentration. High EC values indicate salinity stress risk and influence irrigation management and crop selection decisions.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Salinity Laboratory Methods; ISO 11265 Soil EC Measurement; GLOBALG.A.P. Soil Health

attributes.name: gps_accuracy_m
attributes.description: Horizontal positional accuracy of the GPS coordinates in meters at time of sample collection. RTK-corrected readings typically achieve sub-0.05m accuracy. Used to assess spatial data quality for precision agriculture applications.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center RTK GPS Standards; Esri ArcGIS Data Quality; ISO 19157 Geographic Data Quality

attributes.name: lab_accreditation_number
attributes.description: Official accreditation or certification number of the laboratory that analyzed the sample, issued by a recognized accreditation body (e.g., A2LA, NELAP). Supports regulatory compliance and audit traceability.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; USDA AMS Laboratory Accreditation Program; NELAP Standards

attributes.name: lab_report_date
attributes.description: Date on which the laboratory issued the official analytical results report for this soil sample. Used to calculate lab turnaround time and determine data currency for fertilizer prescriptions.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 Laboratory Competence; USDA AMS Laboratory Accreditation Program

attributes.name: lab_submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the collected soil sample was submitted to the analytical laboratory for processing. Used to track turnaround time and chain-of-custody compliance.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Laboratory Accreditation Program; ISO/IEC 17025 Laboratory Competence

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: GPS latitude coordinate (decimal degrees, WGS84 datum) of the soil sample collection point. Captured via RTK-accurate GPS equipment for precise spatial referencing in GIS systems and VRA prescription mapping.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Spatial Reference Standards; John Deere Operations Center RTK GPS; WGS84 Datum

attributes.name: lime_recommendation_lbs_ac
attributes.description: Laboratory-recommended agricultural lime application rate in pounds per acre, calculated from soil pH and buffer pH results to raise soil pH to the target level for the planned crop. Directly used in fertilizer prescription and VRA lime application planning.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Lime Requirement Calculation Methods; Trimble Ag Software VRA Prescriptions

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: GPS longitude coordinate (decimal degrees, WGS84 datum) of the soil sample collection point. Captured via RTK-accurate GPS equipment for precise spatial referencing in GIS systems and VRA prescription mapping.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Spatial Reference Standards; John Deere Operations Center RTK GPS; WGS84 Datum

attributes.name: magnesium_ppm
attributes.description: Plant-available magnesium (Mg) concentration in parts per million (ppm). Magnesium is a secondary macronutrient and central component of chlorophyll. Used in CEC base saturation calculations and dolomitic lime application decisions.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Fertility Guidelines; Mehlich-3 Extraction Method; GLOBALG.A.P. Soil Nutrient Standards

attributes.name: nitrate_n_ppm
attributes.description: Plant-available nitrate nitrogen (NO3-N) concentration in parts per million (ppm) as measured in the soil sample. A key component of the Nitrogen-Phosphorus-Potassium (NPK) nutrient profile. Directly informs nitrogen fertilizer application rates and VRA prescriptions.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Nutrient Management Planning; EPA Nitrate Leaching Standards; GLOBALG.A.P. Nutrient Management

attributes.name: nitrogen_recommendation_lbs_ac
attributes.description: Laboratory or agronomist-recommended nitrogen (N) fertilizer application rate in pounds per acre based on soil nitrate-N test results, organic matter nitrogen credit, and planned crop yield goal. Core input for NPK fertilizer prescription and VRA planning.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Nutrient Management Planning; EPA Nitrogen Management Best Practices; Trimble Ag VRA

attributes.name: organic_matter_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of organic matter (OM) in the soil sample, measured by loss-on-ignition or Walkley-Black method. Organic matter is a key indicator of soil health, water-holding capacity, and biological activity. Drives nitrogen credit calculations and carbon sequestration assessments.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Health Assessment; ISO 14001 Soil Carbon Monitoring; GLOBALG.A.P. Soil Organic Matter Standards

attributes.name: ph_water
attributes.description: Soil pH measured using the 1:1 soil-to-water suspension method, representing the Potential of Hydrogen (pH) — the primary indicator of soil acidity or alkalinity. Values range from 0-14; optimal crop production typically falls between 6.0-7.0. Drives lime application recommendations.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey Laboratory Methods Manual; Mehlich-3 / 1:1 Water pH Method; GLOBALG.A.P. Soil Health

attributes.name: phosphorus_method
attributes.description: Laboratory extraction method used to determine plant-available phosphorus concentration. Bray-1 is standard for acidic soils; Mehlich-3 is a universal extractant; Olsen is used for calcareous/alkaline soils. Method must be recorded as results are not directly comparable across methods.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Testing Methods Manual; North Central Regional Publication 221

attributes.name: phosphorus_ppm
attributes.description: Plant-available phosphorus (P) concentration in parts per million (ppm), measured by Bray-1 or Mehlich-3 extraction method. A key component of the Nitrogen-Phosphorus-Potassium (NPK) nutrient profile. Drives phosphate fertilizer recommendations and VRA prescription maps.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Nutrient Management; Bray-1 / Mehlich-3 Extraction Methods; EPA Phosphorus Loss Risk Assessment

attributes.name: phosphorus_recommendation_lbs_ac
attributes.description: Laboratory or agronomist-recommended phosphate (P2O5) fertilizer application rate in pounds per acre based on soil phosphorus test results and planned crop yield goal. Core input for NPK fertilizer prescription and VRA planning.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Nutrient Management Planning; EPA Phosphorus Index; Trimble Ag VRA Prescriptions

attributes.name: potassium_ppm
attributes.description: Plant-available potassium (K) concentration in parts per million (ppm), measured by Mehlich-3 or ammonium acetate extraction. A key component of the Nitrogen-Phosphorus-Potassium (NPK) nutrient profile. Drives potash fertilizer recommendations and VRA prescription planning.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Nutrient Management Planning; Mehlich-3 Extraction Method; GLOBALG.A.P. Nutrient Management

attributes.name: potassium_recommendation_lbs_ac
attributes.description: Laboratory or agronomist-recommended potash (K2O) fertilizer application rate in pounds per acre based on soil potassium test results and planned crop yield goal. Core input for NPK fertilizer prescription and VRA planning.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Nutrient Management Planning; Trimble Ag Software VRA Prescriptions

attributes.name: sample_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the soil sample was physically collected from the field. Critical for seasonal trend analysis and determining the agronomic context (pre-plant, post-harvest, etc.).
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Sampling Protocols; GLOBALG.A.P. Soil Health Standards

attributes.name: sample_depth_in
attributes.description: Depth in inches at which the soil sample was collected from the surface. Standard agronomic sampling depths are 0-6 inches (topsoil) or 6-12 inches (subsoil). Critical for interpreting nutrient availability relative to root zone.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Sampling Depth Standards; GLOBALG.A.P. Soil Management; Trimble Ag Software

attributes.name: sample_method
attributes.description: Method used to collect the soil sample. Grid sampling uses a systematic spatial grid; zone sampling collects within defined management zones; composite combines multiple cores; benchmark uses fixed reference points for longitudinal tracking.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Sampling Protocols; Trimble Ag Software VRA Sampling; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: sample_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable sample identifier assigned at time of collection, used for lab submission tracking and field cross-referencing. Typically formatted as a lab accession or farm-assigned code (e.g., FARM-2024-F01-Z3).
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Sampling Guidelines; GLOBALG.A.P. Soil Management Standards

attributes.name: sample_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the soil sample record, tracking progression from field collection through laboratory analysis to agronomic approval for use in fertilizer prescriptions.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Sampling Workflow; ISO 14001 Environmental Records Management

attributes.name: sampling_technician
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the agronomist, certified crop advisor (CCA), or field technician who physically collected the soil sample. Used for chain-of-custody documentation and quality assurance traceability.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Chain of Custody Requirements; USDA NRCS Soil Sampling SOPs; FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: soil_texture_class
attributes.description: USDA soil texture classification based on the relative proportions of sand, silt, and clay particles. Texture class influences water-holding capacity, drainage, tillage requirements, and nutrient management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sand|loamy_sand|sandy_loam|loam|silt_loam|silt|sandy_clay_loam|clay_loam|silty_clay_loam|sandy_clay|silty_clay|clay — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Texture Classification System; USDA Soil Survey Manual

attributes.name: sulfur_ppm
attributes.description: Plant-available sulfur (S) concentration in parts per million (ppm). Sulfur is a secondary macronutrient critical for protein synthesis and enzyme function. Deficiencies are increasingly common in high-yield cropping systems and drive sulfur fertilizer recommendations.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Nutrient Management; GLOBALG.A.P. Soil Nutrient Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this soil sample record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change detection, incremental data pipeline processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date and Time Standards; SOX Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity

attributes.name: zinc_ppm
attributes.description: Plant-available zinc (Zn) micronutrient concentration in parts per million (ppm), measured by Mehlich-3 or DTPA extraction. Zinc deficiency is common in high-pH soils and drives micronutrient fertilizer recommendations for corn and other sensitive crops.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Micronutrient Management; Mehlich-3 / DTPA Extraction Methods; GLOBALG.A.P.

products.name: management_zone
products.description: Spatially defined sub-field management zone used for variable rate application (VRA) prescriptions, precision nutrient management, and yield zone analysis. Captures zone name, zone code, zone type (soil type, EC zone, yield zone, topographic zone), delineation method (EC scanning, yield history, satellite NDVI, manual), zone area (acres), GIS polygon geometry, NDVI index value, EC shallow/deep readings, zone classification (high/medium/low productivity), and active flag. Integrates with Trimble Ag and John Deere Operations Center for VRA prescription generation.
