attributes.name: management_zone_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the management zone record in the Databricks Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: ISO 11179 - Metadata Registry

attributes.name: field_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent agricultural field within which this management zone is spatially defined. Links to the land domain field entity.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Control Point CB 1.1 - Field Identification

attributes.name: growing_season_id
attributes.description: Reference to the growing season for which this management zone configuration is active. Management zone boundaries and soil attribute values may be updated between growing seasons as new soil sampling and yield data become available.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management - Season Planning; GLOBALG.A.P. CB 1.1

attributes.name: soil_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.soil_profile. Business justification: A management zone is delineated based on soil characteristics (EC, pH, OM, CEC, texture) that are authoritatively captured in the soil_profile entity. Linking management_zone to soil_profile formalize
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: agronomist_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for agronomist or crop consultant observations about the management zone, including special management considerations, historical problem areas, or recommendations for upcoming season. Captured in Granular Farm Management or Trimble Ag Software during field scouting.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management - Field Notes; GLOBALG.A.P. CB 1.3 - Record Keeping

attributes.name: area_acres
attributes.description: Calculated spatial area of the management zone expressed in acres, derived from the GIS polygon geometry. Used for VRA prescription rate calculations, input cost allocation, and yield-per-acre (YPM) reporting. Precision to four decimal places supports sub-acre zone granularity.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Spatial Analysis; USDA Farm Service Agency (FSA) Field Acreage Standards

attributes.name: area_hectares
attributes.description: Calculated spatial area of the management zone expressed in hectares for international reporting and metric-system compliance. Supports GLOBALG.A.P. and ISO 14001 environmental reporting requirements.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. CB 1.1; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: cec_meq_100g
attributes.description: Mean cation exchange capacity (CEC) of the management zone soil expressed in milliequivalents per 100 grams (meq/100g). Measures the soil's ability to hold and supply positively charged nutrient ions (Ca, Mg, K, Na). Higher CEC indicates greater nutrient-holding capacity. Used for fertilizer rate calibration and soil amendment planning.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey; ISO 11260 Soil Quality - CEC Determination; GLOBALG.A.P. CB 4.2

attributes.name: centroid_latitude
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the management zone polygon centroid in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used for GPS (Global Positioning System) navigation, weather station proximity matching, and spatial analytics in Esri ArcGIS.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS - Coordinate Reference Systems; WGS84 Standard; John Deere Operations Center GPS

attributes.name: centroid_longitude
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the management zone polygon centroid in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used for GPS navigation, weather data correlation, and spatial analytics in Esri ArcGIS.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS - Coordinate Reference Systems; WGS84 Standard; John Deere Operations Center GPS

attributes.name: conservation_practice_code
attributes.description: USDA NRCS conservation practice standard code applied to this management zone (e.g., 590 - Nutrient Management, 329 - Residue and Tillage Management, 340 - Cover Crop, 412 - Grassed Waterway). Supports USDA EQIP (Environmental Quality Incentives Program) compliance reporting and ISO 14001 environmental management documentation.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Conservation Practice Standards; USDA EQIP Program Requirements; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this management zone record was first created in the lakehouse Silver Layer, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date and Time Standards; SOX Section 404 - Data Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 - Data Integrity

attributes.name: delineation_method
attributes.description: Method used to spatially delineate the management zone boundary. EC (Electrical Conductivity) scanning uses Veris or EM38 sensors; yield history uses multi-year combine yield monitor data from Climate FieldView or John Deere Operations Center; satellite NDVI uses remote sensing imagery; manual uses operator-drawn boundaries in Esri ArcGIS or Trimble Ag; soil sampling uses interpolated soil test point data; topographic analysis uses digital elevation model (DEM) data.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software - Prescription Management; Climate FieldView Analytics; John Deere Operations Center

attributes.name: delineation_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the management zone boundary was originally delineated or most recently revised. Used to assess zone data currency and schedule periodic re-delineation based on updated EC scanning, yield history, or satellite imagery data.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software - Zone Version Management; USDA NRCS BMP Guidelines

attributes.name: drainage_class
attributes.description: USDA NRCS soil drainage class for the management zone, indicating the natural rate of water removal from the soil profile. Affects crop selection, planting date decisions, and tile drainage infrastructure planning. Poorly drained zones may qualify for wetland conservation programs.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey - Drainage Class Definitions; USDA Farm Service Agency Conservation Programs

attributes.name: ec_deep_ds_m
attributes.description: Apparent soil electrical conductivity (EC) reading at deep depth (typically 0-90 cm) expressed in deciSiemens per meter (dS/m). Measured via Veris 3100 or EM38 sensor. Reflects subsoil characteristics including clay pan depth and water-holding capacity. Complements shallow EC for comprehensive zone delineation.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software - EC Zone Delineation; USDA NRCS Soil EC Standards; Veris Technologies Measurement Protocol

attributes.name: ec_scan_date
attributes.description: Date on which the soil electrical conductivity (EC) scanning survey was conducted for this management zone. Used to assess data currency and schedule re-scanning intervals (typically every 3-5 years per BMP guidelines).
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software - EC Scanning Protocol; USDA NRCS BMP Guidelines

attributes.name: ec_shallow_ds_m
attributes.description: Apparent soil electrical conductivity (EC) reading at shallow depth (typically 0-30 cm) expressed in deciSiemens per meter (dS/m). Measured via Veris 3100 or EM38 sensor during EC scanning. Correlates with soil texture, clay content, and salinity. Used as primary input for EC-based zone delineation and VRA (Variable Rate Application) prescription generation.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software - EC Zone Delineation; USDA NRCS Soil EC Standards; Veris Technologies Measurement Protocol

attributes.name: external_zone_code
attributes.description: Native identifier of this management zone in the originating source system (e.g., Trimble Ag zone GUID, John Deere Operations Center zone ID, Esri ArcGIS feature OID). Enables bidirectional synchronization and traceability between the lakehouse Silver Layer and operational precision agriculture platforms.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software - Zone API; John Deere Operations Center - Field Boundary API; Esri ArcGIS REST API

attributes.name: gis_polygon_wkt
attributes.description: Spatial boundary of the management zone stored as Well-Known Text (WKT) polygon geometry in WGS84 coordinate reference system (EPSG:4326). Sourced from Esri ArcGIS or John Deere Operations Center RTK-accurate field mapping. Enables spatial joins with soil sampling points, yield data, and satellite imagery layers.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS - Feature Class Standards; OGC Simple Features Standard; ISO 19125

attributes.name: last_soil_sample_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent composite soil sampling event conducted within this management zone. Used to assess soil data currency and trigger re-sampling workflows. GLOBALG.A.P. and USDA NRCS BMP guidelines recommend soil sampling every 2-4 years.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Sampling Guidelines; GLOBALG.A.P. CB 4.2; ISO 10381 Soil Sampling Standards

attributes.name: ndvi_image_date
attributes.description: Date on which the satellite or aerial imagery used to calculate the current NDVI value was captured. Critical for assessing data currency and seasonal relevance of the vegetation index reading.
attributes.references: Climate FieldView - Imagery Metadata; Sentinel-2 / Landsat Data Standards

attributes.name: ndvi_value
attributes.description: Most recent NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) value for the management zone, ranging from -1.0 to 1.0. Derived from satellite or aerial multispectral imagery. Values above 0.5 indicate dense, healthy vegetation; values below 0.2 indicate sparse or stressed vegetation. Used for in-season crop monitoring and zone reclassification.
attributes.references: Climate FieldView - NDVI Analytics; NASA Landsat / Sentinel-2 Remote Sensing Standards; USDA NASS Crop Monitoring

attributes.name: nitrogen_lbs_acre
attributes.description: Mean available nitrogen (N) level in the management zone soil expressed in pounds per acre (lbs/acre), derived from composite soil sampling. Component of NPK (Nitrogen Phosphorus Potassium) nutrient profile. Used to calculate nitrogen fertilizer application rates in VRA prescriptions and comply with nutrient management plan requirements.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Nutrient Management Practice Standard 590; EPA Nutrient Management Guidelines; GLOBALG.A.P. CB 4.2

attributes.name: organic_matter_pct
attributes.description: Mean soil organic matter (OM) content expressed as a percentage of dry soil weight for the management zone. Measured via loss-on-ignition or Walkley-Black method from composite soil samples. Higher OM improves water retention, nutrient cycling, and soil structure. Key indicator for carbon sequestration reporting under ISCC and sustainability programs.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Health Framework; ISO 14235 Soil Quality - Organic Carbon; ISCC Carbon Certification

attributes.name: phosphorus_lbs_acre
attributes.description: Mean available phosphorus (P) level in the management zone soil expressed in pounds per acre (lbs/acre), derived from composite soil sampling. Component of NPK nutrient profile. Used to calculate phosphorus fertilizer application rates in VRA prescriptions and support EPA water quality compliance for phosphorus runoff management.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Nutrient Management Practice Standard 590; EPA Clean Water Act - Nutrient Runoff; GLOBALG.A.P. CB 4.2

attributes.name: potassium_lbs_acre
attributes.description: Mean available potassium (K) level in the management zone soil expressed in pounds per acre (lbs/acre), derived from composite soil sampling. Component of NPK nutrient profile. Used to calculate potassium fertilizer application rates in VRA prescriptions.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Nutrient Management Practice Standard 590; GLOBALG.A.P. CB 4.2

attributes.name: productivity_class
attributes.description: Agronomic productivity classification of the management zone based on historical yield performance and soil capability. High productivity zones receive premium input rates; low productivity zones may receive reduced inputs or conservation treatment under BMP (Best Management Practices) guidelines.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Land Capability Classification; GLOBALG.A.P. CB 1.1; BMP Guidelines

attributes.name: slope_pct
attributes.description: Mean slope gradient of the management zone expressed as a percentage (rise over run × 100), derived from digital elevation model (DEM) analysis in Esri ArcGIS. Used for erosion risk assessment, drainage planning, and equipment operation safety. Slopes above 8% may require conservation practices under USDA NRCS BMP guidelines.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Land Capability Classification; Esri ArcGIS Terrain Analysis; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: soil_ph_mean
attributes.description: Mean soil pH (Potential of Hydrogen) value for the management zone, representing average soil acidity or alkalinity on a 0-14 scale. Calculated from composite soil samples within the zone. Critical for nutrient availability assessment and lime application rate determination in VRA prescriptions. Optimal range for most crops is 6.0-7.0.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Health Assessment; ISO 10390 Soil Quality - pH Determination; GLOBALG.A.P. CB 4.2

attributes.name: soil_texture_class
attributes.description: USDA soil texture classification for the dominant soil type within the management zone, based on relative proportions of sand, silt, and clay particles. Determines water infiltration rate, water-holding capacity, and tillage characteristics. Used for irrigation scheduling and equipment operation planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sand|loamy_sand|sandy_loam|loam|silt_loam|silt|sandy_clay_loam|clay_loam|silty_clay_loam|sandy_clay|silty_clay|clay — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Texture Triangle Classification; ISO 11277 Soil Particle Size Analysis

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this management zone record was originated or last updated. Supports data lineage tracking and conflict resolution when zone data is synchronized across multiple precision agriculture platforms.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage Standards; ISO 8000 Data Quality

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this management zone record was most recently modified in the lakehouse Silver Layer, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used to detect stale zone configurations and trigger re-synchronization with source precision agriculture systems.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date and Time Standards; SOX Section 404 - Data Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 - Data Integrity

attributes.name: vra_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this management zone is eligible for variable rate application (VRA) prescription generation in Trimble Ag Software or John Deere Operations Center. Zones must meet minimum area thresholds and have current soil data to qualify for VRA. True = eligible for VRA prescriptions; False = not eligible.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software - VRA Prescription Rules; John Deere Operations Center - Prescription Management

attributes.name: zone_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the management zone within the farm management information system (FMIS). Used as the business key in Trimble Ag Software and John Deere Operations Center for variable rate application (VRA) prescription generation.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software - Zone Management; John Deere Operations Center Field Mapping

attributes.name: zone_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name assigned to the management zone (e.g., 'North Field High Productivity Zone', 'EC Zone 3 - Sandy Loam'). Used in FMIS reporting and VRA prescription labeling.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software - Zone Management; GLOBALG.A.P. CB 1.1

attributes.name: zone_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the management zone. Active zones are used in current-season VRA prescriptions; inactive zones are temporarily suspended; archived zones are retained for historical analysis; draft zones are pending agronomist review and approval.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management - Zone Lifecycle; GLOBALG.A.P. CB 1.1

attributes.name: zone_type
attributes.description: Classification of the zone based on the primary agronomic criterion used to define it. Soil type zones are delineated by soil series; EC (Electrical Conductivity) zones by apparent soil EC readings; yield zones by multi-year yield history; topographic zones by elevation and slope; NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) zones by satellite-derived vegetation index; management zones by operator-defined boundaries.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software - Zone Types; USDA NRCS Soil Survey; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: zone_version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the management zone boundary definition, incremented each time the zone polygon or classification attributes are revised. Supports audit trail and historical comparison of zone configurations across growing seasons.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management - Data Versioning; ISO 14001 Environmental Records Management

products.name: field_boundary
products.description: Versioned GIS boundary geometry record for each field, supporting boundary change history as fields are split, merged, or re-surveyed. Stores boundary version number, effective start date, effective end date, geometry type (polygon/multipolygon), coordinate reference system (CRS/EPSG code), boundary source (RTK GPS survey, drone imagery, ArcGIS digitized), total calculated area (acres), perimeter (feet/meters), boundary accuracy class (RTK/sub-meter/meter), ArcGIS feature class reference, and John Deere Operations Center field ID. Enables temporal boundary tracking for FSA compliance and crop insurance.
products.reference: Esri ArcGIS Feature Layer / John Deere Operations Center

attributes.name: field_boundary_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each versioned field boundary record in the land domain. Primary key for the field_boundary data product. Role: MASTER_RESOURCE.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Feature Class Standard; ISO 19125 (Simple Features for SQL)

attributes.name: farm_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the farm or operation that owns or manages this field boundary. Supports multi-farm enterprise hierarchies in Granular Farm Management and SAP S/4HANA land management.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; USDA Farm Service Agency (FSA) Farm Records

attributes.name: primary_field_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent agricultural field entity that this boundary version describes. Multiple boundary versions may exist for the same field over time as boundaries are split, merged, or re-surveyed.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS; John Deere Operations Center Field Management

attributes.name: tertiary_trimble_field_id
attributes.description: Field identifier assigned by Trimble Ag Software for variable rate prescription (VRA) and crop scouting integration. Enables linkage of boundary geometry with Trimble-generated field plans and prescription maps.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software Field Management; VRA (Variable Rate Application) Standards

attributes.name: accuracy_class
attributes.description: Positional accuracy classification of the boundary geometry. 'RTK' indicates centimeter-level accuracy from Real-Time Kinematic GPS survey; 'sub_meter' indicates accuracy better than 1 meter; 'meter' indicates accuracy within 1-5 meters; 'multi_meter' indicates accuracy greater than 5 meters (e.g., from manual digitization or low-resolution imagery).
attributes.references: RTK (Real-Time Kinematic) GPS Standards; USDA NRCS Geospatial Data Standards; ISO 19157 (Data Quality)

attributes.name: accuracy_meters
attributes.description: Quantitative positional accuracy of the boundary geometry expressed in meters (root mean square error or circular error probable). Complements accuracy_class with a precise numeric value for spatial quality assessment and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 19157 (Geographic Information — Data Quality); USDA NRCS Geospatial Standards

attributes.name: arcgis_feature_class_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the corresponding feature class and object ID within the Esri ArcGIS geodatabase. Enables direct linkage between this data product and the authoritative GIS source layer for spatial queries and map rendering.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Geodatabase Standards; ISO 19110 (Feature Catalogue)

attributes.name: area_acres
attributes.description: Total calculated area of the field boundary in acres, derived from the boundary geometry. Used for FSA compliance reporting, crop insurance acreage certification, input application rate calculations, and yield per acre (YPM) computations. This is the authoritative GIS-calculated area, not a surveyed or estimated value.
attributes.references: USDA FSA Acreage Reporting; Crop Insurance Regulations (RMA); GLOBALG.A.P. Field Registration

attributes.name: area_hectares
attributes.description: Total calculated area of the field boundary in hectares, derived from the boundary geometry. Used for international reporting, metric-system compliance, and integration with global agricultural standards (GLOBALG.A.P., ISO 14001 environmental reporting).
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Field Registration; ISO 14001 Environmental Management; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: boundary_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this field boundary within the farm management information system (FMIS). Used for cross-system referencing between ArcGIS, John Deere Operations Center, and SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: FMIS (Farm Management Information System) Standards; Esri ArcGIS Feature Class Naming

attributes.name: boundary_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name assigned to this field boundary, typically matching the field name used operationally (e.g., 'North 40', 'River Bottom Field'). Serves as the primary identity label for business users.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; Trimble Ag Software Field Naming Convention

attributes.name: boundary_source
attributes.description: Method or technology used to capture or derive this field boundary. 'RTK_GPS_survey' indicates Real-Time Kinematic (RTK) GPS ground survey; 'drone_imagery' indicates boundary derived from UAV aerial imagery; 'ArcGIS_digitized' indicates manual digitization in Esri ArcGIS; 'satellite_imagery' indicates derivation from satellite imagery; 'manual_entry' indicates operator-entered coordinates.
attributes.references: RTK (Real-Time Kinematic) GPS Standards; Esri ArcGIS; John Deere Operations Center; GLOBALG.A.P. Field Mapping

attributes.name: boundary_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this boundary version. 'active' indicates the current operative boundary; 'superseded' indicates a prior version replaced by a newer one; 'draft' indicates a boundary under review before activation; 'retired' indicates a boundary no longer in use; 'pending_review' indicates awaiting FSA or agronomist validation.
attributes.references: USDA FSA Compliance; GLOBALG.A.P. Field Registration; ISO 19125

attributes.name: boundary_version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of this boundary record for the parent field. Increments each time the boundary is re-surveyed, split, merged, or corrected. Version 1 is the initial boundary; higher numbers represent subsequent revisions.
attributes.references: ISO 19125 (Simple Features); USDA FSA Field Boundary Versioning Requirements

attributes.name: centroid_latitude
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the field boundary centroid in decimal degrees (WGS84 / EPSG:4326). Used for weather station assignment, solar radiation modeling, and quick spatial lookups without full geometry processing.
attributes.references: WGS84 (World Geodetic System 1984); GPS (Global Positioning System) Standards; Esri ArcGIS

attributes.name: centroid_longitude
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the field boundary centroid in decimal degrees (WGS84 / EPSG:4326). Used alongside centroid_latitude for weather station assignment, logistics routing, and spatial indexing.
attributes.references: WGS84 (World Geodetic System 1984); GPS (Global Positioning System) Standards; Esri ArcGIS

attributes.name: clu_identifier
attributes.description: USDA Common Land Unit (CLU) unique identifier for this field boundary. The CLU is the smallest unit of land that has a permanent, contiguous boundary and is used as the basis for USDA farm program administration and acreage reporting.
attributes.references: USDA Common Land Unit (CLU) Program; USDA FSA; NRCS Geospatial Data Gateway

attributes.name: conservation_program
attributes.description: Name or code of the USDA conservation program in which this field boundary is enrolled (e.g., 'CRP' for Conservation Reserve Program, 'EQIP' for Environmental Quality Incentives Program, 'WRP' for Wetland Reserve Program). Null if not enrolled in any conservation program.
attributes.references: USDA FSA Conservation Reserve Program (CRP); USDA NRCS EQIP; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the country in which this field boundary is located (e.g., 'USA'). Supports international operations and GLOBALG.A.P. country-of-origin labeling (COOL) compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; COOL (Country of Origin Labeling); GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: county_fips_code
attributes.description: Five-digit Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) code identifying the US county in which this field boundary is located. Required for USDA FSA county office assignment, crop insurance rating, and regulatory jurisdiction determination.
attributes.references: USDA FSA County Records; FIPS 6-4 (Counties and County Equivalents); USDA RMA Crop Insurance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this field boundary record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the audit trail creation anchor for data lineage and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley) Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: crs_epsg_code
attributes.description: EPSG (European Petroleum Survey Group) numeric code identifying the coordinate reference system (CRS) in which the boundary geometry coordinates are expressed (e.g., 4326 for WGS84, 32614 for UTM Zone 14N). Critical for accurate spatial calculations and cross-system interoperability.
attributes.references: EPSG Geodetic Parameter Registry; OGC CRS Standards; Esri ArcGIS Spatial Reference

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this boundary version ceases to be operative, typically when superseded by a new version due to field split, merge, or re-survey. Null indicates the boundary is currently active with no defined end date.
attributes.references: USDA FSA Farm Records; FSMA Traceability Rule; Crop Insurance Regulations (RMA)

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this boundary version is considered operative and legally binding for FSA compliance, crop insurance, and land management purposes. Marks the beginning of the temporal validity window for this boundary record.
attributes.references: USDA FSA Farm Records; FSMA Traceability Rule; Crop Insurance Regulations (RMA)

attributes.name: elevation_avg_meters
attributes.description: Average elevation of the field above mean sea level in meters, derived from digital elevation model (DEM) data. Used for microclimate analysis, frost risk assessment, and precision agriculture zone delineation.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS National Elevation Dataset; Esri ArcGIS DEM Analysis

attributes.name: fsa_field_number
attributes.description: USDA Farm Service Agency (FSA) field number within the assigned tract. Together with fsa_tract_number, uniquely identifies this field in the USDA Common Land Unit (CLU) registry for federal program compliance and acreage certification.
attributes.references: USDA FSA Common Land Unit (CLU); USDA Farm Records; Crop Insurance Regulations (RMA)

attributes.name: fsa_tract_number
attributes.description: USDA Farm Service Agency (FSA) tract number assigned to this field for federal program compliance, acreage reporting, and crop insurance purposes. Required for ARC/PLC program enrollment and FSA farm records.
attributes.references: USDA FSA Farm Records; USDA Common Land Unit (CLU) Standards; Crop Insurance Regulations (RMA)

attributes.name: geometry_type
attributes.description: GIS geometry type of the boundary shape as defined by ISO 19125 Simple Features. 'Polygon' for contiguous single-parcel fields; 'MultiPolygon' for non-contiguous fields composed of multiple disconnected parcels (e.g., fields separated by roads or waterways).
attributes.references: ISO 19125 (Simple Features for SQL); Esri ArcGIS Geometry Standards; OGC (Open Geospatial Consortium)

attributes.name: geometry_wkt
attributes.description: Full boundary geometry encoded in Well-Known Text (WKT) format as per OGC standards. Stores the polygon or multipolygon coordinate ring defining the precise field boundary. Used by Esri ArcGIS and John Deere Operations Center for spatial analysis and field mapping.
attributes.references: OGC Well-Known Text (WKT) Standard; ISO 19125; Esri ArcGIS

attributes.name: irrigation_type
attributes.description: Primary irrigation method applied to this field boundary. Informs water resource management planning, evapotranspiration (ET) calculations, and irrigation event scheduling in the crop management domain.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Irrigation Water Management; EPA Water Quality Standards; BMP (Best Management Practices)

attributes.name: is_gmo_restricted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this field boundary has a contractual or certification-based restriction prohibiting the planting of genetically modified organism (GMO) crops. True if GMO planting is prohibited; False if GMO crops are permitted.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Biotechnology Regulations; Non-GMO Project Standard; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: is_organic_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this field boundary is enrolled in and certified under the USDA National Organic Program (NOP). True if the field carries active organic certification; False otherwise. Drives organic input restrictions and segregation requirements.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP); USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS); GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: land_use_type
attributes.description: Primary land use classification for this field boundary. Determines applicable regulatory requirements, conservation program eligibility, and crop planning constraints. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cropland|pasture|orchard|vineyard|fallow|wetland|woodland|conservation|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Land Use Classification; USDA FSA; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: perimeter_meters
attributes.description: Total calculated perimeter length of the field boundary in meters, derived from the boundary geometry. Used for fencing cost estimation, irrigation system design, and field edge management planning.
attributes.references: ISO 19125 (Simple Features); Esri ArcGIS Geometry Calculations

attributes.name: slope_percent
attributes.description: Average slope of the field expressed as a percentage (rise over run × 100). Used for erosion risk assessment, drainage planning, variable rate application (VRA) prescriptions, and conservation practice eligibility under USDA NRCS programs.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey; USDA NRCS Conservation Practice Standards; ISO 14001

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation (ISO 3166-2:US) identifying the state in which this field boundary is located. Used for state-level regulatory compliance, FSA state office routing, and geographic reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2:US; USDA FSA State Records; EPA State Regulatory Jurisdiction

attributes.name: survey_date
attributes.description: Date on which the field boundary was physically surveyed or digitized to produce this version. Used to assess boundary currency, trigger re-survey workflows, and support FSA acreage certification timelines.
attributes.references: USDA FSA Acreage Reporting Deadlines; GLOBALG.A.P. Field Registration; ISO 19157

attributes.name: surveyed_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person, organization, or system that performed or certified the boundary survey (e.g., licensed surveyor name, drone service provider, or system name such as 'John Deere Operations Center Auto-Boundary'). Supports audit trail and data quality accountability.
attributes.references: USDA FSA Acreage Certification; ISO 19157 (Data Quality Lineage); GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this field boundary record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change detection, incremental data pipeline processing, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SOX Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

products.name: use_plan
products.description: Annual or multi-year land use planning record assigning intended crop rotation, land use type, and conservation designations to each field for a given crop year. Captures crop year, planned crop (commodity), planned rotation sequence, land use type (row crop, pasture, hay, fallow, cover crop, CRP, wetland), conservation reserve program (CRP) enrollment flag, CRP contract number, planned tillage system (no-till, strip-till, conventional), irrigation plan flag, and plan status (draft/approved/active/completed). Supports FSA farm program compliance and crop insurance acreage reporting.
products.reference: Granular Farm Management / FSA Acreage Report

attributes.name: use_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the land use plan record. Primary key for the land_use_plan data product in the land domain.
attributes.references: Internal Data Standard

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: FSA Acreage Reporting and Crop Insurance enrollment require land use plans to reference the commodity master for standardized commodity codes, grade standards, and MRL applicability. planned_commodity
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: farm_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the farm or operation unit to which the planned field belongs. Supports farm-level aggregation of land use planning across multiple fields.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: field_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agricultural field parcel to which this land use plan applies. Links to the field master record containing GIS boundary, acreage, and soil profile data.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS; John Deere Operations Center

attributes.name: growing_season_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to crop.growing_season. Business justification: Land use plans are annual FSA/USDA documents aligned to specific crop years and growing seasons. Linking land_use_plan to growing_season enables FSA compliance reporting, crop insurance unit alignment

attributes.description: Total land area served by the subsurface tile drainage system in this zone, measured in acres. Used for drainage coefficient calculations, drainage district permit compliance, and BMP reporting. Applicable when zone_type = 'subsurface_drainage'.

attributes.name: drainage_coefficient_in_day

attributes.name: drainage_district_permit_ref
attributes.description: Permit number or reference code issued by the local drainage district authority governing the subsurface tile drainage system. Required for regulatory compliance and environmental reporting. Applicable when zone_type = 'subsurface_drainage'.

attributes.name: et_scheduling_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this irrigation zone uses Evapotranspiration (ET)-based scheduling to determine irrigation timing and volume. ET-based scheduling integrates weather data and crop coefficients to optimize water use efficiency.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Irrigation Water Management; Climate FieldView ET Scheduling; ASCE Standardized Reference ET

attributes.name: gis_boundary_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier or layer name for the zone boundary polygon stored in Esri ArcGIS. Enables spatial analysis, overlap detection, and RTK-accurate field mapping for precision water management.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS; John Deere Operations Center; USDA FSA CLU (Common Land Unit)

attributes.name: installation_contractor
attributes.description: Name of the contractor or company that installed the irrigation system or subsurface tile drainage system. Used for warranty claims, maintenance coordination, and capital expenditure (CAPEX) documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: installation_cost_usd
attributes.description: Total capital expenditure (CAPEX) incurred for the installation of the irrigation or drainage system, expressed in US dollars. Used for asset valuation, depreciation calculations, and ROI analysis in SAP S/4HANA FI-AA and Granular Farm Management financial planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA; GAAP/IFRS Capital Expenditure Standards; FASB ASC 360

attributes.name: installation_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the irrigation or drainage system was installed. Used for asset age tracking, depreciation scheduling, and infrastructure replacement planning in SAP S/4HANA Fixed Assets.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA (Fixed Asset Accounting); GAAP/IFRS Asset Depreciation Standards

attributes.name: irrigated_area_acres
attributes.description: Total land area served by this irrigation zone measured in acres. Used for permitted volume compliance calculations, water use efficiency reporting, and USDA Farm Service Agency (FSA) acreage reporting.
attributes.references: USDA FSA Acreage Reporting; GLOBALG.A.P. Water Management Standard

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical inspection of the irrigation or drainage system infrastructure. Used to track maintenance compliance intervals and trigger inspection work orders in SAP S/4HANA PM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; ISO 55000 Asset Management; GLOBALG.A.P. Infrastructure Maintenance

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes or remarks about the irrigation or drainage zone, including known issues, special operating conditions, or historical context not captured in structured fields. Used by farm managers and agronomists in Granular Farm Management.

attributes.name: permitted_volume_acre_ft
attributes.description: Maximum annual water withdrawal volume authorized under the associated water right permit, expressed in acre-feet. Compliance ceiling for seasonal irrigation scheduling and water use reporting to state water authorities.
attributes.references: State Water Authority Permit Frameworks; USDA NRCS Water Rights; EPA Clean Water Act

attributes.name: soil_moisture_sensor_count
attributes.description: Number of soil moisture sensor locations deployed within this irrigation zone for real-time soil water status monitoring. Supports IoT-driven precision irrigation scheduling via John Deere Operations Center integration.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center IoT Integration; USDA NRCS Soil Moisture Monitoring

attributes.name: soil_moisture_sensor_locations
attributes.description: GPS coordinate string or GIS reference describing the placement locations of soil moisture sensors within the zone (e.g., WKT MULTIPOINT or comma-separated lat/lon pairs). Supports precision water management and IoT sensor mapping in Esri ArcGIS.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS; John Deere Operations Center; RTK GPS Standards

attributes.name: system_condition
attributes.description: Current physical condition assessment of the irrigation or drainage infrastructure. Drives maintenance prioritization, capital replacement planning, and OEE reporting in SAP S/4HANA PM and John Deere Operations Center.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; USDA NRCS Conservation Practice Standards; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: system_type
attributes.description: Classification of the irrigation delivery system technology installed in this zone. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: center_pivot|drip|flood|subsurface_drip|linear_move|traveling_gun — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Irrigation Guide; ASABE Standards; Climate FieldView

attributes.name: tile_depth_inches
attributes.description: Installation depth of the subsurface drainage tile below the soil surface in inches. Affects drainage effectiveness, frost protection, and interaction with soil horizons. Applicable when zone_type = 'subsurface_drainage'.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Conservation Practice Standard 606; ASABE EP480

attributes.name: tile_diameter_inches
attributes.description: Internal diameter of the subsurface drainage tile pipe in inches. Determines hydraulic capacity and drainage coefficient. Used for system capacity calculations and replacement planning. Applicable when zone_type = 'subsurface_drainage'.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Conservation Practice Standard 606; ASABE EP480

attributes.name: tile_map_gis_ref
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tile Map Geographic Information System (GIS) Reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or layer name for the subsurface tile drainage map stored in Esri ArcGIS. Enables spatial visualization of tile layout, outlet locations, and drainage area boundaries for BMP planning and contractor coordination.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS; USDA NRCS Conservation Practice Standard 606

attributes.name: tile_material
attributes.description: Material composition of the subsurface drainage tile pipe installed in this zone. Corrugated plastic/HDPE is the modern standard; clay and concrete are legacy materials found in older installations. Applicable when zone_type = 'subsurface_drainage'.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Conservation Practice Standard 606; ASABE EP480

attributes.name: tile_outlet_latitude
attributes.description: GPS latitude coordinate of the subsurface tile drainage system outlet location in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used for field mapping in Esri ArcGIS and environmental monitoring of drainage discharge points. Applicable when zone_type = 'subsurface_drainage'.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS; WGS84 Coordinate Reference System; EPA Clean Water Act Section 404

attributes.name: tile_outlet_longitude
attributes.description: GPS longitude coordinate of the subsurface tile drainage system outlet location in decimal degrees (WGS84). Used for field mapping in Esri ArcGIS and environmental monitoring of drainage discharge points. Applicable when zone_type = 'subsurface_drainage'.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS; WGS84 Coordinate Reference System; EPA Clean Water Act Section 404

attributes.name: tile_system_type
attributes.description: Classification of the subsurface tile drainage system layout installed in this zone. 'Pattern' indicates systematic grid installation; 'random' indicates targeted placement in wet spots; 'interceptor' indicates placement to intercept lateral water flow. Applicable when zone_type = 'subsurface_drainage'.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Conservation Practice Standard 606 (Subsurface Drain); ASABE EP480

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this irrigation zone record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change data capture (CDC), audit compliance, and Silver Layer delta processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SOX Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: water_source_type
attributes.description: Classification of the primary water supply source feeding this irrigation zone (e.g., groundwater well, surface river diversion, on-farm reservoir, irrigation canal). Critical for water right compliance and drought risk assessment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: well|river|reservoir|canal|municipal|recycled — promote to reference product if additional sources are needed]
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Water Management; EPA Clean Water Act; State Water Authority Regulations

attributes.name: zone_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the irrigation or drainage zone. Drives scheduling eligibility, maintenance planning, and asset reporting in SAP S/4HANA PM and John Deere Operations Center.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: zone_type
attributes.description: Discriminator indicating whether this zone record represents an irrigation delivery system or a subsurface tile drainage system. Drives which set of operational attributes are applicable for the zone.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Conservation Practice Standards; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

products.name: farm_unit
products.description: Operational farm unit grouping fields and parcels under a single management structure — typically corresponding to a USDA FSA farm number and tract number. Captures farm name, FSA farm number, FSA tract number, operating entity name, farm manager, total operated acres (owned + leased), county, state, primary commodity, farm type (grain, livestock, mixed, specialty crop), and operational status (active/inactive). Serves as the top-level aggregation point in the land domain hierarchy: farm_unit → parcel → field. Links to parcels for legal land identity and to fields for operational management. Used for FSA program enrollment, crop insurance unit structuring, enterprise budgeting, and USDA program payment tracking. One farm_unit may span multiple parcels and contain multiple fields. SSOT for the operational hierarchy that links fields and parcels to their managing entity.
products.reference: USDA FSA Farm Number / Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: gis_boundary_reference

attributes.name: leased_acres

attributes.name: longitude

attributes.references: WGS84 Coordinate Reference System; Esri ArcGIS; John Deere Operations Center

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special conditions, or contextual information about this farm unit not captured in structured fields. Used by farm managers and data stewards for supplemental documentation.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; SAP S/4HANA

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the farm unit indicating whether it is actively managed, temporarily inactive, under transition (e.g., organic conversion), or permanently retired from operation.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; USDA FSA Farm Records

attributes.name: organic_certification_status

attributes.name: owned_acres

products.name: easement

Stores easement type, grantor name, grantee name (utility company, government agency, neighbor), easement area (acres) or corridor width (feet), easement length (feet), recorded document reference, recording date, expiration date (if term easement), compensation paid ($), restrictions imposed, and GIS geometry reference. Critical for land use planning and title due diligence.

attributes.name: easement_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the easement record. Primary key for the land.easement data product.

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Conservation easements create long-term compliance obligations (annual monitoring requirements, restricted use obligations, reporting to land trusts). Linking easement to its governing compliance obli

attributes.name: parcel_id

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Conservation easements may require environmental permits (Section 404 wetland permits, NRCS easement permits). Linking easement to the governing permit enables compliance tracking for easement-related
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: annual_payment
attributes.description: Annual recurring payment made to the grantor for the easement right, expressed in US dollars. Applicable for term easements with periodic compensation structures. Used for OPEX budgeting and financial planning in Granular Farm Management.

attributes.name: area_acres
attributes.description: Total land area encumbered by the easement, measured in acres. Applicable for area-based easements such as conservation easements or drainage easements. May be null for linear corridor easements defined by width and length.

attributes.name: compensation_amount

attributes.name: conservation_program

attributes.name: corridor_width_ft

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the easement record was first created in the system. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking in the Databricks Lakehouse.

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: Official recorded document reference number including book, page, instrument number, or deed reference as assigned by the county recorder or land registry. Used for title searches and legal due diligence.

attributes.name: easement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known document or instrument number assigned by the county recorder or title company at the time of recording. Used for title due diligence and cross-referencing recorded documents.

attributes.name: easement_status

attributes.name: easement_type

attributes.name: grantee_name

attributes.name: grantee_type

attributes.name: grantor_name

attributes.name: is_perpetual

attributes.name: legal_description

products.name: farm_vendor_approval
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between farm_unit and vendor. It captures the formal approval of a specific vendor to supply designated agricultural input categories to a specific farm unit, including farm-level pricing agreements, preferred supplier status, and approval validity periods. Each record links one farm_unit to one vendor and carries attributes that exist only in the context of this farm-unit-specific vendor authorization — data that belongs neither to the farm unit master nor to the vendor master alone.. Existence Justification: In agricultural operations, a farm unit actively approves and manages multiple vendors for input supply (seed, fertilizer, agrochemicals, fuel), and a single vendor supplies inputs to multiple farm units across a region or enterprise. This is not an analytical correlation — procurement teams explicitly create, maintain, and expire farm-unit-level vendor approvals with farm-specific pricing agreements, approved input categories, and validity periods. The relationship is operationally managed as a 'Vendor Approval' or 'Supply Agreement' record that procurement and farm managers actively govern.

products.name: land_field_operation
products.description: This association product represents the operational role relationship between a field and a customer account. It captures who operates a given field, in what capacity, and for what period — supporting FSA farm records, crop insurance operator declarations, lease management, and custom farming billing. Each record links one field to one account with a specific operator role and effective date range. A field may have multiple simultaneous records (e.g., one landowner + one tenant + one custom operator), and one account may have many such records across its entire field portfolio.. Existence Justification: In agricultural operations, a single field can be simultaneously operated by multiple accounts in different capacities — a landowner account holds title, a cash-rent tenant account farms the ground, and a custom operator account may perform specific operations (e.g., harvesting). Conversely, one account (e.g., a large farming operation or custom operator) manages many fields across multiple farm units. The business actively tracks these operator relationships for FSA farm records, crop insurance eligibility, and operational billing — this is not a derived correlation but an actively managed operational record.

products.name: field_input_restriction
products.description: This association product represents the regulatory and operational restriction Contract between a field and an agricultural input product. It captures the specific restriction governing whether and how a given input product may be applied to a given field, driven by organic certification, groundwater advisories, conservation program enrollment, GMO restrictions, or other regulatory requirements. Each record links one field to one input_product and carries the restriction type, regulatory basis, effective period, and reason — data that exists only in the context of this specific field-product pairing.. Existence Justification: In agricultural operations, a field can have multiple input product restrictions simultaneously (e.g., an organic-certified field restricts all synthetic pesticides, while a field near a waterway restricts specific herbicides, and a conservation-enrolled field restricts certain soil amendments). Conversely, a single input product (e.g., a restricted-use herbicide) is restricted on many different fields across the farm for different regulatory reasons. The business actively manages these restrictions — creating, updating, and expiring them — as a compliance and operational control mechanism with its own regulatory basis, effective dates, and restriction type.

products.name: field_certification_scope
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between a specific agricultural field and a sustainability certification. It captures the operational scope record that defines which fields are covered under each certification, the certified area applicable to that field, the per-field certification status, audit findings, and the effective and expiry dates of coverage. Each record links one field to one sustainability_certification with attributes that exist only in the context of this field-level certification scope — data that belongs neither to the field master record nor to the certification master record alone.. Existence Justification: In agricultural operations, a single field genuinely holds multiple simultaneous certifications (e.g., USDA Organic + GlobalG.A.P. + Rainforest Alliance applied to the same paddock at the same time), and a single certification (e.g., a farm-level USDA Organic certificate) covers multiple fields within that farm unit. The business actively manages this relationship — compliance teams track which fields are in scope for each certification, what certified area applies per field, and the per-field audit status. This is not an analytical derivation; it is an operational record that auditors, certification bodies, and farm managers create, update, and query directly.

Supports operational efficiency and asset lifecycle management aligned with ISO 55000.

SSOT for all equipment identity, registration, and financial summary data. Central master record referenced by all transactional products in the equipment domain.

attributes.name: acquisition_date

attributes.name: asset_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name or designation for the asset (e.g., 'John Deere 8R 410 Tractor - North Field Unit 3'). Used for operational identification and reporting.

attributes.name: commissioning_date

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; ISO 55000:2014; GAAP ASC 360

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO) module cost center code to which the asset's Operational Expenditure (OPEX) and depreciation charges are allocated. Enables farm-level and department-level cost reporting and EBITDA analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; GAAP; IFRS; SOX financial reporting controls

attributes.name: current_book_value
attributes.description: Current net book value of the asset after accumulated depreciation, calculated as acquisition cost minus total accumulated depreciation to date. Used for financial reporting, insurance valuation, and disposal decisions. Denominated in USD.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360; IFRS IAS 16; SAP S/4HANA FI/AM Module; SOX compliance

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the asset was formally retired from service and decommissioned. Marks the end of the operational lifecycle for depreciation cessation, disposal processing, and regulatory reporting. Null if asset is still active.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; ISO 55000:2014; GAAP ASC 360; IFRS IAS 16

attributes.name: depreciation_method

attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360; IFRS IAS 16; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: engine_hours
attributes.description: Cumulative total engine or operating hours recorded on the asset since manufacture or last major overhaul. Primary usage metric for maintenance scheduling (e.g., 250-hour, 500-hour service intervals), depreciation under units-of-production method, and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) calculation. Sourced from John Deere Operations Center telematics.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; SAP S/4HANA PM Module; ISO 55000:2014; OEE standard

attributes.name: engine_power_kw
attributes.description: Rated engine power output of the asset in kilowatts (kW) as specified by the manufacturer. Used for equipment capability matching to field operations, fuel consumption benchmarking, and EPA emissions classification.
attributes.references: EPA Tier 4 Final Emissions Standards; SAE J1349 engine power standard; John Deere Operations Center

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: Type of fuel or energy source used by the asset. Relevant for fuel cost allocation, emissions reporting (EPA Tier 4 Final compliance), and sustainability tracking under ISCC and ISO 14001 environmental management standards.
attributes.references: EPA Tier 4 Final Emissions Standards; ISO 14001; ISCC sustainability certification

attributes.name: gps_rtk_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the asset is equipped with a Global Positioning System (GPS) / Real-Time Kinematic (RTK) positioning receiver for precision agriculture operations including Variable Rate Application (VRA), auto-steer, and field mapping. True = RTK-capable; False = no precision positioning hardware.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; Trimble Ag Software; ISO 17894 (GPS for agriculture)

attributes.name: insurance_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current insurance policy for the asset expires. Triggers renewal workflow to ensure continuous coverage and compliance with financing covenants and regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; USDA Risk Management Agency (RMA)

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the insurance policy covering this asset against loss, damage, or liability. Used for claims processing, risk management reporting, and compliance with lender insurance requirements for financed equipment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; USDA Risk Management Agency (RMA)

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal safety or regulatory inspection performed on the asset. Used to track compliance with OSHA equipment safety standards, GLOBALG.A.P. equipment hygiene requirements, and internal audit schedules.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1928 (Agricultural Operations); GLOBALG.A.P.; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

attributes.name: lifecycle_stage

attributes.name: make

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; John Deere Operations Center

attributes.name: model
attributes.description: Manufacturer model designation of the asset (e.g., '8R 410', 'X9 1100', 'R4045'). Combined with make and year to uniquely identify the equipment specification for parts compatibility and performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; John Deere Operations Center

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: Manufacturer model year of the asset (e.g., 2022). Used for depreciation scheduling, technology generation classification, and compliance with emissions standards (EPA Tier 4 Final).
attributes.references: EPA Tier 4 Final Emissions Standards; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: next_service_date
attributes.description: Date on which the next preventive maintenance (PM) service is scheduled for the asset based on the Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) schedule. Derived from last service date plus service interval. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA PM module maintenance plans.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; ISO 55000:2014; John Deere Operations Center maintenance alerts

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, special configuration details, known defects, or other relevant information about the asset that does not fit structured fields. Used by fleet managers and maintenance technicians for contextual documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; ISO 55000:2014

attributes.name: odometer_km
attributes.description: Cumulative distance traveled by the asset in kilometers, applicable to self-propelled vehicles (tractors, combines, sprayers, transport vehicles). Used for road-transport maintenance scheduling and fleet management. Sourced from John Deere Operations Center or vehicle ECU. Null for stationary or non-motorized equipment.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational readiness status of the asset indicating whether it is available for field deployment. attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; ISO 55000:2014; John Deere Operations Center

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Classification of the asset's ownership or financing arrangement. Owned = outright purchase (CAPEX); Leased = finance or operating lease (OPEX/IFRS 16); Rented = short-term hire; Contract Hire = long-term managed service. Drives financial treatment under GAAP/IFRS 16.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: registration_expiry_date

attributes.name: registration_number

attributes.name: salvage_value

attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360; IFRS IAS 16; SAP S/4HANA FI/AM Module

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned unique serial number for the equipment unit. Used for warranty tracking, recall management, and manufacturer service records. Key identifier in John Deere Operations Center.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; John Deere Operations Center; USDA APHIS equipment registration

attributes.name: tag
attributes.description: Internally assigned physical asset tag or barcode label affixed to the equipment for inventory tracking and identification during audits and maintenance. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA PM asset tag field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; ISO 55000:2014

attributes.name: telematics_device_code

attributes.description: Unique identifier of the telematics device or machine connectivity unit installed on the asset and registered in the John Deere Operations Center platform. Enables real-time GPS tracking, remote diagnostics, fuel consumption monitoring, and field data synchronization.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; ISO 15143-3 (AEMP Telematics Data Standard)

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Estimated useful economic life of the asset in years, used as the basis for straight-line depreciation calculations and capital replacement planning. Defined at acquisition per GAAP/IFRS guidelines.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360; IFRS IAS 16; SAP S/4HANA FI/AM Module

attributes.name: vin
attributes.description: 17-character Vehicle Identification Number assigned to motorized agricultural vehicles (tractors, combines, self-propelled sprayers) per ISO 3779 standard. Null for non-motorized implements.

attributes.name: vra_controller_enabled

attributes.description: Indicates whether the asset is equipped with a Variable Rate Application (VRA) controller enabling prescription-based variable rate seeding, fertilization, or chemical application. Supports precision agriculture workflows in Trimble Ag Software and Climate FieldView.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software; Climate FieldView; EPA VRA compliance; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: warranty_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the manufacturer or dealer warranty for the asset expires. Used to trigger preventive maintenance scheduling under warranty terms and to determine whether repair costs are chargeable to the vendor or internal Operational Expenditure (OPEX) budget.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; John Deere Operations Center warranty tracking

attributes.name: category_name

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.references: ISO 55000; SOX Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Standard depreciation calculation method applied to assets in this category for financial reporting purposes. Drives SAP S/4HANA FI-AA depreciation key assignment. Aligned with IFRS IAS 16 and GAAP ASC 360 requirements for agricultural equipment asset accounting.

attributes.name: effective_from

attributes.name: effective_until

attributes.name: equipment_class
attributes.description: Operational class of the equipment category aligned with core agricultural business processes (e.g., tillage, planting, spraying, harvesting, irrigation). 'none' applies to non-powered implements (e.g., tillage tools, trailers). attributes.name: globalg_ap_equipment_type

attributes.name: inspection_governing_body

attributes.name: inspection_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets in this category are subject to mandatory regulatory inspection requirements (e.g., EPA pesticide application equipment calibration, OSHA safety inspections for operator-driven equipment, USDA/APHIS compliance checks for livestock handling equipment). attributes.name: jd_ops_center_category_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: John Deere Operations Center Category Code
attributes.description: Equipment category code as defined in John Deere Operations Center fleet telematics platform. Used for cross-system data reconciliation between the enterprise asset taxonomy and John Deere precision agriculture fleet management data feeds.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center API; ISO 15143-3 Telematics

attributes.name: oee_benchmark_target_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) Benchmark Target Percentage
attributes.description: Industry benchmark target for Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) expressed as a percentage (0–100) for assets in this category. Used as the KPI baseline for fleet performance monitoring in John Deere Operations Center and operational reporting dashboards. OEE = Availability × Performance × Quality.

attributes.name: operator_license_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether operating assets in this category requires a specific operator license, certification, or training qualification (e.g., CDL for transport vehicles, pesticide applicator license for sprayers, OSHA-mandated forklift certification for material handling equipment). Supports workforce compliance management in SAP SuccessFactors.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1928; EPA Pesticide Applicator Certification; DOT CDL Requirements; SAP SuccessFactors

attributes.name: opex_budget_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger (GL) account code in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO to which operational and maintenance expenditure for assets in this category is posted. Supports OPEX budget tracking, maintenance cost analysis, and EBITDA reporting by equipment category.
attributes.references: GAAP; IFRS; SAP S/4HANA FI-CO Module; SOX Financial Reporting Controls

attributes.name: pesticide_applicator_cert_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether operating assets in this category requires a valid EPA-certified pesticide applicator license (e.g., self-propelled sprayers, aerial application equipment). Supports IPM (Integrated Pest Management) compliance and EPA regulatory audit readiness.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 11 Pesticide Applicator Certification; USDA APHIS; FSMA

attributes.name: pm_interval_days
attributes.description: Calendar-day interval between scheduled preventive maintenance events for assets in this category, used when calendar-based (rather than usage-based) PM scheduling is applicable (e.g., annual inspections, seasonal service). Complements pm_interval_hours for dual-trigger PM strategies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; ISO 55000

attributes.name: pm_interval_hours
attributes.description: Standard operating hours interval between scheduled preventive maintenance (PM) events for assets in this category (e.g., 250 hours for tractor engine service). Used to auto-generate PM work orders in SAP S/4HANA PM/CMMS and John Deere Operations Center maintenance scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; ISO 55000; OEM Equipment Service Manuals

attributes.name: power_rating_hp
attributes.description: Typical or standard power rating in horsepower (HP) for assets in this category, representing the principal quantitative performance characteristic. Used for equipment matching (tractor-implement compatibility), fleet specification planning, and fuel consumption benchmarking.
attributes.references: ASABE S296 Agricultural Equipment Power Standards; SAE J1349

attributes.name: precision_ag_compatible
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets in this category support precision agriculture hardware integration, including RTK (Real-Time Kinematic) GPS receivers, VRA (Variable Rate Application) controllers, NDVI sensors, or FMIS (Farm Management Information System) data connectivity. Supports precision ag fleet planning.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software; Climate FieldView; John Deere Operations Center; ISO 11783 (ISOBUS)

attributes.name: salvage_value_pct
attributes.description: Estimated residual (salvage) value at end of useful life expressed as a percentage of original acquisition cost, used in depreciation base calculation for assets in this category. Supports CAPEX planning and asset disposal valuation in SAP S/4HANA FI-AA.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 16; GAAP ASC 360; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: sap_asset_class_code
attributes.description: Corresponding asset class code in SAP S/4HANA FI-AA (Fixed Asset Accounting) module that maps to this equipment category. Enables direct integration between the equipment taxonomy and SAP financial asset accounting for depreciation, CAPEX tracking, and balance sheet reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Module; IFRS IAS 16; GAAP ASC 360; SOX

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric display sort order for presenting asset categories in user interfaces, reports, and dropdown lists within the equipment domain. Allows business-defined ordering independent of alphabetical or ID-based sequencing.
attributes.references: Internal UI/UX Standards; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: standard_depreciation_life_years
attributes.description: Standard useful economic life in years assigned to all assets within this category for CAPEX depreciation scheduling and financial reporting. Used in SAP S/4HANA FI/CO asset accounting to default depreciation key and useful life at asset creation. Aligned with GAAP/IFRS IAS 16 useful life estimation.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment; GAAP ASC 360; SAP S/4HANA FI-AA

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this asset category record was last modified. Supports change tracking, taxonomy governance audit trails, and Silver Layer incremental data processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: ISO 55000; SOX Audit Trail Requirements; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed

attributes.name: vra_controller_compatible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Variable Rate Application (VRA) Controller Compatible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether assets in this category are compatible with VRA (Variable Rate Application) controllers for precision input management (seed, fertilizer, pesticide). Supports VRA prescription execution tracking in Trimble Ag Software and Climate FieldView.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software; Climate FieldView; ISO 11783 ISOBUS; EPA VRA Compliance

attributes.name: weight_class
attributes.description: Standardized weight class of assets in this category, used for transport logistics planning, road permit requirements, soil compaction risk assessment, and field access restrictions. Aligns with USDA and DOT weight classification standards for agricultural equipment.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Compaction Guidelines; DOT Federal Bridge Formula; ASABE

products.name: telematics_reading
products.description: High-frequency telemetry records streamed from John Deere Operations Center, Trimble, and other IoT-enabled agricultural equipment. Captures machine hours, engine RPM, fuel consumption rate, ground speed, PTO engagement, hydraulic pressure, GPS coordinates (RTK-corrected latitude/longitude), heading, NDVI sensor readings, implement depth/width, load weight, fault codes (DTC), operational status (field working/transport/idle/parked), geofence zone, RTK correction status, field boundary match flag, data source identifier, and timestamp. SSOT for all equipment telemetry including fleet position tracking — latest-reading queries provide current fleet position for dispatch dashboards, field coverage monitoring, theft detection, and operator hours-of-service compliance (replacing standalone fleet_position). Supports OEE calculation, predictive maintenance triggers, precision agriculture VRA audit trails, and fleet dispatch. One record per telemetry event per asset.

attributes.name: employee_id
