attributes.name: field_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agricultural field or land parcel where the equipment was operating at the time of the reading. Supports field coverage monitoring and VRA audit trails.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P.; John Deere Operations Center Field Mapping; Esri ArcGIS

attributes.name: input_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.input_product. Business justification: Real-time telematics captures application_rate_actual during spraying operations. Direct FK to input_product enables automated label compliance monitoring — comparing actual application rate against m
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: vra_prescription_id
attributes.description: Reference to the active Variable Rate Application (VRA) prescription being executed by the equipment at the time of the reading. Supports precision agriculture audit trails and agrochemical application compliance.
attributes.references: VRA (Variable Rate Application) Standard; Trimble Ag Software; GLOBALG.A.P.; EPA Pesticide Regulations

attributes.name: weather_observation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to weather.observation. Business justification: Precision agriculture analytics correlate real-time telematics readings (fuel consumption, engine load, ground speed) with concurrent weather observations to model weather impacts on equipment perform
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: application_rate_actual
attributes.description: Actual rate of material (seed, fertilizer, agrochemical) being applied by the implement at the time of the reading, in the unit defined by the active VRA prescription. Supports compliance verification against prescribed rates and MRL (Maximum Residue Limit) audit trails.
attributes.references: VRA (Variable Rate Application) Standard; EPA MRL Regulations; GLOBALG.A.P.; Trimble Ag Software

attributes.name: application_rate_target
attributes.description: Prescribed target rate of material application from the active VRA prescription at the time of the reading, in the same unit as actual_application_rate. Enables deviation analysis between prescribed and actual application for compliance and agronomic reporting.
attributes.references: VRA (Variable Rate Application) Standard; EPA MRL Regulations; GLOBALG.A.P.; Trimble Ag Software

attributes.name: application_rate_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the actual and target application rate fields (e.g., kg/ha for fertilizer, L/ha for liquid agrochemicals, seeds/ha for planting). Ensures correct interpretation of application rate values across different implement types.
attributes.references: VRA (Variable Rate Application) Standard; USDA; EPA; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: coolant_temp_c
attributes.description: Engine coolant temperature in degrees Celsius at the time of the reading. Elevated values trigger predictive maintenance alerts and can indicate impending engine failure.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center Telematics; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Identifies the originating system or IoT platform that streamed this telemetry record. EVENT_TYPE_OR_CHANNEL per EVENT_LOG role minimum. Supports multi-source fleet management and data lineage.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; Trimble Ag Software; Climate FieldView

attributes.name: dtc_code
attributes.description: Diagnostic Trouble Code (DTC) reported by the equipment's onboard diagnostics system at the time of the reading. Null when no fault is active. Triggers corrective maintenance work orders in SAP S/4HANA PM and supports predictive maintenance analytics.
attributes.references: SAE J1939 DTC Standard; John Deere Operations Center; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: dtc_severity
attributes.description: Severity classification of the active Diagnostic Trouble Code (DTC) at the time of the reading. 'Critical' faults require immediate equipment shutdown; 'warning' faults require scheduled maintenance; 'informational' faults are advisory only.
attributes.references: SAE J1939 DTC Standard; John Deere Operations Center; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: engine_hours
attributes.description: Cumulative engine operating hours recorded on the equipment's hour meter at the time of the reading. Primary trigger metric for preventive maintenance scheduling (PM) and asset lifecycle management per ISO 55000.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module; John Deere Operations Center

attributes.name: engine_load_pct
attributes.description: Engine load as a percentage of maximum rated capacity at the time of the reading. Supports OEE calculation, fuel consumption benchmarking, and predictive maintenance triggers.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center Telematics; ISO 22400 OEE

attributes.name: engine_rpm
attributes.description: Engine speed in revolutions per minute at the time of the reading. Used for fuel efficiency analysis, operator behavior monitoring, and predictive maintenance trigger evaluation.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center Telematics; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: field_boundary_match
attributes.description: Indicates whether the equipment's GPS position at the time of the reading falls within the registered boundary of the assigned field. False values indicate potential off-field operation, boundary drift, or GPS error.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center Field Mapping; Esri ArcGIS; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: fuel_consumption_rate_lph
attributes.description: Instantaneous fuel consumption rate in liters per hour at the time of the reading. Supports OPEX cost allocation, carbon footprint reporting, and fuel efficiency benchmarking across the fleet.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center Telematics; EPA Emissions Reporting; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: fuel_level_pct
attributes.description: Remaining fuel level in the equipment's tank expressed as a percentage of full capacity at the time of the reading. Supports dispatch planning, refueling logistics, and downtime prevention.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center Telematics; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: gps_altitude_m
attributes.description: Altitude of the equipment above mean sea level in meters at the time of the reading, as reported by the onboard GPS/RTK receiver. Supports terrain-aware precision agriculture analytics.
attributes.references: WGS84 Coordinate Reference System; John Deere Operations Center Telematics

attributes.name: ground_speed_kph
attributes.description: Actual ground speed of the equipment in kilometers per hour as measured by the GPS receiver at the time of the reading. Used for field coverage rate calculations, operator compliance, and OEE analysis.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center Telematics; ISO 22400 OEE

attributes.name: heading_degrees
attributes.description: Direction of travel of the equipment in degrees from true north (0–360) at the time of the reading. Supports field pass mapping, coverage analysis, and auto-steer validation.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center Telematics; Trimble Ag Software

attributes.name: hydraulic_pressure_kpa
attributes.description: Hydraulic system pressure in kilopascals at the time of the reading. Abnormal values indicate hydraulic system faults and trigger corrective maintenance work orders.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center Telematics; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: implement_depth_cm
attributes.description: Working depth of the attached implement (e.g., planter, tillage tool) in centimeters at the time of the reading. Supports agronomic compliance verification, VRA prescription audit trails, and soil management analytics.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center Telematics; Trimble Ag Software; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: implement_width_m
attributes.description: Working width of the attached implement in meters at the time of the reading. Used for field coverage area calculations and pass efficiency analysis.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center Telematics; Trimble Ag Software

attributes.name: ingested_timestamp
attributes.description: The UTC timestamp when this telemetry record was received and ingested into the lakehouse Silver layer from the source system (John Deere Operations Center, Trimble, or other IoT platform). Supports data latency monitoring and pipeline auditing.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer; John Deere Operations Center API

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: RTK-corrected WGS84 latitude coordinate of the equipment at the time of the reading, in decimal degrees. Supports fleet position tracking, field coverage monitoring, geofence evaluation, and theft detection.
attributes.references: WGS84 Coordinate Reference System; RTK (Real-Time Kinematic) Positioning Standard; Esri ArcGIS

attributes.name: load_weight_kg
attributes.description: Weight of the load carried by the equipment (e.g., grain in combine hopper, fertilizer in applicator) in kilograms at the time of the reading. Supports yield estimation, logistics planning, and axle load compliance.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center Telematics; USDA Yield Reporting; DOT Axle Load Regulations

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: RTK-corrected WGS84 longitude coordinate of the equipment at the time of the reading, in decimal degrees. Supports fleet position tracking, field coverage monitoring, geofence evaluation, and theft detection.
attributes.references: WGS84 Coordinate Reference System; RTK (Real-Time Kinematic) Positioning Standard; Esri ArcGIS

attributes.name: ndvi_reading
attributes.description: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index value captured by the onboard crop sensor at the time of the reading, ranging from -1.0 to 1.0. Supports variable rate application (VRA) decisions, crop health monitoring, and precision agriculture analytics.
attributes.references: NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) Standard; John Deere Operations Center; Trimble Ag Software; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the equipment at the time of the reading. Drives OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) calculation by classifying time into productive, transport, idle, and parked categories. EVENT_PAYLOAD_OR_VALUE per EVENT_LOG role minimum.
attributes.references: ISO 22400 OEE Standard; John Deere Operations Center; FMIS

attributes.name: pto_engaged
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Power Take-Off (PTO) shaft was engaged at the time of the reading. PTO engagement signals active implement operation (e.g., mower, spreader, pump) and is used for productive-time classification in OEE calculations.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center Telematics; ISO 22400 OEE; ASABE Standards

attributes.name: pto_rpm
attributes.description: Power Take-Off shaft speed in revolutions per minute at the time of the reading when PTO is engaged. Used to verify correct implement operating speed and diagnose PTO-related faults.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center Telematics; ASABE Standards

attributes.name: reading_quality_flag
attributes.description: Data quality classification for this telemetry record assigned during Silver layer ingestion. 'Valid' records are used in analytics; 'suspect' records require review; 'invalid' records are excluded from reporting. Supports data governance and AI/ML feature engineering.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Data Quality; GFSI Data Integrity Standards

attributes.name: reading_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise UTC timestamp when the telemetry event was recorded by the equipment's onboard controller. EVENT_TIMESTAMP per EVENT_LOG role minimum. Distinct from ingestion audit timestamps.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center Telematics API; ISO 8601

attributes.name: rtk_correction_status
attributes.description: Quality indicator for the GPS/RTK positional correction applied at the time of the reading. 'Fixed' indicates sub-inch accuracy; 'float' and 'dgps' indicate degraded precision. Critical for VRA prescription audit trails and auto-steer accuracy validation.
attributes.references: RTK (Real-Time Kinematic) Positioning Standard; NMEA 0183; Trimble Ag Software

attributes.name: signal_strength_dbm
attributes.description: Cellular or satellite communication signal strength in decibel-milliwatts (dBm) at the time of the reading. Supports data quality assessment, connectivity gap analysis, and telematics infrastructure planning.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center Telematics; IoT (Internet of Things) Connectivity Standards

attributes.name: transmission_delay_ms
attributes.description: Latency in milliseconds between the equipment recording the telemetry event and the data being received by the cloud platform. Supports data quality scoring and near-real-time fleet dashboard reliability assessment.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center Telematics; IoT (Internet of Things) Data Quality Standards

products.name: work_order
products.description: Corrective and preventive maintenance work orders for agricultural equipment managed through CMMS (e.g., SAP PM). Header captures work order number, order type (PM/CM/inspection), priority, asset reference, fault description, reported fault code, assigned technician, planned and actual start/end dates, labor hours, total maintenance cost (OPEX), work order status (open/in-progress/completed/cancelled), and sign-off details. Embedded parts consumption line items (replacing standalone parts_usage) capture part number, quantity used, unit cost, total cost, issue date, issuing warehouse/bin, and technician ID — SSOT for actual material consumption data supporting OPEX cost tracking, inventory replenishment triggers, and maintenance cost analysis by asset and crop enterprise. Core CMMS transactional record for all maintenance activities. Integrates with SAP MM goods issue and SAP CO cost allocation.

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the work order as assigned by the CMMS (SAP PM). Used for cross-system reference, technician communication, and audit trails. Maps to SAP PM Order Number (AUFNR).
attributes.references: SAP PM Module; ISO 55000

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the work order within the CMMS workflow. Drives operational dashboards, KPI reporting, and SLA compliance tracking. Maps to SAP PM system status (STAT). Values: open, in_progress, completed, cancelled, on_hold.
attributes.references: SAP PM Module; ISO 55000

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the maintenance work order by activity type: PM (Preventive Maintenance), CM (Corrective Maintenance), INSP (Inspection), CALIB (Calibration), OVERHAUL, or SAFETY. Drives scheduling logic, cost allocation, and OPEX reporting. Maps to SAP PM Order Type (AUART). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PM|CM|INSP|CALIB|OVERHAUL|SAFETY — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP PM Module; ISO 55000; OSHA Maintenance Standards

attributes.name: parts_line_count
attributes.description: Total number of spare parts or material consumption line items recorded against this work order. Provides a quick header-level indicator of parts complexity and supports inventory replenishment trigger logic without requiring line-level joins.
attributes.references: SAP MM Module; SAP PM Module

attributes.name: planned_end_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date on which maintenance work is planned to be completed. Used for downtime window management, equipment availability planning, and SLA target setting. Maps to SAP PM Scheduled Finish Date (GLTRP).
attributes.references: SAP PM Module; ISO 55000

attributes.name: planned_labor_hours
attributes.description: Estimated number of labor hours required to complete the maintenance work order, as planned by the maintenance scheduler. Used for workforce capacity planning and budget forecasting. Maps to SAP PM Planned Work (ARBEI).
attributes.references: SAP PM Module; ISO 55000

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date on which maintenance work is planned to commence, as set by the maintenance planner. Used for resource scheduling, parts pre-staging, and downtime planning. Maps to SAP PM Scheduled Start Date (GSTRP).
attributes.references: SAP PM Module; ISO 55000

attributes.name: priority_code
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking assigned to the work order indicating urgency and scheduling precedence. 1=Emergency/Critical, 2=High, 3=Medium, 4=Low/Routine. Drives resource allocation and response time SLAs. Maps to SAP PM Priority (PRIOK).
attributes.references: SAP PM Module; ISO 55000; OSHA 29 CFR 1910

attributes.name: reported_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the equipment fault or maintenance requirement was first reported by the operator or detected by telematics (John Deere Operations Center). Principal business event timestamp for the work order lifecycle. Maps to SAP PM Malfunction Start Date/Time (QMDAT/QMZEIT).
attributes.references: SAP PM Module; John Deere Operations Center; ISO 55000

attributes.name: safety_permit_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the safety permit (lock-out/tag-out, confined space, hot work) issued for this maintenance work order. Required for OSHA compliance documentation and safety audit trails.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.147; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.146

attributes.name: safety_permit_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a safety permit (e.g., lock-out/tag-out, confined space entry, chemical handling permit) is required before maintenance work can commence. Supports OSHA compliance and safety management workflows.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.147 (LOTO); OSHA 29 CFR 1910.146; EPA Safety Standards

attributes.name: sign_off_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the work order was formally signed off and closed by the authorizing supervisor. Marks the official end of the work order lifecycle and triggers cost settlement in SAP CO.
attributes.references: SAP PM Module; SAP CO Module; ISO 55000

attributes.name: signed_off_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the supervisor or maintenance manager who formally approved and closed the work order. Required for quality assurance, regulatory compliance, and audit trail purposes. Maps to SAP PM Completed By (ERNAM).
attributes.references: SAP PM Module; ISO 55000; OSHA Maintenance Records

attributes.name: total_maintenance_cost
attributes.description: Total OPEX cost of the work order encompassing labor, parts, and external service charges. SSOT for maintenance cost reporting by asset, cost center, and crop enterprise. Maps to SAP CO total actual costs settled to the maintenance order (TKOSTEN).
attributes.references: SAP CO Module; GAAP; IFRS IAS 16; ISO 55000; OPEX Reporting

products.name: maintenance_plan
products.description: Preventive maintenance (PM) schedules and plans for agricultural equipment assets. Header defines maintenance strategy (time-based, usage-based, condition-based), maintenance cycle (e.g., every 250 engine hours, annually), applicable asset categories, and compliance requirements (OSHA, EPA, local equivalents). Embedded task list line items (replacing standalone maintenance_item) specify individual maintenance tasks including task type (lubrication, calibration, filter replacement, inspection, adjustment), task description, standard labor hours, required skill level, safety precautions (REI/OSHA), required tools, required parts/materials with quantities, and completion status. SSOT for all PM task definitions and maintenance scheduling. Linked to CMMS maintenance plans. Drives automatic work order generation and ensures equipment readiness for planting and harvest seasons.
products.reference: SAP PM Maintenance Plan / CMMS Preventive Maintenance Schedule

attributes.name: maintenance_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the preventive maintenance (PM) plan record. Primary key for the maintenance_plan entity within the equipment domain SSOT.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; SAP PM Module

attributes.name: asset_category_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to equipment.asset_category. Business justification: maintenance_plan currently stores asset_category as a free-text STRING column, which is a denormalized reference to the asset_category lookup table. PM schedules in agricultural CMMS are defined at th
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific equipment asset this plan is assigned to, when the plan is asset-specific rather than category-wide. Links to the equipment asset master record in the CMMS/SAP PM module.
attributes.references: SAP PM Module; ISO 55000

attributes.name: climate_normal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to weather.climate_normal. Business justification: Seasonal maintenance plan intervals are calibrated against historical climate normals — average first frost dates drive winterization PM schedules, historical dust/humidity normals set filter replacem
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: climate_risk_indicator_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to weather.climate_risk_indicator. Business justification: Seasonal PM plans for agricultural equipment are adjusted based on climate risk indicators — drought conditions increase dust filter intervals, freeze risk drives winterization schedules. The maintena
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: haccp_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.haccp_plan. Business justification: HACCP plans mandate equipment maintenance as prerequisite programs (PRPs) under FSMA Preventive Controls. Linking maintenance plans to the governing HACCP plan enables auditors to verify PRP complianc
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.material_master. Business justification: MRO inventory planning: maintenance plans specify required materials (filters, lubricants, belts) that must be stocked. Linking maintenance_plan to material_master enables automated reorder triggering
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_obligation. Business justification: EPA and OSHA regulations mandate specific maintenance intervals for agricultural equipment (pesticide applicator calibration, CAFO equipment inspections). Linking maintenance_plan to compliance_obliga
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor_contract. Business justification: Preventive maintenance plans in agriculture are often governed by OEM dealer service contracts or extended warranty agreements. Linking maintenance_plan to vendor_contract enables contract-driven PM s
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP PM work center (maintenance shop, field service team, or external contractor) responsible for executing this maintenance plan. Drives labor cost allocation and scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP PM Module; ISO 55000

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the maintenance manager or engineer who formally approved this maintenance plan for use. Required for regulatory compliance documentation under OSHA and EPA frameworks.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910; ISO 55000; SAP PM Module

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which this maintenance plan was formally approved by the responsible maintenance manager or engineer. Establishes the official activation baseline for compliance and audit purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 55000; OSHA 29 CFR 1910; SAP PM Module

attributes.name: auto_wo_generation
attributes.description: Indicates whether this maintenance plan is configured to automatically generate work orders in SAP PM when the maintenance cycle due date or usage threshold is reached. When False, work orders must be created manually.
attributes.references: SAP PM Module; ISO 55000

attributes.name: cmms_plan_reference
attributes.description: External reference identifier linking this plan to the corresponding maintenance plan record in the CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System), such as SAP PM maintenance plan number or John Deere Operations Center service plan ID. Enables cross-system traceability.
attributes.references: SAP PM Module; John Deere Operations Center; ISO 55000

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP CO cost center code to which OPEX maintenance costs for this plan are allocated. Enables financial reporting of maintenance expenditure by farm unit, equipment type, or operational division.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module; GAAP; IFRS IAS 16

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this maintenance plan record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 55000; SAP PM Module; SOX

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary values in this plan (e.g., USD, EUR, BRL). Supports multi-currency operations for international agricultural enterprises.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS; GAAP

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this maintenance plan becomes active and eligible to generate work orders. Aligns with asset commissioning date or seasonal equipment activation.
attributes.references: SAP PM Module; ISO 55000

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date on which this maintenance plan expires or is decommissioned. Null indicates an open-ended plan with no scheduled end. Used for asset lifecycle management and plan version control.
attributes.references: SAP PM Module; ISO 55000

attributes.name: epa_compliance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this maintenance plan includes tasks subject to EPA regulatory requirements (e.g., sprayer calibration for pesticide application equipment, emissions checks, fluid disposal). Triggers environmental compliance documentation.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR; EPA FIFRA; Environmental Protection Agency

attributes.name: estimated_labor_cost
attributes.description: Estimated total labor cost to execute one cycle of this maintenance plan, in the base currency. Calculated from estimated_labor_hours and applicable labor rates. Supports OPEX cost allocation.
attributes.references: SAP CO Module; SAP SuccessFactors; GAAP; IFRS IAS 16

attributes.name: estimated_labor_hours
attributes.description: Total standard labor hours required to complete all tasks in this maintenance plan. Aggregated from individual task labor hour estimates. Used for workforce planning and OPEX budgeting.
attributes.references: SAP PM Module; ISO 55000

attributes.name: last_completed_date
attributes.description: Date the most recent maintenance cycle was completed and signed off. Used to calculate next_due_date and track compliance with PM schedules.
attributes.references: SAP PM Module; ISO 55000; OSHA 29 CFR 1910

attributes.name: last_completed_hours
attributes.description: Engine/operating hour meter reading at the time the most recent maintenance cycle was completed. Sourced from John Deere Operations Center telematics. Used for usage-based interval tracking.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; SAP PM Module

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days before the maintenance due date that a work order should be automatically generated, allowing time for parts procurement and labor scheduling. Supports seasonal readiness for planting and harvest windows.
attributes.references: SAP PM Module; ISO 55000

attributes.name: maintenance_cycle_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the maintenance cycle interval. 'hours' refers to engine/operating hours from John Deere Operations Center telematics; 'acres'/'hectares' refer to field coverage metrics; calendar units support time-based strategies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hours|days|weeks|months|years|acres|hectares|kilometers — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP PM Module; John Deere Operations Center; ISO 55000

attributes.name: maintenance_cycle_value
attributes.description: Numeric interval defining how frequently the maintenance plan recurs. Interpreted in conjunction with maintenance_cycle_unit (e.g., 250 engine hours, 12 months, 500 acres). Sourced from OEM specifications and SAP PM maintenance strategy.
attributes.references: SAP PM Module; OEM Service Manuals; ISO 55000

attributes.name: next_due_date
attributes.description: Calculated date when the next maintenance cycle is due based on last completion and the maintenance cycle interval. Drives scheduling dashboards and work order auto-generation in SAP PM.
attributes.references: SAP PM Module; ISO 55000

attributes.name: next_due_hours
attributes.description: Engine/operating hour threshold at which the next maintenance cycle is due. Calculated as last_completed_hours plus the usage-based cycle interval. Sourced from John Deere Operations Center telematics data.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; SAP PM Module; ISO 55000

attributes.name: oem_service_bulletin
attributes.description: Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) service bulletin or technical service document number that this maintenance plan is based on or references (e.g., John Deere Technical Manual TM-XXXX). Ensures alignment with manufacturer specifications.
attributes.references: OEM Technical Manuals; ISO 55000

attributes.name: osha_compliance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this maintenance plan includes tasks subject to OSHA regulatory requirements (e.g., lockout/tagout procedures, confined space entry, hazardous energy control). Triggers mandatory safety documentation on generated work orders.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.147 (Lockout/Tagout); OSHA 29 CFR 1910.146

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the maintenance plan (e.g., 'Annual Combine Harvester PM', '250-Hour Tractor Engine Service'). Used in operator dashboards and scheduling reports.
attributes.references: SAP PM Module; ISO 55000

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the maintenance plan, used in CMMS work order generation, SAP PM module references, and cross-system communication. Follows the PM-XXXXXX naming convention.
attributes.references: SAP PM Module; ISO 55000

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the maintenance plan. 'draft' indicates plan is under development; 'active' means plan is in use and generating work orders; 'suspended' means temporarily paused; 'completed' means all cycles fulfilled; 'cancelled' means plan is no longer applicable.
attributes.references: SAP PM Module; ISO 55000

attributes.name: plan_version
attributes.description: Version number of the maintenance plan document (e.g., '1.0', '2.3'). Incremented when plan tasks, intervals, or compliance requirements are revised. Supports audit trail and change management per ISO 55000.
attributes.references: ISO 55000; SAP PM Module

attributes.name: precision_ag_hardware
attributes.description: Indicates whether this maintenance plan includes calibration or servicing tasks for precision agriculture hardware such as GPS/RTK receivers, VRA controllers, NDVI sensors, or auto-steer systems. Triggers specialized calibration task workflows.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; Trimble Ag Software; SAP PM Module

attributes.name: rei_hours
attributes.description: Restricted Entry Interval in hours applicable to maintenance tasks performed on sprayer or pesticide application equipment. Specifies the minimum time after pesticide application before maintenance personnel may safely enter treated areas. Mandated by EPA/FIFRA.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA; EPA 40 CFR Part 170 (Worker Protection Standard); APHIS

attributes.name: required_skill_level
attributes.description: Minimum skill level required to execute the maintenance plan tasks. 'operator' indicates basic tasks performable by equipment operators; 'certified_mechanic' requires OEM-certified technicians. Drives workforce assignment in SAP SuccessFactors.
attributes.references: SAP PM Module; SAP SuccessFactors; OSHA 29 CFR 1910

attributes.name: required_tools
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or description of specialized tools and equipment required to execute the maintenance plan tasks (e.g., torque wrench, hydraulic press, RTK calibration kit, diagnostic scanner). Supports tool reservation and kitting.
attributes.references: SAP PM Module; OEM Service Manuals

attributes.name: safety_precautions
attributes.description: Free-text description of mandatory safety precautions required before and during execution of maintenance tasks in this plan (e.g., lockout/tagout procedures, PPE requirements, confined space protocols, chemical handling). Referenced in generated work orders.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910; EPA Worker Protection Standard; ISO 45001

attributes.name: season_type
attributes.description: Agricultural season associated with this maintenance plan when seasonal_flag is True. Drives scheduling alignment with the crop calendar to ensure equipment is ready for critical operational windows.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; SAP PM Module; FMIS

attributes.name: seasonal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this maintenance plan is tied to a specific agricultural season (e.g., pre-planting inspection, post-harvest winterization). When True, scheduling is aligned with the crop calendar to ensure equipment readiness.
attributes.references: SAP PM Module; Granular Farm Management; ISO 55000

attributes.name: strategy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the maintenance strategy driving this plan. 'time_based' triggers on calendar intervals (e.g., annually); 'usage_based' triggers on engine hours or acreage; 'condition_based' triggers on sensor thresholds (e.g., oil pressure); 'predictive' uses IoT/telematics analytics from John Deere Operations Center.
attributes.references: ISO 55000; SAP PM Module; OSHA 29 CFR 1910

attributes.name: task_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual maintenance task line items defined within this plan (e.g., lubrication, filter replacement, calibration, inspection). Provides a quick summary of plan complexity for scheduling and labor estimation.
attributes.references: SAP PM Module; ISO 55000

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this maintenance plan record. Used for change tracking, data synchronization, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO 55000; SAP PM Module; SOX

products.name: fault
products.description: Record of equipment faults, breakdowns, and diagnostic trouble codes (DTC) detected via telematics or reported by operators. Captures fault code, fault description, severity level, detection source (telematics/operator/inspection), asset affected, field/location at time of fault, downtime start/end, estimated production impact (acres lost, yield impact), root cause classification, and corrective action taken. Feeds into OEE availability calculations and reliability-centered maintenance (RCM) analysis.
products.reference: SAP PM Notification / John Deere Operations Center Fault Codes

attributes.name: fault_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each equipment fault record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the equipment_fault data product. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — a discrete business event (fault occurrence) with its own lifecycle from detection through resolution.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agricultural equipment asset (tractor, combine, planter, sprayer, irrigation system, etc.) that experienced the fault. Links to the equipment asset master record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the equipment operator or field technician who reported the fault, when detection source is operator-reported. Links to the workforce/employee master. Supports PARTY_REFERENCE requirement for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors; OSHA Incident Reporting

attributes.name: equipment_field_operation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to equipment.field_operation. Business justification: Equipment faults occur during specific field operations (e.g., a combine breakdown during harvesting, a sprayer fault during application). equipment_fault has field_id but no FK to the specific field_
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_event. Business justification: Equipment faults causing reportable environmental incidents (spills, emissions exceedances, pesticide drift events) generate compliance events requiring regulatory notification. Linking equipment_faul
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: field_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agricultural field or land parcel where the equipment was operating at the time of fault detection. Supports geospatial analysis and field-level OEE impact assessment via Esri ArcGIS.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS; John Deere Operations Center; ISO 55000

attributes.name: nonconformance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.nonconformance. Business justification: Equipment faults (sprayer malfunction, harvester contamination, cold storage failure) directly cause product nonconformances including MRL exceedances and food safety incidents. This traceability link

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to weather.precipitation_event. attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.description: Identifier of the onboard telematics unit (John Deere Operations Center MTG or equivalent) that transmitted the fault signal. Used for data lineage tracing from telematics source to fault record and for diagnosing telematics data quality issues.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to equipment.telematics_reading. Linking equipment_fault to violation_record enables root cau
