attributes.description: Foreign key linking to weather.observation. Business justification: Root cause analysis for field equipment faults requires correlating fault detection with concurrent weather conditions (extreme cold causing hydraulic failure, high humidity causing electrical faults)
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP PM corrective maintenance work order created in response to this fault. Enables traceability from fault detection through corrective action completion.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: acres_lost
attributes.description: Estimated number of acres that could not be worked due to equipment downtime from this fault. Quantifies the production impact in the primary agricultural unit of measure. Used for OPEX impact analysis, crop planning adjustments, and insurance claims. Expressed in acres (US standard).
attributes.references: USDA Farm Production Standards; Granular Farm Management; ISO 55000

attributes.name: actual_repair_cost_usd
attributes.description: Actual total cost in US dollars incurred to repair the fault, as confirmed upon SAP PM work order settlement. Includes labor hours, spare parts consumed, and external contractor charges. Used for OPEX reporting, cost center allocation, and maintenance budget variance analysis per GAAP/IFRS.
attributes.references: GAAP; IFRS IAS 16; SAP S/4HANA CO/PM Module; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: corrective_action_taken
attributes.description: Description of the corrective maintenance action performed to resolve the fault, as recorded in the SAP PM work order completion. Includes parts replaced, adjustments made, software updates applied, or temporary workarounds implemented. Essential for maintenance history and warranty claims.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; ISO 55000 Asset Management; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP CO cost center code to which the repair costs for this fault are allocated. Enables OPEX tracking by farm unit, operational division, or geographic region. Supports financial reporting under GAAP/IFRS and SOX internal controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; GAAP; IFRS; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the fault record was first created in the source system (SAP PM notification or John Deere Operations Center alert). Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for data lineage and audit trail purposes in the Databricks silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 55000; SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: detection_source
attributes.description: Method by which the fault was first detected. Telematics = automatically detected via John Deere Operations Center or onboard ECU; Operator_Report = reported by equipment operator; Inspection = identified during scheduled preventive maintenance inspection; Sensor_Alert = triggered by IoT sensor threshold breach; Third_Party = reported by external service provider.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; SAP S/4HANA PM; IoT Framework

attributes.name: detection_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the fault was first detected, either by telematics system or reported by the operator. This is the principal real-world business event timestamp (BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP). Used as the start reference for downtime duration calculations and OEE availability metrics.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; SAP S/4HANA PM; John Deere Operations Center

attributes.name: downtime_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of equipment downtime in minutes, calculated from downtime_start_timestamp to downtime_end_timestamp. Stored as a business field (not a real-time derived metric) once the fault is closed. Core input for OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) availability calculations and reliability-centered maintenance (RCM) analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 22400 OEE Standard; USDA Farm Equipment Productivity Standards

attributes.name: downtime_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the equipment was returned to operational service following corrective action. Null if the fault is still open or equipment has not yet been restored. Used with downtime_start_timestamp to calculate total downtime duration for OEE availability metrics.
attributes.references: ISO 22400 OEE Standard; SAP S/4HANA PM; RCM Methodology

attributes.name: downtime_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the equipment became operationally unavailable due to the fault. May differ from detection_timestamp if the equipment continued limited operation after fault detection. Used directly in OEE availability calculations and production impact assessments.
attributes.references: ISO 22400 OEE Standard; SAP S/4HANA PM; RCM Methodology

attributes.name: dtc_code
attributes.description: Standardized Diagnostic Trouble Code (DTC) as transmitted by the equipment's onboard telematics system (John Deere Operations Center, SAE J1939 protocol). Identifies the specific electronic control unit (ECU) fault condition. Used for automated fault classification and RCM analysis.
attributes.references: SAE J1939 Standard; John Deere Operations Center; ISO 11783 (ISOBUS)

attributes.name: engine_hours_at_fault
attributes.description: Total cumulative engine hours recorded on the equipment at the time the fault occurred, as reported by the telematics system. Critical for condition-based maintenance (CBM) analysis, warranty validation, and mean time between failures (MTBF) calculations.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; SAP S/4HANA PM; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: equipment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the agricultural equipment type that experienced the fault. Enables fault trend analysis by equipment category and supports fleet-level OEE benchmarking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tractor|combine|planter|sprayer|irrigation_system|harvester|tillage|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; SAP S/4HANA PM Equipment Category; ISO 55000

attributes.name: estimated_repair_cost_usd
attributes.description: Estimated total cost in US dollars to repair the fault, including labor, parts, and external service charges. Populated at fault creation for budget planning; updated with actuals upon work order completion. Supports OPEX cost allocation and maintenance budget management per GAAP/IFRS financial reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP; IFRS IAS 16 Property Plant and Equipment; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: fault_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the fault type used for reliability-centered maintenance (RCM) analysis and spare parts planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mechanical|electrical|hydraulic|software|structural|operator_error|unknown — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 14224 Reliability Data; SAP S/4HANA PM; RCM Methodology

attributes.name: fault_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the equipment fault, breakdown, or abnormal condition. May be auto-populated from DTC lookup table or manually entered by the operator/technician. Provides context for maintenance planning and root cause analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; John Deere Operations Center

attributes.name: fault_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the fault record, used in maintenance work orders, operator reports, and SAP PM notifications. Format: EF-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}. Serves as the human-readable reference across SAP S/4HANA PM, John Deere Operations Center, and field communications.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: fault_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fault record from initial detection through resolution and closure. Drives workflow routing in SAP PM and maintenance scheduling. Open = detected, not yet actioned; In_Progress = corrective action underway; Resolved = fix applied; Closed = verified and closed; Recurring = fault has reoccurred after prior resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: gps_latitude
attributes.description: GPS latitude coordinate (decimal degrees, WGS84) of the equipment's location at the time of fault detection, as recorded by the onboard GPS/RTK receiver. Enables geospatial fault mapping in Esri ArcGIS and field-level downtime analysis.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center GPS; Esri ArcGIS; RTK Positioning Standard

attributes.name: gps_longitude
attributes.description: GPS longitude coordinate (decimal degrees, WGS84) of the equipment's location at the time of fault detection, as recorded by the onboard GPS/RTK receiver. Used with gps_latitude for geospatial fault mapping and field-level impact analysis.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center GPS; Esri ArcGIS; RTK Positioning Standard

attributes.name: is_safety_critical
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fault poses a safety risk to the equipment operator or bystanders. Safety-critical faults trigger mandatory OSHA incident reporting workflows and immediate equipment lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures. True = safety risk present; False = no immediate safety concern.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1928 (Agricultural Operations); ISO 55000; SAP S/4HANA PM Safety

attributes.name: is_warranty_claim
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fault has been submitted or is eligible for a manufacturer warranty claim. True = warranty claim initiated or applicable; False = out-of-warranty or not eligible. Supports CAPEX/OPEX cost recovery tracking and vendor performance management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Warranty Management; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the fault record in the source system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED field for change tracking, incremental data pipeline processing, and audit trail compliance in the Databricks silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 55000; SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: maintenance_team
attributes.description: Name or code of the maintenance team or work center responsible for resolving this fault, as assigned in SAP PM. Examples: internal_fleet_team, dealer_service, oem_field_technician. Supports workload balancing and maintenance team performance KPI reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Work Center; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: odometer_km_at_fault
attributes.description: Total cumulative distance in kilometers recorded on the equipment odometer at the time of fault, as reported by telematics. Applicable to mobile equipment (tractors, combines, sprayers). Used alongside engine hours for condition-based maintenance scheduling and warranty claims.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; SAP S/4HANA PM; ISO 55000

attributes.name: recurrence_count
attributes.description: Number of times this same fault (same DTC code or fault category on the same asset) has recurred within the current operating season. A value greater than 1 indicates a recurring fault pattern requiring escalated RCM investigation. Supports chronic failure identification and maintenance strategy optimization.
attributes.references: ISO 14224 Reliability Data; RCM Methodology; SAP S/4HANA PM

attributes.name: resolution_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fault was confirmed as resolved and the equipment returned to full operational service. Distinct from downtime_end_timestamp (which marks when equipment restarted) — resolution_timestamp marks formal closure confirmation in SAP PM. Used for mean time to repair (MTTR) calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; ISO 55000; ISO 14224 MTTR

attributes.name: root_cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized root cause classification code assigned after fault investigation, aligned with SAP PM cause catalog and ISO 14224 failure taxonomy. Examples: wear_and_tear, improper_maintenance, manufacturing_defect, operator_misuse, environmental_damage, age_related_failure. Used for RCM analysis and preventive maintenance optimization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: wear_and_tear|improper_maintenance|manufacturing_defect|operator_misuse|environmental_damage|age_related_failure|unknown — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 14224 Reliability Data; SAP S/4HANA PM Cause Catalog; RCM Methodology

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the identified root cause of the fault following investigation. Complements root_cause_code with detailed findings from the technician or maintenance engineer. Supports knowledge base development and recurring fault prevention.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; ISO 14224; RCM Methodology

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Severity classification of the fault indicating operational impact and urgency of corrective action. Critical = immediate equipment stoppage; High = significant performance degradation; Medium = reduced efficiency; Low = minor issue, can continue operating. Drives maintenance prioritization and OEE availability calculations.
attributes.references: ISO 14224 Reliability Data; SAP S/4HANA PM Priority; RCM Methodology

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this fault record originated. SAP_PM = SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance notification; JD_OPS_CENTER = John Deere Operations Center telematics alert; TRIMBLE = Trimble Ag Software field report; MANUAL = manually entered; CLIMATE_FIELDVIEW = Climate FieldView event. Supports data lineage and silver layer reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM; John Deere Operations Center; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage

attributes.name: yield_impact_bu
attributes.description: Estimated yield loss in bushels (BU) attributable to the equipment downtime caused by this fault. Calculated based on acres lost and expected yield per acre (YPM). Supports crop loss reporting, insurance claims, and financial impact assessment. BU (Bushel) is the standard grain yield unit per USDA WASDE reporting.
attributes.references: USDA WASDE Reporting; Granular Farm Management; FSMA Traceability

products.name: parts_inventory
products.description: Inventory master for spare parts, consumables, and replacement components held for agricultural equipment maintenance. Captures part number (material number), part description, OEM part number, compatible asset models/categories, unit of measure, current stock quantity, reorder point, reorder quantity, storage location (bin/warehouse), unit cost, total stock value, lead time from supplier, and criticality classification (critical/non-critical). Supports MRO (Maintenance, Repair, and Operations) inventory management, prevents equipment downtime due to parts stockouts during planting and harvest seasons, and integrates with procurement for automated replenishment.
products.reference: SAP MM Material Master (MRO) / Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: parts_inventory_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each spare part or consumable record in the MRO (Maintenance, Repair, and Operations) inventory master. Primary key for the parts_inventory data product.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.facility. Business justification: Parts inventory is physically stocked at specific facilities (maintenance shops co-located at grain elevators or processing plants). Linking parts_inventory to supply.facility enables inventory visibi
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Parts inventory valuation is posted to GL accounts (spare parts inventory asset account on receipt; maintenance expense on consumption). Agriculture operations require this for inventory balance sheet
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary vendor/supplier from whom this part is procured. Links to the supplier master for automated purchase requisition routing and supplier performance tracking in SAP MM procurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing Module; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: ABC analysis classification of the part based on annual consumption value: A = high-value/high-priority (top 80% of spend), B = medium-value (next 15%), C = low-value (bottom 5%). Drives differentiated inventory control policies, cycle count frequencies, and safety stock levels in SAP MM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM ABC Analysis; ISO 55000 Asset Management; GAAP ASC 330

attributes.name: annual_consumption_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of this part consumed in the trailing 12-month period, expressed in the base unit of measure. Used as the primary input for reorder point and safety stock calculations, and for identifying slow-moving inventory candidates for write-down.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Consumption Statistics; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: asset_class_code
attributes.description: SAP AM (Asset Management) asset class code indicating whether this part is capitalized as a CAPEX (Capital Expenditure) item or expensed as OPEX (Operational Expenditure). Drives accounting treatment and depreciation scheduling for high-value replacement components.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Module; GAAP ASC 360; IFRS IAS 16; SOX

attributes.name: bin_location
attributes.description: Specific bin, shelf, or rack location within the storage facility where this part is physically located (e.g., 'A-12-03' = Aisle A, Rack 12, Shelf 3). Managed by Manhattan Associates WMS for precise pick-and-put-away operations.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA WM Module

attributes.name: compatible_asset_models
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of specific equipment model numbers or model families this part is compatible with (e.g., 'John Deere 8R 410, John Deere 8R 370, Case IH Magnum 380'). Enables technicians to quickly identify applicable parts during field maintenance.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP CO (Controlling) cost center code to which the cost of this part is allocated when issued against a maintenance work order. Enables OPEX (Operational Expenditure) tracking by farm, equipment fleet, or business unit for financial reporting and budgeting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; GAAP; IFRS IAS 2; SOX Financial Reporting Controls

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this parts inventory master record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking per SOX internal controls.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; SAP S/4HANA MM Audit Log; ISO 55000

attributes.name: criticality_classification
attributes.description: Operational criticality rating of the part: critical (stockout causes immediate equipment downtime during planting or harvest), non_critical (equipment can operate temporarily without), or safety_critical (required for operator safety per OSHA standards). Drives safety stock levels and emergency procurement protocols.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; OSHA 29 CFR 1928 (Agricultural Operations); SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the unit cost and total stock value are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, BRL). Supports multi-currency operations for global agricultural enterprises.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS IAS 2 Inventories; GAAP ASC 330

attributes.name: equipment_category
attributes.description: The primary agricultural equipment category this part is compatible with (e.g., tractor, combine, planter, sprayer, irrigation system). Supports parts lookup during maintenance planning and work order creation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: tractor|combine|planter|sprayer|irrigation|tillage|harvester|grain_cart|general — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; SAP S/4HANA PM Module; ISO 55000

attributes.name: hazardous_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this part or consumable is classified as a hazardous material requiring special storage, handling, or disposal procedures (e.g., hydraulic fluids, battery acid, pesticide concentrates). When True, triggers compliance with EPA and OSHA hazardous materials regulations and requires an associated Safety Data Sheet (SDS).
attributes.references: EPA RCRA Hazardous Waste Regulations; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 Hazard Communication; SDS (Safety Data Sheet) requirement

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the part record in the inventory master: active (stocked and available), inactive (temporarily not stocked), obsolete (superseded by a newer part number), discontinued (no longer available from OEM), or on_order (replenishment in progress). Governs whether the part can be issued against work orders.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: last_issued_date
attributes.description: Date on which this part was most recently issued from inventory to a maintenance work order or field technician. Used to identify slow-moving or obsolete inventory and support inventory rationalization decisions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Issue; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: last_physical_count_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical inventory count or cycle count for this part. Used to assess inventory accuracy, identify shrinkage, and schedule next count per the annual physical inventory plan. Aligns with SAP MM inventory management cycle count functionality.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Inventory Management; GAAP ASC 330; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: last_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent goods receipt (GRN) for this part from a supplier. Supports inventory freshness analysis, supplier delivery performance tracking, and shelf-life management for perishable consumables.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Receipt; GRN (Goods Receipt Note) process

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard procurement lead time in calendar days from purchase order (PO) placement to goods receipt (GRN) at the warehouse. Critical input for reorder point calculation to ensure parts availability during planting and harvest seasons.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA Material Management (MM) module material number uniquely identifying this spare part or consumable within the enterprise ERP system. Serves as the primary cross-system integration key for procurement, inventory, and maintenance workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: maximum_stock_quantity
attributes.description: The upper inventory limit for this part, beyond which overstocking is flagged. Used in SAP MM min/max replenishment planning to prevent excess capital tied up in slow-moving MRO (Maintenance, Repair, and Operations) inventory.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: oem_part_number
attributes.description: The original equipment manufacturer's (OEM) part number as published in the equipment service manual or parts catalog. Used for cross-referencing with supplier catalogs, warranty claims, and ordering from authorized dealers (e.g., John Deere, CNH Industrial, AGCO).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: part_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the spare part by functional category. Drives inventory segmentation, procurement routing, and storage requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mechanical|electrical|hydraulic|pneumatic|consumable|lubricant|filter|wear_part|structural|electronic — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: part_description
attributes.description: Detailed technical description of the spare part including specifications, dimensions, material composition, and application context. Supports accurate identification during procurement and maintenance activities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: part_name
attributes.description: Human-readable short name or title of the spare part or consumable (e.g., 'Air Filter Element', 'Hydraulic Pump Seal Kit', 'Combine Header Drive Belt'). Used for display in work orders, purchase requisitions, and inventory reports.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: part_type
attributes.description: Distinguishes the nature of the inventory item: spare_part (replacement component), consumable (single-use item such as oil or filter), tool (maintenance tooling), assembly (multi-component unit), or sub_assembly (partial assembly). Drives MRO (Maintenance, Repair, and Operations) inventory policy and cost allocation between CAPEX and OPEX.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP organizational unit (plant code) representing the farm site, maintenance facility, or distribution center where this part inventory record is maintained. Enables multi-plant inventory management across geographically distributed agricultural operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Organizational Structure; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: The minimum stock quantity threshold at which a replenishment purchase requisition is automatically triggered in SAP MM MRP (Material Requirements Planning). Calculated based on average daily consumption during peak seasons (planting/harvest) and supplier lead time to prevent equipment downtime.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: reorder_quantity
attributes.description: The standard replenishment order quantity triggered when stock falls to or below the reorder point. Optimized to balance procurement costs, storage capacity, and supplier minimum order quantities (MOQ). Drives automated purchase requisition creation in SAP MM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Buffer stock quantity maintained above the reorder point to absorb demand variability and supply disruptions during critical agricultural seasons (planting, harvest). Particularly important for critical-classified parts where stockout causes immediate equipment downtime.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: sds_document_number
attributes.description: Reference number for the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) associated with this hazardous part or consumable. Required by OSHA Hazard Communication Standard (HazCom) for all hazardous chemicals stored in the workplace. Null for non-hazardous parts.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 Hazard Communication Standard; EPA RCRA

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Maximum storage duration in days before the part or consumable degrades or expires (applicable to lubricants, chemicals, rubber seals, and other perishable MRO items). Null for non-perishable parts. Supports FEFO (First Expired First Out) inventory management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Management; EPA regulations for agricultural chemicals

attributes.name: stock_quantity
attributes.description: Current on-hand stock quantity of the part expressed in the base unit of measure (UOM). Represents unrestricted-use stock available for maintenance work orders. Updated in real time via goods receipts (GRN) and goods issues from SAP MM or Manhattan Associates WMS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: SAP MM storage location code identifying the warehouse or farm facility where this part is physically stored (e.g., 'WH01' = Central Parts Warehouse, 'FRM-NORTH' = North Farm Shop). Supports multi-site inventory management across farm operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: supplier_part_number
attributes.description: The supplier's own catalog or part number for this item, as used in purchase orders (PO) and goods receipt notes (GRN). Enables accurate ordering and receiving reconciliation with supplier invoices and packing lists.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing Module; GRN (Goods Receipt Note) process

attributes.name: total_stock_value
attributes.description: Total monetary value of current on-hand stock, calculated as stock_quantity multiplied by unit_cost. Represents the balance sheet carrying value of MRO (Maintenance, Repair, and Operations) inventory for financial reporting under GAAP/IFRS. Refreshed upon each inventory transaction.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 330 Inventory; IFRS IAS 2 Inventories; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module

attributes.name: unit_cost
attributes.description: Standard or moving average cost per unit of measure for this part, expressed in the local currency. Used for inventory valuation, OPEX/CAPEX cost allocation to maintenance work orders, and total stock value calculation. Sourced from SAP MM material master valuation data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/CO Module; GAAP ASC 330 Inventory; IFRS IAS 2 Inventories

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The base unit of measure (UOM) in which the part is stocked and transacted (e.g., EA = each, KG = kilogram, L = liter, M = meter, SET = set, BOX = box). Aligns with SAP MM base UOM configuration and drives quantity calculations for reorder and valuation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|KG|L|M|SET|BOX|ROLL|PAIR|GAL — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; ISO 80000-1 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this parts inventory master record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for incremental data pipeline processing (delta loads) and change audit trail in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; SAP S/4HANA MM Audit Log; ISO 55000

attributes.name: valuation_method
attributes.description: The cost accounting method used to value this part's inventory: standard_cost (fixed standard price), moving_average (weighted average updated on each receipt), fifo (first-in first-out), or lifo (last-in first-out). Configured in SAP MM material master and governs financial reporting treatment.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 330 Inventory; IFRS IAS 2 Inventories; SAP S/4HANA MM/FI Module

attributes.name: warranty_period_months
attributes.description: OEM or supplier warranty duration in months from the date of installation or purchase. Supports warranty claim tracking and cost recovery from suppliers for premature part failures. Null if no warranty applies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; ISO 55000 Asset Management

products.name: oee_record
products.description: Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) measurement records calculated per asset per operational shift or day. Captures availability rate (planned vs. actual uptime), performance rate (actual vs. theoretical throughput), quality rate (acceptable output vs. total output), composite OEE percentage, planned production time, unplanned downtime minutes, planned downtime minutes, total acres covered, and benchmark OEE target from asset category. Supports fleet performance management, CAPEX justification for equipment replacement, and operational efficiency KPI reporting aligned with ISO 55000.
products.reference: ISO 22400 OEE / John Deere Operations Center Machine Utilization

attributes.name: oee_record_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each OEE measurement record. Primary key for the oee_record data product in the equipment domain Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: asset_assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to equipment.asset_assignment. Business justification: OEE records measure equipment effectiveness per asset per shift, which directly corresponds to an asset_assignment period (equipment assigned to a field/operator/cost center). Linking oee_record to as
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agricultural equipment asset (tractor, combine, planter, sprayer, irrigation system, etc.) for which this OEE record is calculated. Links to the equipment asset master.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module; John Deere Operations Center

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: Agriculture OEE benchmarking is performed by commodity type — combine OEE for corn vs. soybeans differs by crop characteristics. Equipment performance reports segmented by commodity are standard in pr
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the equipment operator (workforce member) responsible for operating the asset during this OEE measurement period. Supports operator performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.facility. Business justification: OEE is measured for equipment operating at supply facilities (grain dryers, conveyors, elevators). Facility-level OEE reporting is a standard KPI in post-harvest operations. This link enables throughp
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: field_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agricultural field or land parcel where the equipment was operating during this OEE measurement period. Enables spatial analysis of equipment performance by field zone using Esri ArcGIS and John Deere Operations Center field mapping.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; Esri ArcGIS; Trimble Ag Software; USDA Farm Service Agency

attributes.name: growing_season_id
attributes.description: Reference to the growing season or crop year during which this OEE record was captured. Enables seasonal fleet performance trending and year-over-year OEE benchmarking aligned with crop planning cycles.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; SAP S/4HANA PP Module; USDA

attributes.name: sales_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.contract. Business justification: OEE records for harvest equipment measure actual throughput against contracted delivery volumes. Contract performance reporting uses OEE availability and throughput data to validate whether equipment
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: shift_id
attributes.description: Reference to the operational shift or work schedule period during which this OEE record was captured. Supports shift-level fleet performance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; John Deere Operations Center

attributes.name: weather_observation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to weather.observation. Business justification: OEE variance analysis for agricultural machinery requires separating weather-caused downtime (rain delays, extreme heat shutdowns) from mechanical downtime. Linking oee_record to the concurrent weathe
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: acceptable_output_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of output meeting quality standards during the measurement period. Used as the numerator for quality rate calculation. For harvesting equipment, represents grain meeting grade standards; for sprayers, represents correctly applied area.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; GLOBALG.A.P.; ISO 22000; John Deere Operations Center

attributes.name: actual_operating_time_min
attributes.description: Total minutes the asset was actively operating (engine running and performing work) during the measurement period, as recorded by John Deere Operations Center telematics. Equals planned production time minus unplanned downtime.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; ISO 55000; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: actual_throughput_rate
attributes.description: The measured actual throughput rate of the asset during operating time (e.g., acres per hour, gallons per minute). Compared against theoretical throughput rate to derive performance rate.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; SAP S/4HANA PM Module; ISO 55000

attributes.name: availability_rate
attributes.description: Ratio of actual operating time to planned production time, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.9250 = 92.50%). Calculated as (Planned Production Time - Unplanned Downtime) / Planned Production Time. One of the three OEE component rates.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; SEMI E10 OEE Standard; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: breakdown_count
attributes.description: Number of unplanned equipment breakdowns (failures requiring corrective maintenance work orders) that occurred during the measurement period. Drives unplanned downtime and is a key input to MTBF calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; ISO 55000; John Deere Operations Center

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this OEE record was first created in the Silver Layer data product. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking for the Databricks Lakehouse ingestion pipeline.
attributes.references: ISO 55000; SAP S/4HANA PM Module; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which the OEE measurement data was sourced. Supports data lineage tracking and audit trail for Silver Layer ingestion. Primary source is John Deere Operations Center telematics; secondary sources include SAP S/4HANA PM and manual entry.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; SAP S/4HANA PM Module; Trimble Ag Software; Climate FieldView

attributes.name: engine_hours
attributes.description: Total engine operating hours accumulated by the asset during the measurement period, as reported by John Deere Operations Center telematics. Used for preventive maintenance scheduling and asset lifecycle tracking per ISO 55000.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; SAP S/4HANA PM Module; ISO 55000

attributes.name: fuel_consumption_gallons
attributes.description: Total fuel consumed by the asset during the measurement period in US gallons, as reported by John Deere Operations Center telematics. Used for OPEX cost allocation, fuel efficiency benchmarking, and environmental reporting.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; SAP S/4HANA CO Module; EPA; ISO 14001

attributes.name: gps_tracking_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether GPS/RTK precision positioning was active on the asset during this measurement period. When true, telematics data (acres covered, field boundaries) is sourced from John Deere Operations Center GPS telemetry; when false, data may be manually entered.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; Trimble Ag Software; RTK GPS Standards

attributes.name: idle_time_min
attributes.description: Total minutes the asset engine was running but not performing productive work (idling) during the measurement period. Captured via John Deere Operations Center telematics. Contributes to performance loss analysis and fuel waste identification.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; SAP S/4HANA PM Module; EPA; ISO 55000

attributes.name: measurement_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this OEE measurement was recorded. Used for daily and shift-level fleet performance trending and CAPEX justification reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: measurement_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the OEE measurement period ended (shift or day end). Combined with start timestamp to derive total measurement window duration.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; ISO 55000; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: measurement_period_type
attributes.description: Granularity of the OEE measurement period: shift-level (per operational shift), daily (24-hour calendar day), or weekly (7-day rolling). Determines aggregation level for KPI reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: measurement_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the OEE measurement period began (shift or day start). Used for granular telematics alignment with John Deere Operations Center data.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; ISO 55000; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: minor_stoppage_count
attributes.description: Number of brief, unplanned stoppages (typically under 10 minutes each) that did not trigger a formal work order but contributed to performance rate loss during the measurement period. Sourced from John Deere Operations Center telematics event data.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; SEMI E10 OEE Standard; ISO 55000

attributes.name: oee_benchmark_target
attributes.description: The benchmark OEE target percentage (as a decimal) defined for the asset category (e.g., 0.8500 = 85% for combines). Sourced from asset category reference data. Used to assess performance gap and trigger CAPEX replacement reviews.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module; John Deere Operations Center

attributes.name: oee_percentage
attributes.description: Composite OEE score expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.7906 = 79.06%), calculated as Availability Rate × Performance Rate × Quality Rate. Primary KPI for fleet performance management and CAPEX justification for equipment replacement per ISO 55000.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; SEMI E10 OEE Standard; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: oee_variance
attributes.description: Difference between actual OEE percentage and the benchmark target (oee_percentage minus oee_benchmark_target), expressed as a signed decimal. Negative values indicate underperformance; used to prioritize maintenance interventions and CAPEX reviews.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: operation_type
attributes.description: Type of agricultural operation the equipment was performing during the measurement period. attributes.name: device_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the precision device. Drives maintenance scheduling, calibration compliance alerts, and asset utilization reporting. 'calibration_due' triggers workflow in CMMS/FMIS.

attributes.name: device_type

attributes.name: firmware_version

attributes.references: ISO 11783 (ISOBUS); John Deere Operations Center; Trimble Ag Software

attributes.name: fmis_device_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Farm Management Information System (FMIS) Device ID

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date the precision device was physically installed on or integrated with the parent equipment asset. Marks the start of the device's operational lifecycle on that asset. Used for warranty period calculation and CAPEX depreciation tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: ip_rating
attributes.description: IEC 60529 Ingress Protection rating indicating the device's resistance to dust and water (e.g., 'IP67' for dust-tight and immersion-resistant). Critical for field deployment suitability assessment in agricultural environments.
attributes.references: IEC 60529 Ingress Protection Standard; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: isobus_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the precision device holds official ISOBUS (ISO 11783) certification, enabling plug-and-play interoperability with ISOBUS-compliant tractors and implements. Required for VRA controller and section control module compatibility validation.
attributes.references: ISO 11783 (ISOBUS) Standard; AEF (Agricultural Industry Electronics Foundation) ISOBUS Certification

attributes.name: last_calibration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent calibration of the precision device was performed. Used to calculate calibration compliance status and trigger next calibration scheduling. Mandatory for GLOBALG.A.P. and FSMA traceability compliance.

attributes.name: manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the original equipment manufacturer (OEM) of the precision device (e.g., Trimble, John Deere, Raven Industries, Ag Leader, Topcon). Used for warranty management, technical support escalation, and procurement analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; ISO 55000 Asset Management

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned model or part number for the precision device (e.g., 'Trimble NAV-900', 'Raven Viper 4+'). Used for spare parts procurement, firmware compatibility checks, and OEM service bulletin tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; John Deere Operations Center

attributes.name: next_calibration_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date by which the next calibration of the precision device must be completed to maintain compliance. Calculated from last_calibration_date plus calibration_interval_days. Drives CMMS preventive maintenance work order generation.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Precision Agriculture Standards; ISO 9001 Calibration Requirements; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, known issues, configuration remarks, or special handling instructions related to the precision device. Used by field technicians and precision agriculture specialists for contextual documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; John Deere Operations Center

attributes.name: operating_temp_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum ambient temperature in degrees Celsius at which the precision device is rated to operate reliably. Used for summer deployment planning and heat-stress operational risk assessment in field conditions.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; OEM device specifications

attributes.name: operating_temp_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum ambient temperature in degrees Celsius at which the precision device is rated to operate reliably. Used for seasonal deployment planning and cold-climate operational risk assessment.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; OEM device specifications

attributes.name: power_source
attributes.description: Primary power supply method for the precision device. Determines installation requirements, field operational constraints, and maintenance considerations for remote or battery-powered sensors.
attributes.references: ISO 55000 Asset Management; John Deere Operations Center hardware specifications

attributes.name: purchase_cost
attributes.description: Original acquisition cost of the precision device in the operating currency. Used for CAPEX tracking, asset depreciation calculations, and ROI analysis of precision agriculture hardware investments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; GAAP/IFRS Asset Accounting; CAPEX management standards

attributes.name: purchase_date
attributes.description: Date the precision device was purchased or procured. Used as the anchor date for warranty period calculation, CAPEX depreciation schedules, and asset lifecycle reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/FI Module; GAAP/IFRS Asset Accounting

attributes.name: section_count
attributes.description: Number of independently controllable sections on a section control module or VRA controller (e.g., 12-section boom sprayer, 24-row planter). Determines granularity of variable rate application and overlap reduction capability.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software; Raven Industries Section Control; GLOBALG.A.P. Precision Agriculture Standards

attributes.name: signal_frequency_mhz
attributes.description: Operating signal frequency in megahertz for GPS/RTK receivers and radio-based precision devices (e.g., 1575.42 MHz for GPS L1, 1227.60 MHz for GPS L2). Used for interference analysis and regulatory spectrum compliance with FCC/USDA requirements.
attributes.references: FCC Spectrum Regulations; USDA Precision Agriculture Standards; RTK positioning standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the precision device record was most recently modified. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline and audit trail compliance.

attributes.name: warranty_expiry_date

Ensures measurement accuracy for VRA prescriptions, yield data integrity, and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: adjustment_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the specific adjustment performed on the device during calibration, including parameter changes, offset corrections, or hardware modifications applied.

attributes.name: adjustment_made
attributes.description: Indicates whether a physical or software adjustment was applied to the device during the calibration event (True = adjustment made; False = no adjustment required, device was within tolerance).

attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which the calibration activity was performed. This is the principal business event date for the calibration record.

attributes.description: The procedural approach used to perform the calibration, distinguishing between field-based tests, laboratory procedures, OEM manufacturer procedures, third-party certified calibration, or automated self-check routines.

attributes.name: calibration_standard
attributes.description: The reference standard, certified instrument, or traceable measurement benchmark used to perform the calibration (e.g., NIST-traceable reference, OEM factory standard, ISO 17025 accredited lab standard). Ensures traceability of measurement accuracy.

attributes.name: calibration_start_time
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the calibration procedure commenced, used for duration calculation and audit trail purposes.

attributes.description: Classification of the calibration activity performed, identifying the specific precision agriculture device category being calibrated. attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software; John Deere Operations Center; Climate FieldView; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: certificate_issued_date
attributes.description: The date on which the calibration certificate was formally issued, which may differ from the calibration date if certificate processing involves a review period.
attributes.references: ISO 17025; GLOBALG.A.P.; ISO 9001

attributes.name: certificate_number

attributes.name: cmms_notification_number

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; ISO 55000

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The SAP CO cost center code to which the labor and material costs of this calibration event are allocated, supporting OPEX tracking and equipment lifecycle cost management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this calibration event record was first created in the system, providing the audit trail creation marker for data lineage and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; FSMA Traceability Rule; SOX

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to labor_cost and parts_cost fields (e.g., USD, EUR, BRL). Supports multi-currency operations for global agricultural enterprises.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS; GAAP

attributes.name: deviation_value

attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; ISO 17025

attributes.name: device_serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned serial number of the precision agriculture device or sensor being calibrated, used for asset tracking, warranty management, and OEM service records.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Category of the precision agriculture device or sensor being calibrated, providing classification context for analytics and maintenance planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: gps_receiver|rtk_receiver|flow_meter|yield_monitor|sprayer_controller|soil_sensor|weather_sensor|vra_controller|nozzle_assembly — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; Trimble Ag Software; ISO 55000

attributes.name: event_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for the calibration event, used in certificates, audit trails, and regulatory submissions. Format: CAL-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; GLOBALG.A.P. Calibration Records

attributes.name: labor_cost
attributes.description: The actual labor cost incurred for performing the calibration event, expressed in the operational currency. Contributes to OPEX tracking and equipment total cost of ownership analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; GAAP; IFRS; ISO 55000

attributes.name: location_description
attributes.description: Description of the physical location where the calibration was performed (e.g., field workshop, equipment yard, certified calibration lab, in-field during operation). Supports audit trail and logistics planning.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: measurement_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure applicable to the pre-calibration, post-calibration, and reference standard readings (e.g., gal/min for flow meters, bu/ac for yield monitors, meters for GPS accuracy, mS/cm for EC sensors, pH units).
attributes.references: ISO 80000 Quantities and Units; USDA Measurement Standards

attributes.name: next_calibration_due_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date by which the next calibration of this device must be completed to maintain measurement accuracy compliance. Drives preventive maintenance scheduling and CMMS work order generation.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; ISO 55000; GLOBALG.A.P.; SAP S/4HANA PM Module

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for technician observations, environmental conditions during calibration, anomalies encountered, or additional context not captured in structured fields. Supports root cause analysis and audit review.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: parts_cost
attributes.description: The actual cost of any replacement parts or consumables used during the calibration event, expressed in the operational currency. Contributes to OPEX and parts inventory cost tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/CO Module; GAAP; IFRS; ISO 55000

attributes.name: pass_fail_result
attributes.description: The outcome determination of the calibration event: pass (within tolerance), fail (outside tolerance), or conditional_pass (within tolerance with noted conditions). Drives device release for field operations or quarantine for repair.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; GLOBALG.A.P. Calibration Records; FSMA

attributes.name: post_calibration_reading
attributes.description: The measured value recorded from the device or sensor immediately after the calibration adjustment was applied. Compared against the reference standard to confirm calibration success.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; GLOBALG.A.P. Calibration Records; Climate FieldView

attributes.name: pre_calibration_reading
attributes.description: The measured value recorded from the device or sensor immediately before the calibration adjustment was applied. Used to quantify measurement drift and justify calibration necessity.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; GLOBALG.A.P. Calibration Records; Climate FieldView

attributes.name: reference_standard_reading
attributes.description: The known, certified value from the calibration reference standard against which pre- and post-calibration readings are compared. Establishes the target accuracy benchmark.
attributes.references: ISO 17025; NIST Traceability; ISO 9001

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this calibration event was performed to satisfy a specific regulatory or certification requirement (True = regulatory-driven calibration; False = routine preventive calibration). Supports FSMA, EPA, and GLOBALG.A.P. compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FSMA; EPA; GLOBALG.A.P.; USDA; ISO 9001

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_reference
attributes.description: Specific regulatory citation, certification standard, or compliance framework requirement that mandated this calibration event (e.g., FSMA Produce Safety Rule Section 112.50, GLOBALG.A.P. AF 7.1, EPA 40 CFR Part 170 REI compliance).
attributes.references: FSMA; EPA; GLOBALG.A.P.; USDA NOP; ISO 22000

attributes.name: tolerance_value
attributes.description: The maximum allowable deviation between the device reading and the reference standard for the calibration to be considered passing. Defines the acceptable accuracy threshold for the device type.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; OEM Manufacturer Specifications; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this calibration event record was last modified, supporting audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: inspector_type

attributes.name: items_passed_count

products.name: custom_hire_contract
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between an agricultural equipment asset and a customer account in custom hire operations. It captures the formal service engagement whereby a specific piece of equipment is contracted to a specific customer account for a defined period and scope of work. Each record links one asset to one account and carries the contractual terms (acreage, rate, service type) and operational performance data that exist only in the context of this specific asset-customer engagement.. Existence Justification: In agricultural custom hire operations, a single piece of equipment (e.g., a combine harvester) is contracted out to multiple customer accounts across a season, and a single customer account may contract multiple assets (combine, grain cart, tractor, sprayer) for their farming operations. The business actively manages these service contracts with specific terms including contracted acreage, hourly rates, service type, and performance tracking — this is a recognized operational concept called a 'Custom Hire Contract' or 'Equipment Service Agreement' that humans create, update, and close throughout the crop season.

products.name: parts_issue
products.description: This association product represents the Parts Issue (Material Reservation) event between work_order and parts_inventory. It captures each line-item-level consumption of a spare part or consumable against a specific maintenance work order, as recorded in the CMMS (SAP PM goods issue / IBM Maximo material usage). Each record links one work_order to one parts_inventory item and carries the quantity issued, unit cost at time of issue, issue date, reservation status, and return quantity — data that exists only in the context of this specific work-order-to-part consumption event. Serves as the SSOT for actual material consumption supporting OPEX cost tracking, inventory replenishment triggers, and maintenance cost analysis by asset and crop enterprise.. Existence Justification: In agricultural CMMS operations, a single work order consumes multiple spare parts from inventory (e.g., a combine harvester repair may require an air filter, hydraulic seal, and drive belt simultaneously), and each part number is consumed across many different work orders over time. This is a textbook operational M:N: the 'parts issue' or 'material reservation' is a well-established CMMS business concept actively created, updated, and closed by maintenance planners and technicians. The relationship carries its own data — quantity issued, unit cost at time of issue, issue date, reservation status, and return quantity — none of which belong solely to the work order header or the parts inventory master.

products.name: maintenance_plan_bom
products.description: This association product represents the Bill of Materials (BOM) contract between a preventive maintenance plan and a parts inventory item. It captures the planned parts list for each PM plan cycle, specifying which parts are required, in what quantity, in what role, and at what estimated cost. Each record links one maintenance_plan to one parts_inventory item with attributes that exist only in the context of this plan-part combination. Actively managed by maintenance planners in CMMS systems to ensure parts availability before work order execution and to drive automated procurement replenishment ahead of planting and harvest seasons.. Existence Justification: In agricultural equipment maintenance management, a preventive maintenance (PM) plan defines a Bill of Materials (BOM) specifying exactly which parts and consumables are required for each service interval — one plan requires many parts, and one part (e.g., an oil filter or hydraulic fluid) appears across many plans. This is a well-recognized operational concept in CMMS systems called a 'PM BOM' or 'maintenance plan parts list', actively created and managed by maintenance planners. The relationship carries its own data (required quantity, part role, mandatory flag, estimated cost, consumption UOM) that belongs to neither the plan nor the part inventory record alone.

products.name: asset_contract_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the operational Allocation of a specific agricultural equipment asset to a specific sales contract. It captures the business record of which assets are deployed to fulfill which contract obligations across the crop marketing season, including hours consumed, acreage covered, compliance certification status for GlobalGAP/FSMA audit purposes, and the utilization cost allocated to the contract for financial reporting. Each record links one asset to one sales contract and carries attributes that exist only in the context of that specific asset-contract pairing — they cannot reside on the asset (which serves many contracts) or the contract (which uses many assets).. Existence Justification: In large-scale grain operations, agricultural equipment assets (harvesters, grain carts, transport vehicles) are actively allocated to specific sales contracts to fulfill delivery obligations — a single harvester services multiple contracts across a season, and a single contract may require multiple pieces of equipment simultaneously. The business operationally tracks this allocation for cost allocation (CAPEX/OPEX per contract), GlobalGAP audit compliance, and utilization reporting. This is not an analytical correlation derivable from transactional joins — it is an actively managed operational record with its own attributes (allocated hours, acreage, compliance status, utilization cost) that belong to neither the asset nor the contract alone.

products.name: input_compatibility
products.description: This association product represents the formal compatibility certification between an agricultural equipment asset and an agricultural input product. It captures which input products a given asset is approved or certified to apply, and under what conditions (rate capability, formulation type, certification status, effective date). Each record links one asset to one input_product with attributes that exist only in the context of this compatibility relationship — such as the approved application rate range achievable by that specific asset for that specific input, and whether a formal certification is required and on file.. Existence Justification: In agricultural operations, specific equipment assets (sprayers, spreaders, planters) are certified or rated for compatibility with specific input products based on material compatibility, nozzle specifications, EPA label requirements, and equipment capabilities. A single sprayer asset can be approved for many herbicide/fungicide formulations, and a single input product can be applied by many different equipment assets across a farm fleet. This compatibility relationship is actively managed by agronomists and equipment managers as a formal certification or approval record — it is not derivable from transactional application data alone.

products.name: asset_certification_scope
products.description: This association product represents the formal inclusion of a specific agricultural asset within the scope of a sustainability certification. It captures which assets are registered under each certification, the per-asset compliance verification status, and the audit evidence linking individual equipment to certification requirements. Each record links one asset to one sustainability_certification with attributes that exist only in the context of this asset-certification pairing — such as the date compliance was verified for that asset, the asset's individual status within the certification, and the standard version under which the asset was assessed.. Existence Justification: In certified agricultural supply chains, a single farm asset (e.g., a sprayer or tractor) can be in-scope for multiple sustainability certifications simultaneously (e.g., ISCC for biofuel traceability, GlobalG.A.P. for food safety, and USDA Organic for crop inputs), and a single certification covers a portfolio of assets across the farm operation. The business actively manages which specific assets are within each certification's scope, tracks per-asset compliance verification dates and statuses, and must demonstrate this linkage to auditors and buyers. This is a named, operationally managed concept in certified supply chain practice.

domains.name: supply
domains.description: Orchestrates end-to-end agricultural supply chain and logistics from farm inputs through storage, processing, and delivery to food manufacturers and retailers. Manages TMS-driven transportation planning, shipment tracking (BOL, AWB), route optimization, cold chain management, carrier and 3PL relationships, and traceability lot (LOT) tracking with RFID. Ensures compliance with FSMA transportation rules for food safety. Integrates with Manhattan Associates WMS and SAP S/4HANA MM for inbound and outbound logistics.

products.name: shipment
products.description: SSOT for every agricultural shipment — grain, produce, livestock feed, and processed food movements from farm to food manufacturer or retailer. Master record capturing shipment identity, BOL/AWB legal documentation (shipper, consignee, freight terms, seal numbers, electronic signatures per 49 CFR), origin and destination facility, commodity lot (LOT), carrier assignment, transport mode (road, rail, air, sea), shipment status lifecycle, scheduled and actual departure/arrival dates, total weight (MT/CWT/BU), temperature requirements for cold chain, FSMA Sanitary Transportation rule compliance flag, container identifiers, delivery milestone events (pickup confirmation, in-transit checkpoints, border crossing, proof of delivery with GPS coordinates, photo evidence, and electronic signature capture), and exception events (delay, damage, refusal). Single authoritative record for shipment identity, legal shipping documentation, execution tracking, and delivery event history within the supply domain. Subsumes BOL document data and delivery event tracking — no separate products exist for these concepts.

Subsumes freight booking and load plan data — no separate products exist for these concepts.
