attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Vendor Master

attributes.name: compliance_audit_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Carrier Audit Assessment - Compliance Audit Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the compliance audit record under which this carrier assessment was conducted.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: license_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.license. Business justification: Carrier qualification in agriculture requires verification of active licenses (DOT operating authority, state carrier licenses, pesticide applicator licenses for fumigation carriers). Linking carrier
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: operating_permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Agricultural carriers must hold operating permits (USDA, state transport, hazmat). Linking carrier to their governing operating permit supports carrier qualification, compliance verification during co
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: sap_vendor_id
attributes.description: Vendor master record number assigned to this carrier in SAP S/4HANA MM module. Used for cross-referencing freight invoices, purchase orders (PO), and goods receipt notes (GRN) in the ERP system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master (LFA1/LFB1 tables)

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the carrier was formally approved to transport trial materials to or from this specific trial site. Belongs to the approval relationship, not to the carrier or site master records.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 date

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the carrier's approval for this trial site. Controls whether the carrier may be tendered loads for this site. Derived from the approval management process.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: approved_commodity_types
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of agricultural commodity categories this carrier is approved to transport (e.g., 'grain', 'fresh_produce', 'livestock', 'fertilizer', 'pesticides'). Derived from carrier certifications and equipment capabilities.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Act; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule; EPA Pesticide Transport Regulations

attributes.name: audit_date
attributes.description: The specific date on which audit activities were conducted for this carrier. Relevant when a multi-carrier audit spans multiple site visits on different dates.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: audit_outcome
attributes.description: The audit outcome determined specifically for this carrier within the audit engagement. A multi-carrier audit may yield different outcomes per carrier.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: audit_scope_for_carrier
attributes.description: Narrative description of the specific operations, routes, facilities, or practices within scope for this carrier in the context of this audit. May be a subset of the overall audit scope when the audit covers multiple carriers.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: carrier_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the carrier record within the agricultural supply chain master data. Controls whether the carrier is eligible for new shipment assignments in the TMS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: carrier_type
attributes.description: Primary mode of transportation the carrier operates. Drives TMS routing logic, BOL/AWB document selection, and FSMA Sanitary Transportation rule applicability. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: trucking|rail|air_freight|ocean|intermodal|3pl — promote to reference product if additional modes are needed]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TMS; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1

attributes.name: cold_chain_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier has certified refrigerated or temperature-controlled transport capability for cold chain agricultural commodities (e.g., fresh produce, dairy, meat). Required for perishable shipment routing in TMS.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule; GLOBALG.A.P. Cold Chain Standard

attributes.name: cold_chain_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier's cold chain capability has been specifically verified and validated for this trial site's requirements. Distinct from the carrier-level cold_chain_capable flag, which is a general capability indicator. A carrier may be generally cold-chain capable but not yet verified for a specific site's temperature profile or containment requirements.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: compliance_score
attributes.description: Composite compliance score (0-100) reflecting the carrier's adherence to regulatory requirements (FSMA, DOT, FMCSA) and contractual obligations. Calculated from documentation currency, audit results, and violation history.
attributes.references: FMCSA Safety Measurement System (SMS); FSMA; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Evaluation

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the current master carrier agreement or rate contract. Triggers renewal workflow alerts in SAP S/4HANA MM. Null indicates an open-ended evergreen agreement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Outline Agreement; Oracle NetSuite Procurement

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Effective start date of the current master carrier agreement or rate contract between the agricultural enterprise and the carrier. Defines the period during which contracted rates and service commitments apply.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Outline Agreement; Oracle NetSuite Procurement

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this carrier is required to submit or implement corrective actions as a result of findings identified during this audit. Drives follow-up workflow in the compliance domain.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction where the carrier is legally registered. Determines applicable regulatory frameworks (FMCSA, Transport Canada, etc.) and COOL compliance requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; USDA COOL Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the carrier master record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports data lineage, audit trail, and FSMA record-keeping requirements.
attributes.references: FSMA Record-Keeping Requirements; SOX Internal Controls; ISO 22000

attributes.name: damage_claim_rate
attributes.description: Rolling ratio of shipments resulting in a cargo damage claim to total shipments executed. Used to assess carrier handling quality for sensitive agricultural commodities and inform carrier tier scoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Evaluation; USDA Agricultural Marketing Act

attributes.name: dot_number
attributes.description: USDOT number issued by the Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA) to identify commercial motor carriers operating in interstate commerce. Required for FSMA Sanitary Transportation compliance verification.
attributes.references: FMCSA 49 CFR Part 390; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1

attributes.name: edi_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier supports EDI transaction sets (e.g., 204 Motor Carrier Load Tender, 214 Shipment Status, 210 Freight Invoice) for automated load tendering and status updates in the agricultural supply chain.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 EDI Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM EDI Integration

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the carrier's site-specific approval expires and must be renewed. Approval periods may align with annual carrier qualification cycles or cooperator agreement renewal dates.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 date

attributes.name: fsma_cert_expiry_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Certification Expiry Date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the carrier's FSMA Sanitary Transportation certification. Triggers compliance alerts when approaching expiry to prevent use of non-compliant carriers for food-grade agricultural shipments.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart O; FDA

attributes.name: fsma_sanitary_transport_certified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Sanitary Transportation Certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier holds a valid FSMA Sanitary Transportation of Human and Animal Food certification (21 CFR Part 1, Subpart O). Mandatory for carriers transporting food-grade agricultural products to food manufacturers.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart O; FDA Food Safety Modernization Act

attributes.name: gps_tracking_capable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Positioning System (GPS) Real-Time Tracking Capability Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier provides real-time GPS-based shipment location tracking integrated with the TMS for visibility into in-transit agricultural commodity shipments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TMS; John Deere Operations Center Fleet Telematics

attributes.name: hazmat_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier holds USDOT hazardous materials (HAZMAT) certification for transporting regulated agricultural inputs such as pesticides, fertilizers, and fumigants with Safety Data Sheet (SDS) requirements.
attributes.references: USDOT 49 CFR Parts 171-180 HAZMAT Regulations; EPA; OSHA

attributes.name: insurance_cert_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the carrier's current insurance certificate (cargo liability, general liability, and auto liability). Carrier is ineligible for load assignment if this date has passed. Monitored for proactive renewal alerts.
attributes.references: FMCSA 49 CFR Part 387; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Evaluation

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_amount
attributes.description: Total cargo liability insurance coverage amount in USD as stated on the carrier's current insurance certificate. Used to validate coverage adequacy for high-value agricultural commodity shipments.
attributes.references: FMCSA 49 CFR Part 387; USDA Agricultural Commodity Standards

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the carrier master record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; FSMA Record-Keeping Requirements; SAP S/4HANA Change Documents

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal registered business name of the freight carrier or 3PL provider as recorded with the relevant regulatory authority (e.g., FMCSA, DOT). Used for contracts, BOL documentation, and compliance filings.
attributes.references: FMCSA Carrier Registration; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master

attributes.name: max_temp_celsius
attributes.description: Maximum temperature in degrees Celsius that the carrier's temperature-controlled units can maintain. Defines the upper bound of the carrier's cold chain capability for fresh produce and ambient-chilled agricultural shipments.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule; ISO 22000 Food Safety Management

attributes.name: mc_number
attributes.description: Operating authority number (MC number) issued by FMCSA to carriers transporting regulated commodities for hire in interstate commerce. Validates carrier authority to haul agricultural products.
attributes.references: FMCSA 49 CFR Part 365; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule

attributes.name: min_temp_celsius
attributes.description: Minimum temperature in degrees Celsius that the carrier's refrigerated units can maintain. Used for TMS routing of frozen or deep-chilled agricultural products requiring specific temperature ranges.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule; ISO 22000 Food Safety Management

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_rate
attributes.description: Rolling percentage of shipments delivered within the committed delivery window. Primary KPI for carrier performance evaluation, tier assignment, and preferred carrier status in TMS routing for agricultural logistics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Evaluation; GLOBALG.A.P. Supply Chain Standard

attributes.name: on_time_pickup_rate
attributes.description: Rolling percentage of shipments where the carrier completed pickup within the agreed pickup window. Key performance indicator (KPI) for carrier scorecard evaluation and performance tier assignment in the agricultural supply chain.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Evaluation; GLOBALG.A.P. Supply Chain Standard

attributes.name: performance_eval_period
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter and year (e.g., '2024-Q3') for which the current rolling performance metrics (on-time rates, damage claim rate, compliance score, performance tier) were last evaluated and updated.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Evaluation

attributes.name: performance_rating_at_site
attributes.description: Performance rating (0.00–5.00) assigned to the carrier based on observed performance specifically at this trial site. Distinct from the carrier's aggregate rolling performance metrics, which span all sites and shipments. Enables site managers to flag carriers that perform well globally but poorly at their specific location.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association Attribute

attributes.name: performance_tier
attributes.description: Current performance tier classification assigned based on the carrier's rolling KPI scores (on-time rates, damage claims, compliance score). Drives TMS primary/secondary/tertiary carrier selection logic for agricultural shipment routing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Evaluation; GLOBALG.A.P. Supply Chain Standard

attributes.name: preferred_lane_assignments
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of preferred origin-destination lane codes (e.g., 'MIDWEST-SOUTHEAST', 'CA-TX') where this carrier has committed capacity or preferred routing agreements. Used by TMS for primary carrier selection in route optimization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TMS Route Determination; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the carrier's operational contact used for load tender notifications, BOL transmissions, and compliance document exchange.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact at the carrier organization responsible for load tendering, dispatch coordination, and issue resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the carrier's operational contact used for dispatch coordination, load tendering, and exception management in the agricultural supply chain.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master

attributes.name: rejected_loads_count
attributes.description: Count of loads rejected or refused by the carrier after tender acceptance within the current evaluation period. High rejection rates indicate capacity reliability issues and impact carrier tier scoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TMS; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: rfid_tracking_capable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) Tracking Capability Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier supports RFID-based shipment and lot (LOT) tracking for end-to-end traceability of agricultural commodities from farm to food manufacturer. Integrates with Manhattan Associates WMS RFID infrastructure.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S; GS1 RFID Standards

attributes.name: scac_code
attributes.description: Unique 2-4 character Standard Carrier Alpha Code (SCAC) assigned by the National Motor Freight Traffic Association (NMFTA) to identify the carrier in EDI transactions, BOL documents, and TMS routing.
attributes.references: NMFTA SCAC Directory; ANSI X12 EDI Standards

attributes.name: service_modes
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of transportation service modes offered by the carrier (e.g., FTL, LTL, refrigerated, flatbed, bulk, tanker, intermodal). Used for TMS lane matching and load tendering in agricultural logistics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TMS; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: temperature_excursion_rate
attributes.description: Rolling ratio of cold chain shipments where a temperature excursion (deviation outside the specified range) was recorded to total cold chain shipments. Critical metric for FSMA compliance and food safety risk management.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1; ISO 22000 Food Safety Management

attributes.name: total_shipments_executed
attributes.description: Cumulative count of shipments executed by this carrier within the current evaluation period. Provides volume context for interpreting rate-based KPIs (on-time, damage, temperature excursion) in carrier performance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TMS; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: trade_name
attributes.description: Operating or 'doing business as' (DBA) trade name of the carrier, if different from the legal name. Used in day-to-day communications and TMS lane assignments.
attributes.references: FMCSA Carrier Registration

products.name: route
products.description: SSOT for planned transportation routes used in agricultural commodity and input movements across the supply chain network. Defines origin facility node, destination facility node, intermediate waypoints, distance (miles/km), estimated transit time by transport mode, preferred carrier assignments, seasonal road restriction flags (spring weight limits, harvest season congestion), cold chain corridor designation, toll and border crossing points, bridge weight limit constraints, and GPS/RTK route geometry reference. Used by TMS for route optimization, freight cost estimation, and VRA delivery planning for precision agriculture inputs. Single authoritative record for transportation route definitions within the supply domain.
products.reference: TMS Route Master

attributes.name: route_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for a transportation route definition within the agricultural supply chain network. Primary key for the route data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM (Transportation Management); Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: destination_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the destination facility node (distribution center, food manufacturer, retailer DC, port terminal) where the route ends. Used for delivery planning, customer service level management, and COOL compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Shipping Point; COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) 7 CFR Part 60; FSMA

attributes.name: origin_facility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the origin facility node (farm, elevator, warehouse, processing plant) where the route begins. Used for network planning, freight cost estimation, and FSMA traceability. Links to the facility/location master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Plant/Storage Location; FSMA Food Traceability Rule 21 CFR Part 1

attributes.name: permit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.permit. Business justification: Agricultural transport routes crossing state/national borders or involving regulated commodities require route-specific permits (overweight permits, phytosanitary corridor approvals, APHIS movement pe
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: preferred_carrier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the preferred carrier or 3PL assigned to this route based on contracted rates, service performance, and commodity handling capabilities. Used by TMS for automated carrier selection and freight tendering.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Carrier Master; Manhattan Associates TMS

attributes.name: zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to weather.weather_zone. Business justification: Seasonal route planning for harvest logistics requires weather zone classification to apply correct spring weight restrictions, harvest congestion flags, and cold-chain corridor requirements. A logist
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: avg_transit_delay_hours
attributes.description: Historical average delay in hours experienced on this route beyond the estimated transit time, calculated from actual shipment performance data. Used for realistic delivery promise date calculation, carrier performance benchmarking, and TMS transit time buffer planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Performance Analytics; KPI (Key Performance Indicator) Transportation; USDA Agricultural Transportation Statistics

attributes.name: commodity_class
attributes.description: NMFC (National Motor Freight Classification) commodity class or agricultural commodity category for which this route is designated (e.g., grain, fresh produce, livestock, fertilizer, pesticides, dairy). Determines carrier equipment requirements, handling protocols, and regulatory compliance needs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: grain|fresh_produce|livestock|fertilizer|pesticides|dairy|seeds|feed|processed_food|equipment — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NMFC National Motor Freight Classification; USDA Commodity Classification; EPA Pesticide Transport Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this route record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail, data lineage tracking, and SOX financial reporting controls for transportation cost records.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; ISO 8601; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity); SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for freight cost values on this route (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN). Required for multi-currency international route cost management and IFRS/GAAP financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS; GAAP

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the route destination location. Required for COOL compliance, import/export documentation, APHIS permits, and international freight cost calculation.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; COOL 7 CFR Part 60; USDA APHIS; CBP Customs

attributes.name: distance_km
attributes.description: Total planned distance of the route in kilometers, as calculated from GPS/RTK route geometry or GIS network analysis. Used for freight cost estimation, fuel consumption planning, driver hours-of-service compliance, and carbon footprint calculation.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Network Analysis; FMCSA Hours of Service 49 CFR Part 395; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: distance_miles
attributes.description: Total planned distance of the route in miles, the standard unit for US domestic trucking freight rate calculations, FMCSA compliance, and carrier contract negotiations. Maintained alongside kilometers for dual-unit reporting.
attributes.references: FMCSA 49 CFR; USDA Agricultural Transportation; SAP S/4HANA TM

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this route definition is no longer valid for TMS planning. Null indicates an open-ended route with no planned expiry. Used for seasonal route deactivation, road closure management, and contract expiry alignment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Route Validity; FHWA Road Closure Management

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this route definition becomes valid and available for TMS transportation planning. Supports seasonal route activation (e.g., harvest season routes, post-spring-thaw routes) and contract-aligned route management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Route Validity; FSMA Transportation Planning

attributes.name: estimated_transit_hours
attributes.description: Estimated total transit time in hours for the route under standard operating conditions, accounting for transport mode, distance, and typical delays. Used for delivery scheduling, customer promise dates, and cold chain temperature exposure calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Transit Time; FSMA Sanitary Transportation 21 CFR Part 1; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: freight_cost_per_km
attributes.description: Standard contracted freight cost per kilometer for this route in the base currency (USD). Used by TMS for freight cost estimation, carrier rate benchmarking, and transportation spend analytics. Derived from carrier contracts negotiated in SAP S/4HANA MM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing; TMS Freight Cost Calculation; GAAP Transportation Cost Accounting

attributes.name: fsma_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act) Compliance Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route and its designated carriers have been validated as compliant with FSMA Sanitary Transportation of Human and Animal Food rules (21 CFR Part 1, Subpart O), including vehicle sanitation, temperature control, and shipper-carrier agreement requirements.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart O; FDA Food Safety Modernization Act

attributes.name: gps_geometry_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URI pointing to the GPS/RTK route geometry definition stored in Esri ArcGIS or the GIS layer repository. Contains the spatial polyline representation of the route for map visualization, precision agriculture VRA delivery planning, and geofencing. Follows GeoJSON or Esri feature service reference convention.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS GIS Standards; RTK (Real-Time Kinematic) Positioning; ISO 19115 Geographic Metadata

attributes.name: has_border_crossing
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route includes one or more international border crossings requiring customs documentation, phytosanitary certificates, APHIS import/export permits, or COOL compliance. Triggers additional documentation requirements in SAP S/4HANA GTS.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Import/Export; COOL 7 CFR Part 60; CBP Customs Regulations; CFIA (Canada); SAP GTS

attributes.name: has_harvest_congestion
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route experiences significant traffic congestion during harvest season due to high agricultural vehicle volumes. Used by TMS for seasonal transit time adjustments, route optimization, and harvest logistics planning.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Transportation; SAP S/4HANA TM Seasonal Planning; John Deere Operations Center

attributes.name: has_spring_weight_restriction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route is subject to seasonal spring weight limit restrictions (spring thaw load restrictions) that reduce allowable gross vehicle weight on roads during spring months. Affects load planning, carrier selection, and delivery scheduling during spring planting season.
attributes.references: FHWA Spring Weight Restrictions; State DOT Seasonal Load Restrictions; USDA Farm-to-Market Road Standards

attributes.name: has_toll_road
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route includes toll roads, bridges, or tunnels that incur additional freight costs. Used for accurate freight cost estimation, carrier rate negotiations, and transportation spend analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Freight Cost Calculation; FHWA Toll Facilities

attributes.name: hazmat_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route is approved for transportation of hazardous agricultural materials including pesticides, fertilizers (ammonium nitrate), and fumigants under DOT/EPA hazmat regulations. Drives carrier certification requirements and routing restrictions through populated areas.
attributes.references: DOT Hazardous Materials Regulations 49 CFR Parts 171-180; EPA RCRA; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119

attributes.name: is_cold_chain_corridor
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route is designated as a cold chain corridor requiring temperature-controlled transport equipment (refrigerated trailers, insulated containers) throughout the entire route. Critical for perishable agricultural commodities, fresh produce, and dairy products under FSMA Sanitary Transportation rules.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart O; FDA Food Safety; GFSI Cold Chain Standards

attributes.name: max_temp_celsius
attributes.description: Maximum allowable temperature in Celsius that must not be exceeded throughout the cold chain corridor route. Null for non-cold-chain routes. Used for carrier equipment specification, temperature monitoring alert thresholds, and FSMA compliance documentation.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation 21 CFR Part 1; FDA Food Safety; HACCP Temperature Control

attributes.name: max_vehicle_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum allowable gross vehicle weight in kilograms for this route, determined by the most restrictive bridge weight limit or road weight restriction along the route. Critical for load planning of heavy agricultural commodities (grain, fertilizer, equipment) to prevent infrastructure damage and regulatory violations.
attributes.references: FHWA Bridge Weight Limits 23 CFR Part 658; State DOT Weight Regulations; FMCSA 49 CFR Part 658

attributes.name: min_temp_celsius
attributes.description: Minimum allowable temperature in Celsius that must be maintained throughout the cold chain corridor route. Null for non-cold-chain routes. Used for carrier equipment specification, temperature monitoring alert thresholds, and FSMA compliance documentation.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation 21 CFR Part 1; FDA Food Safety; HACCP Temperature Control

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special handling instructions, known road hazards, carrier-specific requirements, or regulatory advisories relevant to this route. Used by dispatchers, logistics planners, and carrier coordinators for route-specific guidance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Route Notes; Manhattan Associates WMS Operational Notes; SOP (Standard Operating Procedure)

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the route origin location (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX). Required for COOL compliance, APHIS phytosanitary documentation, customs declarations, and international freight rate determination.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; COOL 7 CFR Part 60; USDA APHIS; CBP Customs

attributes.name: rfid_tracking_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) lot tracking infrastructure is available along this route for real-time shipment visibility and LOT traceability. Supports FSMA traceability requirements and Manhattan Associates WMS RFID integration.
attributes.references: RFID (Radio Frequency Identification); FSMA Food Traceability Rule; Manhattan Associates WMS RFID; GS1 RFID Standards

attributes.name: route_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the transportation route, used in TMS, BOL documentation, and carrier communications. Serves as the business-facing identifier across SAP S/4HANA SD/MM and Manhattan Associates WMS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Transportation; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1

attributes.name: route_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the transportation route (e.g., 'Midwest Grain Corridor - Chicago to Memphis'). Used in TMS planning screens, carrier briefings, and operational reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: route_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the route definition. 'active' indicates the route is available for TMS planning; 'seasonal' indicates availability limited to specific periods; 'restricted' indicates regulatory or physical constraints are in effect; 'under_review' indicates pending validation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM Route Master; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule

attributes.name: route_type
attributes.description: Classification of the route by its supply chain function: 'inbound' for farm inputs to storage/processing, 'outbound' for finished goods to customers, 'inter_facility' for transfers between company facilities, 'last_mile' for final delivery to farm or retailer, 'backhaul' for return load optimization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/SD Transportation; Manhattan Associates WMS; USDA Agricultural Supply Chain

attributes.name: seasonal_restriction_end_month
attributes.description: Calendar month number (1-12) when seasonal restrictions end on this route. Used alongside seasonal_restriction_start_month for automated TMS seasonal planning windows and carrier capacity pre-booking.
attributes.references: State DOT Seasonal Load Restriction Programs; USDA Agricultural Transportation Seasonal Planning

attributes.name: seasonal_restriction_start_month
attributes.description: Calendar month number (1-12) when seasonal restrictions (spring weight limits, harvest congestion, winter road closures) begin on this route. Used for automated TMS seasonal planning and proactive carrier notification.
attributes.references: State DOT Seasonal Load Restriction Programs; USDA Agricultural Transportation Seasonal Planning

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transportation for this route (e.g., truck for over-the-road, rail for grain shuttle, intermodal for container movements, barge for river grain transport). Drives carrier selection, freight cost estimation, and transit time calculation in TMS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM; USDA Agricultural Transportation; FSMA 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart O

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this route record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, data synchronization between TMS and SAP S/4HANA, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; ISO 8601; GDPR Article 5; SAP S/4HANA Change Documents

attributes.name: vra_delivery_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Variable Rate Application (VRA) Delivery Eligible Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this route is designated for precision agriculture VRA (Variable Rate Application) input deliveries, requiring GPS-guided last-mile delivery to specific field zones. Integrates with Trimble Ag Software and John Deere Operations Center for precision delivery coordination.
attributes.references: VRA (Variable Rate Application) Precision Agriculture; Trimble Ag Software; John Deere Operations Center; FMIS

attributes.name: waypoint_count

attributes.name: chain_of_custody_event
attributes.business_glossary_term: Chain of Custody Transfer Event Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reading was captured at a chain-of-custody transfer point (True = custody handoff event, e.g., farm to carrier, carrier to warehouse, warehouse to retailer). Critical for FSMA traceability and HACCP lot tracking.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule (21 CFR Part 1.900); HACCP Codex Alimentarius; GLOBALG.A.P.; COOL (Country of Origin Labeling)

attributes.name: corrective_action_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the corrective action taken in response to a temperature excursion (e.g., 'Refrigeration unit reset and temperature restored', 'Product quarantined pending QA review'). Mandatory for HACCP CCP records when corrective_action_taken is True.
attributes.references: HACCP Codex Alimentarius; ISO 22000:2018 Section 8.9.3; GFSI; BRC Global Standard Issue 9

attributes.name: corrective_action_taken
attributes.description: Indicates whether a corrective action was initiated in response to the excursion detected at this reading (True = corrective action recorded). Required for HACCP CCP corrective action documentation and GFSI audit evidence.
attributes.references: HACCP Codex Alimentarius; GFSI; ISO 22000:2018 Section 8.9.3; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cold chain reading record was first ingested into the Databricks silver layer. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and late-arriving data detection.
attributes.references: ISO 22000:2018; GFSI; SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity and accountability)

attributes.name: custody_transfer_party
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the party receiving custody at a chain-of-custody transfer event. Populated only when chain_of_custody_event is True. Supports FSMA traceability lot (LOT) tracking and food safety incident root cause investigation.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule; HACCP Codex Alimentarius; GLOBALG.A.P. Chain of Custody Standard

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Quality assessment of this reading: 'valid' = passed all validation checks; 'suspect' = reading is outside expected sensor range or statistical outlier; 'invalid' = sensor malfunction confirmed; 'missing' = gap-filled placeholder; 'interpolated' = estimated from adjacent readings.
attributes.references: ISO 22000:2018; GFSI Technical Guidance; HACCP Codex Alimentarius; Databricks Silver Layer Data Quality Standards

attributes.name: excursion_deviation_c
attributes.description: Magnitude of temperature deviation from the nearest threshold boundary in degrees Celsius at the time of this reading. Positive value indicates above max threshold; negative indicates below min threshold. Supports severity scoring and product safety risk assessment.
attributes.references: HACCP Codex Alimentarius; GFSI; BRC Global Standard Issue 9; ISO 22000:2018

attributes.name: excursion_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Cumulative duration in minutes that the temperature has been outside the required range at the time of this reading. Used for HACCP corrective action decision-making and product disposition assessment.
attributes.references: HACCP Codex Alimentarius; GFSI; ISO 22000:2018 Section 8.9; FDA Food Code

attributes.name: excursion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reading breached the commodity-specific temperature threshold (True = excursion detected). Primary trigger for HACCP corrective action workflows and GFSI audit evidence generation.
attributes.references: HACCP Codex Alimentarius; GFSI Technical Guidance; ISO 22000:2018 Section 8.9; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule

attributes.name: fsma_traceability_lot_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Traceability Lot Code
attributes.description: FSMA-compliant traceability lot code (TLC) assigned to the commodity lot being monitored in this reading. Enables rapid lot-level traceability for food safety incident response per FSMA Section 204 requirements.
attributes.references: FSMA Section 204 (Food Traceability Rule); FDA 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: gps_latitude
attributes.description: WGS-84 decimal latitude coordinate of the sensor/vehicle at the time of reading. Enables geospatial mapping of excursion events and route compliance verification.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: gps_longitude
attributes.description: WGS-84 decimal longitude coordinate of the sensor/vehicle at the time of reading. Used in conjunction with latitude for geospatial excursion root cause analysis.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: haccp_ccp_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point (HACCP) Critical Control Point Reference
attributes.description: Reference code identifying the specific HACCP Critical Control Point (CCP) plan entry that governs the temperature limits for this reading. Links telemetry data to the formal HACCP plan for audit evidence and regulatory inspection.
attributes.references: HACCP Codex Alimentarius; GFSI; ISO 22000:2018 Section 8.5; FDA 21 CFR Part 120/123; USDA FSIS

attributes.name: humidity_pct
attributes.description: Observed relative humidity percentage inside the transport unit or storage compartment at the time of reading. Critical for fresh produce, cut flowers, and dairy commodities where moisture control prevents spoilage.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Produce Handling Standard; GFSI Technical Guidance; ISO 22000:2018

attributes.name: product_disposition
attributes.description: Disposition decision for the commodity lot based on cold chain excursion assessment at this reading point: 'accepted' = within spec; 'quarantine_hold' = held pending QA review; 'rejected' = product condemned; 'pending_review' = awaiting QA decision. Populated for excursion events.
attributes.references: HACCP Codex Alimentarius; GFSI; ISO 22000:2018 Section 8.9.4; FDA Food Code; FSMA

attributes.name: reading_interval_seconds
attributes.description: Configured polling interval in seconds at which the sensor device is programmed to capture readings. Used to validate data completeness and detect gaps in the telemetry stream.
attributes.references: HACCP Codex Alimentarius; GFSI Technical Guidance; ISO 22000:2018 Section 8.5

attributes.name: reading_source
attributes.description: Origin system or method by which this reading was captured: 'iot_sensor' = direct IoT device telemetry; 'rfid_logger' = RFID data logger; 'manual_entry' = operator-entered; 'tms_integration' = received via TMS feed; 'wms_integration' = received via WMS integration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Manhattan Associates WMS; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule; GFSI

attributes.name: reading_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time (UTC) when the sensor captured this temperature and humidity observation. Primary event timestamp for cold chain telemetry sequencing and excursion duration calculation.
attributes.references: HACCP Codex Alimentarius; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule; ISO 22000:2018

attributes.name: reading_type
attributes.description: Discriminator indicating how this reading was generated: 'periodic' = scheduled interval reading; 'event_triggered' = sensor threshold breach; 'manual' = operator-entered; 'chain_of_custody' = recorded at custody transfer point; 'alarm' = device alarm state.
attributes.references: HACCP Codex Alimentarius; GFSI Technical Guidance; ISO 22000:2018 Section 8.5

attributes.name: required_temp_max_c
attributes.description: Commodity-specific maximum allowable temperature in degrees Celsius for this shipment leg. Defines the upper bound of the HACCP CCP temperature range. Exceedance triggers the excursion_flag.
attributes.references: HACCP Codex Alimentarius; USDA AMS Commodity Requirements; FDA Food Code; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: required_temp_min_c
attributes.description: Commodity-specific minimum allowable temperature in degrees Celsius for this shipment leg. Defines the lower bound of the HACCP critical control point (CCP) temperature range against which excursions are evaluated.
attributes.references: HACCP Codex Alimentarius; USDA AMS Commodity Requirements; FDA Food Code; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: rfid_tag_code
attributes.description: RFID tag identifier attached to the pallet, container, or shipment unit being monitored. Enables automated chain-of-custody tracking and links physical asset movement to cold chain telemetry.
attributes.references: GS1 RFID Standards; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule; Manhattan Associates WMS Integration

attributes.name: sensor_calibration_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the sensor device is due for its next calibration verification. Readings captured after this date may be flagged as non-compliant for HACCP and GFSI audit purposes.
attributes.references: HACCP Codex Alimentarius; GFSI; ISO 22000:2018 Section 8.7; BRC Global Standard Issue 9 Section 6.3

attributes.name: sensor_device_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Internet of Things (IoT) Sensor Device ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the IoT temperature/humidity sensor or RFID-enabled data logger device that captured this reading. Used for device traceability and calibration audit trails.
attributes.references: HACCP Codex Alimentarius; GFSI Technical Guidance; ISO 22000:2018 Section 8.5

attributes.name: temperature_c
attributes.description: Observed ambient temperature in degrees Celsius at the time of reading. Primary cold chain measurement used for HACCP critical control point (CCP) monitoring and excursion detection.
attributes.references: HACCP Codex Alimentarius; GFSI; BRC Global Standard for Food Safety Issue 9; SQF Code Edition 9

attributes.name: temperature_f
attributes.description: Observed ambient temperature in degrees Fahrenheit at the time of reading. Provided alongside Celsius to support US-market carrier and customer reporting requirements without unit conversion.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; FDA Food Code; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Categorical temperature zone designation for the transport compartment or storage area. Classifies the cold chain environment type: frozen (<-18°C), chilled (0–8°C), ambient (15–25°C), controlled_ambient (8–15°C), ultra_low (<-40°C for specialty biologics/vaccines).
attributes.references: GFSI Technical Guidance; BRC Global Standard Issue 9; WHO Cold Chain Guidelines; USDA AMS

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this cold chain reading record in the silver layer. Tracks corrections, quality flag updates, and disposition changes for audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 22000:2018; GFSI; SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5

products.name: lot_trace
products.description: SSOT for end-to-end traceability of agricultural commodity lots (LOT) moving through the supply chain from farm origin through storage, processing, and delivery to final customer. Captures lot number, commodity type, originating field/farm, harvest date, GRN reference, current custody facility, chain-of-custody transfer events with timestamps, RFID tag history, split/merge lot events, COA linkage, MRL test results, PHI compliance status, and final disposition (sold, consumed, destroyed). Single authoritative record for lot-level supply chain traceability supporting FSMA Section 204 food traceability rule, GLOBALG.A.P. chain of custody, and one-up/one-back recall response.
products.reference: LOT — FSMA Section 204 Traceability Rule

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this lot traceability record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and regulatory record retention compliance.
attributes.references: FSMA Section 204 record retention requirements; SOX audit trail; ISO 22000

attributes.name: custody_transfer_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time of the most recent chain-of-custody transfer event for this lot. Represents the principal business event timestamp for the current custody state. Updated at each facility handoff.
attributes.references: FSMA Section 204 Critical Tracking Events (CTE); GLOBALG.A.P. Chain of Custody

attributes.name: disposition_date
attributes.description: The date on which the final disposition of this lot was recorded (sold, consumed, destroyed, etc.). Used for lot lifecycle closure reporting and regulatory record retention.
attributes.references: FSMA Section 204; FDA food traceability record retention requirements

attributes.name: final_disposition
attributes.description: The ultimate disposition of this lot upon closure of the traceability record. 'sold' = delivered to customer; 'consumed' = used in internal processing; 'destroyed' = disposed due to quality failure or recall; 'donated' = donated to food bank or relief; 'returned' = returned to supplier; 'pending' = disposition not yet determined.
attributes.references: FSMA Section 204; FDA recall procedures; USDA commodity disposition reporting

attributes.name: fsma_tlc
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Traceability Lot Code (TLC)
attributes.description: The FSMA Section 204-compliant Traceability Lot Code (TLC) assigned to this lot at the first point of land-based receiving or transformation. Required for FDA food traceability rule compliance and one-up/one-back recall response.
attributes.references: FSMA Section 204; FDA Food Traceability Rule 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S

attributes.name: fsma_tlc_source
attributes.business_glossary_term: FSMA Traceability Lot Code (TLC) Source Point
attributes.description: Identifies the point in the supply chain where the FSMA Traceability Lot Code (TLC) was first assigned. Required by FDA food traceability rule to establish the Critical Tracking Event (CTE) origin.
attributes.references: FSMA Section 204; FDA Food Traceability Rule 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S

attributes.name: harvest_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this lot was harvested from the originating field. Critical for Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) compliance calculations and shelf-life determination. Sourced from Climate FieldView or John Deere Operations Center harvest records.
attributes.references: FSMA Section 204 Key Data Elements; EPA PHI requirements; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: lot_event_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the lot creation or transformation event. 'original' = first-time lot creation at harvest; 'split' = divided from a parent lot; 'merge' = combined from multiple parent lots; 'repack' = repackaged without commodity change; 'reclassify' = grade or classification change.
attributes.references: FSMA Section 204 Critical Tracking Events (CTE); GLOBALG.A.P. Chain of Custody

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: The externally-known, human-readable lot identifier assigned at origin (farm or first point of aggregation). Serves as the primary business identifier for traceability across the supply chain. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA MM batch number and FSMA Traceability Lot Code (TLC).
attributes.references: FSMA Section 204; FDA Food Traceability Rule 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S; GLOBALG.A.P. Chain of Custody

attributes.name: lot_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the lot within the supply chain traceability record. Drives operational workflows, recall response, and final disposition reporting. 'on_hold' indicates quarantine or quality hold pending investigation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|in_transit|in_storage|processing|on_hold|sold|consumed|destroyed — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FSMA Section 204; GLOBALG.A.P. Chain of Custody; SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Status

attributes.name: moisture_content_pct
attributes.description: The moisture content of the commodity in this lot expressed as a percentage. Critical for storage safety (mold/mycotoxin prevention), weight adjustment calculations, and grade determination. Measured at intake and updated after drying operations.
attributes.references: USDA Grain Grading Standards 7 CFR Part 810; GLOBALG.A.P. post-harvest handling

attributes.name: mrl_test_date
attributes.description: The date on which MRL testing was performed on a representative sample from this lot. Used to determine test currency and whether re-testing is required for extended storage periods.
attributes.references: FDA Pesticide Residue Monitoring Program; Codex Alimentarius; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where this lot was produced or harvested. Required for Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) compliance and import/export documentation.
attributes.references: USDA COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) 7 CFR Part 60; ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: phi_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) was observed between the last pesticide application and the harvest date for this lot. True = PHI compliance confirmed; False = PHI violation detected. Mandatory for food safety and EPA compliance.
attributes.references: EPA Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) requirements; FSMA Produce Safety Rule 21 CFR Part 112

attributes.name: phi_days_observed
attributes.description: The actual number of days elapsed between the last recorded pesticide application and the harvest date for this lot. Used to verify PHI compliance against the label-required interval.
attributes.references: EPA PHI label requirements; FSMA Produce Safety Rule 21 CFR Part 112

attributes.name: quantity_bu
attributes.description: The current net quantity of commodity in this lot expressed in Bushels (BU), the standard US grain trade unit. Maintained alongside MT for domestic market reporting and USDA WASDE alignment.
attributes.references: USDA WASDE; CBOT grain contract specifications; SAP S/4HANA MM alternate unit of measure

attributes.name: quantity_mt
attributes.description: The current net quantity of commodity in this lot expressed in Metric Tons (MT). Updated at each custody transfer or split/merge event. Principal quantitative measure for the lot.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Quantity; WASDE reporting units

attributes.name: recall_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lot is currently subject to an active recall or withdrawal action. True = lot implicated in recall; False = no active recall. Triggers immediate operational holds and one-up/one-back notification workflows.
attributes.references: FDA Recall Procedures 21 CFR Part 7; FSMA Section 204; USDA FSIS recall procedures

attributes.name: recall_reference
attributes.description: The official FDA or USDA recall reference number associated with this lot if recall_flag is True. Enables cross-referencing with regulatory recall databases and internal recall management records.
attributes.references: FDA Recall Procedures 21 CFR Part 7; USDA FSIS Recall Case Number; FSMA Section 204

attributes.name: requires_cold_chain
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lot requires continuous cold chain management throughout storage and transportation. True = cold chain mandatory; False = ambient storage acceptable. Drives carrier selection and facility assignment.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart O; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: rfid_tag_code
attributes.description: The current active RFID tag EPC (Electronic Product Code) associated with this lot for automated identification and tracking through the supply chain. Supports real-time location tracking in Manhattan Associates WMS.
attributes.references: GS1 EPC Tag Data Standard; RFID-enabled supply chain traceability; FSMA Section 204

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this lot traceability record originated. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and Silver layer provenance tracking in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Manhattan Associates WMS; Climate FieldView; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: storage_temp_max_c
attributes.description: The maximum allowable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this lot. Exceedance triggers a cold chain exception event and potential quality hold.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule; GLOBALG.A.P. cold chain requirements

attributes.name: storage_temp_min_c
attributes.description: The minimum required storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this lot to maintain food safety and quality. Used for cold chain compliance monitoring and facility assignment validation.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Sanitary Transportation Rule; GLOBALG.A.P. cold chain requirements

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this lot traceability record was most recently modified. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and change detection for downstream consumers.
attributes.references: FSMA Section 204 record retention; SOX audit trail; ISO 22000

Feeds real-time shipment visibility and FSMA transportation compliance audit trail.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the facility, warehouse, port, border crossing, or waypoint location where this delivery event occurred. Enables geospatial traceability and facility-level compliance reporting.

Linking deliv
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent shipment record against which this delivery event is recorded. Links the event to the full shipment context including BOL, carrier, and commodity details.

attributes.name: trial_site_id
