attributes.name: awb_number
attributes.description: The Air Waybill number for air freight shipments at the time of this event. Provides cross-reference to the air transport document for perishable agricultural commodity air shipments.
attributes.references: IATA Air Waybill Standard; FSMA Transportation Rule; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: border_crossing_point
attributes.description: Name or code of the official border crossing or port of entry where the shipment crossed an international boundary. Relevant for USDA APHIS phytosanitary inspection, FDA import screening, and COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) compliance.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; FDA Import Regulations; COOL; CBP

attributes.name: cold_chain_breach
attributes.description: Indicates whether the recorded temperature at this event exceeded the allowable temperature range for the shipment, constituting a cold chain breach. Triggers food safety exception workflows and FSMA non-conformance reporting.
attributes.references: FSMA Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1; FDA Food Safety; ISO 22000; HACCP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this delivery event record was first captured in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SLA measurement of event reporting latency.
attributes.references: FSMA Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1; SOX; ISO 22000

attributes.name: customs_clearance_status
attributes.description: Status of customs clearance at the time of a border crossing or customs clearance event. Applicable for international agricultural commodity shipments subject to USDA APHIS phytosanitary inspection and FDA import controls.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; FDA Import Regulations; CBP (Customs and Border Protection); COOL

attributes.name: customs_reference_number
attributes.description: Official customs entry or declaration reference number assigned by the customs authority at border crossing or clearance events. Required for international agricultural trade compliance and USDA APHIS import documentation.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; FDA Import Regulations; CBP; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: delay_duration_minutes
attributes.description: The number of minutes by which this delivery event was delayed relative to the scheduled event timestamp. Populated for exception events of type 'delay'. Used for carrier performance KPI calculation and SLA breach reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; TMS; FSMA Transportation Rule

attributes.name: delivery_attempt_number
attributes.description: Sequential count of delivery attempts made for this shipment at the destination. Increments with each failed delivery attempt. Used to trigger escalation workflows and carrier penalty clauses after maximum attempts are exceeded.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Manhattan Associates WMS; TMS

attributes.name: electronic_signature_reference
attributes.description: Document reference or storage path to the captured electronic signature obtained at delivery confirmation. Serves as legally admissible proof of delivery for food safety compliance and commercial dispute resolution.
attributes.references: FSMA Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1; ESIGN Act; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: event_notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes recorded by the driver, carrier agent, or dispatcher at the time of the event. Captures contextual information such as access instructions, recipient comments, or site conditions not covered by structured fields.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Manhattan Associates WMS; FSMA Transportation Rule

attributes.name: event_sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordinal sequence number of this event within the shipment's delivery event chain. Enables chronological ordering of all milestone events for a given shipment to reconstruct the full delivery timeline for FSMA audit trail and analytics.
attributes.references: FSMA Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1; SAP S/4HANA SD; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the delivery event record, indicating whether the milestone was successfully completed, failed, or is awaiting confirmation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the delivery milestone event physically occurred in the real world. This is the principal business event time, distinct from record audit timestamps. Critical for FSMA transportation compliance audit trail and cold chain monitoring.
attributes.references: FSMA Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1; ISO 8601; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the delivery milestone event. Drives workflow routing, compliance audit trail, and real-time shipment visibility dashboards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pickup_confirmed|in_transit_checkpoint|border_crossing|customs_clearance|delivery_attempt|proof_of_delivery|exception — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FSMA Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1; SAP S/4HANA SD; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: exception_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the nature, cause, and immediate actions taken for an exception event. Populated when exception_type is not null. Supports carrier claims, insurance documentation, and FSMA corrective action records.
attributes.references: FSMA Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1; ISO 22000; GFSI

attributes.name: exception_type
attributes.description: Classification of the exception condition when event_type is 'exception'. Identifies the nature of the delivery failure or deviation for root cause analysis, carrier claims, and FSMA incident reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: delay|damage|refusal|temperature_breach|lost|partial_delivery — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FSMA Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1; GFSI; SAP S/4HANA QM

attributes.name: fsma_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this delivery event record satisfies all applicable FSMA Sanitary Transportation of Human and Animal Food rule requirements, including temperature control documentation, shipper-carrier agreement coverage, and traceability lot code capture.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1; FDA; ISO 22000

attributes.name: fsma_tlc_reference
attributes.description: The FSMA Traceability Lot Code associated with the commodity at this delivery event. Required under FSMA Section 204 for Foods on the Food Traceability List (FTL) to enable rapid traceback in food safety incidents.
attributes.references: FSMA Section 204; FDA Food Traceability Rule 21 CFR Part 1; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: geofence_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the GPS coordinates recorded at this event fall within the expected geofenced zone for the scheduled waypoint or facility. Used to detect route deviations and unauthorized stops in agricultural supply chain security monitoring.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS; John Deere Operations Center; FSMA Transportation Rule

attributes.name: gps_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate (decimal degrees, WGS84) of the location where this delivery event was recorded. Captured via GPS-enabled device on the transport vehicle or driver mobile device. Supports real-time shipment visibility and route compliance verification.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS; GPS/WGS84 Standard; FSMA Transportation Rule

attributes.name: gps_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate (decimal degrees, WGS84) of the location where this delivery event was recorded. Paired with gps_latitude to provide precise event geolocation for route analytics and compliance audit.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS; GPS/WGS84 Standard; FSMA Transportation Rule

attributes.name: photo_evidence_reference
attributes.description: Document reference or storage path to photographic evidence captured at the time of the delivery event. Used for damage documentation, delivery confirmation, and FSMA food safety incident records.
attributes.references: FSMA Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1; GFSI; ISO 22000

attributes.name: pod_captured
attributes.description: Indicates whether electronic proof of delivery has been captured for this event. True when an electronic signature, photo evidence, or digital confirmation has been recorded. Critical for FSMA transportation compliance and customer dispute resolution.
attributes.references: FSMA Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1; SAP S/4HANA SD; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: recipient_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who accepted or refused the delivery at the destination. Captured as part of proof of delivery documentation. Classified as confidential PII per GDPR and applicable privacy regulations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; FSMA Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: rfid_scan_code
attributes.description: The RFID tag code scanned at this delivery event checkpoint. Enables automated lot-level traceability and real-time inventory visibility across the agricultural supply chain without manual barcode scanning.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule 21 CFR Part 1; GS1 RFID Standards; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: scheduled_event_timestamp
attributes.description: The planned date and time at which this delivery milestone event was expected to occur. Compared against event_timestamp to calculate on-time performance and identify delays for carrier KPI reporting and SLA management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; TMS; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: seal_number
attributes.description: The security seal number on the container or trailer at the time of this delivery event. Verified at pickup, border crossing, and delivery to detect tampering. Required for food safety chain-of-custody documentation under FSMA.
attributes.references: FSMA Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1; CBP C-TPAT; ISO 17712 (High Security Seals)

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this delivery event record originated. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and Silver layer ingestion audit in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Manhattan Associates WMS; John Deere Operations Center

attributes.name: temperature_reading_c
attributes.description: Ambient or cargo temperature in degrees Celsius recorded at the time of this delivery event. Critical for cold chain compliance monitoring of perishable agricultural commodities. Compared against shipment-level min/max temperature thresholds to detect cold chain breaches.
attributes.references: FSMA Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1; FDA Food Safety; GLOBALG.A.P.; ISO 22000

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this delivery event record was last modified. Supports data lineage tracking and change detection in the Silver layer lakehouse pipeline.
attributes.references: SOX; FSMA Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1

products.name: freight_rate
products.description: SSOT for freight rate schedules negotiated with carriers and 3PLs for agricultural commodity transportation. Stores rate type (per mile, per CWT, per MT, per BU, flat rate), origin-destination lane, commodity class (NMFC), equipment type, effective and expiry dates, base rate, fuel surcharge formula (DOE index-linked), accessorial rate schedule (including detention/demurrage, lumper, stop-off charges), minimum charge, currency, and contracted volume tier with commitment discount. Used for freight cost estimation, carrier selection optimization, and freight audit variance analysis against actual invoices. Single authoritative record for contracted freight pricing within the supply domain.
products.reference: Carrier Rate Tariff — TMS Rate Management

attributes.name: freight_rate_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for a freight rate record. Primary key for the freight_rate data product within the supply domain.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Condition Record

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier or third-party logistics (3PL) provider with whom this freight rate is contracted. Links to the carrier master record for carrier selection optimization and freight audit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Vendor Master; TMS Carrier Management

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: Agricultural freight rates are commodity-specific — grain, produce, and livestock rates differ significantly based on handling requirements, temperature needs, and regulatory compliance costs. Linking
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: destination_location_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the destination facility, food manufacturer, retailer distribution center, or port for the freight lane covered by this rate. Defines the endpoint of the origin-destination (O-D) lane.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Plant/Storage Location; TMS Lane Management

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Freight rates are used to pre-accrue freight costs to GL accounts during rate-based accrual processes. Agriculture logistics finance teams use rate cards to generate freight expense accruals by GL acc
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: primary_freight_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the origin facility, farm, elevator, or distribution center for the freight lane covered by this rate. Defines the starting point of the origin-destination (O-D) lane for carrier selection and route optimization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Plant/Storage Location; TMS Lane Management

attributes.name: service_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent freight contract or rate agreement under which this rate schedule is established. Supports contract lifecycle management and volume commitment tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Outline Agreement; TMS Contract Management

attributes.name: base_rate
attributes.description: The contracted base freight rate amount, expressed in the unit defined by rate_type (e.g., USD per mile, USD per CWT, USD per MT, USD per BU, or flat USD amount). This is the principal monetary fact for the rate record, excluding fuel surcharge and accessorial charges. Used as the foundation for freight cost estimation and carrier invoice audit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Condition Amount; GAAP; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: commitment_discount_pct
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to the base rate when the contracted volume commitment tier is met or exceeded. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.05 = 5% discount). Incentivizes volume commitment with carriers and 3PLs for agricultural commodity lanes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Condition Discount; GAAP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this freight rate record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial reporting controls. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) - Internal Controls; GAAP Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the freight rate is denominated (e.g., USD for US Dollar, CAD for Canadian Dollar, EUR for Euro). Required for multi-currency freight cost estimation and financial reporting under GAAP/IFRS.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the destination of the freight lane. Required for export documentation, customs compliance, and international freight rate applicability.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; USDA COOL Regulations; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: destination_zip_code
attributes.description: ZIP code of the destination point for the freight lane. Used for lane-level rate matching in TMS when a specific facility ID is not available. Supports zone-based and mileage-based rate calculations.
attributes.references: USPS ZIP Code Standard; TMS Lane Rate Management

attributes.name: detention_rate_per_hour
attributes.description: Accessorial charge rate applied per hour when a carrier's equipment is detained beyond the contracted free time at origin or destination. A key component of the accessorial rate schedule for agricultural commodity shipments where loading/unloading delays are common.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Accessorial Condition; Carrier Tariff - Detention/Demurrage Rules

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this freight rate becomes binding and applicable for freight cost estimation and carrier selection. Aligns with contract start date in carrier agreements. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Condition Record Validity Start; GAAP Contract Accounting

attributes.name: equipment_type
attributes.description: Type of transportation equipment required for this rate. Refrigerated (reefer) equipment is required for cold chain management of perishable agricultural commodities. Hopper trailers are used for bulk grain. Tankers for liquid commodities. Critical for cold chain compliance under FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule (21 CFR Part 1, Subpart O); SAP S/4HANA TM Equipment Type

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which this freight rate is no longer valid for new shipment cost estimation. Null indicates an open-ended rate with no defined expiration. Retained post-expiry for freight audit variance analysis. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Condition Record Validity End; GAAP Contract Accounting

attributes.name: free_time_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours of free loading/unloading time included in the base rate before detention charges begin to accrue. Standard free time for agricultural commodity shipments is typically 2 hours. Critical for managing detention/demurrage cost exposure at grain elevators and processing facilities.
attributes.references: Carrier Tariff - Detention Rules; SAP S/4HANA TM Freight Agreement

attributes.name: freight_terms
attributes.description: Contractual freight payment terms defining who bears the freight cost and when title transfers. FOB (Free On Board) origin and destination are standard agricultural commodity trade terms. Prepaid = shipper pays; Collect = consignee pays; Third Party = billed to a third party. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA SD billing and SAP MM purchasing conditions.
attributes.references: Incoterms 2020 (ICC); SAP S/4HANA SD - Freight Terms; GAAP

attributes.name: fsma_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this freight rate is associated with a carrier that has been verified as compliant with the FSMA Sanitary Transportation of Human and Animal Food Rule (21 CFR Part 1, Subpart O). True = carrier has confirmed FSMA compliance for this lane and equipment type. Required for food safety audit and carrier qualification.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) - Sanitary Transportation Rule (21 CFR Part 1, Subpart O)

attributes.name: fuel_surcharge_formula
attributes.description: Description or formula code defining how the fuel surcharge is calculated, typically indexed to the US Department of Energy (DOE) weekly diesel retail price index. Examples: 'DOE_TABLE_LOOKUP', 'DOE_PERCENT_OF_BASE', 'FIXED_CPM' (cents per mile). Drives dynamic fuel surcharge computation in TMS freight cost estimation.
attributes.references: US Department of Energy (DOE) Diesel Retail Price Index; SAP S/4HANA MM Condition Supplement

attributes.name: fuel_surcharge_rate
attributes.description: The current or baseline fuel surcharge rate expressed as a percentage of the base rate or as a fixed amount per mile (depending on fuel_surcharge_formula). Updated periodically based on DOE index triggers. Used in freight cost estimation and carrier invoice audit.
attributes.references: US Department of Energy (DOE) Diesel Retail Price Index; SAP S/4HANA MM Condition Rate

attributes.name: lane_distance_miles
attributes.description: Contracted or calculated mileage for the origin-destination freight lane. Used for per-mile rate calculations, fuel surcharge computation, and route optimization analysis. Typically derived from PC*MILER or equivalent mileage engine integrated with TMS.
attributes.references: PC*MILER Mileage Standard; SAP S/4HANA TM - Distance Calculation

attributes.name: lumper_rate
attributes.description: Accessorial charge for lumper (third-party unloading labor) services at destination facilities such as food manufacturer warehouses and retail distribution centers. Included in the accessorial rate schedule when the carrier is responsible for arranging unloading labor.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Accessorial Condition; Manhattan Associates WMS - Receiving Labor

attributes.name: minimum_charge
attributes.description: The minimum freight charge applicable regardless of shipment weight, volume, or distance. Ensures carrier cost recovery for small or short-haul shipments. Applied during freight cost estimation when the calculated base rate falls below this threshold.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Minimum Condition Value; Carrier Tariff Standards

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the origin of the freight lane. Required for cross-border agricultural commodity movements and Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; USDA COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) Regulations

attributes.name: origin_zip_code
attributes.description: ZIP code of the origin point for the freight lane. Used for lane-level rate matching in TMS when a specific facility ID is not available. Supports zone-based and mileage-based rate calculations.
attributes.references: USPS ZIP Code Standard; TMS Lane Rate Management

attributes.name: rate_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the freight rate record, used in carrier negotiations, freight audit, and SAP S/4HANA condition record references. Enables cross-system traceability between TMS, ERP, and carrier portals.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Condition Record Number; TMS Rate Management

attributes.name: rate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the freight rate record. Active rates are available for freight cost estimation and carrier selection. Expired rates are retained for freight audit variance analysis against historical invoices. Pending rates are awaiting carrier confirmation. Suspended rates are temporarily unavailable.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Condition Record Status; TMS Rate Management

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of how the freight rate is calculated and applied. Per mile applies to truckload movements; per CWT (Hundredweight) and per MT (Metric Ton) apply to weight-based commodity pricing; per BU (Bushel) applies to grain and oilseed movements; flat rate applies to fixed-price lane agreements. Drives freight cost estimation logic in TMS.
attributes.references: NMFC (National Motor Freight Classification); SAP S/4HANA MM Condition Type

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this freight rate record originated. SAP_S4HANA indicates the rate was created in SAP S/4HANA MM condition records; TMS indicates origin from the Transportation Management System; MANUAL indicates direct entry. Supports data lineage and freight audit traceability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Condition Record; Oracle NetSuite Procurement

attributes.name: stop_off_charge
attributes.description: Accessorial charge applied for each additional stop beyond the primary origin-destination pair on a multi-stop shipment. Common in agricultural distribution routes serving multiple farm locations or delivery points. Part of the accessorial rate schedule.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Accessorial Condition; NMFTA Tariff Rules

attributes.name: temp_max_celsius
attributes.description: Maximum allowable temperature in degrees Celsius for cold chain shipments covered by this rate. Applicable to refrigerated equipment rates for perishable agricultural commodities. Enforces FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule cold chain requirements.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule (21 CFR Part 1, Subpart O); FDA Food Safety Regulations; ISO 22000

attributes.name: temp_min_celsius
attributes.description: Minimum required temperature in degrees Celsius for cold chain shipments covered by this rate. Applicable to refrigerated equipment rates for perishable agricultural commodities (produce, dairy, meat). Enforces FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule cold chain requirements.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule (21 CFR Part 1, Subpart O); FDA Food Safety Regulations; ISO 22000

attributes.name: transit_days
attributes.description: Contracted standard transit time in calendar days for the origin-destination lane at this rate. Used for delivery scheduling, cold chain management planning, and carrier service level evaluation. Critical for perishable agricultural commodity shipments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM - Transit Time; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Mode of transportation for which this freight rate applies. Truckload (TL) and less-than-truckload (LTL) are primary modes for domestic agricultural commodity movements; rail and intermodal for bulk grain; ocean for export; air for high-value perishables. Aligns with BOL and AWB documentation requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA TM - Freight Order; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule (21 CFR Part 1, Subpart O)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this freight rate record was last modified. Supports change tracking, freight audit variance analysis, and Silver Layer incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) - Internal Controls; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed

attributes.name: volume_tier_max
attributes.description: Maximum contracted volume (in the unit defined by rate_type) applicable for this rate tier. Null indicates no upper bound. Defines the upper boundary of the volume commitment tier for tiered discount rate structures.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Scale Quantity; Carrier Contract Volume Commitment

attributes.name: volume_tier_min
attributes.description: Minimum contracted volume commitment (in the unit defined by rate_type, e.g., CWT, MT, BU, or number of loads) required to qualify for this rate tier. Supports volume-based discount structures in carrier contracts. Used for commitment tracking and carrier performance management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Scale Quantity; Carrier Contract Volume Commitment

attributes.name: volume_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the volume tier commitment quantities (volume_tier_min, volume_tier_max). Aligns with the rate_type unit. CWT (Hundredweight), MT (Metric Ton), and BU (Bushel) are standard agricultural commodity units. Ensures consistent volume commitment tracking across carrier contracts.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service - Commodity Units; SAP S/4HANA MM - Unit of Measure

products.name: carrier_performance
products.description: Tracks operational performance metrics for each carrier across agricultural shipment lanes. Records carrier ID, evaluation period, on-time pickup rate, on-time delivery rate, damage claim rate, temperature excursion rate (cold chain), FSMA compliance score, total shipments executed, rejected loads count, average transit time vs. contracted, and overall performance tier (preferred/approved/probation/suspended). Drives carrier selection decisions and 3PL contract renewals.

attributes.name: carrier_performance_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each carrier performance evaluation record in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Internal Data Architecture Standard

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier (trucking company, rail operator, or 3PL) whose performance is being evaluated. Links to the carrier master record managed in SAP S/4HANA MM and TMS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1

attributes.name: compliance_audit_id

Business justification: Carrier performance evaluations in agriculture incorporate results from compliance audits (FSMA sanitary transport audits, cold chain audits, GFSI audits). Linking carrier_performance to compliance_au
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: evaluated_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Carrier performance evaluations in agriculture logistics are conducted by qualified logistics managers or procurement staff. Linking to the evaluating employee enables accountability reporting, evalua
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: service_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the active carrier rate agreement or 3PL contract under which the evaluated shipments were executed. Links to the contract master in SAP S/4HANA MM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Management; Internal Procurement Policy

attributes.name: avg_transit_time_hours
attributes.description: Average actual transit time in hours across all shipments executed by the carrier during the evaluation period. Compared against contracted transit time to assess schedule adherence.
attributes.references: Internal Supply Chain KPI Framework; SAP S/4HANA TM

attributes.name: bol_documentation_accuracy_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Bill of Lading (BOL) Documentation Accuracy Rate
attributes.description: Percentage of Bills of Lading (BOL) submitted by the carrier that were complete, accurate, and compliant with FSMA traceability requirements during the evaluation period.

attributes.name: carrier_invoice_accuracy_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of carrier freight invoices that matched the contracted rate without dispute during the evaluation period. Supports freight audit and payment (FAP) processes in SAP S/4HANA FI-AP.
attributes.references: Internal Freight Audit and Payment Policy; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP

attributes.name: cold_chain_shipments
attributes.description: Number of shipments within the evaluation period that required temperature-controlled transport (cold chain). Used as the denominator for temperature excursion rate calculations.

attributes.name: composite_performance_score
attributes.description: Weighted composite score (0-100) aggregating all KPI dimensions (on-time delivery, damage claims, FSMA compliance, temperature excursions, invoice accuracy) into a single carrier scorecard value. Basis for performance_tier assignment.
attributes.references: Internal Carrier Scorecard Methodology; GLOBALG.A.P. Supply Chain Assurance

attributes.name: contracted_transit_time_hours
attributes.description: Agreed transit time in hours as specified in the carrier contract or rate agreement for the evaluated lane. Baseline for transit time variance analysis and SLA compliance.
attributes.references: Internal Carrier Contract Management; SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the carrier performance evaluation record was first created in the Databricks Silver Layer. Audit trail field aligned with SOX data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the total_freight_cost field (e.g., USD, EUR, BRL). Supports multi-currency agricultural export operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS; GAAP

attributes.name: damage_claim_count
attributes.description: Number of shipments for which a cargo damage claim was filed against the carrier during the evaluation period. Raw numerator for damage claim rate. Impacts food safety and HACCP compliance assessments.
attributes.references: Internal Supply Chain KPI Framework; HACCP Principles; GFSI Standards

attributes.name: damage_claim_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of shipments resulting in a cargo damage claim during the evaluation period. Calculated as (damage_claim_count / total_shipments) * 100. Critical for food safety compliance and insurance cost management.
attributes.references: Internal Supply Chain KPI Framework; HACCP Principles; GFSI Standards; ISO 22000

attributes.name: evaluation_period_end_date
attributes.description: Last date of the performance evaluation window. Together with evaluation_period_start_date defines the measurement interval for all KPI metrics in this record.
attributes.references: Internal Supply Chain KPI Framework; GLOBALG.A.P. Supply Chain Assurance

attributes.name: evaluation_period_start_date
attributes.description: First date of the performance evaluation window (e.g., start of month, quarter, or contract review period). Used to define the measurement interval for all KPI calculations.
attributes.references: Internal Supply Chain KPI Framework; GLOBALG.A.P. Supply Chain Assurance

attributes.name: evaluation_period_type
attributes.description: Granularity of the performance evaluation cycle. Determines the reporting cadence for carrier scorecards and 3PL contract renewal reviews.
attributes.references: Internal Supply Chain KPI Framework

attributes.name: evaluation_status
attributes.description: Workflow status of the carrier performance evaluation record. Draft: data being compiled; Under Review: pending analyst approval; Approved: scorecard finalized; Published: shared with carrier.
attributes.references: Internal Supply Chain Governance; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: fsma_audit_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Audit Date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent FSMA sanitary transportation compliance audit conducted for this carrier. Tracks audit currency for regulatory compliance management.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1; FDA Food Safety Modernization Act

attributes.name: fsma_compliance_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Compliance Score
attributes.description: Composite score (0-100) measuring the carrier's adherence to FSMA Sanitary Transportation of Human and Animal Food rule requirements, including vehicle sanitation, temperature control documentation, and training records. Mandatory for food-grade agricultural shipments.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1; FDA Food Safety Modernization Act; GFSI Standards

attributes.name: improvement_plan_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier is currently operating under a formal Carrier Improvement Plan (CIP) due to performance deficiencies. True when a corrective action plan is in force; False otherwise.
attributes.references: Internal Carrier Management Policy; ISO 9001 Corrective Action

attributes.name: lane_destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the destination end of the primary evaluated shipping lane. Used for cross-border compliance checks and lane performance analytics.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; USDA COOL Regulations 7 CFR Part 60

attributes.name: lane_origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the origin end of the primary evaluated shipping lane. Supports COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) compliance and lane-level performance segmentation.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; USDA COOL Regulations 7 CFR Part 60

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_count
attributes.description: Number of shipments delivered within the contracted delivery window during the evaluation period. Raw numerator for on-time delivery rate calculation.
attributes.references: Internal Supply Chain KPI Framework; SAP S/4HANA TM

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of shipments delivered within the contracted delivery window during the evaluation period. Calculated as (on_time_delivery_count / total_shipments) * 100. Primary KPI for carrier selection and 3PL contract renewals.
attributes.references: Internal Supply Chain KPI Framework; GLOBALG.A.P. Supply Chain Assurance; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule

attributes.name: on_time_pickup_count
attributes.description: Number of shipments where the carrier completed pickup within the contracted pickup window during the evaluation period. Raw numerator for on-time pickup rate calculation.
attributes.references: Internal Supply Chain KPI Framework; SAP S/4HANA TM

attributes.name: on_time_pickup_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of shipments where the carrier completed pickup within the contracted pickup window during the evaluation period. Calculated as (on_time_pickup_count / total_shipments) * 100. Key carrier KPI for agricultural supply chain reliability.
attributes.references: Internal Supply Chain KPI Framework; GLOBALG.A.P. Supply Chain Assurance

attributes.name: performance_tier
attributes.description: Overall performance classification assigned to the carrier based on composite KPI scores for the evaluation period. Drives carrier selection priority in TMS route planning and 3PL contract renewal decisions. Values: preferred (top-tier, priority allocation), approved (meets standards), probation (below threshold, improvement plan required), suspended (disqualified from new loads).
attributes.references: Internal Carrier Management Policy; GLOBALG.A.P. Supply Chain Assurance; GFSI Standards

attributes.name: previous_performance_tier
attributes.description: Performance tier assigned to the carrier in the immediately preceding evaluation period. Enables tier trend analysis and escalation/de-escalation tracking for carrier management decisions.
attributes.references: Internal Carrier Management Policy

attributes.name: rejected_load_count
attributes.description: Number of loads rejected by the carrier (carrier-caused refusals) or rejected at destination due to carrier-attributable non-conformances (e.g., temperature breach, contamination) during the evaluation period.
attributes.references: Internal Supply Chain KPI Framework; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1; HACCP

attributes.name: rfid_tracking_compliance_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) Tracking Compliance Rate
attributes.description: Percentage of shipments where the carrier maintained continuous RFID tag scan compliance at all required checkpoints during the evaluation period. Supports FSMA traceability lot (LOT) tracking requirements.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule 21 CFR Part 1; FDA Food Safety Modernization Act; GS1 RFID Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which the carrier performance data was sourced (e.g., SAP S/4HANA TM, Manhattan Associates WMS). Supports data lineage and Silver Layer provenance tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Policy; Databricks Lakehouse Architecture Standards

attributes.name: temp_excursion_count
attributes.description: Number of cold chain shipments where the carrier recorded a temperature excursion outside the contracted min/max range during the evaluation period. Raw numerator for temperature excursion rate.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1; FDA Food Safety Modernization Act; ISO 22000

attributes.name: temp_excursion_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of cold chain shipments with a temperature excursion during the evaluation period. Calculated as (temp_excursion_count / cold_chain_shipments) * 100. Critical KPI for perishable agricultural commodity carriers under FSMA cold chain rules.
attributes.references: FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1; FDA Food Safety Modernization Act; ISO 22000

attributes.name: total_freight_cost
attributes.description: Total freight charges invoiced by the carrier for all shipments executed during the evaluation period, in the reporting currency. Used for COGS allocation, carrier spend analysis, and contract benchmarking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-CO; GAAP; IFRS 15

attributes.name: total_shipments
attributes.description: Total number of shipments executed by the carrier within the evaluation period. Serves as the denominator for all rate-based KPI calculations and statistical significance assessment.
attributes.references: Internal Supply Chain KPI Framework; Manhattan Associates TMS

attributes.name: transit_time_variance_hours
attributes.description: Difference between avg_transit_time_hours and contracted_transit_time_hours. Positive values indicate the carrier is running late on average; negative values indicate early delivery. Key input for route optimization and carrier negotiations.
attributes.references: Internal Supply Chain KPI Framework

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transportation used by the carrier for the evaluated shipment lanes (e.g., truck for domestic grain hauls, ocean for export containers). Aligns with BOL and AWB classification in SAP S/4HANA SD.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Transportation; INCOTERMS 2020; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the carrier performance evaluation record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Supports incremental data processing and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5; Internal Data Governance Policy

products.name: freight_invoice
products.description: SSOT for carrier-issued freight invoices covering transportation services on agricultural shipments. Captures invoice number, carrier ID, shipment/BOL references, invoice date, payment due date, line-item charges (base freight, fuel surcharge, accessorials, detention/demurrage, lumper fees, stop-off charges), total amount, currency, freight audit status (matched/disputed/approved), variance from contracted rate, three-way match status (rate vs. BOL vs. invoice), and payment status. Single authoritative record for payable-side freight cost documentation within the supply domain — distinct from customer sales invoices in the sales/invoice domains.
products.reference: Freight Audit and Payment — SAP S/4HANA FI-AP

attributes.name: freight_invoice_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate key identifying each freight invoice record in the silver layer. Primary key for the freight_invoice data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/FI Module — Vendor Invoice (MIRO/FB60)

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier (trucking company, rail operator, ocean carrier, or air freight provider) who issued this freight invoice. Links to the carrier master record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Vendor Master (LFA1); FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Freight invoices are issued within a specific legal entity for financial reporting and intercompany freight cost allocation. Multi-entity agriculture operations (e.g., separate grain trading and farmi
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: supply.freight_invoice carries a cost_center_code text field that is a denormalized reference to finance.cost_center. Freight invoices represent significant logistics costs that must be allocated to c
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: destination_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the destination facility (food manufacturer, retailer DC, or processing plant) where the shipment was delivered. Used for lane-level freight cost analytics and delivery performance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Delivery Plant; FSMA Traceability Rule 21 CFR Part 1

attributes.name: freight_booking_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.freight_booking. Business justification: A freight invoice is issued to settle charges for a specific freight booking. Adding freight_booking_id to freight_invoice enables 3-way match (PO → booking → invoice) and direct reconciliation of inv
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: freight_rate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.freight_rate. Business justification: A freight invoice references the contracted rate schedule for 3-way match and rate variance calculation. Adding freight_rate_id to freight_invoice links the invoice to the specific rate schedule, enab
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: origin_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the facility (farm, grain elevator, processing plant, or distribution center) from which the shipment originated. Used for lane-level freight cost analytics and FSMA traceability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Plant/Storage Location; FSMA Traceability Rule 21 CFR Part 1

attributes.name: service_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.service_contract. Business justification: Freight invoices are issued under service contracts that define the agreed rates, payment terms, and service obligations. Adding supply_contract_id to freight_invoice links each invoice to its governi
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipment record this freight invoice covers. Enables three-way match between the BOL, shipment execution record, and carrier invoice.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Shipment (VTTK); Manhattan Associates TMS

attributes.name: transport_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.transport_order. Business justification: A freight invoice covers transportation services authorized by a transport order. Adding transport_order_id to freight_invoice enables direct linkage from invoice to the TMS authorization document, su
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: accessorial_amount
attributes.description: Total of all accessorial charges billed on this invoice, including but not limited to liftgate, inside delivery, residential delivery, hazmat handling, and temperature-controlled service premiums. Aggregated accessorial total; line-level detail captured in freight_invoice_line.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Accessorial Condition Types; NMFC Accessorial Tariff; GAAP

attributes.name: ap_document_number
attributes.description: SAP FI accounts payable document number assigned when the freight invoice is posted in the general ledger. Links the freight invoice to the financial accounting entry for payment processing and audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Accounting Document (BKPF-BELNR); GAAP; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: approved_amount
attributes.description: The amount approved for payment after freight audit and dispute resolution. May differ from invoice_total_amount when a variance is resolved in favor of the shipper. This is the amount that will be remitted to the carrier.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Approved Invoice Amount; GAAP AP; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: audit_status
attributes.description: Status of the freight audit process specifically — distinct from overall invoice_status. Tracks whether the invoice charges have been validated against contracted rates and BOL details. 'pending' = not yet audited; 'in_review' = audit underway; 'matched' = charges match contracted rates; 'disputed' = discrepancy found; 'resolved' = dispute closed.
attributes.references: GAAP Internal Controls; SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA MM Invoice Verification (MIRO)

attributes.name: awb_number
attributes.description: Air Waybill number for air freight shipments referenced on this invoice. Nullable; populated only when transport mode is air freight. Serves as the air equivalent of the BOL for invoice matching.
attributes.references: IATA Air Waybill Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM Foreign Trade

attributes.name: base_freight_amount
attributes.description: Core transportation charge billed by the carrier before surcharges and accessorials. Represents the line-haul rate applied to the shipment weight, distance, or commodity class. Primary component of total freight cost.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Condition Type (KOFI); GAAP COGS Classification; Uniform Freight Classification

attributes.name: bol_number
attributes.description: Bill of Lading number referenced on this freight invoice. Used to match the carrier invoice against the shipment document for three-way match validation. A BOL is the legal contract between shipper and carrier.
attributes.references: 49 CFR Part 373 — Bills of Lading; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule; SAP S/4HANA SD/MM

attributes.name: contracted_rate_amount
attributes.description: Expected freight charge based on the negotiated carrier contract or rate confirmation for this lane and service type. Used as the benchmark in three-way match and freight audit to identify billing variances.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchasing Info Record / Rate Confirmation; GAAP; SOX AP Controls

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this freight invoice record was first created in the system of record. Provides the audit trail creation marker for SOX compliance and data lineage tracking in the silver layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Document Entry Date (CPUDT); SOX Section 404; GAAP Audit Trail

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this freight invoice (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR, MXN). All amount fields are denominated in this currency.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI — Currency Key (WAERS); IFRS; GAAP

attributes.name: detention_amount
attributes.description: Charges billed for detention (truck waiting at shipper/consignee beyond free time) or demurrage (rail car or container held beyond allowed dwell time). Common in agricultural supply chains during harvest peak periods.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Detention Condition Type; 49 CFR Part 370; GAAP

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description for why this freight invoice is in disputed status. Populated when audit_status = 'disputed'. Common reasons include rate mismatch, duplicate invoice, incorrect weight, unauthorized accessorial, or service failure. Nullable when no dispute exists.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Invoice Verification — Blocking Reason; GAAP AP Dispute Management

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which a freight invoice dispute was formally resolved with the carrier. Nullable; populated only when a dispute has been closed. Used to measure dispute cycle time and carrier performance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Invoice Verification Resolution; GAAP AP Controls; SOX

attributes.name: freight_terms
attributes.description: Freight payment responsibility terms indicating who bears the freight cost. 'prepaid' = shipper pays carrier; 'collect' = consignee pays carrier; 'third_party' = a third party is billed; 'prepaid_and_add' = shipper pays and adds to customer invoice.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/MM — Incoterms / Freight Terms; UCC Article 2; GAAP

attributes.name: fuel_surcharge_amount
attributes.description: Carrier-applied fuel surcharge billed on this invoice, typically calculated as a percentage of base freight based on the DOE diesel fuel index. A standard variable component of freight invoices in agricultural logistics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Condition Type (Fuel Surcharge); DOE Diesel Fuel Index; GAAP

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: SAP General Ledger account code to which the freight expense is posted (e.g., freight-in, freight-out, COGS transportation). Enables financial reporting and cost center allocation of freight expenses.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — GL Account (SKA1); GAAP Chart of Accounts; IFRS 15

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: Date the carrier issued the freight invoice. This is the principal business event date for the invoice and is used to determine payment due date and aging calculations in accounts payable.
attributes.references: GAAP — Accounts Payable Recognition; SAP S/4HANA FI Invoice Date (BLDAT)

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Externally assigned invoice number as printed on the carrier-issued freight invoice document. Used for three-way match, freight audit, and AP payment processing. Corresponds to the vendor invoice reference in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Vendor Invoice Reference (BKPF-XBLNR); GAAP AP documentation standards

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the freight invoice through the freight audit and payment workflow. 'received' = invoice received from carrier; 'under_audit' = freight audit in progress; 'matched' = three-way match passed; 'disputed' = variance identified and dispute raised with carrier; 'approved' = approved for payment; 'paid' = payment remitted; 'voided' = invoice cancelled. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: received|under_audit|matched|disputed|approved|paid|voided — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Invoice Verification Status; GAAP AP Controls; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: invoice_total_amount
attributes.description: Total gross amount billed by the carrier on this invoice, representing the sum of base freight, fuel surcharge, accessorials, detention, lumper fees, stop-off charges, and any other line items. This is the amount subject to AP payment processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Invoice Amount (WRBTR); GAAP AP Payables; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: lumper_fee_amount
attributes.description: Third-party labor charges for unloading agricultural commodities at the destination facility (lumper services). Common at food manufacturer and retailer distribution centers. Billed through the carrier on the freight invoice.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Lumper Condition Type; GAAP COGS; FSMA Sanitary Transportation

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which payment was remitted to the carrier. Nullable until payment is made. Used for cash flow reporting, on-time payment KPI tracking, and carrier relationship management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Payment Run Date (F110); GAAP AP Ledger; SOX

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which payment must be remitted to the carrier per the agreed payment terms. Derived from invoice date plus contracted payment terms (e.g., Net 30). Used for AP aging and cash flow planning.
attributes.references: GAAP — AP Payment Terms; SAP S/4HANA FI Baseline Date (ZFBDT)

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current payment status of the freight invoice from the accounts payable perspective. 'unpaid' = no payment made; 'partial' = partial payment remitted; 'paid' = fully paid; 'overpaid' = payment exceeded invoice amount (requires credit memo).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Payment Status; GAAP AP Ledger; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Contracted payment terms applicable to this freight invoice as agreed with the carrier (e.g., Net 30, Net 15, 2/10 Net 30). Determines payment due date and any early payment discount eligibility.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Payment Terms (ZTERM); GAAP AP Terms; Carrier Contract

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: SAP Purchase Order number associated with the freight service procurement. Used in three-way match (PO vs. GRN vs. invoice) for freight payables processing and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchase Order (EKKO-EBELN); GAAP AP Three-Way Match; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: rate_variance_amount
attributes.description: Monetary difference between the carrier-invoiced amount and the contracted rate amount (invoice_total_amount minus contracted_rate_amount). Positive value indicates overbilling; negative indicates underbilling. Triggers dispute workflow when outside tolerance threshold.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Invoice Verification — Price Variance; GAAP; SOX Section 404 AP Controls

attributes.name: rate_variance_pct
attributes.description: Rate variance expressed as a percentage of the contracted rate amount. Used to determine whether the variance falls within the acceptable tolerance threshold for auto-approval or requires manual freight audit review.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Invoice Verification — Tolerance Percentage; GAAP; SOX AP Controls

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Carrier service level for this shipment. LTL (Less-Than-Truckload), FTL (Full Truckload), PTL (Partial Truckload), expedited, or spot market. Determines applicable rate tariff and service expectations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Shipping Conditions; Manhattan Associates TMS Service Types

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this freight invoice record was ingested into the Databricks silver layer. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/FI; Oracle NetSuite AP; Manhattan Associates TMS; GAAP Data Lineage

attributes.name: stop_off_charge_amount
attributes.description: Additional charges billed for multi-stop shipments where the carrier makes intermediate delivery stops beyond the primary origin-destination pair. Common in agricultural distribution routes serving multiple food manufacturers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Stop-Off Condition Type; NMFC Tariff; GAAP

attributes.name: three_way_match_status
attributes.description: Result of the three-way match validation comparing the contracted rate (rate confirmation), the BOL/shipment execution record, and the carrier invoice. 'passed' = all three documents align within tolerance; 'failed' = discrepancy detected; 'waived' = match bypassed with authorization. Critical SOX control for freight payables.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 — AP Three-Way Match Control; SAP S/4HANA MM Invoice Verification; GAAP

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Mode of transportation for the shipment covered by this freight invoice. Determines applicable rate structures, regulatory requirements, and accessorial charge types. Critical for freight cost analytics by mode.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Shipment Type; FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule 21 CFR Part 1; DOT regulations

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this freight invoice record. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change data capture, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks silver layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Last Changed Timestamp; SOX Section 404; GAAP Audit Trail

products.name: service_contract
products.description: SSOT for supply chain service contracts with carriers, 3PLs, cold storage operators, and logistics service providers. Captures contract number, counterparty legal name and type, contract effective and expiry dates, service scope (lanes, modes, commodity types covered), committed volume (MT/loads per period), SLA terms (transit time targets, on-time delivery percentage, temperature compliance thresholds), penalty and incentive clauses, FSMA compliance obligations, insurance requirements (cargo, liability, workers comp), and contract status (draft/active/expired/terminated). Single authoritative record for logistics service agreements within the supply domain — distinct from procurement input supply contracts owned by the procurement domain.
products.reference: Logistics Service Agreement — SAP S/4HANA MM Contract

Linking service_contract to quality

attributes.description: Reference to the vendor/carrier master record in the supply domain representing the contracted service provider. Links to the carrier or 3PL party master for SLA tracking, payment processing, and performance analytics.

attributes.name: auto_renewal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract automatically renews upon expiry unless either party provides notice of termination within the notice period defined in termination_notice_days. Drives contract expiry alerting and renewal workflow in SAP S/4HANA MM.

attributes.name: base_freight_rate
attributes.description: Contracted base freight rate per unit of measure (per MT, per load, per km, or per CWT as defined by freight_rate_uom). Represents the primary commercial term of the agreement. Confidential as it reflects negotiated pricing strategy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Condition Record (KONP); GAAP ASC 606; IFRS 15

attributes.name: cargo_insurance_min_usd
attributes.description: Minimum required cargo insurance coverage amount in USD that the carrier or 3PL must maintain. Validated against certificate of insurance (COI) during contract onboarding and annual review.
attributes.references: FMCSA 49 CFR Part 387; USDA Risk Management Agency; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: cargo_insurance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the counterparty is contractually required to maintain cargo insurance coverage for agricultural commodities transported under this agreement. True triggers insurance certificate validation during onboarding and annual renewal.

attributes.name: committed_loads_per_period

attributes.references: CBP; USDA APHIS; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: container_number
attributes.description: ISO 6346 standardized container identification number for ocean freight shipments of agricultural commodities. Used for CBP Automated Manifest System (AMS) filing, USDA APHIS inspection scheduling, and supply chain traceability.
attributes.references: ISO 6346; CBP AMS; USDA APHIS

attributes.name: country_of_origin_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country where the agricultural commodity was grown, harvested, or substantially transformed. Required for Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) compliance under USDA Agricultural Marketing Act and CBP import regulations.
attributes.references: USDA COOL (Country of Origin Labeling); CBP; ISO 3166-1

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the customs declaration record was first created in the lakehouse Silver layer. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; ISO 22000

attributes.name: declaration_date
attributes.description: The official date on which the customs declaration was filed with the relevant customs authority. Serves as the principal business event date for the declaration lifecycle and is used for duty calculation and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: CBP; USDA APHIS; ISO 22000

attributes.name: declaration_number
attributes.description: Externally assigned unique declaration number issued by the customs authority (e.g., U.S. Customs and Border Protection Entry Number or export Electronic Export Information (EEI) Internal Transaction Number (ITN)). Used as the primary business identifier for cross-border trade compliance tracking.
attributes.references: U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP); USDA APHIS; FDA Prior Notice

attributes.name: declaration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the customs declaration. Tracks progression from draft filing through CBP/USDA review, potential inspection hold, final clearance, or rejection. Critical for supply chain visibility and FSMA compliance monitoring. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|under_review|inspection_hold|cleared|rejected|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CBP; USDA APHIS; FSMA Transportation Rule

attributes.name: declaration_type
attributes.description: Classifies the direction and nature of the customs declaration: import (inbound agricultural commodity), export (outbound), re-import, re-export, or transit. Drives applicable regulatory requirements and documentation sets.
attributes.references: CBP; USDA APHIS; Codex Alimentarius Commission

attributes.name: declared_value
attributes.description: The declared transaction value of the agricultural commodity shipment as reported to customs authorities, expressed in the declared currency. Used as the basis for ad valorem duty and tariff calculations. Must comply with WTO Customs Valuation Agreement (GATT Article VII).
attributes.references: WTO Customs Valuation Agreement; CBP; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: declared_value_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the declared customs value (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD). Required for accurate duty calculation and financial reporting under GAAP/IFRS.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; WTO Customs Valuation Agreement; IFRS

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country to which the agricultural shipment is consigned. Determines applicable import regulations, phytosanitary requirements, and tariff schedules at the destination.
attributes.references: CBP; ISO 3166-1; Codex Alimentarius Commission

attributes.name: fda_prior_notice_number
attributes.description: The FDA Prior Notice confirmation number required under the Bioterrorism Act (21 CFR Part 1, Subpart I) for food and agricultural commodities imported into the United States. Must be submitted to FDA before the shipment arrives at the U.S. port of entry.
attributes.references: FDA Prior Notice (21 CFR Part 1, Subpart I); FSMA; Bioterrorism Act of 2002

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight of the declared agricultural commodity shipment in kilograms, including packaging. Required field on customs declarations for duty calculation, phytosanitary inspection, and transport compliance.
attributes.references: CBP; USDA APHIS; WCO Harmonized System

attributes.name: hs_tariff_code
attributes.description: The Harmonized System (HS) tariff classification code assigned to the agricultural commodity being imported or exported. Used to determine applicable duty rates, trade restrictions, and phytosanitary requirements. Aligns with the harmonized_tariff_code tracked at the shipment line level.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Harmonized System; USDA APHIS; CBP

attributes.name: import_duty_amount
attributes.description: The calculated import duty amount assessed on the agricultural commodity shipment, expressed in the declared value currency. Computed by CBP based on the HS tariff code, declared value, and applicable duty rate. Recorded for financial accrual and COGS reporting.
attributes.references: CBP; USDA; GAAP; IFRS; SOX

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms 2020) code defining the responsibilities of buyer and seller for delivery, risk transfer, and cost allocation in the cross-border agricultural trade transaction (e.g., FOB, CIF, DAP). Affects customs valuation methodology. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; WTO Customs Valuation Agreement; CBP

attributes.name: inspection_hold_agency
attributes.description: The regulatory agency that placed the inspection hold on the agricultural shipment. Identifies whether the hold was initiated by USDA APHIS (phytosanitary), CBP (customs), FDA (food safety), EPA (pesticide residues), or FSIS (meat/poultry). Populated only when inspection_hold_flag is True.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; CBP; FDA; EPA; FSIS

attributes.name: inspection_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agricultural shipment has been placed on an inspection hold by USDA APHIS, CBP, or FDA at the port of entry/exit. When True, the shipment cannot be released until inspection is completed and hold is lifted.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; CBP; FDA; FSMA

attributes.name: net_weight_kg
attributes.description: Net weight of the agricultural commodity in kilograms, excluding packaging and tare weight. Used for duty calculation on weight-based tariffs and for USDA/FDA quantity reporting.
attributes.references: CBP; USDA APHIS; FDA Prior Notice

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country from which the shipment physically departs. May differ from country_of_origin_code when goods transit through intermediate countries before export.
attributes.references: CBP; ISO 3166-1; USDA APHIS

attributes.name: phytosanitary_cert_number
attributes.description: The official phytosanitary certificate number issued by USDA APHIS Plant Protection and Quarantine (PPQ) program (forms PPQ 586 for imports or PPQ 587 for exports). Certifies that the agricultural commodity meets the phytosanitary requirements of the importing country and is free from regulated pests.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS PPQ 586/587; International Plant Protection Convention (IPPC); ISPM 12

attributes.name: port_of_entry_exit_code
attributes.description: Official CBP port code or UN/LOCODE identifying the port of entry (for imports) or port of exit (for exports) through which the agricultural shipment crosses the border. Used for USDA APHIS inspection scheduling and FDA Prior Notice filing.
attributes.references: CBP Schedule D; UN/LOCODE; USDA APHIS

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this customs declaration record was sourced (e.g., SAP S/4HANA MM for import/export declarations, Oracle NetSuite for trade compliance). Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Oracle NetSuite; SOX; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: tariff_rate_pct
attributes.description: The applicable ad valorem tariff rate percentage applied to the declared value of the agricultural commodity. Derived from the HS tariff code and trade agreement provisions (e.g., USMCA, CPTPP). Used for duty calculation and trade cost analysis.
attributes.references: CBP Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS); WTO; USMCA

attributes.name: trade_agreement_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the preferential trade agreement under which the agricultural commodity qualifies for reduced or zero duty rates (e.g., USMCA, CPTPP, US-Korea FTA). Determines eligibility for duty preference claims and certificate of origin requirements.
attributes.references: USMCA; WTO; CBP; USDA Foreign Agricultural Service (FAS)

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Mode of transport used to carry the agricultural commodity across the border. Determines applicable customs entry type, FDA Prior Notice timing requirements, and FSMA transportation rule applicability.
attributes.references: CBP; FDA Prior Notice; FSMA Transportation Rule; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the customs declaration record. Supports audit trail, change tracking, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; ISO 22000

products.name: carrier_location_approval
products.description: This association product represents the formal approval contract between a freight carrier and an authorized delivery location in the agricultural supply chain. It captures which carriers are approved to serve which receiving facilities, under what service terms, commodity authorizations, and temperature zone agreements. Each record links one carrier to one delivery location and carries attributes that exist only in the context of this approval relationship — such as service level, approved commodity types, temperature zone capability, and approval validity dates. Managed by logistics compliance and transportation teams.. Existence Justification: In agricultural logistics, specific carriers must be formally approved to serve specific delivery locations based on facility-level requirements such as temperature capability, vehicle weight limits, FSMA certification, and dock compatibility. A carrier can be approved to serve many delivery locations, and a delivery location can accept many approved carriers — this approval relationship is actively managed by logistics and compliance teams, not derived from transactional data. The business explicitly tracks which carriers are authorized for which locations, under what service terms, and for which commodity types.

products.name: facility_commodity_capability
products.description: This association product represents the operational capability configuration between a supply chain facility and an agricultural commodity. It captures the specific storage capacity allocation, temperature zone assignment, organic segregation capability, and handling certifications that exist only in the context of a particular facility handling a particular commodity. Each record defines what a facility can do for a specific commodity — enabling logistics planning, compliance verification, and capacity allocation decisions across the agricultural supply network.. Existence Justification: In agricultural operations, a single facility (e.g., a grain elevator) actively handles multiple commodities simultaneously — corn, soybeans, and wheat may all be stored in segregated bins with different capacity allocations, temperature requirements, and handling certifications. Conversely, a single commodity like Yellow Corn No. 2 is stored and processed across many facilities in the logistics network. The business actively manages this relationship through commodity-specific storage configurations, organic segregation capabilities, and handling certifications that are unique to each facility-commodity pairing — this is not derivable from transactional data alone.

products.name: route_stop
products.description: This association product represents the Route Stop — the operational assignment of a customer delivery location as a designated stop on a planned transportation route within the agricultural supply chain TMS. It captures the specific stop-level planning data that exists only in the context of a route-to-delivery-location relationship: stop sequence, arrival windows, commodity types served, and service frequency. Each record links one route to one delivery location and is actively created, updated, and deleted by TMS planners as route networks evolve seasonally or as customer delivery points are added or removed.. Existence Justification: In agricultural TMS operations, a single route corridor (e.g., Midwest Grain Corridor) genuinely serves multiple customer delivery locations along its path — grain elevators, food processing plants, and distribution hubs are all stops on the same route. Conversely, a delivery location such as a major grain elevator or food manufacturing plant dock is realistically served by multiple routes originating from different farm regions or origins. The business actively manages this as a 'Route Stop' or 'Route-to-Location Assignment' — a TMS planning concept with its own operational data including stop sequence, arrival windows, commodity types served, and service frequency.

products.name: contract_commodity_coverage
products.description: This association product represents the Coverage Contract between service_contract and commodity. It captures the commodity-specific terms negotiated within a logistics service contract — including committed volumes, freight rates, and temperature/transit SLA targets that apply to a specific commodity under a specific carrier or 3PL agreement. Each record links one service_contract to one commodity with attributes that exist only in the context of this pairing and cannot reside on either parent entity alone.. Existence Justification: In agricultural logistics, a single service contract with a carrier or 3PL explicitly covers multiple commodity types (e.g., a contract covering corn, soybeans, and wheat simultaneously), each with distinct committed volumes, freight rates, and temperature compliance targets. Conversely, a single commodity like Yellow Corn No. 2 is covered by many different service contracts across different carriers, lanes, and contract periods. The business actively manages these commodity-specific terms within each contract — this is not an analytical derivation but an operational record that logistics and supply chain teams create and maintain.
