domains.name: inventory
domains.description: SSOT for all agricultural inventory positions across grain bins, cold storage, warehouses, and field stockpiles. Tracks commodity lots (LOT/GRN), quantities in CWT, BU, and MT, storage location assignments, FIFO/FEFO rotation, shrinkage, expiration dates (PHI), stock rotation, and WMS-driven cycle counts. Manages seed, chemical, fertilizer, and harvested commodity stock levels with SAP S/4HANA MM and Manhattan Associates WMS integration. Ensures GRN processing and inventory accuracy for supply chain continuity.
domains.references: FSMA Preventive Controls, SAP MM / WMS Standards

products.name: stock_position
products.description: Core master record of current inventory positions across all agricultural storage locations (grain bins, cold storage, warehouses, field stockpiles). Tracks on-hand, reserved, and available-to-promise quantities in CWT, BU, and MT by material, commodity lot, and location. Includes stock type (unrestricted, quality inspection, blocked), valuation class, unit price, total value, and valuation method (standard cost, moving average, FIFO). Supports period-end valuation snapshots capturing valuation date, quantity, unit price, total value in USD, price variance, and SAP accounting document reference for GAAP/IFRS inventory valuation, COGS calculation, and commodity position reporting. Serves as the SSOT for real-time stock levels, inventory valuation, and period-end financial inventory reporting. Supports GS1 GTIN and SSCC identifiers for global supply chain interoperability. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA MM and Manhattan Associates WMS.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor_contract. Business justification: In agriculture grain and input trading, commodity lots are received against specific vendor contracts. Linking commodity_lot to vendor_contract enables contract volume utilization tracking, contracted
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supplier or grower who delivered this commodity lot. Required for procurement traceability, COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) compliance, and vendor quality scorecarding in SAP S/4HANA MM.
attributes.references: USDA COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) 7 CFR Part 60; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; FSMA Supplier Verification

attributes.name: best_before_date
attributes.description: The best-before date for this commodity lot, after which quality may degrade but the product may still be safe for consumption. Used for FEFO (First Expired First Out) rotation logic in WMS and for customer shipment eligibility checks. Distinct from expiration_date which represents a hard safety cutoff.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101.100 food labeling; Codex Alimentarius General Standard for the Labelling of Prepackaged Foods; EU Food Information Regulation 1169/2011

attributes.name: coa_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Certificate of Analysis (COA) issued for this commodity lot by an accredited laboratory, documenting quality test results including moisture, protein, mycotoxins, pesticide residues, and heavy metals. Required for customer shipment documentation and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Laboratory Accreditation; ISO/IEC 17025 laboratory testing; GFSI COA requirements; SQF Code Edition 9

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country where this commodity was produced or harvested. Required for USDA Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) compliance, export documentation (BOL, AWB), and customs declarations.
attributes.references: USDA COOL 7 CFR Part 60 and 65; ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; CBP import/export regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commodity lot record was first created in the system, typically upon GRN posting in SAP S/4HANA MM or inbound receipt confirmation in Manhattan Associates WMS. Serves as the audit trail anchor for record lineage and FSMA traceability documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM document creation timestamp; FSMA Section 204 record creation requirements; ISO 22000:2018 traceability records

attributes.name: days_to_expiry
attributes.description: Number of days remaining until the lot's expiration_date as of the last inventory snapshot date. Used for FEFO prioritization alerts, customer minimum shelf-life requirement checks, and proactive disposition planning. Negative values indicate the lot is past expiration.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS FEFO logic; SAP S/4HANA MM shelf-life management; GFSI shelf-life requirements

attributes.name: disposition_action
attributes.description: Prescribed disposition action for this commodity lot, particularly for lots in quarantine, hold, or expired status. Determined by quality management review in SAP QM. Drives downstream WMS and logistics workflows for lot resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Usage Decision; FDA FSMA Preventive Controls disposition requirements; HACCP corrective action procedures

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Hard expiration date for this commodity lot, after which the product must not be sold or used for food/feed purposes. Triggers automatic lot status change to 'expired' in WMS and SAP MM. Used as the primary FEFO sort key for lot selection in Manhattan Associates WMS pick logic.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101 food labeling; FSMA Preventive Controls for Human Food 21 CFR Part 117; ISO 22000:2018

attributes.name: gmo_status
attributes.description: GMO status of the commodity lot indicating whether the crop is genetically modified, non-GMO, or identity-preserved (IP) non-GMO with documented segregation. Required for export documentation, customer labeling compliance, and USDA NOP organic certification. Identity-preserved lots require full chain-of-custody documentation.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service Non-GMO Program; EU Regulation 1829/2003 on GM food and feed; GLOBALG.A.P. GMO traceability; ISO 21569 GMO detection methods

attributes.name: grade
attributes.description: Official USDA grade designation assigned to this commodity lot based on moisture, test weight, damaged kernels, foreign material, and other quality factors per FGIS Official Grain Standards. Grade determines market price, storage eligibility, and end-use suitability.
attributes.value_regex: US No.1|US No.2|US No.3|US No.4|US No.5|Sample Grade
attributes.references: USDA GIPSA Official Grain Standards of the United States; 7 CFR Part 810; FGIS grading procedures

attributes.name: grn_number
attributes.description: Goods Receipt Note reference number generated in SAP S/4HANA MM upon physical receipt of the commodity lot at a storage facility. Links the lot to the inbound delivery and purchase order for procurement traceability and inventory valuation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Goods Receipt (MIGO); USDA Agricultural Marketing Act

attributes.name: gs1_sscc
attributes.description: 18-digit GS1 Serial Shipping Container Code assigned to the pallet or container carrying this commodity lot, enabling RFID and barcode scanning for pallet-level traceability from farm to table. Supports EDI and WMS integration with Manhattan Associates.
attributes.references: GS1 General Specifications; FDA FSMA Section 204 Key Data Elements; EU General Food Law Regulation 178/2002

attributes.name: hold_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason this commodity lot has been placed on hold or quarantine status. Examples include: failed mycotoxin test, suspected pesticide contamination, pending COA, supplier dispute, or regulatory investigation. Required when lot_status is 'hold' or 'quarantine'.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Usage Decision; FDA FSMA Preventive Controls corrective actions; HACCP CCP deviation documentation

attributes.name: is_organic_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commodity lot is certified organic under the USDA National Organic Program (NOP) or equivalent international organic certification. Organic-certified lots require strict segregation from conventional lots and carry premium pricing. Must be supported by a valid Certificate of Analysis (COA) from an accredited certifier.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) 7 CFR Part 205; EU Organic Regulation 2018/848; IFOAM Organic Standards

attributes.name: last_cycle_count_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent WMS-driven cycle count or physical inventory verification for this commodity lot. Used to assess inventory accuracy, trigger recount workflows, and support FSMA traceability audit readiness. Managed through Manhattan Associates WMS cycle count module.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS Cycle Count; SAP S/4HANA MM Physical Inventory; USDA Warehouse Act inventory verification requirements

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric lot identifier assigned at receipt or production, used for traceability across the agricultural supply chain. Corresponds to SAP MM batch number and Manhattan WMS lot number. Serves as the primary business-facing identifier for FIFO/FEFO rotation, recall management, and FSMA Section 204 traceability.
attributes.references: FSMA Section 204; FDA Traceability Rule 21 CFR Part 1; SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Management; GLOBALG.A.P. traceability standard

attributes.name: lot_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the commodity lot within the inventory management system. Drives FIFO/FEFO rotation logic, WMS pick eligibility, and disposition workflows. 'quarantine' and 'hold' statuses block lot from fulfillment until quality release. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: available|quarantine|hold|released|consumed|expired|disposed — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Status Management; Manhattan Associates WMS lot status; FDA FSMA inventory controls

attributes.name: manufacture_date
attributes.description: Date on which this commodity lot was produced, processed, or packaged. For harvested commodities, this is the harvest date. For processed products (feed, flour, oil), this is the processing date. Used as the anchor date for shelf-life and expiration calculations.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101 food labeling; FSMA Preventive Controls Rule; ISO 22000 Food Safety Management

attributes.name: moisture_content_pct
attributes.description: Moisture content of the commodity lot expressed as a percentage of total weight, measured at receipt or post-drying. Critical quality parameter for grain grading, shrinkage calculation, storage eligibility, and price discounting. USDA standard moisture for corn is 15.5%, wheat 13.5%, soybeans 13%.
attributes.references: USDA Grain Inspection Packers and Stockyards Administration (GIPSA) grain standards; FGIS Official Grain Standards of the United States

attributes.name: quantity_bu
attributes.description: Current on-hand quantity of the commodity lot expressed in bushels (BU), the standard US grain trade unit of measure. Used for grain elevator accounting, CBOT futures hedging, and WASDE supply reporting. One bushel equals 56 lbs for corn/sorghum, 60 lbs for wheat/soybeans.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service bushel weight standards; CBOT grain contract specifications; DTN market data

attributes.name: quantity_cwt
attributes.description: Current on-hand quantity of the commodity lot expressed in hundredweight (CWT = 100 lbs), commonly used for livestock feed, cotton, and specialty crop pricing and billing. Supports SAP MM inventory valuation in CWT-denominated contracts.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service CWT pricing standards; SAP S/4HANA MM unit of measure configuration

attributes.name: quantity_mt
attributes.description: Current on-hand quantity of the commodity lot expressed in metric tons (MT), the standard international trade unit. Used for export documentation, CIF/FOB contracts, and Codex Alimentarius reporting. Derived from BU quantity using commodity-specific conversion factors but stored for operational efficiency.
attributes.references: Codex Alimentarius international commodity standards; FAO trade reporting; USDA FAS export data

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: Date on which this commodity lot was physically received at the storage facility and the GRN was posted in SAP S/4HANA MM. Serves as the FIFO anchor date for first-in-first-out rotation logic and the start of the storage tenure calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Receipt (MIGO); Manhattan Associates WMS inbound receipt; USDA Warehouse Act

attributes.name: received_quantity_bu
attributes.description: Original quantity of this commodity lot at the time of GRN receipt, expressed in bushels. Preserved as the immutable receipt quantity for shrinkage calculation, inventory reconciliation, and audit trail. Distinct from quantity_bu which reflects current on-hand quantity after consumption and adjustments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Receipt quantity; USDA Warehouse Act scale ticket requirements; Manhattan Associates WMS receipt confirmation

attributes.name: rotation_method
attributes.description: Inventory rotation method applied to this commodity lot for pick sequencing in Manhattan Associates WMS. FIFO (First In First Out) is standard for grain; FEFO (First Expired First Out) is required for perishable produce and feed with expiration dates. FEFO_FIFO applies FEFO when expiration dates exist, otherwise FIFO.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS lot rotation configuration; FDA FSMA inventory management best practices; GFSI stock rotation requirements

attributes.name: shrinkage_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of quantity lost from this lot due to moisture evaporation, handling losses, or storage shrink since receipt. Calculated as (received_quantity - current_quantity) / received_quantity * 100. Used for inventory valuation adjustments, storage contract billing, and loss reporting.
attributes.references: USDA GIPSA grain shrinkage standards; SAP S/4HANA MM inventory difference posting; Granular Farm Management shrink tracking

attributes.name: storage_type
attributes.description: Type of storage facility where this commodity lot is currently held. Determines applicable storage conditions, monitoring requirements, and handling procedures. Cold storage lots require temperature and humidity monitoring per FDA FSMA Produce Safety Rule.
attributes.references: USDA Warehouse Act storage type classifications; FDA FSMA Produce Safety Rule 21 CFR Part 112; ISO 22000 storage requirements

attributes.name: test_weight_lbs_bu
attributes.description: Test weight of the commodity lot measured in pounds per bushel (lbs/bu), a key grain quality indicator reflecting kernel density and market grade. Minimum test weights per USDA GIPSA: corn 56 lbs/bu (No.1), wheat 60 lbs/bu (No.1), soybeans 56 lbs/bu (No.1). Affects price premiums and discounts.
attributes.references: USDA GIPSA Official Grain Standards; FGIS grain grading procedures; CBOT delivery specifications

attributes.name: uom_primary
attributes.description: The primary unit of measure used for inventory management and reporting of this commodity lot (e.g., BU for grain, MT for export commodities, CWT for feed). Aligns with SAP MM base unit of measure configuration and Manhattan WMS UOM settings. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BU|MT|CWT|LB|KG|TON|BAG|UNIT — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Unit of Measure; ISO 80000-1 quantities and units; USDA commodity measurement standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this commodity lot record, including quantity adjustments, status changes, quality updates, or location transfers. Supports audit trail requirements and Silver Layer delta processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM change document; Manhattan Associates WMS audit log; FSMA traceability record maintenance requirements

Integrates with Manhattan Associates WMS location master.

attributes.name: capacity_bu
attributes.description: Maximum rated storage capacity of this location expressed in Bushels (BU), the standard volumetric unit for grain commodities (corn, soybeans, wheat). Used for grain bin and elevator capacity planning and USDA reporting.

attributes.name: capacity_cwt
attributes.description: Maximum rated storage capacity of this location expressed in Hundredweight (CWT), a unit commonly used for livestock feed, fertilizer, and certain commodity pricing in North American agricultural markets.

attributes.name: capacity_mt
attributes.description: Maximum rated storage capacity of this location expressed in Metric Tons (MT). Used for international trade reporting, export documentation, and compliance with Codex Alimentarius and EU food safety standards.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City in which the storage facility is located. Used for regional reporting, logistics zone assignment, and regulatory jurisdiction determination.

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date on which this storage location was officially commissioned and made available for operational use. Marks the start of the location's active lifecycle for asset management and depreciation purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM (Plant Maintenance) Asset Master; CAPEX Tracking

attributes.name: commodity_class
attributes.description: Primary commodity classification that this storage location is designed or certified to store. Drives applicable regulatory requirements, handling procedures, and inventory segregation rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: grain|oilseed|produce|livestock_feed|seed|chemical|fertilizer|mixed — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 country code for the country where the storage location is situated (e.g., 'USA', 'CAN', 'BRA'). Used for Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) compliance and international trade documentation.

attributes.name: cycle_count_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency for WMS-driven physical inventory cycle counts at this storage location. Determines how often inventory accuracy is verified against system records to support FIFO/FEFO compliance and shrinkage detection.

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: Date on which this storage location was or is scheduled to be permanently decommissioned and removed from active inventory operations. Nullable for active locations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Asset Retirement; USDA Warehouse License Surrender

attributes.name: fda_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Facility Registration Number
attributes.description: FDA facility registration number assigned under the Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) for food storage facilities. Required for facilities storing human or animal food commodities subject to FDA jurisdiction.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Section 415; 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart H

attributes.name: fifo_fefo_method
attributes.description: Inventory rotation method enforced for this storage location. FIFO (First-In-First-Out) is standard for grain; FEFO (First-Expired-First-Out) is required for perishables and chemicals with Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) constraints. Drives WMS pick sequencing.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS Rotation Rules; SAP S/4HANA MM FEFO/FIFO Configuration; FDA FSMA; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: food_safety_certification
attributes.description: Primary food safety certification standard held by this storage facility (e.g., Safe Quality Food (SQF), British Retail Consortium (BRC), International Featured Standards (IFS), ISO 22000, HACCP). Drives customer eligibility and audit requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SQF|BRC|IFS|GLOBALG.A.P.|ISO22000|HACCP|none — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GFSI (Global Food Safety Initiative); SQF Institute; BRC Global Standards; IFS; ISO 22000; HACCP

attributes.name: gln
attributes.description: GS1 Global Location Number (GLN) — a 13-digit internationally standardized identifier uniquely identifying this physical storage location within the global supply chain. Used for Electronic Data Interchange (EDI), traceability, and GLOBALG.A.P. compliance.
attributes.references: GS1 GLN Standard; GLOBALG.A.P. (Global Good Agricultural Practices); FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: gmo_segregation_required

attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage location is designated for Genetically Modified Organism (GMO)-segregated storage, requiring physical separation from non-GMO commodities. True = GMO segregation enforced; False = no segregation requirement.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP); GLOBALG.A.P. GMO Segregation; EU GMO Labeling Regulations

attributes.name: humidity_controlled

attributes.references: USDA Grain Storage Guidelines; GLOBALG.A.P.; ISO 22000

attributes.name: last_cycle_count_date

attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS Cycle Count Records; SAP S/4HANA MM Inventory Count

attributes.name: last_inspection_date

attributes.name: latitude

attributes.name: location_code

attributes.name: location_status

attributes.name: location_type

attributes.name: longitude

attributes.name: max_humidity_pct

attributes.name: max_temperature_c

attributes.name: min_humidity_pct
attributes.description: Minimum relative humidity level (%) designed or required for this storage location. Controls moisture conditions to prevent commodity degradation, mold growth, and seed viability loss.
attributes.references: USDA Grain Storage Guidelines; GLOBALG.A.P. Storage Requirements; ISO 22000

attributes.name: min_temperature_c
attributes.description: Minimum allowable or designed operating temperature for this storage location in degrees Celsius. Critical for cold storage, refrigerated warehouses, and seed vaults to maintain product viability and food safety compliance.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA); USDA Cold Storage Standards; ISO 22000

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date

attributes.references: USDA Warehouse Act; FDA FSMA; GFSI Audit Schedule

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: organic_certified

attributes.name: postal_code

attributes.name: sap_storage_location_code

attributes.name: temperature_controlled

attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the aisle within the storage section where this bin is physically located. Used for optimizing pick paths and directing warehouse personnel to the correct physical location.

attributes.name: allowed_material_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of SAP material type codes permitted for storage in this bin (e.g., 'FERT,DUNG,ERSA' for fertilizers, seeds, and spare parts). Enforces material segregation rules and prevents incompatible commodity co-mingling. Managed in SAP S/4HANA MM material type configuration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Type (T134); HACCP Material Segregation Requirements; EPA Pesticide Storage

attributes.name: bin_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the bin within its storage location. Used in WMS slot management, pick/put-away instructions, and RFID scanning operations. Corresponds to the WMS bin number in Manhattan Associates.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Bin Master; SAP S/4HANA WM — Storage Bin (T331)

attributes.name: bin_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name or label for the bin location (e.g., 'North Grain Bin Cell 3A', 'Cold Bay 12', 'Rack Position A-02-03'). Used in operational reports and warehouse floor maps.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Bin Master

attributes.name: bin_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the bin location within the WMS. Active bins are available for put-away and picking; blocked bins are temporarily unavailable; reserved bins are pre-allocated; under_maintenance bins are being serviced; decommissioned bins are permanently retired.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Bin Status; SAP S/4HANA WM — Storage Bin Status

attributes.name: bin_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical bin structure. Determines storage rules, capacity constraints, and compatible material types. Grain bin cells hold harvested commodities; rack positions hold packaged goods; cold storage bays hold perishables; floor stacks hold palletized inventory; bulk piles hold loose commodities; chemical cabinets hold agrochemicals. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: grain_bin_cell|rack_position|cold_storage_bay|floor_stack|bulk_pile|chemical_cabinet — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Bin Type Configuration; SAP S/4HANA WM — Storage Type

attributes.name: capacity_bu
attributes.description: Maximum storage capacity of the bin expressed in Bushels (BU), the standard unit of measure for grain commodities in US agricultural operations. Used for grain bin cell utilization planning and WASDE reporting alignment.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service — Grain Standards; WASDE Reporting

attributes.name: capacity_cwt
attributes.description: Maximum storage capacity of the bin expressed in Hundredweight (CWT), a standard unit used for livestock feed, fertilizer, and certain commodity pricing in US agricultural markets.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service — CWT Commodity Pricing Standards

attributes.name: capacity_mt
attributes.description: Maximum storage capacity of the bin expressed in Metric Tons (MT). Used for international trade documentation, export compliance, and alignment with global commodity reporting standards (CIF/FOB contracts).
attributes.references: Codex Alimentarius Commission — Commodity Standards; International trade FOB/CIF documentation

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date the bin location was officially commissioned and made available for use in the WMS. Marks the start of the bin's operational lifecycle and is used for asset age tracking, depreciation scheduling, and capacity planning.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the bin location record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for data lineage and supports SOX financial reporting controls for inventory master data governance.
attributes.references: SOX — Internal Controls over Financial Reporting; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); ISO 22000

attributes.name: current_utilization_pct
attributes.description: Current fill level of the bin expressed as a percentage of its maximum capacity. Calculated from WMS inventory positions and updated on each stock movement. Drives replenishment triggers and bin assignment logic in Manhattan Associates WMS.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Bin Utilization Reporting; SAP S/4HANA MM — Warehouse Utilization

attributes.name: decommissioning_date
attributes.description: Date the bin location was permanently decommissioned and removed from active WMS operations. Nullable for active bins. Used for capacity planning, asset retirement reporting, and historical inventory analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM — Equipment Retirement; Manhattan Associates WMS — Bin Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: height_cm
attributes.description: Physical height dimension of the bin location in centimeters. Determines compatibility with stacked pallets, tall containers, or bulk commodity storage. Used in conjunction with level_code for equipment selection (e.g., high-reach forklift requirements).
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Bin Dimensions; OSHA Material Handling Standards

attributes.name: is_gmo_segregated
attributes.business_glossary_term: Genetically Modified Organism (GMO) Segregated Bin Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bin is designated for GMO-segregated commodity storage. When True, the bin is used exclusively for non-GMO or identity-preserved commodities, supporting COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) and non-GMO supply chain traceability requirements.

attributes.name: is_hazmat_compatible

attributes.name: is_organic_segregated

attributes.name: last_cleaned_date

attributes.references: FDA FSMA — Preventive Controls for Human Food (21 CFR Part 117); HACCP; GLOBALG.A.P.; SQF Code

attributes.name: last_cycle_count_date

attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Cycle Count Management; FDA FSMA — Traceability Rule (21 CFR Part 1, Subpart S)

attributes.name: last_inspected_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical inspection of the bin location for structural integrity, pest presence, moisture ingress, or contamination. Supports USDA APHIS pest management compliance and GFSI audit readiness.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS — Pest Management; GFSI — Facility Inspection Requirements; BRC Global Standards; SQF

attributes.name: length_cm
attributes.description: Physical length dimension of the bin location in centimeters. Used for slotting optimization, determining compatible pallet or container sizes, and space utilization analysis within the warehouse management system.

attributes.name: max_temp_celsius
attributes.description: Maximum allowable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this bin location. Exceeding this threshold triggers WMS alerts and may require stock relocation to prevent quality degradation or food safety violations.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA — Sanitary Transportation Rule; ISO 22000; GLOBALG.A.P. Cold Chain Requirements

attributes.name: max_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum allowable weight load for this bin location in kilograms. Critical for structural safety compliance, particularly for rack positions and floor stacks. Prevents overloading that could cause structural failure or OSHA safety violations.
attributes.references: OSHA — General Industry Standards (29 CFR 1910.159); Structural Engineering Load Standards

attributes.name: min_temp_celsius
attributes.description: Minimum allowable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this bin location. Used to enforce cold chain compliance and prevent commodity spoilage. Monitored via IoT sensors integrated with the WMS.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA — Sanitary Transportation Rule; ISO 22000; GLOBALG.A.P. Cold Chain Requirements

attributes.name: put_away_strategy
attributes.description: WMS put-away strategy assigned to this bin, governing how incoming stock is directed to this location. Fixed bins always receive the same material; open bins accept any compatible material; bulk bins receive large-volume commodity transfers; addition bins consolidate partial pallets; next_empty bins are filled sequentially.

attributes.name: rfid_tag_number
attributes.description: RFID tag identifier physically attached to the bin location for automated scanning and real-time inventory tracking. Enables touchless bin identification during put-away, picking, and cycle count operations in Manhattan Associates WMS.
attributes.references: GS1 RFID Standards — EPC Gen2; Manhattan Associates WMS — RFID Integration

attributes.name: rotation_method
attributes.description: Inventory rotation method applied to stock stored in this bin. LIFO and LEFO may apply to non-perishable inputs.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA — Preventive Controls for Human Food; HACCP Principles; ISO 22000; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: row_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the row within the aisle for this bin. Combined with aisle_code and level_code to form the full physical coordinate of the bin within the warehouse.

attributes.name: storage_section_code

attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Storage Section; SAP S/4HANA WM — Storage Section (T334)

attributes.name: temperature_zone
attributes.description: Temperature-controlled zone classification for the bin. Determines which commodities (e.g., fresh produce, frozen goods, ambient grain) can be stored in this bin. Critical for cold chain compliance and food safety under FDA and FSMA requirements.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.references: SOX — Internal Controls over Financial Reporting; Manhattan Associates WMS — Audit Trail; SAP S/4HANA Change Documents

attributes.name: width_cm

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this reorder policy record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial reporting controls.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; ISO 22000 Record Keeping

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this reorder policy configuration becomes active and is included in MRP planning runs. Supports seasonal policy activation and planned policy transitions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP Configuration; FMIS Best Practices

attributes.name: eoq
attributes.description: Optimal replenishment order quantity calculated to minimize total inventory holding and ordering costs. Expressed in primary UOM. Used as the fixed lot size in SAP MM MRP lot-sizing procedures.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Lot Size; APICS EOQ Model; GAAP Inventory Costing

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which this reorder policy is no longer active. Null indicates an open-ended policy with no planned end date. Enables time-bound seasonal or campaign-specific replenishment configurations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP Configuration; FMIS Best Practices

attributes.name: goods_receipt_processing_days
attributes.description: Number of workdays required to process a goods receipt (GRN) after physical delivery, including quality inspection, weighing, and WMS putaway. Added to lead time in MRP net requirements calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM GR Processing Time; Manhattan Associates WMS; HACCP

attributes.name: is_hazmat
attributes.description: Indicates whether this material is classified as hazardous (e.g., pesticides, herbicides, fumigants). When true, EPA SDS requirements, REI (Restricted Entry Interval), and special storage/handling rules apply.
attributes.references: EPA Hazardous Materials; OSHA SDS; REI Compliance; APHIS

attributes.name: is_mrp_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reorder policy is currently included in SAP MM MRP planning runs. When false, the policy exists as a configuration record but does not trigger automated purchase requisitions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP Planning Flag

attributes.name: is_regulated_substance
attributes.description: Indicates whether this material is subject to regulatory quantity limits, licensing, or reporting requirements (e.g., restricted-use pesticides under EPA, controlled fertilizers under APHIS). Triggers compliance workflow on purchase requisition.
attributes.references: EPA Pesticide Registration; APHIS; USDA; FSMA

attributes.name: is_seasonal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this material experiences significant seasonal demand fluctuations (e.g., planting season seeds, harvest-time chemicals). When true, seasonal demand profiles are applied in MRP planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP Seasonal Planning; USDA Crop Calendar; FMIS Best Practices

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date when this reorder policy was last reviewed and validated by the inventory planner or supply chain manager. Supports periodic policy governance and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P.; ISO 22000; SOX Internal Controls; FSMA

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Expected number of calendar days from purchase requisition creation to goods receipt at the storage location. Used by SAP MM MRP to calculate replenishment timing and avoid stockouts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP Planned Delivery Time; APICS CPIM

attributes.name: lot_size_procedure
attributes.description: SAP MM MRP lot-sizing procedure that determines how replenishment quantities are calculated: fixed order quantity, lot-for-lot (exact requirement), EOQ, period-based, or min-max. Maps to SAP Lot Size field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP Lot Sizing; APICS CPIM

attributes.name: maximum_order_qty
attributes.description: Maximum quantity allowed per single purchase requisition to control procurement spend, storage capacity, and perishability risk. Expressed in primary UOM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP Maximum Lot Size; FSMA Traceability

attributes.name: maximum_stock_qty
attributes.description: Upper bound on inventory quantity for this material at this storage location. Replenishment orders will not exceed this level. Prevents overstocking and storage capacity violations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP Maximum Stock Level; Manhattan Associates WMS Capacity Management

attributes.name: minimum_order_qty
attributes.description: Minimum quantity that must be ordered per purchase requisition, typically driven by supplier minimum order requirements or packaging constraints. Expressed in primary UOM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP Minimum Lot Size; Supplier Contract Terms

attributes.name: minimum_remaining_shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days of remaining shelf life required at time of goods receipt for the material to be accepted into stock. Rejects deliveries that do not meet this threshold per quality management policy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Shelf Life Check; HACCP; GLOBALG.A.P.; ISO 22000

attributes.name: mrp_type
attributes.description: SAP MRP planning type that governs how replenishment is triggered: reorder point (ROP), time-phased planning, consumption-based, or manual. Directly maps to SAP MM MRP Type field (e.g., VB, VM, PD).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP; APICS Supply Chain Standards

attributes.name: order_multiple_qty
attributes.description: Quantity increment by which replenishment orders must be rounded up (e.g., full pallet, full bin, full truckload). Ensures orders align with supplier packaging or transport unit constraints.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP Rounding Value; APICS Lot Sizing

attributes.name: peak_season_end_month
attributes.description: Calendar month (1–12) when peak seasonal demand ends for this material. Defines the seasonal window during which elevated reorder points and safety stock levels are applied.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Seasonal MRP; USDA Crop Calendar; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: peak_season_safety_stock_qty
attributes.description: Elevated safety stock quantity applied during the defined peak season window (e.g., planting or harvest period). Overrides the standard safety stock quantity during peak months.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Seasonal Safety Stock; APICS CPIM; USDA

attributes.name: peak_season_start_month
attributes.description: Calendar month (1–12) when peak seasonal demand begins for this material. Used to adjust reorder points and safety stock levels ahead of high-demand periods such as planting or harvest seasons.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Seasonal MRP; USDA Crop Calendar; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for this reorder policy record, used in SAP MM MRP planning runs and cross-system references.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP Configuration; FMIS Best Practices

attributes.name: policy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the reorder policy configuration. Only active policies are evaluated during SAP MM MRP planning runs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP Configuration; FMIS Best Practices

attributes.name: procurement_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material is procured externally (purchased from supplier), produced in-house, or both. Drives SAP MM MRP to generate purchase requisitions vs. planned orders.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP Procurement Type

attributes.name: purchasing_organization
attributes.description: SAP purchasing organization responsible for negotiating and executing supply contracts for this material. Defines the legal and organizational entity that issues purchase orders.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing Organization; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: reorder_point_qty
attributes.description: Stock level threshold at which a purchase requisition is automatically triggered in SAP MM MRP. Expressed in the primary unit of measure (CWT, BU, or MT). When on-hand quantity falls to or below this value, replenishment is initiated.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP Reorder Point; APICS CPIM Standards

attributes.name: rotation_method
attributes.description: Inventory rotation method applied to this material: FIFO (First In First Out), FEFO (First Expired First Out), LIFO (Last In First Out), or manual. FEFO is mandatory for perishable commodities and chemicals with expiration dates per FSMA and HACCP requirements.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule; HACCP; GLOBALG.A.P.; Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: safety_stock_qty
attributes.description: Minimum buffer stock quantity maintained to protect against demand variability and supply lead time uncertainty. Expressed in primary UOM. Corresponds to SAP MM Safety Stock field in MRP 2 view.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP Safety Stock; APICS CPIM; ISO 22000

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days this material can be stored before it expires or degrades below acceptable quality standards. Used to enforce FEFO rotation and calculate expiration dates from goods receipt date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Shelf Life; FSMA; FDA; HACCP; MRL Compliance

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required storage environment for this material. Drives assignment to compatible storage locations (e.g., cold storage for perishables, hazmat-certified bins for chemicals). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ambient|refrigerated|frozen|controlled_atmosphere|dry|hazmat — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HACCP; EPA SDS Requirements; USDA Cold Storage Standards; FDA

attributes.name: uom_primary
attributes.description: Primary unit of measure in which all quantity thresholds (reorder point, safety stock, maximum stock, EOQ) are expressed. Supports CWT (hundredweight), BU (bushel), and MT (metric ton) per agricultural inventory standards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CWT|BU|MT|LB|KG|GAL|L|EA — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM UOM; USDA Agricultural Measurement Standards; APICS

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this reorder policy record was last modified. Used for change detection in downstream MRP planning runs and data pipeline incremental loads.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; SAP S/4HANA Change Documents

products.name: warehouse_task
products.description: WMS-generated operational task record for physical warehouse activities including putaway, picking, replenishment, consolidation, relabeling, and cycle count execution. Captures task number, task type, assigned operator, source bin, destination bin, material, lot, quantity, task status (open, in-progress, confirmed, cancelled), priority, creation timestamp, completion timestamp, and execution duration. Sourced from Manhattan Associates WMS task management. Supports warehouse labor productivity tracking and operational efficiency measurement.
products.reference: Manhattan Associates WMS Task Management

attributes.name: asset_id

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; Manhattan Associates WMS Equipment Management

attributes.name: commodity_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the inventory lot (LOT/GRN batch) being moved or counted in this task. Supports FIFO/FEFO rotation enforcement and full traceability from farm to table per FSMA requirements.

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse operator (workforce member) assigned to execute this task. PARTY_REFERENCE for this TRANSACTION_HEADER. Used for labor productivity tracking, OEE measurement, and workforce planning via SAP SuccessFactors integration.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors; Manhattan Associates WMS Labor Management; OSHA Workforce Records

attributes.description: Reference to the agricultural material (seed, chemical, fertilizer, or harvested commodity) that is the subject of this warehouse task. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA MM material master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.bin_location. Business justification: warehouse_task has source_bin (STRING) as a denormalized WMS bin reference for the pick/source location. WMS tasks operate at bin level — adding source_bin_location_id FK links to the bin_location mas

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_reservation. Business justification: warehouse_task can be triggered by a stock_reservation (picking task to fulfill a reservation for production, sales, or field application). Adding stock_reservation_id FK (nullable) links the task to
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: stock_transfer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.stock_transfer. Business justification: warehouse_task has reference_document_number (STRING) and reference_document_type (STRING) as polymorphic references. A stock_transfer generates multiple warehouse tasks (pick from source bin, putaway
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the storage location (warehouse zone or area) within the plant where this task is scoped. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA MM storage location and Manhattan Associates WMS location hierarchy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: assigned_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this task was assigned to a specific warehouse operator in WMS. Used to calculate queue wait time (time from creation to assignment) as a labor management KPI.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS Labor Management

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason provided when a task is cancelled before completion (e.g., material not found, bin location error, order cancelled, system error). Populated only when task_status = cancelled. Supports root cause analysis for operational improvement.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS Task Management

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the warehouse operator confirmed task completion in WMS. Used to calculate execution duration, throughput rates, and SLA compliance. Null if task is not yet completed or was cancelled.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS Task Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this warehouse task was created in Manhattan Associates WMS. RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED for this TRANSACTION_HEADER. Also serves as the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP representing when the operational need was identified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; ISO 8601

attributes.name: destination_bin
attributes.description: WMS bin address (aisle-bay-level-position) to which the material is to be placed or transferred. Corresponds to the destination bin field in Manhattan Associates WMS task management. Used for putaway optimization and bin capacity planning.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS Task Management

attributes.name: equipment_type
attributes.description: Category of material handling equipment used for this task. Drives labor standard calculations, aisle access rules, and capacity planning. Forklift and reach truck are common in grain elevator and cold storage environments.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS Equipment Configuration; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.178

attributes.name: execution_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Elapsed time in seconds between task start and task completion. Sourced directly from Manhattan Associates WMS task management (not derived in the Silver Layer). Used for labor standard comparison, operator productivity benchmarking, and warehouse KPI reporting.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS Labor Management; KPI Reporting

attributes.name: grn_number
attributes.description: Goods Receipt Note (GRN) number associated with the inbound receipt that created the inventory being handled in this task. Provides traceability back to the original receiving event in SAP S/4HANA MM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Receipt; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: is_cycle_count_discrepancy
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cycle count task resulted in a quantity discrepancy between the WMS system quantity and the physically counted quantity. When true, triggers an inventory adjustment workflow in SAP S/4HANA MM and may require supervisor approval.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS Cycle Count; SAP S/4HANA MM Inventory Management

attributes.name: is_hazardous
attributes.description: Indicates whether the material involved in this task is classified as hazardous (e.g., pesticides, herbicides, fumigants with EPA/SDS requirements). When true, triggers special handling protocols, REI (Restricted Entry Interval) enforcement, and SDS documentation requirements.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA; OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200; SDS Requirements

attributes.name: is_temperature_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this task involves temperature-controlled storage (cold storage, refrigerated warehouse). When true, operator must follow cold chain handling procedures and temperature monitoring requirements per FDA and FSMA cold chain rules.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Sanitary Transportation Rule; ISO 22000 Cold Chain

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking assigned by WMS to determine task execution sequence. Lower values indicate higher urgency. Used by warehouse management to sequence operator workloads and meet order fulfillment SLAs. Typically ranges 1 (highest) to 99 (lowest) per Manhattan Associates WMS configuration.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS Task Management

attributes.name: qty_confirmed
attributes.description: Actual quantity of material confirmed by the operator upon task completion. May differ from qty_required due to short picks, partial putaways, or cycle count discrepancies. Drives inventory adjustment postings in SAP S/4HANA MM.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA MM Inventory Management

attributes.name: qty_required
attributes.description: Quantity of material required to be moved, counted, or processed as specified when the task was created. Expressed in the primary unit of measure (UOM) for the material. QUANTITATIVE_RESULT for this non-monetary transaction.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: qty_variance
attributes.description: Difference between qty_required and qty_confirmed (qty_required minus qty_confirmed). Positive value indicates a short pick or under-count; negative value indicates an over-pick or over-count. Used for shrinkage analysis and inventory accuracy KPI reporting.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; SAP S/4HANA MM Inventory Accuracy

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: Source document number that triggered this task, such as a SAP Sales Order (SO), Purchase Order (PO), Transfer Order, or Goods Receipt Note (GRN). Provides end-to-end traceability from business document to physical warehouse execution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/SD; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: reference_document_type
attributes.description: Type of source document that triggered this task. SO=Sales Order, PO=Purchase Order, GRN=Goods Receipt Note, TO=Transfer Order, RO=Return Order, CC=Cycle Count authorization. Enables filtering and reporting by business process origin.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/SD; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: rotation_method
attributes.description: Inventory rotation rule applied when selecting the source lot for this task. FIFO (First In First Out) is standard for most agricultural commodities; FEFO (First Expired First Out) is applied for perishables and inputs with PHI (Pre-Harvest Interval) constraints. Ensures compliance with food safety and quality standards.
attributes.references: USDA FSMA; GLOBALG.A.P.; FDA Food Safety; ISO 22000

attributes.name: sap_transfer_order_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA WM/EWM transfer order number corresponding to this WMS task. Enables reconciliation between Manhattan Associates WMS task execution and SAP inventory postings for financial and inventory accuracy reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/WM Module

attributes.name: standard_time_seconds
attributes.description: Engineered labor standard time in seconds for this task type and material/distance combination, as configured in Manhattan Associates WMS labor management. Used to calculate labor efficiency ratio (actual vs. standard) for OEE and workforce productivity reporting.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS Labor Management; REFA Work Measurement Standards

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the warehouse operator began executing this task (scanned first location or confirmed task start in WMS). Used to calculate actual execution duration and labor productivity metrics.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS Task Management

attributes.name: task_group
attributes.description: WMS task group or wave identifier that bundles multiple related tasks for coordinated execution (e.g., a picking wave for a sales order shipment or a cycle count batch). Corresponds to the Task Group field in Manhattan Associates WMS.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS Wave Management

attributes.name: task_number
attributes.description: Externally-known WMS-generated alphanumeric task identifier used by warehouse operators and supervisors to reference a specific task in Manhattan Associates WMS. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this transaction. Corresponds to the Task ID field in Manhattan Associates WMS task management module.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS Task Management

attributes.name: task_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the warehouse task as tracked in Manhattan Associates WMS. LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this TRANSACTION_HEADER. open=task created and awaiting assignment; in_progress=operator has accepted and started execution; confirmed=task completed and confirmed in WMS; cancelled=task voided before completion; on_hold=task paused pending resolution.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS Task Management

attributes.name: task_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical warehouse activity to be performed. Drives labor routing, equipment assignment, and productivity measurement. Values: putaway (inbound stock placement), picking (outbound order fulfillment), replenishment (bin restocking), consolidation (combining partial loads), relabeling (label correction/update), cycle_count (physical inventory verification per WMS cycle count schedule).
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; USDA FSMA Inventory Traceability

attributes.name: uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure in which task quantities (qty_required, qty_confirmed) are expressed. Agricultural commodities use industry-standard units: CWT (Hundredweight), BU (Bushel), MT (Metric Ton). Inputs such as seed and chemicals may use KG, LB, EA, CS, or BAG. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CWT|BU|MT|KG|LB|EA|CS|BAG — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Measurement Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM UOM Configuration

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this warehouse task record was last modified in the source WMS or Silver Layer. RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED for this TRANSACTION_HEADER. Tracks status changes, reassignments, and quantity corrections.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Audit

attributes.name: wave_number
attributes.description: Outbound wave release number that triggered this picking or replenishment task. Links the task to a specific order fulfillment wave in Manhattan Associates WMS, enabling wave-level productivity and throughput analysis.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS Wave Planning

attributes.name: wms_task_number
attributes.description: Native task identifier from Manhattan Associates WMS source system. Preserved for cross-system reconciliation and audit trail between the Silver Layer lakehouse and the operational WMS. Distinct from the surrogate warehouse_task_id.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Integration

products.name: quarantine_hold
products.description: Transactional record managing inventory holds and quarantine status for lots or stock positions pending quality inspection, regulatory review, or food safety investigation. Captures hold number, material, lot, location, quantity on hold in CWT/BU/MT, hold type (quality, regulatory, safety, recall, customer_complaint), hold reason, initiating event reference (COA failure, HACCP deviation, MRL exceedance per EPA/EU Regulation 396/2005), hold start date, expected release date, actual release date, disposition decision (release, rework, destroy, return), and approver. Integrates with SAP QM usage decision and supports FDA/USDA recall response procedures, EU RASFF (Rapid Alert System for Food and Feed) notifications, and Codex Alimentarius food safety standards.

products.name: approved_vendor_material
products.description: This association product represents the Approved Vendor List (AVL) contract between material_master and vendor. It captures the operational qualification and commercial terms governing each approved vendor-material sourcing relationship in agricultural procurement. Each record links one material to one approved vendor and carries attributes — qualification status, preferred rank, contracted price, lead time, and minimum order quantity — that exist only in the context of this specific vendor-material pairing and cannot reside on either the material master or the vendor master alone.. Existence Justification: In agricultural procurement, a single material (e.g., glyphosate herbicide, hybrid corn seed, urea fertilizer) is routinely sourced from multiple approved vendors at different contracted prices, lead times, and minimum order quantities — and each vendor supplies many different materials. The business actively manages an Approved Vendor List (AVL) per material, tracking qualification status, preferred ranking, contracted pricing, and lead times for each vendor-material combination. This is a well-recognized operational concept in agriculture procurement that procurement teams create, update, and retire as supply agreements change.

products.name: lot_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between commodity_lot and account in the agricultural commodity trading process. It captures the operational commitment of a specific quantity from a commodity lot to a customer account, typically governed by a forward contract or sales order. Each record links one commodity_lot to one account with attributes — allocated quantity, price, status, and contract reference — that exist only in the context of this allocation relationship and cannot reside on either the lot or the account alone.. Existence Justification: In agricultural commodity trading, a single commodity lot is routinely split and allocated to multiple customer accounts (e.g., a 50,000 bu corn lot sold in portions to three food manufacturers under separate forward contracts), and a customer account simultaneously holds allocations across many commodity lots. The business actively manages these allocations as operational records — creating, updating, and cancelling them — with quantity, price, status, and contract reference data that belongs to neither the lot nor the account alone. This is a recognized operational concept in grain trading known as a 'Lot Allocation' or 'Commodity Allocation'.

products.name: lot_fulfillment
products.description: This association product represents the fulfillment event between a commodity_lot and a delivery_order in the agricultural supply chain. It captures the operational allocation of a specific commodity lot (or portion thereof) to a specific delivery order, recording quantity allocated, quantity actually delivered, lot split percentage, and quality measurements (grade and moisture) confirmed at the time of delivery. Each record links one commodity_lot to one delivery_order and carries attributes that exist only in the context of this specific lot-to-delivery pairing, supporting FSMA Section 204 traceability, quality settlement, and FIFO/FEFO rotation compliance.. Existence Justification: In grain trading and agricultural supply chain operations, a single delivery order is routinely fulfilled by blending or splitting multiple commodity lots (e.g., combining two partial bins of corn to meet a 50,000 BU delivery order), and a single commodity lot can be allocated across multiple delivery orders over time (e.g., a large 100,000 BU lot split across three separate customer deliveries). The business actively manages this lot-to-delivery allocation as an operational record — tracking quantity allocated, quality at delivery, and moisture per lot-delivery combination — for FSMA Section 204 traceability, quality settlement, and regulatory compliance. This is a recognized operational concept in grain merchandising known as 'lot allocation' or 'lot fulfillment', with its own data (quantity_allocated_bu, moisture_at_delivery, quality_grade_at_delivery) that belongs to neither the lot nor the delivery order alone.

products.name: lot_pesticide_exposure
products.description: This association product represents the PHI Compliance Linkage event between a commodity_lot and a pesticide_use_record. It captures the regulatory determination of whether a specific pesticide application affects a specific commodity lot's pre-harvest interval compliance status. Each record links one commodity_lot to one pesticide_use_record and carries the compliance attributes that exist only in the context of this specific lot-application pairing — including the PHI compliance outcome, the area of the lot affected, and the active ingredient exposure details. Required for FSMA Section 204 traceability, EPA pesticide use reporting, and pre-harvest clearance workflows.. Existence Justification: In agricultural operations, a single commodity lot (harvested from a field over a season) is subject to multiple pesticide applications, each generating its own PUR — and a single pesticide application event can affect multiple commodity lots harvested from the same field across different harvest windows. The business actively manages this relationship to determine PHI compliance status for each lot, which is a regulatory obligation under EPA and FSMA rules. This is not an analytical correlation — it is an operational compliance record that agronomists and compliance officers create, query, and audit as part of pre-harvest clearance workflows.

products.name: nonconformance
products.description: Unified master record for all quality failures, deviations, and food safety incidents across crop production, livestock operations, processing, and supply chain. Captures nonconformance type (product, process, system, MRL_exceedance, food_safety_incident), severity level (minor, major, critical, food_safety_crisis), affected lot, commodity or product SKU, detection point and source. For standard nonconformances: disposition decision, financial impact estimate, regulatory notification flag. For MRL-type: pesticide active ingredient, detected residue level, applicable MRL standard (EPA, EU, Codex), exceedance magnitude, affected export market. For food safety incidents: incident subtype (contamination, foreign material, allergen, pathogen, chemical), hazard classification, recall class (I, II, III), mock recall flag, affected quantity and value, regulatory agencies notified, root cause category, and incident closure status. SSOT for ALL quality failures from minor process deviations through food safety crises, recalls, and market withdrawals.
