attributes.description: Indicates whether this record represents a mock/simulated recall exercise rather than an actual recall event. Required for GFSI, SQF, BRC, and GLOBALG.A.P. certification audit readiness.
attributes.references: SQF Code Edition 9; BRC Global Standard Issue 9; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements

attributes.name: nc_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the nonconformance record within the quality management workflow.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; ISO 9001:2015; FSMA

attributes.name: nonconformance_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nonconformance category. 'product' = physical product defect; 'process' = deviation from SOP/GMP; 'system' = management system gap; 'mrl_exceedance' = Maximum Residue Limit (MRL) exceedance; 'food_safety_incident' = HACCP/FSMA food safety event.
attributes.references: ISO 22000:2018; FSMA; GLOBALG.A.P.; EPA MRL Standards

attributes.name: qm_notification_number
attributes.description: External quality notification number from SAP S/4HANA QM module (Q-notification). Serves as the cross-system business identifier for this nonconformance record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; ISO 9001:2015

attributes.name: quantity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the affected quantity. Supports MT (Metric Ton), BU (Bushel), CWT (Hundredweight), KG, LB, L, GAL, UNIT, CASE per agricultural industry standards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MT|BU|CWT|KG|LB|L|GAL|UNIT|CASE — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: recall_class
attributes.description: FDA/USDA recall classification. Class I = serious adverse health consequences or death; Class II = temporary adverse health consequences; Class III = unlikely to cause adverse health consequences. Populated for food safety incidents requiring recall.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7; USDA FSIS Recall Procedures; FSMA

attributes.name: regulatory_agencies_notified
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of regulatory agencies formally notified of this nonconformance (e.g., FDA, USDA, FSIS, EPA, APHIS). Populated when regulatory_notification_required is True.
attributes.references: FSMA; FDA 21 CFR Part 1; USDA FSIS; APHIS; EPA

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this nonconformance triggers a mandatory regulatory notification obligation to USDA, FDA, FSIS, EPA, or APHIS. Drives compliance workflow escalation.
attributes.references: FSMA Section 415; FDA 21 CFR Part 1; USDA FSIS Directive; APHIS Regulations

attributes.name: reported_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the person who initially reported or raised the nonconformance. Supports accountability tracking and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015; FSMA; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the identified root cause of the nonconformance. Supports trend analysis, corrective action prioritization, and CAPA program management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: raw_material|process_deviation|equipment_failure|human_error|supplier_issue|environmental|pest_contamination|storage_condition — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 10.2; FSMA CAPA Requirements; GFSI; SQF Code; BRC Global Standards

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the identified root cause following investigation. Supports 5-Why or fishbone analysis documentation for CAPA and audit evidence.
attributes.references: ISO 9001:2015 Clause 10.2; FSMA; GFSI; SQF Code; BRC Global Standards

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Risk-based severity classification of the nonconformance. 'minor' = low risk, no regulatory impact; 'major' = significant deviation requiring corrective action; 'critical' = immediate risk to product integrity or compliance; 'food_safety_crisis' = imminent public health risk requiring recall or regulatory notification.
attributes.references: HACCP Codex Alimentarius; FSMA; GFSI; BRC Global Standards; SQF Code

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Stock Keeping Unit identifier for the finished product or processed commodity involved in the nonconformance. Used for traceability and market withdrawal coordination.
attributes.references: GS1 Standards; FSMA Traceability Rule; COOL Regulations

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent update to the nonconformance record. Supports change tracking, audit trail integrity, and data lineage in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 22000:2018; FSMA; SOX; GDPR Article 5

products.name: certificate_of_analysis
products.description: Certificate of Analysis (COA) master records for agricultural commodities, processed products, and inputs. Captures issuing laboratory, sample lot reference (LOT), commodity type, test date, analytical parameters tested (moisture, protein, mycotoxin, pesticide residue, heavy metals, microbial counts), pass/fail status per parameter, MRL compliance flags, and customer-facing release status. Integrates with SAP QM usage decision and supports GFSI certification documentation.
products.reference: COA (Certificate of Analysis) / SAP QM Inspection Lot

attributes.name: certificate_of_analysis_id
attributes.description: Primary key for certificate_of_analysis

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: COAs in agriculture are issued to specific buyers for commodity lots they are purchasing. The 'COA issuance to buyer' process is fundamental — customers require COAs before accepting delivery. Linking
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: grading_standard_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.grading_standard. Business justification: COAs issue a USDA grade determination (usda_grade stored as denormalized text). Linking to grading_standard normalizes the grade reference, enabling buyer contract compliance verification, USDA AMS gr
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: laboratory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.laboratory. Business justification: COAs are issued by specific laboratories. The COA table has issuing_lab_name and lab_accreditation_number (strings) but lacks structured FK. This FK enables joining to get complete laboratory details
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: mrl_threshold_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.mrl_threshold. Business justification: COA mrl_compliant flag and pesticide_residue_result_ppm require reference to the specific regulatory tolerance for the active ingredient/commodity/jurisdiction combination. Export market compliance (E
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: authorized_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the qualified person (laboratory director, quality manager, or authorized signatory) who approved and released this COA. Required for GFSI audit documentation and regulatory traceability.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025:2017 Section 8.8 — Complaints; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; BRC Global Standard Issue 9 Clause 3.5

attributes.name: coa_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable identifier for the COA document as issued by the laboratory or quality department. Used on customer-facing documentation and GFSI audit packages.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; BRC Global Standard Issue 9; SQF Code Edition 9

attributes.name: coa_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the COA document. 'released' indicates the COA is approved for customer-facing distribution. 'superseded' indicates a newer version has replaced this record. Drives SAP QM usage decision workflow.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM — Usage Decision; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements

attributes.name: commodity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the agricultural commodity or product covered by this COA (e.g., grain, oilseed, fresh produce, livestock product, processed food, agricultural input). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: grain|oilseed|fresh_produce|livestock_product|processed_food|agricultural_input|feed|fertilizer|pesticide — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) Commodity Classification; GLOBALG.A.P. Scope

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country where the commodity was produced or harvested. Required for COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) compliance under USDA AMS regulations.
attributes.references: USDA AMS COOL — Country of Origin Labeling 7 CFR Part 60; ISO 3166-1 alpha-3

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this COA record was first created in the system. Audit trail field supporting FSMA record-keeping requirements and GFSI documentation retention policies.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117 Subpart F — Records; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which the COA is no longer considered valid for commercial or regulatory purposes. Typically tied to product shelf life or certification validity period.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; SQF Code Edition 9 Module 2

attributes.name: gfsi_scheme
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI) Certification Scheme
attributes.description: GFSI-recognized food safety certification scheme under which this COA was generated or which governs the testing requirements (SQF, BRC, IFS, FSSC 22000, GLOBALG.A.P.). Determines applicable testing protocols and documentation standards.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements v2020; SQF Code Edition 9; BRC Global Standard Issue 9; IFS Food Version 7; FSSC 22000 Version 5.1

attributes.name: gmo_status
attributes.description: GMO testing result for the lot. 'identity_preserved' indicates the lot has been maintained under IP (Identity Preserved) protocols from seed to shipment. Required for EU export documentation and non-GMO customer specifications.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205; EU Regulation 1829/2003 — GMO Food and Feed; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA v6

attributes.name: haccp_ccp_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point (HACCP) Critical Control Point (CCP) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all HACCP Critical Control Point (CCP) parameters tested in this COA are within established critical limits. False triggers mandatory corrective action under FSMA Preventive Controls and FSIS HACCP regulations.
attributes.references: Codex Alimentarius CAC/RCP 1-1969 — HACCP System; FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; FSIS 9 CFR Part 417

attributes.name: heavy_metal_type
attributes.description: Specific heavy metal analyte tested. Each metal has distinct regulatory maximum levels under FDA, Codex Alimentarius, and EU regulations requiring separate tracking.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Industry — Metals in Food; Codex Alimentarius CXS 193-1995

attributes.name: heavy_metals_result_ppm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Heavy Metals Test Result (Parts Per Million)
attributes.description: Measured concentration of heavy metal contaminants (lead, cadmium, arsenic, mercury) in parts per million. Compared against FDA and Codex Alimentarius maximum levels for food safety compliance.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Industry — Metals in Food; Codex Alimentarius CXS 193-1995; EU Regulation 1881/2006 Annex Section 3

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Certificate of Analysis was formally issued and signed off by the authorized laboratory or quality manager. This is the principal business event date for the COA document lifecycle.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements v2020; BRC Global Standard Issue 9 Clause 6.2

attributes.name: microbial_result
attributes.business_glossary_term: Microbial Count Result (Colony Forming Units per gram)
attributes.description: Measured microbial count expressed as colony forming units per gram (CFU/g). Covers total plate count, E. coli, Salmonella, Listeria, and other pathogens per HACCP critical control point specifications.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117 — Preventive Controls for Human Food; FSIS HACCP Regulations 9 CFR Part 417; Codex Alimentarius CAC/RCP 1-1969

attributes.name: microbial_test_type
attributes.description: Specific microbiological analyte or pathogen tested. Salmonella and Listeria are HACCP critical control point parameters under FSMA Preventive Controls and FSIS regulations.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; FSIS 9 CFR Part 417 — HACCP Systems; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements

attributes.name: moisture_pct
attributes.description: Measured moisture content of the commodity expressed as a percentage of total weight. Critical quality parameter for grain storage, mold prevention, and commodity grading under USDA AMS standards.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Grain Inspection Handbook; AACC International Method 44-15.02

attributes.name: mrl_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether all pesticide residue results are within the applicable Maximum Residue Limits (MRL) for the target market. True = compliant; False = MRL exceedance detected. Critical for export certification and GLOBALG.A.P. audit readiness.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180; Codex Alimentarius MRL Database; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA v6 CB 7.6; EU Regulation 396/2005

attributes.name: mycotoxin_result_ppb
attributes.description: Measured concentration of mycotoxins (aflatoxin, deoxynivalenol, fumonisin, ochratoxin, zearalenone) in parts per billion (ppb). Compared against FDA action levels and EU MRL limits for regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Industry — Mycotoxin Levels in Human Food and Animal Feed; EU Regulation 1881/2006; Codex Alimentarius CXS 193-1995

attributes.name: mycotoxin_type
attributes.description: Specific mycotoxin analyte tested in this COA record. Different mycotoxins have distinct FDA action levels and MRL thresholds under Codex Alimentarius and EU regulations.
attributes.references: FDA Guidance for Industry — Mycotoxin Levels; Codex Alimentarius CXS 193-1995; EU Regulation 1881/2006

attributes.name: overall_result
attributes.description: Aggregate pass/fail determination across all analytical parameters tested. A single 'fail' on any critical parameter (e.g., MRL exceedance, mycotoxin above regulatory limit) results in an overall 'fail'. Drives the release_status decision.
attributes.references: HACCP Codex Alimentarius CAC/RCP 1-1969; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; FDA 21 CFR Part 110

attributes.name: pesticide_residue_result_ppm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pesticide Residue Test Result (Parts Per Million)
attributes.description: Measured pesticide residue concentration in parts per million (ppm). Compared against EPA-established Maximum Residue Limits (MRL) and Codex Alimentarius MRL tables for regulatory compliance and export eligibility.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180 — Tolerances for Pesticide Residues; Codex Alimentarius MRL Database; EU Regulation 396/2005

attributes.name: phi_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) was observed between the last pesticide application and harvest date. True = PHI observed; False = potential PHI violation. Verified against protection_event records.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA — Federal Insecticide Fungicide and Rodenticide Act; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA v6 CB 7.4; USDA GAP Audit Standards

attributes.name: product_description
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the commodity or product as it appears on the COA document, including variety, grade, or specification designation where applicable.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Grading Standards; COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) 7 CFR Part 60

attributes.name: protein_pct
attributes.description: Measured protein content of the commodity expressed as a percentage of dry weight. Key nutritional and commercial quality parameter for grain, feed, and food ingredient specifications.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Grain Grading Standards; AOAC International Method 990.03

attributes.name: release_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lot covered by this COA has been approved for customer shipment and commercial release. 'blocked' prevents order fulfillment in SAP SD. Distinct from coa_status which tracks the document lifecycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM — Usage Decision Stock Posting; FSMA Preventive Controls 21 CFR Part 117

attributes.name: test_date
attributes.description: Date on which laboratory analysis was performed on the sample. Used to determine result validity windows and compliance with regulatory testing timelines.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM — Inspection Lot Results Recording; FDA 21 CFR Part 111

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this COA record. Supports audit trail requirements and change management tracking for regulatory documentation integrity.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117 Subpart F — Records; ISO 22000:2018 Section 7.5 — Documented Information; SOX Section 404

products.name: lab_sample
products.description: Laboratory sample submission and tracking records for all quality testing activities. Captures sample collection point (field, bin, processing line, receiving dock), sample type (grain, soil, water, tissue, feed, environmental swab), collection date/time, chain of custody, assigned laboratory, requested test panel, sample condition at receipt, and disposition after testing. Includes testing protocol metadata: sampling plan reference, sampling frequency, approved analytical methods, test parameters, and acceptance criteria. Supports field-to-COA traceability, FSMA sampling plan compliance, and HACCP verification sampling.
products.reference: FSMA Sampling Plan / HACCP Sampling Record

attributes.name: lab_sample_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each laboratory sample submission record. Primary key for the lab_sample data product in the quality domain.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module - Inspection Lot

attributes.name: collected_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or field technician who physically collected the sample. Required for chain-of-custody documentation and FSMA traceability.
attributes.references: FSMA Subpart O; HACCP Chain of Custody; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA v6

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the facility, farm, processing plant, or warehouse location where the sample was collected. Supports geographic traceability and regulatory site-level reporting.
attributes.references: FSMA Preventive Controls Rule; GLOBALG.A.P. Farm Registration

attributes.name: field_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.field. Business justification: Field-level lab sampling for pesticide residues, heavy metals, and microbial contamination is a core GAP and FSMA compliance practice. Linking lab_sample to field enables field-level quality history a
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: haccp_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.haccp_plan. Business justification: lab_sample has haccp_ccp_flag (BOOLEAN) indicating the sample is associated with a HACCP Critical Control Point. Adding haccp_plan_id FK links the sample to the specific HACCP plan and CCP it monitors
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: inspection_lot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP QM inspection lot under which this sample was collected. Links the lab sample to the broader quality inspection event in the ERP system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module - Inspection Lot (QMEL)

attributes.name: laboratory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal or external laboratory assigned to perform testing on this sample. Supports laboratory accreditation tracking and COA generation.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 Laboratory Accreditation; FDA Laboratory Accreditation Program

attributes.name: land_soil_sample_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.soil_sample. Business justification: When agronomic soil samples are submitted for pesticide residue, heavy metals, or pathogen testing (organic certification, FSMA compliance), the quality lab_sample must reference the originating land.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: procurement_goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.procurement_goods_receipt. Business justification: Incoming goods sampling (pesticide residues, mycotoxins, germination rates) is triggered at goods receipt in agriculture. lab_sample.inspection_lot_id is unlinked and generic; a dedicated procurement_
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: spray_window_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to weather.spray_window. Business justification: Lab samples collected for PHI/REI compliance verification are directly triggered by spray window records. The lab_sample has phi_compliance_flag and fsma_sampling_plan_ref. Linking to the spray_window
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: test_panel_id
attributes.description: Reference to the requested test panel defining the suite of analytical tests to be performed on this sample (e.g., pesticide residue panel, mycotoxin panel, microbiological panel, nutritional panel).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM - Inspection Characteristics; HACCP CCP Testing Protocol

attributes.name: trial_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.trial. Business justification: Residue and MRL compliance sampling during efficacy trials is a named process: lab samples collected from trial plots must link to the trial for 'trial residue sampling' reports, PHI compliance verifi
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: analytical_method_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the approved analytical method used for testing this sample (e.g., AOAC 2007.01 for pesticide residues, EPA Method 8270 for organics, USDA FSIS MLG for microbiology). Ensures regulatory acceptance of test results and supports method validation documentation.
attributes.references: AOAC International Official Methods; EPA Analytical Methods; USDA FSIS Microbiology Laboratory Guidebook (MLG); FDA BAM

attributes.name: chain_of_custody_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the chain-of-custody document accompanying this sample from collection through laboratory receipt. Provides legal defensibility for test results and supports FSMA traceability and regulatory inspection readiness.
attributes.references: FSMA Subpart O; EPA Chain of Custody Requirements; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA v6 CB 7.6

attributes.name: coa_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Certificate of Analysis (COA) issued by the laboratory upon completion of testing. The COA is the primary quality document used for product release, customer delivery, and regulatory compliance. Aligns with COA business jargon.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 211.194; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; SQF Code Edition 9; BRC Global Standard Issue 9

attributes.name: collection_point_description
attributes.description: Specific description of the exact collection point within the facility or field (e.g., 'North field block 3, row 12', 'Bin 7 - top layer', 'Processing Line 2 - post-wash CCP'). Provides granular traceability beyond the collection point type classification.
attributes.references: FSMA Subpart O; HACCP Verification Sampling Documentation

attributes.name: collection_point_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical location or process stage where the sample was collected. Supports field-to-COA traceability and HACCP critical control point mapping. Values: field (in-crop collection), bin (grain storage), processing_line (in-process), receiving_dock (incoming goods), storage (warehouse), transport (in-transit).
attributes.references: HACCP Critical Control Point (CCP) Framework; FSMA Preventive Controls; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA v6

attributes.name: collection_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the sample was physically collected from the collection point. The principal real-world event time for this transaction. Critical for chain-of-custody integrity, PHI (Pre-Harvest Interval) compliance verification, and FSMA traceability records.
attributes.references: FSMA Subpart O; HACCP Chain of Custody; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA v6 CB 7.6

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the lab sample record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 - Data Integrity Controls; FSMA Record Retention Requirements

attributes.name: disposition_action
attributes.description: Final disposition decision for the physical sample material after testing is complete. Released: sample returned or discarded per protocol after passing; Quarantined: held pending further investigation; Destroyed: sample destroyed per biohazard or regulatory protocol; Returned: sample returned to submitter; Resampled: additional sampling required.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM - Usage Decision; ISO/IEC 17025 Section 7.4.4; FSMA Sample Retention Requirements

attributes.name: disposition_date
attributes.description: Date on which the final disposition action was executed for the physical sample material. Required for sample retention compliance and laboratory space management.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 Section 7.4.4; FSMA Record Retention; SAP S/4HANA QM

attributes.name: fsma_sampling_plan_ref
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Sampling Plan Reference
attributes.description: Reference code or document identifier for the FSMA-compliant sampling plan under which this sample was collected. Supports FDA inspection readiness and FSMA Subpart O environmental monitoring and food safety plan documentation. Aligns with FSMA business jargon.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117 Subpart C; FDA Food Safety Plan Builder; FSMA Subpart O

attributes.name: gfsi_scheme_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI) Scheme Code
attributes.description: Identifies the GFSI-benchmarked certification scheme under which this sample was collected or is being used to demonstrate compliance. Supports certification audit readiness for SQF, BRC, IFS, and GLOBALG.A.P. schemes. Aligns with GFSI, SQF, BRC, IFS business jargons.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements v2020; SQF Code Edition 9; BRC Global Standard Issue 9; IFS Food Version 7; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA v6

attributes.name: haccp_ccp_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this sample was collected as part of HACCP (Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points) critical control point monitoring or verification activities. True requires enhanced documentation and regulatory retention per FSMA Preventive Controls rule. Aligns with HACCP business jargon.
attributes.references: HACCP Principle 4 - Monitoring CCPs; FSMA 21 CFR Part 117 Subpart C; Codex Alimentarius HACCP Guidelines

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Human-readable batch or lot tracking identifier associated with the sampled material. Denormalized from the commodity lot for direct COA reporting and regulatory submission without requiring a join. Aligns with LOT (Lot Number) business jargon.
attributes.references: FSMA Subpart S Traceability Rule; FDA 21 CFR Part 1 - Lot Traceability; USDA AMS

attributes.name: mrl_exceedance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any test parameter in this sample exceeded the applicable Maximum Residue Limit (MRL) as defined by EPA, Codex Alimentarius, or customer specification. True triggers non-conformance workflow and regulatory notification procedures. Aligns with MRL business jargon.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180 - Pesticide Tolerances; Codex Alimentarius MRL Database; EU Regulation 396/2005

attributes.name: overall_result
attributes.description: Consolidated pass/fail determination for the sample based on all test parameters in the requested panel against defined acceptance criteria. Pass: all parameters within specification; Fail: one or more parameters exceeded MRL or acceptance threshold; Inconclusive: results require further review; Pending: testing not yet complete.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM - Usage Decision; HACCP CCP Acceptance Criteria; MRL (Maximum Residue Limit) Compliance

attributes.name: phi_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sample collection date was verified to be after the required Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) for any applied crop protection products. True confirms PHI compliance at time of sampling. Critical for pesticide residue MRL compliance. Aligns with PHI business jargon.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA PHI Requirements; USDA AMS Pesticide Data Program; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA v6 CB 7.6.4

attributes.name: received_at_lab_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the sample was officially received and logged at the testing laboratory. Used to calculate sample transit time, assess sample integrity, and enforce holding time limits per analytical method requirements.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 Section 7.4 - Sample Handling; FDA Laboratory Accreditation

attributes.name: required_completion_date
attributes.description: Target date by which laboratory testing and result reporting must be completed. Drives laboratory scheduling, SLA monitoring, and release-hold decisions for production lots awaiting quality clearance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM - Inspection Deadline; HACCP Verification Turnaround Requirements

attributes.name: results_released_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the laboratory officially released the test results and COA. Marks the completion of the testing lifecycle and triggers downstream quality disposition workflows in SAP QM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM - Usage Decision Timestamp; ISO/IEC 17025 Section 7.8

attributes.name: sample_condition
attributes.description: Assessment of the physical condition of the sample upon receipt at the laboratory. Acceptable: sample integrity maintained; Compromised: minor integrity issues noted but testing may proceed with caveats; Rejected: sample integrity failed, testing cannot proceed. Drives chain-of-custody decisions.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 Section 7.4.2 - Sample Condition Assessment; FSMA Chain of Custody

attributes.name: sample_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional observations, anomalies, or contextual information recorded at the time of sample collection or receipt. Captures field conditions, equipment calibration notes, or deviations from standard sampling protocol that may affect result interpretation.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 Section 7.4.2; HACCP Monitoring Records; FSMA Preventive Controls Documentation

attributes.name: sample_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique identifier assigned to the sample at collection or submission. Used for chain-of-custody documentation, COA traceability, and communication with external laboratories. Follows enterprise sample numbering convention (e.g., LAB-2024-000123).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module - Inspection Lot Number; FSMA Subpart O Sampling Plan

attributes.name: sample_quantity
attributes.description: Measured quantity of material collected for the sample (e.g., weight in grams, volume in milliliters). Used to verify adequacy of sample size per analytical method requirements and sampling plan specifications.
attributes.references: AOAC Sampling Procedures; SAP S/4HANA QM - Sample Quantity; ISO/IEC 17025

attributes.name: sample_quantity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the sample quantity field. Standard units include grams (g), kilograms (kg), milliliters (mL), liters (L), milligrams (mg), and ounces (oz). Must align with the unit specified in the analytical method.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM - Unit of Measure; ISO/IEC 17025 Section 7.4

attributes.name: sample_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the laboratory sample from submission through disposition. Drives workflow routing in SAP QM and laboratory tracking systems. Values: submitted (collected and logged), received (confirmed at lab), in_testing (analysis underway), completed (results available), rejected (sample failed receipt criteria), disposed (sample destroyed or returned per protocol).

attributes.name: action_limit
attributes.description: Internal or regulatory action threshold below the MRL that triggers corrective action or investigation before the regulatory limit is breached. Supports HACCP CCP monitoring and FSMA preventive controls.

attributes.name: analyst_signoff_timestamp

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: detection_limit
attributes.description: The lowest concentration or quantity of the analyte that can be reliably detected by the test method. Critical for interpreting non-detect results and MRL compliance reporting to FDA and USDA.
attributes.references: AOAC International; EPA Method Guidelines; Codex Alimentarius; FDA

attributes.name: dilution_factor
attributes.description: The dilution factor applied to the sample prior to analysis. Used to back-calculate the actual concentration in the original sample matrix and ensure accurate MRL compliance determination.

attributes.name: haccp_ccp_flag

attributes.description: Indicates whether this test result is associated with a HACCP Critical Control Point (CCP) monitoring activity. CCP-flagged results require immediate corrective action upon failure and are subject to FSIS and FDA regulatory review.
attributes.references: HACCP Codex Alimentarius; FDA FSMA Preventive Controls; FSIS; ISO 22000

attributes.name: laboratory_accreditation_number
attributes.description: The ISO/IEC 17025 or equivalent accreditation number of the laboratory that performed the test. Printed on COAs and required for regulatory submissions to USDA, FDA, and FSIS to validate laboratory competency.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; USDA; FDA; FSIS; A2LA; PJLA

attributes.name: measured_value
attributes.description: The quantitative result of the analytical test as reported by the laboratory instrument or analyst. For qualitative tests (e.g., Salmonella presence/absence), this field is null and qualitative_result is used instead.
attributes.references: AOAC International; ISO 22000; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: parameter_category
attributes.description: Broad classification of the test parameter type. Supports regulatory reporting segmentation and HACCP critical control point (CCP) categorization. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mycotoxin|pesticide_residue|microbiological|physical|chemical|nutritional|heavy_metal|sensory — promote to reference product if additional categories are needed]
attributes.references: HACCP Codex Alimentarius; FDA FSMA; GFSI; SQF; BRC Global Standards

attributes.name: parameter_name
attributes.description: Name of the analytical parameter being tested (e.g., aflatoxin B1, glyphosate residue, Salmonella spp., moisture content, pH, Electrical Conductivity (EC), nitrate). Drives COA line-item labeling and MRL threshold comparison.
attributes.references: AOAC International; ISO 22000; Codex Alimentarius; EPA; USDA; FDA

attributes.name: pass_fail_status
attributes.description: The compliance determination for this individual test result based on comparison of the measured value against the MRL threshold and action limit. Drives COA issuance, lot release decisions, and regulatory reporting to USDA, FDA, and FSIS.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; USDA; FSIS; ISO 22000; GLOBALG.A.P.; SQF; BRC Global Standards

attributes.name: qualitative_result
attributes.description: Qualitative outcome for presence/absence or positive/negative tests (e.g., Salmonella not detected, GMO absent). Used when a numeric measured_value is not applicable. Supports FSIS microbiological reporting.
attributes.references: FSIS; FDA FSMA; USDA APHIS; ISO 22000

attributes.name: quantitation_limit
attributes.description: The lowest concentration at which the analyte can be quantitatively measured with acceptable precision and accuracy. Distinct from LOD; used for MRL compliance determination and COA reporting.
attributes.references: AOAC International; EPA Method Guidelines; Codex Alimentarius; FDA

attributes.name: recovery_percent
attributes.description: The percentage recovery of a spiked control sample used to validate the analytical method performance for this test run. Acceptable recovery ranges are defined by AOAC and Codex Alimentarius guidelines (typically 70–120%).
attributes.references: AOAC International; Codex Alimentarius; ISO/IEC 17025; EPA

attributes.name: regulatory_program_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the regulatory monitoring or surveillance program under which this test was conducted (e.g., USDA Pesticide Data Program (PDP), FDA Pesticide Residue Monitoring Program, FSIS National Residue Program (NRP), USDA AMS Microbiological Data Program).
attributes.references: USDA PDP; FDA PRMM; FSIS NRP; EPA; APHIS

attributes.name: regulatory_submission_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this test result must be reported to a regulatory authority (USDA, FDA, FSIS, EPA, or APHIS). Triggered by failed MRL results, CCP deviations, or mandatory surveillance program requirements.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; USDA; FSIS; EPA; APHIS; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: result_reported_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the test result was formally reported and made available for COA generation and lot release decisions. Used to calculate laboratory turnaround time KPIs.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; FDA FSMA; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

attributes.name: result_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the test result record within the quality management system. Controls whether the result is eligible for COA inclusion and lot release authorization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; ISO 22000; GFSI

attributes.name: result_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this result is an original first-run test, a repeat test, a confirmatory test following a suspect result, or a retest after corrective action. Supports regulatory investigation workflows.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; USDA; ISO 22000; HACCP Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: sample_matrix
attributes.description: The physical material or commodity type being tested (e.g., grain, soil, water, feed, fresh produce, processed food, animal tissue). Determines applicable MRL thresholds and regulatory reporting pathways under USDA, FDA, or FSIS jurisdiction.
attributes.references: Codex Alimentarius; USDA; FDA; FSIS; EPA

attributes.name: test_method_code
attributes.description: The standardized analytical method reference code used to perform the test (e.g., AOAC 2007.01, ISO 6579, EPA Method 8270D, USDA FSIS MLG 4.10). Required for COA documentation and regulatory method validation compliance.
attributes.references: AOAC International; ISO 22000; EPA; USDA FSIS; FDA BAM

attributes.name: test_method_name

attributes.references: AOAC International; ISO 22000; EPA; USDA FSIS

attributes.name: test_notes

attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

attributes.name: test_performed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the analytical test was physically performed in the laboratory. Distinct from sample receipt and result sign-off timestamps. Critical for FSMA traceability and COA dating.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Traceability Rule; ISO/IEC 17025; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

attributes.name: test_result_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this test result, used on Certificates of Analysis (COA) and regulatory submissions. Typically sourced from SAP QM or the laboratory information management system (LIMS).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; USDA; FDA FSMA

attributes.name: uncertainty_value
attributes.description: The expanded measurement uncertainty associated with the test result, expressed in the same unit as the measured value. Required for ISO/IEC 17025 accredited laboratory reporting and MRL compliance boundary decisions.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; EURACHEM/CITAC Guide CG4; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit in which the measured value is expressed (e.g., ppb, ppm, CFU/g, %, mg/kg, pH units, mS/cm for EC). Aligns with Codex Alimentarius and AOAC reporting conventions for regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: Codex Alimentarius; AOAC International; ISO 22000; USDA; FDA

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

products.name: haccp_plan
products.description: HACCP (Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points) plan master records with embedded CCP monitoring logs for each production process, commodity, or facility. Plan-level: defines process scope, hazard analysis summary, identified biological/chemical/physical hazards, critical control points (CCPs), critical limits, monitoring procedures, corrective action procedures, verification activities, and record-keeping requirements. CCP monitoring log detail: captures real-time or periodic measurements at each CCP including monitoring parameter (temperature, pH, chlorine concentration, metal detector sensitivity), measured value, critical limit, monitoring frequency, operator identity, timestamp, deviation flag, and immediate corrective action taken. Provides both the plan framework and continuous compliance evidence required by FDA FSMA Preventive Controls rule and GFSI scheme auditors (SQF, BRC, IFS).

attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA), 21 CFR Parts 112, 117, 507

attributes.name: gap_audit_evidence_flag

attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. IFA v6, USDA GAP/GHP Audit Program, GFSI Benchmarking Requirements

attributes.name: generic_e_coli_result
attributes.description: Numeric generic E. coli count in MPN/100mL for agricultural water samples. FSMA Produce Safety Rule specifies a geometric mean threshold of 126 MPN/100mL and a statistical threshold value (STV) of 410 MPN/100mL for agricultural water used on produce.
attributes.references: FSMA Produce Safety Rule 21 CFR Part 112.44, EPA Method 1603

attributes.name: gfsi_scheme
attributes.description: The GFSI-benchmarked certification scheme under which this environmental monitoring record serves as audit evidence. Determines specific documentation and frequency requirements applicable to this record.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements v2020, SQF Code Edition 9, BRC Global Standard Issue 9, IFS Food Standard v7, FSSC 22000 v5.1, GLOBALG.A.P. IFA v6

attributes.name: laboratory_accreditation_number
attributes.description: ISO/IEC 17025 accreditation number of the laboratory that performed the analysis. Required for GFSI audit evidence and FSMA regulatory submissions to demonstrate use of validated, accredited testing methods.

attributes.name: monitoring_program_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the written environmental monitoring program document under which this sample was collected. Ensures results are evaluated against the correct action limits and frequencies as the program evolves over time.

attributes.name: monitoring_record_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business identifier for the environmental monitoring event, used in GFSI audit evidence packages and FSMA regulatory submissions. Format: EM-YYYY-NNNNNN.

attributes.name: monitoring_zone
attributes.description: Zone classification of the sample site per industry-standard environmental monitoring zoning: Zone 1 = direct food contact surfaces; Zone 2 = adjacent non-food contact surfaces; Zone 3 = areas removed from food contact; Zone 4 = external/remote areas. Drives sampling frequency and corrective action thresholds.
attributes.references: FSMA Preventive Controls 21 CFR Part 117.165, SQF Code, BRC Global Standard, IFS Food Standard

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional observations, anomalies, or contextual information recorded at the time of sample collection or result review (e.g., equipment downtime, unusual environmental conditions, sanitizer change).

attributes.name: pass_fail_status
attributes.description: Overall pass or fail determination for this environmental monitoring sample based on comparison of the test result against the action limit and program specifications. Drives corrective action workflow initiation.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117.165, SQF Code, BRC Global Standard Issue 9, GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: qualitative_result
attributes.description: Qualitative outcome of the environmental microbiological test. For pathogen testing (Listeria, Salmonella), results are typically reported as Detected/Not Detected. Presumptive Positive triggers confirmatory testing before corrective action.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117.165, FDA BAM, ISO 11290-1, FSIS Directive 10,240.4

attributes.name: quantitative_result
attributes.description: Numeric count or concentration result for indicator organism testing (e.g., coliform count, aerobic plate count). Expressed in the unit defined by result_unit_of_measure. Null for qualitative-only pathogen tests.
attributes.references: FDA BAM, ISO 4833 (Aerobic Plate Count), ISO 4832 (Coliforms), FSMA 21 CFR Part 117

attributes.name: result_reported_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the final test result was reported by the laboratory to the quality team. Used to measure turnaround time and ensure timely corrective action initiation within program-defined windows.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117.165, ISO/IEC 17025:2017, SQF Code Edition 9

attributes.name: result_status
attributes.description: Workflow status of the test result record. Preliminary results are reported before confirmatory testing; Confirmed indicates a presumptive positive has been verified; Final indicates the result is locked for regulatory and audit purposes.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117.165, ISO/IEC 17025, SAP QM Module

attributes.name: result_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantitative test result (e.g., CFU/cm2 for surface swabs, CFU/mL for water samples, MPN/100mL for agricultural water per FSMA Produce Safety Rule). Null when result is qualitative only.
attributes.references: FSMA Produce Safety Rule 21 CFR Part 112.44, FDA BAM, ISO 4833

attributes.name: sample_received_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the environmental sample was received at the laboratory. Used to calculate sample hold time compliance and chain-of-custody integrity.

attributes.name: sample_site_description

attributes.name: sampling_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency at which this monitoring site is sampled as defined in the environmental monitoring program plan. Used to verify compliance with program requirements and identify gaps in monitoring coverage.

products.name: quality_standard
products.description: Master reference table for quality_standard. Referenced by quality_standard_id.

attributes.name: quality_standard_id
attributes.description: Primary key for quality_standard

attributes.name: annual_compliance_cost_usd
attributes.description: Estimated annual cost in USD to maintain compliance with this quality standard, including audit fees, certification fees, testing costs, training expenses, and internal labor. Used for budgeting and cost-benefit analysis of quality programs.

attributes.name: applicable_facility_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of facility or operation types to which this quality standard applies (e.g., farm, packing house, processing plant, cold storage, distribution center, retail). Defines the scope of operations covered.

attributes.name: applicable_product_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of product categories or commodity groups to which this quality standard applies (e.g., fresh produce, dairy, meat and poultry, processed foods, animal feed, packaging materials). Defines the scope of products covered.

attributes.name: audit_frequency_months
attributes.description: Required frequency for third-party audits or internal assessments against this quality standard, expressed in months (e.g., 12 for annual, 24 for biennial). Null if no periodic audit is required.

attributes.name: certification_body
attributes.description: Name of the accredited organization that issues or governs this quality standard (e.g., SQFI, BRC Global Standards, IFS Management GmbH, GLOBALG.A.P. c/o FoodPLUS GmbH, NSF International, SGS, Bureau Veritas). Null for internal or non-certified standards.

attributes.name: certification_duration_months
attributes.description: Validity period of certification issued under this quality standard, expressed in months (e.g., 12, 24, 36). After this period, recertification audit is required. Null for non-certification standards.

attributes.name: corrective_action_timeframe_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days allowed to implement corrective actions for non-conformances identified during audits or assessments under this quality standard. Timeframe varies by severity of finding (e.g., 30 days for major, 90 days for minor).

attributes.name: country_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes where this quality standard is applicable or recognized (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX, DEU, GBR, CHN). Null for global standards applicable everywhere.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this quality standard record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: critical_defect_threshold
attributes.description: Maximum number of critical non-conformances allowed before automatic failure of audit or assessment. Critical defects are findings that pose immediate food safety risk or regulatory violation. Zero tolerance is common for many food safety standards.

attributes.name: documentation_requirements
attributes.description: Description of mandatory documentation, records, and evidence that must be maintained to demonstrate compliance with this quality standard (e.g., HACCP plans, SOPs, training records, COA files, corrective action logs, supplier approvals).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this version of the quality standard becomes enforceable or recommended for adoption. Organizations must comply with the standard from this date forward for new certifications or audits.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this version of the quality standard is superseded or retired. After this date, organizations must transition to the next version. Null for standards with indefinite validity.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic applicability of the quality standard. Global standards apply worldwide (ISO, GFSI schemes), regional standards apply to multi-country regions (EU regulations), national standards apply to a single country (USDA, FDA), state standards apply to sub-national jurisdictions, and local standards apply to specific municipalities or districts.

attributes.name: gfsi_recognized_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this quality standard is benchmarked and recognized by the Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI). GFSI recognition is a key requirement for many global retailers and food manufacturers. True if GFSI-recognized, false otherwise.

attributes.name: internal_owner_department
attributes.description: Name of the internal department or business unit responsible for managing compliance with this quality standard (e.g., Quality Assurance, Food Safety, Regulatory Affairs, Operations). Used for accountability and audit coordination.

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Regulatory or governing body that mandates or oversees the standard (e.g., USDA, FDA, FSIS, European Commission, Codex Alimentarius, state agriculture departments). Applicable for regulatory and industry standards.

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date when this quality standard was last reviewed by internal quality management team for continued applicability, accuracy, and alignment with business needs. Used to ensure master data currency and trigger periodic reviews.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this quality standard record was most recently modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data freshness monitoring.

attributes.name: major_defect_threshold
attributes.description: Maximum number of major non-conformances allowed before failure of audit or assessment. Major defects are significant deviations from standard requirements that could lead to food safety issues if not corrected.

attributes.name: minimum_score_required
attributes.description: Minimum audit score or compliance percentage required to achieve certification or pass assessment under this quality standard (e.g., 80.00 for 80% compliance). Null if the standard does not use numeric scoring.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this quality standard record. Used to trigger proactive review workflows and ensure master data remains current with evolving regulatory and industry requirements.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional information, special considerations, implementation guidance, or historical context related to this quality standard. Used to capture nuances not covered by structured fields.

attributes.name: reference_document_url
attributes.description: Web URL link to the official published standard document, guidance materials, or certification body website where the full standard text and requirements can be accessed.

attributes.name: regulatory_mandate_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether compliance with this quality standard is legally required by government regulation (e.g., FSMA Preventive Controls, HACCP for seafood and juice). True if mandated by law, false if voluntary or industry-driven.

attributes.name: scope_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of what the quality standard covers, including applicable products, processes, facilities, and supply chain stages. Defines the boundaries of compliance requirements and audit scope.

attributes.name: standard_category
attributes.description: Primary functional category of the quality standard. Food safety covers pathogen control and contamination prevention (HACCP, FSMA), quality management covers systematic quality assurance (ISO 9001, SQF), good agricultural practices cover on-farm production (GLOBALG.A.P.), good manufacturing practices cover processing facility operations (GMP, cGMP), hazard analysis covers risk assessment methodologies (HACCP principles), and traceability covers supply chain tracking (PTI, FSMA 204).

attributes.name: standard_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the quality standard (e.g., SQF-2000, BRC-8, IFS-7, HACCP-001, GAP-V5). Used for external reference and certification documentation.

attributes.name: standard_name
attributes.description: Full official name of the quality standard (e.g., Safe Quality Food Level 2, British Retail Consortium Global Standard for Food Safety, International Featured Standards Food).

attributes.name: standard_type
attributes.description: Classification of the quality standard by its origin and enforcement mechanism. Certification standards are third-party verified (GFSI schemes), regulatory are government-mandated (FDA, USDA, FSIS), internal are company-defined, industry are sector-wide best practices, customer-specific are buyer requirements, and voluntary are optional compliance frameworks.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the quality standard. Active standards are in force and enforceable, superseded standards have been replaced by newer versions, draft standards are under development, under review standards are being evaluated for adoption, retired standards are no longer applicable, and suspended standards are temporarily not enforced.

attributes.name: supplier_approval_requirements
attributes.description: Description of supplier qualification, approval, and monitoring requirements mandated by this quality standard (e.g., supplier audits, COA review, risk-based supplier verification, FSMA Foreign Supplier Verification Program requirements).

attributes.name: testing_protocol_requirements
attributes.description: Description of mandatory testing, sampling, and analytical methods required by this quality standard (e.g., pathogen testing frequency, MRL testing protocols, environmental monitoring programs, finished product testing specifications).

attributes.name: traceability_requirements
attributes.description: Description of traceability and supply chain tracking requirements mandated by this quality standard (e.g., one-up/one-back traceability, lot coding requirements, recall readiness, FSMA 204 Key Data Elements for high-risk foods).

attributes.name: training_requirements
attributes.description: Description of mandatory training programs and competency requirements for personnel involved in activities covered by this quality standard (e.g., HACCP training for food safety team, GMP training for production staff, auditor qualification requirements).

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version or edition number of the quality standard (e.g., 8.0, 7.1, V5.2). Quality standards are periodically revised to incorporate new science, regulatory changes, and industry best practices.

attributes.name: parent_quality_standard_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on quality_standard (parent_quality_standard_id)

domains.name: weather
domains.description: Captures meteorological and climate data critical to agricultural decision-making including historical and forecast weather station data, precipitation, temperature, humidity, wind, evapotranspiration (ET) calculations, frost/freeze alerts, growing degree day (GDD) accumulations, and climate risk indicators. Integrates with IoT field sensors, DTN weather feeds, WASDE reports, and Climate FieldView. Supports irrigation scheduling, planting windows, spray windows, pest pressure prediction, and crop insurance documentation.
domains.references: NOAA Climate Data, DTN, USDA WASDE

products.name: station
products.description: Master record for meteorological observation stations including fixed field stations, portable IoT sensor nodes, and DTN network reference points. Stores station identity, GPS/GIS coordinates, elevation, installation date, operational status, data provider (DTN, Climate FieldView, on-farm IoT), associated field or farm unit linkage, and complete sensor/instrument inventory with calibration history (sensor identifier, calibration date, method, pre/post calibration readings, acceptable tolerance range, calibration technician, next scheduled calibration date, out-of-tolerance flag). SSOT for station identity, instrument health, sensor calibration traceability, and data quality assurance referenced by all observation, forecast, and derived weather products. Supports regulatory and insurance documentation of measurement accuracy.
products.reference: WMO Station Metadata Standard

attributes.name: station_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate identifier for the weather station master record. Primary key for all downstream observation, forecast, and derived weather product references.
attributes.references: ISO 19156 - Observations and Measurements

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP SuccessFactors employee record of the technician or agronomist responsible for this station's maintenance, calibration scheduling, and data quality oversight.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HR Master; FSMA Responsible Party Requirements

attributes.name: farm_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the farm or agricultural production unit with which this station is primarily associated. Enables linkage of meteorological observations to crop plans, irrigation events, and yield records within the Granular Farm Management and John Deere Operations Center systems.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Farm Registration; USDA Farm Service Agency (FSA) Farm Records

attributes.name: field_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific field or land parcel most closely associated with this station. Supports field-level weather data attribution for planting windows, spray windows, and pest pressure prediction in Trimble Ag Software and Climate FieldView.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Field Registration; Esri ArcGIS Field Mapping Standards

attributes.name: network_id
attributes.description: Identifier assigned by the external data provider network (e.g., DTN network node ID, Climate FieldView station UUID, NOAA COOP network ID). Used for data feed reconciliation and provider-side traceability.
attributes.references: DTN Data Transmission Network; Climate FieldView API; NOAA Cooperative Observer Program (COOP)

attributes.name: zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to weather.weather_zone. Business justification: A weather station belongs to one geographic weather zone; a zone contains many stations. This FK normalizes the zone membership of each station and enables zone-level aggregation of station data. weat
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: anemometer_height_m
attributes.description: Height above ground level in meters at which the wind speed sensor (anemometer) is mounted. Required for FAO-56 Penman-Monteith reference evapotranspiration (ET) calculations and wind speed standardization to the 2-meter reference height used in irrigation scheduling.
attributes.references: FAO-56 Penman-Monteith ET Reference; WMO No. 8 Instrument Siting Standards

attributes.name: calibration_method
attributes.description: Method used during the most recent calibration event. Determines the level of measurement traceability and acceptability for regulatory and insurance documentation. NIST-traceable calibration is required for USDA crop insurance documentation.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; NIST Traceability Policy; USDA Crop Insurance Actuarial Standards; WMO No. 8

attributes.name: calibration_technician
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the technician or certified service provider who performed the most recent calibration. Required for audit trail and regulatory documentation under FSMA and USDA crop insurance standards.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule; ISO/IEC 17025; USDA Crop Insurance Documentation Requirements

attributes.name: calibration_tolerance_pct
attributes.description: Acceptable measurement tolerance threshold expressed as a percentage of full-scale reading, as defined in the station's calibration specification. Used to evaluate pass/fail status during calibration and set the out_of_tolerance_flag.
attributes.references: WMO No. 8; ISO/IEC 17025; Manufacturer Calibration Specifications

attributes.name: communication_protocol
attributes.description: Data transmission protocol used by the station to relay observations to the central data platform. Determines data latency, reliability SLA, and applicable IoT integration configuration in the FMIS. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cellular_4g|cellular_5g|lora_wan|wifi|satellite|rf_radio|ethernet — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IoT Connectivity Standards; LoRaWAN Specification; 3GPP Cellular Standards

attributes.name: data_provider
attributes.description: Organization or platform supplying meteorological data for this station. Determines data licensing, feed format, latency SLA, and applicable data quality standards. Key for WASDE and DTN market data integration traceability. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: dtn|climate_fieldview|on_farm_iot|trimble|granular|noaa|private — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: DTN Data Transmission Network Standards; Climate FieldView API Documentation; NOAA Data Standards

attributes.name: data_quality_rating
attributes.description: Enterprise data quality tier assigned to this station based on calibration history, uptime percentage, sensor completeness, and data gap frequency. Gold-rated stations are used for regulatory and insurance submissions; Silver for operational decisions; Bronze for supplemental reference only.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule; USDA Crop Insurance Data Quality Standards; ISO 8000 Data Quality

attributes.name: data_transmission_interval_min
attributes.description: Configured frequency in minutes at which the station transmits observation data to the central platform. Drives data freshness expectations for real-time irrigation scheduling, spray window alerts, and frost/freeze notifications.
attributes.references: WMO No. 8 Observation Frequency Standards; FMIS Integration SLA

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the weather station was permanently taken out of service. Null for active stations. Used to bound the valid observation record window for historical analysis and regulatory documentation.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule; USDA Crop Insurance Actuarial Standards

attributes.name: elevation_m
attributes.description: Station elevation above mean sea level in meters. Critical for barometric pressure correction, evapotranspiration (ET) calculations, frost/freeze risk modeling, and accurate temperature lapse-rate adjustments in crop protection and irrigation scheduling.
attributes.references: WMO No. 8; FAO-56 Penman-Monteith ET Reference

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the weather station was physically installed and commissioned at its current location. Defines the start of the station's valid observation record for historical data analysis and crop insurance documentation.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule; USDA Crop Insurance Actuarial Standards

attributes.name: insurance_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this station meets USDA Risk Management Agency (RMA) requirements for use as an approved weather data source in crop insurance loss documentation. Requires current calibration, gold data quality rating, and WMO or NOAA network registration.
attributes.references: USDA RMA Crop Insurance Regulations; FCIC Standards for Weather Data; USDA Risk Management Agency

attributes.name: iot_device_serial
attributes.description: Manufacturer serial number of the IoT sensor node hardware for on-farm stations. Used for warranty tracking, firmware update management, and hardware replacement traceability. Null for DTN reference and cooperative network stations.
attributes.references: IoT Device Management Standards; SAP PM Equipment Master

attributes.name: last_calibration_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent completed calibration of the station's primary sensors. Critical for data quality assurance, regulatory documentation under FSMA, and crop insurance measurement accuracy attestation.
attributes.references: WMO No. 8 Calibration Standards; FSMA Traceability Rule; ISO/IEC 17025 Calibration Laboratory Accreditation

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent preventive or corrective maintenance activity performed on the station. Used to schedule next maintenance in SAP PM and assess station reliability for data quality rating.
attributes.references: SAP PM Maintenance Order; WMO No. 8 Station Maintenance Standards

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude of the station in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum), captured via GPS/RTK positioning. Used for GIS spatial analysis in Esri ArcGIS, field-to-station proximity matching, and precision agriculture variable rate application (VRA) zone assignment.
attributes.references: WGS84 Datum; Esri ArcGIS Coordinate Reference; RTK GPS Standards

attributes.name: leaf_wetness_sensor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this station is equipped with a leaf wetness sensor. Critical for spray window determination (REI compliance), fungal disease pressure modeling under IPM programs, and GLOBALG.A.P. crop protection documentation.
attributes.references: EPA REI Regulations; GLOBALG.A.P. IPM Standards; WMO No. 8

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude of the station in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum), captured via GPS/RTK positioning. Used for GIS spatial analysis, field mapping in John Deere Operations Center, and spatial interpolation of weather data across farm units.
attributes.references: WGS84 Datum; Esri ArcGIS Coordinate Reference; RTK GPS Standards

attributes.name: manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the hardware manufacturer of the weather station or IoT sensor node (e.g., Davis Instruments, Campbell Scientific, Onset HOBO, Pessl Instruments). Used for maintenance scheduling, parts procurement, and calibration procedure selection.
attributes.references: SAP PM Equipment Master; WMO No. 8 Instrument Standards

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer model designation of the weather station hardware. Determines applicable calibration procedures, sensor specifications, and maintenance SOPs referenced in SAP PM.
attributes.references: SAP PM Equipment Master; WMO No. 8

attributes.name: next_calibration_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next calibration of the station's sensors. Used to trigger maintenance work orders in SAP PM and ensure continuous data quality compliance for regulatory and insurance documentation.
attributes.references: WMO No. 8; ISO/IEC 17025; FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, site-specific observations, known data anomalies, or special instructions relevant to this station's operation and data interpretation. Used by field agronomists and data quality teams.
attributes.references: Internal FMIS Documentation Standards

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the weather station. Drives data quality flags on all downstream observation records and determines whether the station is included in active irrigation scheduling, spray window, and GDD accumulation calculations.
attributes.references: ISO 19156; FSMA Traceability Rule - measurement system availability

attributes.name: out_of_tolerance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the most recent calibration found one or more sensors outside the acceptable tolerance range. When True, downstream observation records from this station are flagged for data quality review and excluded from regulatory and insurance submissions until recalibration is completed.
attributes.references: WMO No. 8 Calibration Tolerance Standards; FSMA Traceability Rule; ISO/IEC 17025

attributes.name: power_source
attributes.description: Primary power supply type for the weather station. Determines maintenance requirements, uptime risk profile, and applicable preventive maintenance schedule in SAP PM. Solar and battery stations require periodic battery health checks.
attributes.references: SAP PM Maintenance Planning; WMO No. 8 Station Infrastructure Standards

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this weather station master record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer ingestion traceability.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SOX Data Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this weather station master record. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver layer pipeline and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SOX Data Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: sensor_inventory
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of sensor types installed on this station (e.g., 'temperature,humidity,precipitation,wind_speed,wind_direction,solar_radiation,soil_moisture,leaf_wetness'). Defines which observation parameters are available from this station for ET, GDD, and IPM calculations.
attributes.references: WMO No. 8 Instrument Classification; GLOBALG.A.P. Weather Monitoring Requirements

attributes.name: soil_moisture_sensor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this station includes in-ground soil moisture sensors. Enables direct soil water content measurement for irrigation scheduling decisions and supports NDVI-correlated crop stress analysis.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Irrigation Management; FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper No. 56

attributes.name: solar_radiation_sensor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this station is equipped with a pyranometer or solar radiation sensor. Required for FAO-56 Penman-Monteith ET calculations; stations without this sensor must use estimated solar radiation from sunshine hours or cloud cover data.
attributes.references: FAO-56 Penman-Monteith ET Reference; WMO No. 8

attributes.name: station_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the station, used in field operations, DTN data feeds, Climate FieldView integrations, and regulatory/insurance documentation. Unique across the enterprise station network.
attributes.references: World Meteorological Organization (WMO) Station Numbering; DTN Network Reference

attributes.name: station_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the weather station, typically referencing the associated farm unit, field block, or geographic landmark (e.g., 'North Creek Field Station - Block 4'). Used in reporting, dashboards, and operator interfaces.
attributes.references: WMO No. 8 - Guide to Meteorological Instruments and Methods of Observation

attributes.name: station_type
attributes.description: Classification of the station by its physical deployment and data-provider category. Drives data ingestion pipeline routing and quality thresholds. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fixed_field|portable_iot|dtn_reference|climate_fieldview|cooperative|airport — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]
attributes.references: WMO No. 8; DTN Network Classification; Climate FieldView Integration Standards

attributes.name: temperature_sensor_height_m
attributes.description: Height above ground level in meters at which the temperature and humidity sensors are mounted. Standard WMO siting requires 1.25–2.0 m. Deviations affect GDD accumulation accuracy and frost/freeze alert thresholds.
attributes.references: WMO No. 8 Instrument Siting Standards; FAO-56 ET Reference

attributes.name: wmo_station_number
attributes.description: Official WMO-assigned 5 or 6-digit station identifier for stations registered with the global meteorological network. Null for private on-farm IoT nodes not registered with WMO. Required for NOAA and DTN data feed cross-referencing.
attributes.references: WMO Publication No. 9 - Weather Reporting; WMO Station Catalogue

products.name: observation
products.description: Time-series transactional record of actual meteorological measurements captured at a weather station or IoT field sensor. Stores instantaneous or interval readings for temperature (min/max/avg in °F/°C), precipitation (rainfall/snowfall in inches/mm), relative humidity (%), wind speed (mph) and direction, barometric pressure (inHg/hPa), solar radiation (W/m²), dew point, and leaf wetness duration (hours). Timestamped to ISO 8601 with configurable interval (5-min, 15-min, hourly, daily). SSOT for all raw weather measurements; feeds GDD calculation, ET computation, irrigation scheduling, spray window determination, and crop insurance documentation.
products.reference: NOAA ASOS/AWOS Observation Record

attributes.name: observation_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each meteorological observation record. Primary key for the weather observation time-series table in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; FMIS data standards

attributes.name: field_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agricultural field or land parcel associated with this observation, enabling field-level weather correlation for irrigation scheduling, spray window determination, and crop insurance documentation.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS; Trimble Ag Software; FMIS

attributes.name: station_id
attributes.description: Reference to the weather station or IoT field sensor that captured this observation. Links to the station master record for location, calibration, and ownership metadata.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; Climate FieldView; IoT sensor registry

attributes.name: weather_station_id
attributes.description: FK to weather.weather_station.weather_station_id — Every weather observation is captured at a specific station. Without this FK, weather data cannot be attributed to a location — breaking all spatial weather queries and field-level weather correlation

attributes.name: barometric_pressure_hpa
attributes.description: Atmospheric pressure measured during the observation interval, in hectopascals (hPa). Used for weather front detection, storm prediction, and calibration of altitude-adjusted ET calculations. Supports short-term weather forecasting for field operations planning.
attributes.references: WMO No. 8; FAO-56 Penman-Monteith altitude correction

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when this observation record was first ingested and created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Used for audit trail, data freshness monitoring, and SLA compliance tracking for weather data feeds.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; FSMA data integrity requirements; SOX audit trail standards

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Identifies the originating system or feed that provided this observation record. Supports data lineage, quality weighting, and source reconciliation across IoT field sensors, DTN weather feeds, Climate FieldView integrations, and manual entries.
