products.name: sensor_calibration
products.description: Calibration and maintenance record for IoT field weather sensors and weather station instruments. Stores sensor identifier, calibration date, calibration method, pre/post calibration readings, acceptable tolerance range, calibration technician, next scheduled calibration date, and out-of-tolerance flag. Ensures data quality and traceability for regulatory and insurance documentation purposes.
products.reference: ISO 17025 Calibration Standard / WMO Instrument Calibration Guidelines

attributes.name: sensor_calibration_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each sensor calibration record in the weather domain. Primary key for the sensor_calibration data product.
attributes.references: ISO 22000; FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or contractor who performed the calibration. Required for accountability, regulatory audit trails, and workforce compliance tracking via SAP SuccessFactors.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 Section 6.2; OSHA; FSMA Personnel Qualifications

attributes.name: field_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agricultural field where the sensor is deployed. Supports spatial traceability of calibration records to specific crop production areas for irrigation scheduling, spray window, and insurance documentation.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule; GLOBALG.A.P.; Esri ArcGIS Field Mapping

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fixed_asset. Business justification: Sensor calibration records are maintenance activities on capitalized weather station assets. Linking calibration records to the fixed asset enables maintenance cost capitalization vs expensing decisio
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: reference_standard_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the NIST-traceable or certified reference standard instrument used during calibration. Required for ISO/IEC 17025 compliance and regulatory audit documentation.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 Section 6.4; NIST Traceability Policy

attributes.name: sensor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the IoT field weather sensor or weather station instrument that was calibrated. Links to the sensor master record.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Measurement Equipment Management; SAP QM Equipment Calibration

attributes.name: station_id
attributes.description: Reference to the weather station at which the sensor is installed. Supports traceability of calibration records to a specific field location.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Weather Station Standards; Climate FieldView Integration

attributes.name: adjustment_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether a physical or electronic offset adjustment was applied to the sensor during this calibration event. Distinguishes verification-only calibrations from those requiring corrective adjustment.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; SAP QM Calibration Order

attributes.name: adjustment_value
attributes.description: The magnitude of the offset or correction applied to the sensor during calibration. Expressed in the same unit as measurement_unit. Used to retroactively correct historical sensor readings affected by drift.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; WMO No. 8; USDA NRCS

attributes.name: affected_observation_start_date
attributes.description: The earliest date from which historical weather observations may have been affected by sensor drift, typically the date of the previous calibration. Used to scope data quality remediation and insurance claim documentation.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule; USDA NRCS; ISO 22000

attributes.name: ambient_humidity_pct
attributes.description: Relative humidity percentage recorded at the calibration site at the time of the procedure. Environmental conditions are documented per ISO/IEC 17025 to validate calibration validity.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 Section 6.3; WMO No. 8

attributes.name: ambient_temperature_c
attributes.description: Ambient air temperature in degrees Celsius recorded at the time and location of calibration. Environmental conditions can affect sensor readings and calibration accuracy; required for ISO/IEC 17025 calibration certificates.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 Section 6.3; WMO No. 8

attributes.name: calibration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the calibration procedure was performed. Principal business event date for this transaction record. Used for scheduling, compliance reporting, and insurance documentation.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; USDA NRCS Sensor Maintenance Standards; FSMA

attributes.name: calibration_interval_days
attributes.description: The required frequency of calibration expressed in calendar days. Determined by sensor type, manufacturer specification, and regulatory requirements. Used to calculate next_calibration_date.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; Manufacturer Specification; USDA NRCS

attributes.name: calibration_location
attributes.description: Indicates where the calibration was physically performed. 'field_in_situ' means the sensor was calibrated at its installed location; 'laboratory' means it was removed and bench-tested; 'manufacturer_depot' means returned to the OEM.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; WMO No. 8; SAP PM Work Order

attributes.name: calibration_method
attributes.description: The procedure or technique used to perform the calibration. 'field_comparison' compares against a co-located reference sensor; 'laboratory_bench' involves removal and bench testing; 'reference_standard' uses a NIST-traceable reference instrument.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; WMO No. 8; USDA NRCS Calibration Procedures

attributes.name: calibration_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for the calibration technician to record observations, anomalies, corrective actions taken, or any deviations from standard procedure during the calibration event.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; SAP QM Inspection Results

attributes.name: calibration_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for this calibration event, formatted as CAL-YYYY-NNNNNN. Used for regulatory documentation, insurance claims, and audit trail references.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 Calibration Laboratory Requirements; FSMA Traceability Rule; SAP QM Calibration Order

attributes.name: calibration_result
attributes.description: Overall outcome of the calibration procedure. 'pass' indicates sensor is within tolerance without adjustment; 'pass_with_adjustment' indicates within tolerance after correction; 'fail' indicates sensor could not be brought within tolerance and must be decommissioned or replaced.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; SAP QM Usage Decision; USDA NRCS

attributes.name: calibration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the calibration record. 'failed' indicates the sensor did not meet tolerance after calibration and requires corrective action. 'overdue' indicates the scheduled calibration date has passed without completion.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; SAP QM Inspection Lot Status

attributes.name: calibration_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which the calibration procedure was executed, including timezone offset. Supports audit trail and regulatory documentation requirements.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this calibration record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and regulatory documentation requirements.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; FSMA Traceability Rule; SOX

attributes.name: data_quality_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pre-calibration drift was significant enough to have materially impacted the quality of historical weather observations recorded since the last calibration. True triggers a data quality review and potential retroactive correction of affected records.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Data Quality Standards; FSMA Traceability Rule; ISO 22000

attributes.name: insurance_documentation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this calibration record is required as supporting documentation for a crop insurance claim. When True, the record must be retained per USDA Risk Management Agency documentation requirements.
attributes.references: USDA Risk Management Agency (RMA); FSMA; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: measurement_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure applicable to the pre-calibration, post-calibration, and reference standard readings. Ensures dimensional consistency across sensor types (e.g., °C for temperature, %RH for humidity, mm for precipitation). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: °C|%RH|mm|m/s|deg|m³/m³|W/m²|hPa|hours — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: WMO No. 8; ISO 80000-1 Quantities and Units; USDA NRCS

attributes.name: next_calibration_date
attributes.description: The date by which the next calibration of this sensor must be completed. Drives preventive maintenance scheduling, compliance monitoring, and automated overdue alerts. Calculated based on calibration interval policy.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; SAP PM Maintenance Plan; USDA NRCS Sensor Maintenance Standards

attributes.name: out_of_tolerance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sensor reading remained outside the acceptable tolerance range after calibration adjustment. True triggers a corrective action workflow, sensor quarantine, and data quality review for affected historical observations. Critical for regulatory and insurance documentation.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; FSMA Traceability Rule; USDA NRCS Data Quality Standards

attributes.name: post_calibration_error
attributes.description: Calculated difference between the post-calibration sensor reading and the reference standard reading. Confirms whether the calibration adjustment brought the sensor within acceptable tolerance.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; WMO No. 8

attributes.name: post_calibration_reading
attributes.description: The sensor measurement value recorded immediately after the calibration adjustment was applied. Compared against the reference standard to confirm the sensor is within acceptable tolerance.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; WMO No. 8 Guide to Meteorological Instruments

attributes.name: pre_calibration_error
attributes.description: Calculated difference between the pre-calibration sensor reading and the reference standard reading. Quantifies sensor drift prior to adjustment. Used for data quality assessment of historical weather observations.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; WMO No. 8; USDA NRCS Data Quality Standards

attributes.name: pre_calibration_reading
attributes.description: The raw sensor measurement value recorded immediately before the calibration adjustment was applied. Used to quantify drift and assess data quality for historical observations.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; WMO No. 8 Guide to Meteorological Instruments

attributes.name: reference_standard_reading
attributes.description: The measurement value recorded by the certified reference standard instrument at the time of calibration. Serves as the ground truth against which pre- and post-calibration readings are compared.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; NIST Traceability Policy; WMO No. 8

attributes.name: sensor_manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the manufacturer of the sensor instrument. Used for vendor management, warranty claims, and equipment lifecycle tracking.
attributes.references: SAP PM Equipment Master; ISO/IEC 17025

attributes.name: sensor_model
attributes.description: Model designation of the sensor instrument as specified by the manufacturer. Supports calibration procedure selection and spare parts management.
attributes.references: SAP PM Equipment Master; ISO/IEC 17025

attributes.name: sensor_serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned serial number of the sensor instrument. Used for equipment traceability, warranty management, and regulatory documentation. Aligns with SAP PM Equipment master serial number.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; SAP PM Equipment Master; FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: sensor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the IoT field sensor or weather station instrument being calibrated. Determines applicable calibration standards, tolerance ranges, and measurement units. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: temperature|humidity|precipitation|wind_speed|wind_direction|soil_moisture|soil_temperature|solar_radiation|barometric_pressure|leaf_wetness — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: WMO No. 8 Guide to Meteorological Instruments; USDA NRCS; ISO 9001

attributes.name: technician_certification_number
attributes.description: Professional certification or qualification number of the calibration technician. Validates that the individual performing calibration meets required competency standards per ISO/IEC 17025.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 Section 6.2; USDA NRCS Technician Qualification Standards

attributes.name: technician_name
attributes.description: Full name of the technician who performed the calibration. Retained for regulatory documentation and audit purposes where a named individual must be identified on calibration certificates.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; FSMA; OSHA

attributes.name: tolerance_lower_limit
attributes.description: The minimum acceptable deviation from the reference standard reading. If the post-calibration reading falls below this limit, the sensor is flagged as out-of-tolerance and requires corrective action.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; WMO No. 8; Manufacturer Specification Sheet

attributes.name: tolerance_upper_limit
attributes.description: The maximum acceptable deviation from the reference standard reading. If the post-calibration reading exceeds this limit, the sensor is flagged as out-of-tolerance and requires corrective action.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; WMO No. 8; Manufacturer Specification Sheet

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this calibration record was last modified. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; FSMA Traceability Rule; SOX

attributes.name: work_order_number
attributes.description: SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) work order number associated with this calibration event. Provides traceability to the maintenance planning and cost tracking system.
attributes.references: SAP PM Work Order; ISO 9001 Maintenance Management

attributes.description: Reference to the weather station used for monitoring meteorological conditions relevant to this policy. Used for validating weather-related claims (frost, freeze, drought, excessive moisture).

attributes.name: acreage_reporting_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the policyholder must report planted acreage to the insurance carrier. Failure to report by this date may result in coverage denial.

attributes.name: approved_yield_per_acre
attributes.description: The approved or guaranteed yield per acre established by the insurance carrier based on historical production records. Used as the baseline for calculating coverage and claims.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date on which this policy was cancelled, if applicable. Null if the policy has not been cancelled.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason for policy cancellation, if applicable. Includes non-payment of premium, fraud, misrepresentation, policyholder request, carrier decision, or other reasons.

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Name of the insurance company or underwriter providing the coverage (e.g., Rain and Hail, ProAg, Crop Risk Services).

attributes.name: coverage_level_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of the approved yield or revenue that is insured under this policy (e.g., 50%, 65%, 75%, 85%). Higher coverage levels result in higher premiums.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this insurance policy record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: crop_year
attributes.description: The agricultural crop year for which this insurance policy provides coverage (e.g., 2023, 2024). Aligns with planting and harvest cycles.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code indicating the currency in which premiums, liabilities, and claims are denominated.

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: Amount the policyholder must pay out-of-pocket before insurance coverage begins. May be expressed as a dollar amount or percentage of liability.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the insurance policy coverage begins and becomes binding. Typically aligned with planting season or crop year start.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the insurance policy coverage ends. May be null for open-ended or continuously renewed policies.

attributes.name: harvest_price_per_unit
attributes.description: The actual commodity price per unit at harvest time. Used in revenue protection policies to determine final claim amounts.

attributes.name: insured_acres
attributes.description: Total number of acres covered under this insurance policy. Critical for calculating premiums and claim payouts.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this insurance policy record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: liability_amount
attributes.description: Maximum amount the insurance carrier is liable to pay under this policy in the event of a covered loss. Calculated as insured acres × approved yield × coverage level × projected price.

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique policy number assigned by the insurance carrier or underwriter. Used for claims, renewals, and customer service inquiries.

attributes.name: policy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the insurance policy indicating whether it is active, pending approval, suspended, cancelled, expired, or lapsed.

attributes.name: policy_terms_document_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the full policy terms and conditions document. Provides legal reference for coverage details, exclusions, and claim procedures.

attributes.name: policy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the insurance policy indicating the type of agricultural coverage provided (e.g., crop hail, multi-peril crop insurance, crop revenue, livestock mortality, farm property, equipment).

attributes.name: practice_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the farming practice covered under this policy (e.g., irrigated, non-irrigated, organic, conventional). Affects risk assessment and premium calculation.

attributes.name: prevented_planting_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether this policy includes coverage for prevented planting due to adverse weather conditions (e.g., excessive rain, flooding, drought) that make planting impossible.

attributes.name: producer_premium_amount
attributes.description: Net premium amount paid by the producer/policyholder after subsidies and discounts are applied.

attributes.name: production_reporting_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the policyholder must report actual production/yield to the insurance carrier for claim settlement purposes.

attributes.name: projected_price_per_unit
attributes.description: The projected commodity price per unit (bushel, ton, cwt) established at the beginning of the crop year. Used for revenue-based policies to calculate guaranteed revenue.

attributes.name: renewal_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this policy is eligible for automatic renewal for the next crop year based on claims history and compliance.

attributes.name: replant_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates whether this policy includes coverage for replanting costs when crops fail to germinate or are destroyed shortly after planting due to insured causes.

attributes.name: sales_closing_date
attributes.description: Last date on which a producer can purchase or make changes to this insurance policy for the current crop year.

attributes.name: subsidy_amount
attributes.description: Government subsidy amount applied to reduce the policyholder's premium cost. Common in federally-supported crop insurance programs.

attributes.name: total_premium_amount
attributes.description: Total premium amount charged for this insurance policy before any subsidies or discounts.

attributes.name: underwriting_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes from the underwriter regarding special conditions, risk factors, or considerations for this policy.

attributes.name: unit_structure
attributes.description: Defines how insured acreage is grouped for coverage purposes. Basic units are by section, optional units by field, enterprise units combine all acreage of a crop, and whole-farm units cover all crops together.

attributes.name: parent_insurance_policy_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on insurance_policy (parent_insurance_policy_id)

products.name: insurance_claim
products.description: Master reference table for insurance_claim. Referenced by claim_id.

attributes.name: insurance_claim_id
attributes.description: Primary key for insurance_claim

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party who holds the insurance policy and is filing or associated with this claim.

attributes.name: alert_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific weather event that caused or contributed to the loss, linking to meteorological records for validation and documentation.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the insurance adjuster assigned to evaluate and process this claim.

attributes.name: field_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific agricultural field or location where the loss occurred.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the insurance policy under which this claim is filed.

attributes.name: acres_affected
attributes.description: The total acreage of farmland affected by the loss event. Measured in acres.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the claim was approved for payout by the underwriting team.

attributes.name: approved_claim_amount
attributes.description: The final approved claim payout amount after underwriting review and policy coverage calculations. Measured in USD.

attributes.name: assessed_loss_amount
attributes.description: The loss amount determined by the insurance adjuster after field inspection and evaluation. Measured in USD.

attributes.name: claim_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique claim number assigned by the insurance carrier or internal system for tracking and reference purposes.

attributes.name: claim_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the insurance claim indicating its position in the claims processing workflow.

attributes.name: claim_type
attributes.description: Classification of the insurance claim based on the nature of the loss or damage being claimed.

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the claim was officially closed and no further action is required.

attributes.name: coverage_level
attributes.description: The coverage level percentage selected by the policyholder under the insurance policy (e.g., 50%, 65%, 75%, 85%). Measured as a percentage.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this claim record was first created in the system. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: crop_type
attributes.description: The type of crop affected by the loss event (e.g., corn, soybeans, wheat, cotton). Applicable for crop loss claims.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this claim (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR).

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: The deductible amount applied to this claim per the policy terms. Measured in USD.

attributes.name: denial_reason
attributes.description: Explanation provided when a claim is denied, detailing the policy exclusions or conditions that led to the denial.

attributes.name: estimated_loss_amount
attributes.description: The initial estimated monetary value of the loss as reported by the policyholder or agent. Measured in USD.

attributes.name: filed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the formal claim documentation was filed with the insurance carrier.

attributes.name: fraud_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this claim has been flagged for potential fraud investigation. True if flagged, False otherwise.

attributes.name: inspection_date
attributes.description: The date on which the field inspection was conducted by the insurance adjuster.

attributes.name: loss_cause
attributes.description: Detailed description of the cause of the loss (e.g., hail, drought, flood, frost, wind, disease, pest infestation).

attributes.name: loss_date
attributes.description: The date on which the insured loss or damage event occurred. This is the principal business event timestamp for the claim.

attributes.name: loss_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the loss event, damage sustained, and circumstances surrounding the claim.

attributes.name: net_payout_amount
attributes.description: The net amount paid to the policyholder after deductibles and adjustments. Measured in USD.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or observations recorded by adjusters, underwriters, or agents during the claim lifecycle.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the claim payout was issued to the policyholder.

attributes.name: reinsurance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this claim is subject to reinsurance arrangements. True if reinsurance applies, False otherwise.

attributes.name: reported_date
attributes.description: The date on which the claim was first reported to the insurance carrier or agent.

attributes.name: supporting_documentation
attributes.description: References to supporting documents submitted with the claim (e.g., photos, weather reports, yield records, receipts). Stored as file paths or document identifiers.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this claim record was last modified in the system. Follows format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: yield_loss_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of expected crop yield lost due to the insured event. Measured as a percentage (0-100).

attributes.name: parent_insurance_claim_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on insurance_claim (parent_insurance_claim_id)

products.name: sensor
products.description: Master reference table for sensor. Referenced by sensor_id.

attributes.name: sensor_id
attributes.description: Primary key for sensor

attributes.name: field_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agricultural field or plot where the sensor is installed, linking sensor data to specific crop management zones.

attributes.name: weather_station_id
attributes.description: Reference to the weather station or field location where this sensor is deployed, enabling grouping of sensors by site.

attributes.name: accuracy_rating
attributes.description: Manufacturer-specified accuracy rating of the sensor expressed as a percentage or tolerance value, indicating the precision of measurements.

attributes.name: calibration_interval_days
attributes.description: Number of days between required calibration services as specified by manufacturer recommendations or internal quality standards.

attributes.name: communication_protocol
attributes.description: Network protocol or technology used by the sensor to transmit data to collection systems or gateways.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sensor record was first created in the system, supporting audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Calculated score representing the overall quality and reliability of data produced by this sensor, based on completeness, accuracy, and consistency metrics.

attributes.name: elevation_meters
attributes.description: Height above sea level in meters at which the sensor is installed, important for atmospheric pressure and temperature adjustments.

attributes.name: firmware_version
attributes.description: Version number of the firmware software running on the sensor device, important for compatibility and security updates.

attributes.name: health_status
attributes.description: Assessment of the sensors technical health based on diagnostic checks, data quality metrics, and performance indicators.

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date when the sensor was physically installed and deployed in the field or at the weather station location.

attributes.name: installation_height_meters
attributes.description: Height in meters above ground level at which the sensor is mounted, relevant for wind speed, temperature, and other measurements that vary with height.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the sensor is currently active and should be included in data collection and monitoring processes.

attributes.name: last_calibration_date
attributes.description: Date when the sensor was last calibrated to ensure measurement accuracy and compliance with quality standards.

attributes.name: last_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Date when the sensor last received maintenance service such as cleaning, battery replacement, or physical inspection.

attributes.name: last_reading_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent data reading received from the sensor, used to monitor sensor connectivity and operational status.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the sensor installation location in decimal degrees, used for spatial analysis and weather mapping.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the sensor installation location in decimal degrees, used for spatial analysis and weather mapping.

attributes.name: manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the company or organization that manufactured the sensor device.

attributes.name: measurement_range_max
attributes.description: Maximum value that the sensor is capable of measuring within its operational specifications.

attributes.name: measurement_range_min
attributes.description: Minimum value that the sensor is capable of measuring within its operational specifications.

attributes.name: measurement_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure in which the sensor reports its readings, such as Celsius for temperature, percent for humidity, or millimeters for precipitation.

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer-assigned model number or designation for the sensor device, used for technical specifications and maintenance reference.

attributes.name: next_calibration_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next calibration service to maintain sensor accuracy and operational reliability.

attributes.name: next_maintenance_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next preventive maintenance service to ensure continued sensor reliability and data quality.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for recording additional information about the sensor such as installation conditions, known issues, or special configuration details.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the sensor indicating whether it is actively collecting data, under maintenance, experiencing faults, or has been retired from service.

attributes.name: power_source
attributes.description: Type of power supply used to operate the sensor device, such as battery, solar panel, or alternating current.

attributes.name: sampling_frequency_seconds
attributes.description: Interval in seconds at which the sensor collects and reports measurements. Lower values indicate more frequent data collection.

attributes.name: sensor_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code or serial number assigned to the sensor device by the manufacturer or deployment system.

attributes.name: sensor_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label assigned to the sensor for identification purposes in field operations and monitoring dashboards.

attributes.name: sensor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the sensor based on the meteorological or environmental parameter it measures. Determines the type of data collected and its application in agricultural decision-making.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number assigned by the manufacturer to this specific sensor unit for warranty, support, and traceability purposes.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sensor record was last modified, supporting change tracking and audit requirements.

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the manufacturer warranty coverage for the sensor device expires.

attributes.name: parent_sensor_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on sensor (parent_sensor_id)

products.name: calibration_standard
products.description: Master reference table for calibration_standard. Referenced by reference_standard_id.

attributes.name: calibration_standard_id
attributes.description: Primary key for calibration_standard

attributes.name: accuracy_tolerance
attributes.description: The maximum permissible deviation from the reference value, expressed in the same unit of measure. Defines the acceptable calibration error range.

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: The purchase price or acquisition cost of the calibration standard in the organizations base currency. Used for asset valuation and budget planning.

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: The date on which the calibration standard was acquired or purchased by the organization. Used for asset management and depreciation tracking.

attributes.name: applicable_sensor_types
attributes.description: List of sensor types and models that can be calibrated using this standard, such as thermocouples, resistance temperature detectors, capacitive humidity sensors, or tipping bucket rain gauges.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the calibration certificate issued by the certifying authority. Used for audit and compliance verification.

attributes.name: certification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the calibration standard was certified by the certifying authority. Marks the beginning of the standards validity period.

attributes.name: certifying_authority
attributes.description: The name of the accredited laboratory, national metrology institute, or certification body that issued the calibration certificate for this standard.

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Additional notes regarding regulatory compliance, special handling requirements, or deviations from standard procedures relevant to this calibration standard.

attributes.name: confidence_level_percent
attributes.description: The statistical confidence level associated with the uncertainty value, typically expressed as a percentage such as 95% or 99%.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this calibration standard record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: custodian_name
attributes.description: Name of the person or department responsible for the custody, maintenance, and proper use of this calibration standard.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the calibration certificate expires and the standard must be recertified or retired from use. Critical for maintaining calibration validity.

attributes.name: is_primary_standard
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is a primary calibration standard with direct traceability to national standards, or a secondary/working standard derived from a primary standard.

attributes.name: last_verification_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which the calibration standard was verified or checked for continued accuracy and compliance with specifications.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the physical location where the calibration standard is stored, such as a laboratory, field station, or calibration facility identifier.

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: The name of the company or organization that manufactured the calibration standard device or reference material.

attributes.name: measurement_parameter
attributes.description: Specific meteorological or environmental parameter that this standard is designed to measure or calibrate, such as air temperature, relative humidity, barometric pressure, or rainfall intensity.

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: The manufacturers model or part number for the calibration standard. Used for procurement, maintenance, and replacement planning.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this calibration standard record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: next_verification_due_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next verification or recalibration of the standard. Used for maintenance planning and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: operating_range_max
attributes.description: The maximum value of the measurement range over which this calibration standard is valid and accurate, expressed in the unit of measure.

attributes.name: operating_range_min
attributes.description: The minimum value of the measurement range over which this calibration standard is valid and accurate, expressed in the unit of measure.

attributes.name: recalibration_interval_days
attributes.description: The recommended number of days between recalibrations to maintain the standards accuracy and traceability. Typically ranges from 180 to 730 days depending on standard type and usage.

attributes.name: reference_value
attributes.description: The certified reference value of the calibration standard. This is the known, traceable value against which field sensors and equipment are calibrated.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number assigned by the manufacturer to this specific calibration standard unit. Enables individual asset tracking and history.

attributes.name: standard_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique code identifying this calibration standard in laboratory and field systems. Used for traceability and reference in calibration procedures.

attributes.name: standard_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the calibration standard used for sensor and equipment calibration in agricultural weather monitoring systems.

attributes.name: standard_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the calibration standard indicating whether it is available for use, expired and awaiting recalibration, retired from service, or temporarily suspended.

attributes.name: standard_type
attributes.description: Category of calibration standard indicating which meteorological parameter it is designed to calibrate. Determines applicability to specific sensor types.

attributes.name: storage_conditions
attributes.description: Required environmental conditions for proper storage of the calibration standard when not in use, including temperature range, humidity limits, and protection requirements.

attributes.name: traceability_chain
attributes.description: Documentation of the unbroken chain of calibrations linking this standard to national or international measurement standards, ensuring metrological traceability.

attributes.name: uncertainty_value
attributes.description: The quantified uncertainty associated with the reference value, representing the range within which the true value is expected to lie with a specified confidence level.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the reference value is expressed, such as degrees Celsius, percent relative humidity, millibars, meters per second, or millimeters.

attributes.name: usage_instructions
attributes.description: Detailed instructions for proper use of the calibration standard in field and laboratory calibration procedures, including setup, stabilization time, and handling precautions.

attributes.name: parent_calibration_standard_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on calibration_standard (parent_calibration_standard_id)

products.name: station_network
products.description: Master reference table for station_network. Referenced by network_id.

attributes.name: station_network_id
attributes.description: Primary key for station_network

attributes.name: annual_subscription_cost
attributes.description: Annual cost in USD for accessing data from this commercial weather network. Null for free government or cooperative networks. Used for cost allocation and vendor performance analysis.

attributes.name: api_endpoint_url
attributes.description: Base URL for the network's data API endpoint. Used by integration services to retrieve weather data programmatically. Confidential to prevent unauthorized access.

attributes.name: authentication_method
attributes.description: Security authentication mechanism required to access the network's data feed. API Key for token-based access; OAuth for delegated authorization; Basic Auth for username/password; Certificate for mutual TLS; None for public data sources.

attributes.name: calibration_frequency_days
attributes.description: Standard interval in days between equipment calibration cycles for stations in this network. Critical for maintaining measurement accuracy for precision agriculture applications.

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the data subscription or partnership agreement with this network provider expires. Null for perpetual or government data sources. Critical for vendor management and budget planning.

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the data subscription or partnership agreement with this network provider became effective. Applicable for commercial weather data services like DTN.

attributes.name: coverage_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or territory covered by the station network. May be global, national, state-level, or localized to specific agricultural zones.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this station network record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: data_feed_protocol
attributes.description: Technical protocol used to receive weather data from the network. API for RESTful services; FTP for batch file transfers; MQTT for IoT sensor streams; HTTP for web services; WebSocket for real-time streaming; proprietary for vendor-specific formats.

attributes.name: data_format
attributes.description: File or message format used by the network to deliver weather data. JSON and XML for web services; CSV for tabular data; GRIB and NetCDF for gridded meteorological data; Proprietary for vendor-specific formats requiring custom parsers.

attributes.name: data_latency_minutes
attributes.description: Average time delay between observation collection at the station and data availability in the feed, measured in minutes. Critical for time-sensitive agricultural decisions like spray window timing.

attributes.name: data_parameters_available
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of weather parameters provided by this network (e.g., 'temperature,precipitation,humidity,wind_speed,solar_radiation,soil_moisture,evapotranspiration'). Defines the analytical capabilities supported by this network.

attributes.name: data_update_frequency_minutes
attributes.description: Frequency at which the network publishes updated weather observations, measured in minutes. Typical values: 5 minutes for real-time IoT sensors, 15 minutes for automated stations, 60 minutes for manual observations.

attributes.name: documentation_url
attributes.description: Web URL pointing to the network's technical documentation, API specifications, and data dictionaries. Essential reference for data integration and interpretation.

attributes.name: forecast_horizon_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days into the future for which forecast data is available from this network. Typical values: 7-10 days for operational forecasts, 14-16 days for extended outlooks. Null if network does not provide forecasts.

attributes.name: historical_data_start_date
attributes.description: Earliest date for which historical weather observations are available from this network. Important for climate analysis, growing degree day (GDD) calculations, and multi-year trend analysis.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this station network record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data synchronization across systems.

attributes.name: measurement_units_system
attributes.description: Standard system of measurement used by the network for reporting weather data. Metric uses Celsius, millimeters, meters per second; Imperial uses Fahrenheit, inches, miles per hour; Mixed uses combination based on parameter type.

attributes.name: network_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the weather station network. Used for external references and integrations with DTN, Climate FieldView, and other weather data providers.

attributes.name: network_name
attributes.description: Full business name of the weather station network (e.g., 'National Weather Service ASOS', 'DTN Agricultural Network', 'Climate FieldView Station Grid').

attributes.name: network_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the weather station network. Active networks provide real-time data feeds; inactive networks are temporarily offline; suspended networks have data quality issues; decommissioned networks are permanently retired; pilot networks are in testing phase.

attributes.name: network_type
attributes.description: Classification of the station network by ownership and operational model. Government networks include NWS, NOAA; commercial includes DTN, Weather Underground; cooperative includes CoCoRaHS; private includes on-farm IoT sensor networks; research includes university agricultural research stations.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional information about the network, including special configuration details, known data quality issues, integration challenges, or operational notes for data engineering teams.

attributes.name: operator_organization
attributes.description: Name of the organization that owns and operates the weather station network (e.g., 'National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration', 'DTN LLC', 'Climate Corporation', 'Iowa State University').

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact at the network operator organization. Used for technical support requests and service notifications.

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary technical or account contact at the network operator organization. Used for issue escalation, contract renewals, and technical support.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary contact at the network operator organization. Used for urgent technical issues and service outages.

attributes.name: primary_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code representing the primary country of operation for the network (e.g., 'USA', 'CAN', 'BRA', 'ARG').

attributes.name: quality_assurance_level
attributes.description: Level of data quality control and validation applied by the network. Basic includes automated range checks; Standard adds cross-validation with nearby stations; Enhanced includes manual review and correction; Research Grade meets scientific publication standards.

attributes.name: reliability_score
attributes.description: Calculated reliability metric (0-100) based on data availability, uptime, and quality over the past 12 months. Used for vendor performance evaluation and data source prioritization in multi-network environments.

attributes.name: spatial_resolution_km
attributes.description: Average distance in kilometers between stations in the network, representing the spatial granularity of coverage. Lower values indicate denser station placement and more localized weather data. Critical for field-level precision agriculture.

attributes.name: station_count
attributes.description: Total number of active weather stations currently operating within this network. Updated periodically as stations are added or decommissioned.

attributes.name: supports_alerts
attributes.description: Indicates whether the network provides automated weather alerts and warnings (e.g., frost alerts, severe weather warnings, spray window notifications). Critical for risk management and operational decision support.

attributes.name: supports_forecast_data
attributes.description: Indicates whether the network provides forecast data in addition to historical and real-time observations. True for networks like DTN and NOAA that include predictive models; False for observation-only networks.

attributes.name: terms_of_use_url
attributes.description: Web URL pointing to the legal terms of use, licensing restrictions, and data redistribution policies for the network's data. Critical for compliance with data usage agreements.

attributes.name: parent_station_network_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on station_network (parent_station_network_id)

products.name: account_hierarchy
products.description: Defines all inter-account relationships within the customer network — including parent-child corporate structures (global parent to regional subsidiary), cooperative membership networks, buying group affiliations, co-packer relationships, toll processing partnerships, broker-buyer relationships, and franchise networks. Captures both hierarchical (vertical) and lateral (peer-to-peer) relationships with relationship type, direction, hierarchy level, effective and expiry dates, contractual basis flag, hierarchy path, consolidation flag for enterprise-wide credit limit and volume discount aggregation, relationship manager, and both account party references. Supports multi-tier food manufacturer account structures, cooperative grain marketing networks, and network-level analysis of customer interdependencies critical for agricultural commodity trading. This is the single authoritative source (SSOT) for ALL inter-account relationships — vertical hierarchies, lateral affiliations, cooperative memberships, co-packer partnerships, and broker-buyer linkages. No other product in this domain models inter-account relationships.
