attributes.name: relationship_category
attributes.description: Broad categorical grouping of the relationship for analytics and reporting segmentation. Distinguishes B2B enterprise corporate hierarchies from cooperative grain marketing networks, buying group affiliations, co-packer/toll processing partnerships, and distribution network linkages.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Segmentation; SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Classification

attributes.name: relationship_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business code uniquely identifying this relationship record within the CRM and ERP systems (e.g., Salesforce Account Relationship ID or SAP SD Partner Function Code). Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit trail.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Relationship ID; SAP S/4HANA SD Partner Function

attributes.name: relationship_direction
attributes.description: Indicates the directionality of the relationship between the two account parties. 'parent_to_child' denotes a vertical downward link (e.g., global parent to regional subsidiary), 'child_to_parent' denotes an upward reference, and 'lateral' denotes a peer-to-peer affiliation (e.g., co-packer partnership, buying group membership at the same tier).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Hierarchy; SAP S/4HANA SD Account Relationship

attributes.name: relationship_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive label for this inter-account relationship (e.g., 'AgriCorp Global — Midwest Grain Cooperative Membership', 'FreshPack Co-Packer Agreement'). Used in CRM displays, reporting dashboards, and relationship manager communications.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: relationship_start_reason
attributes.description: Business reason or event that initiated this inter-account relationship. Used for relationship lifecycle analytics, M&A integration tracking, and cooperative membership growth reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: relationship_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the inter-account relationship record. 'active' indicates the relationship is in force; 'pending' indicates awaiting approval or contract execution; 'suspended' indicates temporarily halted; 'terminated' indicates permanently ended.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; SAP S/4HANA SD Customer Account Status

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the inter-account relationship. Drives business rules for credit consolidation, volume discount aggregation, and reporting roll-ups. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: parent_subsidiary|cooperative_member|buying_group|co_packer|toll_processing|broker_buyer|franchise|distributor_affiliate — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Relationship Type; GLOBALG.A.P. Supply Chain Participant Classification

attributes.name: salesforce_relationship_code
attributes.description: External system identifier for this relationship record as assigned by Salesforce CRM (15 or 18-character Salesforce ID). Used for bi-directional synchronization between the lakehouse silver layer and the Salesforce CRM operational system of record.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Relationship Object

attributes.name: sap_partner_function_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA SD partner function code that classifies the role of the child account in relation to the parent within SAP (e.g., 'AG' for sold-to party, 'WE' for ship-to party, 'RE' for bill-to party, 'RG' for payer). Enables ERP-aligned relationship classification for order processing and invoicing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Partner Determination; SAP Note 109533

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for the termination or expiry of this inter-account relationship. Populated when relationship_status is 'terminated'. Used for churn analysis, cooperative exit tracking, and M&A divestiture reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; SAP S/4HANA SD; IFRS 15 Contract Modification

attributes.name: territory_code
attributes.description: Sales territory or geographic region code associated with this account relationship. Used for territory-based sales reporting, relationship manager assignment, and regional agricultural market analysis aligned with USDA Agricultural Statistics Districts.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Territory Management; SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Territory; USDA NASS Agricultural Statistics Districts

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this account hierarchy relationship record was most recently modified. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental ETL processing, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; SOX Section 404; Databricks Delta Lake CDC

attributes.name: volume_discount_tier
attributes.description: Pricing tier assigned to this relationship node for consolidated volume discount eligibility. Aggregated purchase volumes across the parent-child account group determine tier qualification. Used in SAP S/4HANA SD condition records for automatic pricing determination on agricultural commodity sales orders.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Conditions; Oracle NetSuite Pricing Tiers

products.name: address
products.description: Physical and mailing addresses associated with customer accounts and contacts — including billing addresses, shipping/delivery locations, farm gate pickup points, cold storage facility addresses, and registered business addresses. Stores address type (billing, shipping, registered, farm gate), street lines, city, state/province, postal code, country, GIS coordinates (latitude/longitude from Esri ArcGIS), COOL country of origin code, address validation status, and primary address flag. Supports multi-location customers such as retail chains and distribution networks.
products.reference: SAP SD Ship-To / Bill-To Party Address

attributes.name: address_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each address record associated with a customer account or contact. Serves as the primary key for the address entity in the customer domain Silver layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module – Business Partner Address Object

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account this address belongs to. Links the address record to the parent customer entity in the customer domain.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM – Account Object; SAP S/4HANA SD – Business Partner

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual contact person this address is associated with, when the address belongs to a specific contact rather than the overall account. Nullable for account-level addresses.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM – Contact Object

attributes.name: address_source
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this address was originally sourced or last updated. Supports data lineage tracking and conflict resolution during master data management synchronization across Salesforce CRM, SAP S/4HANA, Oracle NetSuite, and Granular Farm Management.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Governance – Master Data Management (MDM); GDPR Article 30 (Records of Processing)

attributes.name: address_type
attributes.description: Classifies the functional purpose of the address. 'billing' is the invoicing address; 'shipping' is the delivery destination; 'registered' is the legal business registration address; 'farm_gate' is a pickup point at the farm; 'cold_storage' is a refrigerated facility address; 'mailing' is for general correspondence. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: billing|shipping|registered|farm_gate|cold_storage|mailing|warehouse|processing_plant — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD – Address Usage Type; Salesforce CRM – Address Type Field

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City, town, municipality, or locality name of the address. For rural agricultural addresses, may reference the nearest incorporated municipality.
attributes.references: USPS Addressing Standards; ISO 19160-1 (Addressing)

attributes.name: cool_country_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) Country Code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code designating the country of origin for COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) compliance purposes. May differ from the physical address country for re-export or processing facility scenarios. Mandatory for USDA COOL compliance on covered commodities including beef, pork, lamb, chicken, fish, shellfish, perishable agricultural commodities, peanuts, pecans, ginseng, and macadamia nuts.
attributes.references: COOL – Country of Origin Labeling (7 CFR Part 60 and 65); USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS); FSMA

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the address (e.g., 'USA', 'CAN', 'MEX', 'BRA'). Used for COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) compliance, international shipping documentation (BOL, AWB), and FDA/USDA import/export regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; COOL – Country of Origin Labeling (7 CFR Part 60); FDA Import Regulations; USDA APHIS

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: County or parish name of the address. Critical for USDA Farm Service Agency (FSA) county-level agricultural program eligibility, crop insurance administration, and state agricultural reporting. Also used for EPA and APHIS county-level regulatory compliance tracking.
attributes.references: USDA Farm Service Agency (FSA) County Office Structure; USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service (NASS); EPA County-Level Reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this address record was first created in the system. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail requirements under FSMA, GDPR, and SOX financial reporting controls.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30 (Records of Processing Activities); SOX Section 404; FSMA Recordkeeping Requirements

attributes.name: delivery_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field for special delivery instructions specific to this address. Includes gate access codes, dock numbers, receiving hours, refrigeration requirements for cold chain deliveries, and farm-specific access directions not captured in structured address fields. Sourced from Manhattan Associates WMS and TMS delivery notes.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS – Delivery Notes; SAP S/4HANA SD – Delivery Instructions

attributes.name: do_not_ship
attributes.description: Indicates that shipments must not be dispatched to this address. May be set due to regulatory restrictions, customer request, failed delivery history, or compliance holds. Enforced during order fulfillment in Manhattan Associates WMS and SAP S/4HANA SD.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS – Address Restrictions; SAP S/4HANA SD – Delivery Block

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Dun & Bradstreet DUNS (Data Universal Numbering System) nine-digit identifier for the business entity at this address. Used for supplier qualification, credit risk assessment, USDA program eligibility verification, and federal procurement compliance.
attributes.references: Dun & Bradstreet DUNS Number Standard; USDA Supplier Qualification; SAM.gov Federal Procurement

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this address record is valid and effective for business use. Supports time-bounded address management for seasonal farm gate locations, temporary cold storage facilities, and lease-based distribution points.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD – Address Validity Period; ISO 8601 Date Standard

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date after which this address record is no longer valid for business use. Nullable for indefinitely active addresses. Used to manage seasonal farm gate closures, facility relocations, and lease expirations for distribution network addresses.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD – Address Validity Period; ISO 8601 Date Standard

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classifies the type of physical facility at this address. Supports logistics planning, cold chain management, and regulatory compliance routing. 'farm' indicates a production site; 'cold_storage' indicates temperature-controlled facility relevant to food safety (FSMA, HACCP); 'cooperative' indicates an agricultural cooperative location. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: farm|warehouse|distribution_center|cold_storage|processing_plant|retail_store|office|cooperative|grain_elevator|packing_house — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FSMA – Food Safety Modernization Act; HACCP – Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points; USDA FSIS

attributes.name: fips_code
attributes.description: Five-digit FIPS (Federal Information Processing Standards) county code assigned by the U.S. Census Bureau. Used for USDA program administration, FSA county office routing, crop insurance mapping, and federal agricultural subsidy eligibility determination.
attributes.references: FIPS 6-4 (Counties and Equivalent Entities); USDA Farm Service Agency; USDA Risk Management Agency (RMA)

attributes.name: geocode_accuracy
attributes.description: Precision level of the latitude/longitude geocoding result from Esri ArcGIS. 'rooftop' indicates exact parcel-level match; 'range_interpolated' is street-level interpolation; 'geometric_center' is centroid of a polygon; 'approximate' is postal code or city centroid; 'unverified' means coordinates have not been validated.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Geocoding Quality Codes; ISO 19160-4 (Address Quality)

attributes.name: gln
attributes.description: GS1 Global Location Number (GLN) — a 13-digit identifier uniquely identifying this physical location in the global supply chain. Used for EDI transactions, traceability in food supply chains, GLOBALG.A.P. location registration, and GS1-compliant logistics documentation including BOL and ASN.
attributes.references: GS1 Global Location Number (GLN) Standard; GLOBALG.A.P. Location Registration; GS1-128 Logistics Label Standard; FSMA Traceability Rule (21 CFR Part 1, Subpart S)

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address record is currently active and usable for business operations. Inactive addresses are retained for historical audit and traceability but excluded from operational address selection for orders, invoices, and shipments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD – Address Validity; Salesforce CRM – Address Status

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the primary address for the customer account or contact. Only one address per customer per address type should be flagged as primary. Used to determine the default address for billing, shipping, or correspondence when multiple addresses exist.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM – Primary Address Flag; SAP S/4HANA SD – Standard Address

attributes.name: is_residential
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a residential address as opposed to a commercial or agricultural business address. Affects carrier surcharge calculations, delivery scheduling windows, and B2C vs B2B routing logic for direct-to-consumer agricultural product deliveries.
attributes.references: USPS Residential Delivery Indicator; UPS/FedEx Residential Surcharge Standards

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the address in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum), sourced from Esri ArcGIS geocoding. Supports GIS-based spatial analysis, delivery route optimization via TMS, farm gate proximity calculations, and precision agriculture field mapping. Range: -90.0000000 to +90.0000000.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Geocoding Service; WGS84 Datum (EPSG:4326); ISO 6709

attributes.name: line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line including street number and street name. For farm gate addresses, may include rural route or farm road designation.
attributes.references: USPS Addressing Standards; GDPR Article 4; ISO 19160-1 (Addressing)

attributes.name: line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, unit, building, floor, dock number, or additional location detail. Commonly used for distribution center dock numbers or warehouse unit identifiers.
attributes.references: USPS Addressing Standards; ISO 19160-1 (Addressing)

attributes.name: line3
attributes.description: Tertiary address line for additional location detail such as industrial park name, complex name, or rural delivery instructions. Used primarily for international addresses requiring additional lines.
attributes.references: ISO 19160-1 (Addressing); Universal Postal Union (UPU) Standards

attributes.name: loading_dock_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether a loading dock is available at this address for freight deliveries. Critical for logistics planning of bulk agricultural inputs (fertilizers, seeds, pesticides) and large-volume produce shipments requiring dock-height unloading.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS – Facility Capabilities; SAP S/4HANA SD – Shipping Point Configuration

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the address in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum), sourced from Esri ArcGIS geocoding. Supports GIS-based spatial analysis, delivery route optimization, and proximity-based territory management. Range: -180.0000000 to +180.0000000.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Geocoding Service; WGS84 Datum (EPSG:4326); ISO 6709

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP code or postal code for the address. Supports USPS ZIP+4 format for domestic addresses and international postal code formats. Used for delivery routing, sales territory assignment, and COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) compliance zone mapping.
attributes.references: USPS ZIP Code Standards; Universal Postal Union (UPU); COOL – Country of Origin Labeling (7 CFR Part 60)

attributes.name: refrigeration_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether refrigerated or cold storage receiving capability is available at this address. Essential for cold chain compliance when delivering perishable agricultural commodities, fresh produce, dairy, and meat products per FSMA and HACCP requirements.
attributes.references: FSMA – Sanitary Transportation of Human and Animal Food (21 CFR Part 1); HACCP; FDA Food Safety

attributes.name: salesforce_address_code
attributes.description: External identifier for this address record in Salesforce CRM. Enables bidirectional synchronization between the Databricks Silver layer and Salesforce for sales pipeline management, partner relationship tracking, and customer account maintenance.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM – Account/Contact Address Object; SAP S/4HANA SD Integration

attributes.name: sap_address_code
attributes.description: External identifier for this address record in SAP S/4HANA Business Partner (BP) address management. Used for reconciliation between the enterprise ERP and the lakehouse Silver layer for billing, shipping, and procurement address data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA – Business Partner (BP) Address Management; SAP MM/SD Modules

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, territory, or administrative region of the address. Stored as ISO 3166-2 subdivision code (e.g., 'US-IA' for Iowa, 'CA-ON' for Ontario). Critical for USDA state-level agricultural reporting and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2 (Country Subdivision Codes); USDA State Agricultural Statistics

attributes.name: timezone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the address location (e.g., 'America/Chicago', 'America/Los_Angeles'). Used for scheduling delivery windows, coordinating harvest pickup times, and aligning order cutoff times across multi-timezone distribution networks.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database (TZDB); ISO 8601

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this address record was last modified. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks lakehouse pipeline and audit compliance under GDPR and SOX.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30; SOX Section 404; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed

attributes.name: validation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the address was last validated against postal authority databases or geocoding services. Used to schedule re-validation cycles and assess address data freshness for logistics and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Certification Standards; ISO 19160-4 (Address Quality)

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Current validation status of the address record against postal authority databases. 'validated' confirms the address is deliverable per USPS CASS certification or international equivalent; 'unvalidated' has not been checked; 'invalid' failed validation; 'pending_review' requires manual verification. Critical for ensuring delivery accuracy for agricultural inputs and produce shipments.
attributes.references: USPS Coding Accuracy Support System (CASS); Universal Postal Union (UPU); ISO 19160-4

attributes.name: parent_address_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on address (parent_address_id)

products.name: segment
products.description: Market segmentation classifications applied to customer accounts for targeted sales, pricing, and agronomic support strategies. Defines segment name (e.g., Large Food Manufacturer, Regional Cooperative, Direct Farm Consumer, Export Distributor), segment criteria (revenue band, commodity focus, geography, certification tier), applicable pricing tier, assigned account manager pool, GLOBALG.A.P. or SQF certification requirement flag, segment-to-account assignment tracking (assigned segment, assignment date, expiry date, assignment method — manual, rule-based, or ML-scored — segment score, and assignment history). Used by Salesforce CRM for pipeline targeting and SAP SD for pricing condition determination. Enables historical tracking of segment migrations and supports CRM-driven campaign targeting and tiered agronomic service allocation.
products.reference: Salesforce CRM Account Segment / SAP SD Customer Classification

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each customer market segment classification record in the Agriculture data platform. Primary key for the customer_segment product.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 11179 — Data Element Naming and Definition

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: Agriculture customer segments are defined by commodity focus (grain buyers, produce buyers, livestock processors). Segment-based pricing tiers, campaign targeting, and agronomic service tier assignmen
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: payment_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to invoice.payment_term. Business justification: Customer segments in agriculture define tier-level payment terms (e.g., cooperative members get harvest deferral). Replacing denormalized payment_terms_code with a FK to payment_term enables segment-d
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: account_manager_pool
attributes.description: Name or code of the designated account manager team or pool responsible for accounts in this segment (e.g., Enterprise Ag Sales Team, Export Markets Group, Cooperative Relations Team). Used for Salesforce CRM territory assignment and SAP SuccessFactors workforce planning.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Territory Management; SAP SuccessFactors Workforce Planning

attributes.name: agronomic_service_tier
attributes.description: Level of agronomic advisory and technical support services allocated to accounts in this segment. PREMIUM = dedicated agronomist, field visits, VRA prescriptions; STANDARD = shared agronomist pool, periodic consultations; BASIC = self-service digital tools only; NONE = no agronomic services provided.
attributes.references: USDA Extension Service Guidelines; GLOBALG.A.P. Agronomic Support Standards

attributes.name: assignment_method
attributes.description: Method by which customer accounts are assigned to this segment. MANUAL = assigned by account manager or sales operations; RULE_BASED = automatically assigned based on defined criteria (revenue band, geography, certification); ML_SCORED = assigned via machine learning scoring model based on behavioral and transactional data.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Einstein Analytics Segmentation; SAP SD Customer Classification

attributes.name: campaign_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether accounts assigned to this segment are eligible for Salesforce CRM marketing campaigns and targeted outreach programs. True = eligible for campaign inclusion; False = excluded from campaign targeting (e.g., inactive or archived segments).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Campaign Management; GDPR Article 6 — Lawful Basis for Marketing

attributes.name: cool_labeling_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) documentation and labeling compliance is required for products supplied to accounts in this segment. Mandatory for retail and export segments under USDA COOL regulations.
attributes.references: USDA COOL — Agricultural Marketing Act 7 USC 1638; AMS COOL Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this customer segment record was first created in the Agriculture data platform. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail, data lineage, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard; SOX Section 404 — Data Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: credit_limit_usd
attributes.description: Default credit limit in USD applied to accounts assigned to this segment. Used as the baseline credit exposure threshold in SAP S/4HANA FI credit management (FD32) and Oracle NetSuite AR. Individual account credit limits may override this segment-level default.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Credit Management (FD32); GAAP Credit Risk Management

attributes.name: crm_segment_code
attributes.description: External identifier for this segment as recorded in Salesforce CRM. Enables bidirectional synchronization between the Agriculture data platform (Silver Layer) and Salesforce CRM for pipeline targeting and account management. Null if not yet synchronized.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Segment Object API; Salesforce Data Integration Guidelines

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this segment definition becomes active and available for account assignment. Supports temporal validity tracking and historical segment migration analysis. Aligns with SAP SD validity period management.
attributes.references: SAP SD — Validity Period Management; ISO 8601 Date Standard

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date on which this segment definition expires and is no longer available for new account assignments. Null indicates an open-ended segment with no planned expiry. Supports segment lifecycle management and historical migration tracking.
attributes.references: SAP SD — Validity Period Management; ISO 8601 Date Standard

attributes.name: fsma_compliance_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Compliance Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act) compliance documentation is required from customer accounts in this segment. Relevant for food manufacturer and distributor segments subject to FDA FSMA Produce Safety Rule and Preventive Controls.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA — Produce Safety Rule 21 CFR Part 112; FDA FSMA Preventive Controls

attributes.name: geography_scope
attributes.description: Geographic market scope defining where this segment applies (e.g., domestic US, North America, LATAM Export, EU Export, Global). Supports Salesforce CRM regional campaign targeting and COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) compliance tracking for export segments.
attributes.references: USDA COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) Regulations; GLOBALG.A.P. Market Scope

attributes.name: globalg_ap_cert_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether GLOBALG.A.P. (Global Good Agricultural Practices) certification is a mandatory requirement for customer accounts assigned to this segment. True = certification required for onboarding and retention; False = certification not mandated.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Certification Standard v5; USDA Agricultural Marketing Requirements

attributes.name: gmo_preference
attributes.description: Segment-level GMO (Genetically Modified Organism) supply preference governing product catalog eligibility and sourcing requirements. GMO_ACCEPTED = standard supply accepted; NON_GMO_REQUIRED = non-GMO verified supply mandatory; NO_PREFERENCE = no restriction applied.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service — Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard; GLOBALG.A.P. GMO Module

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: Default International Commercial Terms (Incoterms 2020) applicable to sales transactions for accounts in this segment. Governs risk transfer and freight responsibility. Particularly relevant for export distributor segments. Drives SAP SD delivery and billing document configuration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP SD — Incoterms Configuration; USDA Export Trade Guidelines

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which this segment definition was most recently reviewed and validated by the sales operations or data governance team. Used to track review cadence compliance and identify stale segment definitions requiring refresh.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Segment Governance; ISO 22000 Food Safety Management Review

attributes.name: max_segment_score
attributes.description: Maximum ML-derived or rule-based score threshold (0.00–100.00) defining the upper bound for account assignment to this segment. Null indicates no upper bound (e.g., top-tier strategic segment). Used with min_segment_score to define the qualifying score range.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Einstein Scoring Thresholds; SAP SD Customer Scoring

attributes.name: min_segment_score
attributes.description: Minimum ML-derived or rule-based score threshold (0.00–100.00) required for a customer account to qualify for assignment to this segment. Used in conjunction with max_segment_score to define the score band for this segment.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Einstein Scoring Thresholds; SAP SD Customer Scoring

attributes.name: ml_model_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the ML scoring model used when assignment_method is ML_SCORED. Enables reproducibility, model governance, and audit traceability for AI-driven segment assignments. Null when assignment_method is MANUAL or RULE_BASED.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Einstein Analytics Model Versioning; ISO/IEC 25012 Data Quality

attributes.name: organic_cert_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether USDA National Organic Program (NOP) certification is required for accounts in this segment. Applies to organic produce buyers and specialty food manufacturers requiring certified organic supply.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) — 7 CFR Part 205; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service

attributes.name: pricing_tier_code
attributes.description: SAP SD pricing condition tier code applicable to all accounts assigned to this segment (e.g., PT-GOLD, PT-SILVER, PT-STANDARD). Drives price list determination, volume discount schedules, and contract pricing in SAP S/4HANA SD module.
attributes.references: SAP SD Pricing Condition (VK11/VK12); GAAP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: revenue_band_max_usd
attributes.description: Maximum annual revenue threshold (in USD) for a customer account to qualify for this segment. Null indicates no upper bound (e.g., for the highest-tier strategic segment). Used in conjunction with revenue_band_min_usd for rule-based segment assignment.
attributes.references: GAAP Revenue Recognition Standards; SAP SD Pricing Condition Criteria

attributes.name: revenue_band_min_usd
attributes.description: Minimum annual revenue threshold (in USD) for a customer account to qualify for this segment. Used as a rule-based assignment criterion alongside revenue_band_max_usd. Supports SAP SD pricing tier determination and Salesforce CRM pipeline segmentation.
attributes.references: GAAP Revenue Recognition Standards; SAP SD Pricing Condition Criteria

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency at which segment criteria, account assignments, and scoring thresholds are reviewed and recalibrated by the sales operations or data governance team. Supports proactive segment management and CRM pipeline accuracy.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Segment Governance; GLOBALG.A.P. Customer Review Cycle

attributes.name: sap_customer_group
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA SD module customer group code (field: KDGRP) mapped to this segment. Drives pricing condition determination, output determination, and account assignment in SAP SD. Aligns segment definitions with SAP master data for seamless ERP integration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Customer Group (KDGRP) Field; SAP SD Pricing Condition VK11

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the segment (e.g., LFM-001, REG-COOP, EXP-DIST). Used as the business key in Salesforce CRM campaign targeting and SAP SD pricing condition determination.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Campaign Segment Coding; SAP SD Pricing Condition

attributes.name: segment_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the business characteristics, target profile, and strategic purpose of this customer segment. Supports sales team onboarding and CRM campaign briefing.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Segment Definition; USDA Agricultural Marketing Guidelines

attributes.name: segment_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the market segment (e.g., Large Food Manufacturer, Regional Cooperative, Direct Farm Consumer, Export Distributor). Used in Salesforce CRM pipeline targeting and reporting dashboards.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Segmentation; GLOBALG.A.P. Customer Classification

attributes.name: segment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the segment definition. Active segments are available for account assignment and CRM campaign targeting. Draft segments are under review. Archived segments are retained for historical analysis only.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Segment Lifecycle Management; SAP SD Condition Status

attributes.name: segment_tier
attributes.description: Strategic importance tier assigned to the segment, driving service level, account manager allocation, and agronomic support intensity. products.name: preference
products.description: Captures all customer-level preferences governing how the agricultural enterprise engages with and delivers to each account. Includes commodity preferences (preferred crop types, grain grades, organic vs. conventional), packaging preferences (bulk, bagged, containerized), delivery preferences (FOB farm gate, CIF destination, preferred carrier), COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) preferences (required origin countries per commodity, labeling format — full origin, mixed origin, derived from — acceptable and restricted origin country lists, COOL audit frequency, last COOL compliance review date, COOL documentation requirement flag), GMO tolerance flag, certification requirements (USDA Organic, GLOBALG.A.P., SQF, BRC), preferred communication language, invoice delivery method (EDI, email, portal), and payment method preference. This is the single authoritative source (SSOT) for ALL customer preferences — including COOL regulatory compliance preferences. No other product in this domain models customer preferences. Supports USDA COOL regulatory compliance, commodity-specific origin tracking, and customer-specific order configuration.

products.name: lead
products.description: Prospective customer records captured from agricultural trade shows (e.g., Commodity Classic, World Ag Expo), agronomic field days, USDA market development programs, digital campaigns, and referral networks before formal account qualification. Stores lead source, prospect company name, contact name, commodity interest (grain, produce, livestock products), estimated annual purchase volume (BU or MT), geographic region, lead status (new, contacted, qualified, converted, disqualified), assigned sales representative, Salesforce CRM lead ID, lead score, and conversion date to account. Supports the agricultural sales pipeline from prospect identification through qualification to paying customer activation. Owned by the customer domain as the SSOT for pre-account prospect identity — the sales domain references converted leads via account_id after activation.

Owned by the customer domain as the SSOT for customer-facing service interactions — distinct from the quality domain's non-conformance records which track internal production quality events, and distinct from the sales domain's order dispute records which track commercial transaction disputes.

attributes.description: Indicates whether the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) applies to this consent record (True), based on the data subject being a California resident. Relevant for US domestic agricultural operations serving California-based food manufacturers and consumers.
attributes.references: CCPA Section 1798.100; CPRA Amendment; California AG Regulations

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The specific communication channel for which consent is being granted or managed. Distinct from collection_method — this represents the channel the data subject is consenting TO receive communications through (e.g., email marketing, SMS alerts for crop advisory, postal mail for regulatory notices).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; CAN-SPAM Act; TCPA; CTIA Guidelines

attributes.name: collection_method
attributes.description: The mechanism through which consent was collected from the data subject. Includes digital web forms (e.g., Salesforce CRM portal), signed physical or electronic documents, verbal consent with a recording reference, email confirmation links, API-based integrations, or paper-based forms used in field operations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1); GDPR Recital 32; ESIGN Act

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: The exact date and timestamp when the data subject granted consent. This is the principal business event timestamp for the consent lifecycle and is critical for GDPR audit trails and consent validity calculations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1); GDPR Article 5(2) — accountability principle

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the consent record. 'granted' indicates active consent; 'withdrawn' indicates the data subject has revoked consent; 'pending' indicates consent request sent but not yet responded to; 'expired' indicates consent has lapsed past its validity period; 'refused' indicates the data subject explicitly declined.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Article 17; CCPA Section 1798.120

attributes.name: consent_type
attributes.description: Category of consent being recorded. Covers marketing email communications, SMS marketing, data sharing with logistics partners (e.g., TMS/WMS providers), agronomic advisory communications, third-party analytics sharing, and customer profiling activities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: marketing_email|marketing_sms|data_sharing_logistics|agronomic_advisory|third_party_analytics|profiling — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; GDPR Article 7; CAN-SPAM Act; TCPA

attributes.name: consent_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the consent notice or privacy policy under which consent was collected (e.g., v1.0, v2.3). Enables tracking of consent obtained under different versions of privacy notices, which is critical when privacy policy updates require re-consent.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 13; GDPR Article 14; GDPR Recital 58

attributes.name: cool_preference_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) Preference Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has provided consent for sharing Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) data with downstream supply chain partners (True). Relevant for agricultural commodity traceability and compliance with USDA COOL regulations.
attributes.references: USDA COOL — 7 CFR Part 60 and 65; Agricultural Marketing Act; GDPR Article 6

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and timestamp when this consent record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit trail creation marker and is immutable after initial record creation. Aligns with GDPR accountability requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(2) — accountability; ISO 27701; SAP S/4HANA audit trail

attributes.name: data_retention_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days for which personal data processed under this consent will be retained after consent withdrawal or expiry. Supports GDPR Article 5(1)(e) storage limitation compliance and automated data deletion workflows.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(1)(e) — storage limitation; GDPR Article 17; ISO 27701 Section 7.4.7

attributes.name: data_subject_type
attributes.description: Classification of the data subject whose consent is being recorded. Distinguishes between individual B2C consumers, B2B business contacts (food manufacturers, distributors, retailers), employees, supplier contacts, and cooperative members — each subject to different regulatory obligations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4(1); CCPA Section 1798.140; FSMA Section 204

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document number for the signed physical or electronic consent document. Applicable when collection_method is 'signed_document' or 'paper_form'. Enables retrieval of the original signed consent artifact for audit purposes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1); ESIGN Act; UETA (Uniform Electronic Transactions Act)

attributes.name: double_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a double opt-in confirmation process was completed (True), where the data subject confirmed their consent via a secondary verification step (e.g., email confirmation link). Double opt-in provides stronger evidence of consent validity for marketing communications.
attributes.references: GDPR Recital 32; CAN-SPAM Act; CASL (Canada Anti-Spam Legislation)

attributes.name: double_opt_in_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and timestamp when the data subject completed the double opt-in confirmation step. Null if double opt-in was not required or not yet completed. Provides audit evidence for the confirmation event.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1); CASL Section 10; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this consent record expires and must be renewed. Supports time-limited consent policies required for GDPR compliance and internal data governance standards. Null for open-ended consents that do not have a defined expiry.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(1)(e) — storage limitation; ISO 27701 Section 7.2.3

attributes.name: fsma_traceability_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Traceability Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent record is associated with data processing required for FSMA Section 204 food traceability compliance (True). FSMA traceability data sharing may have a separate legal basis (legal obligation) distinct from marketing consent.
attributes.references: FSMA Section 204 — Food Traceability; FDA 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S; GDPR Article 6(1)(c)

attributes.name: gdpr_applicable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether GDPR applies to this consent record (True) based on the data subject's jurisdiction and the nature of data processing. Critical for international agricultural trade operations where EU/EEA customers are involved.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 3 — territorial scope; GDPR Article 4(1)

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the device from which consent was submitted via a web form or digital channel. Captured as evidence of consent origin for GDPR audit purposes. May be considered PII in certain jurisdictions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1); GDPR Recital 30; ePrivacy Directive

attributes.name: jurisdiction
attributes.description: The regulatory jurisdiction applicable to this consent record, expressed as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code or regional code (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU, EU). Determines which privacy regulation governs the consent (e.g., GDPR for EU/EEA, CCPA for California, PIPEDA for Canada). Critical for international agricultural trade operations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 3 — territorial scope; CCPA; PIPEDA; ISO 3166-1

attributes.name: legal_basis
attributes.description: The lawful basis under which personal data is processed as defined by GDPR Article 6. For international agricultural trade operations, this determines whether processing relies on explicit consent, contractual necessity (e.g., FSMA traceability obligations), legal obligation (e.g., USDA/FDA reporting), or legitimate interest.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; GDPR Recital 40-49; ISO 27701

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes or context related to this consent record, such as special handling instructions, compliance officer annotations, or details about unusual consent collection circumstances.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(2) — accountability; Internal SOP

attributes.name: opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consent was obtained through an affirmative opt-in action (True) versus a pre-ticked box or implied consent mechanism (False). GDPR requires explicit opt-in for consent to be valid; this flag supports compliance validation and audit.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Recital 32 — unambiguous indication; ePrivacy Directive

attributes.name: purpose_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the specific data processing purpose for which consent was obtained. Provides granular detail beyond the consent_type classification, such as 'Sharing harvest yield data with logistics partner for route optimization' or 'Sending weekly agronomic advisory newsletters on IPM practices'.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(1)(b) — purpose limitation; GDPR Article 13(1)(c)

attributes.name: recording_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the audio recording or call log where verbal consent was captured. Applicable when collection_method is 'verbal_recording'. Links to the call recording system for audit retrieval. Null for non-verbal consent collection methods.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1); TCPA; FTC Telemarketing Sales Rule

attributes.name: renewal_reminder_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a consent renewal reminder communication has been sent to the data subject prior to expiry (True) or not yet sent (False). Supports consent lifecycle management workflows.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; ISO 27701; Salesforce CRM Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: renewal_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent record requires active renewal before the expiry_date (True) or is open-ended without a renewal requirement (False). Drives automated consent renewal workflows and customer communications in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(1)(e) — storage limitation; ISO 27701 Section 7.2.3

attributes.name: salesforce_consent_code
attributes.description: External identifier for this consent record in Salesforce CRM, which serves as the operational system of record for customer management and sales pipeline. Enables bidirectional synchronization between the Databricks Silver Layer and Salesforce for consent status updates.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Individual and ContactPointConsent objects; GDPR Article 30

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this consent record originated. Salesforce CRM is the primary source for customer consent management; SAP S/4HANA may originate consents related to procurement or supplier data sharing; web portal and mobile app cover direct digital channels.
attributes.references: ISO 27701 Section 7.2.1; GDPR Article 30 — records of processing activities

attributes.name: third_party_category
attributes.description: Category of the third party involved in data sharing under this consent. Supports GDPR Article 13 disclosure requirements and enables analytics on consent patterns by partner type across the agricultural supply chain.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 13(1)(e); GDPR Article 30 — records of processing activities

attributes.name: third_party_name
attributes.description: Name of the third-party organization with whom data will be shared under this consent, if applicable. Relevant for consents covering data sharing with logistics partners (TMS/WMS providers), agronomic advisory services, or market data providers (e.g., DTN). Null for consents that do not involve third-party data sharing.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 13(1)(e); GDPR Article 26 — joint controllers; GDPR Article 28 — processors

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and timestamp when this consent record was last modified. Tracks any updates to consent status, withdrawal, or metadata. Essential for GDPR audit trails and data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(2) — accountability; ISO 27701; Databricks Delta Lake audit

attributes.name: user_agent
attributes.description: Browser or application user agent string captured at the time of digital consent submission. Provides technical evidence of the device and browser environment used during consent collection, supporting GDPR accountability requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(2) — accountability; GDPR Article 7(1)

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: The date and timestamp when the data subject withdrew their previously granted consent. Null if consent has not been withdrawn. Upon withdrawal, all downstream data processing activities relying on this consent must cease per GDPR Article 7(3).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(3); GDPR Article 17 — right to erasure

attributes.name: withdrawal_method
attributes.description: The mechanism through which the data subject withdrew their consent. GDPR Article 7(3) requires that withdrawal be as easy as giving consent. Null if consent has not been withdrawn.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(3); GDPR Recital 42; CAN-SPAM Act — unsubscribe mechanism

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or categorized reason provided by the data subject for withdrawing consent. Supports customer relationship management, compliance reporting, and analysis of consent withdrawal patterns to improve data practices.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(3); GDPR Article 17; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: parent_consent_record_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on consent_record (parent_consent_record_id)

products.name: account_commodity_program
products.description: This association product represents the Procurement Agreement (Contract) between a customer account and an agricultural commodity. It captures the operational terms under which a specific account sources a specific commodity — including volume commitments, negotiated pricing tiers, GMO and organic compliance requirements, and the effective period of the agreement. Each record links one account to one commodity with attributes that exist only in the context of this account-commodity procurement relationship. Replaces the denormalized preferred_commodity_categories string field on the account record.. Existence Justification: In agricultural commodity trading, a buyer account actively purchases and maintains procurement relationships with multiple commodities (e.g., a food manufacturer buys corn, soybeans, and wheat), and each commodity is purchased by many different accounts. This relationship is operationally managed as a named business concept — a 'Commodity Preference' or 'Procurement Agreement' — with its own attributes including volume commitments, pricing tiers, GMO/organic requirements, and effective date ranges that belong to neither the account nor the commodity alone.

products.name: bundle_enrollment
products.description: This association product represents the Enrollment event between account and product_bundle. It captures the operational record of a customer account subscribing to a specific product bundle program for a given crop season — including contracted volume commitments, account-specific pricing overrides, early-order incentive participation, and enrollment lifecycle status. Each record links one account to one product_bundle for one season_year, with attributes that exist only in the context of this enrollment relationship. Supports ag retail sales program management, early-order incentive tracking, and seasonal input supply planning.. Existence Justification: In agricultural retail, customer accounts actively enroll in multiple product bundle programs per season (e.g., a grain farmer subscribes to a seed+crop protection program AND a starter fertilizer+seed treatment package simultaneously), and each bundle program is subscribed to by many accounts across different territories and tiers. This relationship is operationally managed as a 'Sales Program Enrollment' or 'Bundle Subscription' — a recognized business concept in ag retail with its own lifecycle, contracted volumes, pricing overrides, and season-year tracking. Business stakeholders actively create, modify, and close these enrollment records as part of the sales campaign and early-order program process.

products.name: dual_role_partnership
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between account and vendor where a single real-world business entity simultaneously holds both a customer relationship and a vendor/supplier relationship with the agricultural enterprise. It captures the operational terms governing this dual-role arrangement — including commodity scope, volume commitments, exclusivity, and effective date range — that exist only in the context of this specific account-vendor pairing. Each record links one customer account to one vendor master record and is actively managed by both commercial and procurement teams.. Existence Justification: In agriculture, entities such as grain cooperatives, food manufacturers, and vertically integrated agribusinesses routinely operate as BOTH a customer (purchasing processed commodities or finished goods) AND a vendor/supplier (selling raw inputs, co-products, or agricultural commodities) to the same enterprise. This dual-role relationship is an actively managed business concept — procurement and commercial teams explicitly track which entities hold both roles, under what commodity scope, with what volume commitments, exclusivity terms, and effective date ranges. The relationship itself is a recognized operational construct that humans create, update, and expire as part of supplier qualification and customer onboarding processes.

products.name: location_commodity_authorization
products.description: This association product represents the Authorization contract between delivery_location and commodity. It captures the operational capability and compliance authorization for a specific delivery location to receive, handle, and store a specific agricultural commodity. Each record links one delivery_location to one commodity with attributes — handling capability, temperature class, volume limits, and effective dating — that exist only in the context of this location-commodity pair and drive order routing, carrier assignment, and logistics compliance validation.. Existence Justification: In agricultural logistics, a delivery location (grain elevator, cold storage, food plant dock) is physically equipped and certified to receive specific commodity types — a grain elevator may accept corn, soybeans, and wheat but NOT livestock; a cold storage facility accepts perishable produce but NOT dry grains. Conversely, each commodity (e.g., Yellow Corn No. 2) can be delivered to many authorized receiving locations across the supply chain. The business actively manages this capability matrix to drive order routing, carrier assignment, and compliance validation — it is not derivable from transactional history alone.

products.name: audit_participation
products.description: This association product represents the Role-based participation of a customer account in a compliance audit. It captures the specific scope, role, and outcome applicable to each account-audit pairing in the agricultural enterprise's compliance program. Each record links one account to one compliance_audit with attributes that exist only in the context of this participation relationship — including the account's role in the audit, the scope of audit activities applicable to that account, and the outcome relevant to that account.. Existence Justification: In agricultural supply chains, customer accounts (food manufacturers, processors, distributors) are directly subject to compliance audits — a single audit may cover multiple customer accounts (e.g., a GFSI audit covering several co-packers or buyer-facing facilities), and a single customer account may participate in multiple compliance audits over time (USDA GAP, FSMA, GlobalG.A.P., SQF). The business actively tracks each account's participation in each audit, including their specific role (auditee, observer, co-auditee), the scope applicable to that account, and the outcome relevant to that account. This is an operationally managed relationship — compliance teams create, update, and close these participation records as part of audit lifecycle management.
