attributes.name: allergen_declaration
attributes.description: Structured declaration of major food allergens present in or potentially cross-contaminated in this processed good, as required by FDA FALCPA. Includes the 9 major allergens: milk, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soybeans, sesame.
attributes.references: FDA Food Allergen Labeling and Consumer Protection Act (FALCPA) — 21 USC 343; FDA FASTER Act 2021

attributes.name: bom_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this processed good to its Bill of Materials (BOM) in SAP S/4HANA PP module. The BOM defines the raw material inputs, quantities, and assembly instructions required for production.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module — Bill of Materials (BOM); ISO 9001 Production Documentation

attributes.name: cases_per_pallet
attributes.description: Standard number of trade cases stacked per pallet for this processed good. Drives warehouse slotting, transportation load planning, and freight cost calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Pallet Configuration; Manhattan Associates WMS Slotting; GS1 Logistics Standards

attributes.name: coa_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Certificate of Analysis (COA) is required for each production lot of this processed good. When true, a COA must be generated and attached to shipment documentation per customer or regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA — Supplier Verification Requirements; GFSI Certification Schemes; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

attributes.name: cool_country_of_origin
attributes.business_glossary_term: Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) Country of Origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country of origin for COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) compliance. Required on retail labels for covered commodities under USDA COOL regulations (7 CFR Part 60).
attributes.references: USDA COOL Regulations — 7 CFR Part 60 and 65; ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the processed good record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial reporting controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Material Master Creation Date; SOX Section 404; ISO 8601

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the standard cost value (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD). Ensures multi-currency financial reporting compliance under IFRS and GAAP.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS IAS 21 — Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates; GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: fsma_preventive_controls_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Preventive Controls Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this processed good is subject to FSMA Preventive Controls for Human Food requirements (21 CFR Part 117). When true, a written food safety plan with hazard analysis and preventive controls must be maintained.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA — 21 CFR Part 117 Preventive Controls for Human Food; FDA Food Safety Modernization Act

attributes.name: gfsi_certification_scheme
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI) Certification Scheme
attributes.description: The GFSI-benchmarked food safety certification scheme applicable to this processed good's production facility and process. Values include SQF (Safe Quality Food), BRC (British Retail Consortium), IFS (International Featured Standards), FSSC 22000, or GLOBALG.A.P.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements v2020; SQF Code Edition 9; BRC Global Standard Issue 9; IFS Food Version 7

attributes.name: gmo_status
attributes.description: Indicates the GMO (Genetically Modified Organism) status of the processed good. Drives labeling requirements under USDA National Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard (NBFDS) and non-GMO marketing claims.
attributes.references: USDA National Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard (NBFDS) — 7 CFR Part 66; Non-GMO Project Standard

attributes.name: gmp_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the production process for this processed good has been validated as compliant with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) as defined under FDA 21 CFR Part 110/117. Required for food safety certification.
attributes.references: GMP — FDA 21 CFR Part 110 / 21 CFR Part 117; ISO 22000:2018

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight of the processed good in its consumer packaging in kilograms. Used for freight calculation, pallet load planning, and BOL (Bill of Lading) documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Material Weight; GS1 Logistics Standards; IATA/IMDG Freight Regulations

attributes.name: haccp_plan_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) Plan Reference
attributes.description: Document reference identifier for the HACCP (Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points) plan governing the production of this processed good. Required for FSMA compliance and GFSI certification audits.
attributes.references: HACCP — Codex Alimentarius CAC/RCP 1-1969; FDA FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the processed good record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture (CDC), data lineage tracking, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Material Master Change Log; SOX Section 404; ISO 8601

attributes.name: net_content_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the net content value (e.g., kg, g, lb, oz, L, mL, MT, CWT, BU). Aligns with SAP S/4HANA base unit of measure and USDA standard units for agricultural commodities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: kg|g|lb|oz|L|mL|MT|CWT|BU — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Fair Packaging and Labeling Act (FPLA); SAP S/4HANA MM — Base Unit of Measure; USDA AMS

attributes.name: net_content_value
attributes.description: Numeric net content quantity of the processed good per consumer unit (e.g., 25.000 for a 25 kg bag of flour, 0.400 for a 400 g can). Used for labeling compliance and unit-of-measure conversions.
attributes.references: FDA Fair Packaging and Labeling Act (FPLA); USDA FSIS Labeling Requirements

attributes.name: nop_certificate_number
attributes.description: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) certificate number issued by the accredited certifying agent. Required on organic product labels and for audit trail compliance. Null if organic_certified_flag is false.
attributes.references: USDA NOP — 7 CFR Part 205.401; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service Organic Integrity Database

attributes.name: nutritional_profile_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking to the detailed nutritional facts panel data for this processed good, including calories, macronutrients, vitamins, and minerals. Required for FDA Nutrition Facts Label compliance.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101.9 — Nutrition Labeling; USDA FoodData Central; FDA Nutrition Facts Label Requirements

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this processed good is certified organic under the USDA National Organic Program (NOP). When true, the product must meet NOP production, handling, and labeling standards (7 CFR Part 205).
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) — 7 CFR Part 205; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service

attributes.name: packaging_format
attributes.description: Primary consumer or trade packaging format for the processed good. Drives warehouse storage configuration, pallet planning, and labeling requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bag|can|carton|drum|pail|pouch|tray|bottle|bulk_bin|sack — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Packaging Material; Manhattan Associates WMS Packaging Configuration

attributes.name: processing_method
attributes.description: Primary industrial processing method applied to transform raw agricultural inputs into the finished good. Informs GMP compliance requirements, HACCP plan selection, and energy/resource planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: milling|pressing|canning|freezing|drying|pelleting|pasteurization|fermentation|extrusion|blending — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) — 21 CFR Part 110; HACCP Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: High-level category classifying the type of processed agricultural good. Drives product hierarchy, reporting segmentation, and regulatory compliance routing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: flour_and_milling|oil_and_fat|canned_produce|frozen_vegetable|dried_grain|feed_pellet|packaged_food|dairy_processed|meat_processed|beverage — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Material Group; USDA Commodity Classification

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Internal alphanumeric product code used for cross-system identification within ERP, WMS, and TMS platforms. Distinct from SKU in that it represents the base product without packaging variant.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Material Number

attributes.name: product_line
attributes.description: Commercial product line classification indicating the market positioning of the processed good. Supports organic, non-GMO, conventional, premium, private label, and commodity product line management.
attributes.references: USDA NOP — 7 CFR Part 205; Non-GMO Project Standard; SAP S/4HANA SD — Product Hierarchy

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Full commercial name of the processed agricultural good (e.g., 'Whole Wheat Flour 25kg', 'Canned Sweet Corn 400g', 'Frozen Peas 1kg'). Used in sales orders, labeling, and customer-facing documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Material Description; USDA Commodity Classification

attributes.name: product_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the processed good in the product catalog. Controls availability for sales orders, procurement, and production planning within SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Material Status; FDA Product Recall Regulations

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Total shelf life of the processed good in days under specified storage conditions. Used for expiry date calculation, FEFO (First Expired First Out) inventory management, and customer delivery window planning.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101 — Food Labeling; SAP S/4HANA MM — Shelf Life Management; ISO 22000:2018

attributes.name: standard_cost
attributes.description: Standard production cost per unit of the processed good as maintained in SAP S/4HANA CO (Controlling) module. Used for COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) calculation, variance analysis, and financial reporting under GAAP/IFRS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module — Standard Cost Estimate; GAAP ASC 330 Inventory; IFRS IAS 2 Inventories

attributes.name: storage_condition_type
attributes.description: Categorical storage condition requirement for the processed good. Drives warehouse zone assignment in Manhattan Associates WMS and cold chain logistics planning in TMS.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 110; FSMA Preventive Controls for Human Food Rule; Manhattan Associates WMS Zone Configuration

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum permissible storage temperature in degrees Celsius for maintaining product quality and safety. Exceeding this threshold triggers quarantine hold procedures in the WMS.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 110 — Current GMP; FSMA Preventive Controls Rule; ISO 22000:2018

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum required storage temperature in degrees Celsius for maintaining product quality and safety. Used for cold chain management, warehouse zone assignment, and TMS temperature-controlled routing.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 110 — Current GMP; FSMA Preventive Controls Rule; ISO 22000:2018

attributes.name: units_per_case
attributes.description: Number of individual consumer units packed per trade case. Used for order quantity conversion, warehouse pick planning in Manhattan Associates WMS, and sales order entry in SAP S/4HANA SD.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Unit of Measure Conversion; GS1 Packaging Hierarchy Standards

attributes.name: usda_commodity_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) Commodity Code
attributes.description: USDA commodity classification code that categorizes the processed good within the federal agricultural commodity taxonomy. Required for USDA reporting, subsidy programs, and trade documentation.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service — Commodity Classification; WASDE Reporting

products.name: input_product
products.description: Master catalog of all agricultural input products procured and applied in farm operations — fertilizers (NPK formulations, micronutrients, lime), crop protection chemicals (herbicides, fungicides, insecticides, nematicides), adjuvants, soil amendments, biological inoculants, and seed treatments. Captures active ingredient (AI), EPA registration number, SDS reference, MRL thresholds (linked to mrl_threshold), PHI (Pre-Harvest Interval), REI (Restricted Entry Interval), restricted use pesticide (RUP) flag, signal word, formulation type, application rate range, and organic-approved status (OMRI listing). Aligned with EPA FIFRA registration and USDA NOP compliance requirements. Links to product_master for SKU/procurement identity.
products.reference: EPA Pesticide Registration / OMRI Products List

attributes.name: input_product_id
attributes.description: Primary key for input_product

attributes.name: emission_factor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.emission_factor. Business justification: Nitrogen fertilizer input products require emission factors for N2O GHG calculations (IPCC Tier 1/2). This FK links each fertilizer product to its governing emission factor, supporting Scope 3 upstrea
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent product_master record that provides the SKU/procurement identity for this input product, linking to the broader product catalog.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Material Master

attributes.name: mrl_threshold_id
attributes.description: Reference to the mrl_threshold record defining the maximum residue limit applicable to this input product for regulatory compliance under EPA and Codex Alimentarius standards.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA; Codex Alimentarius MRL Standards; FDA 21 CFR

attributes.name: sustainability_certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.sustainability_certification. Business justification: Agricultural input products (fertilizers, biologicals) must reference sustainability certifications (OMRI, CDFA) for organic system plan compliance and sustainable input procurement. This link support
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: active_ingredient_name
attributes.description: The common chemical name of the primary active ingredient (AI) as registered with the EPA and listed on the product label. For multi-AI products, contains the primary AI; additional AIs are tracked in supplemental records. Critical for MRL compliance, resistance management, and PHI/REI determination.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Active Ingredient Registry; Codex Alimentarius; ISO 1750 Pesticide Common Names

attributes.name: active_ingredient_pct
attributes.description: The concentration of the primary active ingredient expressed as a percentage (% w/w or % w/v) as stated on the EPA-registered product label. Used for dose-response calculations, MRL compliance checks, and resistance group tracking.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Label Requirements; 40 CFR Part 156

attributes.name: application_method
attributes.description: The recommended or label-specified method of applying this input product to the crop or soil. Drives equipment selection, Variable Rate Application (VRA) prescription design, and operator certification requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: foliar_spray|soil_incorporation|seed_treatment|fertigation|broadcast|banding|injection|aerial|drip_irrigation|chemigation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Label Directions; USDA NRCS Conservation Practice Standards; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: application_rate_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the application rate (min and max) of this input product, as specified on the EPA label or manufacturer recommendation. Supports both US customary (oz/acre, lb/acre, gal/acre) and metric (kg/ha, L/ha) units for international operations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oz/acre|fl_oz/acre|lb/acre|gal/acre|qt/acre|kg/ha|L/ha|g/ha|ml/ha|ton/acre — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Label; USDA NRCS; FAO Pesticide Application Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this input product record was first created in the master catalog system. Supports data lineage, audit trail requirements, and SOX financial reporting controls for procurement-related master data.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ISO 22000 Record Keeping; FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: epa_registration_number
attributes.description: The EPA registration number assigned under FIFRA (Federal Insecticide, Fungicide, and Rodenticide Act) for pesticide and crop protection products. Format: registrant-product[-supplemental]. Required for all restricted and general use pesticides sold or distributed in the US.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 3; 40 CFR Part 152

attributes.name: epa_toxicity_category
attributes.description: The EPA acute toxicity category (I through IV) assigned to this pesticide product based on oral, dermal, inhalation, and eye/skin irritation studies. Category I = most toxic (DANGER), Category IV = least toxic. Drives PPE requirements, storage segregation, and disposal protocols.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA 40 CFR Part 156; EPA Toxicity Category Classification

attributes.name: formulation_type
attributes.description: The physical and chemical formulation code of the input product per industry-standard classification (e.g., EC=Emulsifiable Concentrate, WP=Wettable Powder, SC=Suspension Concentrate, SL=Soluble Liquid, GR=Granule, WG=Water Dispersible Granule, DF=Dry Flowable, CS=Capsule Suspension, EW=Emulsion Water, ME=Micro-Emulsion). Determines mixing, handling, and application equipment requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EC|WP|SC|SL|GR|WG|DF|CS|EW|ME — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CropLife International Formulation Codes; EPA FIFRA Label; FAO/WHO Pesticide Specifications

attributes.name: groundwater_advisory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this input product carries an EPA groundwater advisory or leaching potential warning on its label, requiring special application restrictions near water bodies, wells, or sensitive aquifer areas. True = groundwater advisory present; False = no advisory.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA 40 CFR Part 156; EPA Groundwater Protection Guidelines; USDA NRCS BMP

attributes.name: hazmat_class
attributes.description: The DOT (Department of Transportation) hazardous materials classification for this input product, used for transportation labeling, placarding, and shipping documentation (e.g., Class 3 Flammable Liquid, Class 6.1 Toxic Substance, Class 9 Miscellaneous). Required for BOL and shipping compliance.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Parts 171-180; IATA DGR; IMDG Code

attributes.name: input_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the agricultural input product type. Drives procurement routing, storage requirements, regulatory handling, and application planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fertilizer|crop_protection|seed_treatment|soil_amendment|biological|adjuvant|micronutrient|lime|inoculant — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Input Classification; EPA FIFRA; OMRI

attributes.name: input_subcategory
attributes.description: Detailed subcategory within the input_category (e.g., 'herbicide', 'fungicide', 'insecticide', 'nematicide' under crop_protection; 'nitrogen', 'phosphorus', 'potassium', 'NPK blend' under fertilizer; 'biological inoculant', 'mycorrhizal' under biological). Supports granular reporting and IPM program management.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Pesticide Classification; USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205; OMRI

attributes.name: label_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current product label was approved by the EPA or relevant regulatory authority. Used to ensure that application records reference the currently approved label version for compliance auditing under FSMA and GLOBALG.A.P.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Label Approval; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard; FSMA

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this input product record was most recently modified in the master catalog. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline and compliance audit trails.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ISO 22000 Record Keeping; FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: The name of the company that physically manufactures or formulates this input product. May differ from the registrant (e.g., generic manufacturers). Used for supplier qualification, procurement sourcing, and COA (Certificate of Analysis) validation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; ISO 22000; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: max_application_rate
attributes.description: The maximum label-specified application rate for this input product per unit area or per unit of crop. Enforced as an upper bound in VRA prescriptions and application event records to ensure label compliance and prevent over-application violations under EPA FIFRA.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Label Directions; USDA NRCS; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard

attributes.name: max_seasonal_applications
attributes.description: The maximum number of applications of this input product permitted per growing season per the EPA-registered label. Used in application scheduling, IPM program compliance, and resistance management rotation planning.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Label Directions; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard

attributes.name: min_application_rate
attributes.description: The minimum label-specified application rate for this input product per unit area or per unit of crop. Used in conjunction with application_rate_unit to define the lower bound of the label rate range for VRA prescription generation and compliance auditing.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Label Directions; USDA NRCS; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard

attributes.name: mode_of_action_code
attributes.description: The IRAC (Insecticide Resistance Action Committee), FRAC (Fungicide Resistance Action Committee), or HRAC (Herbicide Resistance Action Committee) mode of action group code for this crop protection product. Essential for Integrated Pest Management (IPM) resistance rotation planning (e.g., HRAC Group 9 = glyphosate, FRAC Group 3 = DMI fungicides).
attributes.references: IRAC Mode of Action Classification; FRAC Code List; HRAC Classification; EPA FIFRA

attributes.name: npk_nitrogen_pct
attributes.description: The guaranteed nitrogen (N) content expressed as a percentage of total weight for fertilizer products, as required on the fertilizer label per AAPFCO (Association of American Plant Food Control Officials) standards. Null for non-fertilizer inputs.
attributes.references: AAPFCO Model Bill; USDA NRCS; State Fertilizer Regulations

attributes.name: npk_phosphorus_pct
attributes.description: The guaranteed available phosphate (P2O5) content expressed as a percentage of total weight for fertilizer products per AAPFCO labeling standards. Null for non-fertilizer inputs.
attributes.references: AAPFCO Model Bill; USDA NRCS; State Fertilizer Regulations

attributes.name: npk_potassium_pct
attributes.description: The guaranteed soluble potash (K2O) content expressed as a percentage of total weight for fertilizer products per AAPFCO labeling standards. Null for non-fertilizer inputs.
attributes.references: AAPFCO Model Bill; USDA NRCS; State Fertilizer Regulations

attributes.name: omri_listed_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Organic Materials Review Institute (OMRI) Listed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this input product holds a current OMRI (Organic Materials Review Institute) listing, confirming independent third-party review and approval for use in certified organic production. Distinct from organic_approved_flag which reflects NOP regulatory status.
attributes.references: OMRI Products List; USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205

attributes.name: organic_approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this input product is approved for use in certified organic production systems under the USDA National Organic Program (NOP). True = approved for organic use; False = not approved. Must be cross-referenced with OMRI listing and NOP 205.601/205.602 allowed materials list.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.601-205.602; OMRI Listed Materials

attributes.name: package_size
attributes.description: The standard commercial package size (quantity per container) for this input product as sold or procured (e.g., 2.5, 30, 50). Used in conjunction with package_unit for inventory management, purchase order creation, and application rate calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Unit of Measure; GS1 Packaging Standards

attributes.name: package_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the package_size of this input product (e.g., gal, qt, lb, kg, L). Aligns with SAP S/4HANA base unit of measure for procurement and inventory transactions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: gal|qt|fl_oz|lb|oz|kg|L|mL|ton|bag|drum|tote — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Unit of Measure; GS1 Standards; AAPFCO

attributes.name: pre_harvest_interval_days
attributes.description: The minimum number of days that must elapse between the last application of this input product and the harvest of the treated crop, as mandated on the EPA-registered label. Critical for MRL compliance and food safety under FSMA and FDA regulations. Null for non-crop-protection inputs.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Label; FDA 21 CFR; FSMA Produce Safety Rule; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Internal Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) or material code assigned to this input product in the ERP system for procurement, inventory, and cost tracking purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Material Number; GS1 Standards

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: The registered commercial or trade name of the agricultural input product as it appears on the EPA label or manufacturer documentation (e.g., 'Roundup PowerMAX', 'Urea 46-0-0', 'Rhizobium inoculant').
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Label Requirements; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Description

attributes.name: product_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of this input product in the master catalog. Active = currently approved and available for procurement/application; Discontinued = no longer available; Pending Registration = awaiting EPA or regulatory approval; Suspended = temporarily withdrawn; Under Review = regulatory re-evaluation in progress.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Status; EPA FIFRA Registration Review

attributes.name: registrant_name
attributes.description: The name of the company or entity holding the EPA registration for this pesticide product, as listed in the EPA Pesticide Registration database. The registrant is legally responsible for label compliance and product efficacy claims.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 3; EPA Pesticide Registration System (PRISM)

attributes.name: registration_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the EPA registration for this pesticide product expires or is subject to re-registration review. Products with expired registrations cannot be legally sold or applied. Triggers procurement and compliance alerts in the FMIS.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 3; 40 CFR Part 152; EPA Registration Review Program

attributes.name: resistance_group
attributes.description: The resistance management group designation (e.g., IRAC Group 4A, FRAC Group 11, HRAC Group 2) used for rotation planning under Integrated Pest Management (IPM) programs to prevent or delay development of resistance in target pest populations.
attributes.references: IRAC; FRAC; HRAC Resistance Management Guidelines; EPA FIFRA

attributes.name: restricted_entry_interval_hours
attributes.description: The minimum number of hours that workers must wait before entering a treated field after application of this pesticide product, as specified on the EPA-registered label. Mandatory for OSHA Worker Protection Standard (WPS) compliance and farm safety programs.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Worker Protection Standard (WPS); 40 CFR Part 170; OSHA 29 CFR 1928

attributes.name: restricted_use_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product is classified as a Restricted Use Pesticide (RUP) by the EPA, requiring purchase and application only by certified pesticide applicators or persons under their direct supervision. True = RUP; False = General Use.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 3(d); 40 CFR Part 152 Subpart I

attributes.name: sds_reference
attributes.description: The document reference number or URL pointing to the current Safety Data Sheet (SDS) for this input product, as required under OSHA Hazard Communication Standard (HazCom 2012) and GHS. The SDS must be accessible to all workers handling the product.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 HazCom; GHS/UN; EPA FIFRA

attributes.name: shelf_life_months
attributes.description: The manufacturer-specified shelf life of this input product in months from the date of manufacture, under recommended storage conditions. Used for inventory rotation (FIFO), expiry date management in the WMS, and procurement planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Shelf Life Management; Manhattan Associates WMS; ISO 22000

attributes.name: signal_word
attributes.description: The EPA-mandated signal word appearing on the pesticide product label indicating the acute toxicity hazard level to humans: DANGER (Toxicity Category I - most toxic), WARNING (Category II), CAUTION (Category III), NONE (Category IV - least toxic). Required for SDS documentation and worker safety training.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA 40 CFR Part 156.64; GHS/UN Globally Harmonized System

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: The maximum storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this input product as specified by the manufacturer or SDS. Defines upper thermal limit for warehouse storage zone assignment and cold chain compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom; SDS Section 7; Manhattan Associates WMS Storage Conditions

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: The minimum storage temperature in degrees Celsius for this input product as specified by the manufacturer or SDS. Used to define cold chain and warehouse storage zone requirements in the WMS and to prevent product degradation or hazardous conditions.
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom; SDS Section 7; Manhattan Associates WMS Storage Conditions

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: The four-digit UN number (e.g., UN1993, UN2902) assigned by the United Nations Committee of Experts on the Transport of Dangerous Goods for this hazardous input product. Required on shipping labels, placards, and Bill of Lading (BOL) for DOT-regulated transport.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods; DOT 49 CFR; IATA DGR

products.name: organic_certification
products.description: Tracks USDA National Organic Program (NOP) organic certification records for products, product lines, and production operations. Captures certifying agent name, certificate number, certification scope (crops, livestock, handling/processing), certification effective date, expiration date, annual renewal status, allowed materials list, and any suspension or revocation events. Links products to their certified organic status and supports COOL and organic labeling compliance. Required for organic premium pricing and retail organic claims.
products.reference: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) / 7 CFR Part 205

attributes.name: organic_certification_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each organic certification record. Primary key for the organic_certification data product.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) 7 CFR Part 205

attributes.name: compliance_audit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_audit. Business justification: NOP organic certifications are issued following an on-site inspection/audit by the certifying agent. Linking organic_certification to the compliance_audit record enables audit-to-certificate traceabil
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agricultural product or commodity in the product catalog that is covered under this organic certification. Links the certification record to the specific sellable or transferable item for organic labeling and premium pricing eligibility.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.303; USDA Commodity Codes

attributes.name: product_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product line covered under this organic certification when the certificate applies to a group of related products rather than a single SKU. Supports organic certification at the product family level.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.201; GLOBALG.A.P. Organic Certification

attributes.name: allowed_materials_list_reference
attributes.description: Document reference or identifier for the approved materials list associated with this certification. Lists all inputs (fertilizers, pesticides, processing aids) approved for use under the certified organic system plan, cross-referenced against the USDA National List of Allowed and Prohibited Substances.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.601-205.606; OMRI (Organic Materials Review Institute) Listed Products

attributes.name: annual_renewal_status
attributes.description: Tracks the current annual renewal status of the organic certification. Renewed: successfully renewed for the current certification year. Pending_renewal: renewal application submitted and under review. Not_renewed: operation chose not to renew. Overdue: renewal deadline passed without submission.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.406(b); USDA NOP Annual Update Requirements

attributes.name: certificate_document_reference
attributes.description: File path, document management system reference, or URL pointing to the scanned or digital copy of the official organic certificate issued by the certifying agent. Supports audit trail, labeling compliance verification, and customer COA (Certificate of Analysis) requests.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.406; ISO 22000 Document Control

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Externally-issued certificate number assigned by the accredited certifying agent. This is the official document reference used in regulatory filings, labeling claims, and audit trails under USDA NOP requirements.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.406; GLOBALG.A.P. Organic Certification

attributes.name: certification_scope
attributes.description: The operational scope covered by this organic certificate as defined by USDA NOP. Valid values: crops (field and greenhouse crop production), livestock (animal husbandry), handling_processing (post-harvest handling and processing operations), wild_crops (wild-harvested plant materials), aquatic_animals (aquatic animal production). Determines which products and operations are covered under this certificate.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.201; USDA NOP Accreditation Program

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the organic certification. Active: certificate is valid and in good standing. Suspended: temporarily halted pending investigation or corrective action. Revoked: permanently cancelled due to violation. Pending: application submitted, awaiting certifying agent approval. Expired: past expiration date without renewal. Withdrawn: voluntarily relinquished by the operation.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.662; USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.665

attributes.name: certified_acreage
attributes.description: Total land area in acres covered under this organic certification. Represents the certified organic production footprint and is used for yield planning, premium pricing calculations, and regulatory reporting to USDA.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.201; USDA NASS Organic Survey

attributes.name: certifying_agent_code
attributes.description: The official USDA-assigned accreditation code or identifier for the certifying agent. Used for regulatory cross-referencing with USDA AMS accreditation records and electronic filing systems.
attributes.references: USDA AMS National Organic Program Accreditation; USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.500

attributes.name: certifying_agent_name
attributes.description: The name of the USDA-accredited certifying agent (ACA) that issued and administers this organic certificate. Certifying agents are third-party organizations accredited by the USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) to certify organic operations.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.501; USDA AMS Accredited Certifying Agents List

attributes.name: cool_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the organic certification record supports Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) compliance requirements. COOL mandates disclosure of the country of origin for covered commodities at retail, and organic products must meet both NOP and COOL labeling requirements.
attributes.references: USDA COOL 7 CFR Part 60 and 65; Agricultural Marketing Act of 1946

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country where the certified organic product was produced or primarily grown. Required for COOL compliance and international organic equivalency agreements.
attributes.references: USDA COOL 7 CFR Part 60; ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; Codex Alimentarius CAC/GL 2-1985

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this organic certification record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage tracking, and compliance record-keeping in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ISO 22000 Record Control; GDPR Article 5(e)

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the organic certification becomes legally valid and binding. Marks the start of the certified period during which organic labeling claims and premium pricing are authorized.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.406(a)

attributes.name: equivalency_standard
attributes.description: Identifies the specific international organic standard or equivalency arrangement recognized by this certification (e.g., EU Organic, Canada Organic, Japan JAS Organic, IFOAM). Populated only when international_equivalency_flag is True.
attributes.references: USDA NOP International Organic Equivalency Arrangements; IFOAM Organic Standards

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the organic certification expires and must be renewed to maintain organic status. Organic certificates are typically issued on an annual basis. Expiration triggers renewal workflow and may affect organic premium pricing eligibility.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.406(b); USDA NOP Annual Renewal Requirements

attributes.name: fsma_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the certified organic operation is also compliant with applicable Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) rules, including the Produce Safety Rule and Preventive Controls for Human Food. Organic certification does not automatically confer FSMA compliance.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA 21 CFR Part 112; FDA FSMA Produce Safety Rule

attributes.name: globalg_ap_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the operation holds concurrent GLOBALG.A.P. (Global Good Agricultural Practices) certification in addition to USDA NOP organic certification. GLOBALG.A.P. certification is often required by major retail buyers and export markets.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Integrated Farm Assurance (IFA) Standard; GFSI Benchmarking

attributes.name: gmo_free_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the certified operation and its products are verified as free from Genetically Modified Organisms (GMOs). USDA NOP prohibits the use of excluded methods including genetic engineering; this flag confirms GMO-free status as part of organic compliance.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.105(e); Non-GMO Project Standard

attributes.name: international_equivalency_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification is recognized under an international organic equivalency arrangement (e.g., USDA-EU Organic Equivalency Agreement, USDA-Canada Organic Equivalency Arrangement). Enables certified organic products to be sold as organic in partner countries without additional certification.
attributes.references: USDA NOP International Trade; EU Organic Regulation 2018/848; Canada Organic Regime

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent on-site inspection conducted by the certifying agent at the certified operation. Annual on-site inspections are required under USDA NOP to verify compliance with organic standards.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.403; USDA NOP On-Site Inspection Requirements

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this organic certification record was most recently modified. Tracks changes to certification status, renewal events, suspension/revocation actions, and document updates for audit and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ISO 22000 Record Control; GDPR Article 5(e)

attributes.name: next_inspection_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next on-site inspection by the certifying agent. Used for compliance planning and operational readiness to ensure the operation is prepared for the annual NOP inspection.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.403

attributes.name: nop_system_plan_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Organic Program (NOP) Organic System Plan Reference
attributes.description: Document reference number or identifier for the Organic System Plan (OSP) submitted to and approved by the certifying agent. The OSP is the foundational compliance document describing all practices, materials, and monitoring activities for the certified operation.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.201; USDA NOP Organic System Plan Requirements

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional remarks, conditions, or special provisions associated with this organic certification record. May include certifying agent conditions, corrective action requirements, or operational notes relevant to compliance management.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205; ISO 22000 Food Safety Management

attributes.name: operation_name
attributes.description: The legal name of the certified organic operation (farm, ranch, or handling facility) as it appears on the organic certificate. This is the entity name recognized by the certifying agent and USDA NOP for compliance purposes.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.401; USDA NOP Organic System Plan

attributes.name: operation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the certified organic operation type. Producer: farms and ranches growing organic crops or raising organic livestock. Handler: facilities processing or packaging organic products. Broker: entities buying and selling organic products. Importer: entities importing certified organic products. Distributor: entities distributing certified organic products.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.2; USDA NOP Definitions

attributes.name: organic_label_type
attributes.description: The USDA NOP-defined organic labeling category authorized for products under this certification. 100_percent_organic: all ingredients are certified organic. Organic: at least 95% certified organic ingredients. Made_with_organic: 70-95% certified organic ingredients. Organic_ingredients: less than 70% organic, may list specific organic ingredients. Determines permissible label claims and USDA Organic Seal usage.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.301-205.310; USDA Organic Seal Usage Guidelines

attributes.name: premium_pricing_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether products covered by this certification are currently eligible for organic premium pricing in sales and distribution channels. Eligibility requires active certification status and valid organic label type authorization.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.300; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service Organic Price Reporting

attributes.name: renewal_due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which the annual renewal application and supporting documentation must be submitted to the certifying agent to maintain uninterrupted organic certification status.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.406(b)

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the organic certification was permanently revoked by the certifying agent. Populated only when certification_status is 'revoked'. Revocation is the most severe enforcement action and prohibits the operation from making organic claims.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.665

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the reason for permanent revocation of the organic certification. Documents the specific violation or fraudulent activity that resulted in the certifying agent revoking the certificate.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.665; USDA NOP Adverse Action Procedures

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: The date on which the organic certification was suspended by the certifying agent. Populated only when certification_status is 'suspended'. Suspension may result from non-compliance findings, use of prohibited substances, or failure to submit required documentation.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.662

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the reason for suspension of the organic certification. Documents the specific non-compliance finding or violation that triggered the suspension action by the certifying agent.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.662; USDA NOP Adverse Action Procedures

attributes.name: transition_complete_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the mandatory 36-month organic transition period has been completed for the land or operation covered by this certification. True indicates the operation has fulfilled the transition requirement and is eligible for full organic certification.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.202(b)

attributes.name: transition_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the operation began the mandatory 36-month transition period required before land can be certified organic under USDA NOP. During transition, no prohibited substances may be applied to the land.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.202(b); USDA NOP Transition Requirements

products.name: gmo_declaration
products.description: Records GMO status declarations and non-GMO verification records for agricultural products and commodities. Captures GMO trait description, transformation event identifier (APHIS petition number), approved market status by jurisdiction (US, EU, China), non-GMO verification body (Non-GMO Project, USDA Organic), identity preservation (IP) protocol reference, and testing/verification date. Supports USDA BE (Bioengineered Food Disclosure) labeling compliance and export market GMO documentation requirements.

attributes.name: master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agricultural product or commodity for which this GMO declaration is recorded. Links to the product catalog master.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS); USDA Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard (BFDS)

attributes.name: organic_certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.organic_certification. attributes.name: sustainability_certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.sustainability_certification. Business justification: GMO declarations reference non-GMO sustainability certifications (Non-GMO Project, ISCC) that validate the declaration. This FK links the declaration to the governing certification scheme, supporting

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.trade_compliance_record. Business justification: GMO declarations are required for international trade compliance (EU, China, Japan GMO import approvals). Linking gmo_declaration to the trade_compliance_record enables verification that the correct G
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: transformation_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the specific genetic transformation event (e.g., MON810, GTS 40-3-2, Bt11). Assigned by the developer and referenced in APHIS regulatory petitions. Used for traceability in export documentation and market approval verification.
attributes.references: APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services; OECD Unique Identifier System for Transgenic Plants; Codex Alimentarius CAC/GL 45-2003

attributes.name: aphis_petition_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS) Petition Number
attributes.description: APHIS petition number associated with the deregulation or regulatory approval of the specific bioengineered trait or transformation event. Used to verify US market approval status and cross-reference APHIS regulatory records.
attributes.references: APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services 7 CFR Part 340; USDA

attributes.name: be_disclosure_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this product requires Bioengineered (BE) food disclosure labeling under the USDA National Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard (NBFDS). Drives label generation and compliance workflows.
attributes.references: USDA Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard (BFDS) 7 CFR Part 66; FSMA

attributes.name: be_disclosure_type
attributes.description: Method of BE food disclosure used on product labeling as required by USDA NBFDS. Options include on-package text, USDA BE symbol, electronic/digital link (QR code), or phone number. 'not_required' when product is exempt.
attributes.references: USDA Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard (BFDS) 7 CFR Part 66; AMS

attributes.name: certificate_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the non-GMO certificate or GMO verification certificate expires and must be renewed. Drives compliance monitoring and re-certification workflows.
attributes.references: Non-GMO Project Standard; USDA NOP; GLOBALG.A.P.; GFSI

attributes.name: china_market_approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GMO transformation event has received regulatory approval for import or commercial use in China. Required for export documentation to Chinese buyers and compliance with MARA (Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs) biosafety certificates.
attributes.references: China MARA Biosafety Certificate; Codex Alimentarius; USDA Foreign Agricultural Service (FAS)

attributes.name: coa_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or document identifier for the Certificate of Analysis (COA) associated with this GMO declaration. The COA contains the full laboratory test results and is provided to customers and regulatory bodies.
attributes.references: USDA AMS; GFSI; SQF; BRC Global Standards; ISO 22000

attributes.name: cool_country_of_origin
attributes.business_glossary_term: Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) Country of Origin
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country of origin of the product as required for Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) compliance. Relevant for GMO declarations as country of origin may affect applicable GMO regulations.
attributes.references: USDA Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) 7 CFR Part 60; AMS; ISO 3166-1

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when this GMO declaration record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; ISO 22000; FSMA

attributes.name: declaration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the GMO declaration was formally submitted or issued. Represents the principal business event date for this record, distinct from system audit timestamps.
attributes.references: USDA BFDS 7 CFR Part 66; APHIS; GLOBALG.A.P.; ISO 22000

attributes.name: declaration_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for this GMO declaration record, used in regulatory submissions, export documentation, and audit trails. Follows internal numbering convention (e.g., GMO-2024-00123).
attributes.references: USDA Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard (BFDS); APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: declaration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the GMO declaration record. Tracks the workflow from initial draft through regulatory review to approval, expiry, or withdrawal. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_review|approved|rejected|expired|withdrawn — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard (BFDS); APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services; ISO 22000

attributes.name: declared_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or organization responsible for submitting this GMO declaration. Used for accountability, audit trail, and regulatory compliance documentation.
attributes.references: USDA BFDS; APHIS; FSMA; SOX

attributes.name: donor_organism
attributes.description: Scientific name of the organism from which the introduced genetic material was derived (e.g., 'Agrobacterium tumefaciens', 'Bacillus thuringiensis'). Required for regulatory submissions and export documentation.
attributes.references: APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services; Codex Alimentarius CAC/GL 45-2003; EU Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003

attributes.name: eu_market_approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GMO transformation event has received regulatory approval for commercial use or import in the European Union. Critical for export compliance and trade documentation.
attributes.references: EU Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003; EU Regulation (EC) No 1830/2003; European Food Safety Authority (EFSA)

attributes.name: gmo_status
attributes.description: Declared GMO classification of the product. 'bioengineered' aligns with USDA BE disclosure requirements. 'non_gmo' indicates verified absence of bioengineered material. 'conventional' indicates no GMO testing performed. 'under_assessment' indicates testing in progress.
attributes.references: USDA Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard (BFDS) 7 CFR Part 66; APHIS; EU Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003

attributes.name: gmo_threshold_percent
attributes.description: Maximum allowable percentage of GMO material for the product to be classified as non-GMO or to meet the applicable regulatory threshold for the target market (e.g., 0.9% for EU, 5.0% for Japan). Drives compliance determination logic.
attributes.references: EU Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003; Japan MHLW; Non-GMO Project Standard (0.9%); USDA BFDS

attributes.name: introduced_gene
attributes.description: Name of the gene or genetic construct introduced into the organism (e.g., 'cp4 epsps', 'cry1Ab', 'bar'). Used for scientific documentation, regulatory submissions, and export market approval cross-referencing.
attributes.references: APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services; Codex Alimentarius CAC/GL 45-2003; EU Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003

attributes.name: ip_protocol_reference
attributes.description: Reference code or document identifier for the Identity Preservation (IP) protocol applied to maintain the segregation and traceability of non-GMO or specific GMO product streams throughout the supply chain. Supports USDA BE disclosure and export market requirements.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) IP Guidelines; GLOBALG.A.P.; ISO 22000; GFSI

attributes.name: japan_market_approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GMO transformation event has received regulatory approval for import or commercial use in Japan. Required for export documentation to Japanese buyers under Japan's Food Safety Commission GMO approval framework.
attributes.references: Japan Food Safety Commission; Japan Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare (MHLW); Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when this GMO declaration record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and data freshness monitoring.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; ISO 22000; FSMA

attributes.name: non_gmo_certificate_number
attributes.description: Certificate or verification number issued by the non-GMO verification body. Used for audit trail, customer documentation, and regulatory compliance. Null when no third-party verification exists.
attributes.references: Non-GMO Project Standard; USDA National Organic Program (NOP); GFSI

attributes.name: non_gmo_verification_body
attributes.description: Name of the third-party organization that verified and certified the non-GMO status of the product (e.g., Non-GMO Project, USDA Organic NOP). Applicable only when gmo_status is 'non_gmo'. 'none' indicates no third-party verification.
attributes.references: Non-GMO Project Standard; USDA National Organic Program (NOP) 7 CFR Part 205; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product holds USDA National Organic Program (NOP) certification. Organic certification inherently prohibits GMO use; this flag supports cross-validation of GMO status against organic certification status.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) 7 CFR Part 205; IFOAM; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, qualifications, or explanations related to the GMO declaration. May include details on testing anomalies, conditional approvals, or market-specific exceptions.
attributes.references: USDA BFDS; GFSI; ISO 22000

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the GMO declaration was reviewed and approved or rejected by the responsible quality or regulatory team. Supports workflow tracking and audit compliance.
attributes.references: USDA BFDS; GFSI; SQF; BRC Global Standards; ISO 22000

attributes.name: reviewer_name
attributes.description: Name of the quality assurance or regulatory compliance officer who reviewed and approved or rejected this GMO declaration. Required for audit trail and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: USDA BFDS; GFSI; ISO 22000; SOX; FSMA

attributes.name: sample_lot_number
attributes.description: Lot or batch number of the product sample submitted for GMO testing. Enables traceability from the GMO declaration back to the specific production lot for recall management and audit purposes.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S; USDA AMS; HACCP; ISO 22000

attributes.name: test_result_percent
attributes.description: Quantitative result of GMO testing expressed as a percentage of GMO material detected in the sample (e.g., 0.0500 = 0.05%). Used to assess compliance against regulatory thresholds (e.g., EU 0.9% labeling threshold, Japan 5% threshold).
attributes.references: EU Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003 (0.9% threshold); Japan MHLW (5% threshold); ISO 21570; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: testing_laboratory
attributes.description: Name of the accredited laboratory that performed GMO testing on the product. Must be an ISO 17025-accredited laboratory for regulatory acceptance of results.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; USDA AMS; Codex Alimentarius CAC/GL 74-2010

attributes.name: testing_method
attributes.description: Laboratory method used to test for the presence or absence of GMO material in the product (e.g., PCR - Polymerase Chain Reaction, ELISA - Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay). 'not_tested' when no laboratory testing was performed.
attributes.references: ISO 21569; ISO 21570; ISO 21571; Codex Alimentarius CAC/GL 74-2010; USDA AMS

attributes.name: threshold_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Jurisdiction or market for which the gmo_threshold_percent applies. Uses ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or 'global' for internationally harmonized thresholds. Enables multi-market compliance management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USA|EU|CHN|JPN|BRA|CAN|AUS|global — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; Codex Alimentarius; USDA Foreign Agricultural Service (FAS)

attributes.name: trait_description
attributes.description: Descriptive name and functional summary of the introduced genetic trait (e.g., 'Herbicide tolerance - glyphosate', 'Insect resistance - Bt Cry1Ab protein', 'Drought tolerance - DREB transcription factor'). Supports product labeling, COA documentation, and export market compliance.
attributes.references: APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services; Codex Alimentarius CAC/GL 45-2003; USDA BFDS

attributes.name: us_market_approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this GMO transformation event has received regulatory approval for commercial use in the United States market. Verified against APHIS deregulation status and FDA/EPA approvals.
attributes.references: APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services; FDA; EPA; USDA BFDS 7 CFR Part 66

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which GMO status was verified through testing, certification, or third-party audit. Used to determine currency of the declaration and trigger re-verification workflows.
attributes.references: USDA BFDS; Non-GMO Project Standard; GLOBALG.A.P.; ISO 22000

products.name: grading_standard
products.description: Reference catalog of all applicable grading standards and grade specifications for agricultural commodities and products. Captures USDA grade designation (e.g., US No. 1, US Extra Fancy, USDA Prime), commodity type, grading criteria (moisture content, test weight, foreign material tolerance, defect limits), applicable regulation citation, effective date, and administering agency (AMS, FSIS, GIPSA). Supports quality inspection workflows and COA generation. Aligned with USDA AMS and GIPSA official grade standards.
products.reference: USDA AMS / GIPSA Official United States Standards for Grain

attributes.name: grading_standard_id

attributes.name: commodity_id

attributes.name: administering_agency

attributes.name: applicable_market_class

attributes.name: coa_template_reference

attributes.name: color_requirement
