attributes.references: USDA AMS COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) Regulations; 7 CFR Part 60

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this grading standard record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements per SOX and FSMA compliance frameworks.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); FSMA; ISO 22000; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this grading standard became or becomes officially effective and enforceable. Used to determine applicability during quality inspection and COA generation workflows.
attributes.references: USDA AMS; GIPSA; Federal Register

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this grading standard expires or is superseded. Null indicates the standard is open-ended with no scheduled expiration. Used to enforce version control in quality inspection workflows.
attributes.references: USDA AMS; GIPSA; Federal Register

attributes.name: foreign_material_max_pct
attributes.description: Maximum allowable percentage of foreign material (non-commodity matter) permitted for this grade designation. A standard GIPSA grading factor for grains, oilseeds, and other bulk commodities.
attributes.references: GIPSA Official Grain Standards; USDA AMS

attributes.name: gfsi_scheme_alignment
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI) Scheme Alignment
attributes.description: Identifies the GFSI-recognized food safety scheme (e.g., SQF, BRC, IFS, GLOBALG.A.P., FSSC 22000) with which this grading standard is aligned or compatible. Supports customer audit and certification requirements.
attributes.references: GFSI (Global Food Safety Initiative); SQF; BRC Global Standards; IFS; GLOBALG.A.P.; ISO 22000

attributes.name: gmo_applicability
attributes.description: Indicates whether this grading standard applies to GMO products, non-GMO products, or both. Supports product line segregation for non-GMO and conventional product lines per USDA and GLOBALG.A.P. requirements.
attributes.references: USDA AMS; GLOBALG.A.P.; Non-GMO Project Standard

attributes.name: grade_designation
attributes.description: Official grade label assigned by the administering agency (e.g., 'US No. 1', 'US No. 2', 'US Extra Fancy', 'USDA Prime', 'USDA Choice', 'US Grade A'). Represents the quality tier within the standard. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: US No. 1|US No. 2|US No. 3|US Extra Fancy|USDA Prime|USDA Choice|USDA Select|US Grade A|US Grade B|US Grade C — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA AMS; GIPSA Official Grade Standards; FSIS Grading Standards

attributes.name: grading_method
attributes.description: Primary method used to assess and assign this grade (e.g., visual inspection, mechanical sizing, laboratory analysis, electronic/NIR sensing, or a combination). Determines inspection workflow and equipment requirements in SAP QM and field operations.
attributes.references: USDA AMS; GIPSA; ISO 22000; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: inspection_frequency
attributes.description: Required frequency of grading inspections for commodities subject to this standard (e.g., per lot, per shipment, per batch, periodic, continuous). Drives quality inspection scheduling in SAP QM and Manhattan WMS workflows.
attributes.references: USDA AMS; GIPSA; FSMA; ISO 22000; HACCP

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this grading standard record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, data synchronization with SAP QM, and regulatory audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); FSMA; ISO 22000; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: moisture_content_max_pct
attributes.description: Maximum allowable moisture content (%) for a commodity to qualify for this grade designation. A critical grading criterion for grains and oilseeds per GIPSA standards. Exceeding this threshold results in grade reduction or rejection.
attributes.references: GIPSA Official Grain Standards; USDA AMS

attributes.name: mrl_threshold_ppm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Residue Limit (MRL) Threshold (Parts Per Million)
attributes.description: Maximum Residue Limit (MRL) threshold in parts per million (ppm) for pesticide or chemical residues applicable to this grading standard. Compliance with MRL is required for grade certification and export eligibility per EPA and Codex Alimentarius standards.
attributes.references: EPA MRL Regulations; Codex Alimentarius Commission; FDA; USDA AMS; FSMA

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional remarks, special conditions, or clarifications related to this grading standard (e.g., seasonal applicability, regional exceptions, special handling requirements). Used by quality and compliance teams.
attributes.references: USDA AMS; GIPSA

attributes.name: organic_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this grading standard is applicable to USDA National Organic Program (NOP) certified organic products. When True, the standard supports organic product line quality certification and COA generation.
attributes.references: USDA NOP (National Organic Program); 7 CFR Part 205

attributes.name: publication_date
attributes.description: Date on which this grading standard was officially published in the Federal Register or by the administering agency. Distinct from the effective date; used for regulatory audit trails and compliance documentation.
attributes.references: Federal Register; USDA AMS; GIPSA

attributes.name: regulation_citation
attributes.description: Official regulatory citation for the grading standard, including CFR title, part, and section (e.g., '7 CFR Part 26', '7 CFR Part 868', '9 CFR Part 319'). Required for COA generation and FSMA compliance documentation.
attributes.references: USDA AMS; GIPSA; FSIS; Code of Federal Regulations (CFR); FSMA

attributes.name: serious_defects_max_pct
attributes.description: Maximum allowable percentage of serious defects (e.g., heat-damaged kernels, mold, insect damage) permitted for this grade. Serious defects are a distinct sub-category of total defects with stricter tolerance limits per GIPSA standards.
attributes.references: GIPSA Official Grain Standards; USDA AMS

attributes.name: size_requirement
attributes.description: Size specification or size range required for this grade designation (e.g., minimum diameter in mm, weight per unit, count per carton). Applies to produce, eggs, and livestock products per USDA AMS grading standards.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Produce Grading Standards; FSIS

attributes.name: standard_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the grading standard (e.g., 'USDA-GR1-CORN', 'AMS-EF-APPLE'). Used as the business key for cross-system reference and COA generation.
attributes.references: USDA AMS; GIPSA Official Grade Standards; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

attributes.name: standard_document_url
attributes.description: URL link to the official published grading standard document on the administering agency's website (e.g., USDA AMS, GIPSA). Provides direct access to the authoritative source document for quality inspectors and compliance teams.
attributes.references: USDA AMS; GIPSA; Federal Register

attributes.name: standard_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the grading standard as published by the administering agency (e.g., 'United States Standards for Grades of Corn', 'USDA Extra Fancy Grade for Apples'). Used in COA documentation and quality inspection workflows.
attributes.references: USDA AMS; GIPSA Official Grade Standards

attributes.name: standard_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the grading standard. 'active' indicates the standard is currently in force; 'superseded' indicates replaced by a newer version; 'withdrawn' indicates no longer applicable; 'draft' or 'pending' indicates under review or awaiting official publication.
attributes.references: USDA AMS; GIPSA Official Grade Standards

attributes.name: superseded_by_code
attributes.description: Standard code of the newer grading standard that replaces this record when status is 'superseded'. Enables forward navigation in the version chain for compliance and historical reporting.
attributes.references: USDA AMS; GIPSA

attributes.name: test_weight_min_lbs_bu
attributes.description: Minimum test weight in pounds per bushel (lbs/bu) required for a grain or oilseed commodity to qualify for this grade. Test weight is a key GIPSA grading factor reflecting grain density and quality.
attributes.references: GIPSA Official Grain Standards; USDA AMS; BU (Bushel) unit of measure

attributes.name: total_defects_max_pct
attributes.description: Maximum allowable percentage of total defects (damaged kernels, heat damage, broken kernels, etc.) permitted for this grade designation. Applies to grain, oilseed, and produce grading per GIPSA and AMS standards.
attributes.references: GIPSA Official Grain Standards; USDA AMS

attributes.name: usda_commodity_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) Commodity Code
attributes.description: Official USDA commodity code associated with this grading standard, enabling alignment with USDA AMS, GIPSA, and WASDE reporting systems. Used for regulatory reporting and supply chain traceability.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Commodity Codes; GIPSA; WASDE

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version or revision number of the grading standard as published by the administering agency (e.g., '1.0', '2023', '3'). Supports audit trails and historical compliance verification.
attributes.references: USDA AMS; GIPSA; Federal Register

products.name: mrl_threshold
products.description: Reference table of Maximum Residue Limits (MRL) for pesticide active ingredients (AI) on specific agricultural commodities by regulatory jurisdiction. Captures active ingredient name, EPA registration number, commodity or commodity group, MRL value (ppm), regulatory jurisdiction (US EPA, EU, Codex Alimentarius, importing country), effective date, and tolerance type (established, exemption, import tolerance). Critical for pre-harvest interval (PHI) compliance, export documentation, and COA verification. Sourced from EPA and Codex Alimentarius databases.
products.reference: EPA 40 CFR Part 180 / Codex Alimentarius MRL Database

attributes.name: mrl_threshold_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each MRL threshold record in the regulatory reference catalog. Primary key for this table.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180; Codex Alimentarius CAC/MRL

attributes.name: active_ingredient_cas_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Active Ingredient Chemical Abstracts Service (CAS) Registry Number
attributes.description: CAS Registry Number uniquely identifying the pesticide active ingredient chemical substance. Enables unambiguous cross-referencing across regulatory databases and SDS documentation.
attributes.references: Chemical Abstracts Service (CAS); EPA Pesticide Chemical Search

attributes.name: active_ingredient_name
attributes.description: Common or IUPAC chemical name of the pesticide active ingredient (AI) for which the MRL is established. Used to cross-reference against agrochemical product labels and COA verification.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180; Codex Alimentarius CAC/MRL; ISO 1750 Pesticide Common Names

attributes.name: analytical_method_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the validated analytical method (e.g., AOAC, EN, EPA method number) used for laboratory detection and quantification of the residue to verify compliance with this MRL. Supports COA and laboratory accreditation alignment.
attributes.references: AOAC International Official Methods; EPA Pesticide Analytical Methods; EU SANTE/11312/2021 Analytical Quality Control

attributes.name: application_method
attributes.description: Method of pesticide application for which this MRL tolerance is established (e.g., foliar spray, soil application, seed treatment, post-harvest treatment, fumigation). Affects residue behavior and PHI calculation.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180; GLOBALG.A.P. Integrated Farm Assurance (IFA) Standard

attributes.name: codex_reference_number
attributes.description: Official Codex Alimentarius MRL reference number (CXL number) for this tolerance, enabling direct cross-reference to the Codex MRL database. Used for international trade documentation and export COA verification.
attributes.references: Codex Alimentarius Commission CAC/MRL Database; Codex Alimentarius Procedural Manual

attributes.name: commodity_code
attributes.description: Standardized commodity classification code from USDA or Codex Alimentarius commodity classification system. Used for regulatory reporting, export documentation, and WASDE alignment.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Commodity Codes; Codex Alimentarius CAC/MISC 4; EPA Commodity Definitions 40 CFR Part 180

attributes.name: commodity_group
attributes.description: Broader commodity group classification under which the specific commodity falls (e.g., cereal grains, fruiting vegetables, root and tuber vegetables, meat and poultry). Supports group tolerance application per EPA and Codex rules.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180 Subpart D; Codex Alimentarius CAC/MISC 4 Commodity Classification

attributes.name: commodity_name
attributes.description: Name of the agricultural commodity or commodity group to which the MRL applies (e.g., wheat grain, fresh tomatoes, beef muscle). Aligned with USDA commodity codes and Codex commodity classifications.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) Commodity Codes; Codex Alimentarius CAC/MISC 4 Classification of Foods

attributes.name: commodity_part
attributes.description: Specific part of the commodity to which the MRL applies (e.g., whole commodity, edible portion only, peel, grain, muscle tissue, fat, liver, milk, eggs). Relevant for processed commodity tolerances and animal product MRLs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: whole_commodity|edible_portion|peel|seed|grain|muscle|fat|liver|kidney|milk|eggs — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Codex Alimentarius CAC/MISC 4 Commodity Classification; EPA 40 CFR Part 180; EU Regulation (EC) No 396/2005 Annex I

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this MRL threshold record was first created in the system. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer ingestion tracking per Databricks Lakehouse governance standards.
attributes.references: ISO 22000:2018 Food Safety Management; FSMA Records Requirements 21 CFR Part 112; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Originating regulatory database or system from which this MRL record was sourced (e.g., EPA Office of Pesticide Programs tolerance database, Codex MRL database, EU Pesticides database). Supports data lineage and refresh cycle management.
attributes.references: EPA OPP Tolerance Database; Codex Alimentarius MRL Database; EU Pesticides Database (ec.europa.eu/food/plant/pesticides)

attributes.name: default_mrl_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this MRL is a default/general tolerance applied in the absence of a specific established tolerance (e.g., Codex default of 0.01 ppm, EU default of 0.01 ppm under Regulation EC 396/2005). True = default MRL applies; False = specific established tolerance.
attributes.references: EU Regulation (EC) No 396/2005 Article 18(1)(b); Codex Alimentarius CAC/MRL Default

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this MRL tolerance became legally effective and enforceable by the regulatory jurisdiction. Used to determine applicability for current crop season compliance and PHI scheduling.
attributes.references: EPA Federal Register Final Rule; Codex Alimentarius Step 8 Adoption; EU Official Journal Publication

attributes.name: epa_registration_number
attributes.description: EPA pesticide registration number associated with the active ingredient or product formulation. Links MRL tolerance to the registered pesticide product for PHI compliance and export documentation.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 3; 40 CFR Part 152

attributes.name: exemption_reason
attributes.description: Regulatory justification for a tolerance exemption, applicable when tolerance_type is 'exemption'. Describes why the active ingredient is exempt from MRL requirements (e.g., naturally occurring substance, minimal risk, biochemical pesticide). Null for non-exemption tolerance types.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180.910-180.960 Exemptions; FIFRA Section 25(b)

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this MRL tolerance expires or is scheduled for revocation. Null for indefinite tolerances. Critical for time-limited emergency exemptions (Section 18) and temporary import tolerances.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 18 Emergency Exemption; 40 CFR Part 180.470; Codex Alimentarius Procedural Manual

attributes.name: federal_register_citation
attributes.description: U.S. Federal Register citation (volume, page number, and date) for the EPA final rule establishing or amending this tolerance. Provides regulatory traceability for audit and legal compliance purposes.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180; U.S. Federal Register; Administrative Procedure Act

attributes.name: gmo_applicability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this MRL tolerance specifically applies to or was established in the context of GMO crop varieties (e.g., herbicide-tolerant GMO crops with higher herbicide residue tolerances). True = GMO-specific tolerance; False = applies to conventional and GMO equally.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180; USDA APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services; EU Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003

attributes.name: import_tolerance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this MRL was established specifically as an import tolerance to facilitate trade for commodities treated with a pesticide not registered domestically. True = import tolerance; False = domestic tolerance. Relevant for FOB/CIF export documentation.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 408(e); 40 CFR Part 180; Codex Alimentarius Import Tolerance Procedures

attributes.name: jurisdiction_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the importing or regulating country associated with this MRL. Used for export eligibility checks and Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) compliance. Null for multi-country jurisdictions (e.g., EU, Codex).
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; USDA Foreign Agricultural Service (FAS) Export Requirements; COOL 7 USC 1638

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which this MRL record was last reviewed and confirmed against the authoritative regulatory source database. Supports data quality management and ensures currency of compliance reference data.
attributes.references: FSMA Preventive Controls Rule 21 CFR Part 117; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; ISO 22000:2018 Food Safety Management

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this MRL threshold record was most recently modified. Used for incremental data refresh, change detection, and regulatory data currency validation in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 22000:2018 Food Safety Management; FSMA Records Requirements 21 CFR Part 112; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: limit_of_quantification_ppm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Limit of Quantification (LOQ) in Parts Per Million (ppm)
attributes.description: Lowest concentration of the active ingredient residue that can be reliably quantified by the validated analytical method. Used to determine whether a non-detect result constitutes MRL compliance, particularly for default MRL tolerances.
attributes.references: EU SANTE/11312/2021 Analytical Quality Control Guidelines; AOAC International; EPA Pesticide Analytical Methods

attributes.name: mode_of_action_code
attributes.description: IRAC (Insecticide Resistance Action Committee), FRAC (Fungicide Resistance Action Committee), or HRAC (Herbicide Resistance Action Committee) mode of action classification code for the active ingredient. Supports IPM resistance management planning.
attributes.references: IRAC Mode of Action Classification; FRAC Code List; HRAC Classification; EPA Pesticide Registration

attributes.name: mrl_value_ppm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Residue Limit (MRL) Value in Parts Per Million (ppm)
attributes.description: The established maximum residue limit expressed in parts per million (ppm, equivalent to mg/kg) for the active ingredient on the specified commodity. Core compliance threshold used for COA verification, pre-harvest interval enforcement, and export eligibility determination.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180; Codex Alimentarius MRL Database (CXL); EU Regulation (EC) No 396/2005

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional regulatory notes, conditions, or qualifications associated with this MRL tolerance (e.g., specific use restrictions, footnotes from regulatory publications, pending review status, or special conditions for application).
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180; Codex Alimentarius CAC/MRL; EU Regulation (EC) No 396/2005

attributes.name: organic_approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the active ingredient is approved for use in certified organic production under USDA National Organic Program (NOP) standards. True = approved for organic use; False = not approved. Supports organic product line compliance and NOP certification maintenance.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) 7 CFR Part 205; OMRI Listed Materials

attributes.name: phi_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days required between the last pesticide application and harvest to ensure residues do not exceed the MRL at time of harvest. Critical for crop protection scheduling and FSMA compliance. Sourced from EPA label requirements.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Label Requirements; FSMA Produce Safety Rule 21 CFR Part 112; GLOBALG.A.P. Crop Protection Module

attributes.name: processing_factor
attributes.description: Ratio of residue concentration in the processed commodity to residue concentration in the raw agricultural commodity (RAC). Used to calculate MRL compliance for processed food products derived from the raw commodity. Values >1 indicate concentration; values <1 indicate reduction.
attributes.references: Codex Alimentarius Guidelines on Pesticide Residues in Processed Foods (CAC/GL 79); EPA 40 CFR Part 180

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The regulatory authority or jurisdiction that established this MRL (e.g., US_EPA for United States Environmental Protection Agency, EU for European Union Regulation EC 396/2005, CODEX for Codex Alimentarius Commission). Critical for export documentation and multi-market compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: US_EPA|EU|CODEX|CANADA|JAPAN|AUSTRALIA|CHINA|BRAZIL|MEXICO|KOREA|INDIA|TAIWAN — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180; EU Regulation (EC) No 396/2005; Codex Alimentarius CAC/MRL; GLOBALG.A.P. MRL Monitoring

attributes.name: residue_definition
attributes.description: Regulatory definition of what constitutes the measurable residue for enforcement purposes, including parent compound and relevant metabolites or degradation products. Critical for laboratory COA analysis method alignment.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180 Tolerance Definitions; Codex Alimentarius Residue Definition Guidelines; EU Regulation (EC) No 396/2005 Annex I

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: Date on which a previously established MRL tolerance was formally revoked or cancelled by the regulatory authority. Null for active tolerances. Supports historical compliance audit trails and COA re-verification.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180 Revocation Notices; EU Regulation (EC) No 396/2005 Amendments

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: Native record identifier from the originating regulatory database (e.g., EPA tolerance petition number, Codex CXL reference, EU database entry ID). Enables traceability back to the authoritative source system for audit and refresh purposes.
attributes.references: EPA OPP Tolerance Database; Codex Alimentarius MRL Database; EU Pesticides Database

attributes.name: tolerance_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the MRL tolerance record: 'active' for currently enforceable tolerances, 'revoked' for cancelled tolerances, 'expired' for time-limited tolerances past their expiry date, 'pending' for proposed tolerances under regulatory review, 'suspended' for temporarily suspended tolerances.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180; Codex Alimentarius Procedural Manual; EU Regulation (EC) No 396/2005

attributes.name: tolerance_type
attributes.description: Classification of the MRL tolerance type: 'established' for standard EPA/Codex tolerances, 'exemption' for active ingredients exempt from tolerance requirements, 'import_tolerance' for tolerances set specifically for imported commodities, 'emergency_exemption' for Section 18 emergency use tolerances, 'group_tolerance' for tolerances covering a commodity group.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 18; 40 CFR Part 180.1; Codex Alimentarius Procedural Manual

products.name: label
products.description: Manages all regulatory and commercial labeling content and compliance records for agricultural products. Covers COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) designations, USDA organic seal authorization, non-GMO label claims, USDA grade shield usage, allergen declarations (FDA Big 9: milk, eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, wheat, soybeans, sesame — including intentional inclusion flags, cross-contact risk levels, and allergen control measure references), nutrition facts panel data (macronutrients, micronutrients, caloric value, serving size, analysis method), net weight declarations, and label artwork file references. Captures label version, effective date, regulatory approval reference, applicable markets/jurisdictions, and HACCP allergen control plan linkage. Tracks FDA FSMA labeling and Preventive Controls allergen management compliance, USDA AMS label approval status, and supports SAP S/4HANA QM module label management.

attributes.name: applicable_markets

attributes.name: calories_per_serving

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: expiry_date

attributes.name: haccp_allergen_control_plan_ref
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) Allergen Control Plan Reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the HACCP allergen control plan document governing allergen management for this product label. Links label allergen declarations to the facility's preventive controls documentation.

attributes.name: label_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code assigned to this label version, used for cross-referencing with SAP QM label management and regulatory submission tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; USDA AMS Label Approval

attributes.name: label_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the label, typically reflecting the product name, market, and version (e.g., 'Organic Whole Wheat Flour — US Retail v3').
attributes.references: USDA AMS; FDA FSMA

attributes.name: label_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the label record. Tracks progression from draft through regulatory approval to active use, supersession by a newer version, or withdrawal from market.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; USDA AMS Label Approval; FDA FSMA

attributes.name: label_type
attributes.description: Classification of the label by its intended commercial use channel: retail consumer packaging, foodservice bulk, export market, private label, or ingredient/intermediate product.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; USDA AMS

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this label record. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and downstream data synchronization.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; SOX; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

attributes.name: mrl_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this label's associated product has been verified to comply with applicable Maximum Residue Limit (MRL) thresholds for pesticide and agrochemical residues as set by EPA, Codex Alimentarius, or destination market regulators.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180; Codex Alimentarius MRL Database; FDA Pesticide Residue Monitoring Program

attributes.name: net_weight_declaration
attributes.description: Mandatory net weight or net quantity statement as it appears on the label (e.g., '5 LB (2.27 kg)', '16 FL OZ (473 mL)'). Must comply with NIST Handbook 133 and FDA net quantity of contents regulations.

attributes.name: non_gmo_claim_flag

attributes.description: Indicates whether this label carries a non-GMO (Genetically Modified Organism) claim. When True, supporting documentation and supply chain traceability records must be maintained per USDA BE Disclosure Standard.

attributes.name: nutrition_analysis_method
