attributes.name: organic_seal_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether this label is authorized to display the USDA Organic seal under the National Organic Program (NOP). True only when the product and operation hold valid NOP certification.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) — 7 CFR Part 205; ISO 22000

attributes.name: plu_code
attributes.description: 4 or 5-digit Price Look-Up (PLU) code used for fresh produce identification at retail point-of-sale. Assigned by the International Federation for Produce Standards (IFPS). Applicable to fresh fruit, vegetable, and herb products.
attributes.references: IFPS PLU Code Standard; USDA AMS

attributes.name: protein_g
attributes.description: Protein content per serving in grams as declared on the Nutrition Facts panel. Mandatory declaration on FDA Nutrition Facts label.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101.9

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_reference
attributes.description: Official reference number or tracking code issued by the regulatory authority (e.g., USDA AMS label approval number, FDA submission reference) confirming this label has been reviewed and authorized.
attributes.references: USDA AMS; FDA FSMA; FSIS

attributes.name: serving_size_description
attributes.description: Serving size as declared on the Nutrition Facts panel (e.g., '1 cup (240g)', '2 tablespoons (32g)'). Must align with FDA Reference Amounts Customarily Consumed (RACC) for the product category.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101.9; FDA RACC Table

attributes.name: servings_per_container
attributes.description: Number of servings per container as declared on the Nutrition Facts panel. May be a whole number or decimal (e.g., 2.5 servings). Required for FDA-compliant Nutrition Facts labeling.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101.9

attributes.name: sodium_mg
attributes.description: Sodium content per serving in milligrams as declared on the Nutrition Facts panel. Key nutrient for dietary guidance and FDA mandatory declaration.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101.9

attributes.name: total_carbohydrate_g
attributes.description: Total carbohydrate content per serving in grams as declared on the Nutrition Facts panel, including dietary fiber and total sugars.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101.9

attributes.name: total_fat_g
attributes.description: Total fat content per serving in grams as declared on the Nutrition Facts panel. Includes saturated fat, trans fat, polyunsaturated fat, and monounsaturated fat.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 101.9; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: upc_code
attributes.description: 12-digit Universal Product Code (UPC) barcode number printed on the label for retail point-of-sale scanning and supply chain identification. Assigned by GS1 and linked to the product SKU.
attributes.references: GS1 US; FDA FSMA; USDA AMS

attributes.name: usda_ams_approval_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) Label Approval Status
attributes.description: Status of the label submission and approval with the USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS), required for meat, poultry, and egg products. Tracks submission through final approval or rejection.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Label Approval Program; FSIS

attributes.name: usda_grade_shield_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this label is authorized to display a USDA grade shield (e.g., USDA Grade A, USDA Choice). Requires grading certificate from USDA AMS grading service.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Grading and Certification Programs

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for this label iteration (e.g., '1.0', '2.3'). Incremented whenever label content, claims, or regulatory data changes. Supports label version history and change control.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; ISO 22000; FDA FSMA Preventive Controls

products.name: bundle
products.description: Defines bundled product offerings combining multiple agricultural products or inputs sold as a single commercial package — such as seed + crop protection programs, starter fertilizer + seed treatment packages, feed + supplement rations, or commodity + logistics service bundles. Captures bundle name, bundle type (fixed, configurable), bundle pricing method (sum of components, discounted package, flat rate), minimum order quantity, availability period, and target customer segment. Includes component-level detail: individual component products (FK to product_master), quantity per bundle, unit of measure, substitution allowed flag, component-level pricing contribution, and component sequence/priority. Supports decomposition of bundle orders into individual product fulfillment lines and component-level inventory reservation. Enables value-added selling programs, input supply dealer agreements, and crop input financing packages.
products.reference: SAP SD Material Listing / Bundled Offering Management

attributes.name: bundle_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the product bundle record. Primary key for the product_bundle data product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Sales BOM / Bundle Object

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_segment. Business justification: Agriculture product bundles (seed+chemical programs, early-order packages) are designed and priced for specific customer segments. Sales planning, bundle eligibility, and campaign management require s
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: availability_end_date
attributes.description: Calendar date after which the bundle is no longer available for new sales orders. Null indicates open-ended availability. Critical for seasonal programs aligned with planting windows and PHI compliance cutoffs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Valid To Date; EPA PHI Compliance; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: availability_start_date
attributes.description: Calendar date from which the bundle becomes available for sales order entry. Used for seasonal crop input programs (e.g., spring planting packages available from January 1) and promotional bundle windows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Valid From Date; Granular Farm Management Seasonal Planning

attributes.name: bundle_category
attributes.description: Agricultural domain classification of the bundle grouping: e.g., 'seed_crop_protection' (seed + IPM program), 'fertilizer_seed' (NPK starter + seed treatment), 'feed_supplement' (livestock feed + nutritional supplement ration), 'commodity_logistics' (grain commodity + BOL/freight service). Supports product hierarchy analytics and dealer program reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: seed_crop_protection|seed_treatment|fertilizer_seed|feed_supplement|commodity_logistics|input_program|custom_application — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service — Commodity Classification; SAP S/4HANA MM Product Hierarchy

attributes.name: bundle_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the bundle in commercial catalogs, dealer agreements, and ERP sales order entry. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA material number for bundle materials.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/SD — Material Master; GS1 SKU Standards

attributes.name: bundle_description
attributes.description: Detailed commercial description of the bundle including agronomic purpose, target crop or livestock species, key benefits, and program highlights. Used in dealer catalogs, Salesforce CRM opportunity management, and customer-facing marketing materials.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Description; Salesforce CRM Product Catalog; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: bundle_name
attributes.description: Human-readable commercial name of the product bundle as presented to dealers, distributors, and customers (e.g., 'Spring Corn Starter Program', 'Beef Cattle Feed + Supplement Ration Pack').
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Sales Material Description; Granular Farm Management Product Catalog

attributes.name: bundle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the bundle offering: 'draft' (under development, not yet available for sale), 'active' (available for order entry), 'discontinued' (no longer offered, existing orders honored), 'seasonal' (available only within defined availability window), 'suspended' (temporarily unavailable due to supply or compliance hold).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Status; GLOBALG.A.P. Product Availability Controls

attributes.name: bundle_type
attributes.description: Classification of the bundle structure: 'fixed' (pre-defined components, no substitution), 'configurable' (customer selects from allowed components), 'promotional' (time-limited marketing bundle), 'subscription' (recurring delivery program), 'financing' (crop input financing package with deferred payment). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fixed|configurable|promotional|subscription|financing — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Sales BOM Category; Granular Farm Management Bundle Configuration

attributes.name: coa_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Certificate of Analysis (COA) must accompany shipment of this bundle, confirming that all components meet specified quality, purity, and safety standards. Required for seed lots, agrochemical bundles, and food-grade commodity packages per GFSI and customer quality agreements.
attributes.references: GFSI — Global Food Safety Initiative; SQF Code; BRC Global Standards; SAP S/4HANA QM — Quality Certificate

attributes.name: component_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct product components included in this bundle definition. Derived at bundle creation and maintained as a denormalized operational field to support quick bundle complexity assessment without joining to component lines.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Sales BOM Item Count; Granular Farm Management Bundle Configuration

attributes.name: cool_label_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) is required on the bundle packaging or accompanying documentation per USDA AMS regulations (True = COOL labeling mandatory; False = not required). Applies to covered commodities including muscle cuts, ground meats, fish, perishable agricultural commodities, peanuts, and ginseng.
attributes.references: USDA AMS — Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) 7 USC 1638; Agricultural Marketing Act

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the product bundle record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial reporting controls.
attributes.references: SOX — Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; ISO 8601; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code applicable to all monetary fields on this bundle record (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'BRL'). Supports multi-currency international agricultural trade operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS; GAAP

attributes.name: dealer_program_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the input supply dealer agreement or crop input financing program under which this bundle is offered. Links the bundle to specific dealer incentive structures, early-order discount programs, and Salesforce CRM partner agreement tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Partner Agreement Management; Granular Farm Management Dealer Programs; SAP S/4HANA SD — Sales Deal

attributes.name: decomposition_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a bundle order can be decomposed into individual product fulfillment lines for warehouse picking, inventory reservation, and invoicing purposes (True = decompose to component lines; False = fulfill as a pre-assembled bundle unit). Critical for Manhattan Associates WMS order fulfillment logic.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Order Decomposition; SAP S/4HANA SD — Delivery Processing

attributes.name: discount_pct
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to the sum-of-components price when pricing_method is 'discounted_package'. Represents the value-added selling incentive for purchasing the bundle versus individual products. Range: 0.00–100.00.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Condition Type K007 (Customer Discount); Granular Farm Management Dealer Programs

attributes.name: early_order_cutoff_date
attributes.description: Last date by which an order must be placed to qualify for the early_order_discount_pct. A key commercial date in pre-season crop input programs and dealer stocking agreements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Pricing Validity; Granular Farm Management Seasonal Planning

attributes.name: early_order_discount_pct
attributes.description: Additional percentage discount applied when the bundle is ordered before the early-order cutoff date, incentivizing pre-season purchasing commitments common in crop input dealer programs. Range: 0.00–100.00.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Condition Type K005 (Early Order Discount); Granular Farm Management Dealer Programs

attributes.name: financing_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bundle qualifies for crop input financing programs (deferred payment, operating line of credit, or third-party ag lender programs). True = bundle is eligible for financing at point of sale; False = cash/standard credit terms only.
attributes.references: USDA Farm Service Agency (FSA) Operating Loans; Granular Farm Management Financial Planning; SAP S/4HANA FI — Credit Management

attributes.name: fsma_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this bundle and all its components have been reviewed and confirmed compliant with applicable FDA FSMA rules (Produce Safety Rule, Preventive Controls for Human Food, etc.). Required for bundles containing fresh produce or food-grade commodities.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) — 21 CFR Parts 112, 117; GFSI; SQF; BRC Global Standards

attributes.name: gmo_status
attributes.description: GMO content declaration for the bundle as a whole: 'non_gmo' (no GMO components), 'gmo_contains' (one or more GMO components present), 'gmo_free_verified' (third-party verified non-GMO, e.g., Non-GMO Project), 'not_applicable' (service or non-biological bundle). Required for COOL labeling, export documentation, and customer transparency programs.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS — Biotechnology Regulatory Services; COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) 7 USC 1638; Non-GMO Project Standard

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight of the bundle in kilograms including all components and packaging. Used for freight cost calculation, BOL documentation, TMS load planning, and HAZMAT transport compliance.
attributes.references: GS1 Logistics Standards; DOT 49 CFR — Freight Weight; SAP S/4HANA MM — Gross Weight; TMS Load Planning

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the bundle contains one or more hazardous materials components (e.g., restricted-use pesticides, anhydrous ammonia fertilizer) requiring special handling, labeling, and transport documentation per DOT and EPA regulations.
attributes.references: EPA — Hazardous Materials Regulations; DOT 49 CFR Parts 171-180; EPA FIFRA; OSHA HazCom Standard 29 CFR 1910.1200

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the product bundle record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX — Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; ISO 8601; SAP S/4HANA Change Document

attributes.name: list_price
attributes.description: Published commercial list price for the complete bundle as a single sellable unit, expressed in the operating currency. Used as the baseline for dealer discount calculations and crop input financing packages.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Condition Type PR00; GAAP Revenue Recognition ASC 606

attributes.name: marketing_program_name
attributes.description: Name of the branded marketing or dealer incentive program under which this bundle is promoted (e.g., 'Grow More Spring Program 2025', 'Precision Livestock Nutrition Package'). Supports Salesforce CRM campaign attribution and ROI reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Campaign Management; Granular Farm Management Dealer Programs

attributes.name: min_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum number of bundle units that must be ordered in a single sales transaction. Enforced at SO entry in SAP S/4HANA SD. Supports dealer agreement minimum purchase commitments and input supply program thresholds.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Minimum Order Quantity; Granular Farm Management Dealer Agreements

attributes.name: order_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure in which the bundle is ordered and invoiced (e.g., 'EA' = each bundle unit, 'CS' = case, 'PAL' = pallet, 'MT' = metric ton, 'BU' = bushel for commodity bundles, 'CWT' = hundredweight). Aligns with SAP S/4HANA base UOM for the bundle material. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|BG|BX|PAL|MT|CWT|BU — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Base Unit of Measure; USDA AMS Unit of Measure Standards; GS1

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all components in this bundle meet USDA National Organic Program (NOP) certification requirements, qualifying the bundle for organic product labeling and marketing (True = fully NOP-certified bundle; False = conventional or mixed).
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) — 7 CFR Part 205; GLOBALG.A.P. Organic Certification

attributes.name: pricing_method
attributes.description: Method used to determine the commercial price of the bundle: 'sum_of_components' (total of individual component list prices), 'discounted_package' (sum of components minus a bundle discount), 'flat_rate' (single fixed price regardless of component values), 'cost_plus' (COGS-based markup), 'negotiated' (dealer/contract-specific price set at agreement level).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Pricing Procedure (RVAA01); Oracle NetSuite Pricing Engine

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Shelf life of the bundle in days, determined by the shortest shelf life among all included components. Used for inventory expiry management, FEFO (First Expired First Out) picking logic in Manhattan Associates WMS, and MRL compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA — Preventive Controls; USDA FSIS Shelf Life Standards; Manhattan Associates WMS FEFO Logic; SAP S/4HANA MM — Shelf Life Management

attributes.name: sku_code
attributes.description: Internal Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) code assigned to the bundle for inventory management, warehouse operations, and ERP material master alignment. Used in Manhattan Associates WMS for stock reservation and order fulfillment of pre-assembled bundle units.
attributes.references: GS1 SKU Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Number; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: storage_temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum allowable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the bundle, driven by the most temperature-sensitive component. Exceeding this threshold may compromise product efficacy, safety, or regulatory compliance (e.g., vaccine-based livestock bundles, biological crop protection products).
attributes.references: USDA AMS Cold Chain Standards; FDA FSMA Preventive Controls; Manhattan Associates WMS Temperature Zone Management

attributes.name: storage_temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum allowable storage temperature in degrees Celsius for the bundle as a whole, driven by the most temperature-sensitive component (e.g., biological seed treatments, live cultures in feed supplements). Used by Manhattan Associates WMS for cold chain storage assignment.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Cold Chain Standards; FDA FSMA Preventive Controls; Manhattan Associates WMS Temperature Zone Management

attributes.name: substitution_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether one or more components within this bundle may be substituted with equivalent products at order fulfillment time (True = substitution permitted per bundle rules; False = exact components required). Supports supply chain flexibility and Manhattan Associates WMS substitution logic.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Item Substitution; Manhattan Associates WMS Substitution Rules

attributes.name: upc_code
attributes.description: 12-digit GS1 Universal Product Code (UPC) barcode identifier for the bundle, used for point-of-sale scanning, retail shelf labeling, and RFID-based inventory tracking in dealer and distributor locations.
attributes.references: GS1 UPC Standard; USDA AMS PLU/UPC Guidelines; RFID Standards ISO 15693

products.name: bundle_component
products.description: Association table capturing the individual component products within each product bundle, including component product reference, quantity per bundle, unit of measure, substitution allowed flag, and component-level pricing contribution. Enables decomposition of bundle orders into individual product fulfillment lines and supports component-level inventory reservation. Carries its own business data (quantity, pricing contribution) beyond the simple M:N relationship.
products.reference: SAP SD BOM / Bundle Component Management

attributes.name: bundle_component_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each bundle component association record within the agricultural product catalog. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Bundle/Kit Component Configuration

attributes.name: bundle_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent bundle product (e.g., a seed+fertilizer+crop protection kit, or a livestock feed package) that contains this component. Links to the product catalog master record for the bundle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Material BOM Header; Oracle NetSuite Item Assembly

attributes.name: master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual component product (e.g., a specific seed variety, agrochemical, fertilizer, or feed ingredient) that is included within the parent bundle. Links to the product catalog master record for the component.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Bill of Materials (BOM) Component; Oracle NetSuite Assembly Item

attributes.name: primary_bundle_substitute_product_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the approved substitute product that may replace this component when substitution_allowed_flag is True and the primary component is unavailable. Enables pre-approved substitution workflows in warehouse fulfillment and order management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Material Substitution Configuration; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: coa_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Certificate of Analysis (COA) must accompany this component when fulfilling bundle orders. Applicable for seed lots, agrochemicals, and food-grade agricultural inputs requiring quality documentation per GFSI, SQF, or BRC standards.
attributes.references: GFSI — Global Food Safety Initiative; SQF Institute; BRC Global Standards; ISO 22000; SAP S/4HANA QM — Quality Certificate

attributes.name: component_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of this component product included in one unit of the parent bundle. Supports fractional quantities for bulk commodities (e.g., 2.5 kg of seed per bundle, 0.5 L of agrochemical per kit). Used for inventory reservation and fulfillment decomposition.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/SD — BOM Component Quantity; USDA Commodity Measurement Standards

attributes.name: component_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric ordering position of this component within the bundle, used for display sequencing, picking order in warehouse fulfillment, and structured bill-of-materials presentation. Aligns with SAP BOM item number sequencing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — BOM Item Sequence; Manhattan Associates WMS — Pick Sequence

attributes.name: component_sku
attributes.description: The Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) code for this component as it appears within the bundle context. May differ from the standalone product SKU when the component is packaged or sized differently for bundle inclusion (e.g., a smaller pack size of seed included in a starter kit bundle).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Number; GS1 SKU Standards; Oracle NetSuite — Item SKU

attributes.name: component_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this bundle component association: active (currently included in bundle), inactive (temporarily excluded), discontinued (permanently removed from bundle), or pending_approval (awaiting quality or regulatory review before activation).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Status; Oracle NetSuite — Item Status; GLOBALG.A.P. Product Lifecycle

attributes.name: component_type
attributes.description: Classification of the component's role within the bundle: primary (core required component), optional (customer-selectable add-on), promotional (included for marketing purposes), sample (trial quantity), or freebie (complimentary item). Drives fulfillment logic and revenue recognition treatment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Bundle Configuration; Oracle NetSuite — Assembly Item Types; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: component_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the component quantity within the bundle (e.g., KG for kilograms, BU for bushels, L for liters, EA for each). Aligns with USDA commodity measurement standards and SAP base unit of measure configuration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|LB|MT|CWT|BU|L|ML|EA|BAG|TON|OZ|GAL — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Measurement Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM — Unit of Measure; ISO 80000-1 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: component_volume_l
attributes.description: The volume of this component in liters as included in the bundle, used for packaging dimension calculations, storage space planning, and container load optimization. Particularly relevant for liquid agrochemicals, fertilizer solutions, and liquid feed supplements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Master Volume; Manhattan Associates WMS — Volumetric Calculations

attributes.name: component_weight_kg
attributes.description: The gross weight of this component in kilograms as included in the bundle, used for total bundle weight calculation, freight cost estimation, shipping label generation, and logistics planning. Aligns with SAP material master weight data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Master Weight; USDA Commodity Weight Standards; DOT Freight Weight Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this bundle component association record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial reporting controls.
attributes.references: SOX — Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); ISO 22000 Record Keeping

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date after which this component is no longer valid within the bundle. Null indicates an open-ended association with no planned expiry. Used for seasonal bundle management, promotional period control, and regulatory compliance (e.g., MRL threshold changes requiring bundle reformulation).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/SD — Validity Period; FDA FSMA Product Labeling; USDA NOP Organic Certification

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this component is valid and active within the bundle. Supports seasonal agricultural product bundles (e.g., spring planting kits) and time-bound promotional bundles. Aligns with SAP validity period configuration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/SD — Validity Period; Granular Farm Management — Seasonal Planning

attributes.name: fulfillment_split_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component may be fulfilled separately from other bundle components (True) or must be shipped together with all other components in a single shipment (False). Supports split-shipment scenarios for agricultural bundles where seed and agrochemicals may ship from different warehouses.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Delivery Split; Manhattan Associates WMS — Order Splitting; USDA Shipping Requirements

attributes.name: gmo_status
attributes.description: Indicates the GMO status of this component within the bundle: gmo (contains genetically modified organisms), non_gmo (does not contain GMOs but not certified), gmo_free_certified (third-party certified non-GMO), or not_applicable (for non-biological components). Required for COOL labeling and USDA reporting.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services; FDA GMO Labeling; Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) Act; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is classified as a hazardous material requiring special handling, storage, and shipping documentation (e.g., certain agrochemicals, pesticides, or fertilizers). Triggers HAZMAT compliance workflows in logistics and warehouse operations.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Hazardous Material Classification; DOT 49 CFR Hazardous Materials Regulations; OSHA SDS Requirements; SAP S/4HANA QM — Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: inventory_reservation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether inventory for this component should be reserved at the component level upon bundle order placement (True) or managed at the bundle level only (False). Drives Manhattan Associates WMS inventory reservation logic for component-level stock allocation.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Inventory Reservation; SAP S/4HANA MM — Reservation Management

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this bundle component association record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, data synchronization with SAP S/4HANA and Oracle NetSuite, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX — Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Change Document; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: The procurement or production lead time in days for this component, used for bundle availability planning and supply chain scheduling. Critical for seasonal agricultural inputs where seed, fertilizer, and crop protection products must be available before planting windows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Lead Time; Granular Farm Management — Supply Planning; FMIS Planning

attributes.name: mandatory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component is mandatory for the bundle to be valid and fulfillable. True = component must be present for bundle fulfillment; False = component is optional and may be excluded. Distinct from substitution_allowed_flag which governs product swaps rather than component inclusion.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — BOM Item Relevancy; Manhattan Associates WMS — Order Fulfillment Rules

attributes.name: max_quantity
attributes.description: The maximum quantity of this component that may be included in the bundle, applicable for variable-quantity bundles. Enforces upper limits for regulatory compliance (e.g., maximum agrochemical quantity per bundle per EPA/MRL restrictions) and inventory allocation controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Maximum Order Quantity; EPA MRL Compliance; FDA FSMA

attributes.name: min_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum quantity of this component that must be included in the bundle, applicable for variable-quantity bundles where customers may select quantities within a defined range (e.g., minimum 1 bag of seed per bundle). Used in order validation and fulfillment planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Minimum Order Quantity; Oracle NetSuite — Item Quantity Rules

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, special handling instructions, or agronomic guidance specific to this component within the bundle context (e.g., 'Apply within 48 hours of seed treatment', 'Store separately from fertilizer', 'Requires cold chain handling'). Not for regulatory documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Long Text; Granular Farm Management — Field Notes

attributes.name: organic_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specific component within the bundle is certified organic under the USDA National Organic Program (NOP). Critical for maintaining bundle-level organic certification integrity — all mandatory components must be organic-certified for the bundle to carry an organic label.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) 7 CFR Part 205; GLOBALG.A.P. Organic Certification; ISO 22000

attributes.name: pricing_contribution_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value attributed to this component within the overall bundle price, representing the component's share of the bundle's total selling price. Used for revenue allocation, cost-of-goods-sold (COGS) decomposition, and component-level profitability analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Condition Pricing; Oracle NetSuite — Item Pricing; GAAP Revenue Allocation (ASC 606); IFRS 15

attributes.name: pricing_contribution_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the component pricing contribution amount (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD). Supports multi-currency agricultural commodity trading and international supply chain operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS; GAAP

attributes.name: pricing_contribution_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the total bundle price attributable to this component, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 35.50 for 35.5%). Used alongside the absolute pricing contribution amount for proportional revenue recognition and margin analysis per component.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Pricing Conditions; GAAP ASC 606 Performance Obligation Allocation; IFRS 15

attributes.name: quantity_variable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the component quantity within the bundle is fixed (False) or variable/customer-selectable (True) within the min/max quantity bounds. Supports configurable agricultural input bundles where farmers select quantities based on acreage or herd size.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Configurable Product (Variant Configuration); Oracle NetSuite — Assembly Configuration

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component requires specific regulatory approval or certification before it can be included in a bundle for sale (e.g., EPA-registered pesticides, USDA-approved seed varieties, FDA-regulated food additives). Triggers compliance review workflows.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Registration; USDA APHIS; FDA FSMA; GLOBALG.A.P. Certification Requirements

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: The display sort order for this component in customer-facing product catalogs, sales order entry screens, and bundle configuration interfaces. Distinct from component_sequence which governs fulfillment/picking order; sort_order governs presentation layer ordering.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Catalog Display; Salesforce CRM — Product Catalog Configuration; Oracle NetSuite — Item Display

attributes.name: storage_compatibility_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the storage compatibility class of this component, used to ensure incompatible components within a bundle are not co-located in warehouse storage (e.g., separating oxidizers from flammables, or keeping seed away from agrochemicals). Aligns with EPA and OSHA storage segregation requirements.
attributes.references: EPA Storage and Disposal Requirements; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106; SAP S/4HANA WM — Storage Type Indicator; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: substitution_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this component may be substituted with an alternative product during order fulfillment when the primary component is out of stock or unavailable. True = substitution permitted; False = component is mandatory and cannot be substituted. Supports Manhattan Associates WMS substitution logic.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Material Substitution; Manhattan Associates WMS — Substitution Rules; GLOBALG.A.P. Product Specification

products.name: substitution_rule
products.description: Defines approved product substitution and equivalency rules specifying which products can replace another in order fulfillment, procurement, or formulation scenarios due to supply constraints, grade equivalency, seasonal unavailability, or customer-approved alternatives. Captures primary product, substitute product, substitution type (equivalent grade, approved alternative, emergency, seasonal), approval authority, customer acceptance required flag, effective date range, and priority ranking when multiple substitutes exist. Supports supply chain resilience, order fulfillment flexibility, and feed formulation ingredient substitution. Aligned with SAP S/4HANA MM material substitution configuration.
products.reference: SAP MM Material Substitution / Supply Chain Flexibility Management

attributes.name: substitution_rule_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the product substitution rule record. Primary key for the substitution_rule data product in the SAP S/4HANA MM material substitution configuration context.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Substitution

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP S/4HANA plant (production facility, grain elevator, processing plant, or distribution center) where this substitution rule is applicable. Null indicates the rule applies enterprise-wide across all plants.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Organizational Structure

attributes.name: master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary agricultural product or commodity (e.g., grain, produce, livestock product, seed input) that is subject to substitution when unavailable or constrained. Links to product.product_master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; USDA Commodity Classification

attributes.name: primary_substitution_substitute_product_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the approved substitute agricultural product or commodity that can replace the primary product in order fulfillment, procurement, or feed formulation scenarios. Links to product.product_master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; USDA Commodity Classification

attributes.name: sales_organization_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP S/4HANA sales organization for which this substitution rule is valid in order fulfillment scenarios. Null indicates applicability across all sales organizations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Organizational Structure

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: Name or role of the business authority (e.g., Procurement Manager, Quality Assurance Director, Feed Nutritionist) who approved this substitution rule. Supports audit trail and regulatory compliance documentation.
attributes.references: USDA; FDA; GLOBALG.A.P.; ISO 22000

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the substitution rule was formally approved by the designated approval authority. Required for regulatory audit trails under FSMA and GLOBALG.A.P. compliance frameworks.
attributes.references: FSMA; GLOBALG.A.P.; ISO 22000; USDA

attributes.name: auto_substitution_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the system (SAP S/4HANA MM) may automatically apply this substitution rule without manual intervention when the trigger condition is met. False requires a planner or procurement officer to manually confirm the substitution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Substitution

attributes.name: coa_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Certificate of Analysis (COA) must accompany the substitute product shipment to validate quality equivalency with the primary product. Supports GFSI, SQF, and BRC compliance requirements.
attributes.references: GFSI; SQF; BRC Global Standards; ISO 22000

attributes.name: cool_country_of_origin
attributes.business_glossary_term: Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) Country Code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country of origin of the substitute product for COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) compliance. May differ from the primary product's origin and must be disclosed to customers and on product labels.
attributes.references: USDA COOL (Country of Origin Labeling); AMS; FSMA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this substitution rule record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for data governance and regulatory compliance documentation.
attributes.references: ISO 22000; FSMA; SOX; GDPR

attributes.name: customer_acceptance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether explicit customer approval must be obtained before applying this substitution in a sales order fulfillment context. True requires customer confirmation; False allows automatic substitution. Relevant for COOL and customer contract compliance.
attributes.references: COOL (Country of Origin Labeling); FSMA; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: customer_group_restriction
attributes.description: Identifies a specific customer segment or customer group (e.g., food manufacturers, retail chains, export accounts) for which this substitution rule is restricted. Null means the rule applies to all customers. Aligns with Salesforce CRM customer segmentation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Calendar date from which this substitution rule becomes valid and may be applied in order fulfillment, procurement, or feed formulation. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA MM validity start date for material substitution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Calendar date after which this substitution rule is no longer valid. Null indicates an open-ended rule with no planned expiration. Used to manage seasonal and emergency substitution windows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: fsma_traceability_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Traceability Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this substitution triggers additional traceability documentation requirements under the FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Food Traceability Rule (Section 204). True requires lot-level tracking and Key Data Elements (KDEs) to be captured.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Food Traceability Rule (Section 204); ISO 22000

attributes.name: gap_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the substitution maintains compliance with Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) standards for both the primary and substitute products. Required for GLOBALG.A.P. certification maintenance and USDA GAP audit readiness.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P.; USDA GAP/GHP Audit Program

attributes.name: grade_equivalency_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the substitute product meets the same USDA grading standard as the primary product (True = grade-equivalent substitution). Used in quality assurance workflows and COA documentation to confirm substitution does not downgrade product quality.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) Grading Standards; ISO 22000

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which this substitution rule was most recently reviewed and confirmed by the approval authority. Used to trigger review reminders and compliance audit checks.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P.; ISO 22000; FSMA

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this substitution rule record was most recently modified. Supports change management, audit trail, and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO 22000; FSMA; SOX; GDPR

attributes.name: max_substitution_qty
attributes.description: Maximum quantity of the substitute product (in the defined unit of measure) that may be applied under this rule per order or procurement event. Prevents over-substitution and supports supply chain planning constraints.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: mrl_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the substitute product meets the same Maximum Residue Limit (MRL) thresholds as the primary product for pesticide and agrochemical residues. Required for food safety compliance under FDA, EPA, and Codex Alimentarius standards.
attributes.references: FDA; EPA; Codex Alimentarius Commission; FSMA

attributes.name: non_gmo_equivalency_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the substitute product maintains the same non-GMO (Genetically Modified Organism) status as the primary product. Critical for non-GMO product lines and customer labeling commitments under USDA BE (Bioengineered) disclosure rules.
attributes.references: USDA Bioengineered (BE) Disclosure Standard; GLOBALG.A.P.; Non-GMO Project

attributes.name: organic_equivalency_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the substitute product maintains the same organic certification status as the primary product under USDA National Organic Program (NOP). True means both products are NOP-certified organic; False means organic status differs and substitution may affect labeling.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP); GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: price_differential_pct
attributes.description: Percentage difference in standard cost between the substitute product and the primary product (positive = substitute is more expensive, negative = substitute is cheaper). Used in procurement cost impact analysis and COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) variance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric ranking (1 = highest priority) used to sequence multiple approved substitutes for the same primary product. Determines which substitute is selected first when multiple substitution rules are active simultaneously in SAP S/4HANA MM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Substitution

attributes.name: quantity_conversion_factor
attributes.description: Numeric multiplier applied to the primary product quantity to determine the equivalent substitute quantity (e.g., 1.05 means 5% more substitute is needed per unit of primary). Accounts for grade equivalency differences in weight, volume, or nutritional value.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; USDA Commodity Standards; NOP

attributes.name: regulatory_restriction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this substitution is subject to regulatory restrictions (e.g., USDA, FDA, EPA, APHIS import/export controls, or state-level agricultural regulations) that limit when or where the substitute product may be used.
attributes.references: USDA; FDA; EPA; APHIS; Codex Alimentarius Commission

attributes.name: review_frequency_days
attributes.description: Number of days between mandatory periodic reviews of this substitution rule to confirm continued validity, regulatory compliance, and business relevance. Supports governance and GLOBALG.A.P. continuous improvement requirements.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P.; ISO 22000; Internal SOP

attributes.name: rule_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this substitution rule, used in SAP S/4HANA MM material substitution configuration and cross-referenced in procurement and order fulfillment workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Substitution

attributes.name: rule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the substitution rule governing whether it may be applied in fulfillment or procurement operations. Active rules are eligible for automatic or manual substitution; suspended rules require review before use.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Internal SOP

attributes.name: substitution_reason
attributes.description: Free-text business justification describing why this substitution rule was established (e.g., 'Corn No. 2 Yellow substituted for Corn No. 1 Yellow during Q4 harvest shortfall; grade equivalency confirmed by QA'). Supports audit documentation and supply chain resilience planning.
attributes.references: USDA; FSMA; ISO 22000; Internal SOP

attributes.name: substitution_scope
attributes.description: Business process context in which this substitution rule is applicable: order_fulfillment (sales order dispatch), procurement (purchase order sourcing), feed_formulation (livestock nutrition ingredient swap), or all (unrestricted across all processes).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Manhattan Associates WMS; FSMA

attributes.name: substitution_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the substitution relationship: equivalent_grade (same quality tier, different lot/source), approved_alternative (customer or regulatory pre-approved swap), emergency (supply disruption-driven), seasonal (crop availability-driven), feed_formulation (ingredient swap in livestock nutrition plans). Drives workflow routing in SAP S/4HANA MM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Substitution; GLOBALG.A.P.; FSMA

attributes.name: supply_constraint_trigger
attributes.description: Business condition that activates this substitution rule: stock_shortage (inventory below reorder point), seasonal_unavailability (crop not in season), quality_hold (primary product under quarantine), supplier_disruption (vendor supply failure), price_threshold (cost exceeds approved ceiling). Drives automated substitution logic in SAP S/4HANA MM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Manhattan Associates WMS; FSMA

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure applicable to the quantity conversion factor for this substitution rule. Uses agricultural industry standard units: BU (Bushel), MT (Metric Ton), CWT (Hundredweight), KG, LB, L (Litre), GAL (Gallon), EA (Each). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BU|MT|CWT|KG|LB|L|GAL|EA — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA Commodity Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM

products.name: product_certification
products.description: Consolidated SSOT for all third-party, regulatory, and program certifications and declarations held by agricultural products. Covers: (1) USDA NOP organic certification — certifying agent, certificate number, scope (crops/livestock/handling), effective and expiration dates, annual renewal status, allowed materials list, suspension/revocation events; (2) GMO/bioengineered food declarations — transformation event identifiers (APHIS petition numbers), approved markets by jurisdiction (US, EU, China), Non-GMO Project Verified status, identity preservation (IP) protocol reference, USDA BE labeling compliance; (3) Food safety and sustainability certifications — GLOBALG.A.P., SQF, BRC, IFS, Fair Trade, Rainforest Alliance, Kosher, Halal, ISCC. Captures certification body, certificate number, certification type, certified product scope, issue date, expiration date, audit cycle, verification/testing date, and certificate document reference. Supports organic premium pricing, non-GMO market access, export documentation, and retail label claims.
products.reference: GLOBALG.A.P. / SQF / BRC / ISCC Certification Standards

attributes.name: product_certification_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each product certification record in the agricultural certification catalog.
attributes.references: Internal Data Standard

attributes.name: compliance_audit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_audit. Business justification: Third-party certifications (GlobalG.A.P., SQF, BRC, FSSC) are issued following a compliance audit. Linking certification to the compliance_audit that generated it enables audit-to-certificate traceabi
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: gmo_declaration_id
attributes.description: APHIS petition number or unique transformation event identifier assigned to a specific genetically modified organism event (e.g., MON810, GTS 40-3-2). Required for USDA Bioengineered (BE) food disclosure and export market approval documentation.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Petition Process 7 CFR Part 340; USDA BE Disclosure Standard 7 CFR Part 66; Codex Alimentarius CAC/GL 45-2003

attributes.name: master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agricultural product or commodity in the product master catalog to which this certification applies.
attributes.references: Internal Data Standard

attributes.name: organic_certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.organic_certification. Business justification: certification is the consolidated SSOT for all third-party and regulatory certifications. When a certification record represents an NOP organic certification, it should reference the detailed organic_
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: sustainability_certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.sustainability_certification. Business justification: Product certifications (GlobalG.A.P., SQF, BRC) reference sustainability scheme certifications for audit alignment and ESG reporting. iscc_sustainability_standard is a denormalized sustainability cert
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: allowed_materials_list_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document URL for the USDA NOP National List of Allowed and Prohibited Substances applicable to this organic certification scope. Ensures that only approved inputs are used in certified organic production.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.600-205.606; OMRI (Organic Materials Review Institute) Listed Products

attributes.name: approved_markets
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3-letter country codes representing jurisdictions where this GMO transformation event or certification has received regulatory approval for commercial use or import (e.g., USA, CAN, BRA, CHN, EU member states). Critical for export documentation and market access decisions.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; EU Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003; Codex Alimentarius; COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) 7 USC 1638

attributes.name: audit_cycle_months
attributes.description: Frequency of the required audit or inspection cycle expressed in months (e.g., 12 for annual, 6 for semi-annual). Determines the recurrence interval for compliance audits under the certification program.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.403; GLOBALG.A.P. General Regulations; SQF Code; BRC Global Standard

attributes.name: be_disclosure_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is subject to USDA National Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard (NBFDS) labeling requirements. True if the product contains detectable modified genetic material from the USDA BE disclosure list.
attributes.references: USDA BE Disclosure Standard 7 CFR Part 66; National Bioengineered Food Disclosure Law (NBFDL) Public Law 114-216

attributes.name: brc_grade
attributes.description: BRC Global Standard audit grade awarded at the most recent certification audit (AA, A, B, C, or D), where AA is the highest achievable grade for unannounced audits. Null if certification_type is not BRC.
attributes.references: BRC Global Standard for Food Safety Issue 9; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements

attributes.name: certificate_document_ref
attributes.description: File path, URL, or document management system reference to the scanned or digital copy of the official certificate document. Supports audit readiness, export documentation, and retail label claim substantiation.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.406; FDA FSMA Records Requirements; GLOBALG.A.P.; BRC Global Standard

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Externally-issued unique certificate number assigned by the certifying body (e.g., USDA NOP organic certificate number, GLOBALG.A.P. GGN, SQF certificate number). Used for audit trails, export documentation, and retail label claims.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP); GLOBALG.A.P.; SQF Institute; BRC Global Standards

attributes.name: certification_scope
attributes.description: Operational scope covered by the certification as defined by the certifying body. For USDA NOP organic, scope is one of: crops, livestock, handling (processing), or wild crop. For food safety certifications, scope may reference specific product categories or processing operations.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.201; GLOBALG.A.P. Scope Documents

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the certification. Active indicates the certificate is valid and in force; suspended indicates a temporary hold pending investigation; revoked indicates permanent cancellation by the certifying body; expired indicates the certificate has passed its expiration date without renewal.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.662; GLOBALG.A.P. General Regulations; FDA FSMA

attributes.name: certification_type
attributes.description: Category of certification held by the product. Covers USDA NOP organic, USDA Bioengineered (BE) food declaration, Non-GMO Project Verified, GLOBALG.A.P., SQF, BRC, and others. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: organic_nop|gmo_be_declaration|non_gmo_verified|globalg_ap|sqf|brc|ifs|fair_trade|rainforest_alliance|kosher|halal|iscc — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205; USDA BE Disclosure Standard 7 CFR Part 66; GLOBALG.A.P.; SQF Institute; BRC Global Standards; IFS; Fair Trade USA; Rainforest Alliance; ISCC

attributes.name: certifying_body_accreditation_number
attributes.description: Accreditation number assigned to the certifying body by the relevant oversight authority (e.g., USDA NOP accreditation number for organic certifying agents, GFSI accreditation reference). Validates the legitimacy of the certifying organization.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.501; ISO/IEC 17011

attributes.name: certifying_body_name
attributes.description: Name of the accredited third-party organization or regulatory agency that issued the certification (e.g., Oregon Tilth, CCOF, NSF International, SGS, Bureau Veritas, Non-GMO Project, SQF Institute). Required for audit and export documentation.
attributes.references: USDA NOP Accredited Certifying Agents List; GFSI; GLOBALG.A.P.; ISO/IEC 17065

attributes.name: coa_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking to the Certificate of Analysis (COA) document associated with this certification, containing laboratory test results for residues, contaminants, or identity preservation verification.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.670; Codex Alimentarius General Standard for Contaminants

attributes.name: cool_country_of_origin
attributes.business_glossary_term: Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) Country Code
attributes.description: ISO 3-letter country code indicating the country of origin of the certified product as required under USDA Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) regulations. Used for retail label compliance and export documentation.
attributes.references: USDA COOL 7 USC 1638; AMS COOL Regulations 7 CFR Part 60 and 65

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the certification record was first created in the system. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5(2)

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the certification is operationally effective and the product may be marketed under the certified claim. May differ from issue_date if there is a transition or grace period.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.400; FDA FSMA; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certification expires and must be renewed to maintain certified status. Critical for organic premium pricing, non-GMO market access, and retail label claims. Triggers renewal workflow when approaching.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.406; GLOBALG.A.P. General Regulations; SQF Code

attributes.name: fair_trade_producer_code
attributes.description: Unique producer or cooperative code assigned by Fair Trade USA or Fairtrade International to identify the certified producer organization associated with this product's fair trade certification.
attributes.references: Fair Trade USA Certification Standards; Fairtrade International Standard

attributes.name: globalg_ap_number
attributes.description: 13-digit GLOBALG.A.P. Number (GGN) assigned to the certified producer or production site under the GLOBALG.A.P. certification scheme. Used for supply chain traceability and retail buyer verification via the GLOBALG.A.P. database.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. General Regulations Part I; GLOBALG.A.P. Integrated Farm Assurance (IFA) Standard

attributes.name: halal_certifying_body
attributes.description: Name of the recognized halal certifying organization (e.g., IFANCA, ISWA, HFA) that issued the halal certification for this product. Null if certification_type is not halal.
attributes.references: IFANCA Halal Standards; OIC/SMIIC 1:2019 General Guidelines for Halal Food

attributes.name: ip_protocol_reference
attributes.description: Reference code or document identifier for the Identity Preservation (IP) protocol applied to maintain non-GMO or specialty crop segregation integrity throughout the supply chain. Required for Non-GMO Project Verified and identity-preserved commodity programs.
attributes.references: Non-GMO Project Standard; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) IP Guidelines; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certifying body formally issued the certificate. Marks the start of the certification's legal validity and is printed on the certificate document.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.406; GLOBALG.A.P. General Regulations

attributes.name: kosher_certifying_agency
attributes.description: Name of the recognized kosher certifying agency (e.g., OU, OK, KOF-K, Star-K) that issued the kosher certification for this product. Null if certification_type is not kosher.
attributes.references: Orthodox Union (OU) Kosher Standards; Star-K Kosher Certification

attributes.name: label_claim_text
attributes.description: Approved marketing claim text authorized by this certification for use on product packaging and retail labels (e.g., 'USDA Organic', 'Non-GMO Project Verified', 'Certified Kosher', 'Fair Trade Certified'). Must align with certifying body approved language.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.303; USDA BE Disclosure Standard; FTC Green Guides 16 CFR Part 260; FDA Labeling Regulations 21 CFR Part 101

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent on-site inspection or audit conducted by the certifying body or accredited auditor. Used to track audit cycle compliance and readiness for renewal.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.403; GLOBALG.A.P. Inspection Protocol; SQF Code Edition 9; BRC Global Standard Issue 9

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the certification record. Used for change data capture (CDC), Silver layer incremental processing, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5(2)

attributes.name: last_verification_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent laboratory testing, residue verification, or document review performed to confirm ongoing compliance with certification requirements (e.g., MRL residue testing for organic, identity preservation testing for non-GMO).
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.670; EPA MRL Regulations; GLOBALG.A.P. Residue Monitoring

attributes.name: next_audit_date
attributes.description: Date on which the next scheduled inspection or audit by the certifying body is planned. Supports audit cycle planning and operational readiness.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.403; GLOBALG.A.P.; SQF Code; BRC Global Standard

attributes.name: non_gmo_project_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product has received Non-GMO Project Verified status, entitling it to display the Non-GMO Project butterfly seal on retail packaging. Supports non-GMO market access and premium pricing.
attributes.references: Non-GMO Project Standard Version 15; USDA BE Disclosure Standard

attributes.name: organic_transition_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is in the USDA NOP organic transition period (36-month land transition requirement) rather than fully certified organic. Transition products cannot be labeled or sold as certified organic.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.202; National Organic Program

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the annual or periodic renewal of the certification was last completed or is next due. Supports proactive renewal management and continuity of certified product claims.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.406; GLOBALG.A.P. Annual Renewal Requirements

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certifying body formally revoked the certification. Populated only when certification_status is 'revoked'. Required for regulatory reporting and product recall risk management.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.662; FDA FSMA 21 CFR Part 1; GLOBALG.A.P. Sanctioning Procedure

attributes.name: sqf_level
attributes.description: SQF certification level achieved: Level 1 (food safety fundamentals), Level 2 (HACCP-based food safety plan), or Level 3 (comprehensive food safety and quality management system). Null if certification_type is not SQF.
attributes.references: SQF Code Edition 9; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Textual description of the reason for suspension of the certification by the certifying body (e.g., prohibited substance detected, recordkeeping violation, failure to allow inspection). Populated only when certification_status is 'suspended'.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.662; GLOBALG.A.P. Sanctioning Procedure

attributes.name: transition_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the 36-month USDA NOP organic transition period began for the associated land or product. Null if organic_transition_flag is false. Used to calculate transition completion eligibility.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.202

products.name: regulatory_status
products.description: Tracks the regulatory approval and market authorization status of agricultural products by jurisdiction — including USDA, FDA, EPA, and international market approvals. Captures product registration number, regulatory agency, approval type (food use, feed use, export approved), approved markets/countries, registration expiration date, pending renewal flag, and any import/export restriction flags. Critical for export compliance, APHIS phytosanitary documentation, and market access management.

attributes.name: regulatory_status_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each regulatory status record in the agricultural product regulatory catalog. Primary key for the regulatory_status data product.
attributes.references: ISO 11179 - Metadata Registry

Regulatory affairs teams need this link to track submission-to-approval timeline

attributes.name: master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agricultural product or commodity in the product master catalog for which this regulatory status record applies. Links to the SSOT product catalog.

products.name: seed_supply_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the Contract between seed_variety and vendor. It captures the formal supply arrangement under which a specific vendor is authorized to supply a specific seed variety for a given growing season and region. Each record links one seed_variety to one vendor with attributes — pricing, contracted volume, supply region, exclusivity, and certification status — that exist only in the context of this vendor-variety supply relationship and cannot be attributed to either the seed variety catalog or the vendor master alone.. Existence Justification: In agricultural seed procurement, a seed variety can be supplied by multiple vendors (seed companies, licensed distributors, regional dealers), and a single vendor typically supplies many seed varieties across their product portfolio. The business actively manages these supply relationships as formal agreements — tracking contracted volumes, pricing, supply regions, and growing seasons — making this a genuine operational M:N relationship, not an analytical correlation. Agriculture businesses explicitly manage 'which vendors are authorized to supply which varieties, under what terms' as a named procurement concept (Seed Supply Agreement).

products.name: crop_label_registration
products.description: This association product represents the formal EPA Crop Label Registration (Contract) between agrochemical_product and commodity. It captures the regulatory approval of a specific agrochemical product for use on a specific commodity crop, including the label-defined application parameters that are unique to each agrochemical-commodity pairing. Each record links one agrochemical_product to one commodity and carries the application rate, pre-harvest interval, seasonal application limits, and approved method that govern compliant use under FSMA, EPA, and GLOBALG.A.P. requirements.. Existence Justification: In agricultural operations, the EPA formally registers specific pesticide-crop combinations, meaning a single agrochemical product is approved for use on multiple commodity crops, and a single commodity crop has multiple agrochemical products registered for use on it. This regulatory approval — known as a crop label registration or crop use registration — carries its own data (application rate, PHI days, seasonal application limits, application method) that belongs to neither the agrochemical product nor the commodity alone, but to the specific pairing. The business actively manages these registrations for FSMA, EPA, and GLOBALG.A.P. compliance, making this a genuine operational M:N relationship.

products.name: agrochemical_practice_compatibility
products.description: This association product represents the Compatibility Contract between agrochemical_product and regenerative_practice. It captures the operational compatibility and restriction rules that govern whether and how a specific agrochemical product may be used in the context of a specific regenerative agriculture practice. Each record links one agrochemical_product to one regenerative_practice with attributes — compatibility status, restriction type, applicable crop type, and effective date — that exist only in the context of this pairing and are actively managed by agronomists and compliance teams to satisfy EPA label requirements, carbon program rules, and GLOBALG.A.P. standards.. Existence Justification: In regenerative agriculture programs, agrochemical products and regenerative practices have explicit compatibility and restriction relationships that are actively managed by agronomists and compliance teams. A single regenerative practice (e.g., pollinator habitat establishment, cover cropping) restricts or conditionally permits multiple agrochemical products, while a single agrochemical product (e.g., a broad-spectrum herbicide) may be restricted or conditionally compatible with multiple regenerative practices. This relationship is operationally managed — agronomists create, update, and retire these compatibility rules as label registrations change, new practices are adopted, or carbon program requirements evolve.

products.name: commodity_broker_authorization
products.description: This association product represents the formal Commodity Brokerage Authorization contract between a commodity and a broker. It captures the specific terms under which a broker is authorized to facilitate sales of a particular agricultural commodity on behalf of the enterprise. Each record links one commodity to one broker and carries the commodity-specific commission rate, volume target, exclusivity arrangement, and authorization period — attributes that exist only in the context of this specific broker-commodity pairing and cannot reside on either the commodity or broker master record alone.. Existence Justification: In agricultural commodity brokerage, a broker specializes in and is authorized to sell multiple commodities (e.g., corn, soybeans, wheat), and each commodity is facilitated by multiple brokers across different territories and channels. This is an operationally managed relationship: the enterprise actively creates, maintains, and terminates broker-commodity authorization agreements that carry their own terms — commodity-specific commission rates, volume targets, exclusivity arrangements, and effective dates. The denormalized `commodity_specializations` field on the broker record is direct evidence that this M:N reality exists and is currently modeled incorrectly as a multi-value string.
