attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service — Grain Transportation; Uniform Commercial Code (UCC) Article 7 — Documents of Title; Manhattan Associates WMS — Outbound Shipment

attributes.name: class_code
attributes.description: Commodity class or variety classification within the grade (e.g., Hard Red Winter, Soft Red Winter for wheat; Yellow Dent for corn; Roundup Ready for soybeans). Provides sub-grade differentiation for specialty or identity-preserved commodity sales.
attributes.references: USDA Federal Grain Inspection Service (FGIS) — Grain Standards; GLOBALG.A.P. Produce Handling Standard

attributes.name: commodity_code
attributes.description: Standardized commodity classification code identifying the agricultural product type (e.g., USDA commodity code, HS tariff code, or internal commodity identifier). Used for regulatory reporting, COOL compliance, and market pricing alignment with DTN/WASDE feeds.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service — Commodity Classification; Harmonized System (HS) Nomenclature

attributes.name: confirmed_delivery_date
attributes.description: The delivery date confirmed by the seller after availability check and logistics scheduling. Represents the committed delivery commitment to the customer for this line item. Drives BOL scheduling and carrier booking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — VBAP Confirmed Delivery Date (Schedule Line); Manhattan Associates WMS — Outbound Shipment Planning

attributes.name: confirmed_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the commodity confirmed for delivery by the seller after inventory allocation and availability check. May differ from ordered quantity due to stock availability, crop yield constraints, or partial fulfillment agreements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — VBAP Confirmed Quantity (ATP Check); GLOBALG.A.P. Supply Chain Standard

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sales order line record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SLA tracking. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA SD order entry timestamp.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — VBAP Creation Timestamp; SOX Section 404 — Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the monetary values on this line item (e.g., USD for US Dollar, EUR for Euro, BRL for Brazilian Real). Supports multi-currency international agricultural commodity trade.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: delivered_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity of the commodity physically delivered or shipped against this sales order line, as recorded upon BOL generation or warehouse goods issue. Used for revenue recognition and invoice reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — VBAP Delivered Quantity; Manhattan Associates WMS — Goods Issue Confirmation

attributes.name: delivery_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific delivery point or destination for this line item (e.g., elevator code, port terminal code, warehouse location code). Used for logistics planning, BOL generation, and TMS routing. May reference a grain elevator, export terminal, or customer facility.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — VBAP Shipping Point; Manhattan Associates WMS — Delivery Location; USDA Warehouse Act

attributes.name: delivery_terms
attributes.description: International commercial terms (Incoterms) governing the transfer of risk and cost responsibility for this commodity line item. FOB (Free On Board) and CIF (Cost Insurance Freight) are most common in agricultural commodity trade. Determines logistics cost allocation and revenue recognition point.
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; USDA Foreign Agricultural Service Export Reporting; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition — Transfer of Control

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary discount applied to this sales order line, including quality discounts (moisture, test weight, foreign material), volume discounts, and commercial negotiation discounts. Reduces the gross line value to arrive at the net line amount. Expressed in transaction currency.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Pricing Conditions (KONV); IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition — Variable Consideration

attributes.name: futures_contract_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the commodity futures contract (e.g., CBOT corn December 2024 — ZCZ24) linked to this sales order line when pricing_basis is futures_linked or basis_contract. Enables hedge accounting reconciliation and mark-to-market valuation.
attributes.references: Chicago Board of Trade (CBOT) Futures Contract Specifications; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; WASDE Price Reporting

attributes.name: gmo_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the commodity on this line is genetically modified (GMO), non-GMO, or identity-preserved non-GMO. Mandatory for customer labeling compliance, export documentation, and market channel eligibility. Non-GMO and identity-preserved status commands price premiums in specialty markets.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP); USDA Agricultural Marketing Service — Non-GMO Verification; EU Regulation 1829/2003 (GMO Labeling); GLOBALG.A.P. Integrated Farm Assurance

attributes.name: grade_code
attributes.description: USDA or industry-standard grade designation for the commodity on this line (e.g., US No. 1, US No. 2, Sample Grade for grains; Choice, Select for livestock). Determines pricing differentials and buyer acceptance criteria. Sourced from Certificate of Analysis (COA) or grain inspection.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service — Official United States Standards for Grain; FSIS Grading Standards

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this sales order line record, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Tracks changes to quantity, price, delivery dates, or status throughout the order lifecycle. Essential for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — VBAP Change Timestamp; SOX Section 404 — Audit Trail Requirements; Databricks Delta Lake CDC

attributes.name: line_net_amount
attributes.description: Net monetary value of this sales order line calculated as confirmed quantity multiplied by unit price, before taxes and after applicable discounts. Used for revenue recognition, invoice generation, and financial reporting under IFRS 15 / GAAP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — VBAP-NETWR (Net Value); IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential position of this line item within the parent sales order, used for ordering and referencing individual items (e.g., line 10, 20, 30 per SAP SD item numbering convention). Enables multi-commodity order management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — VBAP-POSNR (Item Number)

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of this individual sales order line item within the order fulfillment lifecycle. Tracks progression from open through delivery and invoicing. Aligns with SAP SD overall delivery status at item level.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — VBAP Overall Status

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Batch or lot identifier assigned to the specific quantity of commodity on this sales order line, enabling end-to-end traceability from field/farm through delivery. Critical for FSMA traceability requirements, recall management, and HACCP compliance. Aligns with SAP batch management (CHARG).
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) — Traceability Rule (21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S); GLOBALG.A.P. Chain of Custody; SAP S/4HANA MM — Batch Management (CHARG)

attributes.name: moisture_pct
attributes.description: Moisture content of the commodity expressed as a percentage of total weight at time of sale or delivery. A critical quality parameter for grain pricing — moisture above standard (e.g., 15.5% for corn) results in drying charges or price discounts. Sourced from grain inspection or COA.
attributes.references: USDA Federal Grain Inspection Service (FGIS) — Official Grain Standards; USDA AMS Grain Inspection Handbook

attributes.name: mrl_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the commodity on this line has been verified to meet Maximum Residue Limit (MRL) requirements for pesticide and chemical residues as mandated by the destination market (EPA, EU, Codex Alimentarius). True = MRL compliance confirmed; False = non-compliant or pending verification. Blocks shipment if False.
attributes.references: EPA — Pesticide Tolerances (40 CFR Part 180); EU Regulation 396/2005 (MRL); Codex Alimentarius — Pesticide Residues in Food; GLOBALG.A.P. Integrated Farm Assurance

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the commodity originally requested by the customer on this sales order line, expressed in the line unit of measure (BU, MT, CWT, etc.). Represents the buyer's demand commitment before confirmation or allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — VBAP-KWMENG (Cumulative Order Quantity); USDA AMS Contract Terms

attributes.name: organic_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the commodity on this line is certified organic under the USDA National Organic Program (NOP) or equivalent international organic certification. Organic certification commands significant price premiums and requires segregated handling and documentation throughout the supply chain.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) — 7 CFR Part 205; EU Organic Regulation 2018/848; GLOBALG.A.P. Crops Base Module

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the country where the agricultural commodity was produced or harvested. Required for Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) compliance under USDA AMS regulations and international trade documentation. Supports export certificate and phytosanitary documentation.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service — Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) — 7 CFR Part 60/65; APHIS Phytosanitary Export Certification; Codex Alimentarius — Food Labeling Standards

attributes.name: phi_cleared
attributes.description: Indicates whether the mandatory Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) — the minimum number of days between last pesticide/chemical application and harvest — has been satisfied for the commodity on this line. True = PHI interval elapsed and cleared; False = PHI not yet met. Required for food safety compliance and MRL verification.
attributes.references: EPA — Federal Insecticide Fungicide and Rodenticide Act (FIFRA) — PHI Requirements; GLOBALG.A.P. Crop Protection Module; FSMA Produce Safety Rule (21 CFR Part 112)

attributes.name: quantity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure in which ordered, confirmed, and delivered quantities are expressed for this line item. Agricultural commodities use industry-standard units: BU (Bushel), MT (Metric Ton), CWT (Hundredweight), LB (Pound), KG (Kilogram), TON (Short Ton), BAG. Aligns with USDA and international trade conventions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BU|MT|CWT|LB|KG|TON|BAG — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service — Unit of Measure Standards; ISO 80000-1 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason this sales order line was cancelled or rejected (e.g., customer cancellation, out of stock, quality failure, pricing dispute, regulatory hold). Populated only when line_status is cancelled. Used for sales analytics and demand planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: customer_cancel|out_of_stock|quality_failure|pricing_dispute|regulatory_hold|force_majeure|duplicate — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — VBAP Rejection Reason (ABGRU); Salesforce CRM — Opportunity Loss Reason

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date by which the customer requests delivery of the commodity on this line item. Used for production scheduling, harvest planning, and logistics coordination. May differ from confirmed delivery date based on availability and transportation capacity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — VBAP-MBDAT (Material Availability Date); GLOBALG.A.P. Supply Chain Traceability

attributes.name: test_weight
attributes.description: Weight per bushel (lb/bu) or per hectoliter (kg/hL) of the commodity, indicating grain density and quality. Test weight below minimum standard (e.g., 56 lb/bu for corn) results in grade discounts. A primary quality determinant in grain trading and pricing.
attributes.references: USDA Federal Grain Inspection Service (FGIS) — Official United States Standards for Grain; USDA AMS Grain Inspection

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Agreed price per unit of measure for this commodity line item, expressed in the transaction currency. Reflects the negotiated or market-based price at time of order. May be spot, forward, or futures-linked depending on pricing_basis. Commercially sensitive.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — VBAP-NETPR (Net Price); IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

products.name: contract
products.description: Long-term or seasonal agricultural sales contract governing the commercial relationship between the enterprise and a buyer — capturing contract number, contract type (forward, futures-linked, fixed-price, basis), commodity, total contracted volume, price formula, crop year, incoterms, GLOBALG.A.P. certification requirements, FSMA compliance obligations, and contract status. Includes the planned delivery call-off schedule (delivery windows, scheduled volumes per call-off, delivery locations, pricing fixation dates, basis levels, and fulfillment status) enabling tracking of contract execution against committed delivery obligations across the crop marketing season. SSOT for both commercial contract terms and delivery execution planning.

attributes.name: contract_type

'forward' = price agreed for future delivery; 'futures_linked' = price tied to exchange futures; 'fixed_price' = locked price at signing; 'basis' = price set as a differential to a futures benchmark; 'spot' = current market price at delivery.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; CME Group commodity contract standards; DTN market data conventions

attributes.name: contracted_volume
attributes.description: Total quantity of the commodity committed under this contract, expressed in the contract unit of measure (e.g., bushels, metric tons, hundredweight). This is the headline obligation against which call-off fulfillment is tracked.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; CME Group contract specifications; GLOBALG.A.P. traceability

attributes.name: cool_country_code

attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country of origin required for COOL compliance labeling on commodity shipments under this contract. Mandatory for applicable commodities under USDA COOL regulations.
attributes.references: USDA Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) — 7 CFR Part 60; ISO 3166-1

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this contract record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Serves as the audit trail creation marker for data lineage and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the contract price and total value are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, BRL). Required for multi-currency reporting under IFRS.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS; GAAP

attributes.name: delivery_end_date
attributes.description: The latest date by which all contracted commodity deliveries must be completed. Defines the closing of the contracted delivery window and triggers penalty or renegotiation clauses if unfulfilled.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Delivery Schedule; IFRS 15

attributes.name: delivery_start_date
attributes.description: The earliest date on which commodity deliveries may commence under this contract. Defines the opening of the contracted delivery window for call-off scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Delivery Schedule; GLOBALG.A.P. traceability

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract becomes legally binding and commercially effective. Used to determine when pricing terms and delivery obligations commence.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 — Revenue from Contracts with Customers; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the contract expires and all delivery obligations must be fulfilled or rolled over. Nullable for open-ended evergreen contracts.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 — Revenue from Contracts with Customers; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: fsma_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Compliance Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract requires full FSMA compliance documentation including Produce Safety Rule, Preventive Controls, and traceability records. True = FSMA compliance is a contractual obligation.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA); FDA Produce Safety Rule 21 CFR Part 112

attributes.name: fulfilled_volume
attributes.description: Cumulative volume of commodity actually delivered and accepted against this contract to date, expressed in the contract volume UOM. Compared against contracted_volume to determine fulfillment percentage and open position.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Delivery Completion; GLOBALG.A.P. traceability; FSMA traceability rule

attributes.name: futures_contract_month
attributes.description: The CME/CBOT futures delivery month to which this contract's basis or futures-linked price is pegged (e.g., 'DEC-2024', 'MAR-2025'). Null for fixed-price and spot contracts.

attributes.name: gmo_status

attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP); USDA APHIS GMO regulations; COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) requirements

attributes.name: incoterms_code

FOB = Free On Board; CIF = Cost Insurance and Freight. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FOB|CIF|EXW|DAP|DDP|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAT|CFR — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP S/4HANA SD Incoterms configuration

attributes.name: moisture_max_pct

attributes.name: payment_terms

attributes.name: price
attributes.description: The agreed unit price per volume UOM for fixed-price and forward contracts. For basis and futures-linked contracts, this field captures the locked price once fixation occurs; otherwise null until price fixation date.

attributes.name: price_fixation_date

attributes.references: CME Group basis contract terms; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service

attributes.name: quality_grade
attributes.description: The minimum USDA commodity grade or quality specification required for delivery acceptance under this contract (e.g., 'US No. 1', 'US No. 2', 'US Grade A'). Drives quality inspection and COA requirements at delivery.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service — Grain Grading Standards; USDA FGIS; SAP QM Module

attributes.name: sap_contract_number

attributes.name: signed_date

attributes.name: special_conditions

attributes.name: volume_uom

attributes.name: salesforce_opportunity_id
attributes.description: The Salesforce CRM Opportunity or Contract record ID associated with this pricing agreement. Enables traceability between the CRM sales pipeline and the executed pricing agreement in SAP S/4HANA SD.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Opportunity and Contract Objects; SAP S/4HANA SD Integration

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_segment. Business justification: Segment-based pricing: ag price agreements are structured by customer segment tier (pricing_tier_code). This link enables segment-level pricing analytics, renewal workflows, and ensures pricing consis
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable identifier for the pricing agreement as assigned by SAP S/4HANA SD or Salesforce CRM. Used in customer communications, contract references, and audit trails (e.g., PA-2024-00123).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Condition Record Key; Salesforce CRM Contract Number

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the pricing agreement. 'draft' = under preparation; 'pending_approval' = submitted for authorization; 'active' = currently in force; 'suspended' = temporarily halted; 'expired' = past effective end date; 'terminated' = cancelled before expiry.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Condition Record Release Status; Salesforce CRM Contract Status

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pricing strategy governing this agreement. 'spot' = current market price at time of transaction; 'forward' = fixed price for future delivery; 'futures_linked' = price tied to exchange futures contract (e.g., CBOT); 'contract' = negotiated fixed-term contract price; 'index_based' = price derived from a market index such as DTN or WASDE. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: spot|forward|futures_linked|contract|index_based|basis — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; DTN Market Data; WASDE (World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates); SAP S/4HANA SD Condition Type

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the pricing agreement received final business authorization. Used for audit trail, compliance reporting, and determining when the agreement became actionable.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); SAP S/4HANA SD Release Procedure; GAAP

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Authorization workflow status indicating whether the pricing agreement has been reviewed and approved by the required business authority (e.g., Sales Manager, Pricing Committee). Distinct from agreement_status which reflects the overall lifecycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Release Procedure; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Internal Controls; GAAP

attributes.name: base_price
attributes.description: The negotiated base unit price for the commodity under this agreement, expressed in the agreement currency per unit of measure (e.g., USD per bushel, USD per metric ton, USD per CWT). This is the gross price before basis adjustments or discounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Condition Amount (KBETR); IFRS 15; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: commodity_grade
attributes.description: Quality grade or specification of the agricultural commodity covered by this agreement (e.g., US No. 1, US No. 2, Choice, Prime, Organic). Determines eligibility and price differentials. Aligns with USDA grading standards.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service — Grain Grading Standards; USDA FSIS Meat Grading; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: cool_country_of_origin
attributes.business_glossary_term: Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) Country Code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country of origin of the commodity as required by COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) regulations. Mandatory for USDA COOL compliance on covered commodities (e.g., USA, BRA, ARG, CAN).
attributes.references: USDA COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) — 7 U.S.C. § 1638; ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this pricing agreement record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR Article 5 (data integrity); ISO 8601

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the base price and all monetary values in this agreement are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, BRL, CAD).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA SD — Condition Currency (KONWA); IFRS

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to the base price for this agreement, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0250 = 2.50%). Represents negotiated rebates, volume discounts, or promotional allowances. Stored as a rate; the monetary discount amount is computed at order time.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Condition Rate (KBETR) for discount condition types; IFRS 15 Variable Consideration

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this pricing agreement ceases to be binding. Nullable for open-ended agreements. Aligns with the SAP S/4HANA condition record validity end date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Condition Validity Period (DATBI); IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this pricing agreement becomes binding and applicable to sales orders (SO). Aligns with the SAP S/4HANA condition record validity start date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Condition Validity Period (DATAB); IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: flat_discount_amount
attributes.description: Fixed monetary discount per unit applied to the base price under this agreement (e.g., USD 0.05 per bushel). Used when the discount is a fixed amount rather than a percentage. Expressed in currency_code per price_uom.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Absolute Discount Condition (KBETR); IFRS 15

attributes.name: freight_allowance
attributes.description: Negotiated freight cost allowance or deduction included in the pricing agreement, expressed in currency_code per price_uom. Relevant for FOB vs. delivered pricing structures where freight responsibility is shared or subsidized.
attributes.references: Incoterms 2020 (ICC); SAP S/4HANA SD — Freight Condition Type; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service

attributes.name: futures_contract_month
attributes.description: The exchange futures contract delivery month used as the pricing reference for futures-linked or basis agreements (e.g., Z24 = December 2024 CBOT corn). Applicable when agreement_type is 'futures_linked' or pricing_basis includes 'basis_cbot/kcbt/mgex'.
attributes.references: CME Group / CBOT Futures Contract Specifications; USDA WASDE

attributes.name: gmo_status
attributes.description: Indicates the GMO identity preservation status of the commodity covered by this agreement. 'gmo' = conventional GMO commodity; 'non_gmo' = non-GMO but not certified; 'ip_non_gmo' = identity-preserved non-GMO with full chain-of-custody documentation; 'organic' = USDA NOP certified organic (inherently non-GMO).
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP); USDA APHIS Biotechnology Regulations; EU Regulation 1829/2003; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms 2020) code defining the delivery obligations, risk transfer point, and cost responsibilities between seller and buyer under this pricing agreement (e.g., FOB, CIF, DAP). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Incoterms 2020 — International Chamber of Commerce (ICC); SAP S/4HANA SD — Incoterms (INCO1)

attributes.name: is_exclusive
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pricing agreement grants the customer exclusive pricing rights for the specified commodity, grade, and channel — preventing the same terms from being offered to competing buyers during the effective period.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contract Terms; GAAP ASC 606 — Distinct Performance Obligations

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this pricing agreement record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, delta processing in the lakehouse silver layer, and audit compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR Article 5; Databricks Delta Lake — _commit_timestamp

attributes.name: market_reference_index
attributes.description: The external market data source or price index used as the benchmark for index-based or futures-linked pricing (e.g., DTN ProphetX, WASDE, CME CBOT, Reuters Commodities). Supports traceability of price derivation.
attributes.references: DTN (Data Transmission Network); USDA WASDE (World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates); CME Group

attributes.name: max_volume_threshold
attributes.description: The maximum quantity of the commodity covered under this pricing agreement tier. Purchases exceeding this threshold may trigger a different price tier or require renegotiation. Expressed in the price_uom.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Scale Quantity Upper Bound (KSTBM); IFRS 15

attributes.name: min_volume_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum quantity of the commodity the customer must purchase to qualify for this pricing agreement tier. Expressed in the price_uom. Used for volume-tiered pricing and commitment enforcement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Scale Quantity (KSTBM); IFRS 15 Variable Consideration

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional negotiation context, special conditions, broker instructions, or exceptions not captured in structured fields. Examples include harvest season constraints, force majeure clauses, or specific delivery window requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Condition Supplement Text; Salesforce CRM Contract Notes

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the negotiated payment terms associated with this pricing agreement (e.g., NET30, NET60, 2/10NET30, PREPAID). Aligns with SAP S/4HANA payment terms configuration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI — Payment Terms (ZTERM); GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: price_uom
attributes.description: The unit of measure against which the base price is quoted. Common agricultural units include BU (Bushel), MT (Metric Ton), CWT (Hundredweight), LB (Pound), KG (Kilogram), TON (Short Ton), BBL (Barrel), DOZ (Dozen). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BU|MT|CWT|LB|KG|TON|BBL|DOZ — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; SAP S/4HANA SD — Condition Unit (KMEIN); ISO 80000-1

attributes.name: quality_premium
attributes.description: Additional price premium per unit awarded for above-standard commodity quality attributes (e.g., high protein content, organic certification, non-GMO identity preservation, low moisture). Expressed in currency_code per price_uom.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service Quality Premiums; GLOBALG.A.P.; National Organic Program (NOP); USDA

attributes.name: renewal_type
attributes.description: Indicates how this pricing agreement is renewed upon expiry. 'manual' = requires explicit renegotiation; 'auto_renew' = automatically renews for the same term; 'evergreen' = continues indefinitely until terminated; 'one_time' = single-use agreement with no renewal.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Condition Validity Management; Salesforce CRM Contract Renewal

attributes.name: sales_channel_code
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution channel or sales channel (e.g., direct farm-gate, export, domestic wholesale, retail) under which this pricing agreement applies. Supports channel-specific pricing strategies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Distribution Channel (VTWEG)

attributes.name: sap_condition_record_number
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA SD condition record number (KNUMH) that corresponds to this pricing agreement. Provides direct traceability to the source system pricing master data for reconciliation and audit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Condition Record (KNUMH/KONH/KONP)

attributes.name: volume_uom
attributes.description: The unit of measure in which volume thresholds (min/max) are expressed. May differ from price_uom in some commodity contracts (e.g., price per MT but volume commitment in BU). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BU|MT|CWT|LB|KG|TON|BBL|DOZ — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Scale Unit (KSTME); USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; ISO 80000-1

products.name: market_price
products.description: Daily or intraday commodity market price reference sourced from DTN, CME futures, WASDE reports, and local elevator bids — capturing commodity code, price date, price type (cash, futures, basis, FOB, CIF), market location or exchange, unit of measure, bid/ask/settlement values, crop year, and data source. Primary reference for sales teams performing pricing validation, basis calculation, quote generation, and revenue benchmarking. Also consumed by procurement and finance for cost benchmarking and margin analysis.
products.reference: DTN/WASDE Market Price Feed

attributes.name: market_price_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each market price record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for the market_price data product.
attributes.references: Internal Data Architecture Standard

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: Market prices are fundamentally prices FOR specific commodities. commodity_code and commodity_name are denormalized on market_price. Formal FK enables price-to-commodity joins for basis calculations,
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: growing_season_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to crop.growing_season. Business justification: Season-based price analysis: grain market prices are always associated with a specific crop year (e.g., Dec 2024 corn). The existing crop_year plain string is a denormalization. Linking enables season
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: ask_price
attributes.description: The price at which a seller is willing to sell the commodity per unit of measure on the price date. Used alongside bid_price to determine the bid-ask spread for market liquidity assessment and quote ceiling setting.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Price Reporting Guidelines; CME Group Market Data Definitions; DTN Commodity Pricing Standards

attributes.name: basis_value
attributes.description: The difference between the local cash price and the nearby futures contract price (cash price minus futures price), expressed in the same currency and unit of measure. Basis reflects local supply/demand conditions, transportation costs, and storage premiums. Critical for sales teams performing basis calculations, forward contract pricing, and local market competitiveness analysis.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Basis Reporting Standards; CME Group Basis Trading Guidelines; DTN Basis Data Definitions

attributes.name: bid_price
attributes.description: The price at which a buyer is willing to purchase the commodity per unit of measure on the price date. Used by sales teams for pricing validation, quote floor setting, and basis calculation. Expressed in the currency and unit of measure specified in this record.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Price Reporting Guidelines; CME Group Market Data Definitions; DTN Commodity Pricing Standards

attributes.name: close_price
attributes.description: The last traded price at the close of the market session on the price date. Distinct from settlement_price which may be calculated differently by the exchange. Used for end-of-day reporting, trend analysis, and daily price comparison across periods.
attributes.references: CME Group Market Data Definitions; DTN Commodity Pricing Standards

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the market or exchange location where this price was observed (e.g., USA, BRA, ARG, CAN, AUS). Required for international trade pricing, COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) compliance, and multi-country revenue benchmarking.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 Country Codes; USDA COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) Regulations; USDA Foreign Agricultural Service (FAS) Market Data

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this market price record was first ingested and created in the silver layer lakehouse. Used for data freshness monitoring, SLA compliance tracking, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance and Audit Policy; SOX Section 404 — Data Integrity Controls

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the price is denominated (e.g., USD for US Dollar, EUR for Euro, CAD for Canadian Dollar, BRL for Brazilian Real). Required for multi-currency operations, international trade pricing (CIF/FOB), and IFRS/GAAP financial reporting compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS 21 — Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates; GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: delivery_point
attributes.description: The specific geographic delivery location or terminal associated with this price (e.g., 'Gulf of Mexico — New Orleans', 'Pacific Northwest — Portland', 'Chicago Delivery', 'On-Farm — Iowa'). Relevant for FOB and CIF price types. Used in logistics cost modeling, transportation benchmarking, and BOL generation.
attributes.references: Incoterms 2020 (ICC) — FOB and CIF Delivery Point Definitions; USDA AMS Delivery Location Codes

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The timestamp from which this price record is considered valid and applicable for use in sales quotes, procurement benchmarking, and financial reporting. Supports slowly changing dimension (SCD) patterns in the silver layer for historical price tracking and point-in-time analysis.
attributes.references: Internal Data Architecture Standard — SCD Type 2; SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Validity Period Standards

attributes.name: effective_to
attributes.description: The timestamp until which this price record is valid. Null indicates the record is currently active (open-ended validity). Used in conjunction with effective_from for SCD Type 2 historical price tracking, enabling point-in-time price lookups for audit, contract dispute resolution, and retrospective margin analysis.
attributes.references: Internal Data Architecture Standard — SCD Type 2; SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Validity Period Standards

attributes.name: exchange_code
attributes.description: Standardized exchange or market identifier code where the price was quoted or traded (e.g., CBOT — Chicago Board of Trade, CME — Chicago Mercantile Exchange, KCBT — Kansas City Board of Trade, MGE — Minneapolis Grain Exchange, ICE — Intercontinental Exchange). Null for non-exchange sources such as elevator bids or broker quotes.
attributes.references: CME Group Exchange Codes; ISO 10383 Market Identifier Code (MIC) Standard

attributes.name: futures_contract_month
attributes.description: The delivery month and year code for the futures contract being referenced (e.g., 'Z25' for December 2025, 'H26' for March 2026). Uses standard CME/CBOT contract month letter codes (F=Jan, G=Feb, H=Mar, J=Apr, K=May, M=Jun, N=Jul, Q=Aug, U=Sep, V=Oct, X=Nov, Z=Dec). Null for cash or non-futures price types.
attributes.references: CME Group Futures Contract Specifications; CBOT Grain Futures Contract Codes

attributes.name: grade_or_quality
attributes.description: The commodity grade, quality class, or specification standard to which this price applies (e.g., '#2 Yellow Corn', 'Hard Red Winter Wheat — 11% protein', 'USDA Choice Beef', 'No. 1 Soybeans'). Prices vary significantly by grade; this field ensures accurate price-to-product matching for sales quotes and procurement benchmarking.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Commodity Grade Standards; USDA GIPSA (Grain Inspection, Packers and Stockyards Administration) Grade Definitions; GLOBALG.A.P. Quality Standards

attributes.name: high_price
attributes.description: The highest price at which the commodity traded during the market session on the price date. Used for price range analysis, volatility reporting, and sales opportunity identification when prices reach favorable levels.
attributes.references: CME Group Market Data Definitions; DTN Commodity Pricing Standards; USDA AMS Daily Price Reports

attributes.name: is_holiday
attributes.description: Indicates whether the price date falls on a market holiday or exchange closure day (True = holiday/no trading, False = regular trading day). Used to identify non-trading days in price series analysis, gap-filling logic, and seasonal demand forecasting models.
attributes.references: CME Group Exchange Holiday Calendar; USDA AMS Market Holiday Schedule

attributes.name: low_price
attributes.description: The lowest price at which the commodity traded during the market session on the price date. Used alongside high_price for daily price range analysis, risk assessment, and procurement cost benchmarking.
attributes.references: CME Group Market Data Definitions; DTN Commodity Pricing Standards; USDA AMS Daily Price Reports

attributes.name: market_location
attributes.description: The geographic market location, elevator name, port, or exchange venue associated with this price (e.g., 'Chicago Board of Trade', 'Gulf of Mexico Export Terminal', 'Kansas City', 'Minneapolis Grain Exchange', 'Local Elevator — Ames IA'). Used for basis calculation, regional price comparison, and logistics cost benchmarking.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Market Location Codes; CME Group Exchange Venue Definitions

attributes.name: open_interest
attributes.description: The total number of outstanding futures or options contracts that have not been settled or closed as of the price date. A key indicator of market participation and hedging activity. Used by finance and sales teams for market sentiment analysis and forward pricing strategy.
attributes.references: CFTC Commitments of Traders Report; CME Group Open Interest Reporting Standards

attributes.name: open_price
attributes.description: The price at which the commodity first traded at the opening of the market session on the price date. Used for intraday price movement analysis, volatility assessment, and sales team market briefings.
attributes.references: CME Group Market Data Definitions; DTN Commodity Pricing Standards

attributes.name: price_change
attributes.description: The net change in price from the previous trading session's settlement or close price to the current session's settlement or close price. Expressed as a signed decimal (positive = price increase, negative = price decrease). Used for daily market movement reporting and sales team briefings.
attributes.references: CME Group Market Data Definitions; DTN Commodity Pricing Standards

attributes.name: price_date
attributes.description: The calendar date for which this market price record is valid. Represents the trading or reporting date of the price observation. Used by sales teams for daily pricing validation, basis calculation, and quote generation aligned with market conditions on a specific date.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) Daily Price Reporting; DTN Market Data Standards

attributes.name: price_frequency
attributes.description: The temporal frequency or granularity of this price observation. Values: intraday (tick or interval price within a trading session), daily (end-of-day or daily summary), weekly (weekly average or closing price), monthly (monthly average, used for WASDE and long-term planning). Determines how the record is used in analytics and forecasting pipelines.
attributes.references: DTN Market Data Feed Specifications; USDA AMS Price Reporting Frequency Standards

attributes.name: price_qualifier
attributes.description: Additional qualifier describing the nature or timing of the price within its type. Values: nearby (nearest active futures contract month), deferred (future delivery month beyond nearby), spot (immediate delivery cash price), forward (agreed future delivery price), indicative (non-binding market indication), firm (binding quoted price). Used to distinguish pricing intent for quote generation and contract negotiation.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Price Reporting Terminology; CME Group Contract Specifications; Incoterms 2020 (ICC)

attributes.name: price_source
attributes.description: The originating data source or market feed from which this price record was obtained. Values: DTN (Data Transmission Network market data), CME (Chicago Mercantile Exchange futures), WASDE (World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates — USDA monthly report), elevator_bid (local grain elevator posted bid), USDA_AMS (USDA Agricultural Marketing Service daily reports), broker (broker or dealer quote). Critical for data lineage, source credibility weighting, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: DTN Market Data Licensing Agreement; USDA WASDE Report Publication Standards; CME Group Data Policy

attributes.name: price_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this price record indicating its current validity and usability. Values: active (current valid price for use), superseded (replaced by a corrected or updated record), preliminary (provisional price pending final confirmation), final (confirmed and authoritative), cancelled (withdrawn price record). Ensures sales teams only use validated prices for quote generation.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Policy; USDA AMS Price Correction and Revision Procedures

attributes.name: price_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time of the intraday price observation or quote capture (ISO 8601 format with timezone offset). Applicable for intraday price feeds from CME futures or DTN real-time data. Null for end-of-day or daily summary records.
attributes.references: CME Group Market Data Policy; DTN Real-Time Data Feed Standards

attributes.name: price_type
attributes.description: Classification of the price observation indicating the commercial pricing mechanism. Values: cash (spot/local elevator cash price), futures (exchange-traded futures contract price), basis (difference between local cash and futures), fob (Free On Board — seller loads at origin), cif (Cost Insurance and Freight — seller delivers to destination). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cash|futures|basis|fob|cif|forward|settlement — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CME Group Futures Market Definitions; USDA AMS Price Reporting; Incoterms 2020 (ICC) — FOB and CIF definitions

attributes.name: settlement_price
attributes.description: The official end-of-day settlement price established by the exchange or market authority for the commodity on the price date. Used as the authoritative reference for daily mark-to-market, margin calculations, forward contract valuation, and revenue benchmarking by finance and procurement teams.
attributes.references: CME Group Daily Settlement Price Procedures; CFTC Commodity Exchange Act — Settlement Price Rules

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: The original record identifier or message ID from the upstream source system (DTN feed ID, CME market data message ID, WASDE report record reference, SAP S/4HANA SD pricing condition record key). Used for data lineage tracing, duplicate detection, and reconciliation between the silver layer and source systems.
attributes.references: Internal Data Lineage and Audit Policy; SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Condition Record Standards; DTN Data Feed Documentation

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure in which the price is expressed. Values: BU (Bushel — standard for corn, soybeans, wheat), CWT (Hundredweight — standard for cotton, rice, livestock), MT (Metric Ton — international trade standard), LB (Pound — livestock and some specialty crops), TON (Short Ton), OZ (Troy Ounce — precious metals), KG (Kilogram — international). Critical for price comparison, quote generation, and cross-commodity benchmarking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BU|CWT|MT|LB|TON|OZ|KG — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA AMS Unit of Measure Standards; CME Group Contract Unit Specifications; Codex Alimentarius Commission Unit Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this market price record was last modified or updated in the silver layer lakehouse (e.g., price correction, status change, source data revision). Used for change tracking, data quality monitoring, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance and Audit Policy; SOX Section 404 — Data Integrity Controls

attributes.name: volume
attributes.description: Total number of contracts or units traded for this commodity on the price date. Indicates market liquidity and trading activity. Used by sales and procurement teams to assess market depth and execution feasibility for large volume transactions.
attributes.references: CME Group Volume Reporting Standards; CFTC Commitments of Traders Report

attributes.name: wasde_report_month
attributes.business_glossary_term: World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates (WASDE) Report Month
attributes.description: The YYYY-MM formatted month of the USDA WASDE report from which this price or supply/demand context was sourced. Applicable only when price_source = 'WASDE'. The WASDE report is published monthly by USDA and is a primary reference for global commodity supply/demand balance sheets used in revenue benchmarking and seasonal forecasting.
attributes.references: USDA World Agricultural Supply and Demand Estimates (WASDE) Report Publication Schedule; USDA Economic Research Service (ERS)

products.name: delivery_order
products.description: Delivery instruction issued against a confirmed sales order or contract — capturing delivery order number, ship-from location (farm, elevator, warehouse), ship-to customer location, scheduled shipment date, commodity, grade, quantity (BU/MT/CWT), transport mode, carrier assignment, BOL reference, and delivery status. Bridges the sales order to physical logistics execution.
products.reference: SAP SD Outbound Delivery (VL01N)

attributes.name: delivery_order_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate key identifying each delivery order record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Delivery Document

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer (buyer, food manufacturer, distributor) receiving this delivery. Supports customer-level delivery tracking and COOL compliance.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account; SAP S/4HANA SD — Customer Master

attributes.name: alert_id
