attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the assigned transportation carrier (trucking company, rail operator, vessel operator) responsible for executing the physical delivery.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Forwarding Agent; TMS — Carrier Master

attributes.name: certificate_of_analysis_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.certificate_of_analysis. Business justification: A COA must accompany every commodity delivery in agriculture trade. Linking delivery_order to certificate_of_analysis enables COA-to-delivery traceability, supports customer acceptance/rejection decis
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agricultural commodity (e.g., corn, soybeans, wheat, cotton) being delivered. Drives grade, quality, and regulatory compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Master; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.contact. Business justification: Delivery coordination: the receiving contact at the delivery location must be notified of scheduled shipment dates, BOL numbers, and appointment requirements. Standard ag logistics process; distinct f
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying forward or spot commodity contract governing the terms of this delivery, if applicable. Supports contract-based delivery scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Contract Management

attributes.name: deforestation_risk_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.deforestation_risk. Business justification: EUDR requires a due diligence statement referencing a deforestation risk assessment to accompany each physical delivery of regulated commodities. The delivery order references the deforestation risk a
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: delivery_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer delivery destination (plant, distribution center, port terminal) where the commodity is to be received.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Ship-To Party; Manhattan Associates WMS — Destination

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating location (farm, grain elevator, warehouse, or processing facility) from which the commodity is dispatched.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Shipping Point; Manhattan Associates WMS — Facility

attributes.name: inspection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.inspection. Business justification: In agriculture commodity trade, incoming goods inspections are performed at delivery receipt. Linking delivery_order to inspection enables traceability from delivery to inspection outcome (acceptance,
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: order_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order_line. Business justification: A delivery order executes fulfillment at the line-item level — each delivery instruction corresponds to a specific commodity line on the sales order. Currently delivery_order only FKs to the order hea
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: sales_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the confirmed sales order against which this delivery order is issued. Links the physical logistics execution back to the commercial sales transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Sales Order (SO)

attributes.name: sustainability_certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.sustainability_certification. Business justification: Delivery orders for certified commodities (ISCC, organic, Rainforest Alliance) must reference the applicable certification to maintain chain-of-custody documentation at the point of physical delivery.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: yield_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to crop.yield_record. Business justification: FSMA/COOL delivery traceability: a delivery order ships grain from a specific harvest lot. Linking delivery_order to yield_record enables farm-to-delivery traceability required by FSMA and COOL regula
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which the commodity was received and confirmed at the customer destination. Used for revenue recognition, invoice triggering, and on-time delivery reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Proof of Delivery Date; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: actual_shipment_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which the commodity physically departed the ship-from location. Compared against scheduled shipment date for on-time performance KPI tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Actual Goods Issue Date; FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: bol_number
attributes.description: The Bill of Lading reference number issued by the carrier upon pickup of the commodity. Serves as the legal contract of carriage and title transfer document for the shipment.
attributes.references: USDA FSIS — Shipping Documentation; UCC Article 7 — Bills of Lading

attributes.name: commodity_grade
attributes.description: The USDA or contractually specified quality grade of the commodity being delivered (e.g., US No. 1, US No. 2, Sample Grade for grains). Determines pricing, acceptance criteria, and end-use suitability. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: US_No1|US_No2|US_No3|US_No4|US_No5|Sample_Grade|Premium|Standard — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service — Grain Grading Standards; SAP S/4HANA QM

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country where the commodity was produced or harvested. Mandatory for Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) compliance under USDA AMS regulations.
attributes.references: USDA AMS — Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) 7 CFR Part 60; ISO 3166-1

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transaction (e.g., USD, EUR, BRL). Supports multi-currency international agricultural trade reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS — Foreign Currency Transactions

attributes.name: delivery_channel
attributes.description: The sales and distribution channel through which this delivery is executed — direct to customer, via broker/agent, through a distributor, export channel, or intercompany transfer. Supports channel performance analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Distribution Channel; Salesforce CRM — Sales Channel

attributes.name: delivery_order_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable delivery order reference number used in communications with carriers, customers, and logistics partners. Follows the format DO-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Outbound Delivery Number

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the delivery order across its lifecycle from creation through physical delivery or cancellation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Delivery Processing Status

attributes.name: grn_number
attributes.description: The Goods Receipt Note number issued by the customer or receiving warehouse upon acceptance of the delivery. Confirms quantity and quality acceptance and initiates the accounts receivable process.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Goods Receipt (GRN); Manhattan Associates WMS — Receipt Confirmation

attributes.name: gross_weight_mt
attributes.description: Total gross weight of the shipment in metric tons, including packaging and container tare weight. Required for carrier weight compliance, freight billing, and customs documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Gross Weight; DOT Weight Regulations; USDA FSIS

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms code defining the point of risk and cost transfer between seller and buyer (e.g., FOB — Free On Board, CIF — Cost Insurance and Freight). Governs title transfer and insurance obligations.
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP S/4HANA SD — Incoterms

attributes.name: incoterms_location
attributes.description: The named place or port associated with the Incoterms code (e.g., 'FOB Gulf Port, MS' or 'CIF Rotterdam'). Specifies the exact point of risk transfer as required by ICC Incoterms 2020.
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP S/4HANA SD — Incoterms Location

attributes.name: is_gmo
attributes.description: Indicates whether the commodity contains or is derived from genetically modified organisms (GMO). Required for customer disclosure, export documentation, and compliance with international GMO labeling regulations.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS — Biotechnology Regulations; National Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard (7 CFR Part 66)

attributes.name: is_organic_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the commodity in this delivery is certified organic under the USDA National Organic Program (NOP). Drives premium pricing, labeling requirements, and segregation protocols.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) — 7 CFR Part 205; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this delivery order record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, data lineage, and incremental ETL processing in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Change Document Timestamp; SOX Audit Controls

attributes.name: net_weight_mt
attributes.description: Net weight of the commodity in metric tons, excluding packaging and tare. Used for commodity quantity reconciliation, invoice verification, and USDA reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Net Weight; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service

attributes.name: pricing_basis
attributes.description: The pricing mechanism applied to this delivery — spot (current market price), forward (agreed future price), futures-linked (tied to CBOT/CME futures contract), contract fixed (pre-agreed fixed price), or basis (futures price plus/minus a basis differential).
attributes.references: USDA WASDE; DTN Market Data; SAP S/4HANA SD — Pricing Procedure

attributes.name: proof_of_delivery_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether a signed Proof of Delivery (POD) document has been received from the customer or carrier, confirming physical receipt of the commodity. Triggers invoice release in SAP SD.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Proof of Delivery; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The ordered quantity of the commodity to be delivered, expressed in the unit of measure specified in the unit_of_measure field (BU, MT, CWT, etc.).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Delivery Quantity; USDA WASDE Reporting Standards

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description for delivery rejection or partial acceptance by the customer (e.g., grade non-conformance, quantity discrepancy, contamination, late delivery). Populated when delivery_status is cancelled or on_hold.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM — Quality Notification; GFSI Non-Conformance Reporting

attributes.name: scheduled_delivery_date
attributes.description: The planned calendar date on which the commodity is expected to arrive at the ship-to customer location. Used for customer commitment and demand planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Delivery Date; FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: scheduled_shipment_date
attributes.description: The planned calendar date on which the commodity is scheduled to depart from the ship-from location. Used for carrier booking and logistics coordination.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Planned Goods Issue Date

attributes.name: source_system_reference
attributes.description: The originating system document reference for this delivery order (e.g., SAP outbound delivery document number, Manhattan WMS shipment ID). Supports data lineage and cross-system reconciliation in the lakehouse.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Outbound Delivery; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any special handling, delivery, or unloading instructions communicated to the carrier or receiving facility (e.g., temperature requirements, fumigation status, unloading sequence).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Delivery Note Text; HACCP Handling Procedures

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: The mode of transportation used to execute the delivery (truck, rail, barge, ocean vessel, air freight, or intermodal combination). Drives carrier selection, BOL type, and freight cost.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Shipping Conditions; TMS — Transport Mode

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure in which the delivery quantity is expressed. BU (Bushel) for grains, MT (Metric Ton) for international trade, CWT (Hundredweight) for livestock products.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; SAP S/4HANA MM — Unit of Measure

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: The agreed price per unit of measure for the commodity in this delivery, expressed in the transaction currency. Confidential commercial pricing data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Condition Value; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

products.name: broker
products.description: Master record for agricultural commodity brokers and independent sales agents who act as intermediaries in the sales channel. Captures broker code, name, brokerage firm, license number, USDA registration, commodity specializations, commission rate structure, geographic territory, and relationship status. Includes commission transaction management: calculation rules, earned amounts per sales order/contract, payment status, settlement periods, and commission history. Brokers facilitate transactions between the enterprise and buyers but are neither customers nor suppliers. SSOT for broker identity, performance, and commission lifecycle.
products.reference: Salesforce CRM Partner Account

attributes.name: broker_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate identifier for the broker master record. Primary key for the broker entity in the sales domain Silver layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Partner Function Master

attributes.name: license_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.license. Business justification: Agricultural commodity brokers must hold valid state grain dealer or commodity broker licenses. Linking broker to compliance.license enables license expiry monitoring, regulatory validation before com
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: sales_territory_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.territory. Business justification: Brokers operate within defined sales territories for agricultural commodity distribution. broker carries geographic_territory (STRING free-text) but no FK to the territory master. Adding sales_territo
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: annual_volume_target_mt
attributes.description: Agreed annual commodity volume target in Metric Tons (MT) that the broker is expected to facilitate. Used for performance tracking, tiered commission threshold evaluation, and seasonal demand forecasting. Supports YPM (Yield Per Acre Metric) analytics.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management Financial Planning; SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Quota; WASDE Supply and Demand Estimates

attributes.name: broker_category
attributes.description: Operational category indicating the primary commodity segment the broker specializes in. Supports routing of sales opportunities and commission rule assignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: commodity|grain|livestock|produce|specialty_crop|multi_commodity|feed|fiber — promote to reference product if expanded]
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) Commodity Classification; WASDE Commodity Categories

attributes.name: broker_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier assigned to the broker, used in SAP S/4HANA SD partner function records and Salesforce CRM for cross-system reference. Unique across all broker records.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Partner Function; Salesforce CRM Partner Object

attributes.name: broker_type
attributes.description: Classification of the broker entity: individual independent agent, brokerage firm, agricultural cooperative acting as intermediary, or industry association. Drives commission structure and contract template selection.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Partner Function Category; USDA Agricultural Marketing Act

attributes.name: business_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the broker's registered business location. Used for commission payment remittance, legal correspondence, and USDA registration verification.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Broker Registration; SAP S/4HANA FI Vendor Master Address

attributes.name: business_city
attributes.description: City of the broker's registered business address. Used in geographic territory assignment and regulatory jurisdiction determination.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Vendor Master; USDA AMS Regional Office Assignment

attributes.name: business_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the broker's primary business country. Determines applicable regulatory framework (USDA, FDA, COOL compliance) and currency for commission payments.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) — USDA AMS; GDPR (for non-US brokers)

attributes.name: business_state_province
attributes.business_glossary_term: Broker Business State or Province Code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or Canadian province code for the broker's primary business location. Drives state licensing compliance checks and territory assignment logic.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2 US/CA State Codes; USDA AMS State Office Jurisdiction

attributes.name: commission_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which broker commissions are calculated and paid (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR). Supports multi-currency commission settlement for international brokers.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS 21 Foreign Currency Transactions; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Configuration

attributes.name: commission_rate_pct
attributes.description: Standard commission rate expressed as a percentage of the net sales order value earned by the broker for facilitating a transaction. Used as the default rate in commission calculation rules. Stored as a decimal (e.g., 0.0250 = 2.50%). Negotiated per broker agreement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Condition Type Commission; Granular Farm Management Financial Planning; GAAP Revenue Recognition ASC 606

attributes.name: commission_structure_type
attributes.description: Type of commission calculation structure applicable to this broker: flat rate (fixed percentage), tiered (rate varies by volume band), volume bonus (additional payment at threshold), spot-linked (tied to spot market price), or futures-linked (tied to futures contract price). Drives commission engine logic.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Procedure; DTN Market Data Integration; WASDE Price Benchmarks

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the broker agreement expires or is terminated. Null indicates an open-ended agreement. Used to enforce commission eligibility cutoffs and trigger renewal workflows in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Outline Agreement Validity; Salesforce CRM Contract Object; GAAP Contract Termination

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the broker agreement becomes legally effective and the broker is authorized to transact on behalf of the enterprise. Used for commission eligibility validation and contract lifecycle management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Outline Agreement; GLOBALG.A.P. Partner Agreement; GAAP Contract Inception

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the broker master record was first created in the Silver layer data product. Serves as the audit trail creation marker per SOX and GDPR data lineage requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity; ISO 22000 Record Keeping

attributes.name: exclusivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the broker holds an exclusive territory or commodity agreement with the enterprise, preventing assignment of competing brokers to the same territory or commodity segment. True = exclusive arrangement.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Partner Agreement; SAP S/4HANA SD Territory Exclusivity; Agricultural Marketing Act

attributes.name: federal_tax_number
attributes.description: Federal Employer Identification Number (EIN) or Tax Identification Number (TIN) for the broker entity. Required for IRS 1099 commission reporting and SAP FI vendor master setup for commission payments.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1099-MISC; GAAP Revenue Recognition; SOX Financial Reporting Controls

attributes.name: gfsi_scheme
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI) Certification Scheme
attributes.description: GFSI-recognized food safety certification scheme held by the broker or their represented suppliers, such as SQF (Safe Quality Food), BRC (British Retail Consortium), IFS (International Featured Standards), or FSSC 22000. Relevant for brokers handling food-grade commodities requiring supply chain food safety compliance.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; SQF Institute; BRC Global Standards; IFS Food Standard; FDA FSMA Section 204

attributes.name: globalg_ap_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the broker holds a valid GLOBALG.A.P. (Global Good Agricultural Practices) certification, confirming adherence to internationally recognized agricultural standards. True = currently certified. Relevant for premium commodity channels and export markets.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Certification Standard; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; FDA FSMA Supply Chain Program

attributes.name: incoterms_preference
attributes.description: Preferred International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) used by the broker in sales transactions, such as FOB (Free On Board) or CIF (Cost Insurance and Freight). Defaults to sales order Incoterms when broker is assigned. Relevant for BOL generation and logistics cost allocation.
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP S/4HANA SD Incoterms Configuration; BOL Generation Standards

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal performance and compliance review conducted for this broker. Used to trigger periodic review workflows and ensure ongoing USDA, FDA, and GLOBALG.A.P. compliance.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Annual Audit Requirements; FSMA Supplier Verification Program; Salesforce CRM Partner Review Workflow

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal registered name of the broker individual or brokerage firm as it appears on USDA registration, state licensing documents, and contractual agreements.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Broker Registration; GLOBALG.A.P. Partner Requirements

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Date on which the broker completed the enterprise onboarding process, including USDA registration verification, license validation, SAP vendor master creation, and Salesforce CRM partner record activation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Partner Onboarding SOP; Salesforce CRM Partner Onboarding Workflow; USDA AMS Compliance Verification

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms governing when earned commissions are disbursed to the broker after a sales order or contract is settled. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA FI payment terms configuration for vendor commission payments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms; GAAP Accounts Payable; Oracle NetSuite AP Module

attributes.name: preferred_sales_channel
attributes.description: Primary sales channel through which the broker facilitates transactions: spot market (immediate delivery pricing), forward contract, futures-linked pricing, auction, or direct negotiation. Aligns with pricing strategy configuration in SAP S/4HANA SD and DTN market data feeds.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Strategy; DTN Market Data Network; WASDE Forward Pricing

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the broker contact used for sales order notifications, commission statements, and regulatory correspondence. Sourced from Salesforce CRM partner record.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Partner Object; GDPR Article 4; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact person at the brokerage firm or the individual broker. Used for sales correspondence, contract execution, and commission dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; GDPR Article 4 (for international brokers)

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the broker contact. Used for urgent sales negotiations, logistics coordination, and commission payment inquiries.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Partner Object; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: relationship_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the broker relationship with the enterprise. Controls whether the broker can be assigned to new sales orders, contracts, or commission transactions. Managed in Salesforce CRM partner lifecycle workflow.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Partner Lifecycle Management; SAP S/4HANA SD Partner Blocking

attributes.name: salesforce_partner_code
attributes.description: External system identifier linking this broker master record to the corresponding partner account record in Salesforce CRM. Enables bidirectional synchronization of broker profile, opportunity assignments, and relationship status between the Silver layer and Salesforce.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Partner Community; SAP S/4HANA SD — Salesforce Integration (CPI/BTP)

attributes.name: sap_vendor_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA FI/MM vendor master record number assigned to the broker for commission payment processing via Accounts Payable. Required for 1099 reporting and commission disbursement through SAP FI payment runs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Vendor Master (LFA1); Oracle NetSuite AP Vendor Record; IRS 1099-MISC Reporting

attributes.name: settlement_period
attributes.description: Frequency at which broker commission statements are generated and payments are settled. Determines the commission aggregation window in the commission lifecycle management process.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Commission Settlement; Granular Farm Management Financial Planning; GAAP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for the termination of the broker relationship when relationship_status is set to 'terminated'. Used for audit trail, regulatory compliance documentation, and broker performance analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Partner Blocking Reason; Salesforce CRM Partner Lifecycle; SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: trading_name
attributes.description: Doing-business-as (DBA) or trade name used by the broker in commercial transactions, if different from the legal name. Used in sales order documentation and BOL generation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Partner Master; Salesforce CRM Account Object

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the broker master record in the Silver layer. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental load processing, and audit trail compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity; Databricks Delta Lake CDC

attributes.name: usda_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) Registration Number
attributes.description: Official USDA registration or license number issued to the broker under the Agricultural Marketing Act or Packers and Stockyards Act. Required for compliance with USDA AMS and APHIS regulations when brokering regulated commodities.

attributes.name: ytd_volume_facilitated_mt
attributes.description: Cumulative commodity volume in Metric Tons (MT) facilitated by the broker in the current calendar or fiscal year. Used for performance monitoring against annual volume targets and tiered commission threshold evaluation. Refreshed from SAP S/4HANA SD sales order data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Statistics; Granular Farm Management KPI Reporting; WASDE Volume Benchmarks

Drives sales planning, inventory pre-positioning, and contract negotiation strategy.

attributes.name: allocated_volume
attributes.description: The quantity of commodity volume assigned to this customer under this allocation record. Expressed in the unit of measure specified in volume_uom (BU — Bushel or MT — Metric Ton). Represents the committed supply quantity during constrained periods.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service — Commodity Volume Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD — Quantity Management

attributes.name: allocation_basis
attributes.description: The business rationale or methodology used to determine how available supply is distributed to this customer. Drives equitable allocation decisions during supply-constrained periods. Values: contract_priority (contractual obligation rank), customer_tier (strategic customer classification), channel_strategy (distribution channel priority), pro_rata (proportional to historical volume), spot_market (open market availability), regulatory (government or regulatory mandate).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Allocation Management; FSMA Supply Chain Controls; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: allocation_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the allocation decision was made and the volume was formally assigned to the customer. Represents the principal real-world event date for this allocation record. Used for crop-year supply planning and customer commitment reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Document Date; Granular Farm Management — Allocation Planning

attributes.name: allocation_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the allocation record, used in customer communications, SAP SD allocation documents, and Salesforce CRM opportunity tracking. Follows the format ALLOC-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Allocation Document Numbering

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the customer allocation record. Tracks progression from initial draft through confirmation, fulfillment, and potential reallocation or cancellation during supply-constrained periods.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Delivery and Allocation Status Management

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the allocation was formally approved by the authorized sales manager or commercial director. Supports SOX audit trail requirements and allocation lifecycle governance.
attributes.references: SOX — Sarbanes-Oxley Act; SAP S/4HANA SD — Document Release Date; GAAP Internal Controls

attributes.name: commodity_grade
attributes.description: USDA or industry-standard grade designation of the commodity being allocated (e.g., US No. 1, US No. 2, Sample Grade). Grade determines quality specifications, pricing differentials, and customer eligibility. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: US No. 1|US No. 2|US No. 3|US No. 4|US No. 5|Sample Grade|Premium|Standard — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service — Official United States Standards for Grain; USDA FGIS (Federal Grain Inspection Service)

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the country where the allocated commodity was produced or harvested. Required for COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) compliance under USDA Agricultural Marketing Act and international trade documentation.
attributes.references: USDA COOL — Country of Origin Labeling (7 U.S.C. § 1638); ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; Codex Alimentarius — Food Labeling Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this allocation record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the audit creation trail for data lineage and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX — Sarbanes-Oxley Act; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity); SAP S/4HANA — Document Creation Timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the price_per_unit and total allocation value (e.g., USD for US Dollar). Supports multi-currency operations for international commodity trade under CIF/FOB terms.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; IFRS; GAAP

attributes.name: delivery_terms
attributes.description: International commercial terms (Incoterms) governing the transfer of risk and cost responsibility for the allocated commodity shipment. FOB = Free On Board (seller loads at origin port), CIF = Cost Insurance and Freight (seller covers to destination port). Critical for logistics cost allocation and revenue recognition timing.
attributes.references: Incoterms 2020 — International Chamber of Commerce; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; SAP S/4HANA SD — Shipping Conditions

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The start date from which this allocation is valid and the customer may begin drawing against the allocated volume. Defines the delivery window open date for fulfillment scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Validity Period; GLOBALG.A.P. Supply Agreement Terms

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The end date after which this allocation expires and any unfulfilled volume may be reallocated or cancelled. Defines the delivery window close date. Nullable for open-ended allocations pending supply confirmation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Validity Period; GLOBALG.A.P. Supply Agreement Terms

attributes.name: fulfilled_volume
attributes.description: The actual quantity of commodity that has been delivered or shipped against this allocation to date, expressed in the same unit of measure as allocated_volume (volume_uom). Used to calculate fulfillment shortfall and track delivery commitment performance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Delivery Processing (VL01N); Manhattan Associates WMS — Order Fulfillment

attributes.name: is_gmo
attributes.description: Indicates whether the allocated commodity is derived from Genetically Modified Organism (GMO) seed varieties. Required for customer labeling compliance, export documentation, and USDA National Organic Program (NOP) segregation requirements.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) — 7 CFR Part 205; USDA APHIS Biotechnology Regulations; EU GMO Labeling Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: is_organic_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the allocated commodity holds USDA National Organic Program (NOP) certification or equivalent international organic certification. Drives premium pricing, segregated handling requirements, and organic chain-of-custody documentation.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) — 7 CFR Part 205; GLOBALG.A.P. Organic Certification; ISO 22000

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Batch or lot tracking identifier assigned to the specific commodity inventory being allocated. Enables end-to-end traceability from farm origin through customer delivery, supporting FSMA traceability requirements and food safety recall management.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule (21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S); HACCP Lot Traceability; SAP S/4HANA MM — Batch Management (MSC1N); GLOBALG.A.P. Traceability

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, customer negotiation notes, special handling instructions, or commercial exceptions related to this allocation. Sourced from SAP SD long text or Salesforce CRM opportunity notes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Document Long Text; Salesforce CRM — Opportunity Notes

attributes.name: price_per_unit
attributes.description: Agreed or reference price per unit of measure for the allocated commodity, expressed in the currency specified in currency_code. May reflect spot, forward, or futures-linked pricing as defined in the pricing_type field. Confidential as it represents negotiated commercial terms.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Pricing Conditions (VK11); DTN Market Data; WASDE Price Benchmarks; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: pricing_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pricing mechanism applied to this allocation. spot = current market price, forward = agreed future delivery price, futures_linked = price tied to exchange futures contract, basis = futures price plus/minus a basis differential, fixed = locked price regardless of market, index = price tied to a published index (e.g., DTN, WASDE).
attributes.references: CBOT (Chicago Board of Trade) Commodity Pricing Standards; DTN Market Data; SAP S/4HANA SD — Pricing Procedures

attributes.name: reallocation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation record was created as a result of a reallocation from another customer or contract. When True, the original_allocation_id field identifies the source allocation from which volume was transferred.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Allocation Reprocessing; Granular Farm Management — Supply Reallocation

attributes.name: remaining_volume
attributes.description: Outstanding uncommitted or undelivered volume under this allocation (allocated_volume minus fulfilled_volume). Maintained as a stored field to support real-time supply planning and customer commitment tracking without requiring on-the-fly calculation in constrained-period dashboards.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Allocation Balance Tracking; Granular Farm Management — Inventory Planning

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The customer's preferred or contractually requested delivery date for the allocated commodity volume. Used for logistics scheduling, BOL generation, and customer service level tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD — Requested Delivery Date (VBAK-VDATU); Manhattan Associates WMS — Order Scheduling

attributes.name: supply_constraint_reason
attributes.description: The primary reason triggering the allocation management process for this record. Identifies the supply-side event causing shortfall relative to contracted volumes. Used for root cause analysis, insurance claims, and regulatory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: drought|poor_harvest|logistics_disruption|quality_rejection|force_majeure|regulatory_hold|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA Risk Management Agency — Crop Insurance; FSMA Supply Chain Disruption Reporting; ISO 22000 Food Safety Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to this allocation record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Tracks the last change event for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver Layer incremental processing.
attributes.references: SOX — Sarbanes-Oxley Act; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity); Databricks Delta Lake — Change Data Capture

attributes.name: volume_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the allocated_volume field. BU = Bushel (standard US grain measure), MT = Metric Ton (international trade standard), CWT = Hundredweight, LB = Pound, KG = Kilogram, TON = Short Ton. Aligns with SAP S/4HANA UOM configuration and USDA reporting standards.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service — Units of Measure; SAP S/4HANA MM — Unit of Measure Configuration; ISO 80000-1

Supports quality dispute resolution and reverse logistics in the agricultural supply chain.

attributes.description: Reference to the originating sales order (SO) against which this return is raised. Enables traceability from return back to the original commercial transaction for credit memo processing and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Sales Order Reference; FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to invoice.weight_ticket. Business justification: A commodity return in agriculture requires re-weighing at the receiving facility, generating a weight ticket that documents the returned net weight, moisture, and grade. This FK links the return autho

attributes.description: Date on which the returned goods were physically received and confirmed at the designated warehouse or receiving facility. Used for reverse logistics reconciliation and GRN generation.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Goods Receipt; SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Goods Receipt Note (GRN)

attributes.name: bol_number
attributes.description: Bill of Lading number associated with the return shipment from the customer back to the receiving facility. Used for reverse logistics tracking, carrier reconciliation, and proof of return receipt.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Transportation; SAP S/4HANA SD Shipping; Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: commodity_grade
attributes.description: USDA or contractually defined grade of the returned commodity at the time of return (e.g., US No. 1, US No. 2, Sample Grade). Used in grade dispute resolution and regrading disposition decisions.

attributes.name: cool_country_of_origin
attributes.business_glossary_term: Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) Country Code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country of origin of the returned commodity, as required under USDA Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) regulations. Used for compliance verification and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: USDA COOL Regulations (7 CFR Part 60 & 65); AMS Country of Origin Labeling; ISO 3166-1

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the return order record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for audit trail, SLA measurement, and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Document Creation

attributes.name: credit_memo_triggered
attributes.description: Indicates whether a credit memo has been triggered in the financial system (SAP S/4HANA FI/SD) as a result of this return order. True when the return qualifies for customer credit; False when pending review or rejected for credit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/FI Module — Credit Memo Processing; GAAP Revenue Recognition (ASC 606); IFRS 15

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the return value amount (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD). Ensures consistent financial reporting across international agricultural trade transactions.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS; GAAP; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: delivery_terms
attributes.description: International commercial terms (Incoterms) governing the original delivery and applicable to the return logistics, determining responsibility for freight, insurance, and risk transfer during the return shipment.
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Delivery Terms; USDA AMS Trade Terms

attributes.name: disposition_instruction
attributes.description: Authorized instruction specifying how the returned goods are to be handled upon receipt and inspection. Drives warehouse operations, quality management workflows, and financial treatment of the returned inventory.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module — Usage Decision; FSMA Preventive Controls; GLOBALG.A.P. Complaint Handling

attributes.name: expected_return_date
attributes.description: Anticipated date by which the returned goods are expected to arrive at the receiving warehouse. Used for reverse logistics planning, warehouse capacity scheduling, and SLA monitoring.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS — Inbound Planning; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: grn_number
attributes.description: Goods Receipt Note (GRN) number generated in SAP S/4HANA MM upon physical receipt of the returned goods at the warehouse. Confirms inventory re-entry and triggers downstream disposition and financial processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — Goods Receipt Note (GRN); Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the return order record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Change Document

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Batch or lot tracking identifier assigned to the returned agricultural product. Critical for FSMA traceability, MRL compliance investigation, and linking the return to the original harvest or production batch.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Traceability Rule (21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S); GLOBALG.A.P. Traceability; SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Management

attributes.name: mrl_exceedance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the return was triggered by a confirmed or suspected Maximum Residue Limit (MRL) exceedance for pesticide or chemical residues in the returned commodity. True triggers mandatory regulatory notification and disposal disposition.
attributes.references: EPA Maximum Residue Limits (40 CFR Part 180); FDA FSMA; Codex Alimentarius MRL Standards; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, internal comments, or escalation details related to the return order. May include logistics instructions, customer communication summaries, or quality investigation observations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Header Text; Salesforce CRM — Activity Notes

attributes.name: phi_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the return is associated with a Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) violation, where the crop was harvested before the mandatory waiting period following pesticide application had elapsed. Drives regulatory reporting and quality investigation.
attributes.references: EPA Pre-Harvest Interval Requirements; FDA FSMA Produce Safety Rule (21 CFR Part 112); GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: pricing_basis
attributes.description: Pricing mechanism under which the original sale was transacted, determining how the return value and credit memo are calculated. Spot returns are valued at current market price; futures-linked returns reference the contracted futures price.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module — Pricing Conditions; DTN Market Data; WASDE Price References

products.name: contract_certification_verification
products.description: This association product represents the Verification Event between a customer certification_record and a sales contract. It captures the operational compliance-verification process by which a specific certification is confirmed as satisfying a specific contract's certification requirements. Each record links one certification_record to one contract and carries attributes that exist only in the context of this verification: when it was verified, by whom, what certification type was required by the contract, and whether the certification was deemed compliant. Critical for GFSI-aligned supply chain qualification, FSMA audit trails, and GLOBALG.A.P. contract compliance tracking.. Existence Justification: In agricultural commodity trading, a single sales contract routinely requires multiple certifications (e.g., GLOBALG.A.P. + FSMA + Organic NOP simultaneously), and a single certification record (e.g., a buyer's USDA Organic certificate) can satisfy compliance requirements across multiple contracts within its validity period. The business actively manages which certifications have been verified against which contracts, tracking verification date, compliance status, and the specific cert type required by each contract — this is an operational compliance-verification process, not a derived analytical correlation.
products.reference: Internal - M:N Association

attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association PK

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the specific customer certification record that was verified against the contract requirement.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.references: Sourced from detection phase relationship_data

Captures which of the contract's certification obligations this verification record addresses, since a single contract may require multiple cert types verified separately.
attributes.references: Sourced from detection phase relationship_data

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: The outcome of the verification: whether the certification record was deemed to fully satisfy, conditionally satisfy, or fail to satisfy the contract's certification requirement at the time of verification. Belongs to the verification event.
attributes.references: Sourced from detection phase relationship_data

attributes.references: Sourced from detection phase relationship_data

domains.description: Single source of truth for all billing, invoicing, payments, and revenue recognition. Manages accounts receivable (AR), payment terms, credit management, financial settlements, and invoice lifecycle from generation to payment. Integrates with GL for revenue accounting per GAAP/IFRS standards. Supports agricultural-specific billing scenarios including commodity-based pricing, weight-ticket reconciliation, and seasonal payment terms.

products.name: invoice
products.description: Core accounts receivable invoice header representing the primary billing document issued to food manufacturers, distributors, cooperatives, and agricultural buyers. Captures invoice number, billing date, due date, total amount, tax, currency, payment terms, invoice status (draft/issued/partially_paid/paid/void/disputed), invoice type (commodity sale, service, weight-ticket settlement, contract settlement, advance billing, intercompany transfer, cooperative patronage), and source transaction references (sales order, delivery, contract). Serves as the SSOT for all outbound billing documents including intercompany transactions between farms, elevators, processing plants, and distribution subsidiaries. Links to invoice_line for item detail, payment_allocation for cash application, and billing_account for customer financial relationship.
products.reference: SAP FI-AR Invoice / GAAP ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: company_code_id
