attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying sales or commodity purchase contract linked to this payment, particularly relevant for advance payments, crop pre-purchase agreements, and seasonal payment programs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: gl_posting_journal_entry_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gl Posting Journal Entry Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Cash receipt payments generate GL postings (debit bank/cash, credit AR). In agriculture AR operations, linking payment to its GL journal entry supports cash application reconciliation, period close AR
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary invoice against which this payment is applied. Supports invoice-to-payment reconciliation in accounts receivable (AR).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Oracle NetSuite AR

attributes.name: payment_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to invoice.payment_term. Business justification: payment.payment_terms_code is a denormalized string reference to the payment_term reference table. Payments must reference the authoritative payment term to validate early payment discount eligibility
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: advance_purpose
attributes.description: Specific business purpose for advance or prepayment transactions. Applicable only when payment_type is 'advance' or 'deposit'. Supports agricultural-specific advance payment programs including crop pre-purchase financing, seed and input supply advances, and grain storage deposits.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; USDA Farm Service Agency; Granular Farm Management; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Gross amount of the payment as submitted by the payer in the transaction currency. Represents the total funds received before any deductions, discounts, or adjustments are applied.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310; IFRS 9; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR

attributes.name: applied_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the payment amount that has been successfully applied against one or more AR invoices. The difference between payment_amount and applied_amount yields the unapplied balance.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Oracle NetSuite AR

attributes.name: bank_reference_number
attributes.description: Unique reference number assigned by the bank for the payment transaction (e.g., ACH trace number, wire confirmation number, check clearing reference). Used for bank reconciliation and payment tracing.
attributes.references: NACHA ACH Rules; SAP S/4HANA FI-TR; Oracle NetSuite Bank Reconciliation

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Interface or channel through which the payment was submitted. 'portal' = customer self-service web portal; 'edi' = EDI 820 electronic remittance; 'manual' = manually entered by AR staff; 'bank_direct' = bank-initiated lockbox or direct debit; 'mobile' = mobile payment application.
attributes.references: EDI X12 820; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Oracle NetSuite

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.description: Paper check number when payment_method is 'check'. Required for check reconciliation, stop-payment processing, and audit trail in agricultural cooperative and distributor payments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Oracle NetSuite AR; GAAP

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the payment was cleared against the AR invoice in the accounting system. Marks the completion of the cash application process and AR balance reduction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Oracle NetSuite AR; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: commodity_lot_reference
attributes.description: Lot number (LOT) or batch identifier of the agricultural commodity (grain, produce, livestock) associated with this payment. Enables traceability from payment back to specific commodity lot for FSMA compliance and quality reconciliation.
attributes.references: FSMA; USDA; SAP S/4HANA MM; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP cost center code associated with the payment for internal management accounting and profitability analysis by business unit or agricultural division.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; Oracle NetSuite; GAAP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the payment record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial reporting controls.
attributes.references: SOX; GAAP; SAP S/4HANA FI; Oracle NetSuite

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the payment transaction (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD). Supports multi-currency agricultural commodity sales and international trade settlements.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS 21; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: discount_taken_amount
attributes.description: Early payment discount amount deducted by the payer per agreed payment terms (e.g., 2/10 net 30). Recorded separately for cash discount accounting and terms compliance tracking.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Oracle NetSuite AR

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the payment was contractually due per the invoice payment terms. Used for early/late payment analysis, discount eligibility determination, and AR aging reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Oracle NetSuite AR; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign currency exchange rate applied to convert the payment amount to the company's functional currency (USD) at the time of payment. Required for multi-currency AR reconciliation and IFRS 21 translation.
attributes.references: IFRS 21; GAAP ASC 830; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: Payment amount converted to the company's functional currency (USD) using the exchange_rate at the time of payment. Used for consolidated financial reporting and GL posting.
attributes.references: IFRS 21; GAAP ASC 830; SAP S/4HANA FI-CO

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger (GL) account code to which this payment is posted in the financial accounting system. Supports revenue recognition, AR clearing, and advance payment liability accounting per GAAP/IFRS.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310; IFRS 9; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; Oracle NetSuite GL

attributes.name: is_intercompany
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment is an intercompany transaction between related legal entities within the agricultural enterprise group. Required for intercompany elimination in consolidated financial statements per GAAP/IFRS.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 810; IFRS 10; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: is_partial_payment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment covers only a portion of the total invoice amount. True when applied_amount is less than the full invoice balance. Supports installment and partial payment tracking for agricultural seasonal payment programs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Oracle NetSuite AR; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by AR staff regarding the payment, such as dispute context, special handling instructions, customer communication details, or reconciliation remarks.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Oracle NetSuite AR

attributes.name: payer_bank_account
attributes.description: Masked or tokenized bank account identifier of the payer used for ACH, EFT, or wire payments. Stored in masked format for PCI compliance. Used for payment routing validation and fraud detection.
attributes.references: PCI DSS; NACHA ACH Rules; SAP S/4HANA FI-TR; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: payer_bank_routing_number
attributes.description: ABA routing transit number (9 digits) of the payer's bank for ACH and wire payment processing. Used for payment routing validation and bank reconciliation.
attributes.references: NACHA ACH Rules; ABA Routing Number Standard; SAP S/4HANA FI-TR

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The business event date on which the payment was received or initiated by the payer. Used for aging analysis, cash application, and revenue recognition timing per GAAP/IFRS.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Financial instrument or mechanism used to submit the payment. 'ACH' = Automated Clearing House electronic transfer; 'wire' = bank wire transfer; 'check' = paper check; 'EFT' = Electronic Funds Transfer; 'commodity_offset' = payment settled via commodity credit or offset against grain/livestock delivery — common in agricultural cooperative and elevator transactions.
attributes.references: NACHA ACH Rules; SAP S/4HANA FI; Oracle NetSuite AR

attributes.name: payment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the payment transaction, typically matching the payment document number in SAP S/4HANA FI or Oracle NetSuite. Used for cross-system reconciliation and customer remittance matching.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Oracle NetSuite AR

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the payment transaction. 'pending' = received but not yet bank-confirmed; 'cleared' = bank-confirmed and applied to AR; 'returned' = rejected by bank (e.g., NSF check, ACH return); 'voided' = cancelled before clearing; 'on_hold' = suspended pending investigation or dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; GAAP ASC 310; IFRS 9

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment by its business purpose and timing relative to the invoice. 'standard' = payment against an existing invoice; 'advance' = prepayment before invoice issuance (crop pre-purchase, seed advance, input supply advance); 'deposit' = security or storage deposit; 'installment' = partial payment under a deferred or seasonal payment plan.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: SAP profit center code for allocating payment revenue to the appropriate agricultural business segment (e.g., crop sales, livestock, inputs distribution) for segment reporting per IFRS 8.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA; IFRS 8; Oracle NetSuite

attributes.name: remittance_advice_number
attributes.description: Reference number from the payer's remittance advice document accompanying the payment. Used to match payment to specific invoices and deductions in the cash application process.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Oracle NetSuite AR; EDI 820 Payment Order/Remittance Advice

attributes.name: return_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized bank return reason code when payment_status is 'returned' (e.g., NACHA ACH return codes R01=Insufficient Funds, R02=Account Closed, R03=No Account). Required for returned payment processing and customer follow-up.
attributes.references: NACHA ACH Return Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR

attributes.name: sales_order_reference
attributes.description: Sales Order (SO) number from SAP S/4HANA SD or Oracle NetSuite linked to this payment. Enables end-to-end order-to-cash reconciliation for agricultural product sales.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Oracle NetSuite; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: unapplied_amount
attributes.description: Remaining payment balance not yet applied to any invoice. Represents funds held in suspense or advance payment accounts pending invoice matching. Common in agricultural commodity sales with prepayment programs.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Oracle NetSuite AR

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the payment record. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and data lineage for SOX compliance and financial controls.
attributes.references: SOX; GAAP; SAP S/4HANA FI; Oracle NetSuite

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The bank value date on which funds are credited to the company's account. May differ from payment_date for wire transfers and ACH batches. Critical for accurate cash position reporting and bank reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TR; Oracle NetSuite Bank Reconciliation; IFRS 9

attributes.name: weight_ticket_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the grain or commodity weight ticket number used to reconcile payment amounts against actual delivered commodity weight. Specific to agricultural commodity billing where payment is based on scale-verified weight at elevator or processing facility.
attributes.references: USDA Grain Inspection Packers and Stockyards Administration (GIPSA); Granular Farm Management; SAP S/4HANA MM

products.name: payment_allocation
products.description: Association entity linking payments to specific invoices and invoice lines, enabling partial payment tracking, multi-invoice settlement, and split-payment reconciliation. Captures allocation date, allocated amount, discount taken, early payment discount, write-off amount, allocation type (full/partial/advance/credit_offset/netting), reconciliation status, and variance amount. Critical for weight-ticket settlement reconciliation, commodity contract payment matching, and cooperative patronage distribution application in agricultural billing workflows.
products.reference: SAP FI-AR Clearing / Oracle NetSuite Payment Application

attributes.name: payment_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each payment allocation record linking a payment to a specific invoice or invoice line. Serves as the primary key for this association entity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module - Clearing Document

attributes.name: advance_payment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to invoice.advance_payment. Business justification: payment_allocation is the association entity linking payments to invoices. When an advance payment is being applied against an invoice, the payment_allocation record should reference the originating a
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: clearing_journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Payment allocations (clearing open AR items) generate GL clearing journal entries. In agriculture AR operations, matching payments to invoices triggers GL clearing postings. clearing_document_number i
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the invoice header being settled by this allocation. Supports multi-invoice settlement scenarios common in commodity contract billing and cooperative patronage distribution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Module; Oracle NetSuite AR

attributes.name: line_id
attributes.description: Reference to a specific invoice line item being settled. Enables partial payment tracking at the line level, critical for weight-ticket reconciliation and commodity-based billing where individual line items may be settled independently.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Module; Oracle NetSuite AR

attributes.name: patronage_distribution_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cooperative patronage distribution record being applied through this allocation. Supports cooperative patronage dividend application against member invoices, a common agricultural billing workflow for grain cooperatives and farm supply cooperatives.
attributes.references: USDA Rural Development Cooperative Programs; IRS Subchapter T Cooperative Taxation; SAP S/4HANA FI Special GL

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payment record being allocated. Links the allocation to the source payment transaction in the accounts receivable (AR) ledger.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Module; Oracle NetSuite AR

attributes.name: allocated_amount
attributes.description: The gross monetary amount of the payment applied to this invoice or invoice line in the transaction currency. Core financial field for AR settlement, revenue recognition, and cash application reporting per GAAP/IFRS standards.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA FI Clearing Amount; Oracle NetSuite Payment Application Amount

attributes.name: allocation_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the payment was applied to the invoice. Used for aging analysis, cash application reporting, and Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) calculation. May differ from the payment receipt date in seasonal agricultural billing cycles.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Date

attributes.name: allocation_number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for this payment allocation record, used in AR clearing documents, remittance advice matching, and audit trails. Corresponds to the SAP FI clearing document number or Oracle NetSuite application number.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Clearing Document; Oracle NetSuite Payment Application

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the payment allocation: pending (awaiting posting), posted (applied to AR ledger), reversed (allocation reversed/cancelled), reconciled (matched and confirmed in bank reconciliation), disputed (under investigation for discrepancy). Drives AR aging and cash application workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Clearing Status; Oracle NetSuite AR Application Status; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: allocation_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the nature of the payment application: full (complete invoice settlement), partial (portion of invoice settled), advance (prepayment applied against future invoice), credit_offset (credit memo applied), netting (offsetting payable against receivable), write_off (uncollectable balance cleared). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: full|partial|advance|credit_offset|netting|write_off — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Clearing Types; GAAP ASC 310; IFRS 9

attributes.name: approved_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or username of the finance manager or controller who approved this payment allocation, particularly for write-offs, large variance clearances, or deduction approvals. Supports segregation of duties and SOX internal control requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 and 404; SAP S/4HANA FI Workflow Approval; Oracle NetSuite Approval Workflow

attributes.name: base_currency_amount
attributes.description: Allocated amount converted to the company's functional (base) currency for general ledger (GL) posting and financial reporting. Required for multi-currency operations in international agricultural commodity trading per IFRS 21.
attributes.references: IFRS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates; GAAP ASC 830; SAP S/4HANA FI Local Currency Amount

attributes.name: commodity_contract_number
attributes.description: Reference to the agricultural commodity purchase or sales contract against which this payment is being applied. Supports commodity contract payment matching for grain, livestock, and produce contracts. Links to forward contracts, basis contracts, and hedge-to-arrive (HTA) arrangements.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS); CFTC Commodity Exchange Act; SAP S/4HANA SD Contract

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP Controlling (CO) cost center code associated with this payment allocation for internal management accounting and profitability analysis. Enables revenue attribution by farm unit, crop division, or livestock operation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Center Accounting; GAAP Management Accounting

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or username of the AR specialist or system process that created this payment allocation record. Required for SOX internal controls, audit trail, and segregation of duties compliance in financial operations.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 and 404; SAP S/4HANA FI User; Oracle NetSuite Created By

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payment allocation record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting per SOX financial controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 310; SAP S/4HANA FI Document Creation Timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the allocated amount (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD). Required for multi-currency agricultural commodity trading and international supply chain billing.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: deduction_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of deductions taken by the payer against the invoice, such as quality dockage, moisture penalties, freight charges, or promotional allowances. Distinct from discount_taken_amount as deductions are typically disputed or contractually defined adjustments in commodity billing.
attributes.references: USDA GIPSA Grain Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD Deduction; Oracle NetSuite Deduction Amount

attributes.name: deduction_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the reason for any deduction taken by the payer against the invoice amount (e.g., quality deduction, moisture dockage, freight deduction, promotional allowance). Common in agricultural commodity billing where buyers deduct for grade, moisture, or foreign material.
attributes.references: USDA GIPSA Grain Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD Deduction Reason; Oracle NetSuite Deduction Management

attributes.name: discount_due_date
attributes.description: The last date by which payment must be received to qualify for the early payment discount. Used to validate whether the early_payment_discount_amount was legitimately earned. Derived from invoice date and payment terms.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms; Oracle NetSuite Discount Date; GAAP ASC 606-10-32

attributes.name: discount_taken_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the trade or cash discount applied at the time of payment allocation. Represents the discount actually utilized by the payer, which may differ from the discount offered. Used in AR reconciliation and discount expense reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606-10-32; SAP S/4HANA FI Cash Discount; Oracle NetSuite Discount Applied

attributes.name: early_payment_discount_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the early payment discount earned by the payer for settling the invoice before the discount due date. Distinct from standard trade discounts; tied to payment terms such as 2/10 Net 30 common in agricultural supply chain billing.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310-10; SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms Discount; Oracle NetSuite Early Payment Discount

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign currency exchange rate applied to convert the transaction currency amount to the base/functional currency at the time of allocation. Sourced from the ERP system's daily exchange rate table. Required for IFRS 21 and GAAP ASC 830 compliance.
attributes.references: IFRS 21; GAAP ASC 830; SAP S/4HANA FI Exchange Rate; Oracle NetSuite Currency Exchange Rate

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The general ledger (GL) account code to which this payment allocation is posted for revenue recognition and AR clearing. Ensures proper accounting treatment per GAAP/IFRS chart of accounts. Sourced from SAP FI GL account determination or Oracle NetSuite account mapping.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA FI GL Account; Oracle NetSuite Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: is_intercompany
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment allocation is between entities within the same corporate group (intercompany transaction). Required for intercompany elimination in consolidated financial statements per GAAP ASC 810 and IFRS 10.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 810 Consolidation; IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; SAP S/4HANA FI Intercompany

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payment allocation record was most recently modified. Tracks changes to allocation status, amounts, or reconciliation state. Required for data lineage and SOX audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA FI Change Document; Oracle NetSuite Last Modified Date

attributes.name: netting_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the intercompany or counterparty netting arrangement when allocation_type is 'netting'. Used in agricultural supply chain scenarios where a company is both buyer and seller to the same counterparty (e.g., grain merchandiser netting payables against receivables).
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 210-20 Offsetting; IFRS 32 Financial Instruments Presentation; SAP S/4HANA FI Netting

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by the AR specialist regarding this payment allocation. May include details about partial payment agreements, dispute resolutions, weight-ticket discrepancies, or special handling instructions for seasonal payment arrangements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Text; Oracle NetSuite Memo

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting period posting date for this allocation in the general ledger (GL). May differ from the allocation date when period-end adjustments are made. Determines the fiscal period for revenue recognition and AR aging per GAAP/IFRS.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Date; Oracle NetSuite Posting Period

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: SAP Controlling (CO) profit center code for segment reporting and profitability analysis by business unit (e.g., crop division, livestock division, agri-supply). Supports EBITDA reporting by agricultural business segment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Profit Center Accounting; IFRS 8 Operating Segments; GAAP ASC 280

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of the bank reconciliation matching for this allocation: unreconciled (not yet matched to bank statement), matched (confirmed against bank statement), partially_matched (partial bank confirmation), exception (discrepancy requiring investigation), cleared (fully reconciled and closed). Essential for month-end close and cash management in agricultural operations.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310; SAP S/4HANA FI Bank Reconciliation; Oracle NetSuite Bank Reconciliation

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date on which this payment allocation was reversed. Populated only when allocation_status is 'reversed'. Used for AR aging recalculation and audit trail documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Reversal Date; Oracle NetSuite Void Date; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for reversing this payment allocation (e.g., returned check, bank rejection, incorrect application, duplicate payment). Populated only when allocation_status is 'reversed'. Required for audit trail and AR dispute management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Reversal Reason; Oracle NetSuite Void Reason; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The bank value date on which funds were credited or debited, used for cash flow reporting and bank reconciliation. May differ from the posting date in agricultural cooperative payment cycles and commodity settlement workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Value Date; Oracle NetSuite Bank Value Date; IFRS 9

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: Difference between the invoice amount and the payment allocated, representing unresolved discrepancies such as pricing disputes, weight-ticket measurement differences, or deduction claims. Positive value indicates underpayment; negative indicates overpayment. Critical for weight-ticket settlement reconciliation in grain and commodity billing.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA FI Residual Item; Oracle NetSuite Payment Variance

attributes.name: weight_ticket_number
attributes.description: Reference to the grain elevator or commodity scale weight ticket associated with this payment allocation. Critical for weight-ticket settlement reconciliation in grain, oilseed, and commodity billing workflows where payment is based on net weight delivered.
attributes.references: USDA Grain Inspection Packers and Stockyards Administration (GIPSA); SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Receipt; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: write_off_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount of the invoice balance written off as uncollectable or as an approved variance adjustment. Used in bad debt management, small balance write-offs, and weight-ticket variance clearance in commodity billing workflows.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310-10-35; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; SAP S/4HANA FI Write-Off; Oracle NetSuite Bad Debt Write-Off

products.name: credit_memo

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: field_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating field or farm unit from which the commodity was harvested. Enables field-level yield reconciliation, COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) compliance, and precision agriculture analytics linking weight tickets to yield records.
attributes.references: USDA COOL Regulations; FSMA Traceability Rule; GLOBALG.A.P. Standard

attributes.name: grading_standard_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.grading_standard. Business justification: Weight tickets record the USDA grade assigned at commodity intake — this grade directly determines price adjustments and settlement amounts. A grading_standard_id FK normalizes the denormalized usda_g
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: inspection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.inspection. Business justification: Weight tickets in grain receiving are paired with USDA or third-party quality inspections. weight_ticket.inspection_certificate_number is a denormalized text field; a FK to inspection_id enables prope
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: inspection_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.inspection_record. Business justification: Commodity receipt inspection and settlement: grain/commodity weight tickets in agriculture are issued alongside official inspection records that verify grade, moisture, and quality parameters used for
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: inventory_goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.goods_receipt. Business justification: Grain settlement reconciliation: weight tickets are the scale document for commodity delivery; linking to goods_receipt enables FSMA lot traceability, GRN-to-ticket matching for AP settlement, and inv
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: lot_trace_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.lot_trace. Business justification: FSMA requires lot-level traceability from field to scale to invoice. Linking weight_ticket to lot_trace connects the physical weighing event to the traceable lot record, enabling lot-level settlement
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: research_variety_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.variety. Business justification: Identity-preserved grain receiving requires variety tracking on weight tickets — non-GMO, organic, or IP-protected varieties must be segregated and documented at point of delivery. Weight ticket → var
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.shipment. Business justification: In ag grain operations, weight tickets are generated for inbound truck deliveries that correspond to shipment records. Linking weight_ticket to shipment supports shipment-to-settlement reconciliation,
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: trailer_asset_id
attributes.description: License plate number or fleet identifier of the trailer carrying the commodity. Separate from truck ID as trailers may be interchanged. Used for tare weight lookup and load traceability.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule; State Weights-and-Measures Regulations

attributes.name: trial_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.trial. Business justification: Research trial harvests generate commercial weight tickets when foundation seed or trial grain is sold or transferred. Linking weight_ticket to trial enables research harvest settlement, trial cost ac
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: broken_kernels_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Broken Kernels and Foreign Material Percentage (BCFM)
attributes.description: Percentage of broken corn kernels and foreign material (BCFM) in a corn sample, as defined by USDA FGIS grading standards. A key grade factor for corn that drives price discounts and grade assignment.
attributes.references: USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards; 7 CFR Part 810

attributes.name: commodity_type
attributes.description: Broad classification of the commodity category. Drives applicable grading standards, inspection protocols, and settlement calculation rules (e.g., grain uses bushel-based pricing; livestock uses CWT-based pricing).
attributes.references: USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the weight ticket record was first created in the source system (SAP S/4HANA MM or Granular Farm Management). Used for audit trail and data lineage. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Reporting Controls; FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the settlement amount (e.g., USD for US Dollar). Required for multi-currency operations and IFRS financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS; GAAP

attributes.name: damage_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of grain kernels that are heat-damaged, mold-damaged, sprouted, or otherwise damaged as determined by USDA FGIS inspection. A primary grade factor affecting commodity grade assignment and price discounts.
attributes.references: USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards; 7 CFR Part 810

attributes.name: dockage_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the gross sample weight consisting of material other than the grain (weed seeds, chaff, straw, sand) that passes through a prescribed sieve. Deducted from net weight before pricing per USDA FGIS grading standards.
attributes.references: USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards; 7 CFR Part 810

attributes.name: driver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the truck driver delivering the commodity. Required for chain-of-custody documentation, FSMA traceability, and facility access records.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule; GDPR Article 4 (international operations); DOT Regulations

attributes.name: foreign_material_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the grain sample consisting of foreign material (non-grain matter that does not pass through the dockage sieve). A grade-determining factor per USDA FGIS standards that affects commodity grade and price discounts.
attributes.references: USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards; 7 CFR Part 810

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total certified scale weight of the loaded vehicle (truck/trailer plus commodity) in kilograms as recorded on the certified scale. Foundational quantity for net weight calculation per state weights-and-measures law.
attributes.references: State Weights-and-Measures Regulations; USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards; NIST Handbook 44

attributes.name: is_gmo
attributes.description: Indicates whether the commodity delivered on this weight ticket is derived from genetically modified organisms (GMO). Required for identity preservation programs, non-GMO certification, and international trade compliance (EU GMO labeling regulations).
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Biotechnology Regulations; EU GMO Labeling Regulation 1829/2003; GLOBALG.A.P. Standard

attributes.name: is_organic
attributes.description: Indicates whether the commodity is certified organic under the USDA National Organic Program (NOP). Drives premium pricing, segregated storage requirements, and organic certificate documentation requirements.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP); 7 CFR Part 205; GLOBALG.A.P. Standard

attributes.name: is_split_load
attributes.description: Indicates whether this weight ticket represents a split-load delivery where a single truck carries commodity from multiple fields, farms, or ownership lots. When True, multiple weight tickets may share the same truck/trailer ID and require proportional allocation.
attributes.references: USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: moisture_pct
attributes.description: Moisture content of the grain or oilseed sample expressed as a percentage of total weight, measured at time of delivery. Used to calculate moisture dockage/shrink adjustments to net weight and price per USDA FGIS grading standards. Null for livestock.
attributes.references: USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards; 7 CFR Part 810; AACC International Method 44-15A

attributes.name: net_weight_bu
attributes.description: Net commodity weight converted to bushels (BU) using USDA standard test weight per bushel for the specific commodity (e.g., 56 lbs/bu for corn, 60 lbs/bu for wheat). Used for grain pricing, settlement, and WASDE reporting. Null for livestock and cotton.
attributes.references: USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards; USDA WASDE; 7 CFR Part 800

attributes.name: net_weight_kg
attributes.description: Certified net commodity weight in kilograms, calculated as gross weight minus tare weight. This is the authoritative quantity used for invoice line reconciliation, settlement calculations, and USDA FGIS reporting. Stored as a certified value from the scale system.
attributes.references: USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards; State Weights-and-Measures Regulations; NIST Handbook 44

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for scale operator or receiving clerk notes regarding special conditions, quality observations, load discrepancies, or dispute details associated with this weight ticket. Supports exception handling and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: price_per_unit
attributes.description: Contracted or market price per unit of measure (per bushel for grain, per CWT for livestock, per pound for cotton) applied to this weight ticket for settlement calculation. Sourced from the applicable sales order or commodity contract.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing; DTN Market Data

attributes.name: price_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure to which the price per unit applies. BU = Bushel (grain); CWT = Hundredweight (livestock); MT = Metric Ton; LB = Pound (cotton); KG = Kilogram. Drives settlement amount calculation.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Purchase Order (PO) number from SAP S/4HANA MM or Oracle NetSuite against which this commodity delivery is being received. Enables three-way match (PO/GRN/Invoice) for AP processing and GAAP accrual accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Oracle NetSuite Procurement; GAAP; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: scale_datetime
attributes.description: The certified date and time the commodity was weighed on the certified scale. This is the principal business event timestamp and the authoritative quantity determination moment per state weights-and-measures law. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: State Weights-and-Measures Regulations; USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards

attributes.name: settlement_amount
attributes.description: Gross settlement amount payable to the vendor/grower for this weight ticket, calculated as adjusted net weight multiplied by price per unit before deductions. Represents the principal monetary value of this transaction for AR/AP reconciliation.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: tare_weight_kg
attributes.description: Certified scale weight of the empty vehicle (truck/trailer without commodity) in kilograms. Subtracted from gross weight to determine net commodity weight. May be captured on inbound or outbound weigh.
attributes.references: State Weights-and-Measures Regulations; USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards; NIST Handbook 44

attributes.name: test_weight_lbs_per_bu
attributes.description: Measured weight per bushel of the grain sample in pounds per bushel (lbs/bu), indicating grain density and quality. Used as a grade factor per USDA FGIS standards (e.g., minimum 56 lbs/bu for No. 2 Yellow Corn). Null for non-grain commodities.
attributes.references: USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards; 7 CFR Part 810; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service

attributes.name: ticket_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable certified scale ticket number assigned by the elevator or receiving facility. Used for reconciliation against invoice lines, grain settlement documents, and USDA FGIS inspection records. Unique within a facility.
attributes.references: USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards; State Weights-and-Measures Regulations; FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: ticket_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the weight ticket. 'draft' = captured but not yet certified; 'open' = certified and awaiting settlement; 'settled' = reconciled to an invoice line and payment; 'voided' = cancelled/corrected; 'disputed' = under quality or quantity dispute.
attributes.references: USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the weight ticket record. Tracks corrections, grade adjustments, or settlement status changes. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Financial Reporting Controls; USDA FGIS Grain Inspection Standards

products.name: billing_account
products.description: Accounts receivable account master for each billing customer entity, representing the financial relationship between the agricultural enterprise and its buyers. Captures AR account number, customer reference, credit limit amount, credit risk category (low/medium/high/watch), credit scoring basis, collateral type (crop lien, equipment lien, letter of credit, surety bond), collateral value, credit review date, credit hold status, credit hold reason, current balance, aging buckets (current/30/60/90/120+ days), payment terms code, currency, last payment date, average days to pay, dispute balance, and account manager. Integrates with SAP FI-AR subledger and Oracle NetSuite AR module.
products.reference: SAP FI-AR Customer Account / Oracle NetSuite AR Account

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Primary key for billing_account

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master customer entity in the CRM or ERP customer master. Links the AR billing account to the corresponding buyer record in Salesforce CRM or SAP SD customer master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce CRM; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: billing_customer_account_id
attributes.description: FK to customer.account

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Billing accounts (AR accounts) are maintained by a specific legal entity. In multi-entity agriculture operations, AR aging reports by legal entity, credit limit management by entity, and statutory AR
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal employee or sales representative responsible for managing this AR billing account relationship. Used for collections escalation routing and customer relationship management in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors; Salesforce CRM; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: payment_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to invoice.payment_term. Business justification: billing_account.payment_terms_code is a denormalized string reference to the payment_term reference table. The billing account master should FK to the authoritative payment_term record to enforce cons
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: account_close_date
attributes.description: Date on which the AR billing account was closed or deactivated. Null for active accounts. Used for account lifecycle reporting and historical AR analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Oracle NetSuite AR; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: account_open_date
attributes.description: Date on which the AR billing account was formally opened and activated in the AR subledger. Represents the effective start of the financial relationship between the agricultural enterprise and the buyer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Oracle NetSuite AR; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the AR billing account. 'active' indicates normal billing operations; 'on_hold' indicates credit hold applied; 'pending_review' indicates credit review in progress; 'closed' indicates account terminated.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Oracle NetSuite AR; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the billing account by customer category relevant to agricultural commerce. Drives applicable payment terms, tax treatment, and regulatory reporting (e.g., COOL, USDA export documentation).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; USDA COOL Regulations; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: aging_1_30_amount
attributes.description: Outstanding AR balance for invoices 1 to 30 days past due, expressed in the account currency. Used in AR aging reports for collections prioritization and expected credit loss provisioning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Oracle NetSuite AR; GAAP ASC 310; IFRS 9

attributes.name: aging_31_60_amount
attributes.description: Outstanding AR balance for invoices 31 to 60 days past due, expressed in the account currency. Elevated aging in this bucket may trigger credit review or collection escalation for agricultural buyers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Oracle NetSuite AR; GAAP ASC 310; IFRS 9

attributes.name: aging_61_90_amount
attributes.description: Outstanding AR balance for invoices 61 to 90 days past due, expressed in the account currency. Accounts in this bucket are typically escalated to senior credit management and may trigger collateral enforcement actions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Oracle NetSuite AR; GAAP ASC 310; IFRS 9

attributes.name: aging_91_120_amount
attributes.description: Outstanding AR balance for invoices 91 to 120 days past due, expressed in the account currency. Balances in this bucket are typically subject to formal demand letters and potential write-off evaluation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Oracle NetSuite AR; GAAP ASC 310; IFRS 9

attributes.name: aging_current_amount
attributes.description: Outstanding AR balance for invoices not yet past due (within current payment terms), expressed in the account currency. Part of the standard AR aging bucket analysis used for cash flow forecasting and credit management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Oracle NetSuite AR; GAAP ASC 310; IFRS 9

attributes.name: aging_over_120_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Aging Over 120 Days Past Due Amount
attributes.description: Outstanding AR balance for invoices more than 120 days past due, expressed in the account currency. Represents the highest-risk aging bucket; balances here are evaluated for bad debt write-off per GAAP ASC 310 and IFRS 9 ECL provisioning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Oracle NetSuite AR; GAAP ASC 310; IFRS 9 ECL

attributes.name: ar_account_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric AR account number assigned to the billing customer in the SAP FI-AR subledger or Oracle NetSuite AR module. Used on invoices, statements, and remittance advice for buyer identification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Oracle NetSuite AR; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: avg_days_to_pay
attributes.description: Rolling average number of days from invoice date to payment receipt for this AR account, calculated over the trailing 12-month period. Key KPI for credit risk assessment and payment behavior benchmarking in agricultural commodity sales.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Oracle NetSuite AR; GAAP ASC 310; IFRS 9

attributes.name: bank_account_ref
attributes.description: Masked or tokenized reference to the customer's bank account used for ACH or wire transfer payments. Full account details are stored in the payment vault; this field holds only the last 4 digits or a token for reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: PCI DSS; NACHA ACH Rules; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: billing_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the billing customer's invoicing address. Used on invoice documents, statements, and regulatory filings including USDA and FDA traceability records.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; FSMA Traceability Rule; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR

attributes.name: billing_city
attributes.description: City of the billing customer's invoicing address. Required for invoice generation, tax jurisdiction determination, and COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) compliance reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; USDA COOL Regulations; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR

attributes.name: billing_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the billing customer's invoicing address (e.g., 'USA', 'CAN', 'BRA'). Drives export documentation requirements, COOL labeling, and applicable tax/VAT treatment for international agricultural trade.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; USDA COOL; FDA; GAAP ASC 740; IFRS 21

attributes.name: billing_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the billing customer's invoicing address. Used for tax rate determination, geographic sales analysis, and invoice document generation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; GAAP ASC 740

attributes.name: billing_state_province
attributes.description: State or province of the billing customer's invoicing address. Used for tax jurisdiction determination, state-level agricultural regulatory reporting, and USDA program eligibility.
attributes.references: USDA; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; GAAP ASC 740

attributes.name: collateral_type
attributes.description: Type of collateral securing the AR account credit exposure. Agricultural-specific collateral types include crop liens (UCC Article 9 security interest in standing or harvested crops) and equipment liens. Drives credit limit and risk classification decisions.
attributes.references: UCC Article 9; USDA Farm Service Agency; GAAP ASC 310; IFRS 9

attributes.name: collateral_value
attributes.description: Appraised or estimated monetary value of the collateral securing the AR account, expressed in the account currency. Used in credit exposure calculations and expected credit loss (ECL) modeling per IFRS 9.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Expected Credit Loss; GAAP ASC 310; UCC Article 9

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this AR billing account record was first created in the data platform (Silver Layer). Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX internal control requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR

attributes.name: credit_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this AR account is currently under a credit hold, blocking new sales orders from being processed. When True, SAP SD order creation is blocked pending credit resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management; Oracle NetSuite AR

attributes.name: credit_hold_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the AR account is placed on credit hold. Supports credit management workflow and audit trail for SOX compliance. 'collateral_expired' is specific to agricultural crop lien or letter of credit expiry.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: credit_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding AR balance authorized for this billing account, expressed in the account currency. Enforced during sales order creation in SAP SD credit management. Reviewed periodically based on crop cycle seasonality and buyer financial health.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management; Oracle NetSuite AR; GAAP ASC 310; IFRS 9

attributes.name: credit_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled or last-completed date for periodic credit review of this AR account. Agricultural accounts are typically reviewed annually or after significant crop season events, commodity price swings, or weather-related losses.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; IFRS 9; GAAP ASC 310; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: credit_risk_category
attributes.description: Internal credit risk classification assigned to the billing account based on financial analysis, payment history, and market conditions. 'watch' indicates accounts under heightened monitoring due to commodity price volatility or crop failure risk.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; IFRS 9 Expected Credit Loss; GAAP ASC 310-10

attributes.name: credit_score
attributes.description: Numeric credit score assigned to the billing account based on payment history, financial statements, and agricultural market exposure. Used to determine credit limit and payment terms. Typically sourced from internal scoring model or third-party credit bureau.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Management; IFRS 9; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the AR account (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'BRL'). All monetary amounts on this account are denominated in this currency. Supports multi-currency agricultural export transactions.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI; Oracle NetSuite; IFRS 21

attributes.name: current_balance
attributes.description: Total outstanding accounts receivable balance for this billing account as of the last subledger posting date, expressed in the account currency. Represents the sum of all open invoice amounts net of payments and credit memos.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Oracle NetSuite AR; GAAP ASC 310; IFRS 9

attributes.name: dispute_balance
attributes.description: Total outstanding AR balance currently under formal dispute by the customer, expressed in the account currency. Disputed amounts are excluded from collections activity and tracked separately per GAAP revenue recognition guidance. Common in agricultural weight-ticket reconciliation disputes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Oracle NetSuite AR; GAAP ASC 606; IFRS 15

attributes.name: gl_reconciliation_account
attributes.description: SAP GL reconciliation account number to which this AR subledger account posts. Ensures the AR subledger balance reconciles to the GL trade receivables account per GAAP ASC 310 and SOX internal controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL; GAAP ASC 310; SOX Section 404; IFRS 9

attributes.name: last_payment_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount of the most recent payment received and posted against this AR account, in the account currency. Supports cash application reconciliation and payment pattern analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Oracle NetSuite AR; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent payment received and posted against this AR account. Used in collections analysis, average days to pay calculation, and credit risk monitoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Oracle NetSuite AR; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Preferred or contracted payment method for this AR account. 'commodity_offset' is an agricultural-specific method where payment is settled via commodity delivery or grain bank offset rather than cash.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Oracle NetSuite AR; NACHA ACH Rules

attributes.name: seasonal_terms_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this AR account is subject to seasonal payment terms aligned to agricultural harvest cycles (e.g., deferred payment until post-harvest). When True, standard payment terms are overridden by the seasonal schedule defined in the payment terms code.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; GAAP ASC 606; IFRS 15; USDA Farm Credit

attributes.name: tax_id_number
attributes.description: Federal or state tax identification number (EIN, TIN, or VAT number) for the billing customer entity. Required for 1099 reporting, USDA program payments, and international trade documentation.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; USDA FSA; GAAP; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this AR billing account record was last modified in the data platform. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change data capture, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR

products.name: payment_term
products.description: Reference master defining payment term configurations applicable to agricultural billing including standard net terms, seasonal deferred payment programs, and commodity-specific settlement schedules. Captures term code, term description, net days, discount days, early payment discount percentage, seasonal deferral rules (e.g., post-harvest payment windows), installment schedule flag, installment count, and applicable commodity types. Supports agricultural-specific terms such as deferred grain payment programs and livestock settlement windows.
products.reference: SAP FI Payment Terms / GAAP Revenue Recognition Terms

attributes.name: payment_term_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each payment term configuration record in the agricultural billing reference master.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606, IFRS 15

attributes.name: applicable_commodity_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of commodity categories to which this payment term is applicable (e.g., 'grain,oilseed', 'livestock', 'produce', 'all'). Supports commodity-specific settlement schedules such as deferred grain payment programs and livestock settlement windows. Null indicates applicability to all commodity types.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service, GAAP ASC 606, SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: applicable_company_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA company code(s) for which this payment term is valid. Comma-separated if applicable to multiple company codes. Null indicates applicability across all company codes. Supports multi-entity agricultural enterprise structures.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Configuration, GAAP, IFRS

attributes.name: applicable_customer_segment
attributes.description: Customer segment classification for which this payment term is designed. Allows differentiated term offerings for growers, cooperatives, distributors, and processors within the agricultural supply chain. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: all|grower|cooperative|distributor|processor|retailer|export — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Customer Segmentation, GAAP ASC 606, GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: applicable_sales_org
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA sales organization code(s) for which this payment term is valid. Comma-separated if applicable to multiple sales organizations. Null indicates global applicability across all sales organizations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Organization Configuration

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the finance or credit manager who approved this payment term configuration for use. Supports SOX internal controls over financial reporting and segregation of duties requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404, GAAP Internal Controls, SAP S/4HANA FI Authorization

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which this payment term configuration was formally approved by the authorized finance or credit manager. Supports SOX audit trail and change management documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404, GAAP Internal Controls

attributes.name: baseline_date_type
attributes.description: Defines the reference date from which net due days and discount days are calculated. Agricultural-specific options include weight_ticket_date (grain elevator settlements) and harvest_completion_date (post-harvest deferred programs). Maps to SAP S/4HANA payment term baseline date configuration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms Baseline Date, GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this payment term configuration record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, GAAP ASC 606, ISO 22000

attributes.name: credit_limit_required
attributes.description: Minimum approved credit limit (in functional currency) that a customer must hold to be eligible for this payment term. Supports credit risk management for extended or deferred agricultural payment programs. Null if no minimum credit limit is required.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Credit Management (FCV), GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which this payment term's monetary thresholds and discount calculations are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD). Supports multi-currency agricultural export transactions.
attributes.references: ISO 4217, IFRS 15, SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: deferral_max_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of calendar days that payment may be deferred from the invoice date under a seasonal deferral program, regardless of when the trigger event occurs. Caps the deferral window to manage credit exposure. Null when is_seasonal_deferral is false.
attributes.references: USDA Farm Service Agency, GAAP ASC 606, IFRS 15

attributes.name: deferral_trigger_event
attributes.description: The business event that triggers the start of the payment window for seasonally deferred terms. For example, 'harvest_completion' starts the net due days clock after crop harvest is recorded. Null when is_seasonal_deferral is false.
attributes.references: USDA Farm Service Agency, GAAP ASC 606 Revenue Recognition, Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: discount_days_1

attributes.name: discount_days_2
attributes.description: Number of days from the baseline date within which payment must be received to qualify for the second-tier early payment discount. Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA ZBD2T field. Null if no second discount tier applies.

attributes.name: discount_percent_1
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to the invoice amount if payment is received within discount_days_1. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0200 = 2%). Corresponds to SAP S/4HANA ZBD1P field. Null if no early payment discount applies.

attributes.name: discount_percent_2

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI ZBD2P, GAAP ASC 606 Variable Consideration, IFRS 15

attributes.name: dunning_procedure_code

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: erp_term_key

attributes.name: expiration_date

attributes.name: fsma_compliant
