attributes.name: original_event_revenue_recognition_id
attributes.description: For reversal or adjustment events, references the original revenue_recognition_event_id that is being reversed or corrected. Enables audit trail linkage between original recognition and its reversal/correction entries.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606, SOX, SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR)

attributes.name: performance_obligation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific performance obligation within the contract that this recognition event satisfies. Under ASC 606/IFRS 15, revenue is recognized when or as each performance obligation is satisfied.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 Step 2 (Identify Performance Obligations), IFRS 15 para 22-30

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.shipment. Business justification: Under ASC 606, ag revenue is recognized at shipment (FOB origin) or delivery (FOB destination) based on shipping terms. Linking revenue_recognition to shipment provides the shipment timestamp and term
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: bol_number
attributes.description: The Bill of Lading (BOL) number associated with the shipment that triggered this revenue recognition event. For FOB (Free On Board) shipping point contracts, the BOL date establishes the title transfer date and thus the revenue recognition date.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606, UCC Article 7 (Documents of Title), USDA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this revenue recognition event record was first created in the system. Audit trail field required for SOX compliance and data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX, GAAP, IFRS

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transaction currency in which recognized_amount, deferred_amount, and transaction_price are expressed (e.g., USD, EUR, BRL for Brazilian agricultural exports).
attributes.references: ISO 4217, IFRS, GAAP

attributes.name: deferred_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the transaction price that has been invoiced or received but not yet recognized as revenue, pending future performance obligation satisfaction. Recorded as a contract liability on the balance sheet. Common in multi-season crop contracts and prepaid input supply agreements.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 para 606-10-45-2, IFRS 15 para 105-106, IFRS

attributes.name: event_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for this recognition event (e.g., RRE-2024-000123). Used for audit trails, GL reconciliation, and cross-system referencing in SAP S/4HANA FI.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606, SAP S/4HANA FI Module, SOX

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign currency exchange rate applied to convert the transaction currency amount to the functional currency amount at the recognition event date. Expressed as units of functional currency per one unit of transaction currency.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 21, GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal year and period (YYYY-MM) to which this revenue recognition event is attributed for financial reporting. Determines the accounting period in which recognized revenue appears on the income statement. Aligned with SAP S/4HANA FI fiscal year variant.
attributes.references: GAAP, IFRS, SAP S/4HANA FI Module, SOX

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: The recognized revenue amount translated into the entity's functional currency (typically USD for US-based agricultural operations) using the exchange rate at the recognition event date. Required for consolidated financial reporting under IFRS IAS 21 and GAAP ASC 830.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 21, GAAP ASC 830, SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Translation

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The General Ledger account code to which the recognized revenue amount is posted in SAP S/4HANA FI. Determines the revenue line in the income statement (e.g., crop commodity revenue, livestock revenue, agri-service revenue). Critical for financial close and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: GAAP, IFRS, SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Module, SOX

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which the recognized revenue amount was posted to the General Ledger. May differ from recognition_event_date due to period-end close timing or late adjustments. Governs which fiscal period the revenue falls into.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606, IFRS 15, SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Module, SOX

attributes.name: gl_posting_reference
attributes.description: The document number or journal entry reference generated in the General Ledger system (SAP S/4HANA) when the revenue recognition amount was posted. Enables direct drill-through from the recognition event to the GL journal entry for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606, SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR), SOX

attributes.name: is_contract_modification
attributes.description: Indicates whether this revenue recognition event was triggered by or resulted from a contract modification (change order, price renegotiation, scope change). Contract modifications require reassessment of performance obligations and transaction price allocation under ASC 606/IFRS 15.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 para 606-10-25-10 through 606-10-25-13, IFRS 15 para 18-21

attributes.name: is_variable_consideration_constrained
attributes.description: Indicates whether the variable consideration estimate included in this recognition event has been constrained (i.e., limited to the amount highly probable of not resulting in a significant revenue reversal). Required disclosure under ASC 606 constraint guidance for agricultural price-variable contracts.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 para 606-10-32-11, IFRS 15 para 56-58

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, auditor comments, or explanatory notes related to this revenue recognition event. Used to document non-standard recognition scenarios, regulatory exceptions, or manual override justifications.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606, SOX audit documentation requirements

attributes.name: performance_obligation_satisfied_pct
attributes.description: For over-time revenue recognition, the cumulative percentage of the performance obligation satisfied as of this recognition event date. Expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00). Used to calculate the recognized amount for long-term contract farming, agronomy services, and multi-season supply agreements.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 para 606-10-25-31 through 606-10-25-37, IFRS 15 para 39-45

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: SAP CO profit center code to which this revenue recognition event is attributed. Enables profitability analysis by business unit, crop type, or geographic region within the agricultural enterprise.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module, GAAP, IFRS

attributes.name: recognition_event_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the revenue recognition event occurred — i.e., the date the performance obligation was satisfied and revenue became recognizable. For commodity sales, this is typically the title transfer date per the Bill of Lading (BOL) or weight ticket.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606, IFRS 15, USDA COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) regulations

attributes.name: recognition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the revenue recognition event. 'Pending' indicates awaiting trigger conditions; 'recognized' indicates revenue has been posted to GL; 'deferred' indicates revenue is held pending future obligation satisfaction; 'reversed' indicates a prior recognition has been corrected; 'cancelled' indicates the event was voided.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606, IFRS 15, SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Accounting

attributes.name: recognition_trigger
attributes.description: The specific business event or condition that triggered this revenue recognition event. Identifies whether recognition was triggered by physical delivery confirmation, legal title transfer (commodity), contract milestone completion, period-end proportional allocation, consignment sale by the buyer, or customer invoice acceptance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: delivery_confirmed|title_transfer|contract_milestone|period_end_allocation|consignment_sale|invoice_acceptance — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 para 606-10-25-30, IFRS 15 para 38

attributes.name: recognition_type
attributes.description: Classification of the revenue recognition method applied to this event. 'Point_in_time' applies to standard crop commodity deliveries; 'over_time' applies to long-term service or contract farming arrangements; 'bill_and_hold' applies where goods are invoiced but not yet shipped; 'consignment_release' applies when consigned agricultural goods are sold by the consignee; 'commodity_title_transfer' applies to grain elevator and commodity exchange transactions where title transfer timing governs recognition.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 para 606-10-25-27, IFRS 15 para 35-38, USDA commodity trading regulations

attributes.name: recognized_amount
attributes.description: The gross monetary amount of revenue recognized in this event, expressed in the transaction currency. For agricultural commodity sales, this reflects the agreed contract price multiplied by the delivered quantity (weight-ticket reconciled). Core financial metric for revenue reporting under ASC 606/IFRS 15.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 Step 5 (Recognize Revenue), IFRS 15 para 46, IFRS

attributes.name: revenue_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the revenue type being recognized. Enables disaggregated revenue reporting required under ASC 606 and IFRS 15 disclosure requirements. Categories reflect the primary agricultural revenue streams: crop commodity sales, livestock sales, agricultural services (custom farming, agronomy), input supply (seed, fertilizer, chemicals), and land lease/rental income.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 para 606-10-50-5 (Disaggregation of Revenue), IFRS 15 para 114-115

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Descriptive reason code or narrative explaining why a previously recognized revenue event was reversed. Applicable when recognition_status is 'reversed'. Common reasons in agriculture include: contract cancellation, commodity rejection at delivery, quality dispute, weight-ticket discrepancy, or price renegotiation.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606, IFRS 15, SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Accounting, SOX

attributes.name: sales_order_reference
attributes.description: The Sales Order (SO) number from SAP S/4HANA SD module that originated the revenue stream for this recognition event. Provides traceability from the customer order through invoicing to revenue recognition.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module, GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: shipping_terms
attributes.description: The shipping/delivery terms (Incoterms) governing when title and risk of loss transfer from seller to buyer. Directly determines the point-in-time at which revenue recognition criteria are met. FOB (Free On Board) shipping point means recognition at shipment; FOB destination means recognition at delivery. Critical for agricultural commodity export transactions.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606, Incoterms 2020 (ICC), USDA export regulations

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that originated this revenue recognition event. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer. SAP S/4HANA Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR) is the primary source for enterprise agricultural operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Accounting and Reporting (RAR), Oracle NetSuite, Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: transaction_price
attributes.description: The total transaction price allocated to this performance obligation as determined under ASC 606 Step 3 (Determine Transaction Price). Includes fixed consideration and any variable consideration estimates. For commodity contracts, reflects the agreed price per unit multiplied by contracted quantity.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 Step 3, IFRS 15 para 47-72

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this revenue recognition event record was last modified. Tracks adjustments, status changes, and corrections to the recognition event for audit trail and SOX compliance purposes.
attributes.references: SOX, GAAP, IFRS

attributes.name: variable_consideration_estimate
attributes.description: The estimated amount of variable consideration included in the transaction price for this recognition event. Variable consideration in agriculture includes price adjustments for commodity grade/quality premiums or discounts, volume rebates, weather-contingent pricing, and harvest yield-based true-ups. Constrained to the amount that is highly probable of not reversing per ASC 606 constraint guidance.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 para 606-10-32-5 through 606-10-32-9, IFRS 15 para 50-59

attributes.name: weight_ticket_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the weight ticket number used to reconcile the delivered quantity of agricultural commodities (grain, produce, livestock) against the invoiced quantity. Weight-ticket reconciliation is a critical agricultural-specific step in confirming the quantity basis for revenue recognition.
attributes.references: USDA Grain Standards Act, GAAP ASC 606 Step 4 (Allocate Transaction Price)

products.name: billing_schedule
products.description: Defines recurring or milestone-based billing schedules for long-term agricultural contracts including grain storage agreements, crop input supply contracts, and livestock management service agreements. Captures schedule code, billing frequency (weekly/monthly/quarterly/seasonal/milestone), next billing date, billing amount or formula, contract reference, commodity reference, billing start date, billing end date, auto-invoice flag, and schedule status. Supports seasonal billing cycles aligned with crop harvest and livestock production calendars.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this billing schedule was formally approved and authorized for use. Supports audit trail and financial controls compliance.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether each billing run under this schedule requires explicit management approval before the invoice is released to the customer. Supports internal controls and SOX compliance for material agricultural contracts.

attributes.description: Indicates whether invoices are automatically generated and posted when the billing date or milestone is reached (True), or whether manual review and approval is required before invoice creation (False).

attributes.name: billing_amount
attributes.description: Fixed monetary amount to be invoiced per billing cycle. Used when the billing amount is predetermined (e.g., fixed storage fee per month). Null when billing_formula is used instead for variable or commodity-based pricing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP; IFRS 15

attributes.name: billing_day_of_month
attributes.description: Day of the month (1–31) on which recurring invoices are generated for monthly or quarterly schedules. For example, a value of 1 means invoices are generated on the first of each billing period month.

attributes.name: billing_formula
attributes.description: Expression or formula used to calculate the invoice amount dynamically, supporting commodity-based pricing (e.g., 'quantity_mt * market_price_per_mt', 'weight_cwt * rate_per_cwt'). Used when billing_amount is not fixed. Supports NPK input pricing, weight-ticket reconciliation, and variable rate billing.

attributes.name: billing_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which invoices are generated under this schedule. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: weekly|monthly|quarterly|semi_annual|annual|seasonal|milestone — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Granular Farm Management; IFRS 15

attributes.name: billing_month_of_year
attributes.description: Month of the year (1–12) on which annual or seasonal invoices are generated. Supports crop harvest calendar alignment (e.g., month 10 for fall harvest billing) and livestock production cycle billing.

attributes.name: billing_tolerance_days
attributes.description: Number of days before or after the scheduled billing date within which invoice generation is still considered on-schedule. Accommodates agricultural operational variability such as harvest delays or weather-related disruptions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: completed_occurrences
attributes.description: Count of billing events that have been successfully executed (invoices generated and posted) under this schedule to date. Used to track schedule progress and remaining billing obligations.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP cost center code associated with the billing schedule for internal cost allocation and profitability analysis across agricultural business units (e.g., crop division, livestock division).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this billing schedule record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial reporting controls.
attributes.references: SOX; GAAP; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the billing amount (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD). Supports multi-currency agricultural trade and international commodity contracts.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS; GAAP

attributes.name: discount_percent
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to the billing amount for each invoice generated under this schedule. Supports volume-based, seasonal, or contractual discount arrangements common in agricultural supply chain agreements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Oracle NetSuite; GAAP

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this billing schedule expires and no further invoices will be generated. Nullable for open-ended schedules. Aligns with contract expiry or crop season end.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS 15; GAAP

attributes.name: last_billed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent invoice was generated under this billing schedule. Used to track billing history and validate schedule adherence.

attributes.name: milestone_completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which the triggering milestone was confirmed as completed, authorizing invoice generation for milestone-based billing schedules.

attributes.name: milestone_description
attributes.description: Description of the agricultural business event or milestone that triggers invoice generation for milestone-type schedules (e.g., 'Harvest completion', 'Grain delivery to elevator', 'Livestock weaning', 'Crop input delivery confirmed').
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; IFRS 15 Performance Obligation

attributes.name: next_billing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the next invoice will be automatically generated or triggered under this schedule. Updated after each successful billing run.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Oracle NetSuite AR Module

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special instructions, or exceptions related to this billing schedule (e.g., 'Billing deferred pending USDA crop report', 'Weight-ticket reconciliation required before invoicing').
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: SAP profit center code for revenue attribution, enabling EBITDA and profitability reporting by agricultural segment (e.g., grain storage, crop inputs, livestock services).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_method
attributes.description: Method used to recognize revenue from invoices generated by this schedule per IFRS 15 / ASC 606 standards. 'point_in_time' for delivery-based recognition; 'over_time' for service contracts; 'milestone_based' for performance obligation completion; 'proportional' for percentage-of-completion.
attributes.references: IFRS 15; ASC 606; GAAP; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: schedule_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this billing schedule, used for cross-system reference and communication with customers and partners (e.g., BSCHED-2024-001).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Oracle NetSuite

attributes.name: schedule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the billing schedule (e.g., 'Annual Grain Storage Q1 Billing', 'Seasonal Crop Input Monthly Installment').
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the billing schedule. 'active' indicates invoices are being generated; 'suspended' indicates temporarily paused; 'completed' indicates all billing milestones fulfilled; 'cancelled' indicates terminated before completion; 'draft' indicates not yet activated.

attributes.name: schedule_type

'recurring' for time-based periodic billing; 'milestone' for event-triggered billing (e.g., harvest completion); 'one_time' for single-occurrence billing; 'seasonal' for crop or livestock production calendar-aligned billing.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this billing schedule originated (e.g., SAP S/4HANA FI, Oracle NetSuite, Granular Farm Management). Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Oracle NetSuite; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date on which this billing schedule becomes effective and the first billing cycle begins. Aligns with contract commencement or crop season start.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS 15; GAAP

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax classification code applied to invoices generated by this schedule, determining applicable tax rates and exemptions (e.g., agricultural tax exemptions, state sales tax codes). Integrates with SAP S/4HANA tax determination.

attributes.name: total_billing_occurrences

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.description: Numeric escalation level of the dunning notice indicating severity of the collections action. Level 1 = first reminder, Level 2 = second reminder, Level 3 = final notice, Level 4 = legal action referral. Aligns with SAP dunning levels 1–4.

attributes.name: dunning_level_description
attributes.description: Human-readable label corresponding to the dunning level: First Reminder, Second Reminder, Final Notice, or Legal Action. Used in customer-facing correspondence and collections reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Dunning; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: dunning_method
attributes.description: The communication channel used to deliver the dunning notice to the customer. Email = electronic delivery; Mail = postal letter; Phone = verbal notice; Legal = formal legal correspondence; Fax = facsimile; Portal = customer self-service portal notification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Dunning Configuration; GDPR Article 6 (lawful processing)

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the dunning notice was escalated to legal action or a third-party collections agency. Null if not yet escalated.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: escalation_status
attributes.description: Current escalation state of the dunning notice. Tracks whether the overdue account has been escalated beyond standard collections to legal counsel or a third-party collections agency. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Not Escalated|Pending Escalation|Escalated to Legal|Referred to Agency|Write-Off Initiated — promote to reference product]
attributes.value_regex: Not Escalated|Pending Escalation|Escalated to Legal|Referred to Agency|Write-Off Initiated
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; GAAP ASC 310; IFRS 9 Stage Classification

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign currency exchange rate applied to convert the overdue amount to functional currency at the time of dunning notice issuance.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 830; IFRS 9; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: interest_amount
attributes.description: Calculated interest or late payment charges levied on the overdue balance and included in this dunning notice, per the contractual payment terms. Applicable where agricultural supply contracts include late payment penalty clauses.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Interest Calculation; GAAP ASC 310; IFRS 9

attributes.name: is_dunning_blocked
attributes.description: Indicates whether further dunning actions are currently blocked for this customer account. True = dunning is blocked (e.g., due to dispute, payment plan, or seasonal deferral); False = dunning proceeds normally.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for collections officers to record additional context, customer communications, special circumstances (e.g., crop failure, weather event impacting payment), or follow-up actions related to this dunning notice.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: notice_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the dunning notice was formally issued and sent to the customer. Used as the reference date for response deadline calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR MHNK; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: notice_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable identifier for the dunning notice, used in customer correspondence and collections tracking. Format: DN-{YYYY}-{sequence}.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Dunning; GAAP ASC 310 Receivables

attributes.name: notice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the dunning notice. Draft = prepared but not sent; Issued = sent to customer; Responded = customer acknowledged or paid; Escalated = forwarded to legal/collections agency; Closed = resolved; Cancelled = voided.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; GAAP ASC 310; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: oldest_invoice_date
attributes.description: The invoice date of the oldest unpaid invoice included in this dunning notice. Used to determine the age of the oldest outstanding receivable and assess credit risk.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Aging Report; GAAP ASC 310; IFRS 9

attributes.name: overdue_amount
attributes.description: Total outstanding overdue balance included in this dunning notice, expressed in the transaction currency. Represents the sum of all past-due invoice amounts for the customer account at the time of notice issuance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; GAAP ASC 310; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: overdue_amount_functional
attributes.description: Total overdue balance converted to the company's functional currency (typically USD) using the exchange rate at the time of notice issuance. Required for consolidated AR reporting under GAAP/IFRS.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 830 Foreign Currency; IFRS 9; SAP S/4HANA FI-CO

attributes.name: payment_arrangement_date
attributes.description: The date on which a payment arrangement was formally agreed with the customer. Null if no arrangement has been established.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: payment_arrangement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal payment arrangement or installment plan has been agreed with the customer as a result of this dunning notice. True = arrangement in place; False = no arrangement. Supports seasonal agricultural buyer cash flow management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Payment Plan; GAAP ASC 310; IFRS 9

attributes.name: promised_payment_amount
attributes.description: The amount the customer has committed to paying by the promised payment date. May be less than the full overdue amount if a partial payment arrangement has been agreed.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Collections Management; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: promised_payment_date
attributes.description: The date by which the customer has committed to making payment as part of a payment promise or arrangement. Used to monitor promise-to-pay compliance for agricultural buyers with seasonal cash flow constraints.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Collections Management; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: response_deadline_date
attributes.description: The date by which the customer must respond or remit payment before the dunning notice escalates to the next level. Critical for seasonal agricultural buyers managing post-harvest cash flow.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Dunning; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this dunning notice originated. Supports data lineage and reconciliation across the agricultural enterprise.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Oracle NetSuite AR; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this dunning notice record was last modified. Audit trail field for tracking status changes, escalations, and customer response updates.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5; ISO 22000

products.name: price_basis
products.description: Reference table defining commodity pricing bases used in agricultural invoice calculations including futures-based pricing, basis contracts, spot pricing, and formula pricing. Captures basis code, commodity type (corn, soybeans, wheat, cotton, cattle, hogs), pricing method (CBOT futures, CME futures, spot market, DTN market data, WASDE-referenced), basis amount (premium/discount over futures), effective date, expiry date, delivery location, and applicable contract types. Essential for accurate commodity invoice pricing in grain and livestock billing.
products.reference: CBOT/CME Commodity Pricing / DTN Market Data / WASDE

attributes.name: price_basis_id
attributes.description: Primary key for price_basis

attributes.name: commodity_id

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: grading_standard_id

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: market_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.market_price. Business justification: A price basis record in grain trading references a specific market price source (exchange settlement, WASDE reference). Linking price_basis to market_price enables automated basis calculation, price f
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.material_master. Business justification: Commodity pricing configuration: price basis records define futures-based pricing for specific commodities; material_master is the authoritative commodity specification record (grade standards, moistu
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: sustainability_certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.sustainability_certification. Business justification: Price basis definitions for certified organic/sustainable premiums must reference the specific certification scheme (e.g., USDA Organic, ISCC) that governs the premium. price_basis has organic_certifi
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to weather.weather_zone. Business justification: Commodity price basis amounts vary by weather zone — drought risk, frost-free days, and climate classification directly influence basis levels at delivery locations. Grain merchandisers set zone-speci
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: applicable_contract_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of contract types for which this price basis is valid (e.g., 'basis_contract,hedge_to_arrive,forward_contract,spot_purchase'). Restricts the use of this basis record to appropriate contract contexts in invoice generation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: basis_contract|hedge_to_arrive|forward_contract|spot_purchase|deferred_payment|minimum_price — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA AMS Grain Contract Types; SAP S/4HANA SD Contract Categories

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the authorized person who approved this price basis record for use in invoice calculations. Required for SOX internal controls over financial reporting and GAAP revenue recognition governance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404 Internal Controls; GAAP Revenue Recognition ASC 606

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which this price basis record was formally approved for use. Required for SOX audit trail and financial reporting controls. Null if the record is in pending or draft status.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; GAAP ASC 606; SAP S/4HANA Approval Workflow

attributes.name: basis_amount
attributes.description: The premium or discount applied over or under the futures contract price to arrive at the cash price, expressed in the currency unit per unit of measure (e.g., -0.15 USD/bushel represents a 15-cent under basis for corn). Negative values indicate a discount below futures; positive values indicate a premium above futures.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Grain Basis Reporting; CME Group Basis Conventions

attributes.name: basis_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this price basis configuration (e.g., CORN-CBOT-DEC, SOY-CME-MAR). Used in contract references, invoice line items, and grain elevator systems to reference the applicable pricing basis.
attributes.references: CBOT/CME Exchange Conventions; SAP S/4HANA SD Condition Type

attributes.name: basis_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the basis amount is denominated (e.g., USD for US domestic grain markets, CAD for Canadian operations). Ensures correct currency handling in multi-currency agricultural operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: basis_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the price basis (e.g., 'December Corn CBOT Basis - Central Illinois'). Used in reports, invoices, and contract documents for clear identification of the pricing basis applied.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS) Grain Reporting

attributes.name: basis_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the price basis record. Active records are eligible for invoice pricing; inactive/expired records are retained for historical reference and audit; superseded records have been replaced by a newer basis version.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Condition Record Status; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this price basis record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides audit trail for record creation per SOX and GAAP financial reporting controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 606; ISO 8601

attributes.name: delivery_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the delivery location (e.g., USA, CAN, BRA). Required for international commodity contracts, COOL compliance, and cross-border agricultural trade reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; USDA COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) Regulations

attributes.name: delivery_state_province
attributes.description: Two-letter US state or Canadian province code for the delivery location (e.g., IL, IA, KS, NE). Used for regional basis analysis, USDA reporting, and state-level agricultural compliance.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Regional Grain Reporting; COOL (Country of Origin Labeling)

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The calendar date from which this price basis record becomes active and eligible for use in invoice calculations. Basis records are date-sensitive as commodity basis levels change with market conditions and seasonal patterns.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; SAP S/4HANA Pricing Condition Validity

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The calendar date after which this price basis record is no longer valid for new invoice calculations. Null indicates an open-ended basis with no defined expiration. Aligns with futures contract expiration cycles and seasonal marketing periods.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 Revenue Recognition; CME Group Contract Expiration Calendar

attributes.name: formula_expression
attributes.description: For formula-based pricing methods, the mathematical expression or rule used to calculate the final price (e.g., 'CBOT_CLOSE + BASIS + FREIGHT_ALLOWANCE - MOISTURE_DISCOUNT'). Null for non-formula pricing methods. Stored as a string expression interpreted by the pricing engine.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Procedure; GAAP Revenue Recognition ASC 606

attributes.name: freight_allowance
attributes.description: The freight cost component embedded in or deducted from the basis amount, expressed per unit of measure. Represents the transportation cost from the delivery location to the terminal market or export elevator. Used in FOB vs. CIF pricing reconciliation.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Grain Transportation Reports; Incoterms FOB/CIF

attributes.name: futures_contract_month
attributes.description: The specific futures contract delivery month and year used as the pricing reference (e.g., DEC-2025, MAR-2026). Critical for grain and livestock invoice pricing to identify which futures contract price is applied in basis calculations.
attributes.references: CBOT/CME Futures Contract Month Codes; USDA WASDE

attributes.name: futures_exchange
attributes.description: The futures exchange whose contract price is used as the reference price for this basis (e.g., CBOT for corn/soybeans/wheat, CME for cattle/hogs, ICE for cotton). Null for spot_market or flat_price methods.
attributes.references: CME Group Exchange Designations; CBOT Contract Specifications

attributes.name: gmo_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this price basis applies to GMO commodity (True) or non-GMO/identity-preserved commodity (False). Non-GMO commodities typically command a premium basis over standard GMO commodity prices, requiring separate basis records.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP); GLOBALG.A.P. GMO Traceability; FDA Bioengineered Food Disclosure

attributes.name: handling_charge
attributes.description: The per-unit elevator or handling fee included in or deducted from the basis calculation (e.g., 0.02 USD/BU for grain elevator handling). Represents the cost of receiving, storing, and loading grain at the delivery location.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Grain Storage and Handling Rates; SAP S/4HANA SD Condition Type

attributes.name: max_quantity
attributes.description: The maximum commodity quantity (in the specified unit of measure) for which this basis applies. Basis records may be quantity-banded for volume pricing tiers. Null indicates no maximum quantity restriction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Scale Conditions; USDA AMS Contract Terms

attributes.name: min_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum commodity quantity (in the specified unit of measure) required for this basis to apply. Basis levels may differ for small lots vs. full truckload or barge quantities. Null indicates no minimum quantity restriction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing Scale Conditions; USDA AMS Contract Minimums

attributes.name: moisture_adjustment_rate
attributes.description: The per-unit price adjustment applied per percentage point of moisture above or below the standard moisture level (e.g., -0.0035 USD/BU per 1% moisture above 15.5% for corn). Used in weight-ticket reconciliation and invoice adjustments for grain quality discounts.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Grain Inspection Standards; FGIS (Federal Grain Inspection Service) Moisture Tables

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special conditions, or exceptions associated with this price basis record (e.g., 'Applies only to identity-preserved white corn', 'Subject to CBOT limit move provisions'). Supports operational transparency and audit documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Condition Record Text; GAAP Documentation Requirements

attributes.name: organic_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this price basis applies to USDA-certified organic commodity (True) or conventional commodity (False). Organic commodities command significant basis premiums and require separate pricing basis records for accurate invoice generation.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) 7 CFR Part 205; GLOBALG.A.P. Organic Certification

attributes.name: price_ceiling
attributes.description: The maximum cash price per unit of measure above which this basis will not result in an invoice price, regardless of futures movement. Null if no ceiling applies. Used in capped-price contract billing scenarios common in livestock and specialty crop markets.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Contract Price Cap Guidelines; GAAP ASC 606 Variable Consideration

attributes.name: price_floor
attributes.description: The minimum cash price per unit of measure below which this basis will not result in an invoice price, regardless of futures movement (e.g., minimum price guarantee in minimum-price contracts). Null if no floor applies. Used in minimum-price contract billing scenarios.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Minimum Price Contract Guidelines; GAAP ASC 606 Variable Consideration

attributes.name: pricing_method
attributes.description: The method used to determine the commodity price for invoice calculations. Options include: futures_basis (price = futures + basis), spot_market (current cash price), formula (custom formula-driven), flat_price (fixed agreed price), basis_contract (basis locked, futures open), hedge_to_arrive (futures locked, basis open).
attributes.references: USDA AMS Grain Pricing Guidelines; CME Group Contract Specifications

attributes.name: seasonal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this price basis is seasonal in nature (True) or applies year-round (False). Seasonal bases are common in grain marketing where harvest-time basis levels differ significantly from pre-harvest or post-harvest periods.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Seasonal Grain Marketing Guidelines; Granular Farm Management Financial Planning

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The originating operational system from which this price basis record was sourced (e.g., SAP_SD for SAP S/4HANA Sales & Distribution pricing conditions, GRANULAR for Granular Farm Management, DTN for DTN market data feed). Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Granular Farm Management; DTN Market Data

attributes.name: standard_moisture_pct
attributes.description: The reference moisture percentage at which no moisture adjustment is applied (e.g., 15.5% for corn, 13.0% for soybeans). Moisture readings from weight tickets above this level trigger discounts; below may trigger premiums per the moisture_adjustment_rate.
attributes.references: USDA FGIS Official Grain Standards; CBOT Contract Specifications

attributes.name: standard_test_weight_lbs
attributes.description: The reference test weight in pounds per bushel at which no test weight adjustment is applied (e.g., 56 lbs/BU for corn, 60 lbs/BU for soybeans, 60 lbs/BU for wheat). Deviations from this standard trigger price adjustments per test_weight_adjustment_rate.
attributes.references: USDA FGIS Official Grain Standards; CBOT Contract Specifications

attributes.name: test_weight_adjustment_rate
attributes.description: The per-unit price adjustment applied per pound below the standard test weight (e.g., -0.01 USD/BU per pound below 56 lbs/BU for corn). Test weight is a key quality factor in grain pricing that affects invoice amounts.
attributes.references: USDA FGIS Official Grain Standards; CBOT Contract Specifications

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure against which the basis amount is applied (e.g., BU for bushel in grain, CWT for hundredweight in livestock, MT for metric ton in export contracts). Aligns with USDA and exchange standard units for the commodity type. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BU|CWT|MT|LB|TON|KG|OZ — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service UOM Standards; CBOT Contract Specifications

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this price basis record was last modified, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking, data lineage, and incremental load processing in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 606; ISO 8601

Common in agricultural commodity markets where buyers secure supply through advance payment programs.

attributes.name: advance_amount
attributes.description: Gross amount of the advance payment received from the agricultural buyer in the transaction currency. Represents the total prepayment before any application to invoices or deductions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Module; GAAP ASC 606; IFRS 15

attributes.name: advance_payment_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable business identifier for the advance payment. Used in customer communications, remittance advice matching, and AR reconciliation. Follows the format ADV-YYYY-NNNNNN.

attributes.name: advance_purpose
attributes.description: Business purpose classification for the advance payment describing the agricultural transaction it secures. Drives accounting treatment, revenue recognition timing, and reporting segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: crop_pre_purchase|seed_advance|input_supply_advance|storage_deposit|livestock_pre_purchase|freight_deposit|processing_advance — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; IFRS 15; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service

attributes.name: application_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the advance payment indicating how much of the advance has been applied against invoices. Drives AR aging, cash application workflows, and revenue recognition schedules. Valid values: unapplied (no invoices applied yet), partially_applied (some amount applied), fully_applied (entire advance consumed), cancelled (advance voided), refunded (advance returned to buyer).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Down Payment Clearing; GAAP ASC 606; IFRS 15

attributes.name: applied_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative amount of the advance payment that has been applied against one or more invoices to date. Derived from application events but stored for AR reporting and aging analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Clearing; GAAP ASC 606; IFRS 15

attributes.name: bank_reference_number
attributes.description: Bank-assigned transaction reference number for the advance payment wire transfer or ACH transaction. Used for bank statement reconciliation, payment tracing, and audit trail in treasury operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Bank Accounting; Oracle NetSuite Bank Reconciliation

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP Controlling (CO) cost center code for internal cost allocation of advance payment processing activities. Used in overhead allocation and operational cost reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Cost Center Accounting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the advance payment record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for record creation and supports SOX financial controls and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA FI Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: crop_year
attributes.description: The agricultural crop year (e.g., 2024) to which this advance payment is attributed. Crop year is the standard period for agricultural commodity accounting, contract settlement, and USDA reporting. Enables crop-year-based financial analysis and advance program reconciliation.
attributes.references: USDA WASDE Reporting; USDA Farm Service Agency; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the advance payment transaction currency (e.g., USD, EUR, BRL, CAD). Required for multi-currency agricultural commodity trading and international buyer settlements.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS 21; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Configuration

attributes.name: customer_reference_number
attributes.description: Buyer-provided reference number included with the advance payment remittance, such as the buyer's internal purchase order number or contract reference. Enables matching of incoming payments to buyer records and facilitates dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Remittance Matching; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign currency exchange rate applied at the time of advance payment receipt, expressed as units of transaction currency per one unit of functional currency. Used for functional currency conversion and FX gain/loss reporting per IFRS 21.
attributes.references: IFRS 21 - Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates; SAP S/4HANA FI Exchange Rate

attributes.name: expected_delivery_date
attributes.description: Anticipated date on which the commodity, seed, input supply, or agricultural service secured by this advance payment is expected to be delivered or completed. Drives revenue recognition scheduling, advance application planning, and contract performance monitoring.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606 - Revenue Recognition; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA SD Delivery Scheduling

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which the advance payment is no longer valid for application against invoices if not consumed. Relevant for seasonal agricultural advance programs where prepayments must be applied within a crop season or contract period.

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: Advance payment amount converted to the entity's functional currency (typically USD) using the exchange rate at receipt date. Required for consolidated financial reporting, GL posting, and GAAP/IFRS compliance.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger (GL) account code to which the advance payment liability is posted (typically a customer advance/deferred revenue account). Required for GAAP/IFRS financial reporting and balance sheet classification of advance receipts.

attributes.name: interest_accrued_amount
attributes.description: Total interest amount accrued on the advance payment from receipt date to current date or application date. Applicable when advance payment programs carry interest obligations per contract terms.

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: Annual interest rate (percentage) applicable to the advance payment if the agricultural buyer earns interest on prepaid funds or if the seller charges a financing fee on the advance. Common in large commodity pre-purchase programs and input supply financing arrangements.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 835 - Interest; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: is_intercompany
attributes.description: Indicates whether this advance payment is between two entities within the same agricultural enterprise group (intercompany transaction). Drives intercompany elimination in consolidated financial statements per IFRS 10 and GAAP ASC 810.
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; GAAP ASC 810; SAP S/4HANA FI Intercompany

attributes.name: issuing_entity_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the legal entity or company code within the agricultural enterprise that received the advance payment. Required for intercompany reconciliation, consolidated financial reporting, and multi-entity AR management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code; IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; SOX

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional business context, special instructions, or remarks related to the advance payment. May include buyer-specific terms, crop delivery conditions, or exception handling notes from the AR team.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Text; Oracle NetSuite Memo Field

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Financial instrument or mechanism used by the agricultural buyer to remit the advance payment. Drives bank reconciliation workflows and treasury management. Common in commodity markets: wire transfers for large advance purchases, letters of credit for international grain contracts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Methods; Oracle NetSuite AR

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: SAP Controlling (CO) profit center code associated with the advance payment for internal management reporting and profitability analysis by business unit, crop type, or geographic region.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Profit Center Accounting; GAAP Management Reporting

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which the advance payment funds were received and confirmed in the bank account. Used for cash flow reporting, interest calculations on advances, and GAAP/IFRS revenue recognition timing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module - Posting Date; GAAP ASC 230; IFRS 15

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the advance payment refunded to the agricultural buyer when the advance cannot be fully applied due to contract cancellation, crop failure, or delivery shortfall. Triggers AR credit memo and cash disbursement workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Credit Memo; GAAP ASC 606; IFRS 15

attributes.name: refund_date
attributes.description: Date on which the advance payment refund was issued to the agricultural buyer. Required for cash flow reporting, AR clearing, and buyer dispute resolution tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; GAAP ASC 230 Cash Flow Statements

attributes.name: sales_order_reference
attributes.description: Sales Order (SO) number associated with the advance payment, linking the prepayment to a specific commodity sales order in SAP S/4HANA SD. Enables order-level advance tracking and delivery-based application scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module - Sales Order; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service

attributes.name: seasonal_program_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific seasonal advance payment program under which this prepayment was received (e.g., spring planting advance, fall harvest pre-purchase program). Agricultural commodity markets commonly operate structured seasonal advance programs tied to crop calendars.
attributes.references: USDA Farm Service Agency; Granular Farm Management; SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this advance payment record originated. Supports data lineage, reconciliation between systems, and audit trail requirements. Valid values: SAP_S4HANA (primary ERP), ORACLE_NETSUITE (secondary ERP), GRANULAR (farm management), MANUAL (manual entry).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Oracle NetSuite; Granular Farm Management; SOX IT Controls

attributes.name: unapplied_amount
attributes.description: Remaining balance of the advance payment not yet applied to any invoice. Calculated as advance_amount minus applied_amount. Represents the outstanding liability to the buyer until delivery or service completion.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Module; GAAP ASC 606; IFRS 15

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the advance payment record. Supports change data capture (CDC) for the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline, audit trail requirements, and SOX financial controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA FI Audit Trail; Databricks Delta Lake CDC

attributes.name: weight_ticket_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the weight ticket number associated with the commodity delivery that this advance payment will be applied against. Weight tickets are the primary measurement document in grain and commodity trading for quantity verification and invoice reconciliation.
attributes.references: USDA Grain Inspection Packers and Stockyards Administration (GIPSA); SAP S/4HANA MM

products.name: write_off

Supports GAAP bad debt expense recognition and SOX-compliant write-off approval workflows.

attributes.name: account_id

attributes.name: ar_invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating invoice record being written off. Links to the invoice.invoice product for full invoice detail and reconciliation.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310-10; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer billing account against which the write-off is applied. Identifies the AR customer account in the general ledger.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Oracle NetSuite AR

attributes.business_glossary_term: Gl Posting Journal Entry Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Bad debt write-offs require GL postings (debit allowance for doubtful accounts, credit AR). In agriculture, write-offs for grain buyer defaults or input customer non-payment require specific GL entrie
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: invoice_dispute_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to invoice.dispute. Business justification: write_off.dispute_case_reference is a denormalized string reference to the dispute record. Bad debt write-offs in agricultural AR frequently follow failed dispute resolution. Normalizing to invoice_di
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: allowance_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Allowance for Doubtful Accounts GL Code
attributes.description: GL account code for the Allowance for Doubtful Accounts contra-asset account offset entry. Under the allowance method, the write-off reduces this account rather than directly expensing. Required for GAAP ASC 310-10 indirect write-off method.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310-10; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Gross monetary amount of the accounts receivable balance being written off in the transaction currency. Represents the uncollectable AR balance removed from the books.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310-10; IFRS 9; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR

attributes.name: amount_functional
attributes.description: Write-off amount converted to the company's functional (reporting) currency using the exchange rate at the time of write-off. Required for GAAP/IFRS financial statement reporting and GL posting.

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: Name or role identifier of the individual or committee that authorized the write-off per the SOX-compliant delegation of authority matrix. Required for audit trail and internal controls documentation.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the write-off was formally approved by the designated approval authority. Distinct from the write-off posting date; required for SOX segregation of duties and approval workflow audit trail.

attributes.name: approval_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical approval tier required and obtained for this write-off based on the amount threshold in the delegation of authority policy. Higher write-off amounts require escalation to senior financial officers per SOX controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Internal Audit Controls; GAAP

attributes.name: collection_agency_reference
attributes.description: External collection agency case or account reference number when the debt was referred to a third-party collection agency prior to write-off. Supports recovery tracking and agency fee reconciliation.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: SAP cost center code to which the bad debt expense is allocated for management accounting and OPEX reporting. Enables attribution of write-off costs to specific agricultural business units or regions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Center Accounting; GAAP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the write-off record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation marker required for SOX-compliant financial record keeping.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GAAP; ISO 8601

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transaction currency in which the write-off amount is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD). Supports multi-currency agricultural commodity trading operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; GAAP ASC 830; IFRS 21

attributes.name: customer_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the agricultural customer at the time of write-off. Captured as a denormalized field for audit trail integrity and historical reporting, as the customer record may change post-write-off.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 310-10

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign currency exchange rate applied to convert the write-off transaction amount to the functional currency at the time of write-off posting. Required for multi-currency AR reconciliation.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 830; IFRS 21; SAP S/4HANA FI Exchange Rate

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Accounting fiscal period (YYYY-PP format) in which the write-off is recognized for financial reporting. Aligns with the agricultural company's fiscal calendar for period-end close and GAAP/IFRS reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310-10; IFRS 9; SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year/Period

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: GL account code to which the bad debt expense is posted (typically the Bad Debt Expense or Allowance for Doubtful Accounts account). Required for GAAP revenue accounting and financial statement preparation.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310-10; IFRS 9; SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: Date on which the write-off journal entry was posted to the general ledger. Determines the accounting period for bad debt expense recognition per GAAP/IFRS period-end close requirements.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310-10; IFRS 9; SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Date

attributes.name: invoice_reference_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of invoice numbers included in this write-off transaction when multiple invoices are consolidated into a single write-off event. Supports AR aging reconciliation and audit trail. For single-invoice write-offs, contains the single invoice number.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310-10; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Clearing

attributes.name: is_tax_deductible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the write-off qualifies as a tax-deductible bad debt expense under applicable tax law. Drives tax provision calculations and deferred tax asset recognition.
attributes.references: IRS Revenue Ruling; GAAP ASC 740; IFRS IAS 12

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, legal counsel comments, or credit committee observations related to the write-off decision. Supports comprehensive audit documentation for SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 310-10

attributes.name: original_invoice_amount
attributes.description: Total face value of the original invoice(s) at the time of issuance before any partial payments or credits. Enables calculation of partial write-off percentage and supports credit risk analytics.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310-10; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR

attributes.name: partial_payment_applied
attributes.description: Total payments previously received and applied against the invoice(s) prior to the write-off. The net uncollectable balance equals original_invoice_amount minus partial_payment_applied.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310-10; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: SAP profit center code for segment-level P&L reporting of bad debt expense. Supports EBITDA analysis by agricultural business segment (e.g., crop inputs, livestock, grain trading).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Profit Center Accounting; IFRS 8 Segment Reporting

attributes.name: reason
attributes.description: Categorized business reason for the bad debt write-off. Agriculture-specific reasons include crop_failure_hardship (customer unable to pay due to crop loss event) and dispute_settlement (negotiated resolution). Required for GAAP bad debt expense classification and management reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bankruptcy|insolvency|crop_failure_hardship|dispute_settlement|statute_of_limitations|customer_deceased|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310-10; FSMA; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Reason Code

attributes.name: reason_detail
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context for the write-off reason. For crop failure hardship cases, may include crop type, affected season, and loss event reference. Supports audit documentation and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 310-10

attributes.name: recovered_amount
attributes.description: Total amount subsequently recovered from the customer after the write-off was posted. Populated when recovery_flag is True. Used to record bad debt recovery income and adjust net bad debt expense reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310-10; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR

attributes.name: recovery_date
attributes.description: Date on which the recovered amount was received from the customer. Used for period-accurate bad debt recovery income recognition and cash flow reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310-10; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR

attributes.name: recovery_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any subsequent recovery of the written-off amount has been initiated or received. When True, triggers monitoring of recovery transactions and potential reversal of bad debt expense per GAAP.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310-10; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR Recovery

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the write-off was reversed in the general ledger. Populated only when reversal_flag is True. Determines the accounting period for the reversal entry.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310-10; SAP S/4HANA FI Reversal

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this write-off has been reversed (e.g., due to subsequent full payment or erroneous posting). When True, the write-off_status should reflect 'reversed' and a reversal document reference should be present.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310-10; SAP S/4HANA FI Reversal Document

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which the write-off transaction originated. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation between ERP systems in multi-system agricultural enterprise environments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AR; Oracle NetSuite AR; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: tax_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated tax deduction or tax benefit amount associated with the bad debt write-off. Relevant for income tax reporting where bad debt deductions are allowable under applicable tax regulations.
attributes.references: IRS Revenue Ruling; GAAP ASC 740; IFRS IAS 12

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the write-off record. Tracks changes through the approval workflow and any post-posting amendments for SOX audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GAAP; ISO 8601

attributes.name: weight_ticket_reference
attributes.description: Weight ticket number associated with the commodity delivery underlying the written-off invoice. Supports weight-ticket-based AR reconciliation specific to grain elevator and commodity trading operations.
attributes.references: USDA Grain Standards Act; SAP S/4HANA MM; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: write_off_date
attributes.description: The business event date on which the bad debt write-off was formally executed and recognized. Used for GAAP bad debt expense recognition in the correct accounting period.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310-10; IFRS 9; SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Date

attributes.name: write_off_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for the write-off transaction. Used in audit trails, SOX compliance documentation, and GL posting references. Format: WO-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 310-10; SAP S/4HANA FI Document Number

attributes.name: write_off_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the write-off transaction within the SOX-compliant approval and GL posting workflow. Tracks progression from initial submission through approval, GL posting, and any subsequent reversal.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GAAP ASC 310-10; SAP S/4HANA FI-AR

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: opening_balance
