attributes.references: GAAP ASC 860-20, IFRS 9, SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: factoring_fee_rate_pct
attributes.description: The fee rate applied to the total invoice face amount to calculate the factoring fee. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.015000 = 1.5%). May be a flat rate or tiered based on invoice age, customer credit quality, or commodity type.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 860, Commercial Finance Association Standards

attributes.name: financing_institution_code
attributes.description: Internal or industry-standard code identifying the financing institution. Used for system integration, GL posting, and counterparty reporting. May correspond to a bank identifier code (BIC/SWIFT) or internal vendor code in SAP FI.
attributes.references: SWIFT BIC Standard, SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: financing_institution_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the financial institution (bank, factor, or special purpose vehicle) to which the receivables are sold or pledged. Critical for counterparty risk management and financial statement disclosure under GAAP ASC 860 derecognition assessment.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 860-10-50, IFRS 7 (Financial Instruments Disclosures)

attributes.name: financing_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned to the receivable financing arrangement, used for communication with the financing institution and internal tracking. Corresponds to the facility or transaction reference in SAP FI or Oracle NetSuite AR modules.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 860, IFRS 9

attributes.name: financing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the receivable financing transaction, tracking progression from initiation through settlement. Values: draft (being prepared), submitted (sent to institution), approved (institution confirmed), active (funds disbursed), settled (fully reconciled), cancelled (voided).
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 860, IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: financing_type
attributes.description: Classification of the receivable financing arrangement. Factoring involves outright sale of AR; invoice discounting retains collection responsibility; supply chain finance is buyer-led; asset-backed lending pledges AR as collateral; forfaiting is used for medium-term trade receivables. Common in agricultural commodity trading for seasonal cash flow management.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 860-10, IFRS 9, FASB ASU 2022-02

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code used to post the receivable financing transaction in the enterprise accounting system. Typically maps to a factored receivables or short-term financing liability account per the chart of accounts in SAP S/4HANA FI or Oracle NetSuite GL.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 860, IFRS 9, SAP S/4HANA FI Module, Oracle NetSuite GL

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: Date on which the receivable financing transaction is posted to the general ledger. May differ from disbursement_date due to period-end cut-off requirements. Critical for accurate period-end financial reporting and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 860, IFRS 9, SOX Section 404, SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: is_derecognized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the financed receivables have been removed from the agricultural enterprise balance sheet per GAAP ASC 860 or IFRS 9 derecognition criteria. True = receivables derecognized (off-balance-sheet); False = receivables remain on balance sheet (secured borrowing treatment).
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 860-20-40, IFRS 9 3.2.3, SOX Section 404

attributes.name: maturity_date
attributes.description: Date by which the underlying customer invoices are expected to be paid and the financing arrangement is expected to be fully settled. Used for aging analysis, liquidity forecasting, and monitoring of overdue financing positions.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 860, IFRS 9, Commercial Finance Association Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special conditions, or operational notes related to the receivable financing transaction. May include details about seasonal payment terms, commodity-specific conditions, or financing institution special requirements.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 860, Internal SOP

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer (invoice obligor) has been formally notified of the assignment or sale of their receivable to the financing institution. Notification is legally required in many jurisdictions for the assignment to be enforceable against the debtor. True = notification sent; False = not yet notified.
attributes.references: UCC Article 9 (Secured Transactions), IFRS 9 B3.2.1, GDPR Article 13

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: Profit center associated with the receivable financing transaction for segment reporting and profitability analysis. Enables attribution of financing costs to specific commodity trading or agricultural business segments.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 280 (Segment Reporting), IFRS 8, SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: recourse_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum monetary exposure retained by the agricultural enterprise under a partial recourse arrangement. Null for full recourse or without recourse transactions. Used for contingent liability disclosure in financial statements per GAAP ASC 460.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 460 (Guarantees), GAAP ASC 860-20, IFRS 9

attributes.name: recourse_type
attributes.description: Defines the credit risk allocation between the agricultural enterprise and the financing institution. Full recourse: enterprise bears all credit risk; partial recourse: shared risk up to a defined limit; without recourse: financing institution assumes all credit risk. Determines whether the receivable qualifies for derecognition under GAAP ASC 860 and IFRS 9.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 860-20-40, IFRS 9 B3.2.1, FASB ASU 2022-02

attributes.name: reserve_amount
attributes.description: Amount withheld by the financing institution as a reserve against potential dilution, disputes, or credit losses. Released to the agricultural enterprise upon confirmed customer payment. Equals total_invoice_face_amount minus advance_amount minus factoring_fee_amount.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 860-20, IFRS 9

attributes.name: reserve_released_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the withheld reserve that has been remitted back to the agricultural enterprise following confirmed customer payment collection by the financing institution. Supports reconciliation of the total financing cycle.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 860-20, IFRS 9

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the financing arrangement was fully settled, including remittance of reserve amounts and reconciliation of all fees. May differ from maturity_date if customers pay early or late. Null if not yet settled.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 860-20, IFRS 9

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Current status of the settlement process for this financing transaction. Tracks whether the financing institution has remitted reserve amounts back to the enterprise following customer payment collection. Overdue indicates maturity_date has passed without full settlement.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 860, IFRS 9, SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this receivable financing record originated. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail requirements. SAP S/4HANA FI and Oracle NetSuite are the primary source systems for AR financing transactions.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, GAAP ASC 860, SAP S/4HANA FI Module, Oracle NetSuite AR

attributes.name: total_invoice_face_amount
attributes.description: Aggregate face value of all AR invoices included in this financing transaction before any advance rate, fees, or deductions. Represents the gross receivables pool being financed. Used for GAAP ASC 860 derecognition and IFRS 9 impairment calculations.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 860-20, IFRS 9, SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this receivable financing record. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and data lineage requirements for financial reporting controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404, GAAP ASC 860, IFRS 9

attributes.name: parent_receivable_financing_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on receivable_financing (parent_receivable_financing_id)

domains.name: procurement
domains.description: Manages sourcing and purchasing of all agricultural inputs including seeds, fertilizers (NPK), crop protection chemicals (AI, MRL compliance), feed ingredients, fuel, parts, and operational supplies. Governs PO lifecycle, GRN processing, vendor qualification, contract terms (FOB, CIF), supplier performance, and spend analytics. Ensures SDS documentation and EPA/APHIS regulatory compliance for chemical and biological inputs. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA MM and Oracle NetSuite for AP processing.
domains.references: EPA Pesticide Standards, APHIS Import, SAP MM

products.name: vendor
products.description: Master record for all approved agricultural input suppliers and service providers including seed companies, fertilizer distributors, agrochemical suppliers, feed ingredient vendors, fuel suppliers, and equipment parts dealers. Captures vendor identity (tax ID, DUNS number), qualification lifecycle (pending, approved, conditional, suspended, disqualified), GLOBALG.A.P. and GFSI certification numbers and expiry dates, EPA/APHIS registration numbers, SDS documentation compliance flags, payment terms, FOB/CIF contract defaults, bank details, and SAP S/4HANA vendor master integration keys. Qualification attributes: qualification date, re-qualification due date, SQF/BRC/IFS certification status, FSMA SVCP compliance status, audit score, and approved input categories. Performance metrics (periodic): on-time delivery rate, fill rate, quality acceptance rate, invoice accuracy, regulatory compliance score, overall scorecard rating, and corrective action tracking. SSOT for supplier identity, qualification status, and performance within the procurement domain.
products.reference: SAP MM Vendor Master (LFA1/LFB1)

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the vendor master record in the procurement domain. Primary key for all vendor-related transactions and qualifications.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master (LFA1)

attributes.name: food_safety_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.food_safety_plan. Business justification: FSMA supply chain preventive controls require food manufacturers to verify that their suppliers have adequate food safety plans. Procurement vendor qualification must link to the vendor's food safety
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: license_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.license. Business justification: Vendor qualification for pesticide applicator or restricted-use pesticide suppliers requires verifying active pesticide applicator licenses. Procurement must link vendor records to compliance license
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: aphis_permit_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS) Permit Number
attributes.description: USDA APHIS permit number for vendors supplying regulated biological materials, plant propagation materials, or animal health products subject to APHIS import/movement controls.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS 7 CFR Part 330; APHIS Plant Protection Act; APHIS VS (Veterinary Services) permits

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: Vendor's bank account number used for electronic funds transfer (EFT) and ACH payment processing. Classified restricted due to PCI/financial data sensitivity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI LFBK (vendor bank details); PCI DSS financial data protection; SOX financial controls

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: ABA routing transit number identifying the vendor's financial institution for ACH and wire transfer payments. Classified restricted due to financial data sensitivity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI LFBK; Federal Reserve ABA routing number standard; PCI DSS; SOX AP controls

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the vendor's primary registered business address. Used for Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) compliance, import/export documentation, and FOB/CIF contract defaults.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; USDA COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) regulations; Codex Alimentarius import requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the vendor master record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial reporting controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM LFA1 creation date; SOX internal controls; ISO 22000 supplier record management

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the vendor's invoicing currency (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD). Used for AP invoice processing, FX conversion, and spend analytics.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA MM LFB1-WAERS; IFRS/GAAP foreign currency transaction standards

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit Dun & Bradstreet Data Universal Numbering System (DUNS) number uniquely identifying the vendor's legal entity globally. Used for supplier risk assessment, credit checks, and USDA/FDA supplier verification.
attributes.references: Dun & Bradstreet DUNS Standard; FSMA Supplier Verification (SVCP); USDA procurement requirements

attributes.name: epa_registration_number
attributes.description: EPA registration number for vendors supplying pesticides, herbicides, fungicides, or other regulated agrochemicals. Required under FIFRA (Federal Insecticide, Fungicide, and Rodenticide Act) for legal sale and distribution of crop protection products.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA registration; 40 CFR Part 152; APHIS import permit requirements for biological inputs

attributes.name: fill_rate
attributes.description: Percentage (0.00–100.00) of ordered quantity actually delivered by the vendor within the scorecard period. Measures supply reliability for critical agricultural inputs such as seeds, NPK fertilizers, and crop protection chemicals.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM vendor evaluation; procurement supply reliability KPI standards

attributes.name: fsma_svcp_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Supplier Verification Control Program (SVCP) Compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has been verified as compliant with FSMA Supplier Verification Control Program (SVCP) requirements under 21 CFR Part 1, Subpart L. Required for vendors supplying food-grade or food-contact agricultural inputs.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart L; FSMA Foreign Supplier Verification Program (FSVP)

attributes.name: gfsi_scheme
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI) Certification Scheme
attributes.description: GFSI-benchmarked food safety certification scheme held by the vendor (e.g., Safe Quality Food (SQF), British Retail Consortium (BRC), International Featured Standards (IFS), FSSC 22000). Determines eligibility for supplying food-contact or food-grade agricultural inputs.
attributes.references: GFSI benchmarking requirements; SQF Institute; BRC Global Standards; IFS Food Standard; ISO 22000

attributes.name: incoterm_default
attributes.description: Default International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) agreed with this vendor for shipment of agricultural inputs. Determines risk transfer point and freight cost responsibility. Free On Board (FOB) and Cost Insurance and Freight (CIF) are most common for bulk commodity inputs.
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP S/4HANA MM purchasing info record; USDA import/export logistics standards

attributes.name: invoice_accuracy_rate
attributes.description: Percentage (0.00–100.00) of vendor invoices that matched the corresponding PO and GRN without discrepancy within the scorecard period. Drives AP processing efficiency and three-way match success rate.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI three-way match (PO-GRN-Invoice); Oracle NetSuite AP invoice matching; GAAP AP controls

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recently completed vendor qualification or food safety audit. Used to determine audit currency and trigger re-audit scheduling.
attributes.references: FSMA SVCP audit frequency requirements; GLOBALG.A.P. annual audit cycle; SQF/BRC/IFS audit schedules

attributes.name: last_audit_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0.00–100.00) from the most recent vendor qualification audit. Reflects compliance with GAP, GMP, HACCP, and food safety standards. Scores below threshold trigger conditional status or disqualification.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. audit scoring methodology; SQF/BRC/IFS audit scoring; GFSI benchmarked audit criteria

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal registered name of the vendor organization as it appears on official government and tax documents. Used for contract execution, invoice matching, and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM LFA1-NAME1; IRS EIN registration; USDA supplier registration

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_rate
attributes.description: Percentage (0.00–100.00) of purchase orders delivered by the vendor on or before the confirmed delivery date within the current scorecard period. Key performance indicator (KPI) for vendor scorecard and contract renewal decisions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM vendor evaluation (ME61); GLOBALG.A.P. supply chain performance metrics; procurement KPI standards

attributes.name: open_corrective_actions
attributes.description: Count of open corrective action requests (CARs) issued to the vendor for quality, compliance, or delivery failures. Non-zero values may trigger conditional status or procurement holds pending resolution.
attributes.references: GFSI corrective action requirements; SQF/BRC/IFS non-conformance management; SAP S/4HANA QM notification management

attributes.name: overall_scorecard_rating
attributes.description: Composite vendor performance rating derived from on-time delivery, fill rate, quality acceptance, invoice accuracy, and regulatory compliance scores. Drives preferred vendor designation and contract renewal decisions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM vendor evaluation (ME61); GLOBALG.A.P. supplier performance standards; procurement scorecard best practices

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: SAP/NetSuite payment terms code defining the agreed payment schedule (e.g., NET30, NET60, 2/10NET30). Governs AP invoice due date calculation and early payment discount eligibility.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI LFB1-ZTERM; Oracle NetSuite AP payment terms; GAAP accounts payable standards

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Primary business email address for the vendor's account manager or procurement liaison. Used for PO transmission, GRN confirmations, and compliance correspondence.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4 (for international vendors); SAP S/4HANA MM LFA1 contact data

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary business telephone number for the vendor's procurement or account management contact. Includes country dialing code for international vendors.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4 (for international vendors); SAP S/4HANA MM LFA1-TELF1

attributes.name: qualification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the vendor was most recently granted approved or conditional qualification status following audit and documentation review.
attributes.references: FSMA SVCP; GLOBALG.A.P. certification audit cycle; SQF/BRC/IFS supplier qualification standards

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the vendor's qualification within the approved supplier program. Controls whether purchase orders may be issued. 'Conditional' indicates approval with restrictions (e.g., limited input categories or volume caps).
attributes.references: FSMA SVCP (Supplier Verification Control Program); GLOBALG.A.P. supplier qualification; GFSI approved supplier programs; SAP S/4HANA MM vendor blocking logic

attributes.name: quality_acceptance_rate
attributes.description: Percentage (0.00–100.00) of received goods that passed quality inspection (GRN quality check) without rejection or return within the scorecard period. Reflects vendor's adherence to COA specifications and MRL compliance for agrochemical inputs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM quality inspection results; HACCP incoming material acceptance criteria; MRL compliance per EPA/Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: regulatory_compliance_score
attributes.description: Composite score (0.00–100.00) reflecting the vendor's compliance with applicable regulatory requirements including EPA registration currency, APHIS permit validity, SDS documentation completeness, FSMA SVCP status, and MRL adherence.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA compliance; FSMA SVCP; APHIS permit requirements; OSHA HazCom SDS; Codex Alimentarius MRL standards

attributes.name: requalification_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the vendor must complete re-qualification activities (audit, documentation refresh, certification renewal) to maintain approved status. Triggers procurement alerts when approaching.
attributes.references: FSMA SVCP annual review requirements; GLOBALG.A.P. re-certification cycle; SQF/BRC/IFS periodic audit schedules

attributes.name: sap_vendor_account_group
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA MM vendor account group code (e.g., LIEF for standard suppliers, KRED for one-time vendors) controlling field selection, number ranges, and partner functions in the vendor master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM LFA1-KTOKK vendor account group configuration

attributes.name: scorecard_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the performance measurement period for which the current scorecard metrics (on-time delivery, fill rate, quality acceptance, invoice accuracy, regulatory compliance) were calculated.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM vendor evaluation period; procurement performance review cycle

attributes.name: sds_compliance_flag

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: Federal Employer Identification Number (EIN) or Tax Identification Number (TIN) assigned by the IRS. Required for 1099 reporting, AP processing, and regulatory compliance. Classified restricted due to sensitivity of tax identity data.
attributes.references: IRS EIN/TIN; SAP S/4HANA MM LFA1-STCD1; GAAP/IFRS AP compliance

attributes.name: trade_name

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the vendor master record. Used for change tracking, data synchronization between SAP S/4HANA and Oracle NetSuite, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM change document management; SOX internal controls; GDPR data accuracy requirements

attributes.name: vendor_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric business identifier assigned to the vendor in SAP S/4HANA MM and Oracle NetSuite for cross-system reference, purchase order creation, and AP processing.

products.name: purchase_order
products.description: Core transactional record representing a formal PO issued to a vendor for agricultural inputs including seeds, NPK fertilizers, crop protection chemicals, feed ingredients, fuel, spare parts, and operational supplies. Line items: material/SKU code, commodity description, quantity (BU, MT, CWT, or unit), unit of measure, agreed unit price, line total, requested delivery date, plant/storage location, crop season, lot tracking requirement flag, MRL compliance flag, PHI/REI requirements, and GMO status indicator. SSOT for all PO header and line-level data. Maps to SAP MM EKKO (header) and EKPO (item).

attributes.description: Current state of the PO approval workflow. Tracks whether the PO has passed through the required authorization levels per the procurement approval matrix. Distinct from po_status which tracks the overall PO lifecycle. Required for SOX internal controls and procurement governance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM release strategy (EKKO.FRGKE); SOX Section 302/404; GAAP authorization controls

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the individual who granted final approval for the purchase order per the procurement authorization matrix. Required for SOX audit trail and procurement governance documentation. Corresponds to SAP MM release strategy approver.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM release strategy; SOX Section 302/404 authorization controls

attributes.name: capex_opex_classification
attributes.description: Financial classification of the purchase order spend as Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) for long-lived assets (e.g., equipment parts, infrastructure) or Operational Expenditure (OPEX) for consumable agricultural inputs (seeds, fertilizers, chemicals, fuel). Drives GL account assignment and financial reporting under GAAP/IFRS.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360 (property plant and equipment); IFRS IAS 16; SAP CO cost element classification

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country of origin of the agricultural inputs being procured. Required for COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) compliance, USDA import documentation, tariff classification, and supply chain risk assessment.
attributes.references: USDA COOL (7 USC 1638); CBP 19 CFR Part 102 (country of origin rules); ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; APHIS import requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the purchase order record was first created in the source system (SAP MM or Oracle NetSuite). Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SLA measurement for PO processing cycle time. Corresponds to SAP MM EKKO.AEDAT (creation date) combined with creation time.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO.AEDAT; SOX audit trail requirements; GAAP record-keeping standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the PO transaction (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD). Determines the currency in which vendor invoices will be processed and AP liabilities recorded. Corresponds to SAP MM EKKO.WAERS.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO.WAERS; IFRS/GAAP foreign currency translation

attributes.name: epa_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this PO involves EPA-regulated materials such as registered pesticides, herbicides, fungicides, or other crop protection chemicals subject to EPA FIFRA registration requirements. Triggers SDS documentation requirements and MRL compliance review.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA (Federal Insecticide Fungicide and Rodenticide Act); EPA 40 CFR Part 152; APHIS import permit requirements

attributes.name: fsma_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this PO is subject to FSMA supply chain compliance requirements, including supplier verification, hazard analysis, and corrective action procedures under the Preventive Controls and Foreign Supplier Verification Program (FSVP) rules. True for food-contact agricultural inputs and feed ingredients.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA 21 CFR Part 117 (Preventive Controls); FDA FSMA 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart L (FSVP); GFSI supply chain standards

attributes.name: gmo_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agricultural inputs on this PO contain, are derived from, or are free of Genetically Modified Organisms (GMOs). Critical for identity preservation programs, USDA NOP organic certification compliance, COOL labeling, and customer supply chain transparency requirements.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) 7 CFR Part 205; USDA BE Disclosure Standard (AMS); EU GMO Regulation 1829/2003; GLOBALG.A.P. GMO traceability

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms 2020) code defining the delivery obligations, risk transfer point, and cost responsibilities between buyer and vendor. FOB and CIF are most common for bulk agricultural commodity inputs. Corresponds to SAP MM EKKO.INCO1. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO.INCO1; USDA import/export documentation; CBP trade compliance

attributes.name: incoterms_location
attributes.description: The named place or port associated with the Incoterms code (e.g., 'FOB Houston' or 'CIF Rotterdam'). Specifies the exact geographic point of risk and cost transfer. Corresponds to SAP MM EKKO.INCO2.
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO.INCO2; USDA export documentation

attributes.name: input_category
attributes.description: High-level category of agricultural inputs being procured on this PO. Drives spend analytics by input type, regulatory compliance routing (EPA/APHIS for crop protection chemicals, FSMA for feed ingredients), and budget allocation to OPEX vs CAPEX. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: seeds|fertilizers|crop_protection|feed_ingredients|fuel|spare_parts|operational_supplies|services — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA agricultural input classification; EPA pesticide registration categories; APHIS import categories; FSMA supply chain requirements

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the purchase order record in the source system. Tracks changes to PO terms, quantities, pricing, or status. Essential for incremental data pipeline processing and change data capture from SAP MM and Oracle NetSuite.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO change documents; SOX audit trail; GAAP record-keeping

attributes.name: lot_tracking_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether lot-level traceability is required for the inputs on this PO. When true, GRN processing must capture LOT numbers for each delivery. Mandatory for seeds (variety purity), crop protection chemicals (MRL compliance), and feed ingredients (FSMA traceability). Drives inventory.commodity_lot creation on receipt.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA traceability rule 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S; GLOBALG.A.P. traceability requirements; ISO 22000 traceability

attributes.name: net_po_value
attributes.description: Net total value of the purchase order after applying header-level discounts but before tax. Represents the actual procurement spend commitment for budget and OPEX/CAPEX reporting. Used in EBITDA and COGS analysis for agricultural input cost management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; GAAP COGS; IFRS IAS 2 inventory costing

attributes.name: netsuite_po_ref
attributes.description: Oracle NetSuite internal PO transaction reference number. Used for AP processing, vendor payment reconciliation, and GL posting in NetSuite. Enables cross-system traceability between SAP MM and NetSuite for dual-system procurement environments.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite Procurement module; GAAP AP documentation

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Vendor payment terms code defining the due date calculation and any early payment discount conditions (e.g., 'NET30', '2/10NET30'). Drives AP payment scheduling in Oracle NetSuite and cash flow forecasting. Corresponds to SAP MM EKKO.ZTERM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO.ZTERM; Oracle NetSuite AP terms; GAAP accounts payable

attributes.name: po_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the purchase order was formally issued to the vendor. This is the principal real-world event date for the PO transaction. Used for aging analysis, payment term calculation, and regulatory compliance documentation. Corresponds to SAP MM EKKO.BEDAT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO.BEDAT; GAAP invoice matching; FSMA traceability requirements

attributes.name: po_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional instructions, special handling requirements, or procurement-specific notes communicated to the vendor on this PO. May include PHI/REI compliance reminders for crop protection chemical orders, organic certification requirements, or special packaging instructions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO header text; GLOBALG.A.P. documentation requirements

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable PO number issued to the vendor. Corresponds to SAP MM EKKO.EBELN (purchasing document number) and Oracle NetSuite PO transaction number. Used on all vendor communications, GRN matching, and AP invoice reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO.EBELN; Oracle NetSuite PO; GAAP procurement documentation standards

attributes.name: po_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the purchase order. Tracks the PO from initial draft through approval, issuance to vendor, goods receipt, and final closure or cancellation. Drives workflow routing in SAP MM and AP processing in NetSuite. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|sent|partially_received|fully_received|closed|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO.STATU; Oracle NetSuite PO status; GAAP procurement controls

attributes.name: po_type
attributes.description: Classification of the purchase order by procurement mechanism. Standard POs are single-event purchases; blanket POs cover recurring supply agreements; contract releases draw against a master contract; emergency POs bypass standard approval for urgent agricultural inputs. Corresponds to SAP MM EKKO.BSART (purchasing document type).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO.BSART; GAAP procurement classification

attributes.name: requested_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date by which the buyer requests delivery of the ordered agricultural inputs at the specified plant or storage location. Used for supply chain planning, crop season alignment, and vendor on-time delivery KPI measurement. Corresponds to SAP MM EKKO.EINDT (delivery date at header level).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO.EINDT; GLOBALG.A.P. supply chain traceability

attributes.name: sap_mm_doc_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA MM purchasing document number from the EKKO table (EBELN field). 10-digit numeric identifier used for cross-system traceability between the Databricks Silver Layer and SAP MM. Enables drill-back to source ERP for AP processing and GRN matching.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM EKKO.EBELN

attributes.name: sds_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Safety Data Sheet (SDS) is required for the chemical or biological inputs on this PO per OSHA Hazard Communication Standard (HazCom). True for pesticides, fertilizers, fuels, and other hazardous agricultural chemicals. Triggers SDS documentation collection workflow.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 (HazCom/GHS); EPA FIFRA labeling requirements; APHIS biological material documentation

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applicable to the purchase order in the PO currency, including VAT, GST, or applicable sales/use tax on agricultural inputs. Required for AP invoice matching and tax liability reporting. Corresponds to SAP MM tax condition values.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM tax conditions; GAAP tax accounting; IRS agricultural input tax rules

attributes.name: total_po_value
attributes.description: Gross total value of the purchase order in the PO currency, representing the sum of all line item totals before any header-level discounts or taxes. Used for spend analytics, budget commitment tracking, and AP liability accrual. Corresponds to SAP MM EKKO total value.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; GAAP commitment accounting; IFRS IAS 37 provisions

products.name: procurement_goods_receipt
products.description: Goods Receipt Note (GRN) record capturing the physical receipt and inspection of agricultural inputs at farm, warehouse, feed mill, or processing facility. Header: GRN number, PO reference, vendor delivery note number, receiving location, receipt date/time, overall receipt status, and SAP MM goods movement document number (MIGO). Line items: received quantity vs. ordered quantity, unit of measure, accepted quantity, rejected quantity with rejection reason code, lot/batch number assigned, storage bin/silo assignment, quality inspection status, COA received flag, SDS on file flag, temperature at receipt (for biologicals, vaccines, and cold-chain feed ingredients), and temperature exceedance flag. SSOT for all GRN header and line-level data. Triggers AP invoice three-way match workflow and inventory update. Feeds quality inspection workflow for COA verification and MRL testing.
products.reference: SAP MM Goods Receipt / GRN (MIGO/MSEG)

attributes.name: procurement_goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the Goods Receipt Note (GRN) record in the procurement domain. Primary key for this Silver Layer data product. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module — MIGO Goods Receipt

attributes.name: agrochemical_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.agrochemical_product. Business justification: Goods receipts for agrochemicals verify the specific EPA-registered product received matches PO specification. Label verification, SDS confirmation, and EPA registration number matching are product-sp
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: Goods receipts for commodity inputs reference the commodity for grade verification, moisture testing, and MRL compliance at receipt. Commodity-level receipt reporting drives quality acceptance decisio
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: commodity_lot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.commodity_lot. Business justification: Every procurement GRN in agriculture creates or receives into a commodity lot for traceability. Linking procurement_goods_receipt to commodity_lot enables farm-to-table lot traceability, FSMA supplier

attributes.name: grading_standard_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.grading_standard. Business justification: Goods receipts for commodity inputs are inspected against the applicable USDA grading standard. The grading standard determines acceptance/rejection criteria and price settlement at receipt. Core to c
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: input_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.input_product. Business justification: Goods receipts for agricultural inputs reference the input product for quality inspection criteria, MRL testing requirements, and regulatory compliance verification at receipt. Core to FSMA and EPA co
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: inspection_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to quality.inspection. Business justification: Goods receipt in agriculture triggers a quality inspection (incoming material inspection). procurement_goods_receipt.quality_inspection_status is a denormalized status flag; a proper FK to quality.ins
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: inventory_goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.goods_receipt. Business justification: The procurement GRN and inventory goods_receipt represent the same physical receiving event from two domain perspectives. Linking them enables three-way match (PO-GRN-Invoice) reconciliation and inven
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master record for the agricultural input received (seed, fertilizer, crop protection chemical, feed ingredient, fuel, parts, or operational supply).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Master (MARA/MAKT); inventory.material_master

attributes.name: organic_compliance_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.organic_compliance_record. Business justification: Receiving organic-certified inputs requires verification against the organic compliance record confirming the input is on the approved materials list and the supplier's organic certification is curren
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating Purchase Order (PO) against which this Goods Receipt Note (GRN) is posted. Enables three-way match (PO–GRN–Invoice) in AP processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchase Order (EKKO/EKPO); Oracle NetSuite Procurement

attributes.name: receiver_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Goods receipts for agricultural inputs are performed by specific receiving employees. Linking to employee supports FSMA traceability requirements, quality inspection accountability, and labor producti
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: seed_variety_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.seed_variety. Business justification: Goods receipts for seed deliveries reference the variety for germination testing, purity verification, and lot tracking. Variety-level receipt quality control is mandatory for seed certification compl
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.shipment. Business justification: GRN creation in agriculture is triggered by physical shipment arrival. Linking procurement_goods_receipt→supply.shipment enables 3-way match automation (PO/shipment/invoice), cold chain breach investi
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the farm, warehouse, feed mill, or processing facility where the agricultural inputs were physically received.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Storage Location (T001L); Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: trade_compliance_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.trade_compliance_record. Business justification: Imported agricultural inputs received via GRN require trade compliance verification (APHIS phytosanitary, FDA prior notice, customs clearance). Links GRN to the trade compliance record confirming impo
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor/supplier who delivered the goods. Links to the vendor master record for supplier performance tracking and AP invoice matching.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Vendor Master (LFA1); GLOBALG.A.P. supplier qualification

attributes.name: weight_ticket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to invoice.weight_ticket. Business justification: In grain agriculture, the weight ticket IS the primary receiving document — GRN quantity and quality are determined by the weight ticket. Formalizing this FK enables grain receiving reconciliation, se
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: accepted_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the received agricultural input that passed quality inspection and was accepted into inventory. Triggers inventory update and AP invoice matching for the accepted portion.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM — Usage Decision; GLOBALG.A.P. input quality standards

attributes.name: bol_number
attributes.description: Bill of Lading (BOL) number from the carrier or freight forwarder accompanying the shipment. Used for logistics traceability, customs documentation, and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: FSMA Section 204 traceability; USDA AMS transportation documentation; BOL standard

attributes.name: coa_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Certificate of Analysis (COA) was received from the supplier with this delivery. Mandatory for fertilizers, crop protection chemicals, feed ingredients, and biologicals per GFSI and GLOBALG.A.P. requirements.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. IFA; GFSI; BRC Global Standards; SQF; ISO 22000

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country of origin of the received agricultural input. Required for COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) compliance and import documentation.
attributes.references: USDA COOL (7 USC 1638); ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; FSMA import traceability; CBP import regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the GRN record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and SOX financial reporting controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA MKPF-CPUDT

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the unit price and total receipt value fields (e.g., USD, EUR, BRL). Supports multi-currency procurement for international agricultural input sourcing.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS; SAP S/4HANA FI — Currency Key (WAERS)

attributes.name: gmo_status
attributes.description: GMO (Genetically Modified Organism) declaration status for the received agricultural input, particularly seeds and feed ingredients. Required for USDA NOP organic certification compliance and COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) documentation.
attributes.references: USDA NOP (7 CFR Part 205); USDA APHIS Biotechnology Regulations; EU GMO Regulation 1829/2003

attributes.name: grn_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable Goods Receipt Note (GRN) identifier assigned at time of receipt. Used in supplier communications, AP invoice matching, and audit trails. Format: GRN-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — MIGO Material Document; FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: incoterm_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) code governing the delivery and risk transfer for this shipment (e.g., FOB — Free On Board, CIF — Cost Insurance and Freight). Determines when title and risk pass to the buyer. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FOB|CIF|EXW|DAP|DDP|FCA|CFR|CPT|CIP|DAT — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP S/4HANA MM — Incoterms (INCO1); IFRS 15 revenue/cost recognition

attributes.name: input_category
attributes.description: Classification of the agricultural input type received. Drives downstream compliance workflows: SDS documentation for crop protection chemicals, COA verification for feed ingredients, cold-chain monitoring for biologicals and vaccines. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: seed|fertilizer|crop_protection|feed_ingredient|fuel|parts|operational_supply|biological|vaccine — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA (crop protection); APHIS (biologicals/vaccines); USDA NOP (organic inputs); FSMA

attributes.name: invoice_match_status
attributes.description: Status of the Accounts Payable (AP) three-way match process between the Purchase Order (PO), Goods Receipt Note (GRN), and supplier invoice. Drives payment release or block in Oracle NetSuite and SAP FI/AP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP — Three-Way Match; Oracle NetSuite AP; GAAP/IFRS AP controls; SOX

attributes.name: lot_batch_number
attributes.description: Lot or batch number assigned to the received agricultural input at time of GRN posting. Critical for forward and backward traceability across the supply chain, PHI (Pre-Harvest Interval) compliance, and MRL (Maximum Residue Limit) testing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Batch Number (CHARG); FSMA Section 204 traceability; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Short description of the agricultural input material received (e.g., 'Urea 46% N Fertilizer', 'Glyphosate 41% AI Herbicide', 'Corn Seed Hybrid XYZ'). Supports reporting without requiring a join to material master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Description (MAKTX)

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: SAP material number or ERP item code for the received agricultural input. Retained on the GRN line for direct reference and cross-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Number (MATNR)

attributes.name: migo_document_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP MIGO Goods Movement Document Number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA MM goods movement document number generated by the MIGO transaction upon posting of the goods receipt. Used for ERP reconciliation and audit traceability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — MIGO (Transaction MB01/MIGO); Material Document (MKPF)

attributes.name: mrl_testing_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Residue Limit (MRL) Testing Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether MRL (Maximum Residue Limit) testing is required for this received input before release to use. Applicable to crop protection chemicals and certain feed ingredients per EPA and Codex Alimentarius standards.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA MRL regulations; Codex Alimentarius MRL standards; EU Regulation 396/2005

attributes.name: ordered_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the agricultural input ordered on the originating Purchase Order (PO) line. Used for over/under delivery variance analysis and AP three-way match.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — PO Quantity (MENGE); GAAP inventory valuation

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: Human-readable Purchase Order (PO) number from the source ERP system. Retained on the GRN header for direct reference without requiring a join, supporting AP three-way match and vendor communications.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Purchase Order Number (EBELN); Oracle NetSuite PO

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Accounting posting date for the goods receipt in the ERP system. May differ from the physical receipt timestamp when receipts are posted retroactively. Drives AP period allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Posting Date (BUDAT); GAAP/IFRS period-end cut-off

attributes.name: quality_inspection_status
attributes.description: Status of the quality inspection for the received agricultural input. Drives release to inventory or quarantine hold. Linked to COA verification and MRL testing workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM — Inspection Lot Status; HACCP; GFSI; ISO 22000; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: receipt_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the Goods Receipt Note (GRN). Controls downstream AP invoice matching and inventory update workflows. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|posted|partially_accepted|fully_accepted|rejected|reversed — promote to reference product if additional statuses are required]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Goods Movement Status; Oracle NetSuite GRN Workflow

attributes.name: receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the agricultural inputs were physically received at the facility. Principal business event timestamp for the GRN. Used for lot traceability, PHI (Pre-Harvest Interval) compliance, and cold-chain monitoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Posting Date/Time (BUDAT/CPUDT); FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of the agricultural input physically received at the facility as recorded on the GRN. May differ from ordered quantity due to short shipments or over-deliveries.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Quantity Received (ERFMG); FSMA traceability

attributes.name: rejected_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of the received agricultural input that failed quality inspection and was rejected. Triggers supplier return process and debit memo in AP. Must be reconciled with accepted_quantity + rejected_quantity = received_quantity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM — Rejection Quantity; GLOBALG.A.P.; GFSI

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Coded reason for rejection of the rejected quantity. Examples: DAMAGED, MRL_EXCEEDANCE, COA_FAIL, WRONG_PRODUCT, TEMP_EXCEEDANCE, LABEL_NONCOMPLIANT, PEST_CONTAMINATION. Populated only when rejected_quantity > 0. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DAMAGED|MRL_EXCEEDANCE|COA_FAIL|WRONG_PRODUCT|TEMP_EXCEEDANCE|LABEL_NONCOMPLIANT|PEST_CONTAMINATION|SHORT_DATED — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM — Rejection Reason; EPA MRL compliance; GFSI; BRC Global Standards

attributes.name: sds_on_file
attributes.business_glossary_term: Safety Data Sheet (SDS) On File Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a current Safety Data Sheet (SDS) is on file for the received chemical or biological input. Mandatory for crop protection chemicals, fertilizers, and fuel per EPA and OSHA Hazard Communication Standard (HazCom).
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA; OSHA HazCom Standard (29 CFR 1910.1200); SDS GHS format

attributes.name: storage_bin
attributes.description: Specific storage bin, silo, tank, or warehouse location where the accepted quantity was physically placed after receipt. Used for inventory putaway confirmation and WMS task management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Storage Bin (LGPLA); Manhattan Associates WMS bin assignment

attributes.name: temperature_at_receipt_c
attributes.description: Recorded temperature in degrees Celsius at the time of receipt for cold-chain sensitive agricultural inputs including biologicals, vaccines, and temperature-sensitive feed ingredients. Null for non-temperature-sensitive materials.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS cold-chain requirements; FSMA Preventive Controls; GLOBALG.A.P. cold chain

attributes.name: temperature_exceedance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the recorded temperature at receipt exceeded the specified cold-chain tolerance for the material. When True, triggers quality hold and supplier notification workflow. Applicable to biologicals, vaccines, and cold-chain feed ingredients.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; FSMA Preventive Controls Rule; GLOBALG.A.P. cold chain management

attributes.name: total_receipt_value
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the accepted quantity at the PO unit price (accepted_quantity × unit_price). Used for inventory valuation posting, AP accrual, and spend analytics. Currency is USD unless otherwise specified.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/FI — Goods Receipt Value; GAAP/IFRS inventory valuation; Oracle NetSuite

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for all quantity fields on this GRN line (ordered, received, accepted, rejected). Standard agricultural units: KG (kilogram), MT (Metric Ton), LB (pound), CWT (Hundredweight), BU (Bushel), L (litre), GAL (gallon), EA (each), BAG, TON. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: KG|MT|LB|CWT|BU|L|GAL|EA|BAG|TON — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Base Unit of Measure (MEINS); USDA commodity measurement standards

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Purchase price per unit of measure for the received agricultural input as per the Purchase Order (PO). Used for inventory valuation (moving average or standard cost) and AP invoice matching.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Net Price (NETPR); GAAP/IFRS inventory valuation; Oracle NetSuite

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the GRN record. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Databricks Silver Layer CDC pattern

attributes.name: vendor_delivery_note_number
attributes.description: Supplier-issued delivery note or packing slip number accompanying the shipment. Used for cross-referencing vendor documentation during GRN processing and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Delivery Note Reference (XBLNR); FSMA Section 204 traceability

products.name: vendor_contract
products.description: Formal procurement contract governing the supply of agricultural inputs between the enterprise and a qualified vendor. Captures contract type (framework, spot, annual supply agreement), commodity or input category covered, contracted volume (BU/MT/CWT), delivery terms (FOB/CIF), contract start and end dates, auto-renewal flag, penalty clauses, force majeure provisions, GLOBALG.A.P. compliance requirement, EPA registration requirement for chemical inputs, and SAP MM outline agreement document number. Pricing terms: price type (fixed, formula-based, WASDE-indexed, spot), base price, price adjustment formula, volume tier thresholds, minimum order quantity, currency, and effective/expiry dates. SSOT for all contractual agreements and negotiated pricing with vendors — no separate price agreement product exists.

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FOB|CIF|EXW|DAP|DDP|FCA|CFR — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: penalty_clause_flag

attributes.name: penalty_description

attributes.description: Mechanism by which the contract price is determined. attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the vendor quotation within the procurement workflow. Drives PO creation eligibility and contract negotiation actions. Values: received (quotation received from vendor), under_evaluation (being assessed by procurement team), accepted (selected for PO creation), rejected (not selected), expired (validity period lapsed).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – ME47/ME49 Quotation Status; GLOBALG.A.P. Procurement Controls

attributes.name: quoted_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the agricultural input offered by the vendor at the quoted unit price. Represents the vendor's supply commitment for this quotation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – ME47 Quotation Quantity; Oracle NetSuite Vendor Quote Quantity

attributes.name: quoted_unit_price
attributes.description: The vendor's quoted price per unit of measure for the agricultural input. Forms the basis for PO pricing, contract negotiation, and spend analytics. Expressed in the currency specified by currency_code.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – ME47 Net Price; Oracle NetSuite Vendor Quote Price; GAAP Procurement Valuation

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the vendor quotation was received and recorded in the procurement system. Used for audit trail and RFQ response time analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Quotation Receipt Timestamp; Oracle NetSuite Procurement Audit

attributes.name: rei_hours
attributes.description: Vendor-declared Restricted Entry Interval (REI) in hours for crop protection chemicals — the minimum time workers must wait before re-entering a treated field. Null for non-chemical inputs. Required for OSHA worker safety and EPA FIFRA compliance.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA REI Requirements (40 CFR Part 170); OSHA Agricultural Safety Standards; Worker Protection Standard (WPS)

attributes.name: sds_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has provided or confirmed availability of a Safety Data Sheet (SDS) for the quoted chemical or biological input. Mandatory for OSHA HazCom compliance and EPA chemical handling requirements.
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom Standard 29 CFR 1910.1200; EPA FIFRA; GHS SDS Requirements

attributes.name: total_quoted_amount
attributes.description: Total value of the quotation calculated as quoted_unit_price multiplied by quoted_quantity. Used for spend analytics, budget comparison, and PO value authorization thresholds.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – ME47 Total Value; Oracle NetSuite AP; GAAP Procurement Valuation

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the quoted quantity and unit price (e.g., BU = Bushel, MT = Metric Ton, CWT = Hundredweight, KG = Kilogram, L = Litre, GAL = Gallon). Aligns with SAP MM base unit of measure for PO creation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: BU|MT|CWT|KG|LB|L|GAL|TON|BAG|UNIT — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Base Unit of Measure; USDA Agricultural Measurement Standards; ISO 80000

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this vendor quotation record was last modified in the procurement system. Supports change tracking, data lineage, and SOX audit requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Document Change Timestamp; SOX Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity

attributes.name: validity_end_date
attributes.description: The date after which the quoted prices and terms are no longer binding. Procurement must act before this date to lock in quoted pricing. Null indicates open-ended validity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – ME47 Validity Period End; GLOBALG.A.P. Supplier Terms

attributes.name: validity_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which the quoted prices and terms are binding and valid. Defines the start of the quotation's effective window for PO creation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – ME47 Validity Period Start; GLOBALG.A.P. Supplier Terms

attributes.name: vendor_reference_number
attributes.description: Vendor's own internal reference or document number for this quotation, as provided by the supplier. Supports reconciliation with vendor-side records during PO and GRN matching.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Vendor Quotation Reference; Oracle NetSuite AP

products.name: procurement_ap_invoice
products.description: Accounts payable invoice record received from a vendor following delivery of agricultural inputs. Captures vendor invoice number, invoice date, PO reference, GRN reference, invoiced line items with quantities and amounts, tax amount, currency, payment terms (net 30/60/90, early payment discount percentage), due date, three-way match status (PO-GRN-invoice), match discrepancy details, and Oracle NetSuite AP document reference. Includes dispute management: dispute type (quantity discrepancy, price variance, quality rejection, duplicate invoice, missing COA/SDS), disputed amount, resolution status, credit note reference, and root cause category. Procurement-side SSOT for vendor invoice processing and three-way match validation. BOUNDARY: Procurement owns invoice receipt, three-way match validation, and dispute resolution. Finance domain owns payment disbursement, AP ledger posting, and cash management. Three-way match failures escalate within procurement; payment failures escalate to finance.
products.reference: Oracle NetSuite AP Invoice / SAP MM Invoice Verification (RBKP)

attributes.name: procurement_ap_invoice_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the accounts payable invoice record in the procurement domain. Primary key for this data product. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite AP Module; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
