attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: commodity_price_basis_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to invoice.price_basis. Business justification: Grain procurement AP invoices are priced using futures + basis methodology. Linking AP invoices to the price_basis master enables basis pricing reconciliation between buy-side and sell-side, a fundame
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Procurement AP invoices require cost center assignment for expense allocation to crop production cost centers (e.g., allocating fertilizer invoices to specific field operations). Supports cost center-
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Procurement AP invoices require GL account assignment for financial posting (seed expense, chemical expense, fertilizer expense accounts). Supports automatic account determination and financial coding
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: procurement_goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Goods Receipt Note (GRN) confirming physical delivery of agricultural inputs. Required for three-way match (PO-GRN-Invoice) validation. Null if invoice precedes goods receipt.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Receipt; Oracle NetSuite Inventory Receipt

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating Purchase Order (PO) against which this invoice is matched. Used in three-way match validation (PO-GRN-Invoice). Core procurement linkage per SAP S/4HANA MM purchasing document flow.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchase Order; Oracle NetSuite PO Module

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor (supplier) who issued this invoice. Links to the vendor master record for agricultural input suppliers (seed, fertilizer, crop protection chemical, feed, fuel, parts). Satisfies PARTY_REFERENCE category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Master; Oracle NetSuite Vendor Record

attributes.name: weight_ticket_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to invoice.weight_ticket. Business justification: Three-way match in grain procurement (PO + GRN + weight ticket) is the core AP settlement process in agriculture. AP invoices must be matched to weight tickets to verify delivered quantity, moisture,
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status for this AP invoice within the procurement domain. Approved invoices are forwarded to the Finance domain for payment disbursement and AP ledger posting. Rejected invoices are returned to the vendor or placed on hold.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Invoice Verification; Oracle NetSuite AP Approval Workflow; SOX

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the invoice was formally approved by the procurement team for payment processing. Used for processing SLA measurement, audit trail, and SOX compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA MM; Oracle NetSuite AP

attributes.name: coa_received_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor's Certificate of Analysis (COA) has been received for regulated agricultural inputs (crop protection chemicals, fertilizers, feed ingredients). COA is required for FSMA compliance and quality acceptance. Missing COA triggers dispute type 'missing_coa_sds'.
attributes.references: FSMA; USDA; FDA; GLOBALG.A.P.; SAP S/4HANA QM

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this AP invoice record was first created in the system. Satisfies RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Used for processing SLA measurement and audit trail.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite AP; SAP S/4HANA MM; SOX Audit Controls

attributes.name: credit_note_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the vendor-issued credit note associated with this invoice, issued following dispute resolution (e.g., quality rejection of crop protection chemicals, quantity shortfall). Null if no credit note has been issued.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Invoice Verification; Oracle NetSuite AP; GAAP

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code of the vendor invoice (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD). Required for multi-currency procurement under FOB/CIF contract terms with international agricultural input suppliers. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS; Oracle NetSuite Multi-Currency

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this invoice is currently under formal dispute with the vendor. True when a dispute has been raised; False when no dispute is active. Triggers dispute management workflow within the procurement domain.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Oracle NetSuite AP Dispute Management

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_status
attributes.description: Current status of the dispute resolution process for this invoice. Tracks progression from dispute initiation through vendor negotiation to resolution or escalation. Resolved disputes may result in credit note issuance or invoice adjustment.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite AP; SAP S/4HANA MM; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: dispute_root_cause
attributes.description: Root cause classification for the invoice dispute, used for supplier performance analytics and process improvement. Examples include vendor billing error, receiving discrepancy, contract interpretation, quality failure, or documentation non-compliance (missing COA/SDS). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: vendor_billing_error|receiving_discrepancy|contract_interpretation|quality_failure|documentation_noncompliance|pricing_error|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Oracle NetSuite AP; GLOBALG.A.P.; FSMA

attributes.name: dispute_type
attributes.description: Category of dispute raised against the vendor invoice. Includes quantity discrepancy (invoiced vs received), price variance (invoiced vs PO price), quality rejection (input failed QA/COA), duplicate invoice, and missing Certificate of Analysis (COA) or Safety Data Sheet (SDS) for regulated agricultural chemicals. Null if no dispute.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Oracle NetSuite AP; EPA SDS Requirements; USDA COA Standards; FSMA

attributes.name: disputed_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the invoice amount currently under dispute, expressed in the invoice currency. May be less than the total invoice amount for partial disputes. Used for AP aging and cash flow forecasting.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite AP Dispute Management; SAP S/4HANA MM; SOX

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Calculated date by which payment must be made to the vendor to comply with agreed payment terms (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, Net 90). Derived from invoice date plus payment term days but stored as a business field for AP aging and cash flow planning.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite AP; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; GAAP

attributes.name: early_payment_discount_date
attributes.description: Last date by which payment must be made to qualify for the early payment discount (e.g., 2/10 Net 30 — pay within 10 days to receive 2% discount). Null if no early payment discount applies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Payment Terms; Oracle NetSuite AP

attributes.name: early_payment_discount_pct
attributes.description: Percentage discount offered by the vendor for early payment (e.g., 0.02 = 2% discount if paid within the early payment discount window). Used for cash flow optimization and dynamic discounting decisions in agricultural input procurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Payment Terms; Oracle NetSuite AP

attributes.name: grn_number
attributes.description: Human-readable Goods Receipt Note (GRN) number confirming physical receipt of agricultural inputs at the warehouse or farm location. Used for three-way match documentation and audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Goods Receipt (MIGO); Manhattan Associates WMS

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total gross amount of the vendor invoice before tax deductions, expressed in the invoice currency. Represents the sum of all invoiced line items. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Invoice Verification; Oracle NetSuite AP; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Incoterms Code (Free On Board / Cost Insurance Freight)
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) code defining the delivery and risk transfer point for the agricultural input shipment (e.g., FOB — Free On Board, CIF — Cost Insurance and Freight). Determines freight cost allocation and invoice validation rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FOB|CIF|EXW|DAP|DDP|FCA|CFR|CPT|CIP|DAT — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing; USDA Trade Regulations

attributes.name: input_category
attributes.description: High-level category of agricultural inputs covered by this invoice. Drives compliance requirements: crop protection chemicals require EPA/APHIS compliance and SDS documentation; seeds may require GMO declarations; fertilizers require NPK specification review. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: seeds|fertilizers|crop_protection|feed_ingredients|fuel|parts|equipment|services|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA; EPA; APHIS; FSMA; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Groups

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date printed on the vendor's invoice document, representing the principal real-world business event date. Used for payment term calculation, aging analysis, and period accruals. Satisfies BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Invoice Verification; GAAP Revenue Recognition; IFRS

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the AP invoice within the procurement workflow. Drives routing, escalation, and payment eligibility. Satisfies LIFECYCLE_STATUS category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: received|under_review|matched|approved|disputed|on_hold|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Invoice Verification; Oracle NetSuite AP Workflow

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice document type. Distinguishes standard vendor invoices from credit notes (issued after quality rejection or dispute resolution), debit notes, prepayments, and intercompany transactions for agricultural input procurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Invoice Verification; Oracle NetSuite AP; IFRS

attributes.name: match_discrepancy_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the discrepancy identified during three-way match validation, expressed in the invoice currency. Positive value indicates over-invoicing; negative indicates under-invoicing. Used to determine dispute escalation thresholds.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Invoice Verification; Oracle NetSuite AP; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: match_discrepancy_type
attributes.description: Type of discrepancy identified during three-way match validation. Quantity variance indicates invoiced quantity differs from GRN quantity; price variance indicates invoiced unit price differs from PO price. Drives dispute initiation and resolution workflow.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Invoice Verification; Oracle NetSuite AP; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: net_payable_amount
attributes.description: Net amount payable to the vendor after applying taxes, discounts, and any credit adjustments, expressed in the invoice currency. Represents the final obligation amount. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; Oracle NetSuite AP; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: netsuite_ap_doc_ref
attributes.business_glossary_term: Oracle NetSuite Accounts Payable (AP) Document Reference
attributes.description: Oracle NetSuite internal AP document reference number assigned upon invoice entry into the AP sub-ledger. Used for cross-system reconciliation between procurement and finance domains.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite AP Module

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by procurement staff during invoice processing, dispute resolution, or match exception handling. Captures context for audit trail, vendor communications, and escalation documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Oracle NetSuite AP

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Vendor-agreed payment terms code as configured in SAP S/4HANA or Oracle NetSuite (e.g., NET30, NET60, NET90, 2/10NET30). Governs due date calculation and early payment discount eligibility for agricultural input supplier invoices.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Payment Terms; Oracle NetSuite AP; GAAP

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: Human-readable Purchase Order (PO) number as printed on the vendor invoice and procurement documents. Used for cross-referencing with SAP S/4HANA MM purchasing documents and vendor communications.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing; Oracle NetSuite PO Module

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: Date the vendor invoice was physically or electronically received by the procurement team. Used to calculate processing lead time and determine payment due date under net payment terms.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Invoice Verification; Oracle NetSuite AP

attributes.name: sds_received_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor's Safety Data Sheet (SDS) has been received for hazardous agricultural inputs (crop protection chemicals, pesticides, herbicides). SDS is mandatory under EPA and OSHA regulations for chemical handling and storage compliance.
attributes.references: EPA; OSHA Hazard Communication Standard (HCS); APHIS; SAP S/4HANA QM

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount charged on the invoice (e.g., VAT, GST, sales tax), expressed in the invoice currency. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET. Used for tax reporting and AP ledger posting by the Finance domain.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax; Oracle NetSuite Tax Module; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: three_way_match_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Three-Way Match Status (Purchase Order - Goods Receipt Note - Invoice)
attributes.description: Result of the three-way match validation comparing the Purchase Order (PO), Goods Receipt Note (GRN), and vendor invoice for quantity and price alignment. Core procurement control for agricultural input invoice processing. Matched invoices are eligible for payment approval.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Invoice Verification (MIRO); Oracle NetSuite AP; SOX Internal Controls; GAAP

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this AP invoice record. Satisfies RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Tracks changes during dispute resolution, match correction, and approval workflows.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite AP; SAP S/4HANA MM; SOX Audit Controls

attributes.name: vendor_invoice_number
attributes.description: The externally-assigned invoice number as printed on the vendor's invoice document. Used for duplicate invoice detection, vendor reconciliation, and dispute resolution. Satisfies BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Invoice Verification (MIRO); Oracle NetSuite AP

products.name: input_catalog

Captures material code, input category, unit of measure, EPA registration number (for chemicals), APHIS permit category (for biologicals), SDS required flag, PHI/REI values, MRL limits, and preferred vendor list.
products.reference: SAP MM Material Master (MARA/MARC) — Agricultural Inputs

Linking input_catalog to emission_factor enables autom

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.input_product. Business justification: Input catalog entries resolve to the product master input_product for regulatory attribute retrieval (EPA registration, PHI, REI, MRL). Procurement teams use this link during PO creation to enforce co

attributes.name: seed_variety_id

attributes.name: active_ingredient
attributes.description: Primary active ingredient(s) in crop protection chemicals or veterinary products (e.g., 'glyphosate', 'chlorpyrifos', 'azoxystrobin'). Critical for MRL compliance, PHI determination, and HACCP hazard analysis. Null for non-chemical inputs.

attributes.name: active_ingredient_pct

attributes.name: aphis_permit_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS) Permit Category
attributes.description: USDA APHIS permit classification for biological inputs including biocontrol agents, plant pests, and veterinary biologicals. Required for import, interstate movement, and field release of regulated biological organisms. Null or 'not_applicable' for non-biological inputs.

attributes.name: approved_date

attributes.name: base_uom
attributes.description: Primary unit of measure for procurement and inventory transactions (e.g., KG, MT, L, GAL, BU, CWT, EA). Aligns with SAP S/4HANA MM base UOM and drives GRN quantity validation and stock position calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Unit of Measure (MARA-MEINS); ISO 80000-1 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: catalog_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the input in the master catalog. Controls whether the input is available for purchase requisition and PO creation in SAP S/4HANA MM. 'restricted' indicates regulatory or internal procurement hold.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Status (MARA-MMSTA); GLOBALG.A.P. Approved Input List

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code indicating the country where this input was manufactured or produced. Required for COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) compliance, import documentation, and APHIS phytosanitary permit requirements.
attributes.references: USDA COOL 7 CFR Part 60; APHIS Import Permit Requirements; CBP 19 CFR Part 102; ISO 3166-1

attributes.name: crop_target
attributes.description: Primary crop or crop group for which this input is registered, approved, or intended (e.g., 'corn', 'soybean', 'wheat', 'cotton', 'all_crops'). Drives crop-specific procurement planning, VRA prescription compatibility, and EPA label compliance.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Registered Uses; GLOBALG.A.P. Crop Protection Module; USDA NASS Crop Classification

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the standard cost and pricing fields (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'BRL'). Supports multi-currency procurement operations and IFRS financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates; GAAP

attributes.name: formulation_type
attributes.description: Pesticide or fertilizer formulation type code (e.g., EC=Emulsifiable Concentrate, WP=Wettable Powder, SC=Suspension Concentrate, WG=Water Dispersible Granule, GR=Granule, SL=Soluble Liquid). Affects application equipment compatibility and handling procedures. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EC|WP|SC|WG|GR|SL|CS|not_applicable — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FAO/WHO Pesticide Specifications; EPA FIFRA Label; CropLife International Formulation Codes

attributes.name: gmo_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the input (primarily seeds) is genetically modified (GMO), non-GMO, conventional (no GMO claim), or not applicable for non-seed inputs. Required for USDA APHIS biotech regulatory compliance, COOL labeling, and customer supply chain transparency.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS 7 CFR Part 340; USDA National Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: hazmat_class
attributes.description: DOT hazardous materials classification code for transport and storage compliance (e.g., '3' for flammable liquids/fuels, '6.1' for toxic substances, '8' for corrosives). Null for non-hazardous inputs. Required for BOL documentation and TMS routing.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Parts 171-180; EPA RCRA; OSHA HazCom; GHS Classification

attributes.name: input_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the agricultural input type. Drives procurement workflows, regulatory compliance checks, and SDS documentation requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: seed|fertilizer|crop_protection|feed_ingredient|fuel|spare_part|operational_supply|biological — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Type; USDA APHIS Input Classification; EPA Pesticide Registration

attributes.name: input_name
attributes.description: Human-readable commercial or trade name of the agricultural input (e.g., 'Roundup PowerMAX', 'Pioneer P1197AM', 'Urea 46-0-0'). Used for display, reporting, and procurement communications.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Description; GLOBALG.A.P. Input Register

attributes.name: input_subcategory
attributes.description: Granular classification within the input category (e.g., for crop_protection: herbicide, insecticide, fungicide, nematicide; for fertilizer: nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium, micronutrient, organic). Supports IPM program management and NPK spend analytics.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Group; EPA Pesticide Product Classification; USDA NOP

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent regulatory and compliance review of this catalog entry, including EPA registration status, MRL updates, SDS currency, and vendor qualification renewal. Supports periodic review cycle management per GLOBALG.A.P. and FSMA requirements.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Annual Review Requirements; FDA FSMA Preventive Controls; ISO 22000 Management Review

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Standard procurement lead time in calendar days from PO issuance to GRN for this input from the preferred vendor. Used for reorder point calculation, planting season procurement planning, and supply chain risk management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM MRP Planning (MARC-PLIFZ); Granular Farm Management Procurement Planning

attributes.name: lot_tracked
attributes.description: Indicates whether this input requires lot/batch number tracking throughout the supply chain for traceability, recall management, and FSMA compliance. True for seeds, crop protection chemicals, feed ingredients, and biologicals.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart S Traceability; SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Management; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: material_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique material number assigned in SAP S/4HANA MM or Oracle NetSuite for this agricultural input. Used as the primary cross-system business identifier for procurement, inventory, and AP processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master (MARA-MATNR); Oracle NetSuite Item Record

attributes.name: minimum_order_qty
attributes.description: Minimum quantity per purchase order as required by the preferred vendor, expressed in the purchase UOM. Prevents creation of POs below vendor minimums and supports procurement cost optimization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing Info Record (EINE-MINBM); Oracle NetSuite Vendor Item Record

attributes.name: mode_of_action
attributes.description: Biochemical mode of action classification for crop protection chemicals using HRAC (herbicides), IRAC (insecticides), or FRAC (fungicides) group codes (e.g., 'HRAC Group 9', 'IRAC Group 4A'). Critical for IPM resistance management programs.
attributes.references: HRAC (Herbicide Resistance Action Committee); IRAC (Insecticide Resistance Action Committee); FRAC (Fungicide Resistance Action Committee); EPA IPM Guidelines

attributes.name: mrl_ppm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Residue Limit (MRL) in Parts Per Million (PPM)
attributes.description: Maximum Residue Limit for the active ingredient on the target crop, expressed in parts per million (PPM). Regulatory threshold set by EPA, Codex Alimentarius, or importing country standards. Drives pre-harvest interval enforcement and food safety compliance.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180; Codex Alimentarius MRL Database; EU Regulation 396/2005; FDA FSMA

attributes.name: npk_grade
attributes.description: NPK nutrient analysis expressed as N-P-K percentage (e.g., '46-0-0' for urea, '18-46-0' for DAP, '0-0-60' for potash). Mandatory for all fertilizer inputs. Null for non-fertilizer inputs. Drives soil fertility planning and nutrient management compliance.
attributes.references: AAPFCO (Association of American Plant Food Control Officials) Official Publication; USDA NRCS Nutrient Management

attributes.name: organic_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this input is certified for use in USDA National Organic Program (NOP) certified operations. True only for inputs on the USDA NOP National List of Allowed and Prohibited Substances. Critical for organic farm procurement compliance.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205; USDA National List of Allowed Substances; GLOBALG.A.P. Organic Module

attributes.name: organic_certifier
attributes.description: Name of the USDA-accredited certifying agent that issued the organic certification for this input (e.g., 'CCOF', 'Oregon Tilth', 'OMRI'). Required when organic_certified is True. Supports NOP audit trail and supplier qualification.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.501; OMRI (Organic Materials Review Institute); Fair Trade USA

attributes.name: phi_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days that must elapse between the last application of a crop protection chemical and harvest, as specified on the EPA-registered label. Enforced during crop protection event scheduling to ensure MRL compliance.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Label Requirements; GLOBALG.A.P. Crop Protection Module; FSMA Produce Safety Rule

attributes.name: purchase_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure used on purchase orders and vendor invoices, which may differ from the base UOM (e.g., purchased in MT but stocked in KG). Supports PO creation and AP invoice matching in SAP S/4HANA MM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchasing Info Record; Oracle NetSuite Purchase UOM

attributes.name: rei_hours
attributes.description: Minimum number of hours workers must stay out of treated areas after pesticide application, as mandated by EPA Worker Protection Standard (WPS). Critical for workforce safety compliance and OSHA reporting.
attributes.references: EPA Worker Protection Standard (WPS) 40 CFR Part 170; OSHA 29 CFR 1928.110; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: restricted_use
attributes.description: Indicates whether this crop protection chemical is classified as a Restricted Use Pesticide (RUP) by the EPA, requiring a certified pesticide applicator license for purchase and application. Drives applicator certification verification in procurement workflow.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 3(d); 40 CFR Part 152 Subpart I; USDA APHIS

attributes.name: sds_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Safety Data Sheet (SDS) is required for this input under OSHA Hazard Communication Standard (HazCom) and EPA regulations. True for all crop protection chemicals, fertilizers, and fuels. Drives SDS document management workflow.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 HazCom Standard; EPA FIFRA; GHS (Globally Harmonized System)

attributes.name: seed_treatment_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether seeds are chemically treated (fungicide/insecticide coating), untreated, organically treated, or not applicable for non-seed inputs. Affects handling requirements, PHI/REI applicability, and USDA NOP organic certification eligibility.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205; EPA FIFRA Seed Treatment Registration; GLOBALG.A.P. Seed Module

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of days this input remains effective and safe from the date of manufacture or receipt, as specified by the manufacturer. Drives FIFO/FEFO inventory management, reorder policy, and expiry-based quarantine holds in the WMS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Shelf Life Management; Manhattan Associates WMS Expiry Management; GMP

attributes.name: signal_word
attributes.description: EPA-mandated signal word on the pesticide label indicating acute toxicity level: DANGER (highest toxicity, Category I/II), WARNING (moderate toxicity, Category III), CAUTION (lowest toxicity, Category IV), or not_applicable for non-pesticide inputs. Required for SDS and worker safety training.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA 40 CFR Part 156.64; GHS Hazard Communication; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200

attributes.name: sku_code
attributes.description: Vendor-assigned or internal SKU code for this input, used for order management, barcode scanning, and RFID tracking in the warehouse. Supports Manhattan Associates WMS receiving and inventory control operations.
attributes.references: Manhattan Associates WMS Item Master; GS1 Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM EAN/UPC

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required storage condition for this input to maintain efficacy, safety, and regulatory compliance. Drives WMS bin location assignment in Manhattan Associates and warehouse task planning for proper segregation of incompatible materials.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Label Storage Requirements; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106; GMP Storage Guidelines; ISO 22000

products.name: chemical_compliance
products.description: Regulatory compliance record for each procured crop protection chemical and biological input, including associated Safety Data Sheet (SDS) documentation. Captures EPA registration number, APHIS import permit number, active ingredient (AI) name and concentration, MRL values by commodity and market, PHI (Pre-Harvest Interval) in days, REI (Restricted Entry Interval) in hours, restricted use pesticide (RUP) flag, state-specific registration status, label compliance confirmation, and FSMA preventive controls applicability flag. Includes SDS attributes: SDS document number, revision date, GHS hazard classification, signal word, hazard and precautionary statements, first aid measures, storage requirements, disposal instructions, PPE requirements, emergency contact, and SDS expiry/review date. Required for OSHA HazCom compliance, EPA regulatory reporting, GAP certification, and HACCP compliance.
products.reference: EPA Pesticide Registration / APHIS Permit / FSMA PCHF

attributes.name: chemical_compliance_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each chemical compliance record in the procurement domain. Primary key for the chemical_compliance data product. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE — represents a regulatory compliance record for a procured crop protection chemical or biological input.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; EPA FIFRA Registration

attributes.name: agrochemical_product_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agrochemical product master record in the product domain. Links this compliance record to the specific crop protection chemical or biological input product being regulated.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; product.agrochemical_product

attributes.name: regulatory_change_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_change. Business justification: Chemical compliance records (MRL values, PHI days, registration status) must be updated when regulatory changes affect agrochemical registrations or tolerance levels. Links chemical_compliance to the
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: active_ingredient_concentration
attributes.description: Percentage concentration of the active ingredient (AI) in the formulated product, expressed as weight/weight (w/w) or weight/volume (w/v) percent. Used for dose calculation, MRL compliance, and SDS documentation.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Label Requirements; FAO/WHO Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: active_ingredient_name
attributes.description: Common chemical name of the primary active ingredient (AI) responsible for the pesticidal action of the product, as listed on the EPA-approved label. Critical for MRL compliance checks and PHI determination.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA; Codex Alimentarius MRL Standards; ISO 1750 Pesticide Nomenclature

attributes.name: aphis_import_permit_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS) Import Permit Number
attributes.description: APHIS-issued permit number authorizing the importation of regulated biological inputs, biopesticides, or plant protection products. Required for cross-border procurement of biological agents under APHIS jurisdiction.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS 7 CFR Part 330; APHIS PPQ

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the chemical compliance record. 'active' indicates the product is currently registered and compliant for use; 'suspended' indicates temporary regulatory hold; 'cancelled' indicates EPA registration cancellation; 'pending_review' indicates under regulatory review; 'expired' indicates registration or SDS has lapsed.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA; SAP S/4HANA QM Status Management

attributes.name: concentration_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the active ingredient concentration value (e.g., % w/w, % w/v, g/L). Ensures correct interpretation of concentration for compliance calculations.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Label Requirements; ISO 1750

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this chemical compliance record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements for OSHA HazCom, EPA regulatory reporting, and FSMA recordkeeping. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA QM or Oracle NetSuite document creation timestamp.
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200; FSMA Recordkeeping Requirements; SOX

attributes.name: disposal_instructions
attributes.description: Disposal methods and instructions for the chemical product and its container as specified in SDS Section 13. Includes EPA waste classification, disposal facility requirements, and container rinsing procedures. Required for EPA RCRA compliance and environmental management.
attributes.references: EPA RCRA 40 CFR Parts 260-270; OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200 Appendix D Section 13

attributes.name: emergency_contact
attributes.description: 24-hour emergency telephone number for chemical emergency response, as listed on SDS Section 1 (e.g., CHEMTREC 1-800-424-9300). Required by OSHA HazCom and DOT hazardous materials regulations for emergency response coordination.
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200 Appendix D Section 1; DOT 49 CFR Part 172.604

attributes.name: epa_registration_number
attributes.description: EPA-issued registration number for the pesticide product under the Federal Insecticide, Fungicide, and Rodenticide Act (FIFRA). Required for legal sale and use in the United States. Format: registrant-product[-supplemental].
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 3; 40 CFR Part 152

attributes.name: first_aid_measures
attributes.description: Summary of first aid instructions for exposure routes (inhalation, skin contact, eye contact, ingestion) as specified in SDS Section 4. Required for OSHA HazCom compliance and emergency response planning at field and warehouse locations.
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200 Appendix D Section 4; GHS Rev 9

attributes.name: formulation_type
attributes.description: Standardized formulation type code for the crop protection product (e.g., EC=Emulsifiable Concentrate, WP=Wettable Powder, SC=Suspension Concentrate, WG=Water Dispersible Granule, GR=Granule, SL=Soluble Liquid). Used for application equipment selection, mixing instructions, and storage classification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EC|WP|SC|WG|GR|SL|EW|CS|DP|UL|SP|ZC — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FAO/WHO Pesticide Specifications; CropLife International Formulation Codes

attributes.name: gap_certification_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) Certification Applicability Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this chemical compliance record is subject to GAP certification requirements, including GLOBALG.A.P. IFA or equivalent scheme. When true, the chemical's use must be documented in the farm's GAP compliance records and subject to third-party audit.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. IFA Standard v6; USDA GAP/GHP Audit Program

attributes.name: ghs_hazard_classification
attributes.description: GHS hazard classification category for the chemical product, identifying the type and severity of physical, health, and environmental hazards (e.g., 'Acute Toxicity Category 3', 'Flammable Liquid Category 2'). Drives PPE requirements, storage segregation, and emergency response planning.
attributes.references: GHS (Globally Harmonized System) Rev 9; OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200; UN GHS Purple Book

attributes.name: haccp_critical_control_point
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis Critical Control Point (HACCP) Critical Control Point Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this chemical input is identified as a critical control point (CCP) in the facility's HACCP plan. When true, mandatory monitoring, corrective action, and verification procedures apply per Codex Alimentarius HACCP principles and FSMA Preventive Controls.
attributes.references: Codex Alimentarius HACCP Guidelines CAC/RCP 1-1969; FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; FDA

attributes.name: hazard_statements
attributes.description: Standardized GHS H-code hazard statements describing the nature and degree of hazards posed by the chemical (e.g., 'H301: Toxic if swallowed; H400: Very toxic to aquatic life'). Stored as a semicolon-delimited list of H-codes and descriptions. Required on SDS Section 2.
attributes.references: GHS Rev 9 Annex 3; OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200 Appendix C

attributes.name: is_fsma_preventive_control
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Preventive Controls Applicability Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this chemical input is subject to FSMA preventive controls requirements, triggering mandatory hazard analysis, preventive control measures, monitoring, corrective actions, and recordkeeping under the FSMA Preventive Controls for Human Food rule.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; FDA Food Safety Modernization Act

attributes.name: is_gmo
attributes.description: Indicates whether the biological input contains or is derived from genetically modified organisms (GMO). Required for APHIS biotechnology regulatory compliance, COOL labeling, and organic certification exclusion under USDA National Organic Program (NOP).
attributes.references: USDA APHIS 7 CFR Part 340; USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205; EU GMO Regulation 1829/2003

attributes.name: is_restricted_use_pesticide
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product is classified as a Restricted Use Pesticide (RUP) by the EPA, requiring purchase and use only by certified applicators or persons under their direct supervision. Critical for procurement authorization and applicator certification tracking.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 3(d); 40 CFR Part 152 Subpart I

attributes.name: label_compliance_confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product label has been reviewed and confirmed to comply with all applicable EPA label requirements, including use directions, safety precautions, PHI, REI, and first aid statements. Required for GAP certification and HACCP compliance documentation.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 2(p); GLOBALG.A.P. IFA; HACCP Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this chemical compliance record. Tracks changes to SDS revisions, registration status updates, MRL changes, or label amendments. Required for regulatory audit trail and change management.
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200(g)(5); FSMA; SOX

attributes.name: mrl_commodity
attributes.description: The specific agricultural commodity (e.g., corn grain, soybean, wheat) for which the MRL value applies. MRL values are commodity-specific and market-specific, requiring separate records per commodity-market combination.
attributes.references: Codex Alimentarius; EPA 40 CFR Part 180; USDA AMS

attributes.name: mrl_market
attributes.description: The regulatory jurisdiction or export market for which the MRL value applies (e.g., USA, EU, Japan, China). Different markets have different MRL standards; this field enables multi-market compliance tracking.
attributes.references: Codex Alimentarius; EU Regulation 396/2005; USDA FAS Export Requirements

attributes.name: mrl_value
attributes.description: Maximum Residue Limit (MRL) for the active ingredient on the target commodity, expressed in mg/kg (ppm). Represents the highest legally permissible concentration of pesticide residue in or on food and feed commodities. Used for export market compliance and FSMA preventive controls.
attributes.references: Codex Alimentarius MRL Standards; EPA 40 CFR Part 180; EU Regulation 396/2005

attributes.name: phi_days
attributes.description: Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) in days — the minimum number of days that must elapse between the last application of the chemical and the harvest of the crop. Mandatory for GAP compliance and FSMA preventive controls to ensure MRL compliance at harvest.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Label Requirements; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA; FSMA Produce Safety Rule 21 CFR Part 112

attributes.name: ppe_requirements
attributes.description: Required personal protective equipment (PPE) for handling, mixing, loading, and applying the chemical product as specified on the EPA label and SDS Section 8. Includes gloves, respirator type, eye protection, and protective clothing specifications. Mandatory for EPA Worker Protection Standard compliance.
attributes.references: EPA Worker Protection Standard 40 CFR Part 170; OSHA PPE Standard 29 CFR 1910.132; SDS Section 8

attributes.name: precautionary_statements
attributes.description: Standardized GHS P-code precautionary statements describing recommended measures to minimize or prevent adverse effects from exposure, storage, or disposal (e.g., 'P260: Do not breathe dust/fume; P501: Dispose of contents in accordance with local regulations'). Stored as semicolon-delimited P-codes.
attributes.references: GHS Rev 9 Annex 4; OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200 Appendix C

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: Classification of the crop protection product by its primary mode of action or target pest category. Drives regulatory pathway, label requirements, and IPM program classification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: herbicide|insecticide|fungicide|rodenticide|biopesticide|plant_growth_regulator|adjuvant|nematicide|bactericide — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA; USDA NASS Pesticide Use Survey; GLOBALG.A.P. IFA

attributes.name: registration_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the EPA registration for this chemical product became effective. Marks the start of the legally authorized period for sale and use of the product in the United States under FIFRA.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 3; 40 CFR Part 152

attributes.name: registration_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the EPA registration for this chemical product expires or is due for renewal. Null for registrations without a fixed expiry. Triggers procurement hold and re-registration workflow when approaching expiry.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 3(g); 40 CFR Part 152

attributes.name: rei_hours
attributes.description: Restricted Entry Interval (REI) in hours — the minimum time that must pass after a pesticide application before workers may re-enter the treated area without personal protective equipment (PPE). Required for OSHA HazCom and EPA Worker Protection Standard compliance.
attributes.references: EPA Worker Protection Standard 40 CFR Part 170; OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200

attributes.name: sds_document_number
attributes.description: Unique document control number assigned to the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) for this chemical product. Used for document management, OSHA HazCom compliance, and audit trail. Corresponds to the SDS document identifier in the supplier's document management system.
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom Standard 29 CFR 1910.1200; GHS (Globally Harmonized System) Rev 9

attributes.name: sds_expiry_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Safety Data Sheet (SDS) Expiry / Review Date
attributes.description: Date by which the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) must be reviewed and reissued or confirmed current. Typically set 3-5 years from the revision date per industry practice. Triggers SDS renewal workflow to maintain OSHA HazCom compliance.
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200; ANSI Z400.1

attributes.name: sds_revision_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent revision of the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) as issued by the chemical manufacturer or supplier. OSHA requires SDS to be updated within 3 months of new hazard information. Critical for ensuring workers have access to current hazard information.
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200(g)(5); GHS Rev 9 Section 1

attributes.name: signal_word
attributes.description: GHS/EPA signal word appearing on the product label and SDS indicating the relative level of hazard severity: DANGER (most severe), WARNING (moderate), CAUTION (least severe), or none for non-hazardous products. Required on SDS Section 2 and product label.
attributes.references: GHS Rev 9 Section 1.4; EPA FIFRA Label Requirements; OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code (USPS abbreviation) for which the state_registration_status applies. Enables state-by-state compliance tracking for pesticide products that require individual state registrations under FIFRA Section 24(c).
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 24(c); USPS State Abbreviations

attributes.name: state_registration_status
attributes.description: Registration status of the pesticide product in the specific state(s) where it will be used. States may impose additional registration requirements beyond federal EPA registration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: registered|not_registered|pending|cancelled|restricted — promote to reference product if multi-state tracking is required]
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 24(c); State Lead Agency Pesticide Regulations

attributes.name: storage_requirements
attributes.description: Storage conditions and requirements for the chemical product as specified in SDS Section 7, including temperature range, humidity, segregation from incompatible materials, ventilation, and container requirements. Used for warehouse storage planning and EPA/OSHA compliance.
attributes.references: OSHA HazCom 29 CFR 1910.1200 Appendix D Section 7; EPA FIFRA; NFPA 30

products.name: vendor_audit
products.description: On-site or remote audit record for vendor qualification and ongoing compliance verification. Captures audit type (initial qualification, annual surveillance, for-cause), audit date, auditor name and organization, audit scope (food safety, GAP, GMP, HACCP, EPA compliance), findings count by severity (critical, major, minor), overall audit result (pass, conditional pass, fail), corrective action required flag, corrective action due date, and re-audit required flag. Supports FSMA SVCP and GFSI supplier audit requirements.
products.reference: FSMA SVCP Supplier Audit / GFSI Audit Protocol

attributes.name: vendor_audit_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the vendor audit record. Primary key for the vendor_audit data product in the procurement domain.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module

attributes.name: auditor_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Internal vendor audits (GAP, food safety, EPA compliance) are conducted by credentialed employee auditors. Linking to employee supports audit assignment workflows, corrective action ownership, and reg
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: sustainability_certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.sustainability_certification. Business justification: Vendor re-qualification and audit scheduling in agriculture requires verifying active sustainability certifications (GlobalG.A.P., GFSI, organic). Linking vendor_audit to sustainability_certification
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor/supplier being audited. Links to the vendor master record in the procurement domain.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: audit_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the on-site or remote audit was conducted. For multi-day audits, this is the start date of the audit activity.
attributes.references: FSMA SVCP; GLOBALG.A.P. Certification Requirements

attributes.name: audit_end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the audit activity concluded. For single-day audits, this equals audit_date. Used to calculate audit duration and schedule follow-up activities.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; SQF Code

attributes.name: audit_method
attributes.description: Indicates whether the audit was conducted on-site at the vendor facility, remotely via document review and virtual inspection, or as a hybrid combining both approaches.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; GLOBALG.A.P. Remote Audit Guidelines

attributes.name: audit_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique audit reference number assigned at initiation, used for cross-referencing with vendor correspondence, GFSI certification bodies, and SAP QM audit records.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements

attributes.name: audit_report_reference
attributes.description: Document reference number or URL pointing to the full audit report stored in the document management system. Enables retrieval of detailed findings, evidence, and auditor notes for regulatory review and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: FSMA SVCP; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; SOX Documentation Requirements

attributes.name: audit_result
attributes.description: Overall outcome of the audit: pass (vendor meets all requirements), conditional_pass (vendor meets minimum requirements but must address findings within a defined period), fail (vendor does not meet minimum requirements and is disqualified or suspended pending corrective action).
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; FSMA SVCP; GLOBALG.A.P. Certification Requirements

attributes.name: audit_scope
attributes.description: Narrative description of the audit scope defining which business processes, product categories, and compliance frameworks were evaluated (e.g., food safety, GAP, GMP, HACCP, EPA chemical compliance, FSMA SVCP, animal feed safety). Free-text field capturing the full scope statement as documented in the audit plan.
attributes.references: FSMA SVCP; HACCP Codex Alimentarius; GLOBALG.A.P.; EPA Regulations

attributes.name: audit_score
attributes.description: Numeric percentage score achieved by the vendor during the audit, calculated as the ratio of compliant elements to total auditable elements. Used for benchmarking vendor performance over time and comparing across the supplier base.
attributes.references: SQF Code; BRC Global Standards; GLOBALG.A.P. Scoring Methodology

attributes.name: audit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the audit record: scheduled (planned but not yet conducted), in_progress (audit underway), completed (audit finished and results recorded), cancelled (audit voided), pending_review (awaiting final sign-off).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; FSMA SVCP

attributes.name: audit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the audit by its business purpose: initial_qualification (new vendor onboarding), annual_surveillance (routine periodic review), for_cause (triggered by incident or complaint), re_audit (follow-up after failed audit), desk_review (document-only remote review).
attributes.references: FSMA Supplier Verification for Human Food (SVCP); GLOBALG.A.P. Certification Requirements; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements

attributes.name: auditor_certification_number
attributes.description: Professional certification or accreditation number of the lead auditor issued by a recognized body (e.g., GFSI, SQF, BRC, GLOBALG.A.P.). Used to verify auditor credentials and maintain audit trail integrity.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; SQF Code; BRC Global Standards

attributes.name: auditor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the lead auditor who conducted the audit. May be an internal quality assurance staff member or a third-party certification body auditor.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; SQF Code; BRC Global Standards

attributes.name: auditor_organization
attributes.description: Name of the organization or certification body the lead auditor represents (e.g., internal quality team, SGS, Bureau Veritas, NSF International, SQF Institute).
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; GLOBALG.A.P. Certification Requirements

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which the vendor must submit evidence of completed corrective actions addressing audit findings. Null when corrective_action_required is False.
attributes.references: FSMA SVCP; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; SQF Code

attributes.name: corrective_action_received_date
attributes.description: The date on which the vendor's Corrective Action Plan (CAP) or evidence of corrective actions was received by the procurement quality team. Used to track vendor responsiveness and compliance with remediation timelines.
attributes.references: FSMA SVCP; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is required to submit a formal Corrective Action Plan (CAP) as a result of audit findings. True when critical or major non-conformances are identified.
attributes.references: FSMA SVCP; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; ISO 22000

attributes.name: corrective_action_status
attributes.description: Current status of the corrective action process: not_required (no CAP needed), pending (CAP not yet submitted), submitted (CAP received, under review), accepted (CAP approved by quality team), rejected (CAP insufficient, resubmission required), overdue (past due date without submission).
attributes.references: FSMA SVCP; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; ISO 22000

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the vendor audit record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial reporting controls.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); ISO 22000

attributes.name: critical_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of critical non-conformances identified during the audit. Critical findings represent immediate food safety, regulatory, or legal risks requiring urgent corrective action and may result in audit failure or supply suspension.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; SQF Code; BRC Global Standards; FSMA SVCP

attributes.name: epa_compliance_included
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Compliance Scope Included
attributes.description: Indicates whether EPA regulatory compliance was included in the audit scope. Relevant for crop protection chemical (Active Ingredient/AI) and pesticide suppliers subject to EPA registration and Maximum Residue Limit (MRL) requirements.
attributes.references: EPA Federal Insecticide Fungicide and Rodenticide Act (FIFRA); EPA MRL Regulations

attributes.name: food_safety_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether food safety systems (HACCP, FSMA, GFSI) were included in the audit scope. Supports FSMA Supplier Verification for Human Food (SVCP) compliance tracking.
attributes.references: FSMA SVCP; HACCP Codex Alimentarius; ISO 22000

attributes.name: gap_compliance_included
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) Compliance Scope Included
attributes.description: Indicates whether Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) compliance was included in the audit scope. Relevant for seed, produce, and raw agricultural commodity suppliers.
attributes.references: USDA Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) Program; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: gmp_compliance_included
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Compliance Scope Included
attributes.description: Indicates whether Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) compliance was included in the audit scope. Relevant for feed ingredient, fertilizer, and agrochemical suppliers.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 117 (GMP for Human Food); GMP+ International

attributes.name: major_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of major non-conformances identified during the audit. Major findings represent significant system failures or regulatory deviations that must be corrected within a defined timeframe to maintain supplier qualification status.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; SQF Code; BRC Global Standards

attributes.name: minor_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of minor non-conformances identified during the audit. Minor findings represent isolated deviations or opportunities for improvement that do not immediately threaten food safety or regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; SQF Code; BRC Global Standards

attributes.name: mrl_compliance_verified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Residue Limit (MRL) Compliance Verified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor's adherence to Maximum Residue Limit (MRL) requirements for crop protection chemicals and Active Ingredients (AI) was verified during the audit. Supports EPA and Codex Alimentarius MRL compliance.
attributes.references: EPA MRL Regulations; Codex Alimentarius MRL Standards; APHIS Import Requirements

attributes.name: next_scheduled_audit_date
attributes.description: The planned date for the next routine surveillance audit of this vendor, determined by audit frequency policy based on vendor risk tier and audit result history.
attributes.references: FSMA SVCP; GLOBALG.A.P. Certification Requirements; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements

attributes.name: observation_count
attributes.description: Number of audit observations recorded. Observations are noted areas of concern or improvement opportunities that do not constitute formal non-conformances but are tracked for trend analysis and continuous improvement.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; ISO 22000

attributes.name: re_audit_due_date
attributes.description: The target date by which the re-audit must be completed. Null when re_audit_required is False. Used for scheduling and compliance deadline tracking.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; FSMA SVCP

attributes.name: re_audit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a follow-up re-audit is required to verify that corrective actions have been effectively implemented. Typically set to True for failed audits or conditional passes with critical findings.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; FSMA SVCP; BRC Global Standards

attributes.name: sds_documentation_verified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Safety Data Sheet (SDS) Documentation Verified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor's Safety Data Sheet (SDS) documentation for chemical and biological inputs was reviewed and verified as current and compliant during the audit. Critical for EPA and OSHA compliance for agrochemical and fertilizer suppliers.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA; OSHA Hazard Communication Standard (HCS) 29 CFR 1910.1200; EPA SDS Requirements

attributes.name: supply_suspension_triggered
attributes.description: Indicates whether the audit result triggered an immediate suspension of purchasing activity from this vendor. Set to True when a failed audit or critical finding requires halting procurement to protect food safety or regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: FSMA SVCP; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Blocking

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the vendor audit record was last modified. Used for change tracking, data synchronization with SAP S/4HANA QM and Oracle NetSuite, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: vendor_facility_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the vendor facility location. Used for Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) compliance, import risk assessment, and FSMA Foreign Supplier Verification Program (FSVP) applicability determination.
attributes.references: USDA Country of Origin Labeling (COOL); FSMA Foreign Supplier Verification Program (FSVP); ISO 3166-1

attributes.name: vendor_facility_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific vendor facility or site that was audited. A single vendor may operate multiple facilities, each requiring independent audit records.
attributes.references: FSMA SVCP; GLOBALG.A.P. Certification Requirements

products.name: delivery_schedule
products.description: Planned delivery schedule for agricultural inputs under a vendor contract or blanket PO, aligned with seasonal crop planting calendars and livestock feeding programs. Captures schedule line number, PO or contract reference, input material, planned delivery date, scheduled quantity, delivery location (farm gate, grain elevator, warehouse, feed mill, fuel tank), transport mode (truck, rail, barge), carrier reference, bill of lading (BOL) number, estimated arrival window, and schedule status (planned, vendor-confirmed, in-transit, received, delayed, cancelled). Supports just-in-time delivery of perishable biologicals, seasonal fertilizer pre-positioning, and feed ingredient supply continuity planning.
products.reference: SAP MM Schedule Line (EKET) / TMS Delivery Plan

attributes.name: delivery_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each planned delivery schedule line within the procurement domain. Serves as the primary key for the delivery_schedule data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Schedule Line

attributes.name: agrochemical_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.agrochemical_product. Business justification: Delivery schedules for agrochemicals reference the specific product for hazmat transport compliance (UN number, hazmat class) and PHI/REI application timing planning. Product-level delivery scheduling

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: farm_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.farm_unit. Business justification: Input delivery schedules (seed, fertilizer, chemicals) are planned to specific farm units for seasonal application timing. Linking delivery_schedule to farm_unit enables logistics coordination, ensure
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link
