attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: growing_season_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to crop.growing_season. Business justification: Input delivery schedules are planned around planting windows within a growing season. A proper FK enables delivery-vs-planting-window compliance reporting and seasonal logistics planning. Replaces den
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: inbound_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.inbound_plan. Business justification: Procurement delivery schedule lines must map to supply inbound plans for dock scheduling, receiving resource allocation, and arrival window coordination. In agriculture, procurement schedules drive su
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: input_product_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.input_product. Business justification: Delivery schedules for input products reference the specific input for PHI/REI compliance planning and application timing coordination. Input-level delivery scheduling ensures agrochemicals arrive bef
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agricultural input material (seed, fertilizer NPK, crop protection chemical AI, feed ingredient, fuel, parts) being scheduled for delivery. Links to the material master for specifications, MRL compliance, and SDS documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Material Master; EPA MRL Compliance; SDS

attributes.name: planting_window_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to weather.planting_window. Business justification: Seed delivery schedules are fundamentally driven by planting windows — seeds must arrive before the window opens. Procurement planners set required delivery dates by referencing the planting window; t
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent Purchase Order (PO) or blanket PO under which this delivery schedule line is created. Links to the procurement PO master for contract terms, pricing, and vendor details.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - ME21N Purchase Order

attributes.name: receiving_storage_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.storage_location. Business justification: Agriculture delivery scheduling requires directing inbound shipments to specific grain elevators or warehouses for capacity planning and receiving dock scheduling. The existing delivery_location_id po
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: seed_variety_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.seed_variety. Business justification: Delivery schedules for seed procurement specify the variety being delivered. Seed delivery timing is variety-specific (planting window, maturity). Variety-level delivery scheduling is essential for pl
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the qualified vendor or supplier responsible for fulfilling this delivery schedule line. Supports vendor performance tracking and USDA/EPA-compliant supplier qualification records.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Vendor Master; USDA Supplier Qualification

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: The actual calendar date on which the agricultural input was physically received at the delivery location. Populated upon Goods Receipt Note (GRN) processing. Used for on-time delivery KPI calculation and vendor performance scoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - MIGO Goods Receipt; GRN Processing

attributes.name: bol_number
attributes.description: Bill of Lading (BOL) number issued by the carrier as the legal contract of carriage and receipt of goods. Required for FSMA traceability, COOL compliance, and AP invoice matching. Critical for agricultural chemical and biological shipment documentation.
attributes.references: FSMA Section 204 Traceability; COOL Regulations; UCC Article 7

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Name of the transportation carrier or logistics provider responsible for delivering the agricultural input. Used for carrier performance tracking and freight audit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Forwarding Agent; TMS Carrier Master

attributes.name: carrier_reference
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned reference or tracking number for the shipment. Enables real-time shipment tracking and exception management for in-transit deliveries.
attributes.references: TMS Carrier Reference; SAP S/4HANA MM - Shipment Number

attributes.name: coa_number
attributes.description: Certificate of Analysis (COA) document number provided by the vendor confirming the quality specifications of the delivered agricultural input (e.g., NPK analysis for fertilizers, AI concentration for crop protection chemicals, nutritional profile for feed ingredients).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM - Quality Certificate; GFSI COA Requirements; ISO 22000

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this delivery schedule record was first created in the system, sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM or Oracle NetSuite. Supports audit trail requirements under SOX financial reporting controls and FSMA traceability.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FSMA Traceability; SAP S/4HANA Audit Log

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the unit price and transaction value (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD). Required for multi-currency procurement operations and IFRS/GAAP financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS; GAAP

attributes.name: delay_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description explaining why a delivery schedule line has been delayed or cancelled. Supports supply chain risk analysis, vendor performance management, and contingency planning for critical agricultural inputs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Exception Management; GLOBALG.A.P. Supplier Performance

attributes.name: delivery_location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the delivery destination type. Determines receiving procedures, storage requirements, and compliance checks (e.g., feed mill requires FDA feed safety compliance; chemical warehouse requires SDS and EPA storage regulations). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: farm_gate|grain_elevator|warehouse|feed_mill|fuel_tank|processing_plant — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA Feed Safety Regulations; EPA Chemical Storage; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.119

attributes.name: estimated_arrival_end
attributes.description: End timestamp of the estimated arrival window at the delivery location. Together with estimated_arrival_start defines the delivery window for receiving operations and carrier coordination.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Inbound Delivery; TMS Delivery Window

attributes.name: estimated_arrival_start
attributes.description: Start timestamp of the estimated arrival window at the delivery location. Supports dock scheduling, receiving staff planning, and cold-chain management for perishable biologicals.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Inbound Delivery; Manhattan Associates WMS Receiving

attributes.name: grn_number
attributes.description: Goods Receipt Note (GRN) number generated upon physical receipt and inspection of the agricultural input at the delivery location. Triggers three-way match (PO-GRN-Invoice) in SAP S/4HANA MM and Oracle NetSuite AP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - MIGO GRN; Oracle NetSuite AP Three-Way Match; FSMA

attributes.name: incoterm_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (INCOTERMS) code defining the point of risk and cost transfer between vendor and buyer. Common agricultural trade terms include FOB (Free On Board) and CIF (Cost Insurance and Freight). Governs freight cost allocation and insurance responsibility.
attributes.references: ICC INCOTERMS 2020; SAP S/4HANA MM - Incoterms

attributes.name: input_category
attributes.description: Classification of the agricultural input material being delivered. Drives compliance workflows: crop protection chemicals require SDS and EPA/APHIS documentation; fertilizers require NPK specification; seeds require GMO and phytosanitary certificates. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: seed|fertilizer|crop_protection|feed_ingredient|fuel|parts|supplies — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA; APHIS Phytosanitary; USDA NOP; FDA FSMA

attributes.name: is_perishable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agricultural input is a perishable biological product (e.g., live beneficial insects, biostimulants, inoculants, vaccines) requiring cold-chain management and expedited just-in-time delivery. Triggers special handling and temperature monitoring requirements.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Preventive Controls; APHIS Biological Import Regulations

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this delivery schedule record. Tracks schedule revisions, status changes, and quantity adjustments. Required for data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer and SOX audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Change Log; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: Batch or Lot Number (LOT) assigned to the agricultural input shipment by the manufacturer or vendor. Enables end-to-end traceability from supplier to field application, supporting FSMA Section 204 traceability, recall management, and Certificate of Analysis (COA) matching.
attributes.references: FSMA Section 204 Traceability; SAP S/4HANA MM - Batch Management; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: phi_compliance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the delivered crop protection chemical requires Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) compliance tracking. When True, the receiving system must enforce PHI restrictions to ensure MRL compliance at harvest. Applicable to pesticides and herbicides with EPA-registered PHI requirements.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA PHI Requirements; FDA MRL Compliance; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: planned_delivery_date
attributes.description: The principal planned calendar date on which the agricultural input is scheduled to arrive at the delivery location. Aligned with seasonal crop planting calendars and livestock feeding program schedules to ensure timely availability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - ME38 Schedule Line Date; FMIS Crop Calendar

attributes.name: received_quantity
attributes.description: Actual quantity of agricultural input received and confirmed via Goods Receipt Note (GRN) processing. May differ from scheduled_quantity due to short shipments, overages, or quality rejections. Triggers AP invoice matching in Oracle NetSuite.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - MIGO GRN; Oracle NetSuite AP Three-Way Match

attributes.name: schedule_line_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the delivery schedule line, typically sourced from SAP S/4HANA MM scheduling agreement or Purchase Order (PO) schedule line. Used for cross-system reconciliation and vendor communication.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - ME38 Scheduling Agreement

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the delivery schedule line. Tracks progression from initial planning through vendor confirmation, transit, receipt, and exception states (delayed, cancelled). Supports just-in-time delivery monitoring and supply continuity planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Schedule Line Status; FSMA Supply Chain Controls

attributes.name: scheduled_quantity
attributes.description: The planned quantity of agricultural input material to be delivered on this schedule line, expressed in the base unit of measure (e.g., MT metric tons, BU bushels, CWT hundredweight, liters, units). Drives pre-positioning and inventory planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Schedule Line Quantity; USDA WASDE Units

attributes.name: sds_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Safety Data Sheet (SDS) is required for this delivery. Mandatory for crop protection chemicals, fertilizers, and fuel deliveries per EPA and OSHA Hazard Communication Standard (HazCom). SDS must accompany shipment documentation.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200 HazCom; EPA FIFRA; SDS GHS Standard

attributes.name: seasonal_program
attributes.description: Name or code of the seasonal agricultural program this delivery schedule supports (e.g., 'Spring Planting 2025', 'Fall Fertilizer Pre-Position', 'Q3 Feed Ingredient Program'). Enables grouping of schedule lines by crop season or livestock feeding cycle for supply continuity planning.
attributes.references: FMIS Crop Calendar; Granular Farm Management - Seasonal Planning

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Mode of transportation used for delivering the agricultural input. Common modes include truck (road), rail, barge (waterway), and air (for perishable biologicals). Influences BOL documentation requirements and freight cost allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Shipping Conditions; TMS Transport Mode; INCOTERMS

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for the scheduled and received quantities. Common agricultural units include MT (Metric Ton), BU (Bushel), CWT (Hundredweight), KG (Kilogram), LT (Liter), GAL (Gallon). Aligns with SAP S/4HANA base UOM configuration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MT|BU|CWT|KG|LT|GAL|TON|BAG|UNIT — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Unit of Measure; USDA Agricultural Measurement Standards

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: Contracted unit price for the agricultural input as agreed in the Purchase Order (PO) or vendor contract. Used for goods receipt valuation, AP invoice matching, and spend analytics. Classified as confidential due to commercial sensitivity of pricing terms.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - PO Pricing Conditions; Oracle NetSuite AP; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: vendor_confirmed_date
attributes.description: The delivery date formally confirmed by the vendor or supplier, which may differ from the planned delivery date. Used for vendor performance measurement and supply risk assessment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Vendor Confirmation; GLOBALG.A.P. Supplier Standards

products.name: budget
products.description: Procurement budget allocation record by input category, cost center, farm enterprise, and fiscal period. Captures budget period (annual/quarterly), input category (seed, fertilizer, agrochemical, feed, fuel, parts), allocated budget amount, committed spend (derived from open POs), actual spend to date, remaining budget, variance amount and percentage, budget owner, and last revision date. Enables OPEX control, CAPEX vs. OPEX classification for agricultural inputs, and spend analytics by category, season, and farm enterprise. Sourced from Granular Farm Management and SAP CO.
products.reference: Granular Farm Management Budget / SAP CO Cost Center Budget

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Primary key for budget

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who formally approved this procurement budget allocation. Distinct from the budget owner; the approver may be a finance controller or senior manager. Required for SOX compliance and audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors; SAP S/4HANA CO; SOX; GAAP

attributes.name: budget_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or manager formally accountable for this procurement budget. The budget owner is responsible for approving spend requests, monitoring variance, and authorizing budget revisions. Sourced from SAP SuccessFactors HR.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors; SAP S/4HANA CO; SOX financial controls

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: Procurement budgets in agriculture are allocated by commodity (e.g., corn seed budget, soybean fertilizer budget). Commodity-level budget tracking enables spend-to-budget reporting by crop and drives
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Procurement budgets in multi-entity agriculture operations are scoped to a legal entity for consolidated financial reporting, intercompany budget allocation, and USDA program payment tracking by entit
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP CO cost center to which this procurement budget is allocated. Enables OPEX/CAPEX tracking and spend analytics by organizational unit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO module; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: crop_enterprise_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.crop_enterprise_budget. Business justification: The procurement operational budget references the finance-side crop enterprise budget to ensure input procurement spending aligns with the crop-level financial plan. Supports integrated budget managem
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: farm_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the farm enterprise or business unit to which this budget is assigned. Supports spend analytics segmented by farm operation within the agricultural enterprise.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; SAP S/4HANA CO Profit Center

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Procurement budgets for agricultural inputs map to GL accounts (seed expense, fertilizer expense, pesticide expense) for budget vs. actual variance reporting. The existing gl_account_code is a denorma
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: actual_spend_amount
attributes.description: The total monetary value of procurement spend actually incurred to date against this budget, based on posted Goods Receipt Notes (GRNs) and approved vendor invoices processed through SAP MM/FI and Oracle NetSuite AP. Represents confirmed expenditure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/FI; Oracle NetSuite AP; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: allocated_amount
attributes.description: The total monetary amount formally allocated and approved for procurement spend within this budget record for the defined period and input category. Represents the authorized spending ceiling before any commitments or actuals are recorded.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; Granular Farm Management; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this procurement budget was formally approved by the designated approver. Marks the transition from draft to approved status and establishes the authorization date for audit and SOX compliance purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; SOX; GAAP

attributes.name: budget_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this procurement budget record within the ERP and farm management systems. Used for cross-system reconciliation between SAP CO and Granular Farm Management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; Oracle NetSuite; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: budget_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the procurement budget record (e.g., 'FY2025 Q2 Seed & Fertilizer - North Farm'). Used in reporting dashboards and budget owner communications.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; SAP CO

attributes.name: budget_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the procurement budget record. Draft budgets are under preparation; approved budgets are authorized for spend; active budgets have open commitments; frozen budgets are temporarily suspended; closed budgets have completed their period; cancelled budgets are voided.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; Granular Farm Management; GAAP

attributes.name: capex_opex_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) vs Operational Expenditure (OPEX) Classification
attributes.description: Indicates whether this procurement budget is classified as Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) for long-term asset acquisition (e.g., irrigation infrastructure, equipment) or Operational Expenditure (OPEX) for recurring inputs (e.g., seeds, fertilizers, agrochemicals, fuel). Critical for financial reporting under GAAP and IFRS.
attributes.references: GAAP; IFRS; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO

attributes.name: committed_amount
attributes.description: The total monetary value of open and confirmed Purchase Orders (POs) that have been raised against this budget but not yet invoiced or goods-receipted. Derived from open PO commitments in SAP MM. Represents encumbered budget that is no longer freely available.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/CO; Oracle NetSuite; GAAP commitment accounting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this procurement budget record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation event required for SOX financial controls and data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; SOX; GAAP; ISO 22000

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which all monetary amounts on this budget record are denominated (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency agricultural operations and IFRS reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period granularity of this budget record — annual for full-year budgets or quarterly (Q1–Q4) for sub-annual allocations. Supports both annual OPEX planning and quarterly reforecast cycles.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; Granular Farm Management; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year (e.g., 2025) to which this procurement budget allocation applies. Aligns with the agricultural enterprise's financial reporting calendar in SAP FI/CO.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: growing_season_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the agricultural growing season (e.g., 'SPRING-2025', 'FALL-2024') to which this procurement budget is aligned. Enables spend analytics by crop season, supporting seasonal OPEX planning and year-over-year comparison.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; USDA crop calendar; SAP S/4HANA CO

attributes.name: input_category
attributes.description: Classification of the agricultural input type covered by this budget record. Drives spend analytics by input category and supports NPK fertilizer, AI (Active Ingredient) agrochemical, and feed ingredient cost tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: seed|fertilizer|agrochemical|feed|fuel|parts|supplies|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA; EPA; APHIS; SAP S/4HANA MM material group; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: is_locked
attributes.description: Indicates whether this procurement budget record is locked against further modifications (True) or remains open for amendment (False). Budgets are typically locked at period close or upon reaching a frozen status to preserve financial integrity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; SOX; GAAP

attributes.name: last_revision_date
attributes.description: The date on which this procurement budget record was most recently revised or amended. Tracks the most recent budget adjustment event, supporting audit trails and reforecast cycle management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; Granular Farm Management; GAAP

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for budget owner or finance controller annotations, including justification for budget revisions, seasonal adjustments, or compliance notes related to EPA/APHIS regulated input categories such as agrochemicals.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: original_allocated_amount
attributes.description: The initial budget amount as approved at the start of the budget period, before any revisions or amendments. Preserved for variance analysis comparing original plan versus revised plan versus actuals — a key OPEX control metric.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; Granular Farm Management; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this budget period closes. Defines the boundary for spend commitment and actuals accumulation within this budget record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which this budget period becomes effective. For annual budgets this is typically the first day of the fiscal year; for quarterly budgets it is the first day of the quarter.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: SAP CO profit center code associated with this procurement budget, enabling profitability analysis by farm enterprise or crop production unit. Supports EBITDA reporting at the farm-level granularity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: remaining_amount
attributes.description: The unencumbered budget balance remaining for new procurement commitments, calculated as allocated_amount minus committed_amount minus actual_spend_amount. Provides real-time budget availability for procurement controllers and farm managers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; Granular Farm Management; GAAP

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential integer counter tracking how many times this procurement budget has been revised since initial approval. Version 0 represents the original approved budget; each subsequent amendment increments this counter. Supports budget reforecast audit trails.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; Granular Farm Management; SOX

attributes.name: spend_to_budget_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the allocated budget that has been consumed by actual spend to date (actual_spend_amount / allocated_amount × 100). A key KPI for procurement controllers to monitor budget utilization rate and flag potential overspend risk.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; Granular Farm Management; GAAP

attributes.name: transfer_in_amount
attributes.description: The total monetary amount transferred into this budget record from other budget lines or cost centers during the period. Supports budget reallocation tracking between input categories or farm enterprises.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: transfer_out_amount
attributes.description: The total monetary amount transferred out of this budget record to other budget lines or cost centers during the period. Together with transfer_in_amount, enables full reconciliation of budget movements.

products.name: vendor_product_approval
products.description: This association product represents the formal approval contract between an agricultural input product and a qualified vendor. It captures the operational Approved Vendor List (AVL) entry that procurement teams actively create, maintain, and revoke as part of supplier qualification processes. Each record links one input_product to one vendor with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific vendor-product qualification pairing — including approval status, preferred rank, negotiated pricing, lead time, and quality performance history.. Existence Justification: In agricultural procurement, an approved vendor list (AVL) is a formally managed operational construct where each input product (fertilizer, pesticide, seed treatment) is qualified against multiple approved vendors, and each vendor is approved to supply multiple input products. The business actively creates, maintains, and revokes these vendor-product approvals with specific terms (pricing, lead time, preferred rank, approval status) that belong to neither the input product nor the vendor alone. This is a classic supply agreement / vendor qualification pattern that is operationally managed, not analytically derived.

products.name: vendor_commodity_approval
products.description: This association product represents the formal approval contract between a vendor and a commodity within the agricultural procurement domain. It captures the Approved Supplier List (ASL) entry that the procurement team actively manages — recording which vendors are approved to supply which commodities, under what grade standards, at what price basis, with what lead times, and at what preferred rank. Each record links one commodity to one approved vendor and carries attributes that exist only in the context of that specific vendor-commodity supply relationship. This is the operational record that governs sourcing decisions and supplier qualification at the commodity level.. Existence Justification: In agricultural procurement, vendors are formally approved to supply specific commodities under defined terms — a vendor supplies multiple commodities (corn, soybeans, wheat) and each commodity is sourced from multiple approved vendors. The business actively manages this relationship as a 'Vendor-Commodity Approval' or 'Approved Supplier List' entry, tracking grade standards, pricing basis, lead times, preferred rank, and organic supply eligibility per vendor-commodity pair. These attributes cannot reside on either the vendor or commodity master alone because they are specific to the intersection of a particular vendor supplying a particular commodity.

products.name: approved_vendor_item
products.description: This association product represents the Approved Vendor Item (AVI) contract between a vendor and an input catalog entry in the procurement domain. It captures the operational sourcing agreement that procurement teams actively manage — recording which vendors are approved to supply which agricultural inputs, under what commercial terms, and with what certification and approval status. Each record links one vendor to one input catalog item and carries attributes that exist only in the context of this specific vendor-input sourcing relationship, including negotiated price, lead time, minimum order quantity, approval lifecycle, and certification verification.. Existence Justification: In agricultural procurement, vendors are approved to supply multiple inputs and each input can be sourced from multiple vendors — this is the well-established Approved Vendor List (AVL) or Vendor-Item Master concept actively managed by procurement teams. Each vendor-input combination carries its own negotiated price, lead time, minimum order quantity, approval status, and certification verification, which cannot reside on either the vendor or input catalog record alone. Procurement stakeholders explicitly manage this as a named business entity, querying 'which vendors are approved for this input?' and 'which inputs can this vendor supply?'

products.name: vendor_certification
products.description: This association product represents the Vendor Certification contract between a vendor and a sustainability certification scheme. It captures the specific instance of a vendor holding a particular sustainability or food-safety certification, including the certificate number, scope of coverage, certified crop types, supply chain stage, audit outcomes, and validity dates. Each record links one vendor to one sustainability certification and carries attributes that exist only in the context of that specific vendor-certification relationship — data that cannot reside on either the vendor master or the certification scheme master without duplication or loss of fidelity.. Existence Justification: In agriculture, a single vendor (e.g., a seed company or agrochemical supplier) actively holds multiple sustainability certifications simultaneously — GLOBALG.A.P., RSPO, Rainforest Alliance, USDA Organic — each with its own scope, audit cycle, and expiry. Conversely, a single certification scheme (e.g., Rainforest Alliance) is issued to many vendors across the supply chain. The business actively manages this relationship as a 'Vendor Certification' record, tracking which certifications a vendor holds, under what scope, for which crop types, and with what audit outcomes — data that belongs to neither the vendor master nor the certification scheme master alone.

domains.name: research
domains.description: Governs agricultural R&D data including variety trial results, seed performance benchmarks, soil amendment experiments, IPM efficacy studies, GMO trait evaluations, and precision agriculture technology pilots. Manages experimental designs, trial plot assignments, field trial metadata, statistical analysis outputs, and IP/patent records. Supports USDA APHIS biotech regulatory submissions, crop improvement programs, sustainable farming practices, and internal innovation pipeline tracking.
domains.references: USDA APHIS Biotech, Internal R&D Standards

products.name: trial
products.description: Master record for all agricultural field trials, R&D experiments, and technology evaluations conducted by the research organization. Captures trial name, type (variety/soil_amendment/IPM/GMO_trait/precision_ag), objective, hypothesis, status (planned/active/completed/cancelled), start and end dates, lead researcher, sponsoring program, and trial phase. Type-specific attributes are captured per trial type: for variety trials, links to evaluated variety records; for GMO trait evaluations, captures trait event name, transformation event code, trait type, regulatory submission status, containment protocol, stewardship requirements, and evaluation phase; for IPM efficacy studies, captures pest target organism, efficacy rating, economic threshold, resistance management classification, and MRL compliance; for precision ag pilots, captures technology type, vendor/partner, target KPI, pilot scale, and integration system reference. Tracks key lifecycle milestones (protocol approval, planting, mid-season review, harvest, data lock, report submission). SSOT for all experimental programs, IPM studies, GMO trait evaluations, and precision ag pilots in the research domain.

attributes.name: centroid_longitude

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: crop_variety_code

attributes.name: data_collection_method

Affects data quality assessment and statistical analysis approach.

attributes.name: disease_rating
attributes.description: Quantitative or categorical disease pressure score recorded for this variety in this trial. Reflects the variety's disease response under the specific environmental conditions of the trial.

attributes.name: exclusion_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the reason this plot was excluded from statistical analysis or abandoned (e.g., flood damage, equipment malfunction, pest outbreak, contamination from adjacent treatment). attributes.name: experimental_design_type

RCBD = Randomized Complete Block Design; CRD = Completely Randomized Design; ALPHA = Alpha-Lattice Design; LATIN_SQUARE = Latin Square Design; SPLIT_PLOT = Split-Plot Design; STRIP_TRIAL = Strip Trial Design. Determines the statistical analysis model applied to plot-level results.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Research Service Statistical Design Standards; GLOBALG.A.P. Trial Protocol

attributes.name: gps_boundary_polygon
attributes.description: GIS polygon representing the precise GPS boundary coordinates of the trial plot, stored as a Well-Known Text (WKT) or GeoJSON string. Enables spatial analysis, variable rate application mapping, and integration with Esri ArcGIS and John Deere Operations Center field mapping.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Geospatial Standards; ISO 19125 Geographic Information; GLOBALG.A.P. Spatial Data Requirements

attributes.name: harvest_date

attributes.name: is_control
attributes.description: Indicates whether this treatment represents the control group (untreated check or standard practice baseline) in the experimental design. Essential for statistical analysis and yield response calculations.
attributes.references: ISO 11658 Field Experimentation; USDA NIFA Experimental Design Standards

attributes.name: is_gmo
attributes.description: Indicates whether the seed variety or biological treatment involves a Genetically Modified Organism (GMO). Required for USDA APHIS biotech regulatory submissions, COOL labeling compliance, and export documentation.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services; USDA National Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard; EU GMO Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for agronomists and research scientists to capture additional treatment details, deviations from protocol, special handling instructions, or observations not captured in structured fields. Sourced from Trimble Ag Software crop scouting and Climate FieldView trial records.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Trial Documentation Standards; USDA NIFA Research Reporting

attributes.name: npk_nitrogen_rate
attributes.description: Rate of Nitrogen (N) component in the fertilizer treatment expressed in the treatment's unit of measure (e.g., lb N/ac). Part of the NPK (Nitrogen-Phosphorus-Potassium) nutrient management plan. Applicable when treatment_type = 'fertilizer'.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Nutrient Management Practice Standard 590; EPA Clean Water Act Nutrient Management; GLOBALG.A.P. Fertilizer Module

attributes.name: npk_phosphorus_rate
attributes.description: Rate of Phosphorus (P) component in the fertilizer treatment expressed in the treatment's unit of measure (e.g., lb P2O5/ac). Part of the NPK (Nitrogen-Phosphorus-Potassium) nutrient management plan. Applicable when treatment_type = 'fertilizer'.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Nutrient Management Practice Standard 590; EPA Clean Water Act Nutrient Management; GLOBALG.A.P. Fertilizer Module

attributes.name: npk_potassium_rate
attributes.description: Rate of Potassium (K) component in the fertilizer treatment expressed in the treatment's unit of measure (e.g., lb K2O/ac). Part of the NPK (Nitrogen-Phosphorus-Potassium) nutrient management plan. Applicable when treatment_type = 'fertilizer'.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Nutrient Management Practice Standard 590; EPA Clean Water Act Nutrient Management; GLOBALG.A.P. Fertilizer Module

attributes.name: phi_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days required between the last application of the treatment and crop harvest, as specified on the EPA-registered label. Critical for food safety compliance and MRL adherence under FSMA and Codex Alimentarius standards.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA PHI Label Requirements; FDA FSMA Produce Safety Rule; Codex Alimentarius MRL Standards

attributes.name: planned_application_date
attributes.description: Scheduled calendar date for applying the treatment in the field trial. Used for trial planning, equipment scheduling, and Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) and Restricted Entry Interval (REI) compliance pre-calculation.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Trial Management; EPA FIFRA PHI/REI Compliance Planning

attributes.name: regulatory_approval_status
attributes.description: Current regulatory approval status of the treatment for use on the target crop in the applicable jurisdiction (e.g., EPA-approved, USDA APHIS experimental use permit, restricted use). Critical for compliance gate checks in trial planning and USDA APHIS biotech regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 3/18/24c Registration; USDA APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services; FDA FSMA

attributes.name: rei_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours workers must stay out of treated fields after application, as mandated by EPA Worker Protection Standard (WPS). Required for OSHA and EPA compliance and workforce safety management.
attributes.references: EPA Worker Protection Standard (WPS); OSHA 29 CFR 1928.110; EPA FIFRA Label Requirements

attributes.name: replication_count
attributes.description: Number of replications (plot repetitions) of this treatment within the experimental design. Fundamental to statistical validity of trial results and required for USDA NIFA research reporting and peer-reviewed publication standards.
attributes.references: USDA NIFA Experimental Design Standards; ISO 11658 Field Experimentation; SAS/STAT Experimental Design Guidelines

attributes.name: seed_variety_code
attributes.description: Proprietary or industry-standard code identifying the seed variety used in a seed variety treatment (e.g., Pioneer P1197 AM, Dekalb DKC62-08). Links to seed lot and variety trial records. Applicable when treatment_type = 'seed_variety'.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Plant Variety Protection; GLOBALG.A.P. Seed Traceability; UPOV Convention

attributes.name: sequence
attributes.description: Ordinal sequence number of this treatment within the trial's treatment list (e.g., T1, T2, T3). Used for randomization, plot assignment, and statistical analysis output alignment in replicated experimental designs.
attributes.references: ISO 11658 Field Experimentation; USDA NIFA Experimental Design Standards

attributes.name: target_crop
attributes.description: The crop species or commodity for which this treatment is designed and registered (e.g., corn, soybean, wheat, cotton). Required for EPA FIFRA label use site compliance and USDA APHIS biotech regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Use Site Classification; USDA NASS Crop Classification; GLOBALG.A.P. Crop Base Module

attributes.name: target_pest_or_weed
attributes.description: The specific pest, disease, weed, or abiotic stress the treatment is designed to control or mitigate (e.g., 'Gray Leaf Spot', 'Waterhemp', 'Corn Rootworm', 'Nitrogen deficiency'). Supports Integrated Pest Management (IPM) efficacy studies and scouting observation linkage.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Pest Classification; USDA APHIS IPM Standards; GLOBALG.A.P. Integrated Pest Management Module

attributes.name: tillage_method
attributes.description: Soil tillage practice applied as part of the treatment (e.g., conventional, no-till, strip-till, reduced tillage). Applicable when treatment_type = 'tillage'. Supports soil health analytics and carbon sequestration reporting under ISCC and sustainability frameworks.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Conservation Tillage Standards; ISCC Carbon Certification; GLOBALG.A.P. Soil Management Module

attributes.name: trait_description
attributes.description: Description of the target agronomic trait or experimental outcome the treatment is designed to evaluate or improve (e.g., 'Herbicide tolerance - glyphosate', 'Drought resistance - improved root architecture', 'Yield improvement - nitrogen use efficiency'). Supports crop improvement program tracking and IP/patent records.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Biotech Regulatory Framework; USDA NIFA Crop Improvement Programs; UPOV Convention

attributes.name: treatment_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the treatment within a trial or across the research program. Used in field notebooks, statistical analysis outputs, and regulatory submissions (e.g., USDA APHIS biotech submissions).
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services; ISO 11658 Field Experimentation Standards

attributes.name: treatment_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the treatment (e.g., 'Pioneer P1197 AM + 120 lb N/ac', 'Azoxystrobin 6 fl oz/ac', 'Drip Irrigation 1.2 ET Replacement'). Used in reports, dashboards, and scientific publications.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Trial Documentation Standards; USDA NIFA Research Reporting

attributes.name: treatment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the treatment record within the experimental workflow. Drives trial management dashboards and data quality gates in the research pipeline.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Trial Management; USDA APHIS Biotech Regulatory Submission Workflow

attributes.name: treatment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the treatment category applied in the experiment. Drives downstream analytics and regulatory reporting pathways. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: seed_variety|fertilizer|crop_protection|irrigation|tillage|precision_ag|biological|control|soil_amendment|inoculant — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA NIFA Research Classification; GLOBALG.A.P. Integrated Farm Assurance; EPA FIFRA Treatment Classification

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this treatment record was last modified. Supports data lineage, change management, and audit trail requirements under FSMA, GLOBALG.A.P., and SOX compliance frameworks.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Record-Keeping Requirements; GLOBALG.A.P. Audit Trail Standards; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: vra_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this treatment is configured for Variable Rate Application (VRA) using precision agriculture technology (e.g., Trimble Ag Software VRA prescriptions, John Deere Operations Center). Enables spatial analytics and prescription map linkage.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Precision Agriculture Standards; Trimble Ag Software VRA Protocol; John Deere Operations Center Field Mapping

products.name: experimental_design
products.description: Captures the statistical design, standardized operating protocol (SOP), and execution procedures for each trial. Includes design type (RCBD, CRD, Latin Square, Split-Plot, Strip Trial), number of replications and treatments, blocking structure, randomization seed, statistical power target, alpha level, and design generation software. Governs trial execution protocols: planting date windows, seeding rate specifications, fertilizer application schedules, irrigation management rules, scouting frequency, data collection methods, harvest procedures, and data quality acceptance criteria. Captures protocol version, effective date, approval status, approving agronomist, SOP reference, and GMP/GAP compliance flags. Links to the parent trial and governs how trial_plot assignments and treatment randomization are structured. SSOT for trial methodology, protocol, and standard operating procedures in the research domain.
products.reference: SAS / R Statistical Design / FMIS Experimental Design

attributes.name: experimental_design_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each experimental design record in the research domain. Primary key for the experimental_design data product.
attributes.references: ISO 11179 - Metadata Registry

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the licensed agronomist who reviewed and approved this experimental design protocol. Required for regulatory compliance and GMP audit trail.
attributes.references: USDA NIFA Research Standards; GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices); GLOBALG.A.P. Responsible Person

attributes.name: program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.program. Business justification: Experimental designs are standardized within research programs. Programs define standard protocols and SOPs. Links design templates to their governing program.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: trial_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent field trial that this experimental design governs. Links the design to its associated trial entity in the research domain.
attributes.references: USDA NIFA Research Standards; GLOBALG.A.P. Trial Documentation

attributes.name: alpha_level
attributes.description: Type I error rate (alpha) for hypothesis testing in this experimental design, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0500 = 5%). Governs statistical significance thresholds for treatment comparisons.
attributes.references: USDA NIFA Statistical Design Standards; ISO 3534-3 Statistical Vocabulary

attributes.name: aphis_submission_ref
attributes.description: USDA APHIS (Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service) regulatory submission reference number for biotech/GMO trial designs. Populated only when gmo_trial_flag is True. Required for confined field trial permits.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services; 7 CFR Part 340; APHIS (Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service) Permit System

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the experimental design protocol. Controls whether trial plots can be assigned and field operations can commence. Drives GMP/GAP compliance workflow.
attributes.references: GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices); GAP (Good Agricultural Practices); FSMA Preventive Controls Rule

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the experimental design protocol was formally approved by the designated agronomist. Immutable audit record for GMP and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices); FSMA Preventive Controls Rule; ISO 9001

attributes.name: block_count
attributes.description: Number of blocking units in the experimental design. Applicable for RCBD, Split-Plot, and Alpha-Lattice designs. Null for CRD where no blocking is applied.
attributes.references: USDA NIFA Statistical Design Standards; Cochran & Cox Experimental Designs

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this experimental design record was first created in the system. Immutable audit field supporting data lineage, GMP compliance, and SOX financial reporting controls.
attributes.references: GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices); SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); ISO 9001 Record Control

attributes.name: cv_threshold_pct
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable Coefficient of Variation (CV) percentage for yield or primary response variable measurements. Trials exceeding this CV threshold are flagged for review before inclusion in variety performance databases.
attributes.references: USDA NIFA Statistical Design Standards; ISO 3534-3 Statistical Vocabulary; CIMMYT Trial Analysis Standards

attributes.name: data_collection_method
attributes.description: Primary method used to collect trial plot observations and measurements. Determines data pipeline integration (e.g., Climate FieldView for combine monitor, John Deere Operations Center for IoT/telematics, Trimble for digital tablet).
attributes.references: USDA NIFA Research Standards; GAP (Good Agricultural Practices); FMIS (Farm Management Information System) Integration Standards

attributes.name: data_quality_acceptance_criteria
attributes.description: Narrative description of the data quality thresholds and acceptance rules for this experimental design (e.g., maximum allowable CV%, missing data tolerance, outlier exclusion rules). Governs which plot observations are included in final analysis.
attributes.references: USDA NIFA Research Standards; GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices); ISO 17025 Laboratory Competence

attributes.name: design_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this experimental design across systems (e.g., FMIS, Trimble Ag, Granular). Used for cross-system referencing and regulatory submissions to USDA APHIS.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services; GLOBALG.A.P. Trial Identification

attributes.name: design_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the scientific objectives, hypotheses, and key design decisions for this experimental design. Provides context for agronomists, statisticians, and regulatory reviewers.
attributes.references: USDA NIFA Research Standards; GLOBALG.A.P. Trial Documentation

attributes.name: design_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the experimental design (e.g., 'Corn Hybrid Yield Trial RCBD 2024 - Iowa'). Used in reports, dashboards, and regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: USDA NIFA Research Standards; ISO 11179

attributes.name: design_software
attributes.description: Name and version of the statistical software used to generate the experimental design and randomization (e.g., 'R v4.3.1 - agricolae package', 'SAS v9.4 PROC PLAN', 'Agrobase Generation II'). Required for reproducibility.
attributes.references: USDA NIFA Statistical Design Standards; GMP Reproducibility Requirements; ISO 17025

attributes.name: design_type
attributes.description: Statistical design type governing plot layout and treatment randomization. RCBD = Randomized Complete Block Design; CRD = Completely Randomized Design. Determines blocking structure and analysis model. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: RCBD|CRD|Latin_Square|Split_Plot|Strip_Trial|Augmented|Alpha_Lattice — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA NIFA Statistical Design Standards; Cochran & Cox Experimental Designs; ISO 3534-3 Statistical Vocabulary

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this experimental design protocol version becomes operative and governs trial execution. Used to determine which protocol version applies to a given planting season.
attributes.references: GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices); FSMA Preventive Controls Rule; ISO 9001

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which this protocol version is no longer valid and must be superseded. Null indicates the protocol remains in effect until explicitly superseded.
attributes.references: GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices); ISO 9001 Document Control

attributes.name: fertilizer_schedule_ref
attributes.description: Reference code or document identifier for the standardized NPK (Nitrogen Phosphorus Potassium) fertilizer application schedule prescribed for this experimental design. Links to the nutrient management plan.
attributes.references: GAP (Good Agricultural Practices); EPA Nutrient Management; USDA NRCS 590 Nutrient Management Practice Standard

attributes.name: gap_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this experimental design protocol has been verified as compliant with GAP (Good Agricultural Practices) standards. Required for GLOBALG.A.P. certification and USDA organic program eligibility.
attributes.references: GAP (Good Agricultural Practices); GLOBALG.A.P. Certification Standard; USDA National Organic Program (NOP)

attributes.name: gmo_trial_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this experimental design involves GMO (Genetically Modified Organism) traits or biotech events. When True, triggers mandatory USDA APHIS BPRE/BRS regulatory submission workflow and containment protocol requirements.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services (BRS); 7 CFR Part 340; GMO (Genetically Modified Organism) Regulations

attributes.name: gmp_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this experimental design protocol meets GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices) requirements for research-grade data integrity and documentation. Required for FDA-regulated crop research and food safety submissions.
attributes.references: GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices); FDA 21 CFR Part 211; FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act)

attributes.name: harvest_procedure_ref
attributes.description: Reference code to the standardized harvest procedure document specifying plot combine settings, moisture adjustment protocols, and yield data capture requirements for this experimental design.
attributes.references: GAP (Good Agricultural Practices); GLOBALG.A.P. Harvest Module; Climate FieldView Harvest Data Standards

attributes.name: irrigation_management_rule
attributes.description: Irrigation management protocol applied uniformly across all trial plots. ET (Evapotranspiration)-based and soil moisture-triggered rules require IoT sensor integration. Rainfed indicates no supplemental irrigation.
attributes.references: GAP (Good Agricultural Practices); USDA NRCS Irrigation Water Management; ET (Evapotranspiration) Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this experimental design record was most recently updated. Supports change detection, audit trail, and protocol version management in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices); SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); ISO 9001 Record Control

attributes.name: min_plot_size_sqm
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable plot size in square meters as specified by the experimental design protocol. Plots below this threshold are flagged as non-compliant and excluded from statistical analysis.
attributes.references: USDA NIFA Trial Plot Standards; GLOBALG.A.P. Trial Documentation; ISO 3534-3

attributes.name: planting_window_end
attributes.description: Latest acceptable planting date for trial plots under this experimental design protocol. Planting outside this window invalidates the trial data per protocol acceptance criteria.
attributes.references: GAP (Good Agricultural Practices); GLOBALG.A.P. Crop Base Module; USDA NIFA Trial Protocols

attributes.name: planting_window_start
attributes.description: Earliest acceptable planting date for trial plots under this experimental design protocol. Defines the opening of the planting date window to ensure agronomic validity of results.
attributes.references: GAP (Good Agricultural Practices); GLOBALG.A.P. Crop Base Module; USDA NIFA Trial Protocols

attributes.name: primary_response_variable
attributes.description: The principal agronomic measurement or outcome variable that this experimental design is powered to detect (e.g., 'grain yield BU/acre', 'plant stand count', 'disease severity rating'). Drives statistical power calculations and analysis model selection.
attributes.references: USDA NIFA Research Standards; ISO 3534-3 Statistical Vocabulary; CIMMYT Trial Analysis Standards

attributes.name: protocol_version
attributes.description: Version number of the experimental design protocol document (e.g., '1.0', '2.3'). Enables version control and audit trail for protocol amendments. Required for USDA APHIS biotech regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services; GMP Version Control; ISO 9001 Document Control

attributes.name: randomization_seed
attributes.description: Numeric seed value used by the design generation software to produce the treatment randomization sequence. Enables exact reproducibility of the randomization for audit and re-analysis purposes.
attributes.references: USDA NIFA Statistical Design Standards; ISO 3534-3; GMP Reproducibility Requirements

attributes.name: replication_count
attributes.description: Number of replications (blocks or repetitions) specified in the experimental design. Directly determines statistical power and the minimum number of trial plots required.
attributes.references: USDA NIFA Statistical Design Standards; Cochran & Cox Experimental Designs; ISO 3534-3

attributes.name: scouting_frequency_days
attributes.description: Minimum required interval in days between crop scouting observations for trial plots under this design. Governs IPM (Integrated Pest Management) monitoring cadence and data collection scheduling.
attributes.references: IPM (Integrated Pest Management) Standards; GAP (Good Agricultural Practices); GLOBALG.A.P. Crop Protection Module

attributes.name: seeding_rate_target
attributes.description: Standardized target seeding rate specified in the protocol for all trial plots, expressed in seeds per acre. Deviations beyond the tolerance threshold trigger a data quality flag.
attributes.references: GAP (Good Agricultural Practices); GLOBALG.A.P. Crop Base Module; Trimble Ag VRA Prescription Standards

attributes.name: seeding_rate_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the target seeding rate specification (e.g., seeds per acre, kg per hectare). Ensures consistent interpretation across geographies and reporting systems.
attributes.references: GAP (Good Agricultural Practices); USDA NIFA Trial Protocols; ISO 80000-1 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: sop_reference
attributes.description: Reference code to the governing Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) document that defines execution procedures for this experimental design. Links to the document management system.
attributes.references: GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices); GAP (Good Agricultural Practices); GLOBALG.A.P. Control Points

attributes.name: statistical_power_target
attributes.description: Target statistical power (1 - beta) for the experimental design, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.8000 = 80%). Used to validate that replication count is sufficient to detect the minimum detectable difference.
attributes.references: USDA NIFA Statistical Design Standards; ISO 3534-3 Statistical Vocabulary; Cohen (1988) Statistical Power Analysis

attributes.name: treatment_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct treatments (including controls) defined in this experimental design. Governs the number of treatment randomization assignments per replication.
attributes.references: USDA NIFA Statistical Design Standards; ISO 3534-3 Statistical Vocabulary

products.name: variety
products.description: Master catalog of crop varieties, germplasm accessions, breeding material, and gene bank holdings evaluated or maintained by the research organization. For released and candidate varieties: variety name, crop species, variety code, maturity group, GMO trait status, trait stack description, breeder, seed company, registration status, USDA APHIS deregulation status, plant patent or PVP certificate number, and key agronomic characteristics. For germplasm accessions and gene bank entries: accession number, crop species, collection origin (country, GPS), collection date, storage location (cold storage/cryogenic), viability status, last germination test date, germination rate %, available seed quantity (grams), donor organization, and CGIAR/USDA GRIN cross-reference. Captures entry stage (accession/wild_relative/landrace/elite_line/experimental_hybrid/pre-commercial/released) to distinguish pipeline position. SSOT for variety, germplasm, and accession identity in the research domain.
products.reference: USDA APHIS Variety Registration / GLOBALG.A.P. Seed Catalog

attributes.name: variety_id
attributes.description: Primary key for variety

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: Research varieties are developed for specific commodity markets and must meet commodity specifications for commercial release. Linking research varieties to the commodity master enables MRL compliance
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: seed_vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor. Business justification: variety.seed_company is a denormalized text reference to the seed supplier. Linking to procurement.vendor via seed_vendor_id enables seed sourcing decisions, vendor qualification checks, and contract
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: sustainability_certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.sustainability_certification. Business justification: Seed marketing and organic program compliance require linking variety records to the sustainability certifications that govern their use (e.g., USDA Organic certification for organic-eligible varietie
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: variety_cgiar_accession_id
attributes.description: Cross-reference identifier from the CGIAR (Consultative Group on International Agricultural Research) genebank system. Supports international germplasm exchange and biodiversity conservation tracking.
attributes.references: CGIAR Genebank Standards; FAO ITPGRFA; Nagoya Protocol on Access and Benefit Sharing

attributes.name: variety_grin_accession_id
attributes.description: Cross-reference identifier from the USDA Germplasm Resources Information Network (GRIN) database for germplasm accessions. Enables interoperability with national and international gene bank systems.
attributes.references: USDA GRIN; FAO International Treaty on Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture (ITPGRFA)

attributes.name: accession_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned to a germplasm accession or gene bank entry by the holding institution. Used for cross-referencing with USDA GRIN and CGIAR genebank systems.
attributes.references: USDA GRIN (Germplasm Resources Information Network); CGIAR Genebank Standards; FAO ITPGRFA

attributes.name: aphis_deregulation_status
attributes.description: Status of the USDA Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS) biotechnology deregulation petition for GMO varieties. Required for commercial release of biotech crops in the United States.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services (7 CFR Part 340); FSMA

attributes.name: available_seed_quantity_g
attributes.description: Current quantity of seed available in the gene bank for the accession, measured in grams. Used for inventory management, distribution planning, and regeneration threshold monitoring.
attributes.references: CGIAR Genebank Standards; FAO Genebank Standards for Plant Genetic Resources; USDA GRIN

attributes.name: breeder_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual plant breeder or lead scientist responsible for developing the variety. Used for IP attribution, patent filings, and PVP certificate applications.
attributes.references: USDA Plant Variety Protection (PVP) Office; UPOV Convention Article 17

attributes.name: collection_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the germplasm was originally collected. Required for ITPGRFA compliance and country-of-origin documentation.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; FAO ITPGRFA; Nagoya Protocol; USDA GRIN

attributes.name: collection_date
attributes.description: Date on which the germplasm sample was originally collected from the field, wild habitat, or donor organization. Used for viability tracking and provenance documentation.
attributes.references: USDA GRIN; CGIAR Genebank Standards; FAO ITPGRFA

attributes.name: collection_latitude
attributes.description: GPS latitude coordinate (decimal degrees, WGS84) of the original germplasm collection site. Used for geographic diversity analysis and GIS mapping in Esri ArcGIS.
attributes.references: USDA GRIN; CGIAR Genebank Standards; Esri ArcGIS; FAO ITPGRFA

attributes.name: collection_longitude
attributes.description: GPS longitude coordinate (decimal degrees, WGS84) of the original germplasm collection site. Used for geographic diversity analysis and GIS mapping in Esri ArcGIS.
attributes.references: USDA GRIN; CGIAR Genebank Standards; Esri ArcGIS; FAO ITPGRFA

attributes.name: common_crop_name
attributes.description: Common or trade name of the crop (e.g., Corn, Soybean, Wheat, Cotton, Rice). Used for business reporting and non-scientific communication.
attributes.references: USDA PLANTS Database; FAO Crop Ontology

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the variety or germplasm record was first created in the research data system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: crop_species
attributes.description: Botanical species name (genus and species) of the crop, e.g., Zea mays (corn), Glycine max (soybean), Triticum aestivum (wheat). Follows standard taxonomic nomenclature.
attributes.references: USDA PLANTS Database; Codex Alimentarius Commission; CGIAR Genebank Standards

attributes.name: disease_resistance_profile
attributes.description: Narrative or coded summary of the variety's documented resistance or tolerance ratings to key crop diseases (e.g., SCN, gray leaf spot, fusarium head blight). Used for IPM planning and variety recommendation.
attributes.references: USDA ARS; EPA; Integrated Pest Management (IPM) guidelines; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: donor_organization
attributes.description: Name of the institution, organization, or individual that donated the germplasm accession to the gene bank. Required for benefit-sharing compliance under the Nagoya Protocol and ITPGRFA.
attributes.references: FAO ITPGRFA; Nagoya Protocol on Access and Benefit Sharing; CGIAR Genebank Standards

attributes.name: entry_stage
attributes.description: Pipeline position of the variety or germplasm entry, distinguishing between gene bank holdings and active breeding pipeline stages. Drives workflow routing in the research and commercialization process. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: accession|wild_relative|landrace|elite_line|experimental_hybrid|pre_commercial|released — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CGIAR Genebank Standards; USDA GRIN; GLOBALG.A.P. Crop Protection Module

attributes.name: germination_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of seeds that successfully germinated in the most recent viability test. A key indicator of accession health; values below 85% typically trigger regeneration protocols per CGIAR standards.
attributes.references: CGIAR Genebank Standards; ISTA (International Seed Testing Association); FAO Genebank Standards

attributes.name: gmo_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the variety contains genetically modified organism (GMO) traits as defined by USDA APHIS and FDA regulations. Critical for regulatory submissions, labeling compliance (COOL, USDA NOP), and export documentation.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services; FDA; EPA; ISO 21569 (GMO detection methods); FSMA

attributes.name: herbicide_tolerance_traits
attributes.description: Description of herbicide tolerance traits present in the variety (e.g., glyphosate tolerance, glufosinate tolerance, dicamba tolerance). Critical for crop protection planning and MRL compliance.
attributes.references: EPA; USDA APHIS; Maximum Residue Limit (MRL) regulations; FSMA

attributes.name: ip_protection_type
attributes.description: Type of intellectual property protection applied to the variety. Determines licensing terms, technology use agreements, and commercialization restrictions.
attributes.references: USDA Plant Variety Protection Act; USPTO Plant Patent Act (35 U.S.C. § 163); UPOV Convention

attributes.name: last_germination_test_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent germination viability test conducted on the germplasm accession. Used to schedule next testing cycle per genebank standards (typically every 5–10 years).
attributes.references: CGIAR Genebank Standards; FAO Genebank Standards for Plant Genetic Resources; ISTA (International Seed Testing Association)

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the variety or germplasm record. Used for change tracking, data synchronization, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: maturity_group

attributes.description: NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) value recorded at or near the harvest date for the trial plot. Correlates canopy greenness with yield outcomes and supports precision agriculture analytics.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for agronomists and research staff to record observations about harvest conditions, equipment anomalies, crop lodging, pest damage, or other factors affecting yield measurement accuracy.

attributes.name: plot_area_ha
attributes.description: Measured area of the trial plot in hectares at the time of harvest. Used to calculate per-unit yield (BU/acre or MT/ha) from gross harvested weight. Sourced from Esri ArcGIS field mapping.
attributes.references: USDA NASS Crop Reporting Standards; Esri ArcGIS Geospatial Standards

attributes.name: quality_flag
attributes.description: Data quality assessment flag assigned during Silver Layer validation. Identifies records that passed automated quality checks, failed validation rules, or require manual review before inclusion in statistical yield analysis.
attributes.references: GFSI Global Food Safety Initiative; ISO 22000; GLOBALG.A.P. Crop Base Module

attributes.name: replication_number
attributes.description: Experimental replication number assigned to this trial plot within the trial design. Essential for statistical analysis of variance (ANOVA) and yield mean separation across treatments.
attributes.references: USDA NASS Statistical Methods; GLOBALG.A.P. Crop Base Module

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: Native identifier of this yield measurement record in the originating operational system (e.g., Climate FieldView harvest record ID, John Deere Operations Center field operation ID). Enables cross-system traceability and deduplication.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule; Climate FieldView; John Deere Operations Center

attributes.name: standard_moisture_pct
attributes.description: Industry-standard moisture percentage used as the basis for adjusted yield calculation (e.g., 15.5% for corn, 13.0% for soybeans). Defined per crop species per USDA GIPSA grading standards.
attributes.references: USDA GIPSA Grain Inspection and Grading Standards; USDA NASS

attributes.name: test_weight_kg_hl
attributes.description: Bulk density of the harvested grain expressed in kilograms per hectoliter (kg/hL). Indicates grain quality, maturity, and market grade per USDA GIPSA grading standards. Affects commodity pricing and storage planning.
attributes.references: USDA GIPSA Grain Inspection and Grading Standards; Codex Alimentarius Commission

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this yield measurement record was last modified in the data platform. Tracks data corrections, quality flag updates, and statistical validation changes for audit compliance.
attributes.references: FSMA Traceability Rule; GLOBALG.A.P. Crop Base Module; SOX Financial Reporting Controls

attributes.name: yield_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure in which the adjusted yield is expressed. Supports multi-unit reporting across North American (BU/acre, CWT/acre) and international (MT/ha, kg/ha) markets per USDA and Codex Alimentarius standards.
attributes.references: USDA NASS Crop Reporting Standards; Codex Alimentarius Commission; WASDE

Research-domain SSOT for trial-linked soil data — distinct from the land domain which owns operational soil health records for production fields.
