attributes.name: trial_plot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific research trial plot from which this soil sample was collected. Links soil analytical results to experimental design units for amendment and variety trial analysis.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Biotech Regulatory Submission Framework; GLOBALG.A.P. Trial Documentation Standards

attributes.name: analysis_package
attributes.description: Tier of laboratory analysis requested for this soil sample, determining which analytes are measured. Options range from basic (pH, EC, NPK) to full profile (all macro/micro-nutrients, texture, bulk density). Drives lab cost allocation and research scope.
attributes.references: Internal R&D Laboratory SOP; ISO 17025

attributes.name: bulk_density_g_cm3
attributes.description: Dry bulk density of the soil sample measured in grams per cubic centimetre (g/cm³). Indicates soil compaction level; used to assess tillage treatment effects and root penetration resistance in precision agriculture technology pilots.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey Manual; ISO 11272 Bulk Density Determination

attributes.name: calcium_ppm
attributes.description: Exchangeable calcium (Ca) concentration in the soil sample measured in parts per million (ppm). Secondary macro-nutrient affecting soil structure, pH buffering, and cell wall integrity in trial crops.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey Manual; ISO 11260

attributes.name: cec_meq_100g
attributes.description: CEC (Cation Exchange Capacity) of the soil measured in milliequivalents per 100 grams, indicating the soil's ability to retain and supply cations (nutrients) to plants. Fundamental parameter for fertiliser recommendation models in research trials.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey Manual; ISO 23470 CEC Determination

attributes.name: clay_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of clay-sized particles (<0.002 mm) in the soil sample by weight. Clay content directly influences CEC (Cation Exchange Capacity), shrink-swell behaviour, and nutrient retention in research trial soils.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey Manual; ISO 11277

attributes.name: coa_document_ref
attributes.description: Reference number or URL to the COA (Certificate of Analysis) document issued by the laboratory, containing the official certified analytical results. Required for regulatory submissions to USDA APHIS and internal quality assurance sign-off.
attributes.references: ISO 17025; USDA APHIS Biotech Regulatory Submission; FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this soil sample record was first created in the research data system. Supports audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity); Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: ec_ds_m
attributes.description: Soil EC (Electrical Conductivity) measured in deciSiemens per metre (dS/m), indicating soil salinity level. High EC values can inhibit crop germination and growth; used to design salt-tolerant variety trials and irrigation management experiments.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey Manual; ISO 11265 Soil EC Determination

attributes.name: iron_ppm
attributes.description: Plant-available iron (Fe) micro-nutrient concentration in the soil sample measured in parts per million (ppm). Iron availability is pH-dependent and critical for chlorophyll production; monitored in soil pH amendment research.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey Manual; ISO 14870

attributes.name: is_baseline_sample
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this soil sample represents the pre-treatment baseline characterisation for a trial plot (True) or a post-treatment monitoring sample (False). Baseline samples are used as the control reference in amendment efficacy statistical analysis.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Experimental Design Guidelines; Internal R&D Trial Protocol

attributes.name: lab_name
attributes.description: Name of the accredited external or internal laboratory that performed the soil chemical and physical analysis. Required for result traceability, audit compliance, and inter-laboratory comparison studies.
attributes.references: ISO 17025; USDA Agricultural Laboratory Proficiency Program

attributes.name: lab_submission_ref
attributes.description: External reference number assigned by the accredited soil testing laboratory upon receipt of the sample. Used for chain-of-custody tracking, COA (Certificate of Analysis) retrieval, and audit trail linkage to lab reports.
attributes.references: ISO 17025 Laboratory Accreditation; USDA NRCS Soil Testing Protocols

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: GPS (Global Positioning System) latitude coordinate in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum) of the exact soil sampling point. Enables GIS (Geographic Information System) spatial analysis and variability mapping across trial plots.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Spatial Reference Standards; WGS84 Datum; GLOBALG.A.P. Field Record Requirements

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: GPS (Global Positioning System) longitude coordinate in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum) of the exact soil sampling point. Used in conjunction with latitude for precise geospatial referencing and spatial interpolation of soil properties.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Spatial Reference Standards; WGS84 Datum; GLOBALG.A.P. Field Record Requirements

attributes.name: magnesium_ppm
attributes.description: Exchangeable magnesium (Mg) concentration in the soil sample measured in parts per million (ppm). Secondary macro-nutrient essential for chlorophyll synthesis; used in soil amendment experiment design for trial plots.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey Manual; ISO 11260

attributes.name: nitrogen_ppm
attributes.description: Total nitrogen (N) concentration in the soil sample measured in parts per million (ppm). Part of the NPK (Nitrogen Phosphorus Potassium) macro-nutrient profile; used to calibrate nitrogen fertilisation rates in crop improvement trials.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey Manual; ISO 13878 Total Nitrogen Determination

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for agronomists and field technicians to record qualitative observations at the time of sampling, such as visible soil disturbance, unusual colour, odour, recent flooding, or equipment anomalies that may affect result interpretation.
attributes.references: Internal R&D Field Data Collection SOP

attributes.name: number_of_subsamples
attributes.description: Count of individual sub-sample cores or grabs composited to form this soil sample. Relevant for composite sampling designs; higher sub-sample counts improve spatial representativeness of trial plot characterisation.
attributes.references: ISO 18400-101; USDA NRCS Soil Sampling Protocols

attributes.name: organic_matter_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of OM (Organic Matter) in the soil sample by weight, reflecting soil biological activity, carbon sequestration potential, and long-term fertility. Key baseline metric for soil amendment and cover crop research experiments.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey Manual; ISO 14235 Organic Carbon Determination; ISCC Carbon Certification

attributes.name: ph_method
attributes.description: Analytical method used to determine soil pH, such as water suspension, calcium chloride (CaCl2), or potassium chloride (KCl). Method affects the numeric result and must be recorded for inter-laboratory comparability.
attributes.references: ISO 10390; USDA NRCS Soil Survey Manual

attributes.name: ph_value
attributes.description: Measured pH (Potential of Hydrogen) of the soil sample, indicating soil acidity or alkalinity on a scale of 0–14. Critical for nutrient availability modelling, lime amendment prescriptions, and crop suitability assessments in trial plots.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey Manual; ISO 10390 Soil pH Determination

attributes.name: phosphorus_ppm
attributes.description: Plant-available phosphorus (P) concentration in the soil sample measured in parts per million (ppm). Part of the NPK (Nitrogen Phosphorus Potassium) macro-nutrient profile; critical for root development and energy transfer in trial crop varieties.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey Manual; ISO 11263 Phosphorus Determination

attributes.name: potassium_ppm
attributes.description: Exchangeable potassium (K) concentration in the soil sample measured in parts per million (ppm). Part of the NPK (Nitrogen Phosphorus Potassium) macro-nutrient profile; influences water regulation and disease resistance in trial plots.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey Manual; ISO 11260 Potassium Determination

attributes.name: results_received_date
attributes.description: Date on which the laboratory analysis results were received and ingested into the research data system. Used to calculate lab turnaround time and to trigger downstream amendment experiment design workflows.
attributes.references: ISO 17025; Internal SOP for Soil Data Management

attributes.name: sample_code
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally referenceable identifier for the soil sample, used on lab submission forms, chain-of-custody documents, and COA (Certificate of Analysis) reports. Follows the enterprise soil sample coding convention.
attributes.references: ISO 18400 Soil Sampling Standards; USDA NRCS Soil Survey Manual

attributes.name: sample_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the soil sample from field collection through laboratory analysis to result approval. Drives workflow routing in the FMIS (Farm Management Information System) and lab management processes.
attributes.references: ISO 17025 Laboratory Accreditation; Internal QM Workflow

attributes.name: sampled_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the field technician or agronomist who physically collected the soil sample. Required for chain-of-custody documentation and experimental reproducibility audits.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Chain of Custody; ISO 18400 Soil Sampling

attributes.name: sampling_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the soil sample was physically collected from the trial plot or research field. Critical for temporal alignment with crop growth stages, amendment application events, and seasonal soil health tracking.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey Manual; ISO 18400-101

attributes.name: sampling_depth_cm
attributes.description: Depth in centimetres at which the soil sample was collected from the surface. Standard agronomic depths include 0–15 cm (topsoil), 15–30 cm (subsoil), and 30–60 cm (deep profile). Essential for interpreting nutrient availability and root-zone characterisation.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey Manual; ISO 18400-203

attributes.name: sampling_method
attributes.description: Physical technique used to collect the soil sample, such as composite (multiple sub-samples blended), grab (single point), core, auger, or probe. Affects result representativeness and must be documented for experimental reproducibility.
attributes.references: ISO 18400-101 Soil Sampling Strategy; USDA NRCS Soil Sampling Protocols

attributes.name: sand_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of sand-sized particles (0.05–2.0 mm) in the soil sample by weight. Used with silt and clay percentages to verify texture class assignment and support precision soil amendment modelling.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey Manual; ISO 11277

attributes.name: silt_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of silt-sized particles (0.002–0.05 mm) in the soil sample by weight. Combined with sand and clay fractions to determine soil texture class and water retention characteristics for trial plot baseline data.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey Manual; ISO 11277

attributes.name: sulfur_ppm
attributes.description: Plant-available sulfur (S) concentration in the soil sample measured in parts per million (ppm). Secondary macro-nutrient important for protein synthesis; tracked in research trials evaluating sulfur amendment efficacy.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey Manual; ISO 11048

attributes.name: texture_class
attributes.description: USDA soil texture classification based on the relative proportions of sand, silt, and clay particles. Determines water-holding capacity, drainage characteristics, and tillage requirements for trial plot baseline characterisation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sand|loamy_sand|sandy_loam|loam|silt_loam|silt|sandy_clay_loam|clay_loam|silty_clay_loam|sandy_clay|silty_clay|clay — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Texture Classification; ISO 11277 Particle Size Distribution

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this soil sample record, such as when laboratory results were ingested or the sample status was changed. Supports incremental data pipeline processing and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: water_holding_capacity_pct
attributes.description: Maximum percentage of water the soil can retain against gravity, expressed as a percentage of dry soil weight. Key parameter for irrigation scheduling research, drought-tolerance variety trials, and ET (Evapotranspiration) modelling.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey Manual; ISO 11274 Water Retention Characteristics

attributes.name: zinc_ppm
attributes.description: Plant-available zinc (Zn) micro-nutrient concentration in the soil sample measured in parts per million (ppm). Zinc deficiency is a common limiting factor in crop production; tracked in micro-nutrient amendment trials.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey Manual; ISO 14870

products.name: treatment_application
products.description: Transactional record of each treatment application event on a trial plot, including full input material traceability and consumption tracking. Captures application date and time, applied treatment reference, actual application rate, unit of measure, application method (broadcast/banded/foliar/drip), equipment used, operator ID, weather conditions at application (temperature, wind speed, humidity), PHI (Pre-Harvest Interval) compliance flag, and REI (Restricted Entry Interval) end datetime. Captures protocol deviation notes. Includes complete input material records: seed lot, fertilizer batch, crop protection product reference (LOT/GRN), soil amendment batch, quantity consumed, cost per unit, total cost, and inventory drawdown reference. Supports regulatory traceability of materials used in USDA APHIS-regulated trials, research COGS tracking, input efficacy correlation analysis, and research-specific input consumption reporting.

Captures analysis run date, statistical method, software reference (SAS/R/JMP), response variable, trial and experimental design reference, and analyst ID. Supports publication-ready trial reporting, seed selection recommendations, commercial variety release decisions, and internal crop improvement decision-making. attributes.description: Reference to the field trial or experiment from which this statistical result was derived. Links the analytical output back to its source experimental design and plot data.

attributes.name: alpha_level
attributes.description: The significance threshold (alpha level) used for hypothesis testing and mean separation in this analysis (e.g., 0.05 for 5%, 0.10 for 10%). Determines the critical values for LSD, HSD, and significance codes.
attributes.references: ISO 3534 Statistics Vocabulary; SAS Proc GLM; USDA NIFA Research Standards

attributes.name: analysis_run_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the statistical analysis was executed. Used for versioning analytical outputs and tracking when results were generated relative to trial completion.

attributes.name: analysis_run_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the statistical analysis job was executed, including timezone offset. Enables exact reproducibility tracking and audit of analytical pipeline runs.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard; USDA NIFA Research Data Standards

attributes.name: analysis_type
attributes.description: Classification of the statistical method category applied to generate this result. ANOVA = Analysis of Variance; MET = Multi-Environment Trial analysis; GGE biplot = Genotype plus Genotype-by-Environment biplot for stability analysis; mean_separation = LSD/HSD/Tukey post-hoc tests. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ANOVA|regression|mean_separation|MET|GGE_biplot|stability|correlation|descriptive|mixed_model|path_analysis — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAS Institute Statistical Methods; R Statistical Computing; JMP Pro; USDA NIFA Research Standards

attributes.name: check_variety_mean
attributes.description: Mean value of the response variable for the check variety in this analysis. Provides the absolute performance baseline against which experimental varieties are compared. Expressed in the same units as response_variable_unit.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Variety Registration Standards; GLOBALG.A.P. Variety Trial Protocols

attributes.name: check_variety_name
attributes.description: Name of the check or control variety used as the performance benchmark in the trial. Variety performance is often expressed relative to the check. Required for commercial variety release decisions and seed selection recommendations.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Variety Registration Standards; GLOBALG.A.P. Variety Trial Protocols; APHIS Biotech Regulatory Submissions

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this statistical result record was first created and persisted in the data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SOX Financial Reporting Controls; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity)

attributes.name: crop_year
attributes.description: The agricultural crop year (e.g., 2024) in which the trial data was collected. Used for temporal stratification of variety performance benchmarks and multi-year trend analysis.
attributes.references: USDA WASDE Crop Year Definitions; GLOBALG.A.P. Trial Documentation

attributes.name: cv_pct
attributes.description: Coefficient of Variation expressed as a percentage (CV%), calculated as (standard deviation / grand mean) × 100. Measures experimental precision and data quality. CV% values above 20% for yield trials typically indicate poor experimental control per USDA guidelines.
attributes.references: USDA NIFA Research Data Standards; SAS Proc GLM; ISO 5725 Accuracy and Precision

attributes.name: disease_resistance_rating
attributes.description: Aggregated disease resistance performance rating for the variety or treatment derived from the statistical analysis, typically on a 1-9 scale (1=highly susceptible, 9=highly resistant) or 0-100 percent scale. Supports IPM (Integrated Pest Management) efficacy studies and variety release decisions.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Plant Disease Rating Standards; GLOBALG.A.P. IPM Protocols; ISO 22000 Food Safety Management

attributes.name: environment_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct environments (location-year combinations) included in a Multi-Environment Trial (MET) analysis. A higher count increases the reliability of stability estimates. Applicable when analysis_type is MET, GGE_biplot, or stability.
attributes.references: USDA NIFA MET Analysis Standards; Finlay-Wilkinson Regression; GGE Biplot Methodology

attributes.name: f_statistic
attributes.description: The F-statistic value from the ANOVA table for the primary treatment effect. Ratio of treatment mean square to error mean square. Used to assess whether treatment differences are statistically meaningful.
attributes.references: SAS Proc GLM/Mixed ANOVA Output; ISO 3534 Statistics Vocabulary

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or agro-ecological zone where the trial was conducted (e.g., 'Corn Belt', 'Delta', 'Northern Plains', 'Southeast'). Used for MET (Multi-Environment Trial) regional performance benchmarking and seed selection recommendations by geography.
attributes.references: USDA AMS Geographic Regions; GLOBALG.A.P. Regional Trial Standards; Esri ArcGIS GIS Classification

attributes.name: grand_mean
attributes.description: Overall mean value of the response variable across all treatments and replications in the analysis. Serves as the baseline for interpreting treatment effects and computing relative performance metrics.
attributes.references: USDA NIFA Research Data Standards; SAS Proc GLM Output Standards

attributes.name: hsd_value
attributes.description: Tukey's Honestly Significant Difference (HSD) value at the specified alpha level. More conservative than LSD; used when all pairwise comparisons are of interest. Stored alongside LSD to support different reporting standards.
attributes.references: Tukey HSD Method; SAS Proc GLM; JMP Pro; USDA NIFA Research Standards

attributes.name: is_publication_ready
attributes.description: Indicates whether this statistical result has been reviewed, approved, and is ready for inclusion in external publications, regulatory submissions, or public trial reports. True = approved for publication; False = internal use only or pending review.
attributes.references: USDA NIFA Research Publication Standards; APHIS Biotech Regulatory Submission Requirements

attributes.name: lsd_value
attributes.description: Fisher's Least Significant Difference (LSD) value at the specified alpha level. Two treatment means differing by more than this value are considered statistically different. Standard mean separation metric in agronomic variety trials.
attributes.references: Fisher LSD Method; SAS Proc GLM LSMeans; USDA NIFA Research Standards; GLOBALG.A.P. Variety Trial Protocols

attributes.name: p_value
attributes.description: Probability value (p-value) for the primary treatment effect in the ANOVA or regression analysis. Values below the significance threshold (typically 0.05 or 0.10) indicate statistically significant treatment differences. Core output for publication-ready trial reporting.
attributes.references: SAS Proc GLM/Mixed; R lme4; JMP Pro; ISO 3534 Statistics Vocabulary; USDA NIFA Research Standards

attributes.name: r_squared
attributes.description: Coefficient of determination (R²) from the statistical model, ranging 0 to 1. Indicates the proportion of total variation in the response variable explained by the model. Used to assess model fit quality in regression and ANOVA analyses.
attributes.references: SAS Proc GLM/Reg Output; R lm/lme4; JMP Pro; ISO 3534 Statistics Vocabulary

attributes.name: replication_count
attributes.description: Number of replications per treatment in the experimental design. Directly affects statistical power and the reliability of mean estimates. Standard field trials use 3-4 replications per USDA protocols.
attributes.references: USDA NIFA Research Data Standards; ISO 3534 Statistics Vocabulary

attributes.name: response_variable
attributes.description: The dependent variable or agronomic trait being analyzed (e.g., 'yield_bu_acre', 'plant_height_cm', 'test_weight_lbs_bu', 'disease_severity_pct', 'standability_score'). Defines what outcome the statistical model is measuring.
attributes.references: USDA NIFA Research Data Standards; GLOBALG.A.P. Variety Trial Protocols

attributes.name: response_variable_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measurement for the response variable (e.g., 'BU/acre', 'MT/ha', 'kg/ha', 'cm', 'score 1-9', 'percent'). Required for correct interpretation of all quantitative result fields. Aligns with BU (Bushel) and MT (Metric Ton) standard agricultural units.
attributes.references: USDA NIFA Research Data Standards; ISO 80000 Quantities and Units; BU/MT/CWT agricultural standards

attributes.name: result_code
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this statistical result record, following the format SR-{DOMAIN}-{YEAR}-{SEQUENCE} (e.g., SR-YIELD-2024-00042). Used for cross-referencing in publications, regulatory submissions, and internal reports.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Biotech Regulatory Submission Standards; GLOBALG.A.P. Documentation

attributes.name: result_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for analyst annotations, data quality observations, model assumptions, outlier notes, or contextual information relevant to interpreting this statistical result. Supports scientific rigor and peer review processes.
attributes.references: USDA NIFA Research Data Standards; ISO 5725 Accuracy and Precision

attributes.name: result_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the statistical result record. Draft indicates in-progress analysis; preliminary indicates initial outputs pending peer review; final indicates approved and publication-ready; superseded indicates replaced by a newer analysis run; retracted indicates withdrawn due to data quality issues.
attributes.references: USDA NIFA Research Data Standards; GLOBALG.A.P. Trial Reporting

attributes.name: significance_code
attributes.description: Conventional significance notation derived from the p-value: ns = not significant (p>0.10); * = significant at p≤0.05; ** = highly significant at p≤0.01; *** = very highly significant at p≤0.001. Standard notation used in agronomic publication tables.
attributes.references: SAS Proc GLM Output Conventions; R Statistical Computing; USDA NIFA Publication Standards

attributes.name: software_name
attributes.description: Name of the statistical software platform used to execute the analysis (e.g., SAS, R, JMP). Required for reproducibility documentation and regulatory submissions to USDA APHIS. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SAS|R|JMP|Genstat|ASReml|Python|SPSS — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Biotech Regulatory Submission Standards; USDA NIFA Research Data Standards

attributes.name: software_version
attributes.description: Version number of the statistical software used (e.g., 'SAS 9.4', 'R 4.3.1', 'JMP Pro 17'). Critical for reproducibility — different versions may produce slightly different numerical outputs.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Biotech Regulatory Submission Standards; ISO 5725

attributes.name: stability_index
attributes.description: Quantitative stability index value for variety performance across environments, derived from Finlay-Wilkinson regression (regression coefficient b) or Eberhart-Russell variance of deviations. Values near 1.0 (Finlay-Wilkinson) indicate average stability. Critical for commercial variety release decisions and seed selection recommendations.
attributes.references: Finlay-Wilkinson Regression (1963); Eberhart-Russell Stability (1966); GGE Biplot Methodology; USDA NIFA MET Analysis Standards

attributes.name: stability_method
attributes.description: The specific stability analysis method used to compute the stability_index. Finlay-Wilkinson and Eberhart-Russell are regression-based; GGE biplot and AMMI are multivariate. Required to correctly interpret the stability_index value.
attributes.references: Finlay-Wilkinson Regression (1963); Eberhart-Russell (1966); GGE Biplot (Yan et al.); AMMI Model; USDA NIFA MET Standards

attributes.name: standability_score
attributes.description: Statistical mean standability score for the variety or treatment, measuring resistance to lodging (stalk or root). Typically rated on a 1-9 scale. Critical agronomic trait for commercial variety release and harvest efficiency assessment.
attributes.references: USDA NIFA Agronomic Trait Standards; GLOBALG.A.P. Variety Trial Protocols

attributes.name: standard_error
attributes.description: Standard error of the treatment mean for the response variable. Quantifies the precision of the mean estimate. Published in trial result tables alongside treatment means for scientific reporting.
attributes.references: SAS Proc GLM/Mixed LSMeans Output; ISO 3534 Statistics Vocabulary; USDA NIFA Research Standards

attributes.name: statistical_method
attributes.description: Specific statistical procedure or algorithm applied (e.g., 'Two-way ANOVA with interaction', 'Finlay-Wilkinson regression', 'REML mixed model', 'Tukey HSD', 'Fisher LSD', 'Eberhart-Russell stability', 'AMMI'). Provides methodological detail beyond the analysis_type classification for reproducibility and publication.
attributes.references: SAS Institute Proc GLM/Mixed; R lme4/agricolae packages; JMP Pro; ISO 5725 Accuracy of Measurement Methods

attributes.name: treatment_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct treatments or varieties included in the analysis. Used to contextualize degrees of freedom, mean separation results, and the breadth of the comparative study.
attributes.references: USDA NIFA Research Data Standards; ISO 3534 Statistics Vocabulary

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this statistical result record. Tracks revisions to analytical outputs, corrections, or re-analysis events.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SOX Financial Reporting Controls

attributes.name: actual_end_date

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which field operations commenced, which may differ from the planned start date due to weather delays, equipment availability, or regulatory approval timing. Supports schedule variance analysis.
attributes.references: Internal R&D Project Management SOP; USDA NRCS Conservation Practice Standard

attributes.name: aphis_submission_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS) Submission Reference Number
attributes.description: USDA APHIS-assigned reference number for the regulatory notification or permit associated with this pilot (e.g., for GMO trait evaluations or biotech field trials). Null if aphis_submission_required is False.

attributes.name: aphis_submission_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS) Submission Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pilot involves regulated biotechnology (GMO traits, gene editing) requiring a USDA APHIS regulatory submission or notification under 7 CFR Part 340. Critical for compliance workflow triggering.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS 7 CFR Part 340 Biotechnology Regulations; FSMA Preventive Controls Rule

attributes.name: approved_budget
attributes.description: Total approved budget allocated to the pilot program in the reporting currency. Used for CAPEX/OPEX planning, R&D investment tracking, and ROI calculation post-pilot. Classified confidential due to commercial sensitivity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module Budget Management; GAAP ASC 730; IFRS IAS 38; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the pilot program record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under SOX financial reporting controls and FSMA traceability requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; FSMA Traceability Rule; ISO 22000 Record Management

attributes.name: crop_species
attributes.description: Primary crop species under evaluation in the pilot (e.g., Zea mays for corn, Glycine max for soybean, Triticum aestivum for wheat). Enables cross-pilot analysis by crop and alignment with USDA NASS commodity reporting.
attributes.references: USDA PLANTS Database; GRIN Taxonomy; GLOBALG.A.P. Crop Base Module

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this pilot record (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency financial consolidation in Oracle NetSuite and SAP S/4HANA FI module.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: data_sharing_agreement
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal data sharing agreement exists with the technology vendor or research partner governing the use of pilot-generated field data. Critical for GDPR compliance in international operations and proprietary data protection.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 28 Data Processing Agreements; Internal Data Governance Policy; Salesforce CRM Partner Agreement Registry

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual date on which field operations for the pilot program conclude. Nullable for open-ended pilots. Triggers post-pilot analysis workflows and budget closure in SAP S/4HANA CO module.
attributes.references: Internal R&D Project Management SOP; SAP S/4HANA CO Module Project Settlement

attributes.name: gmo_involved
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pilot involves genetically modified organism (GMO) varieties or biotech traits. Triggers USDA APHIS compliance workflows, COOL labeling requirements, and IP protection protocols.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Biotechnology Regulations; COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) Requirements; GLOBALG.A.P. GMO Module

attributes.name: integration_system
attributes.description: Primary operational system of record that the pilot integrates with for data ingestion and field operations management. Drives ETL pipeline configuration and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Lakehouse silver layer. attributes.name: ip_protection_type
attributes.description: Type of intellectual property protection applied to innovations developed through this pilot. Drives IP management workflows, licensing decisions, and R&D capitalization under GAAP ASC 730 and IFRS IAS 38. Classified confidential due to commercial sensitivity.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 730 R&D Costs; IFRS IAS 38 Intangible Assets; USDA Plant Variety Protection (PVP) Act; USPTO Patent Classification

attributes.name: kpi_unit
attributes.business_glossary_term: Key Performance Indicator (KPI) Unit of Measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the target KPI baseline and goal values. Ensures consistent interpretation across pilot programs (e.g., pct for percentage-based KPIs, bu_ac for yield in bushels per acre, mt_ha for metric tons per hectare).
attributes.references: USDA National Agricultural Statistics Service (NASS) Unit Standards; ISO 80000-1 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the pilot program record. Supports change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Lakehouse silver layer and audit trail compliance under SOX and GDPR.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity; ISO 22000 Record Management

attributes.name: pilot_code
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the pilot program (e.g., PAG-VRA-2024-0001). Used in cross-system references, vendor communications, and regulatory submissions to USDA APHIS.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Biotech Regulatory Submission Standards; Internal FMIS Naming Convention

attributes.name: pilot_name
attributes.description: Descriptive human-readable name of the pilot program (e.g., 'RTK-Guided VRA Corn Trial 2024 — Iowa'). Used in reporting dashboards, FMIS records, and stakeholder communications.
attributes.references: Internal R&D Program Management Standard

attributes.name: pilot_objective
attributes.description: Narrative description of the primary business objective the pilot is designed to achieve (e.g., 'Reduce nitrogen input by 15% while maintaining yield parity using VRA prescriptions'). Supports innovation pipeline tracking and USDA grant reporting.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Conservation Innovation Grant Requirements; Internal R&D SOP

attributes.name: pilot_scale_acres
attributes.description: Total land area enrolled in the pilot program measured in acres. Used for resource planning, cost-per-acre analysis, and scaling decisions. Aligns with John Deere Operations Center field mapping and Esri ArcGIS spatial records.
attributes.references: USDA Farm Service Agency (FSA) Field Acreage Reporting; John Deere Operations Center Field Mapping Standard

attributes.name: pilot_scale_ha
attributes.description: Total land area enrolled in the pilot program measured in hectares. Supports international reporting and metric-system compliance for GLOBALG.A.P. and ISO 22000 submissions alongside the acre-based measure.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Inspection Criteria; ISO 80000-1 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: pilot_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the pilot program. Drives workflow routing, budget release, and reporting eligibility. Values: draft (planning phase), active (in-field execution), on_hold (temporarily suspended), completed (concluded with results), cancelled (terminated before completion).
attributes.references: Internal R&D Lifecycle Management Policy; ISO 22000 Program Management

attributes.name: protocol_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the formal pilot protocol document (SOP) stored in the document management system. Ensures experimental design reproducibility and supports USDA APHIS regulatory submissions and GFSI audit readiness.
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; GLOBALG.A.P. Inspection Criteria; Internal SOP Management Policy

attributes.name: results_summary
attributes.description: Narrative summary of key pilot outcomes and findings upon completion. Populated at pilot conclusion to support go/no-go scaling decisions, innovation pipeline reporting, and USDA NIFA grant final reports.
attributes.references: USDA NIFA Grant Reporting Requirements; Internal R&D Innovation Pipeline Governance

attributes.name: scale_up_recommendation
attributes.description: Post-pilot recommendation from the lead agronomist and R&D committee on whether to scale the technology to full commercial deployment. Drives innovation pipeline stage-gate decisions and CAPEX planning in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: Internal R&D Stage-Gate Innovation Process; GLOBALG.A.P. Continuous Improvement Standard

attributes.name: secondary_integration_system
attributes.description: Secondary operational system of record involved in the pilot (e.g., Esri ArcGIS for spatial mapping alongside John Deere Operations Center for telematics). Supports multi-system data lineage documentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: john_deere_operations_center|climate_fieldview|trimble_ag|granular|esri_arcgis|sap_s4hana|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Integration Standard; Internal Data Architecture Governance

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual date on which field operations for the pilot program commence. Used for timeline management, growing season alignment, and regulatory submission scheduling with USDA APHIS.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Biotech Regulatory Submission Timeline; Internal R&D Project Management SOP

attributes.name: target_kpi
attributes.description: Primary KPI the pilot is designed to improve or validate. OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) for autonomous equipment trials, yield_uplift_pct for crop improvement pilots, input_reduction_pct for VRA and IPM efficacy studies, ndvi_improvement for drone sensing pilots, fuel_reduction_pct and labor_reduction_pct for automation trials.
attributes.references: Internal KPI Framework; GLOBALG.A.P. Continuous Improvement Standard; ISO 22000

attributes.name: target_kpi_baseline_value
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Key Performance Indicator (KPI) Baseline Value
attributes.description: Pre-pilot baseline measurement of the target KPI against which pilot outcomes will be benchmarked (e.g., current OEE of 72.5, current yield of 185.0 bu/ac). Enables statistically valid ROI and uplift calculations post-pilot.
attributes.references: Internal R&D Statistical Analysis Protocol; USDA Economic Research Service Benchmarking

attributes.name: target_kpi_goal_value
attributes.business_glossary_term: Target Key Performance Indicator (KPI) Goal Value
attributes.description: Quantified target value for the primary KPI that defines pilot success (e.g., OEE of 85.0, yield uplift of 10%). Used in go/no-go decision gates and innovation pipeline scoring.
attributes.references: Internal R&D Innovation Pipeline Governance; GLOBALG.A.P. Benchmarking Standard

attributes.name: technology_category
attributes.description: Broad functional category grouping the technology type for portfolio analysis and R&D investment reporting. Sensing (NDVI, IoT sensors), Application (VRA, irrigation), Navigation (RTK, GPS), Analytics (AI/ML, NDVI analytics), Automation (autonomous equipment), Connectivity (IoT networks, DTN integration).
attributes.references: USDA Precision Agriculture Framework; ISO 11783 (ISOBUS) Agricultural Electronics Standard

attributes.name: technology_type
attributes.description: Classification of the precision agriculture technology being evaluated (e.g., RTK-guided VRA, drone-based NDVI sensing, IoT soil moisture network, AI-driven planting prescription, autonomous equipment). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rtk_vra|drone_ndvi|iot_soil_moisture|ai_planting_prescription|autonomous_equipment|satellite_imagery|variable_rate_irrigation|yield_mapping — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center Technology Classification; Trimble Ag Software Technology Registry; USDA Precision Agriculture Framework

products.name: telemetry_event
products.description: Captures IoT and telematics data events generated during precision agriculture pilot operations, including GPS-tagged equipment position, sensor readings (soil moisture, EC, temperature), NDVI drone scan results, VRA controller logs, and RTK positioning accuracy records. Captures event timestamp, device or sensor ID, pilot reference, plot reference, reading type, value, unit, and data quality flag. Supports real-time and post-season analysis of precision ag technology performance.
products.reference: John Deere Operations Center Telematics / IoT Sensor Network

attributes.name: telemetry_event_id
attributes.description: Primary key for telemetry_event

attributes.name: management_zone_id

attributes.name: precision_ag_pilot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the precision agriculture pilot program under which this telemetry event was generated. Links the event to its governing research pilot context.
attributes.references: USDA NIFA Precision Agriculture Research Framework

attributes.name: precision_device_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Internet of Things (IoT) device, sensor, or telematics unit that generated this event. Supports device-level performance tracking and calibration audit trails.
attributes.references: ISO 11783 (ISOBUS); John Deere Operations Center Device Registry

attributes.name: treatment_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to research.treatment_application. Business justification: Telemetry events during precision ag operations can be linked to specific treatment applications (e.g., VRA application events, real-time sensor data during spraying).
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: trial_plot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific field trial plot where this telemetry event was recorded. Enables spatial correlation of sensor readings to experimental plot boundaries.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Field Trial Documentation Standards

attributes.name: vra_prescription_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Variable Rate Application (VRA) prescription that was active or being executed at the time of this telemetry event. Enables reconciliation of actual application rates against prescribed rates for agronomic compliance and efficacy analysis.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software VRA Prescription Schema; USDA NRCS Precision Agriculture BMP

attributes.name: air_temperature_c
attributes.description: Ambient air temperature in degrees Celsius recorded at the sensor or equipment location at the time of the telemetry event. Supports growing degree day (GDD) accumulation calculations and environmental context for agronomic analysis.
attributes.references: WMO No. 8 Guide to Meteorological Instruments; USDA NASS Weather Data Standards

attributes.name: battery_level_pct
attributes.description: Remaining battery charge percentage of the IoT sensor or device at the time of the telemetry event. Used for predictive maintenance scheduling and to flag readings that may be unreliable due to low-power device states.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center Device Health Monitoring; ISO 11783 Device Diagnostics

attributes.name: calibration_status
attributes.description: Calibration status of the sensor or device at the time the telemetry event was recorded. 'calibrated' indicates the device was within its valid calibration window; 'due' indicates calibration is approaching expiry; 'overdue' indicates calibration has lapsed; 'uncalibrated' indicates no calibration record exists. Affects data quality scoring and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 Laboratory Calibration; USDA AMS Calibration Standards; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (UTC) when this telemetry event record was first ingested and persisted in the Silver Layer of the Databricks Lakehouse. Distinct from event_timestamp which captures the real-world observation time. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Data Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity; ISO 22000

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Quality control flag assigned to the telemetry event record indicating the outcome of automated data quality checks. 'pass' indicates all checks passed; 'out_of_range' indicates the reading_value exceeded agronomic thresholds; 'sensor_fault' indicates device self-diagnostic failure; 'gps_degraded' indicates positioning accuracy below threshold; 'duplicate' indicates a suspected duplicate transmission; 'missing_context' indicates required reference data is absent.
attributes.references: FSMA Section 204 Traceability Rule; ISO 22000 Data Integrity; GLOBALG.A.P. Record Keeping

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this telemetry event was ingested into the lakehouse. Supports data lineage tracking, source system reconciliation, and multi-platform precision agriculture pilot analysis.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; Trimble Ag Software; Climate FieldView; Esri ArcGIS

attributes.name: event_code
attributes.description: Structured alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the type of telemetry event (e.g., SOIL_MOIST_READ, NDVI_SCAN, VRA_CMD, RTK_FIX, EC_READ). Used for programmatic event classification and downstream routing.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software Event Taxonomy; Climate FieldView Telemetry Schema

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current processing lifecycle status of the telemetry event record. 'raw' indicates unprocessed ingestion; 'validated' confirms quality checks passed; 'flagged' indicates anomaly detection triggered; 'rejected' indicates the record failed quality thresholds; 'processed' indicates downstream consumption complete.
attributes.references: FSMA Produce Safety Rule — Data Integrity Requirements; ISO 22000

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (UTC) at which the telemetry event was recorded by the device or sensor. This is the principal real-world observation time, distinct from ingestion or processing timestamps. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; John Deere Operations Center Telematics Specification

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the telemetry event discriminating the kind of observation or command captured. Drives downstream processing pipelines and analytics segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: soil_moisture|electrical_conductivity|temperature|ndvi_scan|vra_command|rtk_position|equipment_position|canopy_reflectance|rainfall|wind_speed|humidity|pressure|leaf_wetness|flow_rate|battery_voltage — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 11783 (ISOBUS); USDA NRCS Precision Agriculture Standards

attributes.name: gps_altitude_m
attributes.description: Altitude in metres above mean sea level (MSL) recorded by the GPS receiver at the time of the telemetry event. Relevant for drone-based NDVI scans and terrain-adjusted VRA prescriptions.
attributes.references: WGS-84 Geodetic Datum; FAA UAS Remote ID Standards (drone operations)

attributes.name: gps_latitude
attributes.description: WGS-84 decimal degree latitude coordinate of the device or sensor at the time of the telemetry event. Supports geospatial mapping, plot boundary validation, and precision agriculture spatial analytics via Esri ArcGIS and GIS platforms.
attributes.references: WGS-84 Geodetic Datum; ISO 6709; Esri ArcGIS Coordinate Reference Standards

attributes.name: gps_longitude
attributes.description: WGS-84 decimal degree longitude coordinate of the device or sensor at the time of the telemetry event. Used in conjunction with gps_latitude for precise geospatial positioning of sensor readings and equipment operations.
attributes.references: WGS-84 Geodetic Datum; ISO 6709; Esri ArcGIS Coordinate Reference Standards

attributes.name: heading_degrees
attributes.description: Direction of travel of the equipment or drone in degrees from true north (0–360°) at the time of the telemetry event. Used for pass-by-pass field operation mapping and VRA swath alignment analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 11783 (ISOBUS) Section 7 — Machine Direction; John Deere Operations Center

attributes.name: is_outlier
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the telemetry event reading_value was identified as a statistical outlier by automated anomaly detection algorithms (e.g., z-score or IQR-based methods). True indicates the value deviates significantly from the expected distribution for this sensor and event type.
attributes.references: USDA NIFA Precision Agriculture Research Standards; ISO 5725 Accuracy of Measurement

attributes.name: ndvi_value
attributes.description: Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) value derived from drone or satellite multispectral imagery at the event location, ranging from -1.0 to 1.0. Values above 0.5 indicate healthy dense vegetation. Null for non-NDVI event types. Supports crop health monitoring and yield prediction models.
attributes.references: USDA NASS Remote Sensing Program; NASA MODIS NDVI Product Specification

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for agronomist or field technician annotations associated with this telemetry event, such as observed field conditions, equipment anomalies, or protocol deviations noted at the time of data collection.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Field Record Keeping Requirements; FSMA Produce Safety Rule

attributes.name: quality_score
attributes.description: Composite numeric quality score (0.00–100.00) assigned to the telemetry event based on multi-dimensional quality checks including GPS accuracy, sensor calibration status, signal strength, and value range validation. Supports tiered data confidence levels for AI/ML model training.
attributes.references: USDA NIFA Precision Agriculture Data Quality Framework; ISO 8000 Data Quality

attributes.name: reading_depth_cm
attributes.description: Depth in centimetres at which the soil sensor reading was taken (e.g., 15 cm, 30 cm, 60 cm for soil moisture or EC probes). Null for surface or aerial measurements such as NDVI drone scans or equipment position events.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey Manual; ISO 11272 Soil Quality

attributes.name: reading_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure associated with the reading_value (e.g., pct for soil moisture percentage, ds_m for Electrical Conductivity (EC) in dS/m, celsius for temperature, ndvi for Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI), kg_ha for Variable Rate Application (VRA) rate). Ensures dimensional correctness in analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pct|ds_m|celsius|ndvi|kg_ha|l_ha|mm|m_s|degrees|mbar|lux|mv — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 80000-1 Quantities and Units; USDA NRCS Precision Agriculture Standards

attributes.name: reading_value
attributes.description: The principal quantitative measurement or observed value captured by the sensor or device for this telemetry event (e.g., soil moisture percentage, EC in dS/m, temperature in °C, NDVI index value, VRA application rate). The unit of measure is captured in reading_unit.
attributes.references: ISO 11783 (ISOBUS); USDA NRCS Soil Survey Technical Note

attributes.name: relative_humidity_pct
attributes.description: Ambient relative humidity percentage recorded at the sensor or equipment location at the time of the telemetry event. Used for disease pressure modelling, spray application condition assessment (REI compliance), and evapotranspiration (ET) calculations.
attributes.references: WMO No. 8 Guide to Meteorological Instruments; EPA REI Compliance Standards

attributes.name: rtk_accuracy_cm
attributes.description: Horizontal positioning accuracy in centimetres as reported by the Real-Time Kinematic (RTK) GPS receiver at the time of the event. Values below 2.5 cm indicate RTK-fixed precision; higher values indicate degraded or float solutions. Critical for VRA prescription accuracy validation.
attributes.references: Trimble RTK Positioning Specification; ISO 17123-8 GNSS Field Measurement

attributes.name: rtk_fix_type
attributes.description: Classification of the GPS/GNSS positioning solution quality at the time of the event. 'fixed' indicates centimetre-level RTK accuracy; 'float' indicates sub-decimetre; 'dgps' indicates differential correction; 'autonomous' indicates standard GPS; 'none' indicates no fix. Drives data quality scoring for precision agriculture analytics.
attributes.references: NMEA 0183 GNSS Standard; Trimble Ag Software RTK Classification

attributes.name: scan_altitude_m
attributes.description: Altitude above ground level (AGL) in metres at which the drone or UAV conducted the NDVI or multispectral scan. Affects image resolution and NDVI calculation accuracy. Null for ground-based sensor events.
attributes.references: FAA Part 107 UAS Operations; Trimble Ag Software Drone Flight Logs

attributes.name: signal_strength_dbm
attributes.description: Wireless signal strength in decibels relative to one milliwatt (dBm) at the time of the telemetry event transmission. Used to assess data transmission reliability and identify connectivity dead zones in field operations.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center Connectivity Diagnostics; IEEE 802.11 Wireless Standards

attributes.name: soil_temperature_c
attributes.description: Soil temperature in degrees Celsius recorded by an in-field sensor at the time of the event. Used in conjunction with soil moisture and EC readings for comprehensive soil health assessment and planting condition evaluation.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Survey Technical Note 6; ISO 11274 Soil Quality

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: The native record identifier assigned by the originating operational system (e.g., John Deere Operations Center event UUID, Trimble Ag log entry ID). Enables traceability back to the source system for audit, reconciliation, and duplicate detection.
attributes.references: FSMA Section 204 Traceability Rule; SOX Data Lineage Requirements

attributes.name: speed_km_h
attributes.description: Ground speed of the equipment in kilometres per hour at the time of the telemetry event. Used to validate application uniformity for VRA operations and to detect equipment anomalies such as stalls or over-speed conditions.
attributes.references: ISO 11783 (ISOBUS) Section 7 — Ground Speed; John Deere Operations Center Telematics

attributes.name: transmission_latency_ms
attributes.description: Time in milliseconds between the event timestamp recorded by the device and the timestamp of receipt by the data ingestion platform. Used to assess real-time data pipeline performance and identify network latency issues in precision agriculture IoT deployments.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center Telematics SLA; Climate FieldView Data Ingestion Specification

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time (UTC) when this telemetry event record was last modified in the Silver Layer, such as after quality flag updates, outlier re-scoring, or calibration status corrections. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Data Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity; ISO 22000

attributes.name: vra_actual_rate
attributes.description: The actual application rate recorded by the VRA controller at the time of the event (in units defined by reading_unit). Compared against vra_target_rate to assess application accuracy and controller performance. Null for non-VRA event types.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software VRA Controller Logs; EPA Pesticide Application Records Requirements

attributes.name: vra_target_rate
attributes.description: The prescribed target application rate from the active VRA prescription at the time of the event (in units defined by reading_unit). Null for non-VRA event types. Used to compute rate deviation and application accuracy metrics.
attributes.references: Trimble Ag Software VRA Controller Logs; USDA NRCS Nutrient Management Standard 590

products.name: cooperator

products.name: variety_license
products.description: This association product represents the formal licensing Contract between a customer account and a research variety. It captures the commercial terms under which an account is authorized to use, sell, or distribute a specific crop variety, including royalty obligations, geographic scope, exclusivity rights, and license duration. Each record links one account to one variety and carries attributes that exist only in the context of that specific licensing relationship — they cannot reside on the account or variety alone.. Existence Justification: In the agricultural seed industry, customer accounts (food manufacturers, distributors, cooperatives) actively license specific crop varieties from the research organization under formal licensing agreements that carry distinct commercial terms per account-variety pair. A single account may license multiple varieties (e.g., a food manufacturer licensing several soybean and corn varieties), and a single variety may be licensed to multiple accounts under different royalty rates, geographies, and exclusivity arrangements. This is an operationally managed business relationship — licensing teams create, negotiate, renew, and terminate these agreements as a core commercial process.

products.name: trial_treatment
products.description: This association product represents the Treatment Application event between agrochemical_product and trial. It captures the operational record of a specific agrochemical product being applied as a treatment arm within a field trial or IPM efficacy study. Each record links one agrochemical product to one trial and carries the treatment-specific application rate, timing, observed efficacy, PHI compliance status, and resistance management classification — data that exists only in the context of this specific product-trial combination and cannot reside on either master record alone.. Existence Justification: In agricultural research operations, a single field trial evaluates multiple agrochemical products across different treatment arms (e.g., a fungicide efficacy trial may test 4-6 different products at varying rates), and a single agrochemical product is evaluated across many trials over its registration lifecycle and across different crops, geographies, and pest targets. The relationship itself is a recognized operational concept — a 'Treatment Application' or 'Trial Treatment' — that carries its own data: the specific application rate used in that trial, application timing, observed efficacy rating, PHI compliance status, and resistance management classification. These attributes belong neither to the agrochemical product master nor to the trial master alone, but to the specific combination.

products.name: trial_staff_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the Role-based assignment between a research trial and an employee. It captures the operational record of each person's specific role, date range, allocated hours, and contribution type on a given trial. Each record links one trial to one employee in one role, with attributes that exist only in the context of this assignment — not on the trial or the employee alone. Used for labor cost allocation, publication authorship attribution, and regulatory submission personnel records.. Existence Justification: In agricultural research organizations, a single field trial requires multiple personnel in distinct, simultaneous roles — a principal investigator, co-investigators, field technicians, data managers, and statisticians — all actively working on the same trial at the same time. Conversely, each employee participates in multiple trials across seasons and years. The existing trial.employee_id FK captures only the lead PI, which is structurally insufficient to represent the full staffing reality of a research program.
