attributes.name: mobile_phone
attributes.description: Primary mobile phone number for the employee. Used for emergency notifications, scheduling communications, and field operations coordination. Critical for reaching seasonal and migrant farm workers.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; MSPA

attributes.name: national_id_number
attributes.description: Government-issued national identification number (e.g., Social Security Number in the US). Used for I-9 verification, E-Verify compliance, tax reporting, and MSPA worker disclosure requirements.
attributes.references: USCIS I-9 Form; IRS; MSPA (Migrant and Seasonal Agricultural Worker Protection Act)

attributes.name: osha_safety_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee holds a current OSHA safety certification (e.g., OSHA 10-hour or 30-hour General Industry or Construction card). Required for supervisory roles and equipment operators in farm and processing facility environments.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1928 (Agriculture); OSHA 29 CFR 1910 (General Industry); OSHA Training Institute

attributes.name: pay_type
attributes.description: Compensation structure for the employee. Salaried = fixed annual compensation; Hourly = paid per hour worked; Piece_Rate = paid per unit of agricultural output (e.g., per bin of fruit picked); Daily = fixed daily rate. Piece-rate is common in harvest operations and has specific FLSA compliance requirements.
attributes.references: FLSA; SAP SuccessFactors Payroll; California Labor Code (piece-rate)

attributes.name: personal_email
attributes.description: Personal email address of the employee. Used for communications with seasonal and H-2A workers who may not have enterprise email, and for post-termination correspondence.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655

attributes.name: pesticide_applicator_license_number
attributes.description: State-issued pesticide applicator license number for employees authorized to apply restricted-use pesticides (RUPs). Required by EPA and state lead agencies for compliance with FIFRA. Null for employees not performing pesticide applications.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA (Federal Insecticide Fungicide and Rodenticide Act); 40 CFR 171; State Lead Agency Regulations

attributes.name: pesticide_license_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the employee's state-issued pesticide applicator license. Triggers recertification workflows to ensure continuous compliance with EPA FIFRA and state regulations. Null for non-applicator employees.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA; 40 CFR 171; State Lead Agency Regulations

attributes.name: preferred_name
attributes.description: The name the employee prefers to be called in day-to-day operations. May differ from legal name. Used in operational communications and scheduling systems.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HR Core

attributes.name: primary_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1/639-2 language code for the employee's primary spoken language. Critical for ensuring GAP, HACCP, and pesticide safety training is delivered in the worker's language as required by OSHA and EPA Worker Protection Standard. Examples: es (Spanish), en (English), ht (Haitian Creole).
attributes.references: ISO 639-1; EPA Worker Protection Standard 40 CFR 170; OSHA 29 CFR 1928; MSPA

attributes.name: successfactors_employee_code
attributes.description: The employee identifier assigned in SAP SuccessFactors HR system. Used for cross-system integration with payroll, talent management, and labor cost allocation modules. This is the system-of-record identifier from the HR platform.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HR Core

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date the employee's employment was formally ended. Null for active employees. Used for final pay calculations, benefits termination, access revocation, and seasonal rehire eligibility assessment.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HR Core; FLSA; COBRA

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for the employee's departure from the enterprise. Critical for seasonal rehire eligibility, unemployment insurance claims, and workforce planning analytics. End_of_season is common for H-2A and seasonal agricultural workers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: voluntary_resignation|end_of_season|layoff|termination_for_cause|retirement|death|contract_end — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HR Core; DOL Unemployment Insurance; H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655

attributes.name: work_authorization_type
attributes.description: Classification of the employee's legal authorization to work in the United States. H-2A is the primary agricultural guest worker visa program. Drives compliance workflows for USCIS, DOL, and APHIS requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: us_citizen|permanent_resident|h2a_visa|ead|tn_visa|other_visa|asylum|daca — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USCIS I-9 Form; H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655; INA (Immigration and Nationality Act)

attributes.name: work_email
attributes.description: Official enterprise email address assigned to the employee. Primary digital contact channel for HR communications, system access notifications, and training assignments.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HR Core; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: work_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the primary farm, field complex, or processing facility where the employee is assigned. Used for labor cost allocation by location, OSHA site-specific recordkeeping, and field operations scheduling. Aligns with Granular Farm Management location hierarchy.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HR Core; Granular Farm Management; OSHA 29 CFR 1904

products.name: position
products.description: Authorized headcount positions within the agricultural enterprise organizational structure, including job classification taxonomy. Defines each budgeted role — field crew supervisor, pesticide applicator, irrigation technician, livestock handler, grain elevator operator, food safety auditor — including position code, job family (agronomy, livestock, equipment operations, food processing, administration), pay grade band, FTE allocation, FLSA exemption status, DOL occupational classification (SOC code), H-2A eligible flag, minimum wage tier, physical demands rating, required certifications (pesticide applicator license, OSHA 10/30, HACCP), organizational unit assignment, and the farm operation or processing facility to which the position belongs. SSOT for position definition and job classification taxonomy. Supports workforce planning, DOL H-2A job order filings, USDA labor compliance, and labor cost allocation.
products.reference: SAP SuccessFactors Position Management

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each authorized headcount position within the agricultural enterprise organizational structure. Primary key for the position data product.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Position Management

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.cost_center

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the farm operation, processing facility, grain elevator, or distribution center to which this position is physically assigned.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Position Management; USDA Labor Compliance

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational unit (department, division, or cost center) to which this position is assigned within the enterprise hierarchy.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Organizational Management

attributes.name: parent_position_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the supervisory position directly above this position in the organizational hierarchy, enabling reporting line traversal.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Organizational Management

attributes.name: budgeted_headcount
attributes.description: Number of authorized headcount slots budgeted for this position within the current fiscal planning period. Supports workforce planning, labor budget management, and variance analysis against actual staffing levels.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Workforce Planning; Granular Farm Management Financial Planning

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this position record was first created in the system, used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance recordkeeping purposes.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Audit Trail; SOX Internal Controls; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: eeo_job_category
attributes.description: EEO-1 job category classification for this position as defined by the EEOC, required for annual EEO-1 Component 1 workforce data reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: executive_senior_officials|first_mid_officials|professionals|technicians|sales_workers|administrative_support|craft_workers|operatives|laborers_helpers|service_workers — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EEOC EEO-1 Component 1 Reporting Requirements; Title VII of the Civil Rights Act

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this position becomes or became effective within the organizational structure, marking the start of its authorized existence for headcount planning, DOL H-2A job order validity, and labor compliance purposes.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Position Management; DOL H-2A Regulations 20 CFR Part 655

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the employment arrangement for this position, distinguishing between permanent year-round roles, seasonal agricultural positions, temporary placements, contract workers, and H-2A guest worker positions under the DOL temporary agricultural worker program.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Regulations 20 CFR Part 655; FLSA; USDA Labor Compliance

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this position is scheduled to expire or be eliminated from the authorized headcount plan. Nullable for permanent positions; populated for seasonal, temporary, or project-based roles with a defined end date.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Position Management; DOL H-2A Regulations 20 CFR Part 655

attributes.name: flsa_exemption_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Exemption Status
attributes.description: Classification of the position under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) indicating whether the role is exempt, non-exempt, or qualifies for the agricultural exemption under FLSA Section 13(b)(12), which affects overtime pay eligibility and minimum wage requirements.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) 29 U.S.C. § 213; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: fte_allocation
attributes.description: Budgeted Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) allocation for this position, expressed as a decimal fraction of a standard full-time schedule (e.g., 1.00 = full-time, 0.50 = half-time). Used for headcount planning, labor cost budgeting, and workforce capacity analysis.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Workforce Planning; GAAP Labor Cost Allocation

attributes.name: h2a_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position qualifies for staffing under the DOL H-2A Temporary Agricultural Worker visa program, which allows agricultural employers to bring foreign nationals to the U.S. to fill temporary or seasonal agricultural jobs. Required for DOL H-2A job order filings.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Regulations 20 CFR Part 655; Immigration and Nationality Act Section 101(a)(15)(H)(ii)(a)

attributes.name: housing_provided
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position includes employer-provided housing as required under DOL H-2A regulations, which mandate that agricultural employers provide free housing to H-2A workers and domestic workers who are not reasonably able to return to their residence within the same day.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Regulations 20 CFR Part 655.122; DOL ETA H-2A Housing Standards

attributes.name: job_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the duties, responsibilities, and working conditions for this position, as published in DOL H-2A job orders, internal job postings, and USDA labor compliance documentation.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Job Order Requirements 20 CFR Part 655; USDA Labor Compliance

attributes.name: job_family
attributes.description: Broad functional grouping that classifies the position into an agricultural job family for workforce planning, compensation benchmarking, and labor cost allocation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: agronomy|livestock|equipment_operations|food_processing|administration|supply_chain|quality_compliance|research_development — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Job Classification; USDA Occupational Classification

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this position record was most recently updated, supporting change tracking, audit compliance, and data freshness monitoring in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Audit Trail; SOX Internal Controls; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: min_education_level
attributes.description: Minimum educational qualification required for this position, used in job postings, H-2A job order filings, and candidate screening within SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Job Order Requirements; SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting

attributes.name: min_experience_years
attributes.description: Minimum number of years of relevant work experience required for this position, as specified in job postings and DOL H-2A job order filings.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Job Order Requirements 20 CFR Part 655; SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting

attributes.name: min_wage_tier
attributes.description: Applicable minimum wage tier for this position, distinguishing between federal minimum wage, state minimum wage, DOL Adverse Effect Wage Rate (AEWR) for H-2A positions, piece-rate compensation structures common in agricultural harvesting, or negotiated collective bargaining rates.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Adverse Effect Wage Rate (AEWR); FLSA Minimum Wage Provisions; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: pay_grade
attributes.description: Compensation pay grade band assigned to this position, used for salary range management, compensation benchmarking, and labor cost budgeting within the enterprise pay structure.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Compensation Management; GAAP Labor Cost Allocation

attributes.name: physical_demands_rating
attributes.description: DOL Dictionary of Occupational Titles (DOT) physical demands rating for this position, classifying the level of physical exertion required. Used for ADA accommodation assessments, OSHA ergonomic risk evaluation, and H-2A job order physical requirements disclosure.
attributes.references: DOL Dictionary of Occupational Titles (DOT); ADA Title I; OSHA Ergonomics Guidelines

attributes.name: position_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the position within the enterprise, used in DOL H-2A job order filings, USDA labor compliance reporting, and integration with SAP SuccessFactors and payroll systems.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Position Management; DOL H-2A Job Order Requirements

attributes.name: position_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the authorized position indicating whether it is active and available for staffing, frozen due to budget constraints, pending organizational approval, or eliminated from the headcount plan.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Position Management

attributes.name: remote_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position is eligible for remote or hybrid work arrangements. Most field operations, livestock handling, and equipment operation positions are not remote-eligible; administrative and analytical roles may qualify.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Position Management

attributes.name: requires_cdl
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position requires a valid Commercial Driver's License (CDL) for operating agricultural transport vehicles, grain trucks, or heavy equipment on public roads, as regulated by FMCSA.
attributes.references: FMCSA Commercial Driver's License Standards 49 CFR Part 383; DOT

attributes.name: requires_gap_training
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) Training Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position requires completion of Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) training as part of USDA GAP/GHP certification requirements and FSMA Produce Safety Rule compliance. Applicable to field workers, supervisors, and food handling personnel.
attributes.references: USDA GAP/GHP Audit Program; FDA FSMA Produce Safety Rule 21 CFR Part 112; GLOBALG.A.P. Standard

attributes.name: requires_haccp_certification
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) Certification Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position requires HACCP (Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points) food safety certification, applicable to roles in food processing, packing, and quality assurance functions subject to FDA FSMA and USDA FSIS regulations.
attributes.references: FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA); USDA FSIS HACCP Regulations 9 CFR Part 417; Codex Alimentarius HACCP Guidelines

attributes.name: requires_osha_certification
attributes.description: Specifies the OSHA safety training certification required for this position: OSHA 10-hour General Industry or Construction, OSHA 30-hour for supervisory roles, OSHA Agriculture standard (29 CFR Part 1928), or none required. Used for workforce compliance tracking and training planning.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1928 (Agriculture); OSHA 29 CFR Part 1910 (General Industry); OSHA Outreach Training Program

attributes.name: requires_pesticide_license
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position requires a valid state-issued pesticide applicator license as mandated by the EPA Federal Insecticide, Fungicide, and Rodenticide Act (FIFRA) and state pesticide regulations. Positions such as Pesticide Applicator and Crop Protection Specialist typically require this certification.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA 7 U.S.C. § 136; EPA Worker Protection Standard (WPS) 40 CFR Part 170

attributes.name: seasonal_end_month
attributes.description: Calendar month (1–12) in which seasonal positions typically conclude staffing, used for annual workforce planning, H-2A visa petition duration, and labor demand forecasting aligned with crop harvest completion and post-harvest handling.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Regulations 20 CFR Part 655; USDA Seasonal Labor Planning

attributes.name: seasonal_start_month
attributes.description: Calendar month (1–12) in which seasonal positions typically begin staffing, used for annual workforce planning, H-2A visa petition timing, and labor demand forecasting aligned with crop planting and harvest cycles.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Regulations 20 CFR Part 655; USDA Seasonal Labor Planning

attributes.name: soc_code
attributes.description: U.S. Department of Labor Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) code assigned to this position, required for DOL H-2A job order filings, OSHA recordkeeping, and USDA labor compliance reporting (e.g., 45-2041 for Graders and Sorters, Agricultural Products).
attributes.references: DOL Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) System; DOL H-2A Regulations 20 CFR Part 655

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Official human-readable job title for the position as it appears in organizational charts, offer letters, and DOL H-2A job order filings (e.g., Field Crew Supervisor, Pesticide Applicator, Irrigation Technician, Livestock Handler, Grain Elevator Operator, Food Safety Auditor).
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Position Management; DOL H-2A Job Order Requirements

attributes.name: transportation_provided
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position includes employer-provided transportation between housing and the worksite, as required under DOL H-2A regulations for guest worker positions and migrant labor compliance.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Regulations 20 CFR Part 655.122; Migrant and Seasonal Agricultural Worker Protection Act (MSPA)

attributes.name: union_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the labor union or collective bargaining agreement (CBA) applicable to this position, if any. Used for wage rate determination, benefit entitlement, and labor relations compliance tracking.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: SAP PS Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element code for project-based labor cost allocation, used when the position supports specific capital projects (CAPEX) such as facility construction, irrigation system installation, or precision agriculture technology deployment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS Module; GAAP CAPEX vs OPEX Classification; IFRS IAS 16

attributes.name: work_schedule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the standard work schedule pattern for this position, distinguishing between standard daytime schedules, rotating shifts for processing facilities, seasonally variable hours common in agricultural operations, on-call arrangements, and piece-rate flexible schedules.
attributes.references: FLSA Hours of Work Provisions; SAP SuccessFactors Time Management

products.name: labor_contract
products.description: Employment and labor agreements governing workforce engagement — individual employment contracts, collective bargaining agreements (CBA), H-2A temporary agricultural worker contracts, and seasonal labor agreements with farm labor contractors (FLC). Captures contract type, effective dates, wage rates, housing and transportation obligations (H-2A), work location, hours guarantees, and DOL job order reference number. Critical for H-2A compliance and FSMA worker protection rule adherence.
products.reference: DOL H-2A Job Order / CBA

attributes.name: labor_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each labor contract record in the agricultural workforce management system. Primary key for the labor_contract data product.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HR Module

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: DOL H-2A job orders require specifying the commodity being harvested to determine the Adverse Effect Wage Rate (AEWR) and job duties. Linking to commodity replaces the denormalized crop_type text fiel
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: H-2A labor contracts are filed under a specific legal entity for DOL job order purposes, workers' comp coverage, and surety bond requirements. Multi-entity ag operations need entity-level contract tra
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or worker covered by this labor contract. Links to the workforce employee master record in SAP SuccessFactors.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HR Module

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary farm, facility, or processing plant where the contracted worker is assigned to perform duties.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Organizational Management; FSMA Worker Protection Rule

attributes.name: farm_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.farm_unit. Business justification: H-2A labor contracts must identify the specific agricultural establishment (farm unit) where workers will be employed — a DOL regulatory requirement. Farm-unit-level contract tracking enables complian
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Farm Labor Contractor (FLC) entity when the contract is mediated through a third-party labor contractor rather than a direct hire. Null for direct employment contracts.
attributes.references: USDA Farm Labor Contractor Registration; Migrant and Seasonal Agricultural Worker Protection Act (MSPA)

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which the labor contract received final management or DOL approval. For H-2A contracts, this corresponds to the DOL labor certification approval date. Distinct from signed_date (worker/employer execution).
attributes.references: DOL ETA Form 9142; SAP SuccessFactors HR Module

attributes.name: cba_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) that governs this individual employment contract, when applicable. Links individual contracts to the overarching union-negotiated agreement. Null for non-union contracts.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); SAP SuccessFactors HR Module

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to the labor contract, used for cross-referencing with SAP SuccessFactors, DOL job orders, and H-2A petition filings. Format: LC- followed by alphanumeric characters.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HR Module; DOL ETA Form 9142

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the labor contract. Draft: being prepared; active: currently in force; suspended: temporarily halted; terminated: ended before expiry; expired: reached end date; pending_approval: awaiting DOL or management authorization.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HR Module; DOL H-2A Compliance

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the labor agreement governing the engagement. Values: permanent (year-round direct employment), seasonal (fixed-season direct hire), h2a_temporary (H-2A temporary agricultural worker visa contract), collective_bargaining (CBA — union-negotiated agreement), flc_agreement (Farm Labor Contractor mediated agreement). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: permanent|seasonal|h2a_temporary|collective_bargaining|flc_agreement|piece_rate|apprenticeship — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR Part 655; NLRA (National Labor Relations Act); MSPA

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the worker's country of origin or recruitment. Critical for H-2A visa compliance, USCIS reporting, and DOL job order disclosure. Also used for COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) workforce analytics.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; USCIS H-2A Regulations; DOL ETA Form 9142; COOL (Country of Origin Labeling)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when the labor contract record was first created in the workforce management system (SAP SuccessFactors). Used for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HR Module; SOX Compliance; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the wage rate and any monetary obligations in the contract (e.g., USD for United States Dollar, MXN for Mexican Peso for cross-border H-2A arrangements).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS; GAAP

attributes.name: dol_job_order_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Department of Labor (DOL) Job Order Number
attributes.description: The Department of Labor (DOL) job order reference number assigned during the H-2A temporary agricultural worker program application process. Mandatory for H-2A contracts; links to the ETA Form 9142 filing. Null for non-H-2A contracts.
attributes.references: DOL ETA Form 9142; 20 CFR Part 655 Subpart B; APHIS

attributes.name: e_verify_case_number
attributes.description: The DHS E-Verify system case number confirming the worker's employment authorization. Required for federal contractors and H-2A employers. Provides audit trail for USCIS and DOL compliance inspections.
attributes.references: DHS E-Verify Program; Executive Order 12989; DOL H-2A Compliance

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the labor contract becomes legally binding and the worker's engagement officially begins. For H-2A contracts, this aligns with the DOL-certified start date of need.
attributes.references: DOL ETA Form 9142; SAP SuccessFactors HR Module; FSMA Worker Protection Rule

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the labor contract is scheduled to end. Nullable for permanent open-ended employment contracts. For H-2A contracts, must not exceed 3 years per DOL regulations.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR Part 655; SAP SuccessFactors HR Module

attributes.name: gap_training_completed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) Training Completed Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker has completed required Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) food safety training as mandated by FSMA Produce Safety Rule for workers handling covered produce. Required for GLOBALG.A.P. and SQF certification compliance.
attributes.references: FSMA Produce Safety Rule 21 CFR Part 112; GLOBALG.A.P.; SQF (Safe Quality Food) Institute

attributes.name: guaranteed_hours_per_week
attributes.description: Minimum number of work hours per week guaranteed to the worker under the contract. For H-2A contracts, DOL requires a three-fourths guarantee (75% of the total hours in the contract period). Critical for H-2A compliance and wage obligation calculations.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Three-Fourths Guarantee Rule 20 CFR 655.122(i); FLSA

attributes.name: h2a_petition_number
attributes.description: USCIS petition number (Form I-129) associated with the H-2A temporary agricultural worker visa application. Enables traceability from the labor contract to the immigration filing. Null for non-H-2A contracts.
attributes.references: USCIS Form I-129; DOL H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR Part 655; APHIS

attributes.name: housing_address
attributes.description: Physical address of the employer-provided housing facility for H-2A workers. Required for DOL job order disclosure and OSHA housing inspection compliance. Null when housing_provided is False.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Housing Requirements 20 CFR 655.122(d); OSHA 29 CFR 1910.142

attributes.name: housing_provided
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employer is obligated to provide free housing to the worker under the contract terms. Mandatory for H-2A contracts where workers are not reasonably able to return to their residence each day. Compliance requirement under DOL H-2A regulations.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Housing Requirements 20 CFR 655.122(d); OSHA Housing Standards 29 CFR 1910.142

attributes.name: i9_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker's employment eligibility has been verified via USCIS Form I-9 (Employment Eligibility Verification). Mandatory for all U.S. employers under the Immigration Reform and Control Act (IRCA). Must be True before contract activation.
attributes.references: USCIS Form I-9; Immigration Reform and Control Act (IRCA); APHIS

attributes.name: inbound_transport_reimbursed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employer reimburses the worker for inbound travel costs from the worker's home country or state of recruitment to the worksite. Mandatory reimbursement obligation under H-2A regulations after 50% of the contract period is completed.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Transportation Requirements 20 CFR 655.122(h)(1)

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The official job title or position designation as stated in the labor contract (e.g., Crop Harvester, Irrigation Technician, Pesticide Applicator, Farm Laborer). Must match the DOL job order description for H-2A contracts.
attributes.references: DOL ETA Form 9142; SAP SuccessFactors Position Management; O*NET SOC Codes

attributes.name: osha_safety_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker holds a current OSHA safety certification relevant to agricultural operations (e.g., OSHA 10-hour or 30-hour General Industry or Construction card). Supports OSHA compliance tracking and incident prevention.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1928 (Agriculture); OSHA Training Institute

attributes.name: pesticide_applicator_license
attributes.description: State-issued pesticide applicator license number for workers authorized to apply restricted-use pesticides (RUP). Required by EPA and state lead agencies under FIFRA. Null for workers not performing pesticide application duties.
attributes.references: EPA Federal Insecticide Fungicide and Rodenticide Act (FIFRA); EPA Worker Protection Standard (WPS) 40 CFR Part 170

attributes.name: season_type
attributes.description: The agricultural season or operational phase for which the worker is contracted. Drives workforce planning cycles in Granular Farm Management and aligns with crop calendar scheduling.
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Calendar; Granular Farm Management; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: signed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the labor contract was formally signed by both the employer and the worker (or their authorized representative). Required for legal enforceability and DOL H-2A job order documentation.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR Part 655; SAP SuccessFactors HR Module

attributes.name: soc_code
attributes.description: Bureau of Labor Statistics Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) code for the contracted job role. Required on DOL H-2A job orders to classify the agricultural occupation (e.g., 45-2092 for Farmworkers and Laborers, Crop, Nursery, and Greenhouse).
attributes.references: BLS Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) System; DOL ETA Form 9142

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual date the contract was terminated early, if applicable. Distinct from expiration_date (scheduled end). Populated only when a contract is ended before its scheduled expiration.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HR Module; DOL H-2A Compliance

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for early contract termination. Required for H-2A compliance reporting to DOL when a worker departs before the contract end date. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: voluntary_resignation|involuntary_termination|contract_completion|mutual_agreement|abandonment|visa_revocation|death|disability — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR Part 655; SAP SuccessFactors HR Module

attributes.name: total_contract_hours
attributes.description: Total number of work hours specified for the entire contract period. Used to calculate the three-fourths guarantee obligation for H-2A contracts and for labor cost budgeting in Granular Farm Management.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR Part 655; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: transportation_provided
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employer is obligated to provide or reimburse transportation costs for the worker. For H-2A contracts, employers must provide or pay for inbound and outbound transportation and daily transportation between housing and worksite.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Transportation Requirements 20 CFR 655.122(h); MSPA

attributes.name: union_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the labor union or worker organization representing the employee under a collective bargaining agreement (e.g., UFW — United Farm Workers, UFCW — United Food and Commercial Workers). Null for non-union workers.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); SAP SuccessFactors HR Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording the most recent modification to the labor contract record. Supports change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver layer and audit trail requirements under SOX and FSMA.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors HR Module; SOX Compliance; FSMA

attributes.name: visa_type
attributes.description: Immigration visa classification under which the worker is authorized to work in the United States. H-2A is the primary temporary agricultural worker visa. Drives compliance obligations and documentation requirements.
attributes.references: USCIS H-2A Program; Immigration and Nationality Act (INA) Section 101(a)(15)(H); DOL

attributes.name: wage_rate
attributes.description: The agreed-upon base wage rate for the worker as specified in the labor contract. For H-2A contracts, must meet or exceed the Adverse Effect Wage Rate (AEWR) published annually by DOL. Used for payroll processing and compliance audits.
attributes.references: DOL Adverse Effect Wage Rate (AEWR); FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); SAP SuccessFactors Payroll

attributes.name: wage_rate_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the contracted wage rate. Hourly is most common for H-2A and seasonal workers; piece_rate applies to harvest workers paid per unit of crop harvested (e.g., per bin, per bushel).
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR Part 655; FLSA

attributes.name: work_duties_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the specific agricultural duties, tasks, and responsibilities the worker is contracted to perform. Must be disclosed in the DOL job order for H-2A contracts per FSMA Worker Protection Rule requirements.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Job Order Requirements 20 CFR 655.121; FSMA Worker Protection Rule

products.name: payroll

Supports DOL wage and hour compliance, H-2A three-fourths guarantee tracking, and labor cost allocation to crop enterprise budgets.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP CO cost center to which labor costs are allocated, enabling crop enterprise budget tracking and farm operation cost analysis.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee record for whom this payroll record is generated. Links to the workforce employee master.

attributes.name: gl_account_id

attributes.name: journal_entry_id

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: aewr_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Adverse Effect Wage Rate (AEWR) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the effective hourly wage paid to the employee meets or exceeds the DOL Adverse Effect Wage Rate (AEWR) for the applicable state and period. Critical H-2A compliance indicator.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655.120; APHIS; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: aewr_rate
attributes.description: The DOL-published Adverse Effect Wage Rate applicable to the employee's state and job classification for the pay period. Used as the minimum wage floor for H-2A guest workers and compliance benchmarking.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655.120; USDA Farm Labor Survey

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payroll record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports audit trail and SOX financial reporting controls.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; SAP SuccessFactors Audit Trail; GAAP

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this payroll record. Typically USD for domestic operations; supports international agricultural operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS; GAAP

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the employee's engagement type, distinguishing permanent staff, seasonal farm workers, H-2A guest workers, and migrant laborers. Drives compliance rule application and wage rate determination. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: permanent|seasonal|h2a_guest_worker|migrant|contract|part_time|temporary — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655; Migrant and Seasonal Agricultural Worker Protection Act (MSPA); DOL

attributes.name: farm_operation_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific farm operation or production unit (e.g., field, orchard, processing facility) where the employee worked. Enables labor cost allocation to crop enterprise budgets in Granular Farm Management.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; SAP S/4HANA CO Module; USDA Farm Records

attributes.name: federal_income_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Amount of federal income tax withheld from the employee's gross wages for the pay period per IRS withholding tables and the employee's W-4 elections.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15 (Circular E); Internal Revenue Code Section 3402

attributes.name: gross_wages
attributes.description: Total pre-deduction earnings for the pay period, including regular pay, overtime premium, piece-rate earnings, and any other compensation components before tax and other deductions.
attributes.references: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); IRS Publication 15; GAAP

attributes.name: hourly_rate
attributes.description: The base hourly wage rate applied to this payroll record. For H-2A workers, must meet or exceed the Adverse Effect Wage Rate (AEWR) published by DOL for the applicable state and crop activity.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Adverse Effect Wage Rate (AEWR); Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); USDA

attributes.name: housing_deduction
attributes.description: Amount deducted from gross wages for employer-provided housing furnished to H-2A workers or other agricultural employees. Must comply with DOL reasonable cost or fair rental value limits.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655.122(d); FLSA Section 3(m)

attributes.name: job_classification_code
attributes.description: The DOL Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) or internal job code for the employee's role during the pay period (e.g., crop worker, equipment operator, agronomist). Drives AEWR rate selection and compliance rule application.
attributes.references: DOL Standard Occupational Classification (SOC); H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655; USDA

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payroll record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Required for data lineage, audit trail, and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act; SAP SuccessFactors Audit Trail; GAAP

attributes.name: medicare_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Employee share of Medicare (HI) tax withheld under FICA for the pay period, including the Additional Medicare Tax for high earners where applicable.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA); Internal Revenue Code Section 3101

attributes.name: net_pay
attributes.description: The actual take-home amount disbursed to the employee after all tax withholdings and authorized deductions are subtracted from gross wages.
attributes.references: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); IRS Publication 15; GAAP

attributes.name: other_deductions
attributes.description: Total of all other authorized deductions not separately itemized (e.g., voluntary benefit elections, garnishments, tool deductions) applied to gross wages for the pay period.
attributes.references: DOL Wage and Hour Division; IRS Publication 15; State Wage Payment Laws

attributes.name: overtime_earnings
attributes.description: Total overtime premium earnings for the pay period, calculated at 1.5x the regular rate for hours exceeding 40 per week per FLSA requirements.
attributes.references: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Section 7; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: overtime_hours_worked
attributes.description: Total overtime hours worked beyond the FLSA 40-hour weekly threshold during the pay period. Required for FLSA overtime premium pay calculation and DOL wage and hour compliance reporting.
attributes.references: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Section 7

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the employee is paid. Determines pay period boundaries and is critical for H-2A three-fourths guarantee calculations and FLSA overtime compliance.
attributes.references: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the payroll processing period. Defines the boundary for wage calculations, overtime determination, and H-2A three-fourths guarantee assessment.
attributes.references: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the payroll processing period. Used for DOL wage and hour compliance, H-2A three-fourths guarantee tracking, and labor cost allocation.
attributes.references: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655

attributes.name: pay_type
attributes.description: The compensation structure applied to this payroll record. Piece-rate is common for harvest operations; hourly applies to FLSA overtime calculations; salary for permanent staff.
attributes.references: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which wages were disbursed to the employee. Required for DOL wage payment timeliness compliance and state wage payment law adherence.
attributes.references: DOL Wage and Hour Division; State Wage Payment Laws

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The method by which net pay is disbursed to the employee. Direct deposit is standard; check and pay card are common for seasonal and H-2A workers without bank accounts.
attributes.references: DOL Wage and Hour Division; State Wage Payment Laws; NACHA Operating Rules

attributes.name: payroll_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the payroll record within the SAP SuccessFactors payroll processing lifecycle, from initial calculation through final payment or reversal.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Payroll Module; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: piece_rate_earnings
attributes.description: Total earnings derived from piece-rate compensation (harvest pay) for the pay period, calculated as piece_rate_units multiplied by piece_rate_per_unit. Supports harvest labor cost analysis.
attributes.references: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655

attributes.name: piece_rate_per_unit
attributes.description: The monetary rate paid per piece-rate unit (e.g., per bin, per pound, per row) for harvest or production work. Confidential compensation data used for piece-rate earnings calculation.
attributes.references: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655

attributes.name: piece_rate_units
attributes.description: Total number of piece-rate units (e.g., bins picked, rows harvested, pounds collected) completed by the employee during the pay period. Drives piece-rate earnings calculation for harvest pay.
attributes.references: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655

attributes.name: regular_hours_worked
attributes.description: Total non-overtime hours worked by the employee during the pay period. Used for FLSA compliance, H-2A three-fourths guarantee tracking, and labor cost allocation to farm operations.
attributes.references: DOL Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655

attributes.name: sap_payroll_doc_number
attributes.description: The payroll document reference number generated by SAP S/4HANA payroll processing, used for reconciliation and audit trail back to the system of record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Payroll Module; SOX Financial Reporting Controls

attributes.name: social_security_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Employee share of Social Security (OASDI) tax withheld under FICA for the pay period, calculated at the statutory rate on wages up to the annual wage base.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA); Internal Revenue Code Section 3101

attributes.name: state_income_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Amount of state income tax withheld from the employee's gross wages for the pay period per applicable state tax authority withholding requirements.
attributes.references: State Tax Authority Regulations; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: three_fourths_guarantee_hours
attributes.description: The minimum number of hours the employer is obligated to offer the H-2A worker under the three-fourths guarantee provision (75% of contract period workdays). Used for compliance tracking and potential back-pay liability assessment.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655.122(i); DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: three_fourths_guarantee_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employer has met the H-2A three-fourths guarantee obligation for this pay period. A False value triggers back-pay liability calculation for the shortfall hours.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655.122(i); DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: transportation_deduction
attributes.description: Amount deducted from gross wages for employer-provided transportation to/from the worksite. Subject to DOL H-2A regulations limiting deductions to actual cost and prohibiting deductions that reduce wages below AEWR.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655.122(h); FLSA Section 3(m)

attributes.name: work_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code where the employee performed work during the pay period. Determines applicable state income tax withholding, state minimum wage, and H-2A AEWR rate.
attributes.references: DOL H-2A Program Regulations 20 CFR 655; State Tax Authority Regulations; USDA

attributes.name: h2a_guarantee_hours

attributes.name: hourly_rate

attributes.name: is_amended
attributes.description: Indicates whether this time entry has been amended or corrected after initial submission. Amended records require supervisor re-approval and are flagged for payroll audit review.

attributes.name: is_overtime

attributes.references: FLSA 29 CFR Part 778; SAP SuccessFactors Time Management

attributes.name: location_description

attributes.name: overtime_hours

attributes.name: pay_type

attributes.name: payroll_period
attributes.description: The payroll period (ISO week format YYYY-Www) to which this time entry belongs. Used for FLSA workweek aggregation, H-2A three-fourths guarantee calculations, and payroll batch processing.
attributes.references: FLSA 29 CFR Part 778; H-2A 20 CFR Part 655; SAP SuccessFactors Payroll

attributes.name: piece_rate_per_unit
attributes.description: Dollar amount paid per piece-rate unit completed. Must meet or exceed FLSA minimum wage when divided by total hours worked. Stored for payroll audit and compliance verification.

attributes.name: piece_rate_unit_type

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: visa_type

attributes.name: work_date

products.name: workforce_certification
products.description: Master registry of all professional certifications, licenses, and compliance credentials held by agricultural workers. Covers pesticide applicator licenses (EPA private/commercial/public categories, state license number, issuing state agency, certification categories for field crops, ornamental, right-of-way), OSHA 10/30-hour safety cards, HACCP certification, GAP training completion, forklift operator certification, CDL (commercial driver license), food handler permits, GLOBALG.A.P. worker training certificates, and continuing education units (CEU). Tracks certification type, issuing authority, issue date, expiration date, renewal status, license number, CEU hours completed, state agency reference, and license category. SSOT for ALL worker credential and license data — including pesticide applicator licenses. Supports EPA pesticide applicator compliance, state department of agriculture audits, OSHA verification, GLOBALG.A.P. certification readiness, and CDL/DOT compliance.

attributes.name: housing_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of workers authorized to occupy the assigned housing unit per OSHA and DOL housing standards. Used for occupancy compliance and state inspection reporting.

Captures plan type, coverage tier (employee-only, employee+spouse, family), enrollment date, effective date, termination date, dependent coverage details, employee contribution amount, employer contribution amount, benefit carrier reference, and ACA eligibility determination. Tracks seasonal worker benefit eligibility based on hours worked and lookback period, agricultural cooperative benefit pool participation, and COBRA continuation rights. SSOT for all employee benefit enrollment and eligibility data. Integrates with SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Administration and supports ACA employer mandate reporting (Forms 1095-C), H-2A housing/meals benefit compliance, and seasonal workforce benefit administration.

attributes.description: The date and time the supervisor or HR rendered a final approval or denial decision on the leave request. FMLA requires written notice within 5 business days of the eligibility determination (29 CFR 825.300).

attributes.name: fmla_eligible

attributes.name: fmla_entitlement_used_days

attributes.description: Cumulative FMLA leave days consumed by the employee in the current 12-month FMLA measurement period prior to this request. The FMLA entitlement is 12 weeks (84 calendar days) per year; military caregiver leave allows up to 26 weeks.
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR Part 825.200; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: fmla_hours_worked_lookback
attributes.business_glossary_term: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Hours Worked Lookback
attributes.description: Total hours worked by the employee in the 12-month period immediately preceding the leave request date, used to determine FMLA eligibility (threshold: 1,250 hours). Sourced from SAP SuccessFactors time and attendance records.
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR Part 825.110; DOL Wage and Hour Division

products.name: crew
products.description: Master record for agricultural work crews and gangs — the fundamental operational unit for field labor deployment in row crop, specialty crop, and livestock operations. Captures crew code, crew name, crew type (planting crew, harvest crew, spray crew, irrigation team, livestock handling team, packing line crew, equipment maintenance team), assigned supervisor/crew leader (employee reference), home farm operation or facility, default shift pattern, target crew size, current active member count, active status, seasonal validity start/end dates, and primary language spoken. Crews are the primary unit of labor scheduling, field assignment, productivity tracking, and piece-rate pay calculation in agricultural operations. SSOT for crew identity and composition. Supports H-2A crew-based housing and transportation management, piece-rate pay calculations by crew, DOL crew disclosure requirements under MSPA, and crew-level safety briefing documentation. Crew membership is tracked via employee-to-crew assignment with effective dates to support seasonal rotation and mid-season crew reassignment.
