attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which this invoice is recorded for financial reporting purposes. Used for period-end close, annual budget variance analysis, and GAAP/IFRS consolidated financial statement preparation. Corresponds to SAP field GJAHR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP; IFRS IAS 1; SOX

attributes.name: grn_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the goods receipt note (GRN) confirming physical receipt of agricultural inputs (seeds, fertilizers, chemicals, feed, parts) at the warehouse or farm location. Key document in three-way match. Corresponds to SAP MIGO goods receipt document number.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Manhattan Associates WMS; USDA FSMA; GAAP

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total invoice amount before tax deductions. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Represents the full billed value for agricultural inputs (seeds, fertilizers NPK, crop protection chemicals, feed, equipment parts). Used for COGS allocation and crop enterprise budget variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP ASC 420; IFRS IAS 2; Oracle NetSuite AP

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date printed on the vendor's invoice document. Represents the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP (date precision) for the invoice issuance event. Used for payment terms calculation, aging analysis, and seasonal input cost tracking. Corresponds to SAP field BLDAT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: invoice_line_count
attributes.description: Total number of line items on this invoice. Supports invoice complexity analysis, processing time benchmarking, and validation that all line-level detail records are present in the silver layer. Derived from the source system header record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Oracle NetSuite AP

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the AP invoice. LIFECYCLE_STATUS for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. 'draft' = entered but not posted; 'posted' = recorded in GL; 'approved' = workflow approved; 'paid' = payment cleared; 'blocked' = payment block active; 'cancelled' = reversed/voided.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice document type. 'standard' = regular vendor invoice; 'credit_memo' = vendor credit for returns/adjustments; 'debit_memo' = additional charge; 'recurring' = periodic service invoice; 'intercompany' = between related legal entities. Corresponds to SAP field BLART.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: is_recurring
attributes.description: Indicates whether this invoice is part of a recurring payment schedule (e.g., land lease payments, equipment rental, subscription services). Supports automated invoice matching and cash flow forecasting for seasonal agricultural operations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Oracle NetSuite AP; GAAP

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Net payable amount after tax adjustments (gross_amount minus tax_amount or as applicable per tax treatment). Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET. Represents the actual cash outflow for payment processing and AP aging reports.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP; IFRS IAS 1; Oracle NetSuite AP

attributes.name: payment_block_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the invoice is blocked from payment and the reason. 'unblocked' = cleared for payment; 'manual_block' = manually held; 'quality_block' = QM hold pending COA review; 'price_variance' = unit price exceeds PO tolerance; 'duplicate_check' = potential duplicate invoice detected. Corresponds to SAP field ZLSPR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/MM Module; SOX Section 404; GAAP Internal Controls

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which payment was made to the vendor. Used for AP aging analysis, on-time payment KPI reporting, and cash flow reconciliation. Populated upon payment clearing. Corresponds to SAP field AUGDT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Oracle NetSuite AP; GAAP

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which payment will be or was made to the vendor. Supports treasury operations, bank reconciliation, and payment run configuration. Corresponds to SAP field ZLSCH. Common methods for agricultural suppliers include ACH, wire transfer, check, and EFT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Oracle NetSuite AP; GAAP

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the payment document (check number, ACH transaction ID, wire reference) that cleared this invoice. Populated after payment is executed. Used for bank reconciliation and vendor payment confirmation. Corresponds to SAP field AUGBL (clearing document).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Oracle NetSuite AP; GAAP

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Vendor payment terms code defining the payment schedule and early payment discount conditions (e.g., NT30 = Net 30 days, 2/10NT30 = 2% discount if paid within 10 days, net 30). Drives due_date calculation and cash discount management. Corresponds to SAP field ZTERM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP; Oracle NetSuite AP

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was posted to the general ledger (GL). Determines the accounting period for GAAP/IFRS period-end close. May differ from invoice_date due to processing lag. Corresponds to SAP field BUDAT.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP ASC 420; IFRS IAS 1; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: sap_document_number
attributes.description: Internal SAP S/4HANA FI accounting document number assigned upon invoice posting. Used for cross-referencing with the general ledger and audit trail. Corresponds to SAP field BELNR in table BKPF.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Originating operational system from which this AP invoice record was ingested into the Databricks silver layer. Supports data lineage, reconciliation between SAP S/4HANA FI and Oracle NetSuite AP, and audit trail for the lakehouse pipeline.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer; SAP S/4HANA FI; Oracle NetSuite AP; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applied to the invoice (e.g., sales tax, VAT, use tax). Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET. Supports tax reporting, recoverability analysis, and GAAP/IFRS tax accounting. Corresponds to SAP field WMWST.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP ASC 740; IFRS IAS 12; EPA Tax Compliance

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax determination code applied to the invoice for calculating applicable taxes (sales tax, VAT, use tax, agricultural exemptions). Corresponds to SAP field MWSKZ. Supports tax compliance reporting for EPA, USDA, and state agricultural tax exemption programs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP ASC 740; IFRS IAS 12; EPA; USDA

attributes.name: three_way_match_status
attributes.description: Result of the three-way match validation comparing the purchase order (PO), goods receipt note (GRN), and vendor invoice. 'matched' = all three documents align within tolerance; 'quantity_variance' = invoice quantity differs from GRN; 'price_variance' = invoice price differs from PO; 'grn_missing' = goods receipt not yet recorded. Critical SOX control for agricultural input procurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/FI Module; SOX Section 404; GAAP Internal Controls; USDA Procurement Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this AP invoice record. RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Tracks changes for SOX compliance, workflow audit trail, and delta processing in the Databricks silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GAAP; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: vendor_invoice_number
attributes.description: The externally-assigned invoice number as printed on the vendor's invoice document. Serves as the primary BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for three-way match (PO/GRN/invoice) and vendor dispute resolution. Must be unique per vendor. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA FI document header field BELNR.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP; IFRS IAS 1; SOX Section 302

products.name: ap_invoice_line
products.description: Line-level detail for accounts payable invoices capturing individual line items for agricultural input purchases. Captures line number, material/service description, quantity, unit of measure (MT, BU, CWT), unit price, line amount, GL account assignment, cost center, purchase order reference, goods receipt reference (GRN), tax code, and commodity classification. Supports COGS allocation by commodity and crop enterprise budgeting.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Invoice Line Item (RSEG)

attributes.name: ap_invoice_line_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each accounts payable invoice line item record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity. Entity role: TRANSACTION_LINE.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Module; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: AP invoice lines for grain purchases and commodity input procurement require commodity linkage for cost-of-production reporting, commodity-level spend analysis, and FSMA traceability. Ag procurement c
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center to which this invoice line expenditure is allocated, supporting crop enterprise budgeting and OPEX/CAPEX tracking. Maps to SAP CO cost center (KOSTL).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; GAAP; IFRS; SOX

attributes.name: field_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific agricultural field or land parcel to which this invoice line expenditure is allocated, enabling field-level cost tracking, precision agriculture cost analysis, and GIS-based financial reporting.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; Esri ArcGIS; USDA FSA Farm Records

attributes.name: finance_ap_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent AP invoice header record. Establishes the header-to-line relationship for this invoice line item. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE HEADER_REFERENCE category.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Module; Oracle NetSuite AP Module

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: ap_invoice_line has gl_account_code as a STRING. Each invoice line is posted to a specific GL account (expense, inventory, asset). Normalizing to a FK to gl_account links the line item to the authorit
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: Reference to the material master or service catalog record for the agricultural input, commodity, or service being invoiced on this line. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE RESOURCE_REFERENCE category. Maps to SAP MM material master (MATNR).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: procurement_goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Reference to the goods receipt note (GRN) record confirming physical receipt of agricultural inputs against which this invoice line is matched. Supports three-way matching and COGS allocation. Maps to SAP MIGO goods receipt document.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-IM Module; GAAP; SOX

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.profit_center

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order header associated with this invoice line, enabling three-way matching between PO, goods receipt, and invoice. Maps to SAP MM EKKO/EKPO purchase order.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-PO Module; GAAP; SOX

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.vendor_contract. Business justification: Individual AP invoice lines in agriculture reference contract lines for price compliance checking (e.g., verifying fertilizer invoice price matches contracted price tier). Supports contract compliance
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: capex_opex_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this invoice line represents a capital expenditure (CAPEX) for long-term asset investment or an operational expenditure (OPEX) for day-to-day farming operations. Critical for financial reporting, budgeting, and EBITDA calculation.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 360; IFRS IAS 16; SAP S/4HANA CO; SOX

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this AP invoice line record was first created in the source system, used for audit trail, SOX financial controls, and data lineage tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; GAAP; SOX; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: crop_season
attributes.description: The agricultural crop season or growing year to which this invoice line expenditure is attributed (e.g., '2024-Spring', '2024-Fall'). Enables crop enterprise budgeting, seasonal COGS allocation, and year-over-year financial analysis.
attributes.references: Granular Farm Management; USDA NASS; GAAP

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the monetary amounts on this invoice line (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD). Supports multi-currency AP processing for international agricultural supply chain transactions.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: delivery_date
attributes.description: The actual or expected date on which the agricultural inputs or services on this invoice line were delivered or performed. Used for accrual accounting, crop season alignment, and PHI/REI compliance tracking for agrochemicals.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; GAAP ASC 450; FSMA; EPA PHI/REI

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The monetary discount applied to this invoice line as negotiated with the vendor (e.g., volume rebate, early payment discount, seasonal pricing). Reduces the net payable amount for this line.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Module; Oracle NetSuite AP; GAAP

attributes.name: gmo_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agricultural input on this invoice line contains or is derived from genetically modified organisms (GMO). Required for COOL (Country of Origin Labeling), USDA NOP organic certification compliance, and customer transparency reporting.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; USDA NOP; COOL; FDA Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard

attributes.name: line_amount
attributes.description: The gross monetary value of this invoice line before tax and discounts, calculated as quantity multiplied by unit price. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT category. Maps to SAP RSEG-WRBTR (line item amount in document currency).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Module; GAAP; IFRS; SOX

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line item number within the parent AP invoice, used to order and uniquely identify each line within the invoice. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_SEQUENCE category. Corresponds to SAP RSEG-BUZEI (line item number).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Module; Oracle NetSuite AP Module

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of this AP invoice line within the accounts payable workflow. 'open' = awaiting posting; 'posted' = GL entry created; 'blocked' = held for review (e.g., price variance); 'reversed' = accounting reversal applied; 'cancelled' = line voided; 'parked' = saved but not yet posted. Maps to SAP FI document status.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Module; GAAP; SOX

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: The batch or lot number (LOT) of the agricultural input (seed, fertilizer, pesticide) on this invoice line, enabling traceability from purchase through application for FSMA compliance, MRL tracking, and food safety audit trails.
attributes.references: FSMA; FDA 21 CFR Part 1; GLOBALG.A.P.; SAP S/4HANA MM Batch Management

attributes.name: matching_status
attributes.description: Status of the three-way matching process (PO, GRN, Invoice) for this line item. 'unmatched' = no match yet; 'po_matched' = matched to PO only; 'grn_matched' = matched to GRN only; 'three_way_matched' = fully matched; 'exception' = variance requiring resolution. Critical for SOX controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-IV Module; GAAP; SOX; FSMA

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: The net payable amount for this invoice line after applying discounts and before tax (line_amount minus discount_amount). Used for COGS allocation, crop enterprise budgeting, and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Module; GAAP; IFRS; SOX

attributes.name: po_line_number
attributes.description: The specific line item number on the referenced purchase order that corresponds to this invoice line, enabling precise PO-to-invoice line matching. Maps to SAP EKPO-EBELP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-PO Module; GAAP

attributes.name: price_variance_amount
attributes.description: The monetary difference between the invoiced unit price and the purchase order unit price for this line, used to identify and resolve invoice discrepancies. A non-zero value triggers the matching exception workflow. Maps to SAP MM invoice verification price variance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-IV Module; GAAP; SOX

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the material or service invoiced on this line. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_QUANTITY category. Used in conjunction with unit_of_measure for volume-based COGS allocation and three-way matching against GRN quantity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP RSEG-MENGE; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: quantity_variance
attributes.description: The difference between the invoiced quantity and the goods receipt quantity for this line, used to identify over- or under-billing by vendors. Supports three-way matching exception management and vendor performance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM-IV Module; GAAP; SOX

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this invoice line was ingested into the lakehouse silver layer (e.g., SAP_S4HANA for FI-AP module, ORACLE_NETSUITE for NetSuite AP, GRANULAR for Granular Farm Management). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; Oracle NetSuite AP; Granular Farm Management; Enterprise Data Governance

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The tax amount applicable to this invoice line, including sales tax, VAT, or use tax as applicable by jurisdiction. Used for tax reporting and accounts payable accruals.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Tax Module; GAAP; IFRS; IRS

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: The tax determination code applied to this invoice line, identifying the applicable tax rate and jurisdiction rules (e.g., V1 for input VAT, U1 for use tax). Maps to SAP FI MWSKZ tax code.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Module; IRS; GAAP; IFRS IAS 12

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the invoiced quantity, using standard agricultural units: MT (Metric Ton), BU (Bushel), CWT (Hundredweight), KG (Kilogram), LB (Pound), L (Liter), GAL (Gallon), EA (Each), HR (Hour), AC (Acre). Maps to SAP MEINS base unit of measure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MT|BU|CWT|KG|LB|L|GAL|EA|HR|AC — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; USDA; ISO 80000-1

attributes.name: unit_price
attributes.description: The agreed price per unit of measure for the material or service on this invoice line, as stated by the vendor. Used for price variance analysis against PO unit price and market benchmarks (DTN/WASDE). Maps to SAP RSEG-WRBTR / quantity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Module; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to this AP invoice line record in the source system, supporting change tracking, SOX audit controls, and incremental data loading in the lakehouse pipeline. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP; GAAP; SOX; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: The WBS element code for CAPEX project cost tracking, used when the invoice line relates to capital expenditure on agricultural infrastructure, equipment, or land improvements. Maps to SAP PS POSID.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS/CO Module; GAAP; IFRS IAS 16; SOX

products.name: ap_payment
products.description: Accounts payable payment transaction recording actual disbursements to agricultural input suppliers and service vendors. Captures payment document number, vendor ID, payment date, payment method (ACH, wire, check), bank account, payment amount, currency, cleared invoice references, discount taken, payment run ID, and bank clearing status. Supports seasonal payment cycles aligned with planting and harvest, early-pay discount optimization for input purchases, and cash flow management.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Payment Document (BKPF/BSEG)

attributes.name: ap_payment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for ap_payment

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Internal identifier of the company's house bank account from which the payment was disbursed. References the SAP house bank/account ID configuration. Supports bank account-level cash position monitoring and liquidity management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI House Bank Configuration; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: ap_payment has company_code as a STRING. Payments are made by a specific legal entity. Normalizing to a proper FK ensures referential integrity and enables entity-level payment reporting and cash flow
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center to which this payment is allocated for management accounting and CAPEX/OPEX tracking. Supports COGS allocation by commodity and crop enterprise budgeting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: finance_ap_invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary cleared accounts payable invoice that this payment settles. Supports invoice-to-payment matching and reconciliation for agricultural input purchases.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Oracle NetSuite AP

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: ap_payment has gl_account_code as a STRING. Payment transactions are posted to specific GL accounts (bank clearing accounts, AP accounts). Normalizing to a FK to gl_account links the payment to the au
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: payment_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the automated payment run batch that generated this disbursement. SAP F110 payment run identifier used to group payments executed in the same batch cycle, supporting seasonal payment cycles aligned with planting and harvest.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI F110 Payment Program; Oracle NetSuite AP

attributes.name: procurement_goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: FK to procurement.procurement_goods_receipt

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: FK to procurement.purchase_order

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agricultural input supplier or service vendor receiving this payment. Links to the vendor master record for supplier identity, banking details, and payment terms.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM/FI Vendor Master; Oracle NetSuite AP

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the financial controller or AP manager who approved this payment for disbursement. Required for SOX dual-control and segregation of duties compliance. Supports payment authorization audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI Authorization; GAAP Internal Controls

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payment was formally approved by the authorized approver. Provides SOX-compliant audit trail for payment authorization and segregation of duties controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI Workflow; GAAP Internal Controls

attributes.name: bank_clearing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the bank confirmed the payment as cleared in the bank statement. Used for bank reconciliation, outstanding check tracking, and cash flow actuals reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Bank Statement Processing; GAAP ASC 230

attributes.name: bank_clearing_status
attributes.description: Status of the payment as reported by the bank clearing system. Indicates whether the payment has been confirmed as cleared by the bank, returned (e.g., invalid account), or rejected. Drives bank reconciliation and outstanding payment follow-up.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Bank Reconciliation; NACHA ACH Return Codes; Federal Reserve

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.description: Physical check number assigned when payment method is CHECK. Used for check register management, positive pay file submission to the bank, and outstanding check reconciliation. Null for electronic payment methods (ACH, WIRE, EFT).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Check Management; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment record was first created in the financial system. Provides audit trail for record origination and supports SOX financial reporting controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP Internal Controls

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transaction currency of this payment (e.g., USD for domestic, EUR for European suppliers, BRL for Brazilian commodity purchases). Supports multi-currency AP management for global agricultural supply chain.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Configuration; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: discount_taken_amount
attributes.description: Early payment discount amount deducted from the invoice total at time of payment. Reflects early-pay discount optimization for agricultural input purchases (e.g., seed, fertilizer, crop protection chemicals). Reduces COGS and improves ROI.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Oracle NetSuite AP; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign currency exchange rate applied at the time of payment to convert the transaction currency to the company code local currency (USD). Used for foreign currency gain/loss calculation and IFRS IAS 21 compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Currency; IFRS IAS 21; GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal accounting period (1-12 or 1-16 for special periods) within the fiscal year in which this payment is posted. Used for period-level cash flow reporting, EBITDA analysis, and month-end close reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant; GAAP; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which this payment is recorded for financial reporting purposes. Agricultural businesses may use non-calendar fiscal years aligned with growing seasons. Required for period-end close, GAAP/IFRS consolidated statements, and SOX financial controls.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant; GAAP; IFRS IAS 1; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: invoice_count
attributes.description: Number of individual invoices cleared by this single payment transaction. Supports partial vs. full payment analysis and multi-invoice payment run reconciliation for bulk agricultural input purchases.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Oracle NetSuite AP

attributes.name: local_currency_amount
attributes.description: Payment amount converted to the company code local currency (USD) using the exchange_rate at time of payment. Used for consolidated financial statements, EBITDA reporting, and GAAP/IFRS compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; IFRS IAS 21; GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: net_payment_amount
attributes.description: Actual net amount remitted to the vendor after deducting any early payment discount taken. Equals payment_amount minus discount_taken_amount. Represents the true cash disbursement recorded in the bank statement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP ASC 230; IFRS IAS 7

attributes.name: payment_amount
attributes.description: Gross payment amount disbursed to the vendor in the transaction currency before any discount deduction. Represents the total cash outflow for this payment event. Used for cash flow management and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP ASC 230; IFRS IAS 7; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: payment_block_reason
attributes.description: Reason code indicating why a payment is blocked from processing (e.g., invoice dispute, missing COA, quality hold, vendor master incomplete). Null when payment is not blocked. Supports AP workflow management and vendor dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Block Indicators; Oracle NetSuite AP; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The actual business date on which the payment was issued or disbursed to the vendor. Used for cash flow reporting, early-pay discount optimization, and seasonal payment cycle analysis aligned with planting and harvest periods.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP ASC 230; IFRS IAS 7

attributes.name: payment_document_number
attributes.description: Externally-known payment document number assigned by the financial system (SAP FI or Oracle NetSuite) at the time of payment posting. Used for audit trails, bank reconciliation, and vendor remittance communication.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Oracle NetSuite AP; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument used to disburse funds to the vendor. ACH (Automated Clearing House) is common for domestic agricultural input suppliers; WIRE for international commodity purchases; CHECK for smaller vendors. Supports payment method analysis and bank fee optimization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Methods; NACHA ACH Rules; Federal Reserve Regulation J

attributes.name: payment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by AP staff regarding this payment transaction. May include vendor communication details, dispute context, seasonal payment cycle notes, or special handling instructions for agricultural input suppliers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Oracle NetSuite AP

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: External payment reference number transmitted to the bank and included in the remittance advice to the vendor. For ACH payments, this is the transaction reference in the NACHA file. Enables vendor-side payment matching and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; NACHA ACH Rules; Oracle NetSuite AP

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment transaction. Tracks progression from initiation through bank clearing or return/void. Supports cash flow management and bank reconciliation workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Oracle NetSuite AP; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment transaction type. Advance payments are common for seed and input purchases ahead of planting season. Partial payments occur for large equipment or land lease transactions. Supports cash flow forecasting and working capital analysis.

products.name: crop_enterprise_budget
products.description: Crop enterprise budget master with embedded line-level detail representing planned financial performance for a specific crop, field, and growing season. Header captures budget ID, crop type, field/farm unit, growing season, budget version (original, revised, final), planned revenue per acre/hectare, planned yield, planned price per unit, and approval status. Line-level detail captures individual cost and revenue categories (seed, fertilizer NPK, crop protection, custom hire, labor, equipment, irrigation, land rent, crop insurance, revenue) with planned quantity, unit cost, planned total, actual amount, and variance. Core to agricultural financial planning, break-even analysis, and ROI analysis per crop enterprise.

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status of the crop enterprise budget. Tracks the authorization state separate from the overall budget lifecycle status. Required for SOX financial controls — budgets must be approved before costs can be committed against them.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the individual who approved this crop enterprise budget. Required for SOX audit trail and financial controls documentation. Captured from SAP S/4HANA workflow or SAP SuccessFactors HR records.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which this crop enterprise budget received formal approval. Establishes the authorization date for SOX financial controls and triggers the budget activation in SAP S/4HANA CO for cost commitment tracking.

attributes.name: breakeven_price_per_unit
attributes.description: Minimum commodity price per unit required to cover all planned production costs (planned total cost ÷ planned total yield). Critical decision-support metric for marketing strategy, forward contract pricing, and crop insurance coverage level selection.
attributes.references: USDA ERS; Granular Farm Management; GAAP; IFRS IAS 2

attributes.name: budget_area_acres
attributes.description: Total planned planted area in acres for this crop enterprise budget. US-standard unit used alongside hectares for domestic reporting, USDA FSA program compliance, and land rent calculations expressed per acre.
attributes.references: USDA FSA; Granular Farm Management; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: budget_area_ha
attributes.description: Total planned planted area in hectares (ha) for this crop enterprise budget. Used as the denominator for per-hectare cost and revenue calculations, break-even analysis, and ROI reporting. Aligns with field area records in Esri ArcGIS and John Deere Operations Center.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center; Esri ArcGIS; USDA FSA; ISO 80000-3

attributes.name: budget_date
attributes.description: The principal business event date on which this crop enterprise budget was formally established or initiated. Represents the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP (date precision) for the budget creation event, distinct from system audit timestamps. Used for period alignment in financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; GAAP; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: budget_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the crop enterprise budget, used in financial planning documents, SAP CO cost object references, and Granular Farm Management records. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for cross-system traceability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; Granular Farm Management; GAAP ASC 420

attributes.name: budget_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the crop enterprise budget. Drives approval workflow and financial reporting inclusion. Draft = in preparation; Submitted = pending approval; Approved = authorized for use; Revised = updated post-approval; Final = locked for period close; Cancelled = voided. LIFECYCLE_STATUS for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; SOX Section 302; GAAP

attributes.name: budget_version
attributes.description: Version classification of the crop enterprise budget indicating whether it represents the original plan, a mid-season revision, or the final locked version. Supports variance analysis between original and revised plans per GAAP budgetary control requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; GAAP; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when this crop enterprise budget record was first created in the data platform. Supports RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED requirement for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GAAP; ISO 8601

attributes.name: crop_insurance_cost_per_ha
attributes.description: Planned crop insurance premium cost per hectare included in this enterprise budget. Reflects USDA Risk Management Agency (RMA) policy premiums for revenue protection or yield protection coverage. Confidential as it reflects risk management strategy.
attributes.references: USDA RMA; FSMA; Granular Farm Management; GAAP ASC 720

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this crop enterprise budget (e.g., USD, EUR, BRL). Required for GAAP/IFRS consolidated financial statement preparation and multi-currency reporting in SAP S/4HANA FI.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; GAAP; IFRS IAS 21; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (quarter or posting period) within the fiscal year to which this budget is aligned (e.g., Q1, Q2, P01–P12). Supports sub-annual budget phasing, cash flow planning, and SAP S/4HANA CO period-based cost allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; Oracle NetSuite; GAAP; IFRS IAS 34

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this crop enterprise budget belongs. Used for period-based financial reporting, year-over-year variance analysis, and alignment with SAP S/4HANA FI fiscal year variants and Oracle NetSuite accounting periods.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Oracle NetSuite; GAAP; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: government_program_payment_per_ha
attributes.description: Planned government program payment per hectare expected to be received (e.g., USDA ARC/PLC payments, conservation program payments). Included as a revenue offset in the enterprise budget for accurate net income projection.
attributes.references: USDA FSA ARC/PLC Programs; USDA CRP; Granular Farm Management; GAAP ASC 958

attributes.name: harvest_end_date
attributes.description: Planned date by which harvest operations are expected to be completed for this crop enterprise. Drives revenue recognition timing, post-harvest handling cost planning, and storage/logistics scheduling in the supply chain.
attributes.references: Climate FieldView; Granular Farm Management; GAAP ASC 606; IFRS IFRS 15

attributes.name: is_gmo
attributes.description: Indicates whether the budgeted crop variety is a Genetically Modified Organism (GMO). Affects seed cost tiers, technology trait fees, export market eligibility, and COOL labeling compliance requirements.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; FDA; COOL (Country of Origin Labeling); GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: land_rent_per_ha
attributes.description: Planned cash land rent cost per hectare included in this crop enterprise budget. One of the largest variable cost components in crop production. Confidential as it reflects negotiated lease terms. Used for land cost benchmarking and lease vs. own analysis.
attributes.references: USDA ERS Land Values Report; Granular Farm Management; GAAP ASC 842; IFRS IFRS 16

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for agronomic, financial, or operational notes associated with this crop enterprise budget. Captures assumptions, risk factors, revision rationale, or special conditions (e.g., drought risk, market volatility, new variety trial). Supports audit documentation and management commentary.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; Granular Farm Management; GAAP; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: planned_cost_per_ha
attributes.description: Total planned cost of production per hectare. Key benchmark metric for comparing production efficiency across fields, farms, and seasons. Used in break-even price calculations and OPEX benchmarking against industry standards.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 330; Granular Farm Management; USDA ERS Cost of Production Reports

attributes.name: planned_net_income
attributes.description: Planned net income for the crop enterprise calculated as planned total revenue minus planned total cost. Primary profitability metric for crop enterprise budgeting, ROI analysis, and lender/investor reporting. Confidential as it reflects forward financial projections.
attributes.references: GAAP; IFRS IAS 1; SAP S/4HANA CO Module; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: planned_price_per_unit
attributes.description: Budgeted commodity selling price per unit of measure used to calculate planned revenue. Typically derived from forward contract prices, DTN market data, or WASDE price projections. Confidential as it reflects pricing strategy and forward market positions.
attributes.references: WASDE; DTN (Data Transmission Network); USDA AMS; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: planned_revenue_per_ha
attributes.description: Total planned gross revenue per hectare calculated as planned yield per hectare multiplied by planned price per unit. Core metric for crop enterprise profitability analysis, break-even determination, and ROI reporting. Confidential as it reflects forward pricing strategy.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; IFRS IFRS 15; Granular Farm Management; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: planned_total_cost
attributes.description: Total planned cost of production for the entire budgeted area, aggregating all cost line items (seed, fertilizer NPK, crop protection, labor, equipment, irrigation, land rent, crop insurance, custom hire). Used for COGS allocation, break-even analysis, and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 330; IFRS IAS 2; SAP S/4HANA CO Module; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: planned_total_revenue
attributes.description: Total planned gross revenue for the entire budgeted area (planned revenue per hectare × budget area). Represents the gross income line in the crop enterprise budget P&L. Used for EBITDA projection and SAP S/4HANA CO profitability analysis. Confidential as it reflects forward pricing.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 606; IFRS IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA CO/FI Module; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: planned_yield_per_ha
attributes.description: Expected crop yield per hectare (ha) used as the basis for revenue projections in this enterprise budget. Expressed in the commodity's standard unit of measure (e.g., MT/ha for grains, BU/ha for corn). Derived from historical yield records, NDVI analysis, and agronomic models.
attributes.references: USDA NASS; WASDE; Climate FieldView; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: planting_start_date
attributes.description: Planned date on which planting operations are scheduled to begin for this crop enterprise. Used for cash flow timing, input procurement scheduling, and integration with Climate FieldView and Trimble Ag Software planting plans.
attributes.references: Climate FieldView; Trimble Ag Software; Granular Farm Management; USDA NASS

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA CO profit center code associated with this crop enterprise budget. Enables profitability analysis by crop enterprise, farm unit, or geographic segment for management reporting and EBITDA calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; GAAP; IFRS IFRS 8

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when this crop enterprise budget record was last modified. Supports RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED requirement for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Used for change tracking and SOX audit trail compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GAAP; ISO 8601

attributes.name: yield_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for yield quantities in this budget (e.g., MT = Metric Ton, BU = Bushel, CWT = Hundredweight). Ensures consistent interpretation of planned and actual yield figures across commodity types and reporting systems.
attributes.references: USDA AMS; SAP S/4HANA MM Module; ISO 80000-4

products.name: capital_project
products.description: Capital and project expenditure request, approval, and cost collection record for agricultural investments and operational projects. Covers CAPEX items (tractors, combines, planters, irrigation systems, land improvements, facility construction, technology infrastructure) and OPEX project tracking (field renovation, crop trials, marketing campaigns). Captures request number, asset/project description, category (CAPEX/OPEX), requesting cost center, estimated cost, funding source, business justification, ROI calculation, approval workflow status, approved amount, budget vs actual costs, commitment costs, settlement rule, and project status. Supports CAPEX/OPEX tracking, project cost management, and SOX financial controls.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Investment Request / Oracle NetSuite CAPEX

attributes.name: business_justification

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the capital project request record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, SOX documentation, and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this project record (e.g., USD, EUR, BRL). Ensures consistent multi-currency financial reporting and IFRS compliance.

attributes.name: depreciation_key

attributes.name: estimated_cost_amount

attributes.name: fulfillment_status

attributes.name: planned_completion_date

attributes.name: planned_start_date

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to livestock.herd. Business justification: Livestock producers place live cattle and feeder cattle futures hedges against specific herds for price risk management. Linking commodity_hedge to herd enables hedge effectiveness testing, P&L attrib

attributes.name: production_group_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to livestock.production_group. Business justification: Feedlot operators hedge specific production lots (groups) against futures contracts for closeout price protection. Linking commodity_hedge to production_group supports lot-level hedge effectiveness te
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: basis_risk_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the basis differential between the local cash price and the exchange-traded futures price for the hedged commodity. Represents residual price risk not eliminated by the hedge. Critical metric in agricultural commodity marketing and grain merchandising.
attributes.references: CME Group; CBOT; USDA; ASC 815; IFRS 9

attributes.name: broker_account_number
attributes.description: The account number assigned by the futures commission merchant (FCM) or broker for the trading account under which this hedge position is held. Used for margin account reconciliation and position reporting.
attributes.references: CFTC; CME Group; SAP S/4HANA FI-TRM

attributes.name: contract_expiration_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the futures or options contract expires or the forward contract matures. Used for position management, roll scheduling, and hedge effectiveness testing timelines.
attributes.references: CME Group; CBOT; ICE; ASC 815; IFRS 9

attributes.name: contract_month
attributes.description: The delivery/expiration month of the futures or options contract expressed in standard exchange notation (e.g., Z24 = December 2024, H25 = March 2025). Critical for managing basis risk and roll strategy in agricultural commodity marketing.
attributes.references: CME Group; CBOT; ICE; CFTC

attributes.name: counterparty_name
attributes.description: The name of the broker, dealer, or OTC counterparty for the hedging instrument. For exchange-traded instruments, this is typically the futures commission merchant (FCM) or clearing broker. For OTC forwards, this is the counterparty financial institution or grain merchandiser.
attributes.references: CFTC; ASC 815; IFRS 9; SAP S/4HANA FI-TRM

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this commodity hedge record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under SOX and hedge accounting documentation per ASC 815/IFRS 9.
attributes.references: SOX; ASC 815; IFRS 9; SAP S/4HANA FI-TRM

attributes.name: effectiveness_test_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent hedge effectiveness test was performed. Required for hedge accounting documentation and SOX audit trail.
attributes.references: ASC 815; IFRS 9; SOX; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: effectiveness_test_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to assess hedge effectiveness as required by ASC 815/IFRS 9. 'dollar_offset' compares changes in fair value; 'regression' uses statistical analysis; 'hypothetical_derivative' compares to a perfect hedge; 'critical_terms_match' applies when key terms of hedging instrument and hedged item match.
attributes.references: ASC 815; IFRS 9; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: effectiveness_test_result
attributes.description: The outcome of the most recent hedge effectiveness assessment. 'highly_effective' qualifies for hedge accounting treatment (80-125% offset range per ASC 815); 'ineffective' requires de-designation and P&L recognition of ineffective portion; 'not_tested' for instruments not yet assessed.
attributes.references: ASC 815; IFRS 9; GAAP; IFRS; SOX

attributes.name: exchange_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the exchange on which the futures or options contract is traded. CME (Chicago Mercantile Exchange) for livestock; CBOT (Chicago Board of Trade) for grains and oilseeds; ICE (Intercontinental Exchange) for cotton and sugar; NYMEX for energy-related agricultural inputs.
attributes.references: CME Group; CBOT; ICE; CFTC

attributes.name: forward_price
attributes.description: For forward contracts, the agreed-upon price at which the commodity will be bought or sold at the future settlement date. Expressed in currency per unit of measure. Null for exchange-traded futures and options.
attributes.references: IFRS 9; ASC 815; ICE; GAAP

attributes.name: futures_price_at_entry
attributes.description: The exchange-quoted futures price at the time the hedge position was established. Used as the reference price for basis calculation (local cash price minus futures price) and hedge effectiveness testing.
attributes.references: CME Group; CBOT; ICE; ASC 815; IFRS 9

attributes.name: hedge_designation
attributes.description: Formal hedge accounting designation per ASC 815 (US GAAP) or IFRS 9. 'fair_value' hedges offset changes in fair value of a recognized asset/liability; 'cash_flow' hedges offset variability in future cash flows; 'net_investment' hedges offset foreign currency exposure in net investments; 'not_designated' instruments are economic hedges not qualifying for hedge accounting treatment.
attributes.references: ASC 815; IFRS 9; GAAP; IFRS; SOX

attributes.name: hedge_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the hedge relationship is expected to end or was terminated. Used for hedge accounting de-designation and effectiveness testing period boundaries.
attributes.references: ASC 815; IFRS 9; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: hedge_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the hedging instrument, typically assigned by the treasury management system or SAP S/4HANA FI-TRM module (e.g., HDG-2024-00123). Used for cross-system reconciliation and audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-TRM; ASC 815; IFRS 9

attributes.name: hedge_ratio
attributes.description: The proportion of the hedged item's exposure covered by the hedging instrument, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.8000 = 80% coverage). Required for hedge accounting documentation under ASC 815/IFRS 9 and used in hedge effectiveness testing.
attributes.references: ASC 815; IFRS 9; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: hedge_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the hedge relationship formally begins for hedge accounting purposes per ASC 815/IFRS 9. May differ from trade_date if formal designation documentation is completed after execution.
attributes.references: ASC 815; IFRS 9; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: hedge_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the hedging instrument. 'open' indicates an active position; 'closed' indicates the position has been offset or settled; 'expired' indicates the contract reached maturity; 'cancelled' indicates early termination; 'pending_designation' indicates awaiting formal hedge accounting designation per ASC 815/IFRS 9.
attributes.references: ASC 815; IFRS 9; SAP S/4HANA FI-TRM

attributes.name: hedged_item_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the specific exposure or hedged item being protected by this instrument (e.g., 'Forecasted corn purchase Q3 2024 - 500,000 BU', 'Soybean inventory held at Decatur elevator'). Required for hedge accounting documentation under ASC 815/IFRS 9.
attributes.references: ASC 815; IFRS 9; GAAP; IFRS; SOX

attributes.name: initial_margin_required
attributes.description: The initial margin deposit required by the exchange clearinghouse when the futures position is established. Expressed in the transaction currency. Monitored daily against margin calls for cash flow management.
attributes.references: CME Group; CBOT; ICE; CFTC; SAP S/4HANA FI-TRM

attributes.name: instrument_type
attributes.description: Classification of the hedging instrument. 'futures' are standardized exchange-traded contracts; 'options' grant the right but not obligation to buy/sell at a strike price; 'forward' contracts are OTC bilateral agreements at a fixed forward price; 'swap' contracts exchange cash flows based on commodity price differentials.
attributes.references: ASC 815; IFRS 9; CME Group; CBOT; ICE

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this commodity hedge record was most recently modified. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX; ASC 815; IFRS 9; SAP S/4HANA FI-TRM

attributes.name: mark_to_market_value
attributes.description: The current fair value of the hedging instrument based on the latest available market price. Positive values indicate an unrealized gain; negative values indicate an unrealized loss. Updated daily for exchange-traded instruments per GAAP/IFRS fair value measurement requirements.
attributes.references: ASC 820; IFRS 13; ASC 815; IFRS 9; SAP S/4HANA FI-TRM

attributes.name: mtm_valuation_date
attributes.description: The date as of which the mark-to-market value was last calculated. Ensures financial reporting accuracy and supports period-end close processes in SAP S/4HANA FI.
attributes.references: ASC 820; IFRS 13; ASC 815; IFRS 9

attributes.name: notional_quantity
attributes.description: The total quantity of the underlying commodity covered by the hedging instrument. Expressed in the unit of measure applicable to the commodity (e.g., bushels for grain, hundredweight for livestock, metric tons for oilseeds). Drives exposure calculation and hedge ratio determination.
attributes.references: CME Group; CBOT; ICE; ASC 815; IFRS 9

attributes.name: number_of_contracts
attributes.description: The count of standardized exchange contracts comprising the hedge position. Each exchange contract represents a fixed notional quantity (e.g., 5,000 BU per CBOT corn contract). Used for margin calculation and position limit monitoring.
attributes.references: CME Group; CBOT; ICE; CFTC

attributes.name: option_premium_paid
attributes.description: The total premium paid to acquire an options contract, expressed in the transaction currency. Represents the maximum loss exposure for long option positions. Recorded as an asset under ASC 815/IFRS 9 hedge accounting. Null for futures and forward contracts.
attributes.references: ASC 815; IFRS 9; GAAP; IFRS; SAP S/4HANA FI-TRM

attributes.name: option_type
attributes.description: For options instruments, specifies whether the contract is a call option (right to buy) or put option (right to sell) the underlying commodity. 'not_applicable' for futures and forward contracts. Agricultural producers typically purchase put options to establish price floors.
attributes.references: CME Group; CBOT; ICE; ASC 815; IFRS 9

attributes.name: quantity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the notional quantity. BU (Bushel) for grains; MT (Metric Ton) for oilseeds and international contracts; CWT (Hundredweight) for livestock; LB (Pound) for cotton and sugar; TON for domestic bulk commodities.
attributes.references: CME Group; CBOT; ICE; USDA; GAAP

attributes.name: realized_gain_loss
attributes.description: The actual gain or loss recognized upon closing, expiration, or settlement of the hedging instrument. Positive values indicate a gain; negative values indicate a loss. Recorded to the appropriate P&L or OCI account per ASC 815/IFRS 9 hedge accounting treatment.
attributes.references: ASC 815; IFRS 9; GAAP; IFRS; SAP S/4HANA FI-CO; SOX

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the hedging instrument was or is expected to be settled. For closed/expired positions, the actual settlement date. For open positions, the expected settlement date based on contract terms.
attributes.references: CME Group; CBOT; ICE; ASC 815; IFRS 9

attributes.name: settlement_type
attributes.description: The method by which the contract is settled at expiration. 'cash' settlement uses the final settlement price without physical delivery; 'physical_delivery' requires delivery of the actual commodity; 'offset' indicates the position was closed by an opposing trade before expiration.
attributes.references: CME Group; CBOT; ICE; CFTC; USDA

attributes.name: strike_price
attributes.description: For options contracts, the price at which the holder has the right to buy (call) or sell (put) the underlying commodity. Expressed in the currency per unit of measure (e.g., USD per bushel). Null for futures and forward contracts.
attributes.references: CME Group; CBOT; ICE; ASC 815; IFRS 9

attributes.name: trade_date
attributes.description: The date on which the hedging instrument was executed or entered into. Represents the principal business event date for the hedge transaction, used for mark-to-market valuation and hedge accounting documentation.
attributes.references: ASC 815; IFRS 9; GAAP; IFRS; SAP S/4HANA FI-TRM

attributes.name: transaction_currency
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the hedge instrument is denominated (e.g., USD for CME/CBOT contracts, GBP for ICE London contracts). Used for multi-currency consolidation and IFRS/GAAP foreign currency translation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; GAAP; IFRS; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: variation_margin_balance
attributes.description: The cumulative daily settlement amount reflecting gains and losses on the futures position since inception. Positive indicates net gains credited to the margin account; negative indicates net losses debited. Critical for daily cash flow management and liquidity planning.
attributes.references: CME Group; CBOT; ICE; CFTC; SAP S/4HANA FI-TRM

products.name: government_program
products.description: USDA and government agricultural program enrollment and payment record capturing participation in federal and state farm programs. Covers commodity programs (ARC-CO, ARC-IC, PLC), conservation programs (CRP, EQIP, CSP), crop insurance (FCIC/RMA policies), disaster assistance (WHIP+, ERP, ELAP), and state-level agricultural incentives. Captures program name, administering agency (USDA FSA, NRCS, RMA), enrollment period, enrolled acres/base acres/livestock units, payment rate, estimated and actual payments received, compliance requirements (conservation compliance, HELC/WC), and payment limitation status. Supports farm revenue planning, ROI analysis, and regulatory reporting to USDA.
products.reference: USDA FSA Farm Programs (ARC/PLC/CRP) / NRCS EQIP/CSP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this government program enrollment record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Supports audit trail requirements under SOX financial controls.

attributes.name: crop_insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: USDA Risk Management Agency (RMA) / Federal Crop Insurance Corporation (FCIC) policy number for crop insurance programs. Unique identifier linking to the RMA actuarial data and indemnity payment records.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the program enrollment period expires or the contract term concludes. Null for open-ended or multi-year rolling programs.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the program enrollment period begins and the farm operation becomes eligible for program benefits, payments, or coverage.
attributes.references: USDA FSA; USDA NRCS; USDA RMA; GAAP

attributes.name: enrolled_acres
attributes.description: Total number of acres enrolled in the program for the program year. For conservation programs (CRP, EQIP), this is the contracted acreage. For commodity programs, this represents the planted or covered acres.
attributes.references: USDA FSA; USDA NRCS

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the farm operation formally enrolled or signed up for the government program with the administering agency.
attributes.references: USDA FSA; USDA NRCS; USDA RMA

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the farm's enrollment in the government program. Drives payment eligibility, compliance monitoring, and revenue planning workflows.
attributes.references: USDA FSA; USDA NRCS; USDA RMA

attributes.name: estimated_payment_amount
attributes.description: Projected total payment amount expected to be received from the government program for the program year, in USD. Used for farm revenue planning, ROI analysis, and EBITDA forecasting. Calculated based on enrolled acres, base acres, payment yield, and payment rate.
attributes.references: USDA FSA; USDA NRCS; USDA RMA; GAAP; IFRS; SOX

attributes.name: farm_serial_number
attributes.description: USDA FSA-assigned Farm Serial Number uniquely identifying the farm unit registered with the local FSA county office. Required for commodity program enrollment and payment processing.
attributes.references: USDA FSA

attributes.name: helc_determination
attributes.description: USDA NRCS determination of whether the enrolled land contains Highly Erodible Land (HEL) and whether the farm is in compliance with required conservation practices. Affects program payment eligibility.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS; USDA FSA; Food Security Act of 1985; HELC provisions

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_level
attributes.description: Percentage of expected yield or revenue covered by the crop insurance policy (e.g., 70%, 75%, 80%, 85%). Expressed as a decimal percentage. Determines indemnity payment trigger thresholds.
attributes.references: USDA RMA; FCIC; Federal Crop Insurance Act

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this government program enrollment record was most recently modified in the enterprise data platform. Supports change tracking, data lineage, and SOX audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX; GAAP; IFRS; ISO 22000

attributes.name: livestock_units
attributes.description: Number of livestock units enrolled or covered under livestock-related programs (e.g., ELAP - Emergency Livestock Assistance Program, LFP - Livestock Forage Disaster Program). Expressed in animal units as defined by USDA.
attributes.references: USDA FSA; ELAP; LFP

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional program-specific information, compliance notes, agency correspondence references, or special conditions attached to the enrollment that do not fit structured fields.
attributes.references: USDA FSA; USDA NRCS; USDA RMA

attributes.name: payment_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all payment amounts associated with this program record (typically USD for USDA programs). Required for IFRS consolidated financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the actual program payment was received from the administering agency. Used for cash flow planning, GL posting date determination, and revenue recognition under GAAP/IFRS.
attributes.references: USDA FSA; USDA NRCS; USDA RMA; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: payment_limitation_amount
attributes.description: Maximum allowable payment amount in USD that the farm operation may receive under USDA payment limitation rules for the program year. Varies by program type and entity structure.
attributes.references: USDA FSA; Agriculture Improvement Act of 2018

attributes.name: payment_limitation_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the farm operation's total program payments are within, at, or exceeding USDA-established annual payment limitation caps (e.g., $125,000 per person per year for ARC/PLC). Critical for compliance and payment eligibility monitoring.

attributes.name: payment_rate

attributes.name: profit_center

attributes.name: program_code

attributes.name: program_name

attributes.name: program_number

attributes.references: USDA FSA; USDA NRCS; USDA RMA

attributes.name: program_type

attributes.name: program_year

attributes.references: USDA FSA; USDA NRCS; USDA RMA

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code (USPS abbreviation) for the state in which the enrolled farm or land is located. Used for state-level program eligibility, FSA county office routing, and geographic reporting.
attributes.references: USDA FSA; USPS; ISO 3166-2:US

attributes.name: tract_number
attributes.description: USDA FSA-assigned tract number identifying a contiguous block of land within the farm unit. Used for base acre and enrolled acre tracking at the sub-farm level.
attributes.references: USDA FSA

attributes.name: wetland_conservation_status

attributes.references: USDA NRCS; USDA FSA; Food Security Act of 1985; Wetland Conservation (WC) provisions

products.name: bank_account
products.description: Bank account master representing enterprise banking relationships and cash management accounts used for agricultural operations. Captures bank account number, bank name, bank routing/SWIFT/BIC, account type (operating, savings, escrow, money market), currency, company code, GL reconciliation account, signatory authorities, daily balance, credit facility linkage, and active status. Critical for seasonal cash flow management, crop revenue deposits, input payment disbursements, and operating line of credit draws in agricultural enterprises.

attributes.name: bank_account_id

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module — House Bank Account Master

attributes.name: company_code_id

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP ASC 230; IFRS IAS 7

attributes.name: gl_account_id

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; SOX Section 302/404; GAAP ASC 230

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: The official account name as registered with the financial institution, typically the legal entity name or operating division name (e.g., 'AgriCorp Operating Account — Corn Division').
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI House Bank Configuration; Oracle NetSuite Bank Account Master

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The official bank account number assigned by the financial institution. Used for payment disbursements (input purchases, payroll), crop revenue deposits, and operating line of credit draws. Classified as restricted PCI-sensitive financial data.
attributes.references: PCI DSS v4.0; SOX Section 302; GAAP ASC 230; IFRS IAS 7

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the bank account. Frozen accounts may indicate regulatory holds or fraud investigations. Closed accounts are retained for historical audit trails per SOX requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP ASC 230

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the bank account by its functional purpose within agricultural cash management. Operating accounts handle day-to-day input payments and crop revenue; escrow accounts hold seasonal advance payments; money market accounts manage short-term liquidity between planting and harvest cycles.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI House Bank Account Type; GAAP ASC 230; IFRS IAS 7

attributes.name: available_balance

attributes.references: GAAP ASC 230; SAP S/4HANA Cash Management; Oracle NetSuite Cash Management

attributes.name: balance_date
attributes.description: The date as of which the daily_balance was last recorded or confirmed. Ensures temporal accuracy of cash position reporting for period-close reconciliation and treasury management.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 230; IFRS IAS 7; SAP S/4HANA Cash Management

attributes.name: bank_branch_address
