attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Bank Master; USDA Farm Service Agency Banking Requirements

attributes.name: bank_branch_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific bank branch where the account is held. Relevant for agricultural enterprises with regional banking relationships tied to specific farm credit districts or local agricultural lending offices.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Bank Master Data; Farm Credit Administration Regulations

attributes.name: bank_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the bank branch is domiciled (e.g., USA, CAN, BRA). Determines applicable banking regulations, currency controls, and SWIFT routing conventions for international agricultural trade settlements.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; SWIFT Standards; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the financial institution holding the account (e.g., 'Farm Credit Services of America', 'AgriBank FCB', 'Wells Fargo Bank N.A.'). Used for counterparty identification in payment processing and banking relationship management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI House Bank Master; Oracle NetSuite Bank Master

attributes.name: bank_statement_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which bank statements are received and processed for reconciliation. Daily statements are typical for high-volume operating accounts during planting and harvest seasons; monthly for savings and escrow accounts.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 230; SAP S/4HANA Bank Statement Processing (T-Code FF_5); Oracle NetSuite Bank Reconciliation

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bank account record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Supports audit trail requirements for SOX financial controls and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; GAAP Internal Controls; ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard

attributes.name: credit_facility_drawn
attributes.description: Current outstanding drawn balance on the operating line of credit associated with this account. Tracks seasonal borrowing against the credit facility limit for input financing and working capital management.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 470; IFRS IAS 39; Farm Credit Administration Regulations

attributes.name: credit_facility_limit
attributes.description: Maximum approved credit limit on the operating line of credit linked to this account. Agricultural enterprises rely on seasonal operating lines to finance seed, fertilizer (NPK), and crop protection inputs ahead of harvest revenue. Null for non-credit accounts.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 470; IFRS IAS 39; Farm Credit Administration Regulations; SAP S/4HANA Credit Management

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the account's operating currency (e.g., USD, EUR, BRL, CAD). Determines the base currency for all transactions posted to this account and drives foreign exchange revaluation in multi-currency agricultural operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; GAAP ASC 830; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: daily_balance
attributes.description: Most recent end-of-day ledger balance for the account as reported by the bank or treasury management system. Critical for seasonal cash flow monitoring during planting and harvest cycles, operating line of credit management, and daily liquidity reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 230; IFRS IAS 7; SOX Section 302; SAP S/4HANA Cash Management Module

attributes.name: dual_signatory_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account requires dual authorization (two signatories) for payment transactions above the single-signatory threshold. Enforces segregation of duties as a SOX internal control for high-value agricultural disbursements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; COSO Internal Control Framework; SAP S/4HANA Authorization

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this bank account became active and available for use in enterprise payment processing. Used for temporal validity tracking in SAP S/4HANA and for audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI House Bank Account Validity; GAAP ASC 230; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date on which this bank account ceases to be valid for payment processing. Null for open-ended active accounts. Closed accounts retain this date for historical audit trail and SOX compliance documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI House Bank Account Validity; GAAP ASC 230; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: house_bank_account_id_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA house bank account ID (sub-account identifier within the house bank) used in payment program configuration. Distinguishes between multiple accounts at the same bank (e.g., operating vs. payroll vs. escrow accounts at the same institution).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI House Bank Account Configuration (T-Code FI12)

attributes.name: house_bank_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA house bank identifier that groups bank accounts under a single banking institution within the enterprise. Used in automatic payment program (APP) configuration to route payments through the correct bank for input supplier disbursements and crop revenue collections.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI House Bank Configuration (T-Code FI12); Oracle NetSuite Bank Account Setup

attributes.name: iban
attributes.description: International Bank Account Number used for cross-border payment processing in SEPA and other international banking zones. Required for European agricultural trade partners and international commodity export settlements.
attributes.references: ISO 13616 IBAN Standard; SEPA Payment Scheme; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: last_reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent completed bank reconciliation for this account. Tracks reconciliation currency for period-close management and SOX control compliance. Unreconciled accounts past due date trigger escalation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; GAAP ASC 230; SAP S/4HANA Bank Reconciliation

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this bank account record. Used for change data capture (CDC), audit trail maintenance, and SOX control evidence of master data governance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; GAAP Internal Controls; SAP S/4HANA Change Document Management

attributes.name: overdraft_limit
attributes.description: Approved overdraft protection limit for the account. Provides short-term liquidity buffer during peak agricultural disbursement periods (e.g., planting season input payments) before crop revenue is received.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 470; SAP S/4HANA Cash Management; Farm Credit Administration

attributes.name: payment_method_code
attributes.description: Primary payment method configured for outgoing disbursements from this account in the automatic payment program (APP). Determines how AP payments for seeds, fertilizers, crop protection chemicals, and equipment are processed.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Automatic Payment Program (T-Code F110); NACHA ACH Rules; SWIFT Standards

attributes.name: primary_signatory_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary authorized signatory for the bank account. Required for check signing authority, wire transfer approvals, and banking mandate documentation. Part of SOX internal control documentation for financial authorization.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; GAAP Internal Controls; SAP S/4HANA Authorization Management

attributes.name: purpose_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the specific business purpose of this bank account (e.g., 'Corn and Soybean Crop Revenue Collection — Midwest Region', 'Seasonal Input Supplier Payments — Spring Planting', 'USDA CRP Program Payment Receipt Account').
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI House Bank Configuration; Granular Farm Management Financial Planning

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current reconciliation status of the bank account for the most recent statement period. Unreconciled status triggers period-close blocking actions per SOX financial controls.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; GAAP ASC 230; SAP S/4HANA Cash Management

attributes.name: routing_number
attributes.description: American Bankers Association (ABA) routing transit number identifying the financial institution for domestic ACH and wire transfers. Used for input supplier payments, USDA program payment receipts, and payroll disbursements within the US banking system.
attributes.references: ABA Routing Number Standard; NACHA ACH Rules; SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Configuration

attributes.name: secondary_signatory_name
attributes.description: Full name of the secondary authorized signatory for dual-control payment authorization. Dual-signatory requirements are common for large agricultural enterprises to satisfy SOX internal control requirements for high-value transactions.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; GAAP Internal Controls; Banking Mandate Requirements

attributes.name: single_signatory_limit
attributes.description: Maximum transaction amount that a single authorized signatory can approve without requiring dual authorization. Transactions above this threshold require dual-signatory approval per SOX internal control policies.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; COSO Internal Control Framework; Enterprise Authorization Policy

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this bank account master record originates. SAP S/4HANA FI is the primary source for enterprise accounts; Oracle NetSuite for subsidiary entities; Granular Farm Management for farm-level accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Oracle NetSuite; Granular Farm Management; Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: swift_bic_code
attributes.description: Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) Business Identifier Code for international wire transfers. Required for cross-border agricultural commodity payments, CIF/FOB trade settlements, and foreign currency transactions with international suppliers and buyers.
attributes.references: ISO 9362 SWIFT BIC Standard; SWIFT SR 2023; IFRS IAS 21

attributes.name: usda_program_account
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is designated to receive USDA government program payments (e.g., ARC, PLC, CRP, EQIP, CSP). USDA program accounts require specific tracking for government payment compliance and farm program reporting.
attributes.references: USDA Farm Service Agency (FSA) Payment Regulations; USDA NRCS Program Requirements; GAAP ASC 958

attributes.name: parent_bank_account_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on bank_account (parent_bank_account_id)

products.name: loan
products.description: Loan and credit facility master tracking all debt instruments held by the agricultural enterprise including operating lines of credit, term loans for equipment/land, FSA guaranteed loans, and seasonal crop production loans. Captures loan ID, lender (Farm Credit, commercial bank, FSA), loan type, principal amount, outstanding balance, interest rate (fixed/variable), maturity date, collateral (land, equipment, crop), covenant requirements, payment schedule, and draw/repayment history. Essential for ag financial planning where seasonal borrowing against future crop revenue is standard practice.

attributes.name: loan_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each loan or credit facility record in the agricultural enterprise debt portfolio.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Oracle NetSuite GL

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.bank_account. Business justification: Loans are disbursed to and repaid from specific bank accounts. Linking loan to bank_account enables cash management integration, showing which bank account receives loan proceeds and from which accoun
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: collateral_herd_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to livestock.herd. Business justification: Livestock herds are pledged as collateral for FSA operating loans and commercial lines of credit. Linking loan to herd (as collateral) supports lender reporting, collateral valuation updates, and cove
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: commodity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.commodity. Business justification: CCC commodity loans, FSA marketing assistance loans, and operating lines secured by grain inventory are tied to specific commodities. Linking commodity_id supports commodity loan balance reporting, co
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity (company code) under which this loan is held, supporting consolidated financial reporting per GAAP/IFRS.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center responsible for servicing this loan (e.g., farm operations, equipment division). Enables interest expense allocation by business unit in SAP S/4HANA CO for EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO; GAAP; IFRS

attributes.name: farm_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.farm_unit. Business justification: FSA operating loans and farm lines of credit are issued to specific farm operations. Farm financial managers track debt-to-asset ratios and loan covenants by farm unit. FSA loan number on loan table m
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: loan has gl_account_code as a STRING. Loan balances and interest are posted to specific GL accounts (long-term debt, interest expense). Normalizing to a FK to gl_account links the loan to the authorit
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: parcel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to land.parcel. Business justification: Agricultural real estate loans and FSA guaranteed loans are collateralized against specific parcels. Lenders and farm financial managers track which parcels secure which loans for lien management, tit
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: accrued_interest_amount
attributes.description: Interest expense accrued since the last payment date but not yet paid. Required for period-end accrual journal entries in SAP S/4HANA FI and accurate EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 470; IFRS 9; SAP S/4HANA FI period close

attributes.name: available_credit_amount
attributes.description: Undrawn portion of the credit facility available for future draws (credit_limit_amount minus outstanding_balance). Critical for seasonal liquidity planning and crop input purchasing decisions.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 470; Granular Farm Management financial planning

attributes.name: capex_opex_indicator
attributes.description: Classifies the loan proceeds as Capital Expenditure (CAPEX — land, equipment, infrastructure), Operational Expenditure (OPEX — seasonal inputs, operating costs), or mixed. Drives GL account assignment and financial statement classification.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 840/842; IFRS 16; SAP S/4HANA CO CAPEX/OPEX classification

attributes.name: collateral_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the specific assets pledged as collateral (e.g., 'Section 14 T2N R5E 320 acres farmland', 'John Deere 8R 410 tractor SN XXXXXXX'). Supports lien filing and asset encumbrance management.
attributes.references: UCC Article 9; USDA FSA; Farm Credit System loan documentation

attributes.name: collateral_type
attributes.description: Primary category of assets pledged as security for the loan. Agricultural loans are commonly secured by farmland, equipment, standing crops, or livestock. Drives lender risk assessment and asset encumbrance tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: land|equipment|crop|livestock|accounts_receivable|blanket_lien — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA FSA collateral requirements; Farm Credit System underwriting; UCC Article 9

attributes.name: collateral_valuation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the collateral was most recently appraised or valued. Lenders typically require periodic revaluation; this date triggers renewal workflows.
attributes.references: USDA FSA; Farm Credit System appraisal requirements; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: collateral_value_amount
attributes.description: Appraised or estimated market value of the pledged collateral at the most recent valuation date. Used to calculate loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and assess collateral coverage adequacy.
attributes.references: USDA FSA; Farm Credit System appraisal standards; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: covenant_compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance state with respect to all financial covenants on this loan. A breach status triggers escalation to CFO and legal counsel and may require SOX disclosure. Monitored at each period close.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 470-10-45; SOX Section 302/404; IFRS 9

attributes.name: covenant_description
attributes.description: Summary of key financial covenants attached to the loan agreement (e.g., minimum current ratio of 1.25:1, maximum debt-to-asset ratio of 0.50, minimum working capital of $500,000). Covenant breaches can trigger acceleration clauses.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 470-10-45; SOX Section 302/404; Farm Credit System covenant standards

attributes.name: covenant_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent covenant compliance review or test. Lenders typically require quarterly or annual covenant testing; this date drives the next review scheduling.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 470-10-45; SOX Section 302/404; Farm Credit System

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this loan record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail requirements under SOX and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ISO 8601

attributes.name: credit_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum authorized borrowing capacity under a revolving line of credit or operating line. Applicable to operating lines and seasonal crop production facilities. Null for fully-drawn term loans.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 470; Farm Credit System; Oracle NetSuite credit management

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this loan record (e.g., USD for US Dollar). Supports multi-currency consolidation in IFRS reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS; GAAP

attributes.name: draw_period_end_date
attributes.description: Last date on which the borrower may draw funds under a revolving credit facility or operating line of credit. After this date, the facility enters repayment-only mode. Specific to revolving and seasonal crop production lines.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 470; Farm Credit System revolving credit terms

attributes.name: fsa_guarantee_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the loan principal guaranteed by the USDA Farm Service Agency under the Business and Industry (B&I) or Farm Loan Programs (e.g., 90.00 = 90%). Null for non-guaranteed loans. Reduces lender risk and may affect interest rate terms.
attributes.references: USDA FSA 7 CFR Part 762; USDA Farm Loan Programs

attributes.name: fsa_loan_number
attributes.description: USDA Farm Service Agency assigned loan identifier for FSA direct or guaranteed loans. Required for federal program reporting, subsidy tracking, and USDA compliance filings. Null for non-FSA loans.
attributes.references: USDA Farm Service Agency (FSA) 7 CFR Part 762; USDA NRCS

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: Annual interest rate expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.06500 = 6.5%). For variable-rate loans, this reflects the current effective rate including the benchmark plus spread. Used for interest expense accrual in SAP S/4HANA CO and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 470; IFRS 9; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO

attributes.name: interest_rate_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the interest rate is fixed for the loan term, variable (tied to a benchmark such as SOFR or Prime Rate), or hybrid (fixed for an initial period then variable). Drives interest expense forecasting and hedge accounting decisions.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 815; IFRS 9; Farm Credit System rate structures

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this loan record. Supports change data capture (CDC) processing in the Databricks Silver Layer and SOX audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; ISO 8601; Databricks Delta Lake CDC

attributes.name: lender_name
attributes.description: Name of the lending institution providing the debt facility (e.g., Farm Credit Services of America, Rabobank, Wells Fargo Agribusiness, USDA Farm Service Agency). Essential for counterparty risk management and lender relationship tracking.
attributes.references: Farm Credit System; USDA FSA; GAAP ASC 470

attributes.name: lender_type
attributes.description: Category of the lending institution. Farm Credit institutions are government-sponsored enterprises; FSA loans carry federal guarantees; commercial banks and cooperatives operate under standard banking regulations. Informs interest rate benchmarking and covenant expectations.
attributes.references: Farm Credit Act; USDA FSA; Federal Reserve Regulation

attributes.name: loan_number
attributes.description: Externally-known loan reference number assigned by the lender (e.g., Farm Credit loan number, commercial bank reference, FSA loan number). Used for lender correspondence and payment remittances.
attributes.references: Farm Credit System; USDA Farm Service Agency (FSA); SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: loan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the loan. Drives financial reporting classifications (current vs. non-current debt), covenant monitoring, and SOX control checkpoints.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 470; IFRS 9; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: loan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the debt instrument. Operating lines of credit fund seasonal inputs; term loans finance equipment or land; FSA guaranteed loans are backed by the USDA Farm Service Agency; crop production loans are secured against future harvest revenue. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: operating_line_of_credit|term_loan|fsa_guaranteed|crop_production|equipment_loan|real_estate_mortgage — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA Farm Service Agency (FSA); Farm Credit System; GAAP ASC 470

attributes.name: maturity_date
attributes.description: Contractual date on which the full outstanding principal and any accrued interest are due. Drives current vs. non-current debt classification on the balance sheet and triggers covenant review processes.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 470; IFRS 9; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: next_payment_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the next scheduled payment including both principal and interest components. Supports cash flow planning and AP payment run preparation in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 470; SAP S/4HANA FI/CO

attributes.name: next_payment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the next scheduled principal or interest payment is due to the lender. Used for cash flow forecasting, AP payment scheduling in SAP S/4HANA, and covenant compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 470; SAP S/4HANA FI payment scheduling

attributes.name: origination_date
attributes.description: Date the loan agreement was executed and funds were first made available. Establishes the start of the amortization schedule and the effective date for interest accrual. Aligns with GAAP ASC 470 initial recognition.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 470; IFRS 9; USDA FSA loan origination standards

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: Current unpaid principal balance as of the last payment or draw event. Critical for balance sheet reporting, debt covenant compliance monitoring, and EBITDA-to-debt ratio calculations.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 470; IFRS 9; SOX Section 302/404

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency of principal and/or interest payments. Agricultural loans often use seasonal or annual schedules aligned with harvest revenue cycles rather than standard monthly amortization.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 470; Farm Credit System payment structures; USDA FSA loan terms

attributes.name: principal_amount
attributes.description: Original face value of the loan at origination. Used as the baseline for amortization schedules, interest calculations, and CAPEX/OPEX debt tracking in SAP S/4HANA FI.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 470; IFRS 9; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: purpose_description
attributes.description: Business purpose for which the loan proceeds are used (e.g., 'Purchase of 640-acre irrigated corn ground', 'Seasonal operating inputs for 2024 corn/soybean crop', 'John Deere combine acquisition'). Required for CAPEX/OPEX classification and USDA program eligibility.
attributes.references: USDA FSA; GAAP ASC 470; CAPEX/OPEX classification policy

attributes.name: rate_benchmark
attributes.description: Reference rate index used as the base for variable-rate loans (e.g., SOFR — Secured Overnight Financing Rate, Prime Rate, Farm Credit index). Null for fixed-rate instruments. Required for interest rate risk management and hedge effectiveness testing.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 815; IFRS 9; Federal Reserve benchmark rate guidance

attributes.name: rate_spread_bps
attributes.description: Margin added to the benchmark rate expressed in basis points (e.g., 150 = 1.50%). Combined with the benchmark to derive the effective interest rate for variable-rate loans. Used in interest expense modeling and commodity hedge accounting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 815; IFRS 9; Farm Credit System loan documentation

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this loan record was sourced (e.g., SAP S/4HANA FI, Oracle NetSuite, Granular Farm Management). Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Oracle NetSuite; Granular Farm Management

attributes.name: sox_control_relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this loan is subject to SOX internal control requirements (True = in-scope for SOX 302/404 controls). Material debt instruments require documented controls over completeness, accuracy, and valuation of the liability.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; PCAOB AS 2201

attributes.name: parent_loan_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on loan (parent_loan_id)

products.name: payment_run
products.description: Master reference table for payment_run. Referenced by payment_run_id.

attributes.name: payment_run_id
attributes.description: Primary key for payment_run

attributes.name: approved_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who approved this payment run. Ensures segregation of duties per SOX requirements.

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the corporate bank account from which payments in this run will be disbursed.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Payment runs are executed within a legal entity context. Currently denormalized as company_code (STRING). Normalizing to company_code_id FK enables referential integrity and proper consolidation. Remo
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary cost center responsible for the payments in this run. Used for cost allocation and management reporting.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who created this payment run. Required for audit trails and Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance.

attributes.name: approval_workflow_code
attributes.description: Reference to the approval workflow instance that governed the authorization process for this payment run. Supports multi-level approval requirements.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the payment run was approved by an authorized approver. Required for Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance and audit trails.

attributes.name: batch_reference
attributes.description: External batch or file reference number assigned by the banking system or payment processor when the payment file was transmitted.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payment run record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all payments in this run (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD). All payment amounts within a single run must be in the same currency.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context about the purpose or scope of this payment run (e.g., 'Weekly vendor payments for harvest supplies', 'Monthly grower settlements for corn crop').

attributes.name: error_message
attributes.description: System-generated error or exception message if the payment run encountered processing failures. Used for troubleshooting and operational support.

attributes.name: execution_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the payment run was executed and payments were transmitted to the banking system or payment processor.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year to which this payment run is assigned.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this payment run is assigned for financial reporting and budgeting purposes.

attributes.name: is_recurring
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment run is part of a recurring schedule (e.g., weekly payroll, monthly rent). True if recurring, False if ad-hoc.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payment run record was last modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Internal notes or comments added by treasury or accounts payable staff regarding special handling, exceptions, or other operational details.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument or mechanism used for disbursements in this run (e.g., Automated Clearing House (ACH), wire transfer, physical check, Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT)).

attributes.name: payment_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to this payment run for processing and cash management purposes. Urgent payments may require expedited approval and same-day execution.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms applied to this run (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, Immediate). Inherited from vendor master data but captured here for reporting consistency.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which the payment run transactions are posted to the General Ledger (GL). Used for period-end close and financial reporting.

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment run was reconciled with bank statements.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payment run has been reconciled against bank statements and whether any discrepancies were identified.

attributes.name: recurrence_pattern
attributes.description: Describes the recurrence schedule if is_recurring is True (e.g., 'Weekly on Friday', 'Monthly on 15th', 'Bi-weekly'). Null for ad-hoc runs.

attributes.name: run_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the payment run, formatted as PR-YYYYMMDD-NNNN for external reference and audit trails.

attributes.name: run_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment run based on payee category. Determines routing, approval workflows, and compliance requirements.

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: The date on which payments in this run are scheduled to be executed. Used for cash flow planning and vendor communication.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The originating system or module that generated this payment run (e.g., SAP S/4HANA FI, Oracle NetSuite AP, custom grower settlement system).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment run. Tracks progression from draft through approval, processing, and completion or cancellation.

attributes.name: total_deduction_amount
attributes.description: The sum of all deductions applied across payments in this run, including tax withholdings, advances, and other adjustments.

attributes.name: total_gross_amount
attributes.description: The sum of all gross payment amounts before any deductions, adjustments, or fees. Represents the total obligation to payees.

attributes.name: total_net_amount
attributes.description: The sum of all net payment amounts after deductions. This is the actual cash outflow from the corporate bank account.

attributes.name: total_payment_count
attributes.description: The total number of individual payment transactions included in this payment run.

attributes.name: parent_payment_run_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on payment_run (parent_payment_run_id)

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_employee_id

domains.name: sustainability
domains.description: Manages environmental sustainability data including carbon footprint tracking, greenhouse gas emissions, water stewardship metrics, soil carbon sequestration, biodiversity assessments, and ESG reporting for the agricultural enterprise. Covers compliance with emerging sustainability regulations and voluntary certification programs.

products.name: carbon_footprint
products.description: Master record for enterprise-level and farm-unit-level carbon footprint assessments. Captures total GHG emissions inventory (Scope 1, 2, 3) per farm unit, growing season, or enterprise reporting period. Includes baseline year, measurement methodology (GHG Protocol, ISO 14064), total CO2e tonnes, emission intensity per hectare and per tonne of commodity produced, third-party verification status, and certification body. Serves as the SSOT for carbon accounting across the agricultural enterprise.
products.reference: GHG Protocol Agricultural Guidance / ISO 14064

attributes.name: assessment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for documenting material exclusions, boundary decisions, methodology deviations, restatement reasons, or other contextual information relevant to interpreting the carbon footprint assessment results.
attributes.references: ISO 14064-1:2018 Clause 7; GHG Protocol Corporate Standard Chapter 9

attributes.name: assessment_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference code assigned to this carbon footprint assessment, used for cross-referencing with third-party verifiers, regulatory submissions, and ESG reporting packages. Format: CF-{YEAR}-{ALPHANUMERIC}.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Standard; ISO 14064-1:2018

attributes.name: assessment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the carbon footprint assessment record. Tracks progression from initial data entry through third-party verification to official publication in ESG reports and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: ISO 14064-3:2019 Verification and Validation; GHG Protocol Corporate Standard

attributes.name: assessment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the scope boundary for this carbon footprint assessment. Enterprise covers the full legal entity; farm_unit covers a single farm operation; field covers a specific parcel; commodity covers a crop type; product covers a processed output.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Standard; ISO 14064-1:2018 Clause 5

attributes.name: baseline_year
attributes.description: The reference year against which GHG emissions reductions are measured. Used for tracking progress toward science-based targets and voluntary carbon reduction commitments. Expressed as a four-digit calendar year (e.g., 2019).
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Standard Chapter 5; Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi)

attributes.name: biogenic_co2_emissions_mt
attributes.description: Carbon dioxide emissions from biogenic sources (e.g., combustion of agricultural residues, biomass energy) reported separately from fossil-fuel-derived emissions per GHG Protocol and ISO 14064 requirements. Expressed in metric tons of CO2.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Land Sector and Removals Guidance; ISO 14064-1:2018 Annex B

attributes.name: carbon_offset_credits_mt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Carbon Offset Credits Applied (CO2e Metric Tons)
attributes.description: Volume of verified carbon offset credits (in CO2e metric tons) purchased and retired against this reporting period's gross emissions. Includes credits from voluntary carbon markets (VCM) and compliance markets. Reported separately from biological removals.
attributes.references: Verra VCS Standard; Gold Standard; ICVCM Core Carbon Principles; GHG Protocol Corporate Standard

attributes.name: carbon_removals_co2e_mt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Carbon Removals and Sequestration (CO2e Metric Tons)
attributes.description: Total carbon dioxide removed from the atmosphere through biological sequestration activities such as soil carbon sequestration, cover cropping, agroforestry, and wetland restoration. Expressed in metric tons of CO2 equivalent (CO2e MT). Reported separately from emissions per GHG Protocol guidance.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Land Sector and Removals Guidance; USDA COMET-Farm; ISO 14064-1:2018

attributes.name: cdp_submission_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by the CDP (formerly Carbon Disclosure Project) platform for the submission in which this carbon footprint data was reported. Enables cross-referencing with CDP investor and supply chain disclosures.
attributes.references: CDP Climate Change Questionnaire; TCFD Recommendations

attributes.name: ch4_emissions_co2e_mt
attributes.description: Greenhouse gas emissions from methane (CH4) sources including enteric fermentation in livestock, manure management, and flooded rice cultivation, expressed in metric tons of CO2 equivalent using IPCC AR6 GWP100 factors.
attributes.references: IPCC 2006 Guidelines Volume 4 Agriculture; FAO GLEAM; EPA 40 CFR Part 98

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this carbon footprint assessment record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO 14064-1:2018; SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5(2) Accountability

attributes.name: data_quality_rating
attributes.description: Overall data quality rating for the emissions inventory, reflecting the proportion of primary measured data versus secondary estimated data used in calculations. High = predominantly primary metered/measured data; Estimated = largely modeled or default emission factors.
attributes.references: ISO 14064-1:2018 Clause 6.4; GHG Protocol Corporate Standard Chapter 7; IPCC Tier classification

attributes.name: emission_intensity_per_ha
attributes.business_glossary_term: GHG Emission Intensity per Hectare (CO2e MT/ha)
attributes.description: Carbon footprint intensity expressed as metric tons of CO2 equivalent per hectare of managed agricultural land. Key KPI for benchmarking land-use efficiency and comparing performance across farm units and growing seasons.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Agricultural Guidance; GLOBALG.A.P. Carbon Calculator; FAO GLEAM

attributes.name: emission_intensity_per_mt_commodity
attributes.business_glossary_term: GHG Emission Intensity per Metric Ton of Commodity (CO2e MT/MT)
attributes.description: Carbon footprint intensity expressed as metric tons of CO2 equivalent per metric ton of commodity produced. Enables product-level carbon labeling, supply chain disclosure to food manufacturers, and comparison against industry benchmarks.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Product Standard; ISO 14067:2018 Carbon Footprint of Products; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: ghg_protocol_scope2_method
attributes.description: Indicates whether Scope 2 electricity emissions are calculated using the location-based method (average grid emission factors) or the market-based method (contractual instruments such as RECs or PPAs). Required disclosure per GHG Protocol Scope 2 Guidance.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Scope 2 Guidance (2015); SEC Climate Disclosure Rules

attributes.name: measurement_methodology
attributes.description: The standard or framework used to quantify and report greenhouse gas emissions in this assessment. Determines calculation factors, emission source boundaries, and reporting format. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ghg_protocol|iso_14064|cool_farm_tool|ipcc_guidelines|usda_comet|custom — promote to reference product if additional methodologies are adopted]
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Standard; ISO 14064-1:2018; IPCC 2006 Guidelines; USDA COMET-Farm

attributes.name: n2o_emissions_co2e_mt
attributes.description: Greenhouse gas emissions from nitrous oxide (N2O) sources, primarily synthetic fertilizer application and manure management, expressed in metric tons of CO2 equivalent using IPCC AR6 GWP100 factors. N2O is the dominant GHG in crop production systems.
attributes.references: IPCC 2006 Guidelines Volume 4 Agriculture; GHG Protocol Agricultural Guidance; EPA 40 CFR Part 98

attributes.name: net_emissions_co2e_mt
attributes.description: Net greenhouse gas position calculated as total gross emissions minus verified carbon removals and sequestration. Expressed in metric tons of CO2 equivalent (CO2e MT). Used for net-zero target tracking and voluntary carbon market reporting.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Land Sector and Removals Guidance; Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) Net-Zero Standard

attributes.name: reporting_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the GHG emissions reporting period covered by this assessment. Together with reporting_period_start_date defines the temporal boundary of the GHG inventory.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Standard; ISO 14064-1:2018; SEC Climate Disclosure Rules

attributes.name: reporting_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the GHG emissions reporting period covered by this assessment. Aligns with fiscal year, growing season, or calendar year boundaries as required by the applicable reporting framework.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Standard; ISO 14064-1:2018; SEC Climate Disclosure Rules

attributes.name: science_based_target_aligned
attributes.description: Indicates whether the emissions reduction trajectory reflected in this assessment is aligned with a Science Based Target (SBT) approved by the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi). True = SBTi-approved target alignment confirmed.
attributes.references: Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi); SBTi FLAG (Forest, Land and Agriculture) Guidance

attributes.name: scope1_emissions_co2e_mt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Scope 1 Direct GHG Emissions (CO2e Metric Tons)
attributes.description: Total direct greenhouse gas emissions from sources owned or controlled by the farm enterprise (e.g., fuel combustion in farm equipment, enteric fermentation, manure management, on-farm fertilizer application). Expressed in metric tons of CO2 equivalent (CO2e MT).
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Standard Scope 1; ISO 14064-1:2018; IPCC AR6 GWP100 factors

attributes.name: scope2_emissions_co2e_mt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Scope 2 Indirect GHG Emissions (CO2e Metric Tons)
attributes.description: Total indirect greenhouse gas emissions from the generation of purchased electricity, steam, heat, or cooling consumed by the farm enterprise. Expressed in metric tons of CO2 equivalent (CO2e MT). Supports both location-based and market-based accounting methods.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Scope 2 Guidance; ISO 14064-1:2018

attributes.name: scope3_emissions_co2e_mt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Scope 3 Value Chain GHG Emissions (CO2e Metric Tons)
attributes.description: Total indirect greenhouse gas emissions occurring in the value chain outside of Scope 1 and 2, including upstream inputs (fertilizers, pesticides, seeds, feed) and downstream processing, transport, and end-of-life. Expressed in metric tons of CO2 equivalent (CO2e MT).
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard; ISO 14064-1:2018

attributes.name: total_emissions_co2e_mt
attributes.description: Gross total greenhouse gas emissions across all applicable scopes (Scope 1 + Scope 2 + Scope 3) for the reporting period, expressed in metric tons of CO2 equivalent (CO2e MT). This is the headline figure used in ESG disclosures and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Standard; ISO 14064-1:2018; SEC Climate Disclosure Rules; TCFD Recommendations

attributes.name: total_land_area_ha
attributes.description: Total agricultural land area in hectares covered by this carbon footprint assessment boundary. Used as the denominator for emission intensity per hectare calculations and land-use reporting.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Land Sector Guidance; USDA NRCS; ISO 14064-1:2018

attributes.name: uncertainty_percentage
attributes.description: Quantified uncertainty of the total GHG emissions inventory expressed as a percentage (±%). Calculated per IPCC Tier 1 or Tier 2 uncertainty analysis methods. Required for ISO 14064 conformance and supports materiality assessments in third-party verification.
attributes.references: ISO 14064-1:2018 Clause 6.5; IPCC 2006 Guidelines Volume 1 Chapter 3

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this carbon footprint assessment record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, incremental data pipeline processing, and audit trail compliance in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: ISO 14064-1:2018; SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5(2) Accountability

attributes.name: verification_body
attributes.description: Name of the accredited third-party organization that conducted the independent verification or assurance of the GHG emissions inventory (e.g., Bureau Veritas, SGS, DNV, SCS Global Services). Required for regulatory filings and voluntary certification claims.
attributes.references: ISO 14064-3:2019; ISCC Certification; GLOBALG.A.P.; SEC Climate Disclosure Rules

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the third-party verification or assurance engagement was completed and the verification statement was issued. Used for audit trail and regulatory compliance documentation.
attributes.references: ISO 14064-3:2019; ISAE 3410; SEC Climate Disclosure Rules

attributes.name: verification_statement_ref
attributes.description: Reference number or document identifier of the official verification statement issued by the third-party verification body. Enables traceability to the source verification document for audit and regulatory purposes.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Status of independent third-party verification of the GHG emissions inventory. Distinguishes between unverified, limited assurance (review-level), and reasonable assurance (audit-level) engagements as defined by ISO 14064-3 and ISAE 3410.
attributes.references: ISO 14064-3:2019; ISAE 3410 Assurance Engagements on GHG Statements; SEC Climate Disclosure Rules

attributes.name: activity_quantity
attributes.description: The measured or estimated activity data quantity used as the basis for emission calculation (e.g., liters of diesel consumed, kg of nitrogen fertilizer applied, number of animal head-days, hectares of flooded rice). This is the primary normalized metric for GHG inventory aggregation, ESG reporting, carbon credit accounting, and Science Based Targets (SBTi) progress tracking.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Standard; ISO 14064-1; IPCC AR6; SEC Climate Disclosure Rules; IFRS S2

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Operational system or data collection method from which the activity data was sourced (e.g., 'SAP S/4HANA PM - Fuel Consumption', 'John Deere Operations Center - Telematics', 'Climate FieldView - Application Records', 'Granular Farm Management - Livestock Inventory', 'Manual Entry - Field Log'). Supports data lineage and source system traceability.
attributes.references: ISO 14064-1 Data Management; GHG Protocol Corporate Standard Chapter 7

attributes.name: emission_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the emission event occurred or the start date of the emission period for continuous/periodic sources. Used for temporal aggregation in annual GHG inventories and compliance reporting periods.
attributes.references: ISO 14064-1; EPA Mandatory Reporting Rule 40 CFR Part 98 Annual Reporting

attributes.name: emission_factor_source
attributes.description: The authoritative source or database from which the emission factor was obtained (e.g., 'IPCC 2006 Table 10.11', 'EPA eGRID 2023 WECC', 'USDA ARS 2021', 'Site-Specific Measurement', 'Cool Farm Tool v3.0'). Required for third-party verification and regulatory audit defense.
attributes.references: ISO 14064-3 Verification and Validation; EPA Mandatory Reporting Rule

attributes.name: emission_factor_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the emission factor value, expressing the ratio of gas emitted per unit of activity (e.g., 'kg CH4/head/day', 'kg N2O-N/kg N', 'kg CO2/L diesel', 'kg CO2/kWh'). Essential for dimensional analysis and calculation audit trails.
attributes.references: IPCC 2006 Guidelines; EPA AP-42 Emission Factors

attributes.name: emission_factor_value
attributes.description: The emission factor coefficient applied to convert activity data into raw gas quantity (e.g., kg CH4 per head per day for enteric fermentation, kg N2O-N per kg N applied for synthetic fertilizer). Sourced from IPCC default tables, USDA country-specific factors, or site-measured values depending on IPCC Tier.
attributes.references: IPCC 2006 Guidelines Annex Tables; USDA ARS Emission Factor Database; EPA AP-42

attributes.name: emission_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the emission measurement or estimation period for sources that emit continuously over time (e.g., manure storage, enteric fermentation over a livestock housing period). Null for point-in-time emission events. Together with emission_date defines the reporting window.
attributes.references: ISO 14064-1; IPCC 2006 Guidelines; EPA 40 CFR Part 98

attributes.name: emission_source_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or label of the specific emission source within the source type category (e.g., 'Diesel Tractor Fleet - North Fields', 'Swine Barn 3 - Manure Lagoon', 'Anhydrous Ammonia Application - Field 12'). Provides operational context beyond the source type classification.
attributes.references: EPA Mandatory Reporting Rule 40 CFR Part 98; IPCC 2006 Guidelines

attributes.name: emission_source_type
attributes.description: Classification of the agricultural emission source category as defined by IPCC Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories. Drives selection of appropriate emission factors and IPCC Tier methodology. attributes.references: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National GHG Inventories, Volume 4 Agriculture; EPA Mandatory Reporting Rule 40 CFR Part 98

attributes.name: emission_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the emission record within the GHG inventory management process. Draft = initial data entry; Submitted = pending internal review; Verified = third-party verification completed; Approved = included in official GHG inventory; Rejected = excluded due to data quality issues.
attributes.references: ISO 14064-3 Verification and Validation; GLOBALG.A.P. Environmental Management; GHG Protocol

attributes.name: fuel_quantity_liters
attributes.description: Volume of fuel consumed in liters for combustion-related emission events. Primary activity data for calculating CO2, CH4, and N2O emissions from mobile and stationary combustion sources on-farm (tractors, combines, irrigation pumps, grain dryers). Null for non-combustion sources.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 98 Subpart C; IPCC 2006 Guidelines Volume 2 Chapter 3; EPA AP-42

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: Type of fuel combusted, applicable for fuel combustion emission source type (e.g., 'Diesel', 'Gasoline', 'Natural Gas', 'Propane', 'Biodiesel B20'). Determines the carbon content and oxidation factor for CO2 emission calculation. Null for non-combustion sources. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: diesel|gasoline|natural_gas|propane|biodiesel_b20|ethanol|jet_fuel|coal — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA AP-42 Compilation of Air Emission Factors; IPCC 2006 Guidelines Volume 2 Energy; EPA 40 CFR Part 98 Subpart C

attributes.name: gas_type
attributes.description: The specific greenhouse gas species emitted, using standard IPCC/UNFCCC chemical notation. Determines the Global Warming Potential (GWP) conversion factor applied to calculate CO2-equivalent quantities. CO2 = Carbon Dioxide, CH4 = Methane, N2O = Nitrous Oxide, HFCs = Hydrofluorocarbons, PFCs = Perfluorocarbons, SF6 = Sulfur Hexafluoride.
attributes.references: IPCC Sixth Assessment Report (AR6) GWP Values; UNFCCC Kyoto Protocol Annex A; EPA 40 CFR Part 98

attributes.name: gwp_factor
attributes.description: The Global Warming Potential conversion factor used to convert raw gas quantity to CO2-equivalent (CO2e). Based on IPCC Assessment Report values (e.g., CH4 GWP = 27.9 per AR6 100-year, N2O GWP = 273 per AR6). The specific AR version used should be documented in calculation_methodology.
attributes.references: IPCC Sixth Assessment Report (AR6) Table 7.SM.7; UNFCCC; EPA GWP Values

attributes.name: ipcc_category_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) Category Code
attributes.description: The IPCC source/sink category code from the 2006 IPCC Guidelines for National GHG Inventories (e.g., '3.A.1' for Enteric Fermentation, '3.D.1.1' for Direct N2O from Synthetic Fertilizers, '1.A.4.c' for Mobile Combustion in Agriculture). Enables standardized national inventory reporting and cross-country benchmarking.
attributes.references: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National GHG Inventories, Volume 4 Agriculture, Forestry and Other Land Use

attributes.name: ipcc_tier
attributes.business_glossary_term: Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) Calculation Tier
attributes.description: IPCC methodological tier applied to calculate the emission quantity. Tier 1 uses default IPCC emission factors; Tier 2 uses country-specific or crop-specific factors; Tier 3 uses farm-level measurement, modeling, or direct monitoring data. Higher tiers indicate greater accuracy and are preferred for regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National GHG Inventories; USDA Agricultural Research Service (ARS) Tier 2 Factors

attributes.name: land_area_ha
attributes.description: Area of land in hectares associated with the emission event, applicable for area-based emission sources such as rice cultivation, land use change, crop residue burning, and soil N2O emissions. Used as activity data denominator for per-hectare emission intensity calculations.
attributes.references: IPCC 2006 Guidelines Volume 4; USDA FSA Common Land Unit (CLU); GLOBALG.A.P. Field Registration

attributes.name: livestock_head_count

attributes.name: livestock_species
attributes.description: Species of livestock associated with the emission event, applicable for enteric fermentation and manure management source types (e.g., 'Dairy Cattle', 'Beef Cattle', 'Swine', 'Poultry - Broilers', 'Sheep', 'Goats'). Null for non-livestock emission sources. Required for IPCC Tier 2 livestock emission calculations. attributes.name: manure_management_system

Determines the volatile solids conversion factor and methane conversion factor (MCF) per IPCC guidelines. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: anaerobic_lagoon|liquid_slurry|solid_storage|dry_lot|pasture|anaerobic_digester|composting|deep_bedding — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IPCC 2006 Guidelines Volume 4 Chapter 10 Table 10.17; EPA 40 CFR Part 98 Subpart JJ

attributes.name: nitrogen_applied_kg
attributes.description: Total nitrogen content applied in kilograms for fertilizer-related emission events. Serves as the primary activity data for calculating direct and indirect N2O emissions from synthetic and organic nitrogen applications per IPCC Tier 1 methodology. Null for non-fertilizer sources.
attributes.references: IPCC 2006 Guidelines Volume 4 Chapter 11 Table 11.1; EPA 40 CFR Part 98 Subpart CF; USDA NRCS Nutrient Management

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, anomaly explanations, data quality flags, or operational notes related to the emission record (e.g., 'Equipment malfunction caused elevated fuel consumption', 'Emission factor updated per 2023 IPCC AR6 revision', 'Estimated due to missing meter data'). Supports audit trail and data quality management.
attributes.references: ISO 14064-1; GHG Protocol Corporate Standard

attributes.name: raw_emission_quantity
attributes.description: The calculated emission quantity in the native gas units before conversion to CO2-equivalent (e.g., kg of CH4, kg of N2O, metric tons of CO2). Computed as activity_quantity × emission_factor_value. Stored in native units to preserve calculation transparency.
attributes.references: IPCC 2006 Guidelines; ISO 14064-1; EPA 40 CFR Part 98

attributes.name: raw_emission_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the raw emission quantity in native gas units (e.g., 'kg CH4', 'kg N2O', 'MT CO2', 'g CO2'). Distinct from the CO2-equivalent unit to maintain calculation auditability.

attributes.name: reporting_year

attributes.name: scope_category
attributes.description: GHG Protocol scope classification for the emission event. Scope 1 = direct emissions from owned/controlled sources (e.g., enteric fermentation, on-farm fuel combustion). Scope 2 = indirect emissions from purchased electricity/heat. Scope 3 = all other indirect emissions in the value chain (e.g., purchased fertilizer production, transportation). Critical for ESG reporting and Science Based Targets (SBTi) alignment.
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Accounting and Reporting Standard; SEC Climate Disclosure Rules; IFRS S2 Climate-related Disclosures

attributes.name: uncertainty_percentage
attributes.description: Estimated percentage uncertainty (±%) associated with the emission quantity calculation, reflecting data quality, emission factor variability, and measurement precision. attributes.references: USDA NRCS Conservation Planning; Alliance for Water Stewardship (AWS) Standard 2.0

attributes.name: plan_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the water stewardship plan expires or is scheduled for renewal. Nullable for open-ended plans. Used to trigger renewal workflows and certification re-audit scheduling.
attributes.references: Alliance for Water Stewardship (AWS) Standard 2.0; GLOBALG.A.P. Water Management Module

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the water stewardship plan, typically referencing the farm unit, watershed, or planning period (e.g., 'Cedar Creek Watershed WSP 2024-2026'). Used in reporting dashboards and ESG disclosures.
attributes.references: Alliance for Water Stewardship (AWS) Standard 2.0; GLOBALG.A.P. Water Management Module

attributes.name: plan_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the water stewardship plan becomes effective and binding for the farm unit or watershed. Marks the beginning of the planning period for target tracking and compliance measurement.
attributes.references: Alliance for Water Stewardship (AWS) Standard 2.0; FSMA Preventive Controls Rule

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the water stewardship plan. Drives workflow routing for approvals, regulatory submissions, and certification audits. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|active|under_review|suspended|closed — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Alliance for Water Stewardship (AWS) Standard 2.0; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the plan scope — whether it governs a single farm unit, a watershed, a catchment area, an irrigation district, or the full enterprise. Determines the geographic and operational boundary of the plan.
attributes.references: Alliance for Water Stewardship (AWS) Standard 2.0; USDA NRCS Watershed Planning

attributes.name: planning_year
attributes.description: The primary crop/fiscal year (four-digit integer, e.g., 2024) associated with this water stewardship plan. Used for annual ESG reporting cycles, USDA program enrollment, and year-over-year water use benchmarking.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Conservation Planning; IFRS S2 Climate-related Disclosures

attributes.name: primary_water_source
attributes.description: Classification of the primary water source used for irrigation and farm operations under this plan. Determines applicable regulatory permits (EPA, state water rights), monitoring requirements, and AWS water balance methodology.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Water Act; Alliance for Water Stewardship (AWS) Standard 2.0 Criterion 4.2; GRI 303-3

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency at which this water stewardship plan is formally reviewed and updated. Drives calendar-based review task generation in SAP S/4HANA PM and ensures continuous improvement per ISO 14001 Plan-Do-Check-Act cycle.
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015 Clause 9.3 Management Review; Alliance for Water Stewardship (AWS) Standard 2.0 Criterion 5.1

attributes.name: riparian_buffer_planned
attributes.description: Indicates whether establishment or maintenance of riparian buffer zones is included as a conservation measure in this plan. Riparian buffers reduce agricultural runoff, protect water quality, and support biodiversity. Eligible for USDA NRCS EQIP and CRP cost-share funding.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Riparian Forest Buffer Practice (Code 391); EPA Clean Water Act Section 319; Alliance for Water Stewardship (AWS) Standard 2.0

attributes.name: soil_moisture_monitoring_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether real-time soil moisture monitoring via IoT sensors is deployed and active for this plan's farm unit. Enables precision irrigation scheduling to reduce over-application and supports Variable Rate Application (VRA) prescriptions in Trimble Ag Software.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Irrigation Water Management Practice (Code 449); GLOBALG.A.P. Water Management Module; IoT Precision Agriculture Standards

attributes.name: total_plan_area_ha
attributes.description: Total land area in hectares (ha) covered by this water stewardship plan. Used to normalize water use intensity metrics (m³/ha) for benchmarking and ESG reporting.
attributes.references: GRI 303: Water and Effluents 2018; Alliance for Water Stewardship (AWS) Standard 2.0; GLOBALG.A.P. Farm Boundary Requirements

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this water stewardship plan record. Used for data lineage tracking, change management audits, and Silver Layer incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; ISO 14001:2015 Clause 7.5; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed

attributes.name: water_recycling_target_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Water Recycling and Reuse Target Percentage
attributes.description: Target percentage of total water use to be met through recycled or reclaimed water sources (e.g., tailwater recovery, treated effluent reuse) under this plan. Supports AWS Criterion 4.4 and EPA water reuse guidelines.
attributes.references: Alliance for Water Stewardship (AWS) Standard 2.0 Criterion 4.4; EPA Guidelines for Water Reuse (2012)

attributes.name: water_reduction_target_m3
attributes.description: Absolute volume of water withdrawal reduction committed under this plan, expressed in cubic meters (m³). Complements the percentage target for absolute reporting in ESG disclosures and USDA NRCS program compliance.
attributes.references: Alliance for Water Stewardship (AWS) Standard 2.0; USDA NRCS Environmental Quality Incentives Program (EQIP); GRI 303

attributes.name: water_reduction_target_pct
attributes.description: Percentage reduction in total water withdrawal committed under this plan relative to the baseline annual water use (e.g., 15.00 = 15% reduction target). Used in ESG reporting, Science Based Targets for Nature (SBTN), and AWS certification audits.
attributes.references: Alliance for Water Stewardship (AWS) Standard 2.0; Science Based Targets for Nature (SBTN) Freshwater Guidance; GRI 303

attributes.name: watershed_name
attributes.description: Name of the watershed, catchment, or hydrologic unit (HUC) that this plan governs. Used for geospatial analysis in Esri ArcGIS, regulatory reporting to EPA, and AWS catchment-level water balance assessments.
attributes.references: EPA Watershed Management Framework; USDA NRCS Hydrologic Unit Code (HUC); Alliance for Water Stewardship (AWS) Standard 2.0

attributes.name: parent_water_stewardship_plan_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on water_stewardship_plan (parent_water_stewardship_plan_id)

products.description: Transactional record of soil organic carbon (SOC) sequestration measurements and estimates at the field or management zone level. Captures measurement date, field identifier, management zone, SOC stock (tonnes C/ha), SOC change from baseline, measurement method (direct sampling, modelling via DNDC/RothC/CENTURY), sampling depth, bulk density, carbon credit eligibility flag, verified carbon units (VCUs) generated, and registry submission reference (Verra VCS, Gold Standard, CAR Soil Enrichment Protocol). Core to carbon credit monetization.
products.reference: Verra VCS / CAR Soil Enrichment Protocol / IPCC SOC Tier 2

attributes.name: soil_carbon_sequestration_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each soil organic carbon sequestration measurement or estimate record at the field or management zone level.
attributes.references: ISO 14064 (Greenhouse Gas Quantification and Reporting)
