attributes.name: field_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agricultural field where the soil carbon measurement was taken. Links to the field master record in the land and soil domain.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. (Global Good Agricultural Practices) — Field Registration

attributes.name: management_zone_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sub-field management zone within the field where the measurement applies. Enables variable-rate carbon accounting at finer spatial resolution.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS — Geospatial Zone Management; USDA NRCS Soil Survey

attributes.name: practice_adoption_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sustainability.practice_adoption. Business justification: Soil carbon sequestration measurements are taken to quantify the carbon benefit of specific regenerative practice adoptions (e.g., cover cropping, no-till). This FK links each SOC measurement to the s
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the overarching carbon sequestration project under which this measurement is conducted. A project may span multiple fields and measurement events over multiple years.
attributes.references: Verra VCS Standard v4.0 — Project Registration; ISO 14064-2

attributes.name: soil_temperature_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to weather.soil_temperature. Business justification: Soil carbon sampling protocols require recording soil temperature at measurement time because temperature directly affects SOC decomposition rates and measurement accuracy. Carbon credit registries (V
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: area_ha
attributes.description: Total area of the field or management zone covered by this measurement record, expressed in hectares. Used to scale per-hectare SOC values to total carbon stock and VCU calculations.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. — Field Area Registration; Esri ArcGIS Geospatial Measurement

attributes.name: baseline_soc_stock_t_per_ha
attributes.business_glossary_term: Baseline Soil Organic Carbon (SOC) Stock (Tonnes C per Hectare)
attributes.description: Reference SOC stock value established at the project start date or baseline year, expressed in t C/ha. Used as the denominator for calculating SOC change and carbon credit eligibility.
attributes.references: Verra VM0042 — Baseline Scenario; IPCC 2006 Vol. 4 Ch. 2

attributes.name: buffer_pool_contribution_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of gross VCUs withheld and contributed to the registry's buffer pool (risk buffer) to account for reversal risk. Reduces net VCUs available for sale. Required by Verra VCS and other registries.
attributes.references: Verra VCS Standard v4.0 — AFOLU Pooled Buffer Account; CAR Soil Enrichment Protocol — Buffer Requirements

attributes.name: bulk_density_g_per_cm3
attributes.description: Soil bulk density measured in grams per cubic centimetre (g/cm³) at the time of sampling. Required for converting SOC concentration (%) to SOC stock (t C/ha) and for equivalent soil mass corrections.
attributes.references: ISO 11272 (Soil Quality — Determination of Dry Bulk Density); USDA NRCS Soil Survey

attributes.name: carbon_credit_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SOC change recorded in this measurement event qualifies for carbon credit issuance under the applicable registry protocol. True when SOC change exceeds the minimum threshold and all additionality criteria are met.
attributes.references: Verra VCS Standard v4.0 — Eligibility Criteria; CAR Soil Enrichment Protocol v1.1

attributes.name: co2_equivalent_t
attributes.description: SOC change expressed in tonnes of CO2 equivalent (t CO2e), converting carbon mass to CO2e using the molecular weight ratio (1 t C = 3.667 t CO2e). Standard unit for GHG reporting and carbon market transactions.
attributes.references: IPCC AR6 — Global Warming Potentials; ISO 14064-1; GHG Protocol Land Sector Guidance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this soil carbon sequestration record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance record-keeping requirements.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) — Audit Trail Requirements; ISO 14064-3 — Record Keeping

attributes.name: esg_reporting_period
attributes.business_glossary_term: Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) Reporting Period
attributes.description: Fiscal or calendar year reporting period (e.g., '2024', 'FY2024') to which this measurement contributes for ESG disclosure purposes. Aligns soil carbon data with corporate sustainability reporting cycles.
attributes.references: GRI 305 (Emissions); TCFD (Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures); SEC Climate Disclosure Rule; IFRS S2

attributes.name: laboratory_name
attributes.description: Name of the accredited analytical laboratory that performed SOC concentration analysis on the collected soil samples. Laboratory accreditation is required for registry-compliant measurements.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025 (Laboratory Competence Accreditation); USDA AMS National Science Laboratory

attributes.name: laboratory_report_number
attributes.description: Unique report or certificate of analysis (COA) number issued by the analytical laboratory for the soil sample batch associated with this measurement event. Provides traceability to raw analytical data.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 17025; SAP QM (Quality Management) — Certificate of Analysis (COA)

attributes.name: land_use_type
attributes.description: Current land use classification for the measured area at the time of measurement. Land use type is a primary driver of SOC dynamics and is required for IPCC Tier 2/3 accounting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cropland|pasture|agroforestry|cover_crop|fallow|wetland|rangeland|orchard — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IPCC 2006 Guidelines Vol. 4 — Land Use Categories; USDA NRCS Land Use Classification

attributes.name: measurement_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the soil sample was collected or the model run was executed to estimate soil organic carbon stock. Principal real-world event date for this record.
attributes.references: ISO 10694 (Soil Quality — Determination of Organic Carbon); USDA NRCS Soil Sampling Protocol

attributes.name: measurement_method
attributes.description: Technique used to quantify soil organic carbon stock. Direct sampling involves physical soil core collection and laboratory analysis; DNDC, RothC, and CENTURY are biogeochemical simulation models. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: direct_sampling|DNDC_model|RothC_model|CENTURY_model|remote_sensing|hybrid|IPCC_tier1|IPCC_tier2 — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories — Volume 4 Agriculture; Verra VM0042

attributes.name: measurement_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric identifier assigned to this soil carbon measurement event, used for cross-referencing with laboratory reports, registry submissions, and audit documentation.
attributes.references: Verra VCS (Verified Carbon Standard) — VM0042; CAR Soil Enrichment Protocol

attributes.name: measurement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the soil carbon measurement record, tracking progression from initial data capture through third-party verification and registry submission.
attributes.references: Verra VCS Standard v4.0 — Validation and Verification; ISO 14064-3

attributes.name: monitoring_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the monitoring period covered by this measurement record. Together with monitoring_period_start, defines the interval over which SOC change is quantified.
attributes.references: Verra VM0042 — Monitoring Plan; CAR Soil Enrichment Protocol — Monitoring Period

attributes.name: monitoring_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the monitoring period covered by this measurement record. Defines the temporal boundary for SOC change calculation relative to the baseline.
attributes.references: Verra VM0042 — Monitoring Plan; CAR Soil Enrichment Protocol — Monitoring Period

attributes.name: net_vcu_quantity
attributes.description: Net VCUs available for issuance and sale after deducting buffer pool contributions and uncertainty deductions from gross VCUs. Represents the monetizable carbon credit volume from this measurement event.
attributes.references: Verra VCS Standard v4.0 — Net VCU Issuance; CAR Registry

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for agronomist or data steward annotations regarding anomalies, field conditions, deviations from standard protocol, or other contextual information relevant to interpreting this measurement record.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. — Record Keeping Requirements; FSMA Produce Safety Rule — Record Retention

attributes.name: organic_amendment_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether organic amendments (compost, manure, biochar, or other organic inputs) were applied to the field during the monitoring period. Organic amendments are a key driver of SOC stock increases.
attributes.references: CAR Soil Enrichment Protocol v1.1; USDA NOP (National Organic Program) — Organic Matter Management

attributes.name: registry_name
attributes.description: Name of the carbon credit registry under which this measurement is submitted for verification and VCU issuance (e.g., Verra VCS, Gold Standard, Climate Action Reserve Soil Enrichment Protocol). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Verra_VCS|Gold_Standard|CAR|ACR|BioCarbon_Fund|ISCC|Plan_Vivo — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Verra VCS Standard; Gold Standard for the Global Goals; CAR Soil Enrichment Protocol; ACR Standard

attributes.name: registry_submission_reference
attributes.description: Unique reference number or project ID assigned by the carbon registry upon submission of this measurement for verification. Used for audit trail and tracking VCU issuance status in the registry system.
attributes.references: Verra VCS Registry; CAR Registry; Gold Standard Registry

attributes.name: sample_count
attributes.description: Number of individual soil core samples collected within the field or management zone for this measurement event. Higher sample counts reduce measurement uncertainty and support statistical validity of SOC estimates.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Sampling Protocol; ISO 10381-1 (Soil Quality — Sampling Guidance)

attributes.name: sampling_depth_cm
attributes.description: Depth of soil core or profile sampled for SOC analysis, expressed in centimetres. Standard depths are typically 0–30 cm or 0–100 cm per protocol requirements. Critical for comparability across measurement events.
attributes.references: ISO 10694; USDA NRCS Soil Survey Manual; Verra VM0042 Section 7

attributes.name: soc_change_t_per_ha
attributes.business_glossary_term: Soil Organic Carbon (SOC) Change from Baseline (Tonnes C per Hectare)
attributes.description: Net change in SOC stock relative to the established baseline measurement, expressed in tonnes of carbon per hectare (t C/ha). Positive values indicate sequestration; negative values indicate carbon loss.
attributes.references: Verra VM0042 — Baseline SOC Determination; CAR Soil Enrichment Protocol v1.1

attributes.name: soc_concentration_pct
attributes.description: Measured SOC concentration expressed as a percentage of dry soil mass, as determined by laboratory analysis (e.g., Walkley-Black, dry combustion). Input to SOC stock calculation.
attributes.references: ISO 10694; USDA NRCS Soil Organic Carbon Measurement

attributes.name: soc_stock_t_per_ha
attributes.business_glossary_term: Soil Organic Carbon (SOC) Stock (Tonnes C per Hectare)
attributes.description: Measured or modelled soil organic carbon stock expressed in tonnes of carbon per hectare (t C/ha) at the time of measurement. This is the principal quantitative fact for this record and the basis for carbon credit calculations.
attributes.references: ISO 10694; USDA NRCS Soil Organic Carbon Stock Estimation; Verra VM0042 Section 8

attributes.name: soil_type
attributes.description: USDA or FAO soil classification type for the sampled location (e.g., Mollisol, Vertisol, Alfisol). Influences SOC sequestration potential and model parameterisation.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Taxonomy; FAO World Reference Base for Soil Resources

attributes.name: total_soc_stock_t
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Soil Organic Carbon (SOC) Stock (Tonnes Carbon)
attributes.description: Total SOC stock for the measured area, expressed in tonnes of carbon (t C). Calculated as soc_stock_t_per_ha multiplied by area_ha. Represents the absolute carbon pool for the management unit.
attributes.references: Verra VM0042; ISO 14064-1 (GHG Quantification at Organisation Level)

attributes.name: uncertainty_pct
attributes.description: Statistical uncertainty of the SOC stock or change estimate expressed as a percentage (e.g., 95% confidence interval half-width as % of mean). Required by carbon registries for conservative crediting and buffer pool contributions.
attributes.references: ISO 14064-1 — Uncertainty Assessment; Verra VCS Standard — Uncertainty Deductions; IPCC Good Practice Guidance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this soil carbon sequestration record. Tracks data revisions through the verification lifecycle and supports Silver Layer change detection in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: SOX — Audit Trail Requirements; ISO 14064-3 — Record Keeping; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed

attributes.name: vcu_quantity
attributes.description: Number of Verified Carbon Units (VCUs) generated or estimated from this measurement event. One VCU represents one tonne of CO2-equivalent reduced or removed from the atmosphere. Used for carbon credit monetization.
attributes.references: Verra VCS Standard v4.0 — VCU Issuance; ISO 14064-2

attributes.name: verification_body
attributes.description: Name of the accredited third-party validation and verification body (VVB) that independently verified this measurement event and approved VCU issuance. Required for registry submission.
attributes.references: ISO 14065 (Requirements for GHG Validation and Verification Bodies); Verra VCS Standard — VVB Requirements

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the third-party verification body completed and approved the verification of this soil carbon measurement. Marks the transition to verified status for VCU issuance.
attributes.references: ISO 14064-3; Verra VCS Standard v4.0 — Verification Requirements

attributes.description: The GHG Protocol scope category against which this carbon credit is applied or attributed: Scope 1 = direct emissions from owned/controlled agricultural operations (e.g., enteric fermentation, fuel combustion); Scope 2 = indirect emissions from purchased energy; Scope 3 = value chain emissions (e.g., supply chain, land use change).
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Standard; IPCC Guidelines; TCFD Recommendations; IFRS S2; SEC Climate Disclosure Rules

attributes.name: issuance_date
attributes.description: The date on which the carbon credit was officially issued by the registry following successful third-party verification of the underlying emission reductions or removals.
attributes.references: Verra VCS Standard; Gold Standard; Climate Action Reserve (CAR); ISO 14064-2

attributes.name: methodology_code
attributes.description: The registry-assigned methodology or protocol code used to quantify and verify the greenhouse gas reductions or removals for this credit (e.g., VM0042 for Verra improved agricultural land management, ACR Soil Enrichment Protocol, CAR Soil Enrichment Protocol). Critical for audit and verification purposes.
attributes.references: Verra VCS Methodology Database; Climate Action Reserve (CAR) Protocols; American Carbon Registry (ACR) Methodologies; USDA NRCS Conservation Practice Standards

attributes.name: monitoring_period_end
attributes.description: The end date of the monitoring period during which the greenhouse gas reductions or removals represented by this credit were measured and verified. Together with monitoring_period_start, defines the temporal scope of the credit.
attributes.references: ISO 14064-2; Verra VCS Standard; Gold Standard; Climate Action Reserve (CAR); USDA NRCS

attributes.name: monitoring_period_start
attributes.description: The start date of the monitoring period during which the greenhouse gas reductions or removals represented by this credit were measured and verified. Defines the temporal boundary of the credit's underlying emission reductions.
attributes.references: ISO 14064-2; Verra VCS Standard; Gold Standard; Climate Action Reserve (CAR); USDA NRCS

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional business context, special conditions, or remarks related to the carbon credit record (e.g., reversal risk notes, special retirement conditions, broker commentary, or regulatory correspondence references).
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Policy; SOX audit documentation requirements

attributes.name: permanence_buffer_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the gross carbon credit quantity withheld in a registry buffer pool to insure against potential reversal risks (e.g., wildfire destroying sequestered soil carbon, crop failure). Expressed as a percentage of gross quantity. Particularly relevant for agricultural soil carbon and forestry credits.
attributes.references: Verra VCS Non-Permanence Risk Tool; Climate Action Reserve (CAR) Buffer Pool; American Carbon Registry (ACR) Buffer Account; USDA NRCS

attributes.name: price_per_tonne_usd
attributes.description: The transaction price paid or received per metric tonne of CO2 equivalent for this carbon credit, expressed in US dollars. Used for carbon market valuation, cost accounting, and ROI analysis of the enterprise's carbon portfolio. Null for internally generated credits not yet transacted.
attributes.references: IFRS S2 Climate-related Disclosures; GHG Protocol Corporate Standard; DTN Carbon Market Data; USDA Agricultural Carbon Markets

attributes.name: project_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country where the underlying carbon offset project is located (e.g., USA, BRA, IND). Used for geographic reporting, COOL compliance, and international carbon market eligibility.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number

attributes.name: quantity_tco2e
attributes.description: The volume of greenhouse gas reductions or removals represented by this credit, expressed in metric tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent (tCO2e). One carbon credit typically equals one tonne CO2e. This is the principal quantitative fact for carbon market transactions.
attributes.references: IPCC AR6 Global Warming Potentials; ISO 14064; Verra VCS Standard; Gold Standard; EPA Greenhouse Gas Reporting Program

attributes.name: registry_name
attributes.description: Name of the carbon credit registry where this credit is registered and tracked (e.g., Verra Verified Carbon Standard, Gold Standard, Climate Action Reserve, American Carbon Registry). attributes.name: registry_project_code

attributes.name: retirement_beneficiary

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the carbon credit was permanently retired (cancelled) in the registry, signifying that the associated emission reduction has been claimed against a specific entity's greenhouse gas inventory or net-zero commitment. attributes.name: retirement_reason
attributes.description: The stated business reason for retiring the carbon credit. attributes.name: seller_entity_name

attributes.name: serial_number

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: transaction_type

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this carbon credit record was last modified in the enterprise data platform, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Used for change tracking, data lineage, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: verification_body

Distinct from quality.audit which covers food safety and quality audits.
products.reference: Rainforest Alliance Audit Standard / ISCC Audit Protocol

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the lead auditor (person) responsible for conducting the sustainability audit. Links to the workforce or external party registry.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Approved Certification Bodies; ISO 19011:2018 Guidelines for Auditing

attributes.name: field_crop_plan_id

Adding sustainability_certifi

attributes.name: audit_date
attributes.description: The principal real-world date on which the sustainability audit was conducted or commenced. For multi-day audits, this represents the start date.
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015 Clause 9.2; GLOBALG.A.P. General Regulations

attributes.name: audit_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable reference number assigned to the audit event, used for cross-referencing with certification bodies, regulatory submissions, and corrective action tracking systems. Format: SA-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Audit Control Points; ISO 14001:2015 Clause 9.2

attributes.name: audit_scope
attributes.description: Narrative description of the operational boundaries, processes, and activities covered by this audit (e.g., crop production, irrigation management, pesticide application, carbon accounting, water stewardship, biodiversity).
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015 Clause 4.3; GLOBALG.A.P. Scope Rules

attributes.name: audit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the audit record, tracking progression from scheduling through completion or cancellation.
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015 Clause 9.2; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements

attributes.name: audit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the audit by the relationship between the auditing party and the auditee. Internal audits are conducted by the enterprise itself; second-party audits are conducted by a customer or supply chain partner; third-party audits are conducted by an independent certification body.
attributes.references: ISO 19011:2018 Clause 5.2; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; GLOBALG.A.P. General Regulations

attributes.name: auditor_accreditation_number
attributes.description: Official accreditation or registration number of the auditing organization issued by the relevant certification body or accreditation authority, used to verify legitimacy of the audit.
attributes.references: ISO 17065; GLOBALG.A.P. Approved Certification Bodies Register; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements

attributes.name: auditor_comments
attributes.description: Free-text narrative comments provided by the lead auditor summarizing key observations, commendations, areas of concern, and overall impressions from the sustainability audit.
attributes.references: ISO 19011:2018 Clause 6.6; GLOBALG.A.P. Audit Report Guidelines

attributes.name: auditor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the lead auditor who conducted the sustainability audit. Retained for regulatory traceability and certification body reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 19011:2018 Clause 7.2; GLOBALG.A.P. Approved Certification Bodies Register

attributes.name: auditor_organization
attributes.description: Name of the certification body, consulting firm, or internal department that the lead auditor represents (e.g., Bureau Veritas, SGS, NSF International, internal ESG team).
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Approved Certification Bodies; GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; ISO 17065

attributes.name: biodiversity_assessed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the audit included an assessment of biodiversity conservation practices, habitat management, and ecosystem impact on the farm unit or facility.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Biodiversity Module; Convention on Biological Diversity; TNFD (Taskforce on Nature-related Financial Disclosures)

attributes.name: carbon_footprint_assessed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the audit included an assessment of greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions and carbon footprint metrics for the farm unit or facility, relevant to carbon reporting and net-zero commitments.
attributes.references: ISO 14064-1 GHG Quantification; ISCC Carbon Calculation Methodology; USDA Climate-Smart Agriculture

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current certification status of the farm unit or facility under the audited certification scheme following this audit event. Distinct from audit_outcome which reflects the audit result; this reflects the resulting certification standing.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. General Regulations; ISO 17065; USDA NOP; ISCC System Document

attributes.name: compliance_score_pct
attributes.description: Overall compliance score expressed as a percentage of control points met versus total applicable control points assessed during the audit. Calculated by the certification body or auditor and recorded as a raw audit result (not a derived metric).
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Scoring System; SQF Code Edition 9 Grading; BRC Global Standards Issue 9

attributes.name: corrective_action_description
attributes.description: Narrative summary of the corrective actions required or planned to address non-conformances identified in the audit. May reference specific control points or regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015 Clause 10.2; GLOBALG.A.P. Corrective Action Procedure; FSMA Preventive Controls

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the auditee must submit evidence of corrective actions taken to address non-conformances identified during the audit. Typically set by the certification body or internal compliance team.
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015 Clause 10.2; GLOBALG.A.P. General Regulations; SQF Code Edition 9

attributes.name: corrective_action_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the audit outcome requires the auditee to submit a formal corrective action plan (CAP) to address identified non-conformances. True when major or minor findings are present.
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015 Clause 10.2; GLOBALG.A.P. General Regulations; FSMA Preventive Controls Rule

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this audit record was first captured in the system, used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015 Clause 7.5 (Documented Information); SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the sustainability audit concluded. Populated for multi-day audits; may equal audit_date for single-day audits.
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015 Clause 9.2; SQF Code Edition 9

attributes.name: follow_up_audit_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for a follow-up or verification audit to confirm that corrective actions have been effectively implemented. Populated when the audit outcome is conditional_pass or fail.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. General Regulations; ISO 14001:2015 Clause 9.2; SQF Code Edition 9

attributes.name: gap_compliance_assessed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) Compliance Assessed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the audit included an assessment of Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) compliance covering food safety, worker welfare, environmental stewardship, and traceability requirements.
attributes.references: USDA GAP/GHP Audit Program; GLOBALG.A.P. Integrated Farm Assurance (IFA) Standard; FDA FSMA Produce Safety Rule

attributes.name: ipm_compliance_assessed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Integrated Pest Management (IPM) Compliance Assessed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the audit included an assessment of Integrated Pest Management (IPM) practices, pesticide use records, Maximum Residue Limits (MRL) compliance, and Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) adherence.
attributes.references: EPA IPM Program; GLOBALG.A.P. Crop Protection Module; FDA FSMA Produce Safety Rule; MRL Regulations (EU 396/2005)

attributes.name: major_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of major non-conformances identified during the audit. Major findings represent critical failures against mandatory control points that typically require immediate corrective action and may result in suspension of certification.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Scoring System; SQF Code Edition 9 Grading; BRC Global Standards Issue 9; ISO 14001:2015 Clause 10.2

attributes.name: minor_findings_count
attributes.description: Number of minor non-conformances identified during the audit. Minor findings represent partial compliance or low-risk deviations that require corrective action within a defined timeframe but do not immediately jeopardize certification.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Scoring System; SQF Code Edition 9 Grading; BRC Global Standards Issue 9

attributes.name: next_scheduled_audit_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the next routine sustainability audit cycle for this farm unit or facility under the same certification scheme, used for compliance calendar management and resource planning.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. General Regulations (annual audit cycle); ISO 14001:2015 Clause 9.2; SQF Code Edition 9

attributes.name: observations_count
attributes.description: Number of observations or opportunities for improvement noted by the auditor that do not constitute non-conformances but represent best practice recommendations or areas of potential risk.
attributes.references: ISO 19011:2018 Clause 6.6; GLOBALG.A.P. Audit Report Guidelines

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Overall result of the sustainability audit. Pass indicates full compliance; conditional_pass indicates compliance with minor non-conformances requiring corrective action; fail indicates major non-conformances preventing certification or continued compliance.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. General Regulations; ISO 14001:2015 Clause 9.2; SQF Code Edition 9; BRC Global Standards Issue 9

attributes.name: regulatory_body_notified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the relevant regulatory authority (e.g., USDA, EPA, FDA, APHIS) was formally notified of the audit outcome, as required for certain certification schemes or when significant non-conformances are identified.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Notification Requirements; FDA FSMA Reportable Food Registry; EPA Compliance Reporting; GLOBALG.A.P. Notification Procedures

attributes.name: report_reference
attributes.description: Document reference number or file path to the formal audit report issued by the auditor or certification body. Used to retrieve the full audit report from the document management system.
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015 Clause 7.5; GLOBALG.A.P. Audit Report Requirements; SOX Document Retention

attributes.name: report_url
attributes.description: Secure URL or storage path to the digital audit report document stored in the enterprise document management or data lake system, enabling direct access from analytics and compliance dashboards.
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015 Clause 7.5; FSMA Records Requirements; SOX Document Retention

attributes.name: soil_health_assessed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the audit included an assessment of soil carbon sequestration, organic matter (OM) levels, and soil health management practices as part of the sustainability evaluation.
attributes.references: USDA Natural Resources Conservation Service (NRCS) Soil Health Standards; GLOBALG.A.P. Soil Management Module; ISO 14001:2015

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this audit record, supporting change tracking and data governance requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 14001:2015 Clause 7.5; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: water_stewardship_assessed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the audit included an assessment of water use efficiency, irrigation management, and water quality compliance as part of the sustainability evaluation.
attributes.references: AWS (Alliance for Water Stewardship) Standard; GLOBALG.A.P. Water Module; EPA Clean Water Act

attributes.name: parent_sustainability_audit_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on sustainability_audit (parent_sustainability_audit_id)

products.name: regenerative_practice
products.description: Master record defining regenerative agriculture practices adopted and tracked across farm units and fields. Captures practice type (cover cropping, no-till/reduced-till, crop rotation diversity, agroforestry, composting, integrated pest management, managed grazing), practice name, implementation standard or protocol, eligible carbon program alignment, expected SOC benefit (tonnes C/ha/yr), expected yield impact, cost per acre, and practice status. Serves as the practice catalog for regenerative agriculture program management.
products.reference: USDA NRCS Practice Standards / Regenerative Organic Certified

attributes.name: regenerative_practice_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each regenerative agriculture practice record in the master catalog. Serves as the primary key for all downstream references. [MASTER_RESOURCE role — canonical-attrs-enforced]
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Regenerative Agriculture Framework; USDA Natural Resources Conservation Service (NRCS)

attributes.name: superseded_by_practice_regenerative_practice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the regenerative_practice_id of the newer practice version that replaces this record when deprecated. Enables forward navigation in the practice version chain for program migration and historical reporting.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Conservation Practice Standards Versioning; Verra VCS Methodology Transition Rules

attributes.name: applicable_climate_zones
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of USDA Plant Hardiness Zones or Köppen climate classification zones where this practice is recommended (e.g., 'Zone 5-8', 'Humid Continental', 'Semi-Arid'). Ensures agronomic suitability for geographic deployment.
attributes.references: USDA Plant Hardiness Zone Map; Köppen Climate Classification; Esri ArcGIS Climate Analysis

attributes.name: applicable_crop_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of crop types or commodity groups for which this practice is agronomically applicable (e.g., 'corn, soybean, wheat', 'all row crops', 'perennial forages'). Guides practice assignment in Trimble Ag Software and Climate FieldView field planning workflows.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Conservation Practice Standards; Climate FieldView Crop Management

attributes.name: biodiversity_benefit_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative rating of the practice's expected benefit to on-farm biodiversity (pollinator habitat, wildlife corridors, soil microbiome diversity). Supports ESG biodiversity disclosures and TNFD (Taskforce on Nature-related Financial Disclosures) reporting.
attributes.references: TNFD Nature-related Financial Disclosures Framework; GLOBALG.A.P. Biodiversity Module; Convention on Biological Diversity

attributes.name: carbon_program_alignment
attributes.description: Name of the voluntary or compliance carbon market program this practice is eligible for (e.g., 'Indigo Carbon', 'Corteva Carbon', 'Bayer Carbon Program', 'Verra VCS', 'Gold Standard', 'ACR'). Drives carbon credit revenue potential and program enrollment decisions.
attributes.references: Verra Verified Carbon Standard (VCS); American Carbon Registry (ACR); Gold Standard; USDA Partnerships for Climate-Smart Commodities

attributes.name: cost_per_acre_usd
attributes.description: Estimated total implementation cost per acre in US dollars, including seed, labor, equipment, and materials. Used for enterprise budget planning in Granular Farm Management and SAP CO crop enterprise budgets. Supports ROI and OPEX analysis for regenerative program adoption.
attributes.references: USDA Farm Service Agency (FSA) Cost-Share Programs; Granular Farm Management Financial Planning Module

attributes.name: cost_per_hectare_usd
attributes.description: Estimated total implementation cost per hectare in US dollars for international operations and metric-system reporting. Complements cost_per_acre_usd for global ESG and IFRS reporting contexts.
attributes.references: IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards; GLOBALG.A.P. Cost Benchmarking

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this regenerative practice record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX financial reporting controls for sustainability program management.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; ISO 14001 Records Management; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity

attributes.name: data_collection_method
attributes.description: Primary method for collecting practice performance data (e.g., IoT sensors for soil moisture, John Deere Operations Center telematics for tillage pass verification, satellite imagery for cover crop biomass via NDVI). Informs FMIS integration architecture.
attributes.references: John Deere Operations Center Precision Agriculture; Climate FieldView Data Analytics; Trimble Ag Software; USDA FMIS Standards

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this practice definition was retired or superseded. Null indicates the practice is currently active. Enables temporal queries for historical carbon program compliance and audit trail integrity.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Conservation Practice Standards Versioning; Verra VCS Methodology Retirement Policy

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this practice definition became effective and available for assignment to farm units. Supports versioning of practice standards and ensures historical accuracy in carbon program reporting.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Conservation Practice Standards Versioning; Verra VCS Methodology Effective Dates

attributes.name: esg_reporting_category
attributes.description: Primary ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance) reporting category under which this practice's outcomes are disclosed. Aligns with GRI Standards, SASB Agribusiness Standard, and TCFD framework for sustainability reporting.
attributes.references: GRI 305 Emissions; GRI 303 Water; SASB Agribusiness Standard FB-AG; TCFD Recommendations; CDP Climate Change

attributes.name: expected_ghg_reduction_co2e_t_ha_yr
attributes.business_glossary_term: Expected Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Reduction (Tonnes CO2e per Hectare per Year)
attributes.description: Expected annual greenhouse gas emission reduction expressed in tonnes of CO2 equivalent per hectare per year (t CO2e/ha/yr), encompassing N2O, CH4, and CO2 reductions attributable to the practice. Supports carbon footprint assessment and CDP reporting.
attributes.references: IPCC Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories; GHG Protocol Agricultural Guidance; CDP Climate Change Questionnaire

attributes.name: expected_soc_benefit_t_c_ha_yr
attributes.business_glossary_term: Expected Soil Organic Carbon (SOC) Benefit (Tonnes C per Hectare per Year)
attributes.description: Expected annual soil organic carbon (SOC) sequestration benefit expressed in tonnes of carbon per hectare per year (t C/ha/yr). Used for carbon credit estimation, ESG reporting, and science-based target alignment. Derived from peer-reviewed literature or program-specific quantification methodologies. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE category.
attributes.references: IPCC Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories; Verra VM0042; USDA COMET-Farm Methodology

attributes.name: expected_yield_impact_pct
attributes.description: Expected percentage change in crop yield attributable to this practice relative to conventional baseline (positive = yield increase, negative = yield penalty). Critical for agronomic ROI analysis and farmer adoption decision support. Expressed as a signed percentage (e.g., -3.5 for a 3.5% yield reduction, +2.0 for a 2% yield gain).
attributes.references: USDA Economic Research Service; Rodale Institute Farming Systems Trial; GLOBALG.A.P. Yield Impact Assessment

attributes.name: gmo_restriction
attributes.description: Specifies whether this practice has restrictions on the use of genetically modified organism (GMO) seed or inputs. Relevant for organic program compliance, Non-GMO Project verification, and EU export market requirements.
attributes.references: USDA NOP; Non-GMO Project Standard; EU Regulation 1829/2003 on GMO

attributes.name: implementation_guidance_url
attributes.description: URL link to the official implementation guide, SOP document, or technical specification for this practice (e.g., USDA NRCS practice standard PDF, internal SharePoint SOP). Provides practitioners with authoritative reference material.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Conservation Practice Standards; ISO 14001 Document Control Requirements

attributes.name: implementation_standard
attributes.description: The governing standard, protocol, or methodology that defines how this practice must be implemented (e.g., 'USDA NRCS 340 Cover Crop Standard', 'Verra VM0042 Improved Agricultural Land Management', 'Gold Standard Land Use and Forests'). Critical for carbon program eligibility and audit compliance.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Conservation Practice Standards; Verra Verified Carbon Standard (VCS); Gold Standard for the Global Goals

attributes.name: incentive_payment_per_acre_usd
attributes.description: Government or program incentive payment available per acre for adopting this practice (e.g., USDA EQIP payment, carbon program payment, state cost-share). Offsets implementation cost and is a key driver of farmer adoption economics.
attributes.references: USDA Environmental Quality Incentives Program (EQIP); USDA Conservation Stewardship Program (CSP); USDA Partnerships for Climate-Smart Commodities

attributes.name: iscc_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Sustainability and Carbon Certification (ISCC) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this practice qualifies under International Sustainability and Carbon Certification (ISCC) requirements for biofuel and bio-based product supply chains. Relevant for renewable fuel standard compliance and EU sustainability reporting.
attributes.references: International Sustainability and Carbon Certification (ISCC) System; EU Renewable Energy Directive (RED II)

attributes.name: minimum_implementation_period_yrs
attributes.description: Minimum number of consecutive years the practice must be maintained to qualify for carbon program credits or government incentive payments. Critical for contract term planning and farmer commitment assessment.
attributes.references: Verra VCS VM0042 Permanence Requirements; USDA EQIP Contract Terms; American Carbon Registry Methodology

attributes.name: monitoring_frequency
attributes.description: Required frequency of practice monitoring and data collection for compliance and carbon program reporting. Drives IoT sensor deployment planning and field scouting schedules in Trimble Ag Software and Climate FieldView.
attributes.references: Verra VCS VM0042 Monitoring Requirements; USDA NRCS Conservation Practice Monitoring; ISO 14001 Environmental Monitoring

attributes.name: organic_certification_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this practice is compatible with and eligible under USDA National Organic Program (NOP) certification requirements. True = NOP-compliant practice; False = contains inputs or methods incompatible with organic certification.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP) 7 CFR Part 205; GLOBALG.A.P. Organic Certification Module

attributes.name: phi_days
attributes.description: Pre-harvest interval (PHI) in days applicable to this practice where relevant (e.g., for IPM practices involving biological controls or reduced-risk pesticides). Ensures food safety compliance and MRL adherence at harvest.
attributes.references: EPA Federal Insecticide Fungicide and Rodenticide Act (FIFRA); FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA); USDA FSIS

attributes.name: practice_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code identifying the regenerative practice in the enterprise catalog (e.g., RP-CVRCROP01). Used for cross-system referencing in Granular Farm Management, SAP S/4HANA, and carbon program submissions. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Conservation Practice Standards; GLOBALG.A.P. Sustainable Agriculture Standard

attributes.name: practice_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the regenerative practice including agronomic rationale, implementation steps, expected outcomes, and any special conditions or prerequisites. Used for farmer training materials, SOP documentation, and program enrollment guides.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Conservation Practice Standards; GLOBALG.A.P. Technical Documentation Requirements

attributes.name: practice_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the regenerative agriculture practice (e.g., 'Winter Cover Cropping — Cereal Rye', 'No-Till Corn Soybean Rotation', 'Managed Rotational Grazing'). Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE IDENTITY_LABEL category.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Conservation Practice Standards; Rodale Institute Regenerative Organic Standard

attributes.name: practice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the practice in the enterprise catalog. Controls whether the practice is available for assignment to farm units and fields. 'pilot' indicates limited trial deployment; 'deprecated' means superseded by an updated practice version. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE LIFECYCLE_STATUS category.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Sustainable Agriculture Standard; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems

attributes.name: practice_subtype
attributes.description: Secondary classification providing finer granularity within the practice type (e.g., 'Legume Cover Crop', 'Brassica Cover Crop', 'Strip-Till', 'Silvopasture', 'Alley Cropping'). Enables detailed analytics and program-specific eligibility filtering.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Conservation Practice Standards; Agroforestry Research Trust Classification

attributes.name: practice_type
attributes.description: Primary classification of the regenerative agriculture practice category. Drives program eligibility, carbon credit calculation methodology, and reporting groupings. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE category. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cover_cropping|no_till|reduced_till|crop_rotation|agroforestry|composting|ipm|managed_grazing — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Conservation Practice Standards; Soil Carbon Initiative; GLOBALG.A.P. Regenerative Agriculture

attributes.name: rei_hours
attributes.description: Restricted entry interval (REI) in hours for worker safety compliance where this practice involves pesticide or biological agent application. Mandatory for OSHA and EPA worker protection standard compliance.
attributes.references: EPA Worker Protection Standard (WPS); OSHA 29 CFR 1928.110; EPA FIFRA

attributes.name: science_based_target_aligned
attributes.description: Indicates whether this practice is recognized as contributing to Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) FLAG (Food, Land, Agriculture and Forestry) pathway commitments. True = practice contributes to SBTi-FLAG targets; False = not formally aligned.
attributes.references: Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) FLAG Guidance; SBTi Corporate Net-Zero Standard

attributes.name: soil_health_benefit_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative rating of the practice's expected benefit to soil health indicators including organic matter (OM), cation exchange capacity (CEC), compaction reduction, and microbial activity. Supports USDA Soil Health Initiative reporting and GLOBALG.A.P. soil management compliance.
attributes.references: USDA NRCS Soil Health Framework; GLOBALG.A.P. Soil Management Standard; ISO 14001

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this regenerative practice record. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline and audit compliance tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; ISO 14001 Records Management; Databricks Delta Lake CDC

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Primary method used to verify that the practice has been implemented as specified. Drives audit planning and data collection requirements. Remote sensing uses NDVI and satellite imagery via Esri ArcGIS; field audits involve on-site inspection. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: remote_sensing|field_audit|self_reported|third_party_audit|soil_sampling|satellite_ndvi|mixed — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Verra VCS Monitoring Verification and Reporting (MRV); GLOBALG.A.P. Inspection Protocol; USDA NRCS Practice Verification

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of the practice definition (e.g., '1.0', '2.1', '3.0'). Tracks revisions to practice standards, quantification methodologies, or implementation protocols. Critical for carbon program audit trails requiring specific methodology version references.
attributes.references: Verra VCS Methodology Versioning; USDA NRCS Conservation Practice Standards Revision History

attributes.name: water_quality_benefit_rating
attributes.description: Qualitative rating of the practice's expected benefit to water quality outcomes (nutrient runoff reduction, sediment reduction, groundwater recharge). Supports water stewardship reporting and EPA Clean Water Act compliance documentation.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Water Act Section 319; USDA NRCS Water Quality Practice Standards; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: parent_regenerative_practice_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on regenerative_practice (parent_regenerative_practice_id)

products.name: practice_adoption
products.description: Transactional record capturing the adoption and implementation of a regenerative or conservation practice on a specific field or farm unit in a given season. Captures adoption date, field identifier, farm unit, practice identifier, implementation area (acres/hectares), implementation method, input quantities used (e.g., cover crop seed rate), operator responsible, verification method (remote sensing, field inspection, self-reported), verification date, and carbon program enrollment linkage. Bridges regenerative_practice catalog to field-level execution.
products.reference: USDA NRCS / Verra VCS Methodology

attributes.name: practice_adoption_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each practice adoption record. Primary key for the practice_adoption transactional entity.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: certification_program

attributes.name: country_code

attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; COOL Country of Origin Labeling; GDPR Article 44 (international operations)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this sustainability target record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail requirements under SOX and FSMA traceability rules.

attributes.name: current_period_value
attributes.description: The most recently measured value of the sustainability indicator for the current reporting period, expressed in target_unit. Enables real-time progress tracking against baseline and target values without requiring aggregation from transactional tables.
attributes.references: CDP Climate Disclosure; GHG Protocol; ISO 14064; TCFD Metrics and Targets Pillar

attributes.name: current_period_year
attributes.description: The calendar year corresponding to the current_period_value measurement. Used to contextualize progress data and align with annual ESG reporting cycles and CDP submission periods.
attributes.references: CDP Climate Disclosure; GRI Standards 2021; TCFD Recommendations

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: The geographic boundary to which this sustainability target applies. global = entire enterprise worldwide; regional = multi-country region; country = single country operations; farm_unit = specific farm or agricultural unit; facility = specific processing or storage facility. Supports COOL (Country of Origin Labeling) and GLOBALG.A.P. geographic reporting.
attributes.references: GLOBALG.A.P. Sustainability Standards; COOL Country of Origin Labeling; GRI Standards 2021; ISO 14001

attributes.name: ghg_scope_coverage
attributes.description: Indicates which GHG Protocol emission scopes are covered by this target. Scope 1 = direct farm/facility emissions, Scope 2 = purchased energy, Scope 3 = value chain (feed, fertilizer, transport, land use). Required for SBTi validation and CDP climate disclosure. Set to not_applicable for non-GHG targets (water, biodiversity).
attributes.references: GHG Protocol Corporate Standard; SBTi Corporate Net-Zero Standard; CDP Climate Disclosure; EPA GHG Reporting Rule

attributes.name: interim_target_value
attributes.description: The quantitative milestone value to be achieved by the interim_target_year, expressed in the same unit as target_unit. Enables phased progress tracking and SBTi near-term target validation.
attributes.references: SBTi Corporate Net-Zero Standard; CDP Climate Disclosure

attributes.name: interim_target_year
attributes.description: The near-term milestone year for an intermediate progress checkpoint, typically 5-10 years before the long-term target year (e.g., 2030 interim target for a 2050 net-zero commitment). Required by SBTi Corporate Net-Zero Standard which mandates both near-term and long-term targets.
attributes.references: SBTi Corporate Net-Zero Standard; CDP Climate Disclosure

attributes.name: last_verified_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent third-party independent verification of progress data for this sustainability target. Null if no verification has been completed. Required for CDP limited or reasonable assurance disclosures and SBTi progress reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 14064-3 GHG Verification; CDP Assurance Requirements; SBTi; ISCC

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for internal annotations, methodology clarifications, data quality caveats, or interim review comments related to this sustainability target. Not intended for public disclosure.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems; Internal Governance

attributes.name: on_track_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the current trajectory of progress is sufficient to achieve the target by the target_year, based on the linear or science-based reduction pathway. True = on track; False = off track. Updated at each progress_tracking_frequency cycle. Supports executive dashboards and ESG risk reporting.
attributes.references: SBTi Corporate Net-Zero Standard; CDP Climate Disclosure; TCFD Risk Management Pillar

attributes.name: owning_business_unit
attributes.description: The enterprise business unit or division primarily responsible for executing and reporting on this sustainability target (e.g., 'Crop Operations', 'Livestock Division', 'Supply Chain & Logistics', 'Corporate Sustainability'). Aligns with SAP S/4HANA CO cost center hierarchy.
attributes.references: TCFD Governance Pillar; ISO 14001; GRI Standards 2021

attributes.name: progress_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the required reduction or improvement achieved to date, calculated as (baseline_value - current_period_value) / (baseline_value - target_value) * 100. Stored explicitly to support dashboard KPIs, board reporting, and CDP progress disclosures without requiring real-time computation.
attributes.references: CDP Climate Disclosure; TCFD Metrics and Targets Pillar; GRI Standards 2021

attributes.name: progress_tracking_frequency
attributes.description: The cadence at which progress against this sustainability target is formally measured, reviewed, and reported internally. Drives scheduling of data collection from source systems (SAP S/4HANA, Climate FieldView, John Deere Operations Center) and ESG reporting cycles.
attributes.references: TCFD Metrics and Targets Pillar; CDP Climate Disclosure; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems

attributes.name: public_commitment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the sustainability target was publicly disclosed, such as in an annual ESG report, CDP submission, press release, or GLOBALG.A.P. certification filing. Establishes the accountability start date for external stakeholders and regulators.
attributes.references: CDP Climate Disclosure; TCFD Recommendations; GLOBALG.A.P.; GRI Standards 2021; FSMA Traceability Rule

attributes.name: reduction_pct
attributes.description: The percentage reduction from baseline value required to achieve the target (e.g., 46.2% for a 1.5°C-aligned SBTi near-term target). Expressed as a positive number representing the reduction magnitude. Derived from baseline and target values but stored explicitly for reporting and SBTi submission.
attributes.references: SBTi Corporate Net-Zero Standard; CDP Climate Disclosure; TCFD Recommendations

attributes.name: sbti_commitment_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Science Based Targets Initiative (SBTi) Commitment Date
attributes.description: The date on which the enterprise signed the SBTi commitment letter, pledging to set science-based targets within 24 months. Null if the target is not SBTi-aligned or commitment has not been made.
attributes.references: SBTi Corporate Net-Zero Standard; SBTi Commitment Letter Process

attributes.name: sbti_validation_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Science Based Targets Initiative (SBTi) Validation Status
attributes.description: Status of the target's formal validation by the Science Based Targets initiative. not_submitted = target not yet sent for SBTi review; submitted = under SBTi review; validated = SBTi has confirmed alignment with 1.5°C or well-below 2°C pathway; committed = company has signed SBTi commitment letter; not_applicable = target category not covered by SBTi (e.g., water, biodiversity).
attributes.references: SBTi Corporate Net-Zero Standard; SBTi Target Validation Protocol

attributes.name: target_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the sustainability commitment type. Drives reporting structure and alignment framework selection. Values: net_zero (full value chain decarbonization), carbon_neutral (residual offset allowed), water_positive (return more water than consumed), deforestation_free (no conversion of natural ecosystems), biodiversity_net_gain (measurable biodiversity improvement), renewable_energy (100% renewable electricity per RE100).
attributes.references: SBTi Corporate Net-Zero Standard; RE100 Initiative; CDP Water Security; TNFD Framework; TCFD Recommendations

attributes.name: target_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the sustainability target, used in ESG reports, CDP submissions, and board communications (e.g., ST-NET0001, ST-WATER02). Aligns with TCFD and CDP disclosure frameworks.
attributes.references: CDP Climate Disclosure; TCFD Recommendations; GLOBALG.A.P. Sustainability Standards

attributes.name: target_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the sustainability target, including scope boundaries, key assumptions, reduction pathways, and any exclusions. Used in ESG reports, CDP questionnaire responses, and board briefing materials. Supports TCFD strategy and metrics disclosure.
attributes.references: TCFD Recommendations; GRI Standards 2021; CDP Climate Disclosure; IFRS S1/S2

attributes.name: target_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the sustainability target as it appears in public commitments, ESG reports, and board presentations (e.g., 'Net-Zero Scope 1 & 2 Emissions by 2040', 'Water Positive Operations by 2030').
attributes.references: GRI Standards; TCFD Recommendations; UN SDGs

attributes.name: target_type
attributes.description: Specifies whether the target is expressed as an absolute reduction (total emissions/water volume), an intensity metric (per hectare, per metric ton of commodity), a binary commitment (yes/no achievement), or an index-based measure (e.g., NDVI biodiversity index). Critical for SBTi validation and CDP reporting.
attributes.references: SBTi Target Validation Protocol; GHG Protocol; CDP Climate Disclosure

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: The absolute or intensity-based quantitative goal to be achieved by the target year (e.g., 50,000 MT CO2e for an absolute emissions target, or 0.85 MT CO2e/MT commodity for an intensity target). Used to calculate reduction percentage and track progress.
attributes.references: SBTi Target Validation Protocol; GHG Protocol; CDP; ISO 14064

attributes.name: un_sdg_goals
attributes.business_glossary_term: United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (UN SDGs) Alignment
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of UN SDG goal numbers to which this target contributes (e.g., '2,6,13,15' for Zero Hunger, Clean Water, Climate Action, Life on Land). Supports ESG reporting and investor disclosure aligned with the UN 2030 Agenda.

attributes.references: USDA; FDA FSMA; GLOBALG.A.P.; ISO 22000:2018

attributes.name: preventive_measures_description
attributes.description: Description of the preventive measures and systemic controls implemented to prevent recurrence of the non-conformance. Distinct from corrective actions which address the immediate finding.
attributes.references: ISO 22000:2018; HACCP Codex Alimentarius; FSMA Preventive Controls Rule; GFSI

attributes.name: recurrence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this corrective action plan addresses a recurring non-conformance that has been cited previously. Recurrent findings typically trigger escalated regulatory scrutiny and more stringent corrective action requirements.
attributes.references: USDA FSIS; FDA ORA; GFSI; ISO 22000:2018

attributes.name: regulatory_program_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific regulatory program or compliance framework under which the citation was issued (e.g., FSMA, HACCP, NOP, GLOBALG.A.P., COOL, GFSI). Used for compliance program reporting and trend analysis.
attributes.references: FSMA; HACCP Codex Alimentarius; NOP USDA; GLOBALG.A.P.; GFSI; COOL

attributes.name: responsible_owner_name
attributes.description: Full name of the employee or manager designated as the accountable owner for the corrective action plan. Retained for regulatory submission documents where the system ID alone is insufficient.
attributes.references: USDA FSIS; FDA ORA; ISO 22000:2018

attributes.name: responsible_owner_title
attributes.description: Job title or role of the designated responsible owner, required for regulatory agency submissions and formal CAP documentation.
attributes.references: USDA FSIS; FDA ORA; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the root cause identified through root cause analysis. Used for trend analysis and systemic improvement tracking across the compliance program. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: process_failure|equipment_failure|human_error|training_gap|supplier_issue|system_gap|environmental — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 22000:2018; GFSI; SQF; BRC Global Standards

attributes.name: root_cause_summary
attributes.description: Summary of the root cause analysis conducted to identify the underlying systemic or process failure that led to the regulatory non-conformance. Supports preventive action design and regulatory submission.
attributes.references: ISO 22000:2018; HACCP Codex Alimentarius; FSMA Preventive Controls; GFSI

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Severity classification of the underlying finding or citation that triggered the corrective action plan. Critical findings typically require immediate action and agency notification; minor findings allow extended remediation timelines.
attributes.references: GFSI; SQF; BRC Global Standards; GLOBALG.A.P.; ISO 22000:2018

attributes.name: submitted_to_agency_date
attributes.description: The date on which the corrective action plan was formally submitted to the regulatory agency for review and acknowledgment. Critical for demonstrating timely regulatory response.
attributes.references: USDA FSIS Directive 5000.1; FDA ORA; EPA Enforcement Policy

attributes.name: supporting_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or document management system path for supporting documentation attached to the CAP, including inspection reports, laboratory results, COA (Certificate of Analysis), SDS (Safety Data Sheet), photographic evidence, and agency correspondence.
attributes.references: USDA FSIS; FDA ORA; ISO 22000:2018; FSMA

attributes.name: target_completion_date
attributes.description: The committed target date by which all corrective actions defined in the plan are expected to be fully implemented and verified. This date is typically agreed upon with the regulatory agency.
attributes.references: USDA FSIS; FDA ORA; EPA; ISO 22000:2018; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: verification_completed_date
attributes.description: The date on which verification activities confirming effective implementation of corrective actions were completed.
attributes.references: ISO 22000:2018; GFSI; FSMA Preventive Controls Rule

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: The method used to verify that corrective actions have been effectively implemented and the non-conformance has been resolved. May include re-inspection by the agency, internal audit, third-party audit, or laboratory testing.
attributes.references: ISO 22000:2018; HACCP Codex Alimentarius; GFSI; GLOBALG.A.P.; FSMA

attributes.name: verification_outcome
attributes.description: The result of the verification activity confirming whether the corrective actions were effectively implemented and the non-conformance resolved. Drives CAP closure or escalation decisions.
attributes.references: ISO 22000:2018; GFSI; FSMA; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: violation_category
attributes.description: Regulatory classification of the violation or non-conformance that triggered the CAP (e.g., HACCP deviation, pesticide MRL exceedance, GAP non-compliance, food safety, environmental permit, worker safety). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: haccp_deviation|mrl_exceedance|gap_noncompliance|food_safety|environmental_permit|worker_safety|labeling|record_keeping|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: HACCP Codex Alimentarius; FSMA; EPA; OSHA; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: parent_corrective_action_plan_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on corrective_action_plan (parent_corrective_action_plan_id)

Serves as the SSOT for pesticide use regulatory reporting — distinct from crop.protection_event which is the operational agronomic record.

attributes.name: application_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the pesticide was applied to the field or crop. This is the principal real-world event date for the PUR and is required for PHI and REI compliance calculations. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 8; 40 CFR Part 171; USDA NASS pesticide use survey; GLOBALG.A.P. CB.7

attributes.name: application_end_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the pesticide application was completed. The REI (Restricted Entry Interval) clock begins at this time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: EPA Worker Protection Standard (WPS) 40 CFR Part 170; REI compliance tracking

attributes.name: application_equipment_type
attributes.description: Type of equipment used for the pesticide application (e.g., boom sprayer, airblast sprayer, aerial applicator, backpack sprayer, drip system). Relevant for calibration records, drift risk assessment, and equipment compliance documentation.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA; GLOBALG.A.P. CB.7.6; State Department of Agriculture equipment calibration requirements

attributes.name: application_method
attributes.description: The method used to apply the pesticide (e.g., ground broadcast, aerial, chemigation, soil injection, spot treatment, band application). Required for PUR submissions and environmental impact assessments. Must be an approved method per the product label.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA label compliance; State Department of Agriculture PUR requirements; GLOBALG.A.P. CB.7.6

attributes.name: application_rate
attributes.description: The quantity of pesticide product applied per unit area (e.g., oz/acre, fl oz/acre, lb/acre, pt/acre) as specified on the label and actually applied. Used to verify label compliance and calculate total quantity applied. Must not exceed label maximum rate.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA label compliance; GLOBALG.A.P. CB.7.6; State Department of Agriculture PUR requirements

attributes.name: application_rate_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the application rate (e.g., oz/acre, fl oz/acre, lb/acre). Must align with the pesticide product label specifications and state PUR reporting requirements.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA label requirements; State Department of Agriculture PUR reporting; USDA measurement standards

attributes.name: application_start_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the pesticide application began. Used for REI (Restricted Entry Interval) compliance tracking — the REI clock starts at application completion. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: EPA Worker Protection Standard (WPS) 40 CFR Part 170; REI compliance tracking

attributes.name: applicator_certification_category
attributes.description: EPA or state-defined certification category under which the applicator is licensed (e.g., Agricultural Plant, Ornamental and Turf, Right-of-Way, Aquatic). Determines which pesticide use categories the applicator is authorized to perform. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: agricultural_plant|ornamental_turf|right_of_way|aquatic|fumigation|seed_treatment|forest|public_health — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 11; 40 CFR Part 171 Subpart C; State Department of Agriculture certification categories

attributes.name: applicator_name
attributes.description: Full name of the certified or licensed pesticide applicator who performed the application. Required for regulatory PUR submissions and audit readiness. Distinct from the applicator license number.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 11; State Department of Agriculture PUR requirements; GLOBALG.A.P. CB.7.6

attributes.name: area_treated
attributes.description: Total land area treated during this pesticide application, expressed in acres. Required for PUR submissions and used to verify total quantity applied calculations. May differ from total field area if only a portion was treated.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA; State Department of Agriculture PUR requirements; GLOBALG.A.P. CB.7.6

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this pesticide use record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and regulatory submission timeliness verification. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX audit trail requirements; FSMA recordkeeping; EPA FIFRA recordkeeping

attributes.name: crop_growth_stage
attributes.description: The growth stage of the crop at the time of pesticide application (e.g., V4, R1, pre-emergence, post-emergence, flowering). Critical for PHI compliance calculations and label-compliance verification, as some products have growth-stage restrictions.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA label compliance; GLOBALG.A.P. CB.7.6; BBCH scale for crop growth stages

attributes.name: crop_treated
attributes.description: The crop or commodity to which the pesticide was applied (e.g., corn, soybeans, wheat, tomatoes). Must be an approved use site listed on the EPA-registered product label. Required for MRL compliance and state PUR reporting.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA label compliance; Codex Alimentarius MRL standards; FDA 21 CFR; State Department of Agriculture PUR requirements

attributes.name: pesticide_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pesticide by its primary mode of action or target pest category. Used for IPM (Integrated Pest Management) reporting, environmental compliance, and regulatory categorization.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA pesticide classification; USDA NASS pesticide use survey; IPM program reporting

attributes.name: phi_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pesticide application complies with the Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) requirement on the product label, based on the application date and planned harvest date. True = PHI compliance confirmed; False = PHI violation detected. Critical for food safety and MRL compliance.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA label requirements; FDA MRL enforcement; FSMA Produce Safety Rule; GLOBALG.A.P. CB.7.6

attributes.name: phi_days
attributes.description: The Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) in days as specified on the pesticide product label for the crop treated. Defines the minimum number of days that must elapse between the last application and harvest. Used to calculate the earliest allowable harvest date.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA label requirements; FDA MRL enforcement; GLOBALG.A.P. CB.7.6; USDA NOP (for organic)

attributes.name: pur_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this pesticide use record, used in regulatory submissions and audit trails. May be assigned by the state department of agriculture or generated internally per FMIS convention.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA; California DPR PUR Program; State Department of Agriculture reporting requirements

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the pesticide use record within the regulatory reporting workflow. 'draft' indicates in-progress entry; 'submitted' indicates filed with the regulatory authority; 'accepted' indicates confirmed by the authority; 'rejected' indicates returned for correction; 'amended' indicates a corrected resubmission.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA; State Department of Agriculture PUR submission workflows

attributes.name: rei_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the REI (Restricted Entry Interval) was observed following this pesticide application. True = REI compliance confirmed (no workers entered the treated area before the REI expired); False = REI violation detected. Critical for worker safety compliance under EPA WPS.
attributes.references: EPA Worker Protection Standard (WPS) 40 CFR Part 170; OSHA 29 CFR 1928.110; GLOBALG.A.P. CB.7.6

attributes.name: rei_hours
attributes.description: The Restricted Entry Interval (REI) in hours as specified on the pesticide product label. Defines the minimum time that must elapse after application before workers may re-enter the treated area without PPE. Used to calculate the earliest safe re-entry timestamp.
attributes.references: EPA Worker Protection Standard (WPS) 40 CFR Part 170; EPA FIFRA label requirements; OSHA 29 CFR 1928.110

attributes.name: reporting_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation for the state in which the pesticide application occurred and to which the PUR must be reported. Determines applicable state-specific reporting requirements and deadlines.
attributes.references: State Department of Agriculture PUR requirements; EPA FIFRA state primacy provisions

attributes.name: restricted_use_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pesticide product is classified as a Restricted Use Pesticide (RUP) by the EPA. RUPs may only be purchased and applied by certified applicators. True = RUP; False = general use pesticide. Critical for applicator license validation.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA Section 3(d); 40 CFR Part 152 Subpart I; State Department of Agriculture RUP requirements

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this pesticide use record originated (e.g., Trimble Ag Software, Climate FieldView, Granular Farm Management, John Deere Operations Center, SAP S/4HANA, or manual entry). Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: FSMA recordkeeping; SOX data lineage requirements; enterprise data governance standards

attributes.name: state_reporting_code
attributes.description: State-specific code or identifier required for pesticide use reporting to the state department of agriculture (e.g., California DPR county code, Florida DACS site code). Varies by state and is required for state-level PUR submissions.
attributes.references: California DPR PUR Program; Florida DACS pesticide reporting; State Department of Agriculture PUR requirements

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which this pesticide use record was submitted to the relevant regulatory authority (EPA or state department of agriculture). Used to verify timely filing compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA recordkeeping requirements; State Department of Agriculture PUR submission deadlines

attributes.name: target_pest
attributes.description: The specific pest, disease, or weed targeted by this pesticide application (e.g., corn rootworm, powdery mildew, Palmer amaranth). Must be an approved use listed on the EPA-registered product label. Required for IPM (Integrated Pest Management) program documentation.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA label compliance; USDA IPM program; GLOBALG.A.P. CB.7.6

attributes.name: total_quantity_applied
attributes.description: Total amount of pesticide product applied during this application event, expressed in the unit defined by total_quantity_unit. Calculated as application rate × area treated. Required for state PUR submissions and inventory reconciliation.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA; California DPR PUR reporting; State Department of Agriculture PUR requirements

attributes.name: total_quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the total quantity of pesticide product applied (e.g., oz, fl oz, lb, gal). Must be consistent with the application rate unit and product label.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA label requirements; State Department of Agriculture PUR reporting

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this pesticide use record was last modified. Tracks amendments and corrections to the regulatory record. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX audit trail requirements; FSMA recordkeeping; EPA FIFRA recordkeeping
