attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on pesticide_use_record (parent_pesticide_use_record_id)

products.name: food_safety_plan
products.description: Master record for FSMA-mandated food safety plans including Preventive Controls for Human Food (PCHF), Preventive Controls for Animal Food (PCAF), and Produce Safety Rule (PSR) food safety plans. Captures plan ID, plan type, facility covered, plan version, effective date, qualified facility exemption status, hazard analysis summary, preventive controls defined, monitoring procedures, corrective action procedures, verification activities, recall plan reference, plan approval date, approver credentials, and FDA submission status. Serves as the regulatory SSOT for FSMA food safety plan management.
products.reference: FSMA Preventive Controls Food Safety Plan

attributes.name: employee_id

attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117.126 — Qualified Individual

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the registered food facility covered by this food safety plan. A single facility may have multiple versioned plans over time.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart H — Food Facility Registration

attributes.name: farm_unit_id

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: recall_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the associated product recall plan document that is incorporated by reference into this food safety plan.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117.139 — Recall Plan

attributes.name: allergen_control_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether allergen preventive controls are required under this food safety plan, based on the presence of major food allergens as defined by FALCPA and FASTER Act.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117.135(c)(2) — Allergen Controls; FALCPA; FASTER Act 2021

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Preventive Controls Qualified Individual (PCQI) formally signed off and approved this food safety plan version.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117.126(a) — PCQI sign-off requirement

attributes.name: biological_hazard_identified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the hazard analysis identified one or more biological hazards (e.g., pathogens such as Salmonella, E. coli O157:H7, Listeria monocytogenes) requiring preventive controls.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117.130(a)(1)(i); FDA Hazard Analysis guidance

attributes.name: chemical_hazard_identified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the hazard analysis identified one or more chemical hazards (e.g., pesticide residues exceeding Maximum Residue Limits (MRL), mycotoxins, allergens, cleaning chemical residues) requiring preventive controls.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117.130(a)(1)(ii); EPA MRL standards

attributes.name: corrective_action_summary
attributes.description: Summary of corrective action procedures to be taken when preventive controls are not properly implemented or a deviation occurs, including product disposition and root cause analysis steps.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117.150 — Corrective Actions and Corrections

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this food safety plan record was first created in the system, providing the audit trail creation point for compliance and data governance purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FSMA 21 CFR Part 117.300 — Records

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this version of the food safety plan became operative and binding for the covered facility. Aligns with FSMA compliance date requirements.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117.126; 21 CFR Part 507

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this version of the food safety plan expires or is scheduled for mandatory reanalysis. Null for open-ended plans subject to event-triggered reanalysis only.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117.170 — Reanalysis every 3 years

attributes.name: facility_registration_number
attributes.description: FDA-issued food facility registration number for the facility covered by this plan, as required under the Bioterrorism Act and FSMA. Used to link the plan to the registered facility in FDA systems.
attributes.references: 21 CFR Part 1 Subpart H — Food Facility Registration; FSMA Section 102

attributes.name: fda_reference_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Reference Number
attributes.description: FDA-assigned reference or acknowledgment number for the submitted food safety plan, used for tracking regulatory correspondence and inspection readiness.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; FDA Food Facility Registration

attributes.name: fda_submission_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Submission Date
attributes.description: Date on which this food safety plan or associated documentation was formally submitted to the FDA.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; FDA Electronic Submissions Gateway

attributes.name: fda_submission_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Submission Status
attributes.description: Current status of the food safety plan's submission to the FDA. 'not_required' applies to qualified facility exemptions; 'acknowledged' indicates FDA receipt confirmation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: not_required|pending|submitted|acknowledged|under_review|accepted|rejected — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; FDA Electronic Submissions Gateway

attributes.name: gfsi_certification_scheme
attributes.business_glossary_term: Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI) Certification Scheme
attributes.description: Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI)-recognized certification scheme under which the facility is certified, if applicable. This scheme may satisfy or complement FSMA food safety plan requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SQF|BRC|IFS|FSSC22000|GLOBALG.A.P.|PRIMUS|NONE — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GFSI Benchmarking Requirements; SQF Code; BRC Global Standard; IFS Food Standard; ISO 22000

attributes.name: hazard_analysis_summary
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) Hazard Analysis Summary
attributes.description: Summary narrative of the hazard analysis conducted for this food safety plan, identifying known or reasonably foreseeable biological, chemical, and physical hazards associated with the food and process.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117.130 — Hazard Analysis; Codex Alimentarius HACCP principles

attributes.name: last_reanalysis_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent formal reanalysis of this food safety plan was completed, as required by FSMA reanalysis provisions.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117.170

attributes.name: monitoring_procedure_summary
attributes.description: Summary description of the monitoring procedures established for preventive controls in this plan, including what is monitored, how, frequency, and responsible personnel.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117.145 — Monitoring

attributes.name: pcqi_credential
attributes.description: Credential or training certification held by the PCQI, such as FSPCA Preventive Controls for Human Food training certificate number, demonstrating qualification to prepare the food safety plan.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117.126(a)(2); FSPCA PCQI Training Program

attributes.name: pcqi_name
attributes.description: Full name of the Preventive Controls Qualified Individual (PCQI) responsible for preparing or overseeing the preparation of this food safety plan, as required by FSMA.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117.126(a)(2) — PCQI requirement

attributes.name: physical_hazard_identified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the hazard analysis identified one or more physical hazards (e.g., metal fragments, glass, stones, bone) requiring preventive controls.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117.130(a)(1)(iii); FDA Defect Action Levels guidance

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the food safety plan, used in regulatory submissions, audit documentation, and cross-referencing with FDA records. Format: FSP-{FacilityCode}-{Year}.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117; FDA Food Safety Plan Builder guidance

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the food safety plan. 'active' indicates the plan is in force; 'superseded' indicates a newer version has replaced it; 'withdrawn' indicates the plan was retracted prior to activation.
attributes.references: FSMA 21 CFR Part 117.126; FDA Food Safety Plan lifecycle guidance

attributes.name: plan_title

attributes.name: qualified_facility_exempt

attributes.name: record_retention_years

attributes.name: sanitation_control_required

attributes.name: scope_description

attributes.name: supply_chain_control_required

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date

attributes.name: corrective_action_required

attributes.references: EPA NPDES permit framework; 40 CFR Part 122.41; Clean Water Act Section 309; ISO 14001

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this permit condition record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance record-keeping requirements.

attributes.name: exceedance_count
attributes.description: The cumulative number of times this permit condition limit has been exceeded during the current permit term. Tracks violation history for regulatory reporting, enforcement risk assessment, and permit renewal negotiations.
attributes.references: EPA NPDES permit framework; Clean Water Act Section 309; 40 CFR Part 122.41

attributes.name: is_numeric_limit
attributes.description: Indicates whether this permit condition has a quantitative numeric limit value (True) or is a narrative/qualitative condition without a numeric threshold (False). Determines whether limit_value and limit_unit fields are applicable.
attributes.references: EPA NPDES permit framework; 40 CFR Part 122

attributes.name: last_monitoring_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent sampling or monitoring event was conducted for this permit condition. Used to calculate next due date and assess whether monitoring is current.
attributes.references: EPA NPDES permit framework; 40 CFR Part 122.44; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems

attributes.name: last_reported_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent regulatory report submission covering this permit condition. Used to confirm reporting currency and identify overdue submissions.
attributes.references: EPA NPDES permit framework; 40 CFR Part 122.41(l); EPA eDMR system

attributes.name: last_reported_value
attributes.description: The most recently measured or reported value for the monitored parameter under this condition. Enables quick comparison against the limit value to assess current compliance without querying the monitoring results table.
attributes.references: EPA NPDES permit framework; EPA eDMR reporting; 40 CFR Part 122

attributes.name: limit_type
attributes.description: Specifies the averaging or aggregation period for the numeric limit value (e.g., daily maximum, monthly average, weekly average, instantaneous maximum, annual load). Determines how measured values are compared against the regulatory threshold.
attributes.references: EPA NPDES permit framework; 40 CFR Part 122.45; Clean Water Act

attributes.name: limit_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measurement for the limit value (e.g., mg/L, lbs/day, kg/year, CFU/100mL, pH units, MGD — million gallons per day). Must align with the unit used in sampling and reporting to ensure valid compliance comparison.
attributes.references: EPA NPDES permit framework; 40 CFR Part 136; EPA eDMR reporting standards

attributes.name: limit_value
attributes.description: The numeric threshold value that must not be exceeded (or must be met) for this permit condition. Represents the regulatory limit for the monitored parameter (e.g., 10.0 mg/L for total nitrogen). Null for non-numeric narrative conditions.
attributes.references: EPA NPDES permit framework; 40 CFR Part 122; Clean Water Act effluent guidelines

attributes.name: monitoring_frequency
attributes.description: The required frequency at which sampling or monitoring must be performed for this condition (e.g., daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, continuous). Drives the compliance calendar and sampling schedule for field operations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: daily|weekly|biweekly|monthly|quarterly|semiannual|annual|continuous|event_based — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA NPDES permit framework; 40 CFR Part 122.44; CAFO regulations 40 CFR Part 412

attributes.name: narrative_condition_text
attributes.description: The full text of the permit condition as written in the permit document, particularly for narrative or qualitative conditions that cannot be expressed as a numeric limit. Provides the authoritative regulatory language for compliance interpretation.
attributes.references: EPA NPDES permit framework; 40 CFR Part 122; Clean Water Act; CAFO regulations

attributes.name: next_monitoring_due_date
attributes.description: The calculated or scheduled date by which the next monitoring or sampling event must be completed for this condition. Drives compliance calendar scheduling and field operations planning.
attributes.references: EPA NPDES permit framework; 40 CFR Part 122.44; ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, regulatory interpretations, compliance observations, or operational notes related to this permit condition. Used by compliance officers to document nuances not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems; EPA NPDES permit framework; FSMA compliance framework

attributes.name: parameter_code
attributes.description: The standardized EPA or regulatory agency parameter code for the monitored substance or characteristic (e.g., EPA STORET parameter codes). Enables integration with regulatory reporting systems and electronic discharge monitoring reports (eDMR).
attributes.references: EPA STORET/WQX parameter codes; 40 CFR Part 136; EPA eDMR system

attributes.name: parameter_name
attributes.description: The specific environmental or chemical parameter being regulated or monitored under this condition (e.g., Total Nitrogen, Total Phosphorus, Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD), Total Suspended Solids (TSS), pH, Ammonia, E. coli, flow rate). Aligns with EPA analytical parameter codes.
attributes.references: EPA NPDES permit framework; 40 CFR Part 136; Clean Water Act Section 402; USDA NRCS 590 Nutrient Management Standard

attributes.name: regulatory_citation
attributes.description: The specific regulatory code, statute, or rule citation that authorizes or mandates this permit condition (e.g., '40 CFR Part 122.44', 'Clean Water Act Section 402', 'State Admin Code Chapter NR 200'). Supports legal review and audit readiness.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR; Clean Water Act; Clean Air Act; CAFO regulations; FSMA

attributes.name: reporting_deadline_day
attributes.description: The day of the month by which the monitoring report or discharge monitoring report (DMR) must be submitted to the regulatory agency (e.g., 28 = 28th of the month following the monitoring period). Used to generate compliance calendar alerts.
attributes.references: EPA NPDES permit framework; 40 CFR Part 122.41(l); EPA eDMR reporting requirements

attributes.name: reporting_frequency
attributes.description: The required frequency for submitting compliance reports or discharge monitoring reports (DMR) to the regulatory agency. May differ from monitoring frequency (e.g., monitor weekly but report monthly).
attributes.references: EPA NPDES permit framework; 40 CFR Part 122.41(l); CAFO regulations 40 CFR Part 412

attributes.name: sampling_location
attributes.description: Description of the designated sampling point or monitoring location as specified in the permit (e.g., 'Outfall 001', 'Influent to lagoon', 'Field tile drain at property boundary'). Corresponds to the outfall or monitoring point identifier in the permit document.

attributes.name: sampling_method
attributes.description: The prescribed analytical or field sampling method required for this condition (e.g., grab sample, 24-hour composite, flow-proportional composite, continuous monitoring). References EPA-approved test methods under 40 CFR Part 136.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 136; Standard Methods for the Examination of Water and Wastewater; USDA NRCS

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: The identifier or record reference from the originating operational system of record (e.g., SAP S/4HANA QM module document number, Granular Farm Management compliance record ID) from which this permit condition record was sourced. Supports data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: exceedance_magnitude
attributes.description: The numeric difference between the measured_value and the permit_limit_value when an exceedance occurs (measured_value minus permit_limit_value). Quantifies the severity of the permit violation for enforcement and corrective action prioritization.

attributes.name: flow_rate
attributes.description: The volumetric flow rate of the discharge or water body at the time of sampling, expressed in the unit specified by the permit (e.g., MGD, GPM, CFS). Required for load calculations (mass per day) and flow-weighted composite sample interpretation.
attributes.references: EPA NPDES DMR Reporting; 40 CFR Part 122.45(f); Clean Water Act Section 301

attributes.name: flow_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the discharge flow rate (e.g., MGD = million gallons per day, GPM = gallons per minute, CFS = cubic feet per second). Required for accurate load calculations and DMR reporting.
attributes.references: EPA NPDES DMR Reporting; 40 CFR Part 122.45(f)

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate (WGS84 decimal degrees) of the sample collection point. Enables GIS-based spatial analysis of monitoring results, watershed mapping, and integration with Esri ArcGIS for environmental monitoring visualization.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate (WGS84 decimal degrees) of the sample collection point. Used with latitude for spatial analysis, watershed delineation, and regulatory mapping of monitoring locations.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Spatial Reference; WGS84 Datum; EPA Facility Registry Service (FRS)

attributes.name: measured_value
attributes.description: The quantitative analytical result for the monitored parameter as reported by the laboratory. This is the principal measured outcome of the monitoring event. Null if the result is non-detect (below detection limit).
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 136; ISO/IEC 17025 Laboratory Competence; Standard Methods

attributes.name: monitoring_type
attributes.description: Classification of the environmental monitoring category for this result. Determines the applicable regulatory framework, permit conditions, and reporting requirements. attributes.description: Indicates whether the parameter was not detected above the reporting detection limit. True = result is reported as non-detect (ND) or less-than value. When True, measured_value is null and the reporting_detection_limit serves as the upper bound.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 136; NPDES DMR Reporting Guidance; Standard Methods

attributes.name: parameter_code
attributes.description: Standardized regulatory code identifying the specific chemical, biological, or physical parameter measured (e.g., EPA parameter code for Total Nitrogen, Total Phosphorus, BOD5, pH, fecal coliform, nitrates). Aligns with EPA NPDES parameter codes for DMR reporting.
attributes.references: EPA NPDES Parameter Codes; 40 CFR Part 136; Codex Alimentarius MRL standards

attributes.name: parameter_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the environmental parameter measured (e.g., 'Total Nitrogen', 'Biochemical Oxygen Demand (BOD5)', 'pH', 'Total Suspended Solids', 'Nitrate-Nitrogen'). Complements the parameter_code for reporting and analytics.
attributes.references: EPA NPDES Parameter Codes; Standard Methods for the Examination of Water and Wastewater

attributes.name: permit_limit_type

attributes.references: EPA NPDES Permit Program; 40 CFR Part 122.45(d); EPA TSD for Water Quality-Based Toxics Control

attributes.name: permit_limit_value
attributes.description: The numeric threshold established in the environmental permit for this parameter at this monitoring location. The measured_value is compared against this limit to determine compliance status and exceedance.
attributes.references: EPA NPDES Permit Program; 40 CFR Part 122.45; Clean Water Act Section 301

attributes.name: reporting_detection_limit
attributes.description: The practical quantitation limit (PQL) or minimum level (ML) used for regulatory reporting purposes, typically higher than the MDL. Determines whether a result is reported as a numeric value or as a non-detect qualifier.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 136; NPDES Permit Compliance Monitoring; California Title 22

attributes.name: reporting_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the regulatory reporting period to which this monitoring result belongs. Together with reporting_period_start, defines the compliance window for DMR and permit condition reporting.

attributes.name: reporting_period_start

attributes.references: EPA NPDES DMR Reporting; 40 CFR Part 122.41(l); FSMA Subpart O

attributes.name: result_number

attributes.name: sample_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the environmental sample was physically collected in the field. This is the principal real-world event date for the monitoring result, distinct from laboratory analysis date or record creation date.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 136; USDA NRCS Conservation Practice Standards

attributes.name: sample_location_code
attributes.description: Permit-defined code or identifier for the specific sampling point or monitoring station where the sample was collected (e.g., outfall 001, well MW-3, field tile drain TD-7). Corresponds to the monitoring location defined in the permit.
attributes.references: EPA NPDES Permit Outfall Numbering; 40 CFR Part 122 Appendix E

attributes.name: sample_location_description
attributes.description: Descriptive name or narrative for the sample collection point, providing human-readable context beyond the location code (e.g., 'North field tile drain at county road crossing', 'Lagoon effluent discharge point').
attributes.references: EPA NPDES Permit Program; USDA NRCS Field Office Technical Guide

attributes.name: sample_matrix
attributes.description: The environmental medium or matrix from which the sample was collected. Determines applicable analytical methods, holding times, and regulatory limits. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: effluent|surface_water|groundwater|soil|air|manure|sediment — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 136; Standard Methods for the Examination of Water and Wastewater; SW-846

attributes.name: sample_time
attributes.description: Precise date and time at which the environmental sample was collected, including timezone offset. Required for time-sensitive parameters such as dissolved oxygen, temperature, and pH where diurnal variation is significant.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 136; Standard Methods for the Examination of Water and Wastewater

attributes.name: sample_type
attributes.description: Method by which the sample was collected. Grab samples represent instantaneous conditions; composite samples represent time- or flow-weighted averages. Blanks and duplicates are quality control samples. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: grab|composite_24hr|composite_flow_weighted|field_duplicate|equipment_blank|trip_blank — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 136; Standard Methods for the Examination of Water and Wastewater; EPA NPDES Permit Monitoring Requirements

attributes.name: sampler_name
attributes.description: Name of the certified individual or technician who collected the environmental sample in the field. Required for Chain of Custody documentation and regulatory defensibility of sampling procedures.
attributes.references: EPA Chain of Custody Procedures; NPDES Permit Compliance; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the measured_value is expressed (e.g., mg/L, ug/L, CFU/100mL, pH units, lbs/day, ppm, ppb). Must align with the unit specified in the permit condition for direct comparability.
attributes.references: EPA NPDES DMR Reporting; 40 CFR Part 136; SI/ISO 80000 measurement units

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this monitoring result record. Supports data lineage tracking, audit readiness, and change management for regulatory compliance records.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ISO 14001:2015 Clause 7.5; FSMA Record-Keeping Requirements

attributes.name: parent_monitoring_result_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on monitoring_result (parent_monitoring_result_id)

attributes.name: aphis_permit_number

attributes.description: USDA APHIS-issued permit number for the import or export of regulated agricultural commodities, plants, animals, or biological materials. Required for APHIS-regulated species and products.

attributes.name: border_entry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the shipment arrived at the port of entry or border inspection point. Used to calculate compliance timelines and FDA Prior Notice submission windows.

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Official certificate or permit number assigned by the issuing regulatory authority. Used for tracking, verification, and cross-referencing with government databases.

attributes.name: certificate_type

Examples include phytosanitary certificate, USDA APHIS export certificate, FDA Prior Notice, CITES permit, health certificate, fumigation certificate, organic certificate, and country-of-origin certificate. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: phytosanitary|aphis_export|fda_prior_notice|cites_permit|health_certificate|fumigation_certificate|organic_certificate|country_of_origin — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cites_permit_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species (CITES) Permit Number
attributes.description: CITES permit number issued for trade in species listed under the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora. Required for regulated species in agricultural trade (e.g., certain timber, plants, wildlife).
attributes.references: CITES Convention; USDA APHIS; U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional compliance observations, regulatory correspondence references, corrective action details, or special handling instructions related to this trade compliance record.
attributes.references: Internal Compliance SOP; FSMA; USDA APHIS; FDA

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current regulatory compliance status of the trade record. Reflects the outcome of inspections, document reviews, and authority approvals. 'held' indicates a customs or border inspection hold; 'released' indicates clearance.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; FDA; CBP; FSMA Compliance Framework

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this trade compliance record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); FSMA; GDPR Article 5; ISO 22000

attributes.name: customs_broker_license
attributes.description: CBP-issued license number of the customs broker responsible for this trade compliance filing. Required for regulatory accountability and audit trail.
attributes.references: CBP 19 CFR Part 111; CBP Broker Management Branch

attributes.name: customs_broker_name
attributes.description: Name of the licensed customs broker or freight forwarder engaged to manage the customs clearance and regulatory compliance filing for this shipment.
attributes.references: CBP 19 CFR Part 111; NCBFAA (National Customs Brokers and Forwarders Association of America)

attributes.name: declared_value_usd
attributes.description: Declared customs value of the shipment in US dollars, as reported on the customs entry for duty assessment purposes. Used for tariff calculation and trade statistics reporting.
attributes.references: CBP 19 CFR Part 152; WTO Customs Valuation Agreement; USDA Foreign Agricultural Service (FAS)

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country to which the agricultural commodity is being exported or imported.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; USDA APHIS; FDA; CBP

attributes.name: duty_rate_pct
attributes.description: Applicable customs duty rate expressed as a percentage of the declared customs value, as determined by the HS code, trade agreement, and country of origin. Used for duty cost calculation and trade agreement benefit tracking.
attributes.references: CBP Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS); USTR; WTO

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory certificate or permit expires and is no longer valid for customs clearance or border inspection. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; FDA; CITES; IPPC

attributes.name: fda_prior_notice_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Prior Notice Number
attributes.description: FDA-assigned confirmation number for the Prior Notice filing submitted before importation of food or feed products, as required under FSMA and 21 CFR Part 1. Null for non-food/feed shipments or exports.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 1; FSMA (Food Safety Modernization Act); FDA Prior Notice System Interface (PNSI)

attributes.name: hold_reason
attributes.description: Detailed description of the reason for any customs or border inspection hold placed on the shipment. Captures the specific regulatory violation, documentation deficiency, or pest/disease finding that triggered the hold.
attributes.references: CBP; USDA APHIS PPQ; FDA; FSIS

attributes.name: hold_release_date
attributes.description: Date on which a customs or border inspection hold was officially released and the shipment was cleared for entry or export. Null if no hold was placed or if the hold has not yet been resolved.
attributes.references: CBP; USDA APHIS PPQ; FDA; FSIS

attributes.name: hold_type
attributes.description: Type of hold or detention placed on the shipment by a customs or border inspection authority. 'none' indicates no hold. Used to track compliance issues and resolution timelines.
attributes.references: CBP; USDA APHIS PPQ; FDA; FSIS; FSMA

attributes.name: is_gmo
attributes.description: Indicates whether the commodity contains or is derived from genetically modified organisms (GMOs). Relevant for import/export compliance in jurisdictions with GMO labeling or restriction requirements.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS Biotechnology Regulatory Services; EPA; FDA; Codex Alimentarius; EU Regulation 1829/2003

attributes.name: is_organic_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the commodity covered by this trade compliance record is certified organic under the USDA National Organic Program (NOP) or an equivalent foreign organic certification recognized by USDA.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP); 7 CFR Part 205; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service (AMS)

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory certificate or permit was officially issued by the issuing authority. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; FDA; IPPC; ISO 22000

attributes.name: issuing_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country whose authority issued the certificate or permit.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; USDA APHIS; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: mrl_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the commodity has been verified to comply with the Maximum Residue Limits (MRLs) for pesticide residues as established by the destination country's regulatory authority (e.g., EPA, Codex Alimentarius, EU MRL regulations).
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 180; Codex Alimentarius MRL Database; EU Regulation 396/2005; USDA Agricultural Marketing Service

attributes.name: net_weight_kg
attributes.description: Net weight of the commodity covered by this trade compliance record, expressed in kilograms. Used for customs valuation, duty calculation, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: CBP; WCO; USDA APHIS; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the agricultural commodity was grown, produced, or substantially transformed. Required for Country of Origin Labeling (COOL) compliance.
attributes.references: USDA COOL (Country of Origin Labeling); ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; CBP 19 CFR Part 102; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: phytosanitary_cert_number
attributes.description: Official phytosanitary certificate number issued by the national plant protection organization (NPPO) of the exporting country, certifying that plants and plant products meet the phytosanitary requirements of the importing country.
attributes.references: IPPC (International Plant Protection Convention); USDA APHIS PPQ; ISPM 12 (International Standards for Phytosanitary Measures)

attributes.name: port_of_entry_code
attributes.description: Official CBP or IATA port code identifying the port of entry or exit through which the shipment crosses the border (e.g., 'LAX', '2704' for CBP port codes).
attributes.references: CBP Schedule D Port Codes; IATA; USDA APHIS PPQ

attributes.name: record_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this trade compliance record, used in correspondence with regulatory authorities, brokers, and trading partners. Format: TCR-{COUNTRY_CODE}-{YEAR}-{SEQUENCE}.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; FDA; CBP (U.S. Customs and Border Protection)

attributes.name: shipment_date
attributes.description: Principal real-world date on which the agricultural commodity was shipped or departed from the origin point. Serves as the primary business event date for this compliance record.
attributes.references: CBP; USDA APHIS; FDA Prior Notice 21 CFR Part 1; BOL (Bill of Lading) standards

attributes.name: trade_agreement_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the applicable free trade agreement or preferential trade arrangement governing this shipment (e.g., USMCA, CPTPP, CAFTA-DR). Determines preferential duty rates and certificate-of-origin requirements.
attributes.references: USTR (United States Trade Representative); CBP; USDA Foreign Agricultural Service (FAS); WTO

attributes.name: trade_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment is an import into the domestic market, an export to a foreign market, a re-export of previously imported goods, or a transit movement through a country.
attributes.references: USDA APHIS; FDA Prior Notice (21 CFR Part 1); CBP Regulations

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this trade compliance record was last modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, audit readiness, and Silver layer incremental processing.

Enables proactive regulatory change management and compliance calendar updates.

attributes.name: affects_crop_operations

attributes.name: affects_export_operations

attributes.name: affects_livestock_operations
attributes.description: Indicates whether this regulatory change impacts livestock breeding, animal husbandry, feed management, or veterinary practices. Used to route changes to the livestock compliance team.

attributes.name: affects_processing_operations
attributes.description: Indicates whether this regulatory change impacts food processing, packaging, labeling, or manufacturing operations. Used to route changes to the food safety and processing compliance team.

attributes.name: assigned_owner

attributes.name: assigned_owner_department
attributes.description: Business department or functional unit of the assigned regulatory affairs owner (e.g., 'Regulatory Affairs', 'Food Safety & Quality', 'Environmental Compliance', 'Trade Compliance').

attributes.name: change_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known reference number or docket number assigned by the issuing regulatory body (e.g., Federal Register docket number, EPA rule number, USDA APHIS docket ID). Serves as the primary cross-reference to official regulatory publications.
attributes.references: Federal Register Act; USDA Regulatory Agenda; EPA Docket Management System

attributes.name: change_type
attributes.description: Classification of the type of regulatory change being tracked. 'new_rule' = entirely new regulation; 'amendment' = modification to existing rule; 'repeal' = removal of existing rule; 'guidance_update' = non-binding guidance document update; 'interim_rule' = temporary rule pending final rulemaking; 'proposed_rule' = rule open for public comment.
attributes.references: Federal Register Act; Administrative Procedure Act (APA); USDA Regulatory Agenda

attributes.name: comment_period_deadline
attributes.description: Deadline date for submitting public comments on a proposed or interim rule. Applicable when change_type is 'proposed_rule' or 'interim_rule'. Null for final rules.
attributes.references: Administrative Procedure Act (APA); Federal Register; EPA Docket Management

attributes.name: compliance_deadline
attributes.description: The specific date by which the enterprise must achieve full compliance with the regulatory change. May differ from the effective date when phased compliance schedules or small-entity exemptions apply (e.g., FSMA tiered compliance dates).
attributes.references: FSMA; FDA 21 CFR Part 112; USDA APHIS; EPA FIFRA

attributes.name: cost_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the estimated compliance cost (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'CAD'). Supports multi-currency reporting for international operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS; GAAP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this regulatory change record was first created in the compliance management system. Supports audit trail and compliance calendar management.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory change becomes legally effective and enforceable. Operations must be compliant by this date unless a separate compliance deadline is specified.
attributes.references: Administrative Procedure Act (APA); FSMA; EPA 40 CFR; FDA 21 CFR

attributes.name: estimated_compliance_cost
attributes.description: Estimated total cost (in USD) for the enterprise to achieve compliance with this regulatory change, including capital expenditures (CAPEX), operational expenditures (OPEX), training, consulting, and system modification costs.
attributes.references: GAAP; IFRS; Internal Financial Planning; CAPEX/OPEX Framework

attributes.name: federal_register_citation
attributes.description: Official Federal Register or state register citation for the regulatory change publication (e.g., '88 FR 12345', 'Vol. 88, No. 45, p. 12345'). Enables direct traceability to the source regulatory document.
attributes.references: Federal Register Act; Office of the Federal Register

attributes.name: fsma_rule_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Rule Reference
attributes.description: Specific FSMA rule or subpart reference if this regulatory change is related to the Food Safety Modernization Act framework (e.g., 'Produce Safety Rule', 'Preventive Controls for Human Food', 'Foreign Supplier Verification Program').
attributes.references: FSMA (Public Law 111-353); FDA 21 CFR Parts 112, 117, 507; FSIS

attributes.name: gmo_labeling_impact
attributes.business_glossary_term: Genetically Modified Organism (GMO) Labeling Impact Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this regulatory change affects Genetically Modified Organism (GMO) disclosure or labeling requirements under the National Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard or equivalent regulations.
attributes.references: USDA National Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard (7 CFR Part 66); FDA; COOL

attributes.name: impact_level
attributes.description: Assessed severity of the regulatory change's impact on enterprise operations. 'critical' = immediate operational halt risk or major capital investment required; 'high' = significant process changes required; 'medium' = moderate process adjustments; 'low' = minor documentation or administrative updates.
attributes.references: Internal Compliance Risk Framework; GFSI; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: impact_summary
attributes.description: Narrative summary of the assessed business impact of the regulatory change on agricultural operations, including affected processes, required operational changes, estimated compliance costs, and risk exposure if non-compliant.
attributes.references: FSMA Compliance Framework; GFSI; Internal Compliance SOP

attributes.name: internal_comment_submitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the enterprise has submitted formal public comments during the comment period for a proposed or interim rule. Supports tracking of regulatory engagement activities.
attributes.references: Administrative Procedure Act (APA); Federal Register; Internal Government Affairs Policy

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this regulatory change record was most recently modified. Tracks the currency of the compliance information and supports audit readiness.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: mrl_impact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this regulatory change modifies Maximum Residue Limits (MRL) for pesticides or other agricultural chemicals on food commodities. Triggers review of pesticide application programs and pre-harvest intervals (PHI).
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA; Codex Alimentarius MRL Database; FDA 21 CFR Part 180; EU Regulation 396/2005

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, legal counsel observations, industry association guidance, or supplementary information relevant to this regulatory change that does not fit structured fields.
attributes.references: Internal Compliance Management SOP

attributes.name: organic_certification_impact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this regulatory change affects USDA National Organic Program (NOP) certification requirements, allowed/prohibited substances lists, or organic handling standards.
attributes.references: USDA National Organic Program (NOP); 7 CFR Part 205; IFOAM Organic Standards

attributes.name: penalty_risk_amount
attributes.description: Estimated maximum financial penalty or fine exposure (in the cost_currency) if the enterprise fails to comply with this regulatory change by the compliance deadline. Used for risk quantification and prioritization.
attributes.references: FSMA; EPA FIFRA; USDA APHIS; OSHA; FDA 21 CFR; Internal Risk Management Framework

attributes.name: permit_license_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this regulatory change requires the enterprise to obtain new permits, licenses, or certifications (e.g., pesticide applicator license, environmental discharge permit, food facility registration update).
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA; Clean Water Act NPDES; FDA Food Facility Registration; USDA APHIS Permits

attributes.name: phi_rei_impact
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) / Restricted Entry Interval (REI) Impact Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this regulatory change modifies Pre-Harvest Interval (PHI) or Restricted Entry Interval (REI) requirements for pesticide applications. Triggers updates to crop protection schedules and worker safety protocols.
attributes.references: EPA FIFRA; OSHA Worker Protection Standard (WPS); 40 CFR Part 170

attributes.name: publication_date
attributes.description: Date the regulatory change was officially published in the Federal Register, state register, or equivalent official publication. Marks the start of the compliance awareness timeline.
attributes.references: Federal Register Act; Administrative Procedure Act (APA)

attributes.name: regulation_code
attributes.description: Standardized code or citation for the regulation (e.g., CFR title and part reference such as '21 CFR Part 112', '40 CFR Part 180', '7 CFR Part 205'). Used for precise regulatory cross-referencing.
attributes.references: Code of Federal Regulations (CFR); Federal Register

attributes.name: regulation_name
attributes.description: Official name or title of the regulation, rule, or guidance document being changed or introduced (e.g., 'FSMA Produce Safety Rule', 'FIFRA Pesticide Registration Amendment', 'USDA National Organic Program Update').
attributes.references: FSMA; FIFRA; USDA NOP; FDA 21 CFR; EPA 40 CFR

attributes.name: regulatory_domain

attributes.references: FSMA; FIFRA; Clean Water Act; OSHA; USDA NOP; APHIS; FSIS; IFRS; GAAP

attributes.name: required_response_actions
attributes.description: Narrative description of the specific internal actions required to achieve compliance with this regulatory change (e.g., SOP updates, training programs, system configuration changes, permit applications, label revisions, capital investments).
attributes.references: FSMA; GFSI; GLOBALG.A.P.; Internal Compliance SOP

attributes.name: response_due_date
attributes.description: Internal deadline by which the enterprise must complete its response actions (e.g., SOP updates, training, system changes). May be set earlier than the regulatory compliance_deadline to allow buffer time for implementation and verification.
attributes.references: Internal Compliance Calendar; GFSI; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: review_status
attributes.description: Current internal workflow status of the regulatory change review process. attributes.references: Internal Compliance Management SOP; GFSI Compliance Framework

attributes.name: sop_update_required

attributes.description: Indicates whether existing Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) must be revised or new SOPs created to comply with this regulatory change. Triggers document control workflow.

attributes.name: appeal_deadline
attributes.description: The deadline by which the enterprise must file a formal appeal or contest of the violation with the issuing agency or administrative tribunal. Null if the appeal period has passed or no appeal is applicable. Critical for legal and compliance calendar management.
attributes.references: EPA Administrative Procedures; USDA FSIS; FDA; Administrative Procedures Act (APA)

attributes.name: compliance_schedule_due_date
attributes.description: The final deadline by which all compliance schedule milestones must be completed as required by the enforcement action or consent order. Null if no compliance schedule was imposed. Used for compliance calendar management and audit readiness.
attributes.references: EPA Compliance Schedule Policy; USDA FSIS; FSMA; Clean Water Act

attributes.name: compliance_schedule_imposed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal compliance schedule was imposed as part of the enforcement action, requiring the enterprise to achieve compliance milestones by specified dates. True if a compliance schedule is in effect; False otherwise.
attributes.references: EPA Compliance Schedule Policy; USDA FSIS; FSMA; Clean Water Act Section 309

attributes.name: consent_order_reference
attributes.description: The reference number or identifier of any consent order, consent decree, or settlement agreement associated with this violation. A consent order is a legally binding agreement between the enterprise and the regulatory agency specifying corrective actions and timelines. Null if no consent order was issued.
attributes.references: EPA Consent Decree Program; USDA FSIS; Clean Water Act; FSMA

attributes.name: contested
attributes.description: Indicates whether the enterprise has formally contested or appealed the violation with the issuing agency or through administrative or judicial proceedings. True if contested; False if accepted. Used for legal case management and regulatory relationship tracking.
attributes.references: EPA Administrative Hearing Procedures; USDA FSIS; FDA Administrative Procedures Act

attributes.name: corrective_action_completed_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which all required corrective actions were completed and verified. Null if corrective actions are still in progress. Used to measure compliance response time and demonstrate regulatory good faith.
attributes.references: FSMA; HACCP; EPA Enforcement; USDA FSIS; GLOBALG.A.P.; ISO 22000

attributes.name: corrective_action_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the corrective actions required or undertaken to remediate the violation and achieve regulatory compliance. May include process changes, equipment upgrades, training requirements, or operational modifications mandated by the agency or adopted voluntarily.
attributes.references: FSMA CAPA Requirements; HACCP Corrective Action; GLOBALG.A.P.; SQF; BRC Global Standards; ISO 22000

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which corrective actions must be completed and documented to satisfy the regulatory agency's requirements. Used for compliance calendar tracking and escalation management.
attributes.references: FSMA; HACCP; EPA Enforcement; USDA FSIS; GLOBALG.A.P.; ISO 22000

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this violation record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the audit trail creation point for data lineage and compliance documentation purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SOX; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the penalty amounts (e.g., USD for US Dollar). Supports international operations where penalties may be assessed in foreign currencies.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS; GAAP

attributes.name: environmental_impact_category
attributes.description: Classification of the environmental medium or resource impacted by the violation (air, water, soil, wildlife, none, or multiple). Used for environmental compliance reporting, EPA program alignment, and sustainability impact assessment.
attributes.references: EPA Environmental Justice; Clean Water Act; Clean Air Act; RCRA; ISO 14001 Environmental Management

attributes.name: final_penalty_amount
attributes.description: The final agreed or adjudicated monetary penalty amount after negotiation, settlement, consent order, or appeal, expressed in USD. May differ from the proposed penalty amount. Used for financial reporting, OPEX tracking, and regulatory cost analysis.
attributes.references: EPA Civil Penalty Policy; USDA FSIS; FSMA; GAAP; IFRS IAS 37 (Provisions)

attributes.name: food_safety_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether the violation is related to food safety requirements under FSMA, HACCP, FSIS, or GFSI-recognized standards (SQF, BRC, IFS, GLOBALG.A.P.). True if the violation has food safety implications; False otherwise. Used for FSMA compliance tracking and food safety audit readiness.
attributes.references: FSMA; HACCP; FSIS; GFSI; SQF; BRC Global Standards; IFS; GLOBALG.A.P.; ISO 22000; Codex Alimentarius

attributes.name: issuing_agency_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Jurisdictional level of the issuing regulatory agency (federal, state, county, or municipal). Determines the applicable legal framework and escalation path for enforcement actions.
attributes.references: USDA; EPA; FDA; FSMA; State Agriculture Departments

attributes.name: legal_counsel_assigned
attributes.description: Indicates whether internal or external legal counsel has been assigned to manage this violation, enforcement action, or appeal. True if legal counsel is engaged; False otherwise. Used for legal resource planning and case management.
attributes.references: Internal Legal SOP; SOX Compliance; GAAP ASC 450

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, internal commentary, legal notes, or supplementary information related to the violation record that does not fit into structured fields. Used by compliance officers and legal teams for case management.
attributes.references: Internal Compliance SOP

attributes.name: notice_issued_date
attributes.description: The date on which the formal Notice of Violation (NOV), citation, or enforcement action was officially issued by the regulatory agency. May differ from the violation date if the agency conducted an investigation prior to issuing the notice.
attributes.references: EPA NOV Procedures; USDA FSIS Enforcement; FSMA

attributes.name: operation_type
attributes.description: The type of agricultural operation or business function cited in the violation (e.g., crop production, livestock, food processing, storage and handling, transportation, pesticide application, water management, organic certification). Enables domain-specific compliance analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: crop_production|livestock|food_processing|storage_handling|transportation|pesticide_application|water_management|organic_certification|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA; FDA FSMA; EPA; FSIS; APHIS

attributes.name: penalty_payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the final penalty payment was made to the regulatory agency. Null if payment has not yet been made. Used for financial reconciliation and compliance documentation.
attributes.references: EPA; USDA FSIS; GAAP; IFRS IAS 37

attributes.name: penalty_payment_status
attributes.description: Current payment status of the final assessed penalty. Tracks whether the penalty has been paid in full, partially paid, waived by the agency, deferred under a compliance schedule, or remains unpaid. Used for accounts payable reconciliation and regulatory standing reporting.
attributes.references: EPA Enforcement; USDA FSIS; GAAP ASC 450 (Contingencies); IFRS IAS 37

attributes.name: proposed_penalty_amount
attributes.description: The initial monetary penalty amount proposed by the regulatory agency at the time of the violation notice or enforcement action, expressed in USD. Represents the agency's initial assessment before negotiation, settlement, or appeal. Used for financial exposure tracking and legal strategy.
attributes.references: EPA Civil Penalty Policy; USDA FSIS Penalty Schedule; FSMA Section 302; FIFRA Section 14

attributes.name: public_disclosure_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the violation or enforcement action requires public disclosure under applicable regulations (e.g., EPA Toxic Release Inventory, USDA public enforcement records, SEC material disclosure requirements for publicly traded entities). True if public disclosure is required; False otherwise.
attributes.references: EPA TRI Reporting; USDA Public Enforcement Records; SOX Section 302; SEC Disclosure Rules; GDPR

attributes.name: regulation_citation
attributes.description: The specific Code of Federal Regulations (CFR) citation, statute, or regulatory standard that was violated (e.g., 40 CFR Part 122 for NPDES permits, 21 CFR Part 112 for produce safety, 7 CFR Part 205 for organic certification). Enables precise regulatory tracking and legal reference.
attributes.references: Code of Federal Regulations (CFR); FSMA; Clean Water Act; FIFRA; FFDCA; USDA NOP

attributes.name: regulation_program
attributes.description: The regulatory program or framework under which the violation was issued (e.g., FSMA Produce Safety Rule, NPDES Stormwater Program, FIFRA Pesticide Registration, HACCP, NOP Organic Certification, CAFO Permit Program). Supports compliance program-level reporting and trend analysis.
attributes.references: FSMA; EPA NPDES; FIFRA; USDA NOP; HACCP; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: repeat_violation
attributes.description: Indicates whether this violation is a repeat occurrence of a previously cited violation at the same facility or operation. True if this is a repeat violation; False if it is a first-time occurrence. Repeat violations typically result in elevated penalties and heightened regulatory scrutiny.
attributes.references: EPA Penalty Policy (Gravity Component); USDA FSIS; FSMA; FIFRA Section 14

attributes.name: responsible_party_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual, manager, or organizational unit within the enterprise identified as responsible for the violation or accountable for corrective action. Used for internal accountability tracking and regulatory correspondence.
attributes.references: USDA FSIS; EPA; OSHA; Internal Compliance SOP

attributes.name: severity_level
attributes.description: Legal classification of the violation severity. Criminal violations involve willful or knowing violations subject to prosecution; civil violations involve monetary penalties; administrative violations are regulatory infractions handled within agency processes; informal violations are advisory notices without formal penalty.
attributes.references: EPA Civil Penalty Policy; USDA FSIS Enforcement; FSMA; Clean Water Act; FIFRA

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this violation record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change tracking, audit trail maintenance, and data freshness monitoring in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SOX; GDPR Article 5; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: violation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the regulatory violation occurred or was observed. This is the principal real-world event date, distinct from the date the notice was issued or the record was created. Used for compliance calendar tracking and statute of limitations calculations.
attributes.references: FSMA; EPA Enforcement Policy; USDA FSIS Enforcement

attributes.name: violation_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the regulatory violation as documented by the issuing agency or internal compliance team. Includes the specific non-compliant condition, practice, or omission observed. Used for root cause analysis, corrective action planning, and audit documentation.
attributes.references: FSMA; EPA Enforcement; USDA FSIS; GLOBALG.A.P.; SQF; BRC Global Standards

attributes.name: violation_number
attributes.description: Externally-assigned unique identifier for the violation as issued by the regulatory agency (e.g., NOV number, citation number, enforcement case number). Used for cross-referencing with agency records and legal correspondence.
attributes.references: EPA Enforcement and Compliance; USDA FSIS Enforcement Actions

attributes.name: violation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the violation record, tracking its progression from issuance through resolution. Valid values: open (newly issued, no action taken), under_review (internal or legal review in progress), contested (formally disputed with the agency), resolved (corrective action accepted by agency), closed (fully resolved and documented), appealed (formal appeal filed).
attributes.references: EPA Enforcement and Compliance Assurance; USDA FSIS; FSMA

attributes.name: violation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the formal enforcement instrument issued by the regulatory agency. Distinguishes between informal notices (warning letters), administrative citations, consent orders, stop-sale orders, recall orders, and criminal referrals. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: notice_of_violation|citation|warning_letter|consent_order|stop_sale_order|recall_order|administrative_order|criminal_referral|injunction — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EPA Enforcement Policy; FDA Warning Letters; USDA FSIS; FSMA Section 302

attributes.name: willful_violation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the regulatory agency classified the violation as willful or knowing, which triggers higher penalty tiers and potential criminal referral. True if classified as willful; False otherwise. Relevant for OSHA, EPA, and USDA enforcement actions.
attributes.references: OSHA Willful Violation Standard; EPA Criminal Enforcement; FSMA; FIFRA Section 14(b)

Serves as the SSOT for recall event management.

attributes.name: consignee_count
attributes.description: Total number of consignees (direct customers, distributors, retailers) who received the recalled product and must be notified. Used to track notification completeness and recall effectiveness.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7.49; USDA FSIS Recall Effectiveness Checks

attributes.name: consignee_notification_status
attributes.description: Status of direct notification to all consignees (distributors, retailers, food service operators) who received the recalled product. Tracks whether all downstream recipients have been contacted per FDA/FSIS requirements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7.49; USDA FSIS Recall Notification; FSMA

attributes.name: corrective_action_description
attributes.description: Description of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) implemented to address the root cause and prevent recurrence of the recall event. Required for regulatory closure and GFSI certification maintenance.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; ISO 22000 Section 10; GFSI; SQF; BRC Global Standards; GLOBALG.A.P.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the recall event record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; ISO 22000

attributes.name: disposition_date
attributes.description: Date on which the recalled product disposition (destruction, reconditioning, return) was completed and verified.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7; USDA FSIS Recall Policy

attributes.name: distribution_scope
attributes.description: Geographic scope of product distribution affected by the recall — Nationwide, Regional, State-level, Local, International, or Export Only. Determines the breadth of consumer notification and consignee outreach required.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7; USDA FSIS Recall Notification; COOL

attributes.name: distribution_states
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of US state codes (2-letter USPS abbreviations) or country codes (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3) where the recalled product was distributed. Supports targeted consignee notification and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7; USDA FSIS Recall Notification; ISO 3166-1

attributes.name: effectiveness_check_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent recall effectiveness check was conducted by FDA, FSIS, or the recalling firm.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7.53; USDA FSIS Recall Effectiveness Check Procedures

attributes.name: effectiveness_check_result
attributes.description: Result of the FDA/FSIS recall effectiveness check — assessment of whether the recall communication reached all affected consignees and whether recalled product has been removed from commerce. Satisfactory result is required for recall closure.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7.53; USDA FSIS Recall Effectiveness Check Procedures

attributes.name: estimated_financial_impact
attributes.description: Estimated total financial impact of the recall event in US dollars, including product write-off value, logistics costs, regulatory fees, and operational disruption. Used for financial reporting (GAAP/IFRS), insurance claims, and CAPEX/OPEX impact analysis.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 450; IFRS IAS 37; SOX Financial Reporting Controls

attributes.name: fda_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the FDA was formally notified of the recall event. Required for FDA-regulated products under 21 CFR Part 7 and FSMA Section 423 mandatory recall provisions.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7.46; FSMA Section 423

attributes.name: fda_notification_status
attributes.description: Current status of FDA notification for this recall event — Pending (not yet submitted), Notified (submitted to FDA), Acknowledged (FDA confirmed receipt), or Not Required (product not under FDA jurisdiction).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7; FSMA Section 423

attributes.name: fsis_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which USDA FSIS was formally notified of the recall event. Required for meat, poultry, and egg products regulated under FSIS jurisdiction.
attributes.references: USDA FSIS Recall Policy; 9 CFR Part 418; FSIS Directive 8080.1

attributes.name: fsis_notification_status
attributes.description: Current status of USDA FSIS notification for this recall event — Pending, Notified, Acknowledged, or Not Required (product not under FSIS jurisdiction).
attributes.references: USDA FSIS Recall Policy; FSIS Directive 8080.1

attributes.name: fsma_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this recall event is subject to mandatory reporting requirements under the Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) Section 423 mandatory recall authority.
attributes.references: FSMA Section 423; FDA 21 CFR Part 7

attributes.name: hazard_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the specific hazard or defect that triggered the recall, including pathogen strain, chemical name, allergen type, or foreign material description as applicable.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7; USDA FSIS Recall Policy; HACCP

attributes.name: hazard_type
attributes.description: Category of food safety hazard that prompted the recall — biological (e.g., Salmonella, Listeria), chemical (e.g., pesticide residue exceeding MRL, mycotoxin), physical (e.g., foreign material), allergen (undeclared allergen), or radiological contamination.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; HACCP Hazard Analysis; Codex Alimentarius; USDA FSIS HACCP Rule

attributes.name: initiating_trigger
attributes.description: Root cause or triggering event that initiated the recall — e.g., consumer complaint, laboratory test result (pathogen, pesticide MRL exceedance), regulatory directive, or internal audit finding. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Consumer Complaint|Laboratory Result|Regulatory Directive|Internal Audit|Supplier Notification|Adverse Event Report|Routine Inspection — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7; HACCP; FSMA; USDA FSIS Recall Policy

attributes.name: insurance_claim_filed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a product recall insurance claim has been filed with the insurer for this recall event.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 450; IFRS IAS 37; SOX

attributes.name: lot_numbers
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of lot/batch numbers (LOT) subject to this recall. Lot numbers are the primary traceability identifiers linking production batches to distribution records and consumer products.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA Traceability Rule; USDA FSIS Recall Policy; GS1 Traceability Standards

attributes.name: notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the recall was formally initiated and first notifications were issued to consignees, distributors, and/or the public. This is the principal business event date for the recall lifecycle.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7.46; USDA FSIS Recall Notification Requirements

attributes.name: press_release_date
attributes.description: Date on which the public press release was issued for this recall event. Null if no press release has been issued.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7.50; USDA FSIS Public Notification

attributes.name: press_release_issued
attributes.description: Indicates whether a public press release has been issued for this recall event. Class I recalls typically require public press releases; Class II and III may or may not depending on regulatory guidance.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7.50; USDA FSIS Recall Public Notification Policy

attributes.name: product_disposition
attributes.description: Final disposition method for the recalled product — Destruction (product destroyed under regulatory supervision), Reconditioning (product reworked to meet safety standards), Return to Supplier, Diversion (redirected to non-food use), or Pending (disposition not yet determined).
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7; USDA FSIS Recall Policy; FSMA

attributes.name: quantity_recalled
attributes.description: Total quantity of product subject to recall, expressed in the unit of measure specified in quantity_uom. Includes all affected lots across all distribution channels.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7; USDA FSIS Recall Effectiveness Checks

attributes.name: quantity_recovered
attributes.description: Total quantity of recalled product that has been physically recovered or accounted for through returns, destruction, or reconditioning as of the last effectiveness check. Used to calculate recall effectiveness rate.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7.53; USDA FSIS Recall Effectiveness Checks

attributes.name: quantity_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the recalled quantity — e.g., LB (pounds), KG (kilograms), MT (metric ton), CWT (hundredweight), BU (bushel), CS (cases), EA (each), GAL (gallons). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: LB|KG|MT|CWT|BU|CS|EA|GAL|L — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service; FDA 21 CFR Part 7; NIST Handbook 44

attributes.name: recall_class
attributes.description: FDA/USDA FSIS classification indicating the health hazard severity: Class I — reasonable probability of serious adverse health consequences or death; Class II — remote probability of adverse health consequences; Class III — unlikely to cause adverse health consequences.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7.3; USDA FSIS Recall Classification

attributes.name: recall_closure_date
attributes.description: Date on which the recall was formally closed by the regulatory authority (FDA or USDA FSIS) following satisfactory effectiveness checks and completion of all required corrective actions.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7.55; USDA FSIS Recall Closure Procedures

attributes.name: recall_number
attributes.description: Externally assigned recall identifier issued by FDA or USDA FSIS (e.g., FDA recall number or FSIS recall case number). Used for cross-referencing with regulatory agency records and public announcements.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7.46; USDA FSIS Recall Case Number

attributes.name: recall_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the recall event, tracking progression from initiation through effectiveness checks to formal closure or termination.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7; USDA FSIS Recall Procedures

attributes.name: recall_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the recall was initiated voluntarily by the firm, mandated by a regulatory authority (FDA/USDA FSIS), or classified as a market withdrawal or stock recovery action.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7.3; USDA FSIS Recall Policy; FSMA Section 423

attributes.name: recalled_product_name
attributes.description: Commercial name of the product subject to recall as it appears on the product label and in regulatory notifications. May differ from the internal product master name.
attributes.references: FDA 21 CFR Part 7.46; USDA FSIS Recall Notification; COOL

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative of the confirmed root cause of the recall event — e.g., process control failure, supplier ingredient contamination, labeling error, equipment malfunction. Supports CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: FDA FSMA; HACCP; ISO 22000; GFSI; SQF; BRC Global Standards

attributes.name: upc_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of Universal Product Codes (UPC) or Price Look-Up (PLU) codes associated with the recalled product SKUs, used for consumer-facing identification and retail point-of-sale removal.
attributes.references: GS1 UPC Standard; FDA 21 CFR Part 7; COOL

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the recall event record was last modified. Supports audit trail, change tracking, and Silver Layer data freshness monitoring.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; ISO 22000

attributes.name: parent_recall_event_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on recall_event (parent_recall_event_id)

products.name: recall_lot
products.description: Association record linking specific commodity lots, product lots, or inventory positions to an active recall event. Captures recall lot ID, recall event reference, lot number, commodity or product reference, quantity affected, storage location, current disposition status (quarantined, returned, destroyed, reconditioned, cleared), customer notification status, and lot recovery confirmation. Enables granular lot-level traceability management during a recall and supports FDA/FSIS effectiveness check reporting.
products.reference: Recall Lot Traceability Record

attributes.name: recall_lot_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each recall lot association record linking a specific commodity or product lot to an active recall event.
