attributes.name: buffer_zone_adequate_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the buffer zone assessment confirmed that adequate separation exists between certified organic production areas and adjacent non-organic operations to prevent prohibited substance contamination.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.202(c)

attributes.name: buffer_zone_assessment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the buffer zone between certified organic fields and adjacent conventional or non-organic operations was last formally assessed. Buffer zones protect organic crops from prohibited substance drift and contamination.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.202(c); GLOBALG.A.P. Organic Standard

attributes.name: buffer_zone_notes
attributes.description: Narrative notes from the buffer zone assessment, including observations about adjacent land use, drift risk factors, physical barriers, and any recommended corrective measures to maintain organic integrity.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.202(c); USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.103

attributes.name: certified_acres
attributes.description: Total acreage of land under certified organic production covered by this compliance record. Used for USDA NOP reporting, Organic Integrity Database submissions, and yield benchmarking.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.201(a)(1); USDA Organic Integrity Database

attributes.name: certifying_agent_name
attributes.description: Name of the USDA-accredited certifying agent organization responsible for certifying and auditing this organic operation. Retained as a denormalized reference for reporting and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.501; USDA Organic Integrity Database

attributes.name: compliance_activity_date
attributes.description: The principal real-world date on which the compliance activity, assessment, or submission captured in this record occurred. Used as the primary business event date for compliance calendar management.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.103

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional compliance observations, certifying agent comments, operational context, or documentation references relevant to this organic compliance record that are not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.103

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this organic compliance record. 'open' indicates active monitoring period; 'under_review' indicates certifying agent review in progress; 'compliant' indicates all NOP requirements met; 'non_compliant' indicates a violation identified; 'suspended' indicates certification suspended pending investigation; 'closed' indicates record period concluded.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.662; GLOBALG.A.P. Organic Standard

attributes.name: compliance_year
attributes.description: The calendar year (YYYY) for which this organic compliance record applies. Aligns with the annual certification renewal cycle under the USDA National Organic Program.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.406

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this organic compliance record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SOX Section 404; FSMA Recordkeeping Requirements

attributes.name: gmo_contamination_risk_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Genetically Modified Organism (GMO) Contamination Risk Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a risk of Genetically Modified Organism (GMO) contamination has been identified for this operation during the compliance period. GMO use is prohibited in certified organic production under USDA NOP.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.105(e); USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.202

attributes.name: input_materials_reviewed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether all agricultural inputs (fertilizers, pesticides, soil amendments, livestock feed additives) used during the compliance period have been reviewed and confirmed as compliant with the USDA NOP National List of Allowed and Prohibited Substances.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.105; USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.601-606

attributes.name: inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent on-site inspection conducted by the certifying agent at the certified organic operation. Annual on-site inspections are required under USDA NOP to verify compliance with the Organic System Plan.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.403

attributes.name: inspection_outcome
attributes.description: Result of the most recent on-site inspection by the certifying agent. 'pass' indicates full compliance; 'pass_with_conditions' indicates minor deficiencies requiring corrective action; 'fail' indicates material non-compliance; 'pending_review' indicates inspection report under certifying agent review.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.403; USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.662

attributes.name: nop_violation_category
attributes.description: Category of NOP regulatory violation identified during this compliance period, if applicable. Examples include prohibited substance use, recordkeeping deficiency, labeling non-compliance, or OSP deviation. Null when no violation exists. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: prohibited_substance|recordkeeping|labeling|osp_deviation|commingling|buffer_zone|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.662; USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.663

attributes.name: nop_violation_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of any NOP regulatory violation identified during this compliance period, including the specific regulation cited, the nature of the non-conformance, and the affected production area or product.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.662; USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.663

attributes.name: operation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the certified organic operation type covered by this compliance record. Determines applicable NOP regulatory requirements and inspection protocols.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205 Subparts C and D; USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.2

attributes.name: organic_integrity_db_status
attributes.description: Status of the operation's data submission to the USDA Organic Integrity Database (OID). 'pending' indicates submission not yet made; 'submitted' indicates data transmitted; 'verified' indicates USDA confirmation received; 'discrepancy_flagged' indicates a data mismatch requiring resolution.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.501(a)(17); USDA Organic Integrity Database

attributes.name: organic_integrity_db_submission_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certifying agent submitted or updated the operation's certification data to the USDA Organic Integrity Database (OID), the publicly accessible registry of all USDA-certified organic operations.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.501(a)(17); USDA Organic Integrity Database

attributes.name: osp_submission_status
attributes.description: Current submission and review status of the Organic System Plan (OSP) with the certifying agent for this compliance year. Tracks whether the OSP has been drafted, submitted, accepted, returned for revision, or formally approved.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.201; USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.405

attributes.name: osp_update_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Organic System Plan (OSP) was last updated and submitted to the certifying agent. OSP updates are required whenever there is a change in practices, materials, or operation scope.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.201(c)

attributes.name: osp_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Organic System Plan (OSP) in effect at the time of this compliance record. The OSP is the foundational document describing all practices and substances used in the certified organic operation, required under USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.201.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.201

attributes.name: parallel_production_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the operation produces the same crop or product in both certified organic and non-organic (conventional) forms simultaneously. Parallel production requires enhanced split operation controls and documentation to prevent commingling.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.290; USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.272

attributes.name: prohibited_substance_description
attributes.description: Description of the prohibited substance(s) involved in an incident, including the substance name, application method, and circumstances of use or contamination. Populated only when prohibited_substance_incident_flag is True.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.105; USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.671

attributes.name: prohibited_substance_incident_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a prohibited substance use incident has been identified or reported for this operation during the compliance record period. True triggers mandatory investigation and potential certification suspension under USDA NOP regulations.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.671; USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.202

attributes.name: prohibited_substance_investigation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the investigation into a prohibited substance incident. 'not_applicable' when no incident exists; 'open' when investigation initiated; 'in_progress' when certifying agent review underway; 'resolved' when investigation concluded; 'escalated' when referred to USDA NOP for enforcement action.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.662; USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.671

attributes.name: record_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this compliance record, formatted as OCR-{YEAR}-{SEQUENCE}. Used in correspondence with certifying agents, USDA Organic Integrity Database submissions, and audit documentation.
attributes.references: USDA NOP Organic Integrity Database; USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205

attributes.name: recordkeeping_audit_result
attributes.description: Result of the certifying agent's review of the operation's organic recordkeeping system during the compliance period. USDA NOP requires operators to maintain records sufficient to demonstrate compliance for a minimum of five years.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.103; USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.403(b)

attributes.name: renewal_application_date
attributes.description: Date on which the annual organic certification renewal application was submitted to the certifying agent. Required annually to maintain continuous organic certification status under USDA NOP.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.406

attributes.name: renewal_decision_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certifying agent issued the final renewal decision (approved or denied) for the annual organic certification. Used to track certification continuity and compliance calendar deadlines.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.405; USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.406

attributes.name: split_operation_controls_documented
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required split operation management controls — including physical separation, equipment cleaning procedures, and audit trail documentation — have been formally documented in the Organic System Plan (OSP) for this compliance period.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.290; USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.201

attributes.name: split_operation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a split operation — one that produces, prepares, or handles both certified organic and non-certified products. Split operations require documented controls to prevent commingling and prohibited substance contact.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.290

attributes.name: transition_land_acres
attributes.description: Total acreage currently in the 36-month organic transition period required before land can be certified as organic under USDA NOP. Tracked separately from certified acres to manage transition timelines.
attributes.references: USDA NOP 7 CFR Part 205.202(b)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this organic compliance record was last modified. Used to track record currency, support incremental data loads in the Databricks Silver Layer, and satisfy audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SOX Section 404; FSMA Recordkeeping Requirements

attributes.name: parent_organic_compliance_record_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on organic_compliance_record (parent_organic_compliance_record_id)

Serves as the operational scheduling layer for compliance management — enabling proactive deadline tracking and workload planning across all regulatory obligations.

attributes.description: Job title or role designation of the assigned owner (e.g., Environmental Compliance Manager, Pesticide Applicator, Food Safety Coordinator). Supports workload planning and role-based compliance reporting.

attributes.description: Actual calendar date on which the compliance obligation was fulfilled, the filing was submitted, the permit was renewed, or the inspection was completed. Null if not yet completed. Used for on-time compliance rate analytics.

attributes.name: estimated_penalty_amount

attributes.name: non_compliance_risk

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: license_suspension|financial_penalty|operational_shutdown|product_recall|warning_letter|none — promote to reference product]

products.name: regulatory_agency

attributes.name: registration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the FDA facility registration. 'active' indicates a valid, current registration; 'suspended' indicates FDA has suspended the registration (facility cannot import/export food); 'cancelled' indicates voluntary or involuntary cancellation; 'pending' indicates initial submission awaiting FDA confirmation; 'expired' indicates the biennial renewal window has lapsed without renewal.
attributes.references: FDA Bioterrorism Act (Public Law 107-188); 21 CFR Part 1.230–1.235; FSMA Section 102

attributes.name: registration_submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which the initial FDA facility registration was submitted via the FDA Industry Systems (FIS) portal. Used to track the registration timeline and confirm compliance with pre-operation registration requirements.
attributes.references: FDA Bioterrorism Act (Public Law 107-188); 21 CFR Part 1.230

attributes.name: renewal_status
attributes.description: Current status of the biennial renewal process for this FDA facility registration. 'not_due' indicates the renewal window has not yet opened; 'submitted' indicates the renewal has been filed with FDA; 'confirmed' indicates FDA has confirmed the renewed registration; 'overdue' indicates the renewal deadline has passed without confirmation; 'waived' indicates a regulatory exemption applies.
attributes.references: FDA Bioterrorism Act (Public Law 107-188); FSMA Section 102; 21 CFR Part 1.230

attributes.name: renewal_submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which the biennial renewal application was submitted to the FDA. Used to confirm timely filing within the October 1 – December 31 renewal window of even-numbered years.
attributes.references: FDA Bioterrorism Act (Public Law 107-188); FSMA Section 102; 21 CFR Part 1.230

attributes.name: source_system_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier from the originating operational system of record (e.g., SAP S/4HANA QM module compliance record ID, or Granular Farm Management compliance tracking ID) from which this registration record was sourced or synchronized.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM Module; Granular Farm Management; Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: The date on which the FDA suspended this facility registration. A suspended registration prohibits the facility from importing food into the US and triggers immediate operational and supply chain impacts. Null if registration has never been suspended.
attributes.references: FDA Bioterrorism Act (Public Law 107-188); FSMA Section 102; 21 CFR Part 1.230

attributes.name: suspension_lifted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the FDA lifted the suspension of this facility registration, restoring the facility's authorization to operate. Null if the registration has never been suspended or if suspension is still active.
attributes.references: FDA Bioterrorism Act (Public Law 107-188); FSMA Section 102; 21 CFR Part 1.230

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason provided by the FDA for suspending the facility registration. Typically references a credible threat of serious adverse health consequences or death to humans or animals. Null if registration has never been suspended.
attributes.references: FDA Bioterrorism Act (Public Law 107-188); FSMA Section 102; 21 CFR Part 1.230

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this bioterrorism registration record was last modified in the data platform. Used to detect stale records, trigger renewal reminders, and support audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; FSMA Record Retention Requirements; ISO 22000; Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: us_agent_email
attributes.description: Email address of the designated US Agent for a foreign food facility. Used for FDA communications and emergency notifications. Required only for foreign facilities.
attributes.references: FDA Bioterrorism Act (Public Law 107-188); 21 CFR Part 1.240; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: us_agent_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the US Agent designated by a foreign food facility as required under the FDA Bioterrorism Act. The US Agent serves as the FDA's primary point of contact for the foreign facility. Required only for foreign facilities (is_foreign_facility = true).
attributes.references: FDA Bioterrorism Act (Public Law 107-188); 21 CFR Part 1.227; 21 CFR Part 1.240

attributes.name: us_agent_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the designated US Agent for a foreign food facility. The US Agent must be reachable by the FDA at all times during business hours. Required only for foreign facilities.
attributes.references: FDA Bioterrorism Act (Public Law 107-188); 21 CFR Part 1.240

attributes.name: parent_bioterrorism_registration_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on bioterrorism_registration (parent_bioterrorism_registration_id)

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `agriculture_ecm`.`_metrics`.`compliance_audit_finding`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Key compliance audit finding metrics for executive oversight."
  source: "`agriculture_ecm`.`compliance`.`audit_finding`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "audit_area"
      expr: audit_area
      comment: "Area of the audit (e.g., Food Safety, Environmental)."
    - name: "risk_rating"
      expr: risk_rating
      comment: "Risk rating assigned to the finding."
    - name: "finding_status"
      expr: finding_status
      comment: "Current status of the finding (e.g., Open, Closed)."
    - name: "facility_id"
      expr: facility_id
      comment: "Identifier of the facility where the finding originated."
    - name: "regulatory_agency_id"
      expr: regulatory_agency_id
      comment: "Regulatory agency overseeing the audit."
  measures:
    - name: "total_audit_findings"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of audit findings recorded."
    - name: "open_findings_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN finding_status <> 'Closed' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of audit findings that are not yet closed."
    - name: "average_days_to_close"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(closure_date, identified_date))
      comment: "Average number of days between finding identification and closure for closed findings."
$$
metric_views.description: Key compliance audit finding metrics for executive oversight.

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `agriculture_ecm`.`_metrics`.`compliance_corrective_action_plan`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Metrics on corrective action plans to track remediation efficiency and cost."
  source: "`agriculture_ecm`.`compliance`.`corrective_action_plan`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "cap_status"
      expr: cap_status
      comment: "Current status of the corrective action plan (e.g., Open, Closed)."
    - name: "facility_id"
      expr: facility_id
      comment: "Facility associated with the corrective action plan."
    - name: "regulatory_agency_id"
      expr: regulatory_agency_id
      comment: "Regulatory agency linked to the plan."
    - name: "severity_level"
      expr: severity_level
      comment: "Severity level assigned to the corrective action."
  measures:
    - name: "total_corrective_action_plans"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of corrective action plans created."
    - name: "completed_plans_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN closure_date IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Number of corrective action plans that have been completed (closed)."
    - name: "average_days_to_complete"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(closure_date, initiated_date))
      comment: "Average duration in days from plan initiation to closure for completed plans."
    - name: "total_estimated_remediation_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(estimated_remediation_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of estimated remediation costs across all plans."
    - name: "average_estimated_remediation_cost"
      expr: AVG(CAST(estimated_remediation_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average estimated remediation cost per plan."
$$
metric_views.description: Metrics on corrective action plans to track remediation efficiency and cost.

LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Key performance indicators for agrochemical product portfolio management"
  source: "`agriculture_ecm`.`product`.`agrochemical_product`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "product_type"
      expr: product_type
      comment: "Type of agrochemical product (e.g., herbicide, insecticide)"
    - name: "formulation_type"
      expr: formulation_type
      comment: "Formulation format of the product"
    - name: "manufacturer_name"
      expr: manufacturer_name
      comment: "Manufacturer of the agrochemical"
    - name: "registration_expiry_year"
      expr: YEAR(registration_expiry_date)
      comment: "Year when product registration expires"
    - name: "active_ingredient_name"
      expr: active_ingredient_name
      comment: "Name of the active ingredient"
    - name: "organic_approved_flag"
      expr: organic_approved_flag
      comment: "Flag indicating organic approval"
  measures:
    - name: "total_products"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of agrochemical products"
    - name: "total_active_ingredient_concentration"
      expr: SUM(CAST(active_ingredient_concentration AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Sum of active ingredient concentration across all products"
    - name: "avg_max_application_rate"
      expr: AVG(CAST(max_application_rate AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average maximum application rate"
    - name: "organic_approved_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN organic_approved_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Count of products with organic approval"
    - name: "omri_listed_count"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN omri_listed_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Count of products listed in OMRI"
    - name: "avg_package_size"
      expr: AVG(CAST(package_size AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average package size"
$$
metric_views.description: Key performance indicators for agrochemical product portfolio management
